namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.WinChartHelper.Shared
{
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class UltraLicenseBaseAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private string componentName;

		private ArrayList products;

		public string ComponentName => componentName;

		public abstract UltraProductInfoBase[] LicensedWithProducts { get; }

		internal UltraProductInfoBase[] AllProducts
		{
			get
			{
				if (products == null)
				{
					products = new ArrayList(3);
					LoadProductArray();
				}
				return (UltraProductInfoBase[])products.ToArray(typeof(UltraProductInfoBase));
			}
		}

		protected UltraLicenseBaseAttribute(string componentName)
		{
			if (!DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(GetType()))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_17"));
			}
			this.componentName = componentName;
		}

		private void LoadProductArray()
		{
			UltraProductInfoBase[] licensedWithProducts = LicensedWithProducts;
			if (licensedWithProducts == null || licensedWithProducts.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraProductInfoBase[] array = licensedWithProducts;
			foreach (UltraProductInfoBase ultraProductInfoBase in array)
			{
				if (!(ultraProductInfoBase is UltraProductInfo))
				{
					products.Add(ultraProductInfoBase);
					continue;
				}
				UltraProductInfo ultraProductInfo = (UltraProductInfo)ultraProductInfoBase;
				products.Add(ultraProductInfo);
				UltraProductInfoBase[] allNewerProducts = ultraProductInfo.AllNewerProducts;
				if (allNewerProducts != null && allNewerProducts.Length > 0)
				{
					products.AddRange(allNewerProducts);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	public interface IAnnotation
	{
		Location Location { get; set; }

		void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent);

		void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint);
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ChartCollectionObjectConverter))]
	public abstract class Annotation : IAnnotation, ICloneable
	{
		private IChartComponent _component;

		private bool _Visible = true;

		private Location _location;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public virtual IChartComponent Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _component;
			}
			set
			{
				_component = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20062_2")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		public virtual bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return _Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				_Visible = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_295")]
		public virtual Location Location
		{
			get
			{
				return _location;
			}
			set
			{
				_location = value;
				value?.SetComponent(Component);
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			Component = chartComponent;
			Location.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}

		protected Annotation()
		{
			Location = new Location();
		}

		public virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLocation()
		{
			return Location.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLocation()
		{
			Location = new Location();
		}

		public abstract void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent);

		public abstract void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint);

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public abstract Annotation Clone();

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return GetType().Name;
		}

		public static Point GetRenderPointFromParent(Primitive parent)
		{
			int x = -1;
			int y = -1;
			if (parent is Box)
			{
				Box box = (Box)parent;
				x = box.rect.Left + box.rect.Width / 2;
				y = box.rect.Top + box.rect.Height / 2;
			}
			else if (parent is Ellipse)
			{
				Ellipse ellipse = (Ellipse)parent;
				x = ellipse.p1.X + ellipse.p2.X / 2;
				y = ellipse.p1.Y + ellipse.p2.Y / 2;
			}
			else if (parent is DataPoint)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint = (DataPoint)parent;
				x = dataPoint.point.X;
				y = dataPoint.point.Y;
			}
			else if (parent is Polyline)
			{
				Polyline polyline = (Polyline)parent;
				if (polyline.points != null && polyline.points.Length > 0)
				{
					x = polyline.points[0].point.X;
					y = polyline.points[0].point.Y;
				}
			}
			else if (parent is Polygon)
			{
				Polygon polygon = (Polygon)parent;
				if (polygon.Points != null && polygon.Points.Length > 0)
				{
					int num = int.MaxValue;
					int num2 = int.MinValue;
					int num3 = int.MaxValue;
					int num4 = int.MinValue;
					Point[] points = polygon.Points;
					for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
					{
						Point point = points[i];
						num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, point.X);
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, point.Y);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
					}
					x = (num + num2) / 2;
					y = (num3 + num4) / 2;
				}
			}
			else if (parent is Wedge)
			{
				Wedge wedge = (Wedge)parent;
				Point point2 = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(wedge.Center, wedge.Radius / 2, Geometry.DegreeToRadian((int)(wedge.startAngle + wedge.angleSweep / 2f)));
				x = point2.X;
				y = point2.Y;
			}
			else if (parent is Line)
			{
				Line line = (Line)parent;
				Point midPoint = line.MidPoint;
				x = midPoint.X;
				y = midPoint.Y;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		protected void SetTextSetting(Text label)
		{
			label.FitsInBox = false;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources

	public interface IProvideChartComponent
	{
		IChartComponent ChartComponent { get; set; }
	}
	public interface IChartCollection : IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Annotations
{
	[ListBindable(false)]
	public class AnnotationCollection : CollectionBase, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private IChartComponent _component;

		IChartComponent IProvideChartComponent.ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return Component;
			}
			set
			{
				Component = value;
			}
		}

		internal IChartComponent Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _component;
			}
			set
			{
				_component = value;
			}
		}

		public IAnnotation this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (IAnnotation)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
				if (value is Annotation annotation)
				{
					annotation.SetComponent(Component);
				}
			}
		}

		public AnnotationCollection(IChartComponent component)
		{
			Component = component;
		}

		public int Add(IAnnotation annotation)
		{
			int result = base.List.Add(annotation);
			if (annotation is Annotation annotation2)
			{
				annotation2.SetComponent(Component);
			}
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Remove(IAnnotation annotation)
		{
			base.List.Remove(annotation);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public new void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveAt(index);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, IAnnotation annotation)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, annotation);
			if (annotation is Annotation annotation2)
			{
				annotation2.SetComponent(Component);
			}
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public AnnotationCollection Clone()
		{
			AnnotationCollection annotationCollection = new AnnotationCollection(Component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IAnnotation annotation = (IAnnotation)enumerator.Current;
					if (annotation is Annotation annotation2)
					{
						annotationCollection.Add(annotation2.Clone());
					}
					else
					{
						annotationCollection.Add(annotation);
					}
				}
				return annotationCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				if (PE == null)
				{
					PE = new PaintElement(value);
				}
				else
				{
					PE.Fill = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_300")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return _text;
			}
			set
			{
				_text = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_301")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public LabelStyle TextStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return _textStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				_textStyle = value;
				value?.SetComponent(Component);
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(PaintElementConverter))]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_302")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _pE;
			}
			set
			{
				_pE = value;
				value?.SetComponent(Component);
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public BoxAnnotation()
		{
			Border = new BorderAppearance();
			TextStyle = new LabelStyle();
			PE = new PaintElement();
			TextStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			TextStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			Height = -1;
			Width = -1;
		}

		public Size GetBoxSize()
		{
			int num = 4;
			SizeF sizeF = ((TextStyle == null) ? Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, DefaultConstants.D_TextFont) : ((!TextStyle.WrapText || Width < 0 || Height >= 0) ? Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, TextStyle.Font) : Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, TextStyle.Font, Width, null)));
			int height = ((Height >= 0) ? Height : ((int)(sizeF.Height + (float)num)));
			int width = ((Width >= 0) ? Width : ((int)(sizeF.Width + (float)num)));
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(parent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPointFromParent);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint)
		{
			if (scene == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size boxSize = GetBoxSize();
			Point location = new Point(renderPoint.X - boxSize.Width / 2, renderPoint.Y - boxSize.Height / 2);
			Box box = new Box(new Rectangle(location, boxSize));
			bool noUpdate = PE.GetNoUpdate();
			PE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			if (PE != null)
			{
				box.PE = PE;
				if (Border != null)
				{
					box.PE.StrokeWidth = Border.Thickness;
				}
			}
			if (Border != null)
			{
				box.PE.Stroke = Border.Color;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = Border.Color.A;
				box.Roundness = Border.CornerRadius;
				if (box.lineStyle == null)
				{
					box.lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
				}
				box.lineStyle.DrawStyle = Border.DrawStyle;
				if (box.PE != null && Border.Raised)
				{
					box.PE = box.PE.Clone();
					box.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Raise;
					box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				}
			}
			PE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate);
			Text text = new Text(box.rect, Text, TextStyle.Clone());
			SetTextSetting(text);
			if (text.labelStyle == null)
			{
				text.labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			}
			if (Width == -1 && TextStyle != null)
			{
				if (TextStyle.Dx < 0)
				{
					box.rect.X += TextStyle.Dx;
				}
				box.rect.Width += Math.Abs(TextStyle.Dx);
			}
			if (Height == -1 && TextStyle != null)
			{
				if (TextStyle.Dy < 0)
				{
					box.rect.Y += TextStyle.Dy;
				}
				box.rect.Height += Math.Abs(TextStyle.Dy);
			}
			int rotationAngle = 0;
			if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing)
			{
				rotationAngle = 90;
			}
			else if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing)
			{
				rotationAngle = -90;
			}
			else if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom)
			{
				rotationAngle = -TextStyle.RotationAngle;
			}
			box.RotationAngle = rotationAngle;
			scene.Add(box);
			scene.Add(text);
		}

		public override Annotation Clone()
		{
			BoxAnnotation boxAnnotation = new BoxAnnotation();
			if (Border != null)
			{
				boxAnnotation.Border = Border.Clone();
			}
			boxAnnotation.Text = Text;
			if (TextStyle != null)
			{
				boxAnnotation.TextStyle = TextStyle;
			}
			boxAnnotation.Height = Height;
			if (Location != null)
			{
				boxAnnotation.Location = Location.Clone();
			}
			if (PE != null)
			{
				boxAnnotation.PE = PE.Clone();
			}
			boxAnnotation.Width = Width;
			return boxAnnotation;
		}

		protected internal override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			if (PE != null)
			{
				PE.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			}
			if (TextStyle != null)
			{
				TextStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			}
			if (Border != null)
			{
				Border.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			}
		}
	}

			TextStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			Border.Color = Color.Black;
			Border.CornerRadius = 3;
		}

		private Size GetBubbleSize()
		{
			SizeF sizeF = ((TextStyle == null) ? Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, DefaultConstants.D_TextFont) : Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, TextStyle.Font));
			int height = ((Height >= 0) ? Height : ((int)((double)sizeF.Height * 1.1)));
			int width = ((Width >= 0) ? Width : ((int)((double)sizeF.Width * 1.1)));
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent)

		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(parent);
			Point renderPointFromParent2 = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(offsetParent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPointFromParent, renderPointFromParent2);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent, Point offsetPoint)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(parent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPointFromParent, offsetPoint);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint, Primitive offsetParent)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(offsetParent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPoint, renderPointFromParent);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint, Point offsetPoint)
		{
			Size bubbleSize = GetBubbleSize();
			int width = bubbleSize.Width;
			int height = bubbleSize.Height;
			int x = offsetPoint.X;
			int y = offsetPoint.Y;
			Rectangle bubbleRect = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
			RenderCallout(scene, renderPoint, bubbleRect);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint)
		{
			int num = 10;
			Size bubbleSize = GetBubbleSize();
			int width = bubbleSize.Width;
			int height = bubbleSize.Height;
			int x = renderPoint.X - width / 2;
			int y = renderPoint.Y - num - height;
			RenderCallout(bubbleRect: new Rectangle(x, y, width, height), scene: scene, calloutRoot: renderPoint);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeHeight()
		{
			return Height != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetHeight()
		{
			Height = -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			return Width != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWidth()
		{
			Width = -1;
		}

		private void RenderCallout(SceneGraph scene, Point calloutRoot, Rectangle bubbleRect)
		{
			Callout callout = new Callout();
			if (PE == null)
			{
				callout.PE = new PaintElement(Color.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				callout.PE = PE;
			}
			if (callout.PE.Fill == Color.Empty)
			{
				callout.PE.Fill = FillColor;
			}
			callout.Origin = calloutRoot;
			callout.BubbleRectangle = bubbleRect;
			if (callout.LineStyle == null)
			{
				callout.LineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			}
			if (Border != null)
			{
				callout.LineStyle.DrawStyle = Border.DrawStyle;
				callout.PE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				callout.PE.StrokeWidth = Border.Thickness;
				callout.PE.Stroke = Border.Color;
				callout.PE.StrokeOpacity = Border.Color.A;
				callout.PE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				callout.CornerRadius = Border.CornerRadius;
			}
			Text text = new Text(bubbleRect, Text, TextStyle.Clone());
			SetTextSetting(text);
			if (bubbleRect.Width > 0 && bubbleRect.Height > 0)
			{
				text.labelStyle.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				text.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
				text.labelStyle.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				scene.Add(callout);
				scene.Add(text);
			}
		}

		public override Annotation Clone()
		{
			CalloutAnnotation calloutAnnotation = new CalloutAnnotation();
			if (Location != null)
			{
				calloutAnnotation.Location = Location.Clone();
			}
			if (Border != null)
			{
				calloutAnnotation.Border = Border;
			}
			calloutAnnotation.Offset = base.Offset;
			calloutAnnotation.OffsetMode = base.OffsetMode;
			calloutAnnotation.Location = Location;
			calloutAnnotation.Height = Height;
			calloutAnnotation.Width = Width;
			calloutAnnotation.Text = Text;
			if (TextStyle != null)
			{
				calloutAnnotation.TextStyle = TextStyle.Clone();
			}
			if (PE != null)
			{
				calloutAnnotation.PE = PE.Clone();
			}
			return calloutAnnotation;
		}

		protected internal override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			PE.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			TextStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			Border.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}

		public EllipseAnnotation()
		{
			TextStyle = new LabelStyle();
			PE = new PaintElement();
			TextStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			TextStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			FillColor = Color.White;
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(parent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPointFromParent);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint)
		{
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse();
			SizeF sizeF = ((TextStyle == null) ? Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, DefaultConstants.D_TextFont) : Platform.GetStringSizePixels(Text, TextStyle.Font));
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			num = ((Width <= 0) ? ((int)((double)sizeF.Width * 1.2)) : Width);
			ellipse.p2.X = num;
			num2 = ((Height <= 0) ? ((int)((double)sizeF.Height * 1.2)) : Height);
			ellipse.p2.Y = num2;
			if (ellipse.p2.X >= 1 && ellipse.p2.Y >= 1)
			{
				ellipse.p1 = new Point(renderPoint.X - ellipse.p2.X / 2, renderPoint.Y - ellipse.p2.Y / 2);
				ellipse.lineStyle.DrawStyle = OutlineDrawStyle;
				ellipse.PE.StrokeWidth = OutlineThickness;
				if (PE != null)
				{
					ellipse.PE = PE;
				}
				Text text;
				if (TextStyle.ClipText)
				{
					Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(renderPoint.X - num / 2, renderPoint.Y - num2 / 2, num, num2);
					text = new Text(bounds, Text, TextStyle.Clone());
				}
				else
				{
					text = new Text(renderPoint, Text, TextStyle);
				}
				SetTextSetting(text);
				int rotationAngle = 0;
				if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing)
				{
					rotationAngle = 90;
				}
				else if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing)
				{
					rotationAngle = -90;
				}
				else if (TextStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom)
				{
					rotationAngle = -TextStyle.RotationAngle;
				}
				ellipse.RotationAngle = rotationAngle;
				scene.Add(ellipse);
				scene.Add(text);
			}
		}

		public override Annotation Clone()
		{
			EllipseAnnotation ellipseAnnotation = new EllipseAnnotation();
			ellipseAnnotation.Text = Text;
			if (TextStyle != null)
			{
				ellipseAnnotation.TextStyle = TextStyle;
			}
			ellipseAnnotation.Height = Height;
			if (Location != null)
			{
				ellipseAnnotation.Location = Location.Clone();
			}
			ellipseAnnotation.OutlineColor = OutlineColor;
			ellipseAnnotation.OutlineDrawStyle = OutlineDrawStyle;
			ellipseAnnotation.OutlineThickness = OutlineThickness;
			if (PE != null)
			{
				ellipseAnnotation.PE = PE.Clone();
			}
			ellipseAnnotation.Width = Width;
			return ellipseAnnotation;
		}

		protected internal override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			PE.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			TextStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}

	public class LineImageAnnotation : OffsetableAnnotation

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]

		private Point GetLineConnectsToImagePoint(Point lineOrigin, Rectangle imageRectangle)
		{
			return new Point(imageRectangle.Left + imageRectangle.Width / 2, imageRectangle.Top + imageRectangle.Height / 2);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Primitive parent)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(parent);

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint, Primitive offsetParent)
		{
			Point renderPointFromParent = Annotation.GetRenderPointFromParent(offsetParent);
			RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPoint, renderPointFromParent);
		}

		public override void RenderAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, Point renderPoint, Point offsetPoint)
		{
			if (scene == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Line line = new Line();
			line.p1 = renderPoint;
			int height = Height;
			int width = Width;
			Image image = GetImage();
			if (image != null)
			{
				if (height == -1)
				{
					height = image.Height;
				}
				if (width == -1)
				{
					width = image.Width;
				}
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(offsetPoint.X, offsetPoint.Y, width, height);
			ChartImage chartImage = new ChartImage(image, rectangle);
			chartImage.FitStyle = ImageFitStyle;
			line.p2 = GetLineConnectsToImagePoint(line.p1, rectangle);
			line.PE.Stroke = LineColor;
			line.PE.StrokeOpacity = LineColor.A;
			line.PE.Fill = LineColor;
			line.PE.FillOpacity = LineColor.A;
			if (line.PE == null)
			{
				line.PE = new PaintElement();
			}
			line.PE.StrokeWidth = LineThickness;
			if (LineStyle != null)
			{
				line.lineStyle = LineStyle;
			}
			scene.Add(line);
			if (image != null)
			{
				scene.Add(chartImage);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLineStyle()
		{
			return LineStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLineStyle()
		{
			LineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLineColor()
		{
			return LineColor != Color.Black;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLineColor()
		{
			LineColor = Color.Black;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLineThickness()
		{
			return LineThickness != 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLineThickness()
		{
			LineThickness = 1;
		}

		private Image GetImage()
		{
			if (Image != null)
			{
				return Image;
			}
			if (ImagePath != null && ImagePath.Length > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					return Image.FromFile(_imagePath);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex)
				{
					if (ex.TargetSite != null && ex.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_372"), ex);
					}
					throw;
				}
				catch (OutOfMemoryException ex2)
				{
					if (ex2.TargetSite != null && ex2.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_372"), ex2);
					}
					throw;
				}
				catch (FileNotFoundException innerException)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_372"), innerException);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetImage()
		{
			Image = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeImagePath()
		{
			if (ImagePath != null)
			{
				return ImagePath.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeHeight()
		{
			return Height != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetHeight()
		{
			Height = -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			return Width != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWidth()
		{
			Width = -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeImageFitStyle()
		{
			return ImageFitStyle != ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetImageFitStyle()
		{
			ImageFitStyle = ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit;
		}

		public override Annotation Clone()
		{
			LineImageAnnotation lineImageAnnotation = new LineImageAnnotation();
			lineImageAnnotation.LineColor = LineColor;
			if (Location != null)
			{
				lineImageAnnotation.Location = Location.Clone();
			}
			lineImageAnnotation.Offset = base.Offset;
			lineImageAnnotation.OffsetMode = base.OffsetMode;
			lineImageAnnotation.LineThickness = LineThickness;
			if (LineStyle != null)
			{
				lineImageAnnotation.LineStyle = LineStyle.Clone();
			}
			lineImageAnnotation.Height = Height;
			lineImageAnnotation.Width = Width;
			if (Image != null)
			{
				lineImageAnnotation.Image = Image.Clone() as Image;
			}
			if (ImagePath != null)
			{
				lineImageAnnotation.ImagePath = ImagePath;
			}
			lineImageAnnotation.ImageFitStyle = ImageFitStyle;
			return lineImageAnnotation;
		}

		protected internal override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			LineStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartAppearance : IProvideChartComponent
	{
		[NonSerialized]
		internal IChartComponent component;

		[NonSerialized]
		private bool _Dirty;

		[NonSerialized]
		private bool _NoUpdate;

		private static readonly string PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault = SR.GetString("SR_189");

		private static readonly string PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault2 = SR.GetString("SR_247");

		private static readonly string LogMessageDefault = SR.GetString("SR_248");

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public virtual IChartComponent ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return component;
			}
			set
			{
				SetComponent(value);
			}
		}

		protected bool dirty
		{
			get
			{
				return _Dirty;
			}
			set
			{
				_Dirty = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool noUpdate
		{
			get
			{
				return _NoUpdate;
			}
			set
			{
				_NoUpdate = value;
			}
		}

		protected ChartAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected ChartAppearance(IChartComponent component)
		{
			this.component = component;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			this.component = component;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsDirty()
		{
			return dirty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetDirty(bool dirty)
		{
			this.dirty = dirty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void SetNoUpdate(bool noUpdate)
		{
			this.noUpdate = noUpdate;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool GetNoUpdate()
		{
			return noUpdate;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateAll(bool resize, bool invalidate)
		{
			if (!noUpdate && component != null)
			{
				if (resize)
				{
					component.ResizeAll();
				}
				if (invalidate)
				{
					component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
				component.OnUpdated();
			}
		}

		internal void ValidatePropertyInt(string propName, int propValue, int minValue, int maxValue)
		{
			if (propValue < minValue || propValue > maxValue)
			{
				string message = string.Format(PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault, minValue.ToString(), maxValue.ToString());
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(propName, propValue, message);
			}
		}

		internal void ValidatePropertyDouble(string propName, double propValue, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			if (propValue < minValue || propValue > maxValue)
			{
				string message = string.Format(PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault, minValue, maxValue);
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(propName, propValue, message);
			}
		}

		internal void ValidatePropertyDouble(string propName, double propValue, double minValue, double maxValue, double decimalPlaces)
		{
			if (propValue < minValue || propValue > maxValue)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("#.");
				for (int i = 0; (double)i < decimalPlaces; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("0");
				}
				string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				string arg = minValue.ToString(text);
				string arg2 = maxValue.ToString(text);
				string message = string.Format(PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault, arg, arg2);
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(propName, propValue, message);
			}
		}

		internal void ValidatePropertyDouble2(string propName, double propValue, double minValue, double maxValue, bool useLogMsg)
		{
			if (propValue < minValue || propValue > maxValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(message: (!useLogMsg) ? string.Format(PropOutOfRangeMessageDefault2, minValue, maxValue) : LogMessageDefault, paramName: propName, actualValue: propValue);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_56");
		}
	}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_15")]
		public BorderAppearance Border
		{
			get
			{
				return _Border;
			}
			set
			{
				_Border = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public Rectangle InnerBounds => _InnerBounds;

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			Axes.SetComponent(component);
			Border.SetComponent(component);
			PE.SetComponent(component);
			GridPE.SetComponent(component);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Key;
		}

		public ChartArea()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ChartArea(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Axes = new AxisCollection(chartComponent);
			_PE = new PaintElement(this, "PE");
			_GridPE = new PaintElement(this, "GridPE");
			_GridPE.ElementType = PaintElementType.None;
			_Border = new BorderAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeAxes()
		{
			if (Axes != null)
			{
				return Axes.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetAxes()
		{
			Axes.Clear();
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public ChartArea Clone()
		{
			ChartArea chartArea = new ChartArea(component);
			chartArea._Axes = Axes.Clone();
			chartArea.Key = Key;
			chartArea.Bounds = new Rectangle(Bounds.Location, Bounds.Size);
			chartArea.BoundsMeasureType = BoundsMeasureType;
			chartArea.Border = Border.Clone();
			chartArea.PE = PE.Clone();
			chartArea.Visible = Visible;
			chartArea.GridPE = GridPE.Clone();
			return chartArea;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return !Visible;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetVisible()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeBounds()
		{
			return Bounds != Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetBounds()
		{
			Bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeBoundsMeasureType()
		{
			return BoundsMeasureType != MeasureType.Pixels;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetBoundsMeasureType()
		{
			BoundsMeasureType = MeasureType.Pixels;
		}

		private void SetInnerBounds(Rectangle innerBounds)
		{
			_InnerBounds = innerBounds;
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectChartLayerBounds(Rectangle chartLayerBounds, ChartLayerAppearance layerApp)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisX;
			AxisAppearance axisX2;
			if (layerApp.AxisX != null)
			{
				axisX = ((layerApp.AxisX.OrientationType != AxisNumber.X_Axis) ? null : layerApp.AxisX);
				axisX2 = ((layerApp.AxisX.OrientationType != AxisNumber.X2_Axis) ? null : layerApp.AxisX);
			}
			else
			{
				axisX = (axisX2 = null);
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2;
			if (layerApp.AxisY != null)
			{
				axisAppearance = ((layerApp.AxisY.OrientationType != AxisNumber.Y_Axis) ? null : layerApp.AxisY);
				axisAppearance2 = ((layerApp.AxisY.OrientationType != AxisNumber.Y2_Axis) ? null : layerApp.AxisY);
			}
			else
			{
				axisAppearance = null;
				axisAppearance2 = null;
			}
			if (layerApp.AxisY2 != null)
			{
				if (axisAppearance == null && layerApp.AxisY2.OrientationType == AxisNumber.Y_Axis)
				{
					axisAppearance = layerApp.AxisY2;
				}
				if (axisAppearance2 == null && layerApp.AxisY2.OrientationType == AxisNumber.Y2_Axis)
				{
					axisAppearance2 = layerApp.AxisY2;
				}
			}
			return ChartCore.CorrectChartLayerBounds(chartLayerBounds, axisX, axisAppearance, axisX2, axisAppearance2);
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, IChartComponent chartComponent, ChartCore core)
		{
			Rectangle outerBounds = core.GetBorderLayer().GetOuterBounds();
			Rectangle outerBound;
			if (Bounds == Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				outerBound = outerBounds;
			}
			else if (BoundsMeasureType == MeasureType.Percentage)
			{
				int x = (int)((double)outerBounds.Width * ((double)Bounds.X * 0.01));
				int y = (int)((double)outerBounds.Height * ((double)Bounds.Y * 0.01));
				int width = (int)((double)outerBounds.Width * ((double)Bounds.Width * 0.01));
				int height = (int)((double)outerBounds.Height * ((double)Bounds.Height * 0.01));
				outerBound = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
			}
			else
			{
				outerBound = Bounds;
			}
			BorderLayer borderLayer = new BorderLayer(chartComponent, core);
			borderLayer.SetBackgroundColor(PE.Fill);
			borderLayer.Path = Key + ".Border";
			borderLayer.SetAppearance(Border);
			borderLayer.OuterBound = outerBound;
			borderLayer.PE = PE;
			borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			outerBound = borderLayer.GetInnerBounds();
			Rectangle rect = outerBound;
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rect, clipText: true);
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			outerBound.Inflate(-10, -10);
			SetInnerBounds(outerBound);
			int num = outerBound.Left;
			int num2 = outerBound.Right;
			int num3 = outerBound.Top;
			int num4 = outerBound.Bottom;
			foreach (AxisItem item in (IEnumerable)Axes)
			{
				if (item.Visible)
				{
					switch (item.OrientationType)
					{
					case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, outerBound.Bottom - item.Extent);
						break;
					case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, outerBound.Top + item.Extent);
						break;
					case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
						num = Math.Max(num, outerBound.Left + item.Extent);
						break;
					case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
						num2 = Math.Min(num2, outerBound.Right - item.Extent);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			SetInnerBounds(new Rectangle(num, num3, num2 - num, num4 - num3));
			if (GridPE != null && GridPE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				Box box = new Box(InnerBounds);
				box.PE = GridPE;
				scene.Add(box);
			}
			ChartLayerCollection chartLayers = ((CompositeChartAppearance)chartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite)).ChartLayers;
			ChartLayerCollection chartLayerCollection = new ChartLayerCollection(chartComponent);
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item2 in (IEnumerable)chartLayers)
			{
				item2.CreateChartLayer(chartComponent, core);
				if (item2.ChartArea == this)
				{
					bool flag = chartLayerCollection.GetNoUpdate();
					chartLayerCollection.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					chartLayerCollection.Add(item2);
					chartLayerCollection.SetNoUpdate(flag);
				}
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item3 in (IEnumerable)chartLayerCollection)
			{
				SeriesCollection visibleSeries = item3.Series.GetVisibleSeries();
				if (item3.SwapRowsAndColumns)
				{
					hashtable[item3] = SeriesSwap.Swap(visibleSeries);
				}
				else
				{
					hashtable[item3] = visibleSeries;
				}
			}
			Hashtable hashtable2 = new Hashtable();
			foreach (AxisItem item4 in (IEnumerable)Axes)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = new SeriesCollection(chartComponent);
				seriesCollection.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				bool flag2 = false;
				ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance3 = null;
				bool flag3 = false;
				bool flag4 = false;
				bool flag5 = false;
				bool flag6 = false;
				bool flag7 = false;
				ChartLayerCollection chartLayerCollection2 = new ChartLayerCollection(chartComponent);
				chartLayerCollection2.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item5 in (IEnumerable)chartLayerCollection)
				{
					if (item5.AxisXKey == item4.Key)
					{
						item5.AxisX = item4;
					}
					if (item5.AxisYKey == item4.Key)
					{
						item5.AxisY = item4;
					}
					if (item5.AxisY2Key == item4.Key)
					{
						item5.AxisY2 = item4;
					}
					if (item5.AxisX != item4 && item5.AxisY != item4 && item5.AxisY2 != item4)
					{
						continue;
					}
					chartLayerCollection2.Add(item5);
					seriesCollection.AddRange(((SeriesCollection)hashtable[item5]).ToArray());
					switch (item5.ChartType)
					{
					case ChartType.StackBarChart:
					case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
						flag4 = (flag3 = true);
						break;
					case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
					case ChartType.StackLineChart:
					case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
					case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
						flag4 = false;
						flag3 = true;
						break;
					case ChartType.CandleChart:
						chartLayerAppearance3 = item5;
						break;
					case ChartType.BubbleChart:
					case ChartType.ScatterChart:
					case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
						if (item5.AxisX != null && item5.AxisX.DataType != AxisDataType.Time)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						break;
					case ChartType.GanttChart:
						flag5 = true;
						break;
					case ChartType.ParetoChart:
						if (item4 == item5.AxisY2)
						{
							flag6 = true;
						}
						break;
					case ChartType.BoxChart:
						if (item4 == item5.AxisX)
						{
							flag7 = true;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (item4.DataType == AxisDataType.String && ((SeriesCollection)hashtable[item5]).Count > 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				Axis axis = null;
				axis = item4.DataType switch
				{
					AxisDataType.Time => new TimeAxis(chartComponent, core, item4.OrientationType), 
					AxisDataType.String => (!flag5) ? ((LabelAxisBase)new SetLabelAxis(chartComponent, core, item4.OrientationType, item4.SetLabelAxisType)) : ((LabelAxisBase)new GroupedLabelAxis(chartComponent, core, item4.OrientationType)), 
					_ => new NumericAxis(chartComponent, core, item4.OrientationType, LinearAxisType.NumericData), 
				};
				if (axis != null && chartLayerCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item6 in (IEnumerable)chartLayerCollection)
					{
						if (item6.AxisX == item4 || item6.AxisY == item4 || item6.AxisY2 == item4)
						{
							axis.MainChartLayer = item6.ChartLayer;
							axis.ChartLayerAppearance = item6.ChartTypeAppearance;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				hashtable2.Add(item4, axis);
				axis.SetAppearance(item4);
				axis.LogBase = item4.LogBase;
				axis.OuterBound = outerBound;
				axis.RulerType = item4.NumericAxisType;
				axis.setStyle(256, item4.MajorGridLines.Visible);
				axis.setStyle(262144, item4.Labels.Visible);
				axis.setStyle(512, item4.MinorGridLines.Visible);
				axis.setStyle(524288, item4.Labels.Visible);
				axis.setStyle(4, item4.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Percentage);
				axis.setStyle(2097152, item4.StripLines.Visible);
				axis.seriesLabelFormat = item4.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString;
				axis.itemLabelFormat = item4.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				axis.LogNegativeHandling = item4.LogNegativeHandling;
				switch (item4.OrientationType)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					axis.MapMinimum = InnerBounds.Left;
					axis.MapMaximum = InnerBounds.Right;
					axis.span_1 = InnerBounds.Top;
					axis.span_2 = InnerBounds.Bottom;
					axis.setStyle(32768, set: true);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					axis.MapMinimum = InnerBounds.Bottom;
					axis.MapMaximum = InnerBounds.Top;
					axis.span_1 = InnerBounds.Left;
					axis.span_2 = InnerBounds.Right;
					axis.setStyle(65536, set: true);
					break;
				}
				switch (item4.OrientationType)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					axis.axisLineStart = new Point(InnerBounds.Left, outerBound.Bottom - item4.Extent);
					axis.axisLineEnd = new Point(InnerBounds.Right, outerBound.Bottom - item4.Extent);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					axis.axisLineStart = new Point(InnerBounds.Left, outerBound.Top + item4.Extent);
					axis.axisLineEnd = new Point(InnerBounds.Right, outerBound.Top + item4.Extent);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					axis.axisLineStart = new Point(outerBound.Left + item4.Extent, InnerBounds.Bottom);
					axis.axisLineEnd = new Point(outerBound.Left + item4.Extent, InnerBounds.Top);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					axis.axisLineStart = new Point(outerBound.Right - item4.Extent, InnerBounds.Bottom);
					axis.axisLineEnd = new Point(outerBound.Right - item4.Extent, InnerBounds.Top);
					break;
				}
				axis.SetData(seriesCollection);
				ParetoLayer paretoLayer = axis.MainChartLayer as ParetoLayer;
				if (paretoLayer != null)
				{
					if (paretoLayer.ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection2)
					{
						paretoLayer.SetData(seriesCollection2.GetVisibleSeries());
					}
					paretoLayer.InitializeColumns();
				}
				if (seriesCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					if (axis is SetLabelAxis)
					{
						axis.stackIt = flag4;
						if (item4.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
						{
							axis.Minimum = axis.Zero;
							if (flag4)
							{
								if (axis is SetLabelAxis setLabelAxis)
								{
									IGroupSpacing groupSpacing = setLabelAxis.GetGroupSpacing();
									setLabelAxis.SetMinAndMax(groupSpacing);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								switch (item4.SetLabelAxisType)
								{
								case SetLabelAxisType.DateData:
									if (chartLayerAppearance3 != null)
									{
										SeriesCollection seriesCollection3 = ((!chartLayerAppearance3.SwapRowsAndColumns) ? chartLayerAppearance3.Series : SeriesSwap.Swap(chartLayerAppearance3.Series));
										foreach (ISeries item7 in seriesCollection3)
										{
											if (item7 is CandleSeries)
											{
												CandleSeries candleSeries = (CandleSeries)item7;
												axis.Maximum = candleSeries.Points.Count;
												break;
											}
										}
									}
									else
									{
										axis.Maximum = ((IProvideGroupedLabels)seriesCollection).ItemCountTotal;
									}
									break;
								case SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries:
									axis.Maximum = ((IProvideGroupedLabels)seriesCollection).ItemCountTotal;
									break;
								case SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData:
									if (flag7)
									{
										foreach (ISeries item8 in seriesCollection)
										{
											if (item8 is BoxSetSeries)
											{
												axis.Maximum = ((BoxSetSeries)item8).BoxSets.Count;
												break;
											}
										}
									}
									else if (paretoLayer != null)
									{
										axis.Maximum = paretoLayer.Columns.Count;
									}
									else if (chartLayerCollection.Count == 1 && chartLayerCollection[0].ChartType == ChartType.HeatMapChart)
									{
										IChartData chartData = seriesCollection;
										switch (axis.AxisNumber)
										{
										case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
										case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
											axis.Maximum = chartData.GetColumnCount() - 1;
											break;
										default:
											axis.Maximum = chartData.GetRowCount() - 1;
											break;
										}
									}
									else
									{
										axis.Maximum = ((IChartData)seriesCollection).GetColumnCount() - 1;
									}
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else if (axis is NumericAxis)
					{
						switch (item4.RangeType)
						{
						case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
							if (chartLayerAppearance3 != null)
							{
								SeriesCollection seriesCollection4 = ((!chartLayerAppearance3.SwapRowsAndColumns) ? chartLayerAppearance3.Series : SeriesSwap.Swap(chartLayerAppearance3.Series));
								foreach (ISeries item9 in seriesCollection4)
								{
									if (item9 is CandleSeries)
									{
										CandleSeries candleSeries2 = (CandleSeries)item9;
										switch (item4.OrientationType)
										{
										case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
											axis.Minimum = candleSeries2.GetDataMinimumForOpenLowHighClose();
											axis.Maximum = candleSeries2.GetDataMaximumForOpenLowHighClose();
											break;
										case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
											axis.Minimum = candleSeries2.GetDataMinimumForVolume();
											axis.Maximum = candleSeries2.GetDataMaximumForVolume();
											break;
										}
										break;
									}
								}
								break;
							}
							if (flag6)
							{
								axis.Minimum = axis.Zero;
								axis.Maximum = 100.0;
								break;
							}
							if (flag3)
							{
								double num5 = (double)chartLayerCollection2.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
								double num6 = (double)chartLayerCollection2.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
								if (num5 < 0.0 && num6 >= 0.0)
								{
									if (axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
									{
										double num7 = (double)seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
										double num8 = (double)seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
										axis.Minimum = num7 / axis.LogBase;
										axis.Maximum = num8 / axis.LogBase;
									}
									else
									{
										axis.Minimum = num5;
										axis.Maximum = num6;
									}
								}
								else if (num5 < 0.0 && num6 < 0.0)
								{
									axis.Minimum = num5;
									if (axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
									{
										double num9 = (double)seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
										axis.Maximum = num9 / axis.LogBase;
									}
									else
									{
										axis.Maximum = axis.Zero;
									}
								}
								else if (axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
								{
									double num10 = (double)seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
									axis.Minimum = num10 / axis.LogBase;
									axis.Maximum = num6;
								}
								else if (num5 == num6 && num6 == 0.0)
								{
									axis.Minimum = (double)axis.Minimum - 1.0;
									axis.Maximum = (double)axis.Maximum + 1.0;
								}
								else
								{
									axis.Minimum = axis.Zero;
									axis.Maximum = num6;
								}
								break;
							}
							if (flag2)
							{
								switch (item4.OrientationType)
								{
								case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
								case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
									axis.Maximum = seriesCollection.GetMaximum(DataDimension.XValues);
									axis.Minimum = seriesCollection.GetMinimum(DataDimension.XValues);
									break;
								case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
								case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
									axis.Maximum = seriesCollection.GetMaximum(DataDimension.YValues);
									axis.Minimum = seriesCollection.GetMinimum(DataDimension.YValues);
									break;
								default:
									axis.Minimum = seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
									axis.Maximum = seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
									break;
								}
								double num11 = (double)axis.Minimum;
								double num12 = (double)axis.Maximum;
								int num13 = Math.Sign(num11) * Math.Sign(num12);
								axis.Minimum = num11 - num11 * 0.05 * (double)num13;
								axis.Maximum = num12 + num12 * 0.05;
								break;
							}
							axis.Minimum = seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
							axis.Maximum = seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
							if (axis.Minimum is double && axis.Maximum is double && (double)axis.Minimum == (double)axis.Maximum)
							{
								if ((double)axis.Minimum == 0.0)
								{
									axis.Minimum = (double)axis.Minimum - 1.0;
									axis.Maximum = (double)axis.Maximum + 1.0;
								}
								else
								{
									axis.Minimum = (double)axis.Minimum - (double)axis.Minimum * 0.05;
									axis.Maximum = (double)axis.Maximum + (double)axis.Maximum * 0.05;
								}
							}
							break;
						case AxisRangeType.Custom:
							axis.Minimum = item4.RangeMin;
							axis.Maximum = item4.RangeMax;
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (axis is TimeAxis)
					{
						switch (item4.RangeType)
						{
						case AxisRangeType.Custom:
							axis.Minimum = new DateTime((long)item4.RangeMin);
							axis.Maximum = new DateTime((long)item4.RangeMax);
							break;
						default:
							axis.Minimum = seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Time);
							axis.Maximum = seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Time);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				item4.Margin.FixMargin(axis);
				item4.SmartAxisTickmarks(axis);
				TwoDGridLayer.FixMinimumForLogAxis(axis, item4);
				axis.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			foreach (object value in hashtable2.Values)
			{
				if (value is Axis { AxisLinePrimitive: not null } axis2 && scene.Contains(axis2.AxisLinePrimitive))
				{
					scene.Remove(axis2.AxisLinePrimitive);
					scene.Add(axis2.AxisLinePrimitive);
				}
			}
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item10 in (IEnumerable)chartLayerCollection)
			{
				string errorMessage = "";
				if (!item10.AxesValidForLayer(out errorMessage))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GraphicsContext graphicsContext2 = new GraphicsContext();
				graphicsContext2.SetClipBounds(CorrectChartLayerBounds(InnerBounds, item10));
				scene.Add(graphicsContext2);
				if (item10.ChartLayer != null)
				{
					item10.ChartLayer.LayerID = item10.Key;
					item10.ChartLayer.Stacked = item10.ChartType.ToString().IndexOf("Stack") >= 0;
					if (item10.AxisX != null)
					{
						item10.ChartLayer.Grid["X"] = hashtable2[item10.AxisX];
					}
					if (item10.AxisY != null)
					{
						item10.ChartLayer.Grid["Y"] = hashtable2[item10.AxisY];
					}
					if (item10.AxisY2 != null)
					{
						item10.ChartLayer.Grid["Y2"] = hashtable2[item10.AxisY2];
					}
					item10.ChartLayer.ChartColorModel = core.ChartColorModel;
					item10.ChartLayer.SetData((SeriesCollection)hashtable[item10]);
					item10.ChartLayer.OuterBound = InnerBounds;
					item10.ChartLayer.SetAppearance(item10.ChartTypeAppearance);
					if (item10.Visible)
					{
						item10.ChartLayer.FillSceneGraph(scene);
					}
				}
				GraphicsContext graphicsContext3 = new GraphicsContext();
				graphicsContext3.SetClipBounds(rect, clipText: true);
				scene.Add(graphicsContext3);
			}
		}
	}
	[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.ChartAreaCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class ChartAreaCollection : ChartAppearance, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private ArrayList _List = new ArrayList();

		protected ArrayList List
		{
			get
			{
				return _List;
			}
			set
			{
				_List = value;
			}
		}

		public ChartArea this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index] as ChartArea;
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public int Count => List.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => List.IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => List.SyncRoot;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = value as ChartArea;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => List.IsFixedSize;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => List.IsReadOnly;

		public ChartAreaCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ChartAreaCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			ChartComponent = chartComponent;
		}

		public ChartArea FromKey(string key)
		{
			foreach (ChartArea item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Key == key)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public int Add(ChartArea area)
		{
			if (area.component == null)
			{
				area.SetComponent(component);
			}
			if (area.Key == null || area.Key.Length == 0)
			{
				int num = Count;
				string key;
				do
				{
					num++;
					key = "area" + num;
				}
				while (FromKey(key) != null);
				area.Key = key;
			}
			int result = List.Add(area);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		public ChartAreaCollection Clone()
		{
			ChartAreaCollection chartAreaCollection = new ChartAreaCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				chartAreaCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return chartAreaCollection;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return List.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object item)
		{
			return Add(item as ChartArea);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			List.Clear();
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return Contains(item);
		}

		public int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return List.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ChartArea area)
		{
			List.Insert(index, area);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, value as ChartArea);
		}

		public void Remove(object item)
		{
			List.Remove(item);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			List.RemoveAt(index);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}
	}

					break;
				case ChartType.ParetoChart:
					chartLayer = new ParetoLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackLineChart:
					chartLayer = new LineLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
					chartLayer = new AreaLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
					chartLayer = new SplineLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
					chartLayer = new SplineAreaLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.BoxChart:
					chartLayer = new BoxChartLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					visible = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.TreeMapChart:
					chartLayer = new TreeMapLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new TreeMapLegendLayer(component, this);
					visible = false;
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				case ChartType.HistogramChart:
					chartLayer = new HistogramLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					gridLayer.Visible = true;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackBarChart:
					chartLayer = new BarLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
					chartLayer = new ColumnLayer(component, this);
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				case ChartType.Stack3DBarChart:
					chartLayer = new Bar3DLayer(component, this);
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = true;
					alphaLevel = byte.MaxValue;
					visible = false;
					Is3DNew = true;
					if (chartType != ChartType.Stack3DBarChart)
					{
						axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
						axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance5.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
						axisAppearance4.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance6.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart:
					chartLayer = new Column3DLayer(component, this);
					chartLayer.Stacked = true;
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = true;
					alphaLevel = byte.MaxValue;
					visible = false;
					Is3DNew = true;
					if (chartType != ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart)
					{
						axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
						axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance5.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
						axisAppearance4.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
						axisAppearance6.Labels.ItemFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
					chartLayer = new ColumnLayer(component, this);
					multipleLayers[0] = new LineLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
					chartLayer = new ScatterLayer(component, this);
					multipleLayers[0] = new LineLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer = new IconLegendLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				default:
					chartLayer = new ColumnLayer(component, this);
					Is3D = false;
					break;
				}
				if (component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color) is ColorAppearance colorAppearance)
				{
					bool noUpdate = colorAppearance.GetNoUpdate();
					colorAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					colorAppearance.AlphaLevel = alphaLevel;
					colorAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate);
				}
				if (colorModel is SimpleColorModel)
				{
					((SimpleColorModel)colorModel).SetColorByRow(colorByRowForChartType);
				}
				if (component.IsDesignMode())
				{
					CreateDemoData();
				}
				if (ChartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
				{
					SetDataIntoGanttChart();
				}
				SetDataIntoLayers(data);
				if (Is3D)
				{
					threeDGridLayer.SetChartType(this.chartType);
					threeDGridLayer.SetVisible(visible);
				}
				else
				{
					gridLayer.SetChartType(this.chartType);
					gridLayer.SetVisible(visible);
				}
				chartLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				if (layerHashTable != null)
				{
					foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
					{
						((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).ChartColorModel = colorModel;
					}
				}
				if ((ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart) && multipleLayers[0] != null)
				{
					multipleLayers[0].SetColorModel(colorModel);
				}
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
				SetSize(componentWidth, componentHeight);
				SetPathInLayers();
			}
		}

				dirty = value;
			}

		public Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.ScrollBar ChartScrollBar => _scrollBar;

		public Bitmap SkinImage
		{
			get
			{
				return skinImage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_scrollBar == null)
				{
					_scrollBar = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.ScrollBar(Is3D);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					_scrollBar.ScrollbarSkin = new ScrollBarSkin(SR.GetBitmap("GR_BW"));
				}
				else
				{
					_scrollBar.ScrollbarSkin = new ScrollBarSkin(value);
				}
				skinImage = value;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (sceneGraph != null)
			{
				sceneGraph.Dispose();
				sceneGraph = null;
			}
			if (BaseScene != null)
			{
				BaseScene.Dispose();
				BaseScene = null;
			}
			if (ScrollScene != null)
			{
				ScrollScene.Dispose();
				ScrollScene = null;
			}
			if (layerHashTable != null)
			{
				layerHashTable.Clear();
				layerHashTable = null;
			}
			multipleData = null;
			multipleLayers = null;
			if (labelHash != null)
			{
				labelHash.Clear();
				labelHash = null;
			}
			if (Environment != null)
			{
				Environment.Clear();
				Environment = null;
			}
		}

		{
			sceneGraph = scene;
		}

		public ChartCore(IChartComponent component)
		{
			if (surrogateTableData == null)
			{
				surrogateTableData = new Hashtable();
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				surrogateTableData["bool"] = new object[6] { true, false, true, false, true, false };
				surrogateTableData["numeric"] = new object[6] { 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 };
				surrogateTableData["string"] = new object[6] { "abc", "efg", "hij", "klm", "nmo", "pqr" };
				surrogateTableData["char"] = new object[6] { 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f' };
				surrogateTableData["datetime"] = new object[6]
				{
					now,
					now.AddDays(1.0),
					now.AddDays(2.0),
					now.AddDays(3.0),
					now.AddDays(4.0),
					now.AddDays(5.0)
				};
				surrogateTableData["System.Boolean"] = surrogateTableData["bool"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Byte"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Char"] = surrogateTableData["char"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.OracleClient.OracleBoolean"] = surrogateTableData["bool"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.OracleClient.OracleDateTime"] = surrogateTableData["datetime"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.OracleClient.OracleNumber"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.OracleClient.OracleString"] = surrogateTableData["string"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlBoolean"] = surrogateTableData["bool"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlByte"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlDateTime"] = surrogateTableData["datetime"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlDecimal"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlDouble"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlInt16"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlInt32"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlInt64"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlSingle"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Data.SqlTypes.SqlString"] = surrogateTableData["string"];
				surrogateTableData["System.DateTime"] = surrogateTableData["datetime"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Decimal"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Double"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Int16"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Int32"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Int64"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.SByte"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.Single"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.UInt16"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.UInt32"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
				surrogateTableData["System.UInt64"] = surrogateTableData["numeric"];
			}
			this.component = component;
			Environment.Clear();
			Environment["TODAY_DATE"] = DateTime.Today;
			Environment["TODAY_DATETIME"] = DateTime.Now;
			Environment["CORE_VERSION"] = "3.00.5000.24";
			string text = "";
			text += "RELEASE ";
			text += "GAC_ABLE ";
			Environment["CORE_VERSION_TYPE"] = text;
			sceneGraph = new SceneGraph();
			colorModel = new RandomColorModel();
			borderLayer = new BorderLayer(this.component, this);
			titleLayer = new TitleLayer(this.component, this);
			adornLayer = new AdornmentLayer(this.component, this);
			gridLayer = new TwoDGridLayer(this.component, this);
			threeDGridLayer = new ThreeDGridLayer(this.component, this);
			drillLayer = new DrillLayer(this.component, this);
			skinLayer = new SkinLayer(this.component, this);
			annotationLayer = new AnnotationLayer(this.component, this);
			ChartType = ChartType.ColumnChart;
			gridLayer.SetChartType(ChartType.ColumnChart);
			CreateDemoData();
			if (ChartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
			{
				SetDataIntoGanttChart();
			}
			SetDataIntoLayers(data);
			DataConstString.DataExcpText = SR.GetString("SR_1026");
			DataConstString.DemoColLabel = SR.GetString("SR_1024");
			DataConstString.DemoRowLabel = SR.GetString("SR_1025");
			_scrollBar = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.ScrollBar(Is3D);
		}

		private bool GetColorByRowForChartType(ChartType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.PieChart:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.BarChart3D:
			case ChartType.ColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.AreaChart3D:
			case ChartType.LineChart3D:
			case ChartType.PieChart3D:
			case ChartType.RadarChart:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
			case ChartType.PolarChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderBarChart3D:
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
			case ChartType.PointChart3D:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart3D:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart3D:
			case ChartType.ConeChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart3D:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData chartTypeData)
		{
			SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(chartTypeData, titleLayer.GetInnerBounds(), reCalculateBoundsAfter: true);
		}

		private void SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData chartTypeData, Rectangle outerBounds, bool reCalculateBoundsAfter)
		{
			if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null && chartTypeData == ChartTypeData.ScatterData)
			{
				legendLayer = new IconLegendLayer(component, this);
				legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateBoundsAfter);
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
				legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[0]);
				return;
			}
			if (multipleData != null && multipleData[1] != null && chartTypeData == ChartTypeData.LineData)
			{
				legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
				legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateBoundsAfter);
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				legendLayer.SetChart(multipleLayers[0]);
				legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[1]);
				return;
			}
			switch (chartTypeData)
			{
			case ChartTypeData.DefaultData:
				if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null && multipleData[1] != null)
				{
					legendLayer = new IconLegendLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
					legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[0]);
				}
				else if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null)
				{
					legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer.SetChart(multipleLayers[0]);
					legendLayer.SetData(data);
				}
				else
				{
					legendLayer = new IconLegendLayer(component, this);
					legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
					legendLayer.SetData(data);
				}
				legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateBoundsAfter);
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				break;
			case ChartTypeData.LineData:
				legendLayer = new DiscreteColorLegendLayer(component, this);
				legendLayer.SetChart(multipleLayers[0]);
				legendLayer.SetData(data);
				legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateBoundsAfter);
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				break;
			case ChartTypeData.ScatterData:
				legendLayer = new IconLegendLayer(component, this);
				legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
				legendLayer.SetData(data);
				legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateBoundsAfter);
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(colorModel);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(ChartTypeData chartTypeData)
		{
			if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null && (chartTypeData == ChartTypeData.ColumnData || chartTypeData == ChartTypeData.DefaultData))
			{
				legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
				legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[0]);
			}
			else if (multipleData != null && multipleData[1] != null && chartTypeData == ChartTypeData.LineData)
			{
				legendLayer.SetChart(multipleLayers[0]);
				legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[1]);
			}
			else
			{
				legendLayer.SetChart(chartLayer);
				legendLayer.SetData(data);
			}
		}

		private void setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(ChartTypeData chartTypeData)
		{
			if (ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
			{
				SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(chartTypeData);
			}
			else
			{
				SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(chartTypeData);
			}
		}

		protected void SetDataIntoLayers(IChartData data)
		{
			if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart != ChartType && ChartType.ScatterLineChart != ChartType)
			{
				chartLayer.SetData(data);
			}
			if (layerHashTable != null)
			{
				foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
				{
					((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).ChartData = data;
				}
			}
			ChartTypeData dataAssociation = ((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation;
			if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
			{
				setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(dataAssociation);
			}
			else if (chartType == ChartType.HistogramChart)
			{
				((HistogramLayer)chartLayer).InitializeChartData();
				legendLayer.SetData(((HistogramLayer)chartLayer).HistogramData);
			}
			else
			{
				legendLayer.SetData(data);
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.HistogramChart)
			{
				colorModel.SetData(((HistogramLayer)chartLayer).HistogramData);
			}
			else
			{
				colorModel.SetData(data);
			}
			gridLayer.SetData(data);
			if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
			{
				if (component.IsDesignMode())
				{
					if (chartLayer != null)
					{
						chartLayer.SetData(multipleData[0]);
					}
					if (multipleLayers[0] != null)
					{
						multipleLayers[0].SetData(multipleData[1]);
					}
				}
				gridLayer.SetOptionalData(multipleData);
			}
			else
			{
				gridLayer.SetOptionalData(null);
			}
			threeDGridLayer.SetData(data);
			adornLayer.Clear();
		}

		public void SetSize(int width, int height)
		{
			SetSize(width, height, includeLegend: true);
		}

		private void SetSize(int width, int height, bool includeLegend)
		{
			SetSize(width, height, includeLegend, includeLegend);
		}

		private void SetSize(int width, int height, bool resizeLegend, bool accountForLegendSize)
		{
			componentWidth = width;
			componentHeight = height;
			ResizeAllLayers(resizeLegend, accountForLegendSize);
		}

		private void SetPathInLayers()
		{
			borderLayer.Path = "Border";
			titleLayer.Path = "Border.Title";
			legendLayer.Path = "Border.Title.Legend";
			drillLayer.Path = "Drill";
			if (Is3D)
			{
				threeDGridLayer.Path = "Border.Title.Grid3D";
				threeDGridLayer.Path += ".Chart";
				adornLayer.Path = threeDGridLayer.Path + ".Chart.Adorn";
			}
			else
			{
				gridLayer.Path = "Border.Title.Grid";
				chartLayer.Path = gridLayer.Path + ".Chart";
				adornLayer.Path = chartLayer.Path + ".Chart.Adorn";
			}
		}

		public void ResizeAllLayers()
		{
			ResizeAllLayers(includeLegend: true);
		}

		private void ResizeAllLayers(bool includeLegend)
		{
			ResizeAllLayers(includeLegend, includeLegend);
		}

		private void ResizeAllLayers(bool resizeLegend, bool accountForLegendSize)
		{
			dirty = true;
			borderLayer.SetBounds(0, 0, componentWidth, componentHeight);
			Rectangle innerBounds = borderLayer.GetInnerBounds();
			titleLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
			innerBounds = titleLayer.GetInnerBounds();
			if (ChartType == ChartType.PieChart)
			{
				innerBounds.Inflate(5, 5);
			}
			if (legendLayer.IsVisible())
			{
				Rectangle innerBounds2 = innerBounds;
				Rectangle outerBounds = innerBounds;
				if (resizeLegend)
				{
					legendLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
					innerBounds2 = legendLayer.GetInnerBounds();
				}
				else
				{
					LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)legendLayer.GetAppearance();
					LegendLayer.CalculateBounds(ref innerBounds2, ref outerBounds, legendAppearance.Location, legendAppearance.SpanPercentage);
				}
				if (accountForLegendSize)
				{
					innerBounds = innerBounds2;
				}
			}
			if (Is3D)
			{
				if (threeDGridLayer.IsVisible())
				{
					threeDGridLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
					innerBounds = threeDGridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
				}
			}
			else if (gridLayer.IsVisible())
			{
				gridLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
				innerBounds = gridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
				ChartTypeData dataAssociation = ((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation;
				if (resizeLegend && (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType))
				{
					setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(dataAssociation);
				}
				else
				{
					legendLayer.SetData(data);
				}
			}
			chartLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
			if (layerHashTable != null)
			{
				foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
				{
					((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).OuterBound = innerBounds;
				}
			}
			drillLayer.SetBounds(innerBounds);
			if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
			{
				multipleLayers[0].SetBounds(innerBounds);
			}
			ChartType chartType = ChartType;
			if (chartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				adornLayer.SetBounds(borderLayer.OuterBound);
				adornLayer.ClipBounds = adornLayer.OuterBound;
			}
			else
			{
				adornLayer.SetBounds(Rectangle.Inflate(innerBounds, 2, 2));
			}
		}

		protected void CreateDemoData()

((ChartDataAdapter)new ArrayToChartAdapter(DemoTable.DemoArray(2), flag)) : ((ChartDataAdapter)new DataTableToChartAdapter(DemoTable.Table(6))));
				break;

			case ChartType.BarChart3D:

				break;
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
				try

					double[,] connectTo2 = new double[7, 4]

			case ChartType.PointChart3D:

			case ChartType.HeatMapChart:

					for (int l = 0; l < num2; l++)

							array2[l, m] = Math.Abs(50.0 * Math.Sin((double)(l * 2) * Math.PI / (double)Math.Max(num2, num3)) * Math.Cos((double)(m * 2) * Math.PI / (double)Math.Max(num2, num3))) + 0.01;

					connectTo = new ArrayToChartAdapter(array2, flag);

				connectTo = new ChartDemoData(RANDOM.Next(5, 30), 5, 1.0, 100.0, addRowLabels: false, flag);

				for (int k = 0; k < 50; k++)

					connectTo3[k, 0] = RANDOM.Next(1, 5);
					connectTo3[k, 1] = (int)((double)num * 360.0 / 50.0);
					connectTo3[k, 2] = 30.0 + Math.Abs(connectTo3[k, 0] * 50.0 * Math.Sin(connectTo3[k, 1] * 2.0 * Math.PI / 40.0)) + 0.01;

				if (flag)

					connectTo3[49, 2] = 0.0;

				connectTo = new ArrayToChartAdapter(connectTo3, flag);

			case ChartType.ScatterChart:

				double[,] connectTo3 = new double[50, 3];
				for (int j = 0; j < 50; j++)

					connectTo3[j, 0] = RANDOM.Next(1, 5);
					connectTo3[j, 1] = RANDOM.Next(j + 1, j + 5);
					connectTo3[j, 2] = 10.0 + Math.Abs(connectTo3[j, 0] * 50.0 * Math.Sin(connectTo3[j, 1] * 2.0 * Math.PI / 40.0)) + 0.01;

				connectTo = new ArrayToChartAdapter(connectTo3, flag);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				connectTo = new CandleChartDemoData();
				break;
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
				connectTo = new DataTableToChartAdapter(DemoTable.Table(4));
				break;
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
			{
				double[,] connectTo3 = new double[4, 5]
				{
					{ 30.0, 35.0, 40.0, 50.0, 70.0 },
					{ 10.0, 15.0, 20.0, 30.0, 50.0 },
					{ 50.0, 55.0, 60.0, 70.0, 90.0 },
					{ 10.0, 15.0, 20.0, 30.0, 50.0 }
				};
				connectTo = new ArrayToChartAdapter(connectTo3);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.TreeMapChart:
				connectTo = new DataTableToChartAdapter(DemoTable.Table(9));
				break;
			case ChartType.HistogramChart:
			{
				int[] array = new int[20];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)

				}

			}
			default:
				connectTo = new ChartDemoData(RANDOM.Next(3, 8), RANDOM.Next(3, 15), RANDOM.Next(1, 90), RANDOM.Next(100, 500), addRowLabels: false, flag);
