			data = new ChartDataFilter(connectTo, flag);
			if (ChartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
			{
				SetDataIntoGanttChart();
			}
			if (chartData != null)
			{
				multipleData[0] = new ChartDataFilter(chartData, flag);
			}
			if (chartData2 != null)
			{
				multipleData[1] = new ChartDataFilter(chartData2, flag);
			}
		}

		public void ResetDemoData()
		{
			CreateDemoData();
			SetDataIntoLayers(data);
		}

		internal void InitializeLayersAndLegendsForCompositeChart()
		{
			CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = (CompositeChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite);
			ChartLayerCollection chartLayers = compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers;
			CompositeLegendCollection legends = compositeChartAppearance.Legends;
			ChartAreaCollection chartAreas = compositeChartAppearance.ChartAreas;
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)chartLayers)
			{
				item.SetComponent(component);
				if (item.SeriesListInternal != null)
				{
					item.PopulateSeries();
				}
				if (item.ChartAreaKeyInternal != null && item.ChartAreaKeyInternal.Length > 0)
				{
					item.ChartArea = chartAreas.FromKey(item.ChartAreaKeyInternal);
				}
				if (item.ChartArea != null)
				{
					if (item.AxisXKeyInternal != null && item.AxisXKeyInternal.Length > 0)
					{
						item.AxisX = item.ChartArea.Axes.FromKey(item.AxisXKeyInternal);
						item.AxisXKeyInternal = null;
					}
					if (item.AxisYKeyInternal != null && item.AxisYKeyInternal.Length > 0)
					{
						item.AxisY = item.ChartArea.Axes.FromKey(item.AxisYKeyInternal);
						item.AxisYKeyInternal = null;
					}
					if (item.AxisY2KeyInternal != null && item.AxisY2KeyInternal.Length > 0)
					{
						item.AxisY2 = item.ChartArea.Axes.FromKey(item.AxisY2KeyInternal);
						item.AxisY2KeyInternal = null;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (CompositeLegend item2 in (IEnumerable)legends)
			{
				item2.SetComponent(component);
				if (item2.ChartLayerListInternal != null)
				{
					item2.PopulateChartLayers();
				}
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle CorrectChartLayerBounds(Rectangle chartLayerBounds)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisY = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisY2 = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			AxisAppearance axisX = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisX2 = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			return CorrectChartLayerBounds(chartLayerBounds, axisX, axisY, axisX2, axisY2);
		}

		internal static Rectangle CorrectChartLayerBounds(Rectangle chartLayerBounds, AxisAppearance axisX, AxisAppearance axisY, AxisAppearance axisX2, AxisAppearance axisY2)
		{
			if (axisY != null && axisY.Visible)
			{
				int num = (int)Math.Round((double)axisY.LineThickness / 2.0);
				chartLayerBounds.X += num;
				chartLayerBounds.Width -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				chartLayerBounds.X++;
			}
			if (axisY2 != null && axisY2.Visible)
			{
				int num2 = (int)Math.Round((double)axisY2.LineThickness / 2.0);
				chartLayerBounds.Width -= num2;
			}
			else
			{
				chartLayerBounds.Width += 2;
			}
			if (axisX2 != null && axisX2.Visible)
			{
				int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)axisX2.LineThickness / 2.0);
				chartLayerBounds.Y += num3;
				chartLayerBounds.Height -= num3;
			}
			if (axisX != null && axisX.Visible)
			{
				int num4 = (int)Math.Round((double)axisX.LineThickness / 2.0);
				chartLayerBounds.Height -= num4;
			}
			else
			{
				chartLayerBounds.Height++;
			}
			return chartLayerBounds;
		}

		private void DrawComposite()
		{
			SetupColorModel();
			CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = (CompositeChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite);
			compositeChartAppearance.Series.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			compositeChartAppearance.Series.DataBind();
			compositeChartAppearance.Series.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			data = null;
			if (compositeChartAppearance.Series.Count == 0 && compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers.Count; i++)
				{
					if (compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[i] != null && compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[i].Series.Count > 0)
					{
						data = compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[i].Series;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (data == null)
			{
				data = compositeChartAppearance.Series;
			}
			ChartAreaCollection chartAreas = compositeChartAppearance.ChartAreas;
			CompositeLegendCollection legends = compositeChartAppearance.Legends;
			if (chartAreas.Count == 0)
			{
				DrawInvalidChartImage(SR.GetString("SR_20053_1"));
				return;
			}
			InitializeLayersAndLegendsForCompositeChart();
			SceneGraph.Clear();
			string[] array = ((component == null || component.UserLayerIndex == null) ? new string[1] { "Default" } : component.UserLayerIndex);
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				if (array[j] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (array[j] == "Default")
				{
					borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
					foreach (ChartArea item in (IEnumerable)chartAreas)
					{
						if (item.Visible)
						{
							item.FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph, component, this);
							GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
							graphicsContext.ResetClip();
							SceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
						}
					}
					foreach (CompositeLegend item2 in (IEnumerable)legends)
					{
						if (item2.Visible)
						{
							item2.FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph, component, this);
						}
					}
					titleLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
					annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph);
					skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph);
				}
				else if (LayerHash != null && LayerHash.ContainsKey(array[j]) && LayerHash[array[j]] is ILayer layer)
				{
					layer.FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateData()
		{
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Series) as SeriesCollection;
			bool flag = ChartType == ChartType.Composite;
			bool flag2 = (dataAppearance.DataSource == null && seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0) || flag;
			if (!dataAppearance.GetDataBindCalled() && !component.IsDesignMode() && ChartType != ChartType.ColumnLineChart && ChartType != ChartType.ScatterLineChart && !flag2)
			{
				SceneGraph.Clear();
				DrawInvalidChartImage(DataBindNotCalledMessage);
				return false;
			}
			if ((ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart) && defaultNotRequired && !((DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data)).GetDataBindCalled() && !component.IsDesignMode())
			{
				SceneGraph.Clear();
				if (flag2)
				{
					DrawInvalidChartImage(SR.GetString("SR_20053_60"));
				}
				else
				{
					DrawInvalidChartImage(DataBindNotCalledMessage);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void DrawChart()
		{
			if (!dirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			dirty = false;
			SetupDataModel();
			if (LabelHash != null && LabelHash.Count != 0)
			{
				LabelHash = LabelHash;
			}
			InitializeLayersAndLegendsForCompositeChart();
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Series);
			bool flag = ChartType == ChartType.Composite;
			if (ValidateData())
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					DrawComposite();
					FillSceneGraphEventArgs e = new FillSceneGraphEventArgs(sceneGraph, this);
					component.OnFillSceneGraph(e);
					return;
				}
				if (dataAppearance.ZeroAligned)
				{
					ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = (ChartGridAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis);
					if (chartGridAppearance.X.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic || chartGridAppearance.Y.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic || chartGridAppearance.Z.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic || chartGridAppearance.X2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic || chartGridAppearance.Y2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic || chartGridAppearance.Z2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
					{
						sceneGraph.Clear();
						DrawInvalidChartImage(SR.GetString("SR_2010"));
						return;
					}
				}
				if (Is3D)
				{
					chartLayer.Grid = threeDGridLayer.Grid;
				}
				else
				{
					chartLayer.Grid = gridLayer.Grid;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < multipleLayers.Length; i++)
				{
					if (multipleLayers[i] != null)
					{
						multipleLayers[i].Grid = gridLayer.Grid;
					}
				}
				sceneGraph.Clear();
				SetupColorModel();
				GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
				if (component != null)
				{
					graphicsContext.SetRenderingMode(component.SmoothingMode);
				}
				else
				{
					graphicsContext.SetRenderingMode(SmoothingMode.AntiAlias);
				}
				sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
				graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
				graphicsContext.ResetClip();
				sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
				borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
				titleLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
				LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend);
				TitleLayerBounds = legendAppearance.BoundsReduction(legendLayer, titleLayer.GetInnerBounds());
				drillLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
				GridLayerBounds = gridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
				if (ChartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
				{
					SetDataIntoGanttChart();
					chartLayer.ChartData = data;
				}
				if (chartLayer.IsDataValidForChart())
				{
					if (Is3D)
					{
						graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
						if (threeDGridLayer.IsVisible())
						{
							threeDGridLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						}
						if (colorModel is LinearColorModel linearColorModel)
						{
							linearColorModel.ItemCount = -1;
						}
						chartLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
						graphicsContext.ResetClip();
						sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
					}
					else
					{
						if (gridLayer.IsVisible())
						{
							gridLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						}
						switch (ChartType)
						{
						default:
						{
							graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
							Rectangle innerBounds = gridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
							innerBounds = CorrectChartLayerBounds(innerBounds);
							graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(innerBounds);
							sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
							break;
						}
						case ChartType.PieChart:
						case ChartType.RadarChart:
						case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
						case ChartType.PolarChart:
						case ChartType.FunnelChart:
						case ChartType.PyramidChart:
						case ChartType.TreeMapChart:
							break;
						}
						string[] array = new string[0];
						if (component.UserLayerIndex != null)
						{
							array = component.UserLayerIndex;
						}
						if (colorModel is LinearColorModel linearColorModel2)
						{
							linearColorModel2.ItemCount = -1;
						}
						if (component.UserLayerIndex == null)
						{
							chartLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						}
						if (layerHashTable != null)
						{
							layerHashTable["Default"] = chartLayer;
						}
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
							{
								if (((string)key).Equals(array[j]))
								{
									((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
								}
							}
						}
						if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
						{
							multipleLayers[0].FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						}
					}
					if (legendLayer.IsVisible())
					{
						LegendAppearance legendAppearance2 = (LegendAppearance)legendLayer.GetAppearance();
						if ((ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart) && legendAppearance2.DataAssociation == ChartTypeData.SplitData)
						{
							Rectangle outerBounds = legendLayer.GetOuterBounds();
							Rectangle rectangle;
							Rectangle rectangle2;
							if (legendAppearance2.Location == LegendLocation.Top || legendAppearance2.Location == LegendLocation.Bottom)
							{
								rectangle = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Height);
								rectangle2 = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Height);
							}
							else
							{
								rectangle = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height / 2);
								rectangle2 = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height / 2, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height / 2);
							}
							if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart)
							{
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle, reCalculateAfter: false);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle);
								sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(ChartTypeData.ColumnData);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle2, reCalculateAfter: false);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle2);
								sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(ChartTypeData.LineData);
								if (ChartColorModel is SimpleColorModel && !((SimpleColorModel)ChartColorModel).GetColorByRow())
								{
									SimpleColorModel simpleColorModel = (SimpleColorModel)ChartColorModel;
									simpleColorModel.SetColorByRow(byRow: true);
									legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
									simpleColorModel.SetColorByRow(byRow: false);
								}
								else
								{
									legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
								}
							}
							else if (ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
							{
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle);
								sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData.ScatterData, rectangle, reCalculateBoundsAfter: false);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle2);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle2);
								sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData.LineData, rectangle2, reCalculateBoundsAfter: false);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
							}
							legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateAfter: false);
						}
						else
						{
							graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
							graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(legendLayer.GetOuterBounds());
							sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
							legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						}
						graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
						graphicsContext.ResetClip();
						sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
					}
					if (!Is3D)
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
					}
					else if (Is3DNew)
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
					}
					else
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraphEffects(sceneGraph, component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) as EffectsAppearance);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					sceneGraph.Clear();
					DrawInvalidChartImage(chartLayer.GetDataInvalidMessage());
				}
			}
			FillSceneGraphEventArgs e2 = new FillSceneGraphEventArgs(sceneGraph, this);
			component.OnFillSceneGraph(e2);
		}

		public bool DrawChartWeb()
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!dirty)
			{
				return result;
			}
			dirty = false;
			SetupDataModel();
			result = ValidateData();
			if (result)
			{
				if (Is3D)
				{
					chartLayer.Grid = threeDGridLayer.Grid;
				}
				else
				{
					chartLayer.Grid = gridLayer.Grid;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < multipleLayers.Length; i++)
				{
					if (multipleLayers[i] != null)
					{
						multipleLayers[i].Grid = gridLayer.Grid;
					}
				}
				BaseScene.Clear();
				ScrollScene.Clear();
				SetupColorModel();
				GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
				if (component != null)
				{
					graphicsContext.SetRenderingMode(component.SmoothingMode);
				}
				else
				{
					graphicsContext.SetRenderingMode(SmoothingMode.AntiAlias);
				}
				sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
				graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
				graphicsContext.ResetClip();
				sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
				borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
				titleLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
				if (chartLayer.IsDataValidForChart())
				{
					SetSize(componentWidth, componentHeight, includeLegend: true);
					if (gridLayer.IsVisible())
					{
						if (gridLayer is TwoDGridLayer twoDGridLayer)
						{
							twoDGridLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene, ScrollType != 0 && ScrollType != 2, ScrollType != 1 && ScrollType != 2);
						}
						else
						{
							gridLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
						}
					}
					if (!Is3D)
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
						annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
						annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
					}
					else
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraphEffects(sceneGraph, component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) as EffectsAppearance);
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraphEffects(BaseScene, component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) as EffectsAppearance);
					}
					LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend);
					TitleLayerBounds = legendAppearance.BoundsReduction(legendLayer, titleLayer.GetInnerBounds());
					GridLayerBounds = gridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
					gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsX = false;
					gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsY = false;
					newWidth = componentWidth;
					newHeight = componentHeight;
					switch (ScrollType)
					{
					case 0:
						newWidth *= 2;
						gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsX = true;
						break;
					case 1:
						newHeight *= 2;
						gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsY = true;
						break;
					case 2:
						gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsX = true;
						gridLayer.mOffsetLabelsY = true;
						newWidth *= 2;
						newHeight *= 2;
						break;
					}
					SetSize(newWidth, newHeight, resizeLegend: false, accountForLegendSize: true);
					ScrollGridLayerBounds = gridLayer.GetInnerBounds();
					if (gridLayer.IsVisible())
					{
						gridLayer.FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
					}
					graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
					graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(gridLayer.GetInnerBounds());
					ScrollScene.Add(graphicsContext);
					string[] array = new string[0];
					if (component.UserLayerIndex != null)
					{
						array = component.UserLayerIndex;
					}
					if (colorModel is LinearColorModel linearColorModel)
					{
						linearColorModel.ItemCount = -1;
					}
					if (component.UserLayerIndex == null)
					{
						chartLayer.FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
					}
					if (legendLayer.IsVisible())
					{
						LegendAppearance legendAppearance2 = (LegendAppearance)legendLayer.GetAppearance();
						if ((ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart) && legendAppearance2.DataAssociation == ChartTypeData.SplitData)
						{
							Rectangle outerBounds = legendLayer.GetOuterBounds();
							Rectangle rectangle;
							Rectangle rectangle2;
							if (legendAppearance2.Location == LegendLocation.Top || legendAppearance2.Location == LegendLocation.Bottom)
							{
								rectangle = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Height);
								rectangle2 = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Height);
							}
							else
							{
								rectangle = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height / 2);
								rectangle2 = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height / 2, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height / 2);
							}
							if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart)
							{
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle, reCalculateAfter: false);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle);
								BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(ChartTypeData.ColumnData);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle2, reCalculateAfter: false);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle2);
								BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForColumnLine(ChartTypeData.LineData);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
							}
							else if (ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
							{
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle);
								BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData.ScatterData, rectangle, reCalculateBoundsAfter: false);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
								legendLayer.SetBounds(rectangle2);
								graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(rectangle2);
								BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
								SetDataIntoLegendForScatterLine(ChartTypeData.LineData, rectangle2, reCalculateBoundsAfter: false);
								legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
							}
							legendLayer.SetBounds(outerBounds, reCalculateAfter: false);
						}
						else
						{
							graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
							graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(legendLayer.GetOuterBounds());
							BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
							legendLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
						}
						graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
						graphicsContext.ResetClip();
						BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
					}
					if (layerHashTable != null)
					{
						layerHashTable["Default"] = chartLayer;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
						{
							if (((string)key).Equals(array[j]))
							{
								((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
							}
						}
					}
					if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
					{
						multipleLayers[0].FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
					}
					if (!Is3D)
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(BaseScene);
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
						annotationLayer.FillSceneGraph(ScrollScene);
					}
					else
					{
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraphEffects(ScrollScene, component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) as EffectsAppearance);
						skinLayer.FillSceneGraphEffects(BaseScene, component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) as EffectsAppearance);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DrawInvalidChartImage(chartLayer.GetDataInvalidMessage());
					result = false;
				}
			}
			FillSceneGraphEventArgs e = new FillSceneGraphEventArgs(BaseScene, this);
			component.OnFillSceneGraph(e);
			FillSceneGraphEventArgs e2 = new FillSceneGraphEventArgs(ScrollScene, this);
			component.OnFillSceneGraph(e2);
			return result;
		}

		private void setupDataModelLine()
		{
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = ((ChartType != ChartType.ColumnLineChart) ? ((ScatterLineAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).LineData : ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).LineData);
			if (!component.IsDesignMode())
			{
				if (dataAppearance.DataSource != null)
				{
					IChartData connectTo = ChartDataAdapter.CreateAdapter(dataAppearance.DataSource, dataAppearance.DataMember, dataAppearance.cm, dataAppearance.relationName);
					ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = new ChartDataFilter(connectTo);
					DataAppearance dataAppearance2 = ((ChartType != ChartType.ColumnLineChart) ? ((ScatterLineAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).LineData : ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).LineData);
					chartDataFilter.SetSwapRowsAndColumns(dataAppearance2.SwapRowsAndColumns);
					chartDataFilter.SetUseRowLabels(dataAppearance.UseRowLabelsColumn);
					chartDataFilter.SetRowLabelsColumn(dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn);
					multipleData[1] = chartDataFilter;
					dataAppearance.InitializeAppearance(multipleData[1]);
				}
				else
				{
					dataAppearance.SetDataBindCalled(flag: false);
				}
			}
			if (multipleData[1] != null)
			{
				((IChartDataFilter)multipleData[1]).SetZeroAlignment(dataAppearance.ZeroAligned);
				((IChartDataFilter)multipleData[1]).SetSwapRowsAndColumns(dataAppearance.SwapRowsAndColumns);
			}
			gridLayer.zeroAlign = dataAppearance.ZeroAligned;
			if (multipleData[1] != null && multipleData[1] is ChartDataFilter)
			{
				((ChartDataFilter)multipleData[1]).SetRowLabels(dataAppearance.GetRowLabels());
				((ChartDataFilter)multipleData[1]).SetColumnLabels(dataAppearance.GetColumnLabels());
			}
			dataAppearance.SetDirty(dirty: false);
			multipleLayers[0].SetData(multipleData[1]);
		}

					chartDataFilter.SetUseRowLabels(columnData.UseRowLabelsColumn);

				else
				{

			if (multipleData[0] != null && multipleData[0] is ChartDataFilter)

			chartLayer.SetData(multipleData[0]);
		}

		private bool setupDataModelForColumnLine(ref DataAppearance dataAppColumn, ref DataAppearance dataAppLine)
		{
			dataAppColumn = ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).ColumnData;
			dataAppLine = ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).LineData;
			if (dataAppColumn != null && dataAppColumn.DataSource != null)
			{
				setupDataModelColumn();
			}
			if (dataAppLine != null && dataAppLine.DataSource != null)
			{
				setupDataModelLine();
			}
			if (dataAppLine != null && dataAppColumn != null && dataAppColumn.DataSource != null && dataAppLine.DataSource != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation == ChartTypeData.LineData)
				{
					num++;
				}
				legendLayer.SetChart(multipleLayers[num]);
				legendLayer.SetData(multipleData[num]);
				defaultNotRequired = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool setupDataModelForScatterLine(ref DataAppearance dataAppScatter, ref DataAppearance dataAppLine)
		{
			dataAppScatter = ((ScatterLineAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).ScatterData;
			dataAppLine = ((ScatterLineAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).LineData;
			if (dataAppScatter != null && dataAppScatter.DataSource != null)
			{
				setupDataModelScatter();
			}
			if (dataAppLine != null && dataAppLine.DataSource != null)
			{
				setupDataModelLine();
			}
			if (dataAppLine != null && dataAppScatter != null && dataAppScatter.DataSource != null && dataAppLine.DataSource != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation == ChartTypeData.LineData)
				{
					num++;
				}
				setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation);
				defaultNotRequired = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object CreateSurrogateDataSource(object datasource, string dataMember, CurrencyManager cm, string relationName)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = null;
			DataTable dataTable2 = null;
			if (datasource is DataTable)
			{
				dataTable = new DataTable(((DataTable)datasource).TableName);
				dataTable2 = (DataTable)datasource;
			}
			else if (datasource is DataSet)
			{
				dataTable = ((dataMember == null) ? new DataTable(((DataSet)datasource).Tables[0].TableName) : new DataTable(dataMember));
				dataTable2 = ((DataSet)datasource).Tables[0];
			}
			if (dataTable != null && dataTable2 != null)
			{
				int count = dataTable2.Columns.Count;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DataColumn column in dataTable2.Columns)
					{
						dataTable.Columns.Add(column.ColumnName, column.DataType);
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
					{
						object[] array = new object[count];
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							DataColumn dataColumn2 = dataTable.Columns[j];
							object[] array2;
							if ((array2 = (object[])surrogateTableData[dataColumn2.DataType.FullName]) != null)
							{
								if (array2[i] is int)
								{
									array[j] = (int)array2[i] + RANDOM.Next(30);
								}
								else
								{
									array[j] = array2[i];
								}
							}
						}
						dataTable.Rows.Add(array);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataTable = null;
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private void SetupDataModel()
		{
			defaultNotRequired = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < multipleData.Length; i++)
			{
				multipleData[i] = null;
			}
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			DataAppearance dataAppColumn = null;
			DataAppearance dataAppLine = null;
			DataAppearance dataAppScatter = null;
			if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
			{
				if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart)
				{
					if (setupDataModelForColumnLine(ref dataAppColumn, ref dataAppLine))
					{
						ChartTypeData dataAssociation = ((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation;
						if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
						{
							setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(dataAssociation);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (setupDataModelForScatterLine(ref dataAppScatter, ref dataAppLine))
				{
					ChartTypeData dataAssociation2 = ((LegendAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend)).DataAssociation;
					if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
					{
						setDataIntoLegendForMultipleCharts(dataAssociation2);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Series) as SeriesCollection;
			if (dataAppearance.SwapRowsAndColumns && ChartType != ChartType.Composite)
			{
				seriesCollection = SeriesSwap.Swap(seriesCollection);
			}
			bool flag = dataAppearance.DataSource == null && seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0;
			if (!flag && (dataAppearance.IsDirty() || ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart || data is GanttDataAdapter))
			{
				if (component.IsDesignMode())
				{
					if (dataAppearance.DataSource != null)
					{
						object obj = CreateSurrogateDataSource(dataAppearance.DataSource, dataAppearance.DataMember, dataAppearance.cm, dataAppearance.relationName);
						if (obj == null)
						{
							CreateDemoData();
						}
						else
						{
							IChartData chartData = ChartDataAdapter.CreateAdapter(obj, dataAppearance.DataMember, dataAppearance.cm, dataAppearance.relationName);
							ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = new ChartDataFilter(chartData);
							chartDataFilter.SetSwapRowsAndColumns(dataAppearance.SwapRowsAndColumns);
							if (dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn > -1 && dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn < chartData.GetColumnCount())
							{
								chartDataFilter.SetUseRowLabels(dataAppearance.UseRowLabelsColumn);
								chartDataFilter.SetRowLabelsColumn(dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn);
							}
							data = chartDataFilter;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						CreateDemoData();
					}
					SetDataIntoLayers(data);
				}
				if (!component.IsDesignMode())
				{
					if (dataAppearance.DataSource != null)
					{
						IChartData chartData2 = ChartDataAdapter.CreateAdapter(dataAppearance.DataSource, dataAppearance.DataMember, dataAppearance.cm, dataAppearance.relationName);
						if (chartData2 is GanttDataAdapter)
						{
							data = chartData2;
						}
						else
						{
							ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter2 = new ChartDataFilter(chartData2);
							DataAppearance dataAppearance2 = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
							chartDataFilter2.SetSwapRowsAndColumns(dataAppearance2.SwapRowsAndColumns);
							if (dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn > -1 && dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn < chartData2.GetColumnCount())
							{
								chartDataFilter2.SetUseRowLabels(dataAppearance.UseRowLabelsColumn);
								chartDataFilter2.SetRowLabelsColumn(dataAppearance.RowLabelsColumn);
							}
							data = chartDataFilter2;
						}
						dataAppearance.InitializeAppearance(data);
					}
					else
					{
						dataAppearance.SetDataBindCalled(flag: false);
					}
				}
				if (data != null && data is IChartDataFilter)
				{
					((IChartDataFilter)data).SetZeroAlignment(dataAppearance.ZeroAligned);
					((IChartDataFilter)data).SetSwapRowsAndColumns(dataAppearance.SwapRowsAndColumns);
				}
				if (data != null && data is ChartDataFilter)
				{
					((ChartDataFilter)data).SetRowLabels(dataAppearance.GetRowLabels());
					((ChartDataFilter)data).SetColumnLabels(dataAppearance.GetColumnLabels());
				}
				dataAppearance.SetDirty(dirty: false);
				if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
				{
					if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart)
					{
						SetDataIntoMultipleLayersIfRequiredForColumnLine(ref dataAppColumn, ref dataAppLine);
					}
					if (ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
					{
						SetDataIntoMultipleLayersIfRequiredForScatterLine(ref dataAppScatter, ref dataAppLine);
					}
				}
				if (ChartType == ChartType.GanttChart)
				{
					SetDataIntoGanttChart();
				}
				SetDataIntoLayers(data);
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				data = seriesCollection.GetVisibleSeries();
				SetDataIntoLayers(data);
			}
			gridLayer.zeroAlign = dataAppearance.ZeroAligned;
		}

		private void SetDataIntoMultipleLayersIfRequiredForColumnLine(ref DataAppearance dataAppColumn, ref DataAppearance dataAppLine)
		{
			if (dataAppColumn != null && dataAppColumn.DataSource == null)
			{
				chartLayer.SetData(data);
			}
			if (dataAppLine != null && dataAppLine.DataSource == null)
			{
				multipleLayers[0].SetData(data);
			}
		}

		private void SetDataIntoMultipleLayersIfRequiredForScatterLine(ref DataAppearance dataAppScatter, ref DataAppearance dataAppLine)
		{
			if (dataAppScatter.DataSource == null)
			{
				chartLayer.SetData(data);
			}
			if (dataAppLine.DataSource == null)
			{
				multipleLayers[0].SetData(data);
			}
		}

		internal void SetupColorModel()
		{
			ColorAppearance colorAppearance = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			if (!colorAppearance.IsDirty())
			{
				return;
			}
			IColorModel colorModel = null;
			switch (colorAppearance.ModelStyle)
			{
			case ColorModels.LinearRange:
				colorModel = new LinearColorModel(colorAppearance.ColorBegin, colorAppearance.ColorEnd, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel);
				break;
			case ColorModels.LinearRandom:
			case ColorModels.PureRandom:
			case ColorModels.CustomSkin:
				colorModel = ((colorAppearance.ModelStyle != ColorModels.PureRandom) ? new RandomColorModel(colorAppearance.ColorBegin, colorAppearance.ColorEnd, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel) : new RandomColorModel(colorAppearance.AlphaLevel));
				break;
			case ColorModels.Wireframe:
				colorModel = new SimpleColorModel(wireframe: true);
				break;
			case ColorModels.CustomLinear:
				colorModel = new CustomColorModel(colorAppearance.CustomPalette, random: false, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel);
				break;
			case ColorModels.CustomRandom:
				colorModel = new CustomColorModel(colorAppearance.CustomPalette, random: true, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel);
				break;
			case ColorModels.DataValueLinearRange:
				colorModel = new DataValueLinearColorModel(colorAppearance.ColorBegin, colorAppearance.ColorEnd, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel);
				break;
			case ColorModels.DataValueCustomLinear:
				colorModel = new DataValueCustomColorModel(colorAppearance.CustomPalette, random: false, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel);
				break;
			case ColorModels.Office2007Style:
				colorModel = new Office2007ColorModel(colorAppearance.ColorBegin, colorAppearance.AlphaLevel, data.GetColumnCount(), data.GetRowCount());
				break;
			}
			if (colorAppearance.ModelStyle == ColorModels.CustomSkin)
			{
				((SimpleColorModel)GetIColorModel()).SetColorByRow(colorAppearance.Skin.ApplyRowWise);
			}
			else
			{
				((SimpleColorModel)GetIColorModel()).SetColorByRow(GetColorByRowForChartType(ChartType));
			}
			if (colorModel != null)
			{
				((SimpleColorModel)colorModel).SetColorByRow(((SimpleColorModel)GetIColorModel()).GetColorByRow());
				((SimpleColorModel)colorModel).SetColorScaling(colorAppearance.Scaling);
				((SimpleColorModel)colorModel).SetGrayscale(colorAppearance.Grayscale);
				this.colorModel = colorModel;
				this.colorModel.SetData(data);
				chartLayer.SetColorModel(this.colorModel);
				if (layerHashTable != null)
				{
					foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
					{
						((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).ChartColorModel = this.colorModel;
					}
				}
				if (ChartType.ColumnLineChart == ChartType || ChartType.ScatterLineChart == ChartType)
				{
					multipleLayers[0].SetColorModel(this.colorModel);
				}
				legendLayer.SetColorModel(this.colorModel);
			}
			colorAppearance.SetDirty(dirty: false);
		}

		public void DrawInvalidChartImage(string message)
		{
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = DefaultConstants.D_ChartErrorFont;
			labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit = true;
			labelStyle.FontColor = Color.Red;
			labelStyle.WrapText = true;
			ChartDataInvalidEventArgs e = new ChartDataInvalidEventArgs(message, labelStyle);
			component.DataValidity(validity: false, e);
			Text value = new Text(borderLayer.GetInnerBounds(), e.Text, e.LabelStyle);
			sceneGraph.Clear();
			BaseScene.Clear();
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ResetClip();
			sceneGraph.Add(graphicsContext);
			BaseScene.Add(graphicsContext);
			borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(sceneGraph);
			sceneGraph.Add(value);
			BaseScene.Add(value);
		}

		public IChartData getProperDataForMultipleChart(Primitive prim)
		{
			ILayer layer = prim.Layer;
			if (layer != null && (layer.LayerID == "00" || layer.LayerID == "06"))
			{
				if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null)
				{
					return multipleData[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (multipleData != null && multipleData[1] != null)
			{
				return multipleData[1];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IChartData getProperDataForMultipleChart(AxisNumber axisNumber)
		{
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
			{
				if (multipleData != null && multipleData[0] != null)
				{
					return multipleData[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (multipleData != null && multipleData[1] != null)
			{
				return multipleData[1];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ChartDataEventArgs GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(Primitive prim)
		{
			if (prim == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (data is SeriesCollection && prim.DataPoint != null)
			{
				double result = double.NaN;
				if ((!(prim.Layer is ChartLayer) || !((ChartLayer)prim.Layer).Stacked) && (prim.Value == null || !double.TryParse(prim.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result)))
				{
					result = double.NaN;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(result))
				{
					if (prim.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint)
					{
						result = ((NumericDataPoint)prim.DataPoint).Value;
					}
					else if (prim.DataPoint is XYZDataPoint)
					{
						result = ((XYZDataPoint)prim.DataPoint).ValueZ;
					}
					else if (prim.DataPoint is XYDataPoint)
					{
						result = ((XYDataPoint)prim.DataPoint).ValueY;
					}
					else if (prim.DataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
					{
						result = ((NumericTimeDataPoint)prim.DataPoint).NumericValue;
					}
					else if (prim.DataPoint is BoxSet)
					{
						result = ((BoxSet)prim.DataPoint).Q2;
					}
				}
				if (prim.Layer != null)
				{
					_ = prim.Layer.LayerID;
				}
				return new ChartDataEventArgs(rowLabel: (prim.Series == null) ? prim.DataPoint.Label : prim.Series.Label, row: prim.Row, column: prim.Column, data: result, layerID: prim.Layer.LayerID, colLabel: prim.DataPoint.Label, primitive: prim);
			}
			if (prim.Row == -1 || prim.Column == -1)
			{
				if (prim.Value is double && prim.Layer != null)
				{
					return new ChartDataEventArgs(-1, -1, (double)prim.Value, prim.Layer.LayerID, "", "");
				}
				if (prim.Path == null || prim.Path.IndexOf("Drill") == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (prim.Layer is GanttLayer)
			{
				GanttSeriesCollection series = ((GanttLayer)prim.Layer).GanttData.Series;
				string rowLabel;
				if (prim.Row > -1 && prim.Row < series.Count)
				{
					GanttSeries ganttSeries = series[prim.Row];
					rowLabel = ganttSeries.Key;
				}
				else
				{
					rowLabel = "";
				}
				DateTime[] array = (DateTime[])prim.Value;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = array[1].Subtract(array[0]);
				return new ChartDataEventArgs(prim.Row, prim.Column, timeSpan.Ticks, prim.Layer.LayerID, rowLabel, series.GetItemLabel(prim.Column), prim);
			}
			if (prim.Layer is HistogramLayer)
			{
				return new ChartDataEventArgs(prim.Row, prim.Column, Convert.ToDouble(prim.Value), prim.Layer.LayerID, "", "", prim);
			}
			if (prim.Layer is TreeMapLayer)
			{
				if (prim.DataPoint is TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint)
				{
					return new ChartDataEventArgs(prim.Row, prim.Column, treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue, prim.Layer.LayerID, treeMapDataPoint.Label, treeMapDataPoint.Label, prim);
				}
				if (prim.Series is TreeMapSeries treeMapSeries)
				{
					return new ChartDataEventArgs(prim.Row, prim.Column, treeMapSeries.Value, prim.Layer.LayerID, treeMapSeries.Label, treeMapSeries.Label, prim);
				}
			}
			IChartData chartData = null;
			int row = prim.Row;
			int column = prim.Column;
			string layerID = ((prim.Layer == null) ? "" : prim.Layer.LayerID);
			if (data != null)
			{
				IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = data as IChartDataFilter;
				if (chartDataFilter != null)
				{
					if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
					{
						IChartData properDataForMultipleChart = getProperDataForMultipleChart(prim);
						if (properDataForMultipleChart != null)
						{
							chartDataFilter = (IChartDataFilter)properDataForMultipleChart;
						}
					}
					if (chartDataFilter.GetSwapRowsAndColumns())
					{
						row = chartDataFilter.GetRealRowNumber(prim.Column);
						column = chartDataFilter.GetRealColumnNumber(prim.Row);
					}
					else
					{
						row = chartDataFilter.GetRealRowNumber(row);
						column = chartDataFilter.GetRealColumnNumber(column);
					}
				}
				chartData = data;
				if (ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
				{
					IChartData properDataForMultipleChart2 = getProperDataForMultipleChart(prim);
					if (properDataForMultipleChart2 != null)
					{
						chartData = properDataForMultipleChart2;
					}
				}
			}
			double result2 = 0.0;
			object rowLabel2 = "";
			object colLabel = "";
			if ((chartLayer is PieLayer || chartLayer is Pie3DLayer) && prim.Row == chartData.GetRowCount())
			{
				PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance = chartLayer.GetAppearance() as PieChartAppearance;
				rowLabel2 = pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText;
				if (chartLayer is PieLayer)
				{
					_ = (PieLayer)chartLayer;
					result2 = ((PieLayer)chartLayer).GetOthersValue();
					colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(prim.Column);
				}
				else if (chartLayer is Pie3DLayer)
				{
					_ = (Pie3DLayer)chartLayer;
					result2 = ((Pie3DLayer)chartLayer).GetOthersValue();
					colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(prim.Column);
				}
			}
			else if (chartLayer is ParetoLayer && prim is DataPoint)
			{
				if (prim.Value != null)
				{
					double.TryParse(prim.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
				}
				rowLabel2 = chartData.GetRowLabel(prim.Row);
				colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(prim.Column);
			}
			else if (prim.Layer is PieLayer && prim.Tags != null && prim.Tags.ContainsKey("OthersList") && prim.Tags["OthersList"] is ArrayList)
			{
				PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance2 = ((PieLayer)prim.Layer).GetAppearance() as PieChartAppearance;
				rowLabel2 = pieChartAppearance2.OthersCategoryText;
				ArrayList arrayList = prim.Tags["OthersList"] as ArrayList;
				result2 = 0.0;
				foreach (double item in arrayList)
				{
					result2 += item;
				}
				colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(prim.Column);
			}
			else if (chartLayer is BoxChartLayer)
			{
				result2 = chartData.GetValue(prim.Row, 2);
				rowLabel2 = chartData.GetRowLabel(prim.Row);
				colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(2);
			}
			else if (chartLayer is HierarchicalLayer && prim.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = (NumericDataPoint)prim.DataPoint;
				result2 = numericDataPoint.Value;
				colLabel = prim.DataPoint.Label;
				if (prim.Series != null)
				{
					rowLabel2 = prim.Series.Label;
				}
			}
			else if (prim.Row >= 0 && prim.Row < chartData.GetRowCount() && prim.Column >= 0 && prim.Column < chartData.GetColumnCount())
			{
				result2 = chartData.GetValue(prim.Row, prim.Column);
				rowLabel2 = chartData.GetRowLabel(prim.Row);
				colLabel = chartData.GetColumnLabel(prim.Column);
			}
			return new ChartDataEventArgs(row, column, result2, layerID, rowLabel2, colLabel, prim);
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			foreach (object key in layerHashTable.Keys)
			{
				((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).ChartData = data;
				((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).ChartColorModel = colorModel;
				((ILayer)layerHashTable[key]).Grid = gridLayer.Grid;
			}
			Dirty = true;
			ResizeAllLayers();
		}

		{
			return sceneGraph.GetPrimitiveFromPoint(point);
		}

		public Primitive GetChartPrimitiveFromRowColumn(int row, int column)
		{
			return sceneGraph.GetPrimitiveFromRowColumn(row, column);
		}

		private bool TryIncludeColumn(IChartDataFilter filter, int columnIndex)
		{
			if (columnIndex >= 0 && columnIndex < filter.GetRawData().GetColumnCount())
			{
				filter.IncludeColumn(columnIndex, include: true);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetDataIntoGanttChart()
		{
			GanttChartAppearance ganttChartAppearance = GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() as GanttChartAppearance;
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = data as IChartDataFilter;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			GanttDataAdapter ganttDataAdapter;
			if (chartDataFilter != null)
			{
				ganttDataAdapter = chartDataFilter.GetRawData() as GanttDataAdapter;
				if (chartDataFilter.GetSwapRowsAndColumns())
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ganttDataAdapter = data as GanttDataAdapter;
			}
			GanttDataSource ganttData;
			if (ganttDataAdapter != null)
			{
				ganttData = ganttDataAdapter.GanttData;
				return;
			}
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				ganttData = new GanttDataSource();
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is GanttSeries)
					{
						ganttData.Series.Add((GanttSeries)item);
					}
				}
				data = new GanttDataAdapter(ganttData);
				return;
			}
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.StartTimeColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.EndTimeColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.SeriesLabelsColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.ItemLabelsColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.IDColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.LinkToColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.PercentCompleteColumnIndex);
			TryIncludeColumn(chartDataFilter, ganttChartAppearance.Columns.OwnerColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.StartTimeColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber2 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.EndTimeColumnIndex);
			if (filteredColumnNumber <= -1 || filteredColumnNumber2 <= -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int filteredColumnNumber3 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.SeriesLabelsColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber4 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.ItemLabelsColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber5 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.IDColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber6 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.LinkToColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber7 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.PercentCompleteColumnIndex);
			int filteredColumnNumber8 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(ganttChartAppearance.Columns.OwnerColumnIndex);
			GanttDataSource ganttDataSource = (((GanttLayer)GetChartLayer()).GanttData = new GanttDataSource());
			ganttData = ganttDataSource;
			string text = "Series";
			if (filteredColumnNumber3 <= -1)
			{
				ganttData.Series.Add(text);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				if (filteredColumnNumber3 > -1)
				{
					text = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber3) as string;
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = "";
					}
					if (ganttData.Series[text] == null)
					{
						ganttData.Series.Add(text);
					}
				}
				string text2 = null;
				if (filteredColumnNumber4 > -1)
				{
					text2 = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber4) as string;
				}
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					text2 = "Item " + i;
				}
				if (ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2] == null)
				{
					ganttData.Series[text].Items.Add(text2);
				}
				object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber);
				object objectValue2 = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber2);
				if (!(objectValue is DateTime) || !(objectValue2 is DateTime))
				{
					continue;
				}
				DateTime startTime = (DateTime)objectValue;
				DateTime endTime = (DateTime)objectValue2;
				int index = ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2].Times.Add(startTime, endTime);
				if (filteredColumnNumber5 > -1)
				{
					object objectValue3 = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber5);
					if (objectValue3 != null && double.TryParse(objectValue3.ToString(), NumberStyles.Integer, null, out var result))
					{
						ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2].Times[index].ID = (int)result;
					}
					if (filteredColumnNumber6 > -1)
					{
						object objectValue4 = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber6);
						if (objectValue4 != null && double.TryParse(objectValue4.ToString(), NumberStyles.Integer, null, out var result2))
						{
							ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2].Times[index].LinkToID = (int)result2;
						}
					}
				}
				if (filteredColumnNumber7 > -1)
				{
					object objectValue5 = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber7);
					if (objectValue5 != null && double.TryParse(objectValue5.ToString(), NumberStyles.Integer, null, out var result3))
					{
						ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2].Times[index].PercentComplete = result3;
					}
				}
				if (filteredColumnNumber8 > -1)
				{
					ganttData.Series[text].Items[text2].Times[index].Owner = data.GetObjectValue(i, filteredColumnNumber8) as string;
				}
			}
			data = new GanttDataAdapter(ganttData);
		}

		private bool HasLogarithmicAxis()
		{
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = (ChartGridAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis);
			if (chartGridAppearance.X.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && chartGridAppearance.Y.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && chartGridAppearance.Z.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && chartGridAppearance.X2.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && chartGridAppearance.Y2.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return chartGridAppearance.Z2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Point InternalRowAndColumn(Point externalRowAndColumn)
		{
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = null;
			if (data is GanttDataAdapter)
			{
				return externalRowAndColumn;
			}
			int x = externalRowAndColumn.X;
			int y = externalRowAndColumn.Y;
			int x2;
			int y2;
			if (data is IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter2)
			{
				if (chartDataFilter2.GetSwapRowsAndColumns())
				{
					x2 = chartDataFilter2.GetFilteredRowNumber(y);
					y2 = chartDataFilter2.GetFilteredColumnNumber(x);
				}
				else
				{
					x2 = chartDataFilter2.GetFilteredRowNumber(x);
					y2 = chartDataFilter2.GetFilteredColumnNumber(y);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				x2 = x;
				y2 = y;
			}
			return new Point(x2, y2);
		}
	}
}

				_Contrast = value;
			}
		}

		public SimpleColorModel()
		{
			calculateDistance();
		}

		public SimpleColorModel(bool wireframe)
		{
			this.wireframe = wireframe;
		}

		public SimpleColorModel(Color colorStart, Color colorEnd, byte alpha)
		{
			this.colorStart = colorStart;
			this.colorEnd = colorEnd;
			alphaValue = alpha;
		}

		public virtual Color getOutlineColor(int row, int column, double datavalue)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(alphaValue, Color.Black);
		}

		public virtual Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			if (wireframe)
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			return Color.White;
		}

		public virtual int getFillPattern(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			return 1;
		}

		public virtual void SetData(IChartData dat)
		{
			data = dat;
			InitializeColors();
		}

		public IChartData GetData()
		{
			return data;
		}

		public void SetPalette(Color[] palette)
		{
			this.palette = palette;
			paletteGiven = this.palette != null;
		}

		public Color[] GetPalette()
		{
			return palette;
		}

		public byte GetAlpha()
		{
			return alphaValue;
		}

		public Color GetStartColor()
		{
			return colorStart;
		}

		public Color GetEndColor()
		{
			return colorEnd;
		}

		public ColorScaling GetColorScaling()
		{
			return colorScaling;
		}

		public void SetColorScaling(ColorScaling scaling)
		{
			colorScaling = scaling;
		}

		public virtual void ResetColorModel()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeColors()
		{
		}

		public virtual void SetColorByRow(bool byRow)
		{
			colorByRow = byRow;
		}

		public virtual bool GetColorByRow()
		{
			return colorByRow;
		}

		public virtual void SetGrayscale(bool gray)
		{
			grayModel = gray;
		}

		public virtual bool GetGrayscale()
		{
			return grayModel;
		}

		protected void calculateDistance()
		{
			colorDistance = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((colorEnd.R - colorStart.R) * (colorEnd.R - colorStart.R) + (colorEnd.G - colorStart.G) * (colorEnd.G - colorStart.G) + (colorEnd.B - colorStart.B) * (colorEnd.B - colorStart.B)));
			staleDistance = false;
		}

		protected Color ScaleColor(Color color, int itemNumber, int totalCount)
		{
			if (colorScaling == ColorScaling.None)
			{
				return color;
			}
			double percent = (double)itemNumber / (double)totalCount * 0.7;
			Color result = color;
			switch (colorScaling)
			{
			case ColorScaling.Increasing:
				result = MiscFunctions.LightenColor(color, percent);
				break;
			case ColorScaling.Decreasing:
				result = MiscFunctions.DarkenColor(color, percent);
				break;
			case ColorScaling.Oscillating:
				if (itemNumber % 2 == 0)
				{
					percent = 0.0 / (double)totalCount * 0.7;
					result = MiscFunctions.LightenColor(color, percent);
				}
				else
				{
					percent = 2.0 / (double)totalCount * 0.7;
					result = MiscFunctions.DarkenColor(color, percent);
				}
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected Color GetGrayscaleColor(Color color)
		{
			int num = (color.R + color.G + color.B) / 3;
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, num, num, num);
		}

		protected void SetWireframe(bool wire)
		{
			wireframe = wire;
		}

		protected bool GetWireframe()
		{
			return wireframe;
		}

		protected double GetRangeMultiplier(double dataValue, double dataMax, double dataMin)
		{
			double num = dataMax - dataMin;
			if (Math.Abs(num) < 1E-323)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (dataValue - dataMin) / num;
		}

		public void Init(ColorAppearance colorApp)
		{
		}

		public PaintElement GetPE(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			return new PaintElement();
		}
	}
	public class CustomColorModel : SimpleColorModel
	{
		private Color[] customPalette;

		private Color[] randomizedPalette;

		private bool colorArrayRandom;

		protected virtual Color[] CustomPalette
		{
			get
			{
				return customPalette;
			}
			set
			{
				customPalette = value;
			}
		}

		public CustomColorModel(Color[] colorArray, bool random, byte alpha)
		{
			if (colorArray == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("colorArray");
			}
			customPalette = (Color[])colorArray.Clone();
			colorArrayRandom = random;
			AlphaValue = alpha;
		}

		public override Color getOutlineColor(int row, int column, double datavalue)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, Color.Black);
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			if (customPalette == null || customPalette.Length < 1)
			{
				return Color.White;
			}
			int num;
			int itemNumber;
			int totalCount;
			if (ColorByRow)
			{
				num = row % customPalette.Length;
				itemNumber = column;
				totalCount = Data.GetColumnCount();
			}
			else
			{
				num = column % customPalette.Length;
				itemNumber = row;
				totalCount = Data.GetRowCount();
			}
			Color blue = Color.Blue;
			blue = ((!colorArrayRandom) ? customPalette[num] : randomizedPalette[num]);
			Color color = ScaleColor(blue, itemNumber, totalCount);
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				return GetGrayscaleColor(color);
			}
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, color);
		}

		protected override void InitializeColors()
		{
			if (colorArrayRandom)
			{
				ResetColorModel();
				randomizedPalette = new Color[customPalette.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < customPalette.Length; i++)
				{
					ref Color reference = ref randomizedPalette[i];
					reference = customPalette[ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(customPalette.Length)];
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataValueCustomColorModel : CustomColorModel
	{
		public int CustomPaletteLength => CustomPalette.Length;

		public DataValueCustomColorModel(Color[] colorArray, bool random, byte alpha)
			: base(colorArray, random, alpha)
		{
			Array.Reverse(CustomPalette);
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			Color empty = Color.Empty;
			if (dataValue < Data.GetDataMin())
			{
				empty = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, CustomPalette[0]);
			}
			else if (dataValue > Data.GetDataMax())
			{
				empty = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, CustomPalette[CustomPalette.Length - 1]);
			}
			else
			{
				double rangeMultiplier = GetRangeMultiplier(dataValue, Data.GetDataMin(), Data.GetDataMax());
				if (Math.Abs(rangeMultiplier) < 1E-323)
				{
					empty = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, CustomPalette[0]);
				}
				else
				{
					int num = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)CustomPalette.Length * rangeMultiplier) - 1;
					empty = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, CustomPalette[num]);
				}
			}
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				empty = GetGrayscaleColor(empty);
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private double GetRangeIncrement()
		{
			double dataMax = Data.GetDataMax();
			double dataMin = Data.GetDataMin();
			return (dataMax - dataMin) / (double)CustomPalette.Length;
		}

		public double GetItemRangeBottomAt(int index)
		{
			return Data.GetDataMin() + GetRangeIncrement() * (double)index;
		}

		public double GetItemRangeTopAt(int index)
		{
			return Data.GetDataMax() - GetRangeIncrement() * (double)(CustomPalette.Length - index - 1);
		}

		public Color GetFillColorAtIndex(int index)
		{
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, CustomPalette[CustomPaletteLength - 1 - index]);
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				return GetGrayscaleColor(color);
			}
			return color;
		}
	}
	public class LinearColorModel : SimpleColorModel
	{
		private int _ItemCount = -1;

		public int ItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ItemCount == -1 && Data != null)
				{
					if (ColorByRow)
					{
						return Data.GetRowCount();
					}
					return Data.GetColumnCount();
				}
				return _ItemCount;
			}
			set
			{
				_ItemCount = value;
			}
		}

		public LinearColorModel()
		{
		}

		public LinearColorModel(Color start, Color end, byte alpha)
			: base(start, end, alpha)
		{
		}

		public override Color getOutlineColor(int row, int column, double datavalue)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, Color.Black);
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			if (GetStartColor().Equals(GetEndColor()))
			{
				return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, GetStartColor());
			}
			return getColor(row, column);
		}

		private Color getColor(int row, int column)
		{
			Color result = Color.Beige;
			if (PaletteGiven && Palette != null)
			{
				if (column < Palette.Length)
				{
					result = Palette[column];
				}
				if (RotatePalette)
				{
					result = Palette[column % Palette.Length];
				}
				return result;
			}
			if (StaleDistance)
			{
				calculateDistance();
			}
			int num;
			int itemNumber;
			int totalCount;
			if (ColorByRow)
			{
				num = row;
				itemNumber = column;
				totalCount = Data.GetColumnCount();
			}
			else
			{
				num = column;
				itemNumber = row;
				totalCount = Data.GetRowCount();
			}
			ColorDistance = Math.Max(1, ColorDistance);
			double num2 = (double)ColorDistance / Math.Max((double)ItemCount - 1.0, 1.0);
			int num3 = (int)((double)(int)ColorStart.R + (double)num * num2 * (double)(ColorEnd.R - ColorStart.R) / (double)ColorDistance);
			int num4 = (int)((double)(int)ColorStart.G + (double)num * num2 * (double)(ColorEnd.G - ColorStart.G) / (double)ColorDistance);
			int num5 = (int)((double)(int)ColorStart.B + (double)num * num2 * (double)(ColorEnd.B - ColorStart.B) / (double)ColorDistance);
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			if (num3 > 255)
			{
				num3 = 255;
			}
			if (num4 < 0)
			{
				num4 = 0;
			}
			if (num4 > 255)
			{
				num4 = 255;
			}
			if (num5 < 0)
			{
				num5 = 0;
			}
			if (num5 > 255)
			{
				num5 = 255;
			}
			result = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, num3, num4, num5);
			Color color = ScaleColor(result, itemNumber, totalCount);
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				return GetGrayscaleColor(color);
			}
			return color;
		}
	}
	public class DataValueLinearColorModel : LinearColorModel
	{
		public DataValueLinearColorModel(Color start, Color end, byte alpha)
			: base(start, end, alpha)
		{
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			double rangeMultiplier = GetRangeMultiplier(dataValue, Data.GetDataMin(), Data.GetDataMax());
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, GetDeltaR(rangeMultiplier), GetDeltaG(rangeMultiplier), GetDeltaB(rangeMultiplier));
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				return GetGrayscaleColor(color);
			}
			return color;
		}

		private byte GetDeltaR(double valueDelta)
		{
			return (byte)((double)(int)ColorEnd.R - valueDelta * (double)(ColorEnd.R - ColorStart.R));
		}

		private byte GetDeltaG(double valueDelta)
		{
			return (byte)((double)(int)ColorEnd.G - valueDelta * (double)(ColorEnd.G - ColorStart.G));
		}

		private byte GetDeltaB(double valueDelta)
		{
			return (byte)((double)(int)ColorEnd.B - valueDelta * (double)(ColorEnd.B - ColorStart.B));
		}

		private double GetValueDelta(double dataValue)
		{
			double dataMin = Data.GetDataMin();
			double num = Data.GetDataMax() - dataMin;
			if (Math.Abs(num) < 1E-323)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (dataValue - dataMin) / num;
		}
	}
	public class Office2007ColorModel : SimpleColorModel
	{
		private int _palleteCount;

		private int _columnCount;

		private int _rowCount;

		private double _saturation;

		private ArrayList _colors = new ArrayList();

		internal double Saturation
		{
			get
			{
				return _saturation;
			}
			set
			{
				_saturation = value;
			}
		}

		public Office2007ColorModel(Color start, int alpha, int columnCount, int rowCount)
		{
			ColorStart = start;
			AlphaValue = byte.Parse(alpha.ToString());
			_rowCount = rowCount;
			_columnCount = columnCount;
			_palleteCount = columnCount;
			_saturation = 0.02;
			PopulateColorArray();
		}

		private void PopulateColorArray()
		{
			_colors.Clear();
			double num = 0.3;
			double num2 = 0.85;
			HSL hSLFromColor = GetHSLFromColor(ColorStart);
			int num3 = _palleteCount;
			if (_palleteCount % 2 > 0)
			{
				_colors.Add(ColorStart);
				num3--;
			}
			double num4 = (hSLFromColor.Light - num) / (double)(num3 / 2);
			double num5 = (hSLFromColor.Light - num2) * -1.0 / (double)(num3 / 2);
			double num6 = num4 / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < _palleteCount / 2; i++)
			{
				hSLFromColor = GetHSLFromColor(ColorStart);
				hSLFromColor.Light += num6 * -1.0;
				num6 += num4;
				hSLFromColor.Saturation += _saturation;
				_colors.Insert(0, GetColorFromHSL(hSLFromColor));
			}
			double num7 = num5 / 2.0;
			for (int j = 1; j <= _palleteCount / 2; j++)
			{
				hSLFromColor = GetHSLFromColor(ColorStart);
				hSLFromColor.Light += num7;
				num7 += num5;
				hSLFromColor.Saturation += _saturation * -1.0;
				_colors.Add(GetColorFromHSL(hSLFromColor));
			}
		}

		private Color getColor(int index)
		{
			if (_colors.Count == 0)
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			return (Color)_colors[index % _colors.Count];
		}

		public override Color getOutlineColor(int row, int column, double datavalue)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, Color.Black);
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			if (ColorByRow)
			{
				_rowCount = Data.GetRowCount();
				if (_palleteCount != _rowCount)
				{
					_palleteCount = _rowCount;
					PopulateColorArray();
				}
				return getColor(row);
			}
			_columnCount = Data.GetColumnCount();
			if (_palleteCount != _columnCount)
			{
				_palleteCount = _columnCount;
				PopulateColorArray();
			}
			return getColor(column);
		}

		private HSL GetHSLFromColor(Color c)
		{
			double hue = (double)c.GetHue() / 360.0;
			double saturation = c.GetSaturation();
			double light = c.GetBrightness();
			return new HSL(hue, saturation, light);
		}

		private Color GetColorFromHSL(HSL hsl)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (hsl.Light != 0.0)
			{
				if (hsl.Saturation == 0.0)
				{
					num = (num2 = (num3 = hsl.Light));
				}
				else
				{
					double num4 = ((hsl.Light <= 0.5) ? (hsl.Light * (1.0 + hsl.Saturation)) : (hsl.Light + hsl.Saturation - hsl.Light * hsl.Saturation));
					double num5 = 2.0 * hsl.Light - num4;
					double[] array = new double[3]
					{
						hsl.Hue + 1.0 / 3.0,
						hsl.Hue,
						hsl.Hue - 1.0 / 3.0
					};
					double[] array2 = new double[3];
					double[] array3 = array2;
					for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
					{
						if (array[i] < 0.0)
						{
							array[i] += 1.0;
						}
						if (array[i] > 1.0)
						{
							array[i] -= 1.0;
						}
						if (6.0 * array[i] < 1.0)
						{
							array3[i] = num5 + (num4 - num5) * array[i] * 6.0;
						}
						else if (2.0 * array[i] < 1.0)
						{
							array3[i] = num4;
						}
						else if (3.0 * array[i] < 2.0)
						{
							array3[i] = num5 + (num4 - num5) * (2.0 / 3.0 - array[i]) * 6.0;
						}
						else
						{
							array3[i] = num5;
						}
					}
					num = array3[0];
					num2 = array3[1];
					num3 = array3[2];
				}
			}
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, (int)(255.0 * num), (int)(255.0 * num2), (int)(255.0 * num3));
		}
	}
	internal class HSL
	{
		private double _hue;

		private double _saturation;

		private double _light;

		public double Hue
		{
			get
			{
				return _hue;
			}
			set
			{
				_hue = ((value > 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((value < 0.0) ? 0.0 : value));
			}
		}

		public double Saturation
		{
			get
			{
				return _saturation;
			}
			set
			{
				_saturation = ((value > 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((value < 0.0) ? 0.0 : value));
			}
		}

		public double Light
		{
			get
			{
				return _light;
			}
			set
			{
				_light = ((value > 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((value < 0.0) ? 0.0 : value));
			}
		}

		internal HSL(double hue, double saturation, double light)
		{
			_hue = hue;
			_saturation = saturation;
			_light = light;
		}
	}
	public class RandomColorModel : SimpleColorModel
	{
		private static int MAX_RANDOM_COLORS = 255;

		private Color[] RNDcolorArray = new Color[MAX_RANDOM_COLORS];

		private bool linearColorPointsModel;

		public RandomColorModel()
		{
		}

		public RandomColorModel(byte alpha)
		{
			AlphaValue = alpha;
		}

		public RandomColorModel(Color colorStart, Color colorEnd, byte alpha)
			: base(colorStart, colorEnd, alpha)
		{
			linearColorPointsModel = true;
			ColorDistance = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((colorEnd.R - colorStart.R) * (colorEnd.R - colorStart.R) + (colorEnd.G - colorStart.G) * (colorEnd.G - colorStart.G) + (colorEnd.B - colorStart.B) * (colorEnd.B - colorStart.B)));
			if (ColorDistance == 0)
			{
				ColorDistance = 1;
			}
		}

		public override Color getOutlineColor(int row, int column, double datavalue)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, Color.Black);
		}

		public override Color getFillColor(int row, int column, double dataValue)
		{
			if (RNDcolorArray == null)
			{
				return Color.Black;
			}
			int val;
			int itemNumber;
			int totalCount;
			if (ColorByRow)
			{
				val = row % RNDcolorArray.Length;
				itemNumber = column;
				totalCount = Data.GetColumnCount();
			}
			else
			{
				val = column % RNDcolorArray.Length;
				itemNumber = row;
				totalCount = Data.GetRowCount();
			}
			Color color = RNDcolorArray[Math.Max(0, val)];
			Color color2 = ScaleColor(color, itemNumber, totalCount);
			if (GrayModel)
			{
				return GetGrayscaleColor(color2);
			}
			return color2;
		}

		public override void ResetColorModel()
		{
			InitializeColors();
		}

		private Color getColorRandom()
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(255), ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(255), ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(255));
		}

		private Color getRandomColorLinear()
		{
			int num = ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(ColorDistance);
			int red = ColorStart.R + num * (ColorEnd.R - ColorStart.R) / ColorDistance;
			int green = ColorStart.G + num * (ColorEnd.G - ColorStart.G) / ColorDistance;
			int blue = ColorStart.B + num * (ColorEnd.B - ColorStart.B) / ColorDistance;
			return Color.FromArgb(AlphaValue, red, green, blue);
		}

		protected override void InitializeColors()
		{
			if (Data == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < MAX_RANDOM_COLORS; i++)
			{
				if (linearColorPointsModel)
				{
					ref Color reference = ref RNDcolorArray[i];
					reference = getRandomColorLinear();
				}
				else
				{
					ref Color reference2 = ref RNDcolorArray[i];
					reference2 = getColorRandom();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void SetData(IChartData dat)
		{
			if (Data == null)
			{
				base.SetData(dat);
			}
			else
			{
				Data = dat;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class RulerBase : IRuler, IAdvanceAxis, IOperate, IComparer, IScrollScaleWindow, IMapWindow, IMapLog, IRangeType, ITickmark
	{
		private double _LogZero;

		private LogNegativeHandling _LogNegativeHandling;

		private object mRangeMin;

		private object mRangeMax;

		private double m_Scroll;

		private double m_Scale = 1.0;

		private double m_MapMinimum;

		private double m_MapMaximum = 1.0;

		private object m_WindowMinimum;

		private object m_WindowMaximum;

		private object m_Minimum;

		private object m_Maximum;

		private double m_LogBase = 10.0;

		private double m_Exponent_min = -1.0;

		private double m_Exponent_max = 1.0;

		private NumericAxisType m_RulerType;

		private AxisTickStyle _TickStyle = AxisTickStyle.Percentage;

		private object _TickInterval = 10.0;

		private double _TickPercentage = 10.0;

		private object _TickAlign;

		private bool _EnableTickAlign;

		protected virtual double LogZero

		public AxisRangeType RangeType

				CorrectWindowMinMax();

		}

		public object RangeMin
		{
			get

				return mRangeMin;
			}
			set

				mRangeMin = value;
				CorrectLogRanges();
			}
		}

		public object RangeMax
		{
			get
			{
				return mRangeMax;
			}
			set
			{
				mRangeMax = value;
				CorrectLogRanges();
			}
		}

		public object RangeRange => Subtract(mRangeMax, mRangeMin);

		public double LogBase
		{
			get
			{
				return m_LogBase;
			}
			set
			{
				m_LogBase = value;
				CorrectLogRanges();
			}
		}

		public double Exponent_min => m_Exponent_min;

		public double Exponent_max => m_Exponent_max;

		public double Exponent_Range => m_Exponent_max - m_Exponent_min;

		public double ExponentWindowMin => m_Exponent_min + m_Scroll * Exponent_Range * (1.0 - m_Scale);

		public double ExponentWindowMax => ExponentWindowMin + m_Scale * Exponent_Range;

		public double ExponentWindowRange => ExponentWindowMax - ExponentWindowMin;

		public NumericAxisType RulerType
		{
			get
			{
				return m_RulerType;
			}
			set
			{
				m_RulerType = value;
				if (value == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					CorrectLogRanges();
				}
			}
		}

		public double Scroll
		{
			get
			{
				return m_Scroll;
			}
			set
			{
				m_Scroll = value;
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public double Scale
		{
			get
			{
				return m_Scale;
			}
			set
			{
				m_Scale = value;
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public double MapRange => m_MapMaximum - m_MapMinimum;

		public double MapMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_MapMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_MapMinimum = value;
			}
		}

		public double MapMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_MapMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_MapMaximum = value;
			}
		}

		public object Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_Minimum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_Minimum = value;
				CorrectLogRanges();
			}
		}

		public object Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_Maximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_Maximum = value;
				CorrectLogRanges();
			}
		}

		public object WindowMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMinimum;

				CorrectScrollScale();
			}

		public object WindowMaximum
		{
			get
