				return m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMaximum = value;
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public object WindowRange => Subtract(WindowMaximum, WindowMinimum);

		public object TotalRange => Subtract(m_Maximum, m_Minimum);

		public object Zero => Subtract(m_Minimum, m_Minimum);

		protected object InternalMax
		{
			get
			{
				if (RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
				{
					return Maximum;
				}
				return RangeMax;
			}
		}

		protected object InternalMin
		{
			get
			{
				if (RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
				{
					return Minimum;
				}
				return RangeMin;
			}
		}

		protected object InternalRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
				{
					return TotalRange;
				}
				return RangeRange;
			}
		}

		public abstract RulerGenre Genre { get; }

		public abstract Type Type { get; }

		public AxisTickStyle TickStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return _TickStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				_TickStyle = value;
			}
		}

		public object TickInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return _TickInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				_TickInterval = value;
			}
		}

		public double TickPercentage
		{
			get
			{
				return _TickPercentage;
			}
			set
			{
				_TickPercentage = value;
				_TickInterval = InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(TotalRange) * _TickPercentage / 100.0);
			}
		}

		public object TickIntervalResolved
		{
			get
			{
				object result = null;
				switch (_TickStyle)
				{
				case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
				case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
					if (NumericOf(_TickInterval) < double.Epsilon)
					{
						throw new Exception("Very small tick interval");
					}
					result = _TickInterval;
					break;
				case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
				{
					double d_i = NumericOf(TotalRange) * _TickPercentage / 100.0;
					result = InverseNumericOf(d_i);
					break;
				}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double LogTickIntervalResolved
		{
			get
			{
				double result = 1.0;
				switch (_TickStyle)
				{
				case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
					result = NumericOf(_TickInterval);
					break;
				case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
					result = Exponent_Range * TickPercentage / 100.0;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public object TickAlignResolved
		{
			get
			{
				object result = null;
				object tickIntervalResolved = TickIntervalResolved;
				if (_EnableTickAlign)
				{
					if (!_TickAlign.Equals(Zero))
					{
						result = ((Compare(_TickAlign, tickIntervalResolved) >= 1) ? InverseNumericOf(Math.Abs(NumericOf(_TickAlign)) % NumericOf(tickIntervalResolved)) : _TickAlign);
					}
					else if (NumericOf(Multiply(Minimum, Maximum)) < 0.0)
					{
						result = InverseNumericOf(Math.Abs(NumericOf(Minimum)) % NumericOf(tickIntervalResolved));
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public TickmarkIEnumerable MajorTicks => new TickmarkIEnumerable(this, TickType.Major);

		public TickmarkIEnumerable MinorTicks => new TickmarkIEnumerable(this, TickType.Minor);

		public object TickAlign
		{
			get
			{
				return _TickAlign;
			}
			set
			{
				_TickAlign = value;
			}
		}

		public bool EnableTickAlign
		{
			get
			{
				return _EnableTickAlign;
			}
			set
			{
				_EnableTickAlign = value;
			}
		}

		protected void Init(object min, object max)
		{
			Minimum = min;
			Maximum = max;
			MapMinimum = 0.0;
			MapMaximum = 100.0;
			Scroll = 0.0;
			Scale = 1.0;
		}

		public bool ItemVisible(object d_i)
		{
			int num = Compare(WindowMaximum, d_i);
			int num2 = Compare(WindowMinimum, d_i);
			int num3 = Compare(InternalMax, d_i);
			int num4 = Compare(InternalMin, d_i);
			if (num != 0 && num2 != 0)
			{
				if (num > -1 && num2 < 1 && num3 > -1)
				{
					return num4 < 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public double Map(object d_i)
		{
			double mapMinimum = MapMinimum;
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmap(d_i);
			}
			return linear(d_i);
		}

		public object MapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmapInverse(d_i);
			}
			return linearInverse(d_i);
		}

		private object linearInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(WindowMinimum) + (m_i - MapMinimum) * NumericOf(WindowRange) / MapRange);
		}

		private object logmapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), LogBase));
			return InverseNumericOf(MapMinimum + MapRange * ((num - ExponentWindowMin) / ExponentWindowRange));
		}

		private double linear(object d_i)
		{
			return MapMinimum + MapRange * (NumericOf(d_i) - NumericOf(m_WindowMinimum)) / NumericOf(WindowRange);
		}

		private double logmap(object d_i)
		{
			double num = NumericOf(d_i);
			double num2 = ((num < double.Epsilon) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(num), LogBase));
			return MapMinimum + MapRange * ((num2 - ExponentWindowMin) / ExponentWindowRange);
		}

		protected void CorrectScrollScale()
		{
			m_Scale = NumericOf(WindowRange) / NumericOf(InternalRange);
			m_Scroll = (NumericOf(m_WindowMinimum) - NumericOf(InternalMin)) / (NumericOf(InternalRange) * (1.0 - m_Scale));
		}

		protected void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
			m_WindowMinimum = Add(InternalMin, InverseNumericOf(m_Scroll * (1.0 - m_Scale) * NumericOf(InternalRange)));
			m_WindowMaximum = Add(m_WindowMinimum, InverseNumericOf(m_Scale * NumericOf(InternalRange)));
		}

		protected void CorrectLogRanges()
		{
			m_Exponent_min = Math.Log(NumericOf(InternalMin), LogBase);
			m_Exponent_max = Math.Log(NumericOf(InternalMax), LogBase);
		}

		public abstract double NumericOf(object d_i);

		public abstract object InverseNumericOf(double d_i);

		public abstract object NullValue(object input);

		public virtual object Add(object addendum, object addendee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(addendum) + NumericOf(addendee));
		}

		public virtual object Subtract(object subtractum, object subtractee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(subtractum) - NumericOf(subtractee));
		}

		public virtual object Divide(object dividend, object divisor)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(dividend) / NumericOf(divisor));
		}

		public virtual object Multiply(object multiplicand, object multiplier)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(multiplicand) * NumericOf(multiplier));
		}

		public object Max(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) > NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public object Min(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) < NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public virtual int Compare(object obj1, object obj2)
		{
			if (NumericOf(obj1) < NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (NumericOf(obj1) > NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class TickmarkIEnumerable : IEnumerable
	{
		private TickmarkEnumerator _TickmarkEnumerator;

		public TickmarkIEnumerable(RulerBase ruler, TickType type)
		{
			_TickmarkEnumerator = new TickmarkEnumerator(ruler, type);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _TickmarkEnumerator;
		}
	}
	public class TickmarkEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private RulerBase _Ruler;

		private TickType _Type;

		private object _Tick;

		private object _HalfTick;

		private object _Remainder;

		private double _Logtick;

		private object _Current;

		private bool _FirstTime = true;

		public object Current => _Current;

		public TickmarkEnumerator(RulerBase ruler, TickType type)
		{
			_Ruler = ruler;
			_Type = type;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_Tick = _Ruler.TickIntervalResolved;
			_Logtick = _Ruler.LogTickIntervalResolved;
			_Remainder = _Ruler.TickAlignResolved;
			if (_Type == TickType.Minor && _Ruler.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Linear)
			{
				_HalfTick = _Ruler.Divide(_Tick, 2);
				if (_Ruler.Compare(_HalfTick, _Remainder) < 0)
				{
					_Remainder = _Ruler.InverseNumericOf(Math.Abs(_Ruler.NumericOf(_Remainder)) % _Ruler.NumericOf(_HalfTick));
				}
			}
			_FirstTime = true;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (_FirstTime)
			{
				_Current = _Ruler.Add(_Remainder, _Ruler.WindowMinimum);
				_FirstTime = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_Current = _Ruler.Add(_Current, _Tick);
			}
			return _Ruler.Compare(_Current, _Ruler.WindowMaximum) <= 0;
		}
	}
	public enum TickType
	{
		Major,
		Minor
	}
	public class NumericRuler : RulerBase
	{
		public override RulerGenre Genre => RulerGenre.Continuous;

		public override Type Type => typeof(double);

		public NumericRuler(double min, double max)
		{
			Init(min, max);
		}

		public NumericRuler()
			: this(0.0, 100.0)
		{
		}

		public override object NullValue(object input)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return input;
		}

		public override double NumericOf(object d_i)
		{
			if (d_i is IConvertible)
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(d_i);
			}
			return double.Parse(NullValue(d_i).ToString());
		}

		public override object InverseNumericOf(double d_i)
		{
			return d_i;
		}
	}
	public class TimeRuler : RulerBase
	{
		public override RulerGenre Genre => RulerGenre.Continuous;

		public override Type Type => typeof(DateTime);

		public TimeRuler(DateTime min, DateTime max)
		{
			Init(min, max);
		}

		public TimeRuler()
			: this(new DateTime(1974, 5, 17, 5, 30, 0), DateTime.Now)
		{
		}

		public override object NullValue(object input)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				return base.InternalMin;
			}
			return input;
		}

		public override object Subtract(object subtractum, object subtractee)
		{
			return ((DateTime)NullValue(subtractum)).Subtract((DateTime)NullValue(subtractee));
		}

		public override double NumericOf(object d_i)
		{
			long num = ((DateTime)base.InternalMin).Ticks + 1;
			object obj = NullValue(d_i);
			if (obj is DateTime { Ticks: var ticks })
			{
				num = ((ticks != ((DateTime)base.InternalMin).Ticks) ? (((DateTime)obj).Ticks - ((DateTime)base.InternalMin).Ticks) : ((base.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic) ? 1 : 0));
			}
			else if (obj is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				num = timeSpan.Ticks;
			}
			else if (obj is long)
			{
				num = (long)d_i;
			}
			else if (obj is int)
			{
				num = (int)d_i;
			}
			else if (obj is double)
			{
				num = (long)(double)d_i;
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					num = DateTime.Parse(obj.ToString()).Ticks - ((DateTime)base.InternalMin).Ticks + 1;
				}
				catch (FormatException)
				{
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override object InverseNumericOf(double d_i)
		{
			return Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Util.ValidDateTime(((DateTime)base.InternalMin).Ticks + (long)d_i);
		}
	}

		internal static DateTimeInterval GetScale(DateTime min, DateTime max, int n)
		{
			DateTimeInterval dateTimeInterval = new DateTimeInterval();
			TimeSpan timeSpan = max.Subtract(min);
			if (timeSpan.Ticks == 0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Days;
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 1.0;
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day).AddHours(1.0);
				return dateTimeInterval;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Ticks / n);
			int num = n / 2;
			double num2 = -1.0;
			if (timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)(31 * n))
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Years;
				num2 = timeSpan2.Days / 365;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)(7 * n) && 31.0 * timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Months;
				num2 = timeSpan2.Days / 31;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)n && 7.0 * timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Weeks;
				num2 = timeSpan2.Days / 7;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalHours >= (double)n && timeSpan2.TotalDays >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Days;
				num2 = timeSpan2.TotalDays;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalMinutes >= (double)n && timeSpan2.TotalHours >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Hours;
				num2 = timeSpan2.TotalHours;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalSeconds >= (double)n && timeSpan2.TotalMinutes >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Minutes;
				num2 = timeSpan2.TotalMinutes;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.TotalMilliseconds >= (double)n && timeSpan2.TotalSeconds >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Seconds;
				num2 = timeSpan2.TotalSeconds;
			}
			else if (timeSpan2.Ticks >= n && timeSpan2.TotalMilliseconds >= (double)num)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Milliseconds;
				num2 = timeSpan2.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			else
			{
				dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Ticks;
				num2 = timeSpan2.Ticks;
			}
			if (num2 <= 2.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 1.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 3.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 2.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 5.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 5.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 10.0)
			{
				AxisIntervalType intervalType = dateTimeInterval.IntervalType;
				if (intervalType == AxisIntervalType.Hours || intervalType == AxisIntervalType.Months)
				{
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 6.0;
				}
				else
				{
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 10.0;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 <= 25.0)
			{
				switch (dateTimeInterval.IntervalType)
				{
				case AxisIntervalType.Hours:
				case AxisIntervalType.Months:
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 12.0;
					break;
				case AxisIntervalType.Minutes:
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 15.0;
					break;
				default:
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 25.0;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 <= 50.0)
			{
				switch (dateTimeInterval.IntervalType)
				{
				case AxisIntervalType.Seconds:
				case AxisIntervalType.Minutes:
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 30.0;
					break;
				default:
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 50.0;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 <= 100.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 100.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 250.0)
			{
				if (dateTimeInterval.IntervalType == AxisIntervalType.Minutes && n >= 5 && n <= 10)
				{
					dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Hours;
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 2.0;
				}
				else
				{
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 250.0;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 <= 500.0)
			{
				if (dateTimeInterval.IntervalType == AxisIntervalType.Minutes && n >= 5 && n <= 10)
				{
					dateTimeInterval.IntervalType = AxisIntervalType.Hours;
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 4.0;
				}
				else
				{
					dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 500.0;
				}
			}
			else if (num2 <= 1000.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 1000.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 5000.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 5000.0;
			}
			else if (num2 <= 10000.0)
			{
				dateTimeInterval.TickInterval = 10000.0;
			}
			switch (dateTimeInterval.IntervalType)
			{
			case AxisIntervalType.Years:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, 1, 1);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, 1, 1).AddYears(1);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Months:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, 1);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, 1).AddMonths(1);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Weeks:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day).AddDays(1.0);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Days:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day).AddDays(1.0);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Hours:
			{
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day, min.Hour, 0, 0);
				DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day, max.Hour, 0, 0);
				if (DateTime.Compare(dateTime, DateTime.MaxValue.AddHours(-1.0)) <= 0)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddHours(1.0);
				}
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = dateTime;
				break;
			}
			case AxisIntervalType.Minutes:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day, min.Hour, min.Minute, 0);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day, max.Hour, max.Minute, 0).AddMinutes(1.0);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Seconds:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day, min.Hour, min.Minute, min.Second);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day, max.Hour, max.Minute, max.Second).AddSeconds(1.0);
				break;
			case AxisIntervalType.Milliseconds:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = new DateTime(min.Year, min.Month, min.Day, min.Hour, min.Minute, min.Second, min.Millisecond);
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = new DateTime(max.Year, max.Month, max.Day, max.Hour, max.Minute, max.Second, max.Millisecond).AddMilliseconds(1.0);
				break;
			default:
				dateTimeInterval.Minimum = min;
				dateTimeInterval.Maximum = max;
				break;
			}
			return dateTimeInterval;
		}
	}
	internal class AnInterval : Interval
	{
		public static double[] vint = new double[4] { 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0 };

		public static double[] sqr = new double[3] { 1.414214, 3.162278, 7.071068 };

		public double NumericMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)base.Maximum;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Maximum = value;
			}
		}

		public double NumericMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)base.Minimum;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Minimum = value;
			}
		}

		public AnInterval(double min, double max)
		{
			base.Minimum = min;
			base.Maximum = max;
		}

		public AnInterval(double min, double max, double dataInterval)
			: this(min, max)
		{
			TickInterval = dataInterval;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Concat("Interval = {range=(", base.Minimum, ",", base.Maximum, "), dist=", TickInterval, "}");
		}

		internal static void SmartRangeAndInterval(IRuler axis, int n)
		{
			if (axis.Zero is double)
			{
				AnInterval scale = GetScale((double)axis.Minimum, (double)axis.Maximum, 10);
				axis.Minimum = scale.Minimum;
				axis.Maximum = scale.Maximum;
				axis.TickInterval = scale.TickInterval;
			}
		}

		internal static AnInterval GetScale(double xmin, double xmax, int n)
		{
			if (n <= 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Bad arguments passed to function GetScale");
			}
			double num = n;
			double num2 = 2E-05;
			double num3 = Math.Abs(xmax - xmin) / num;
			double num4 = Math.Log10(num3);
			int num5 = (int)num4;
			if (num3 < 1.0)
			{
				num5--;
			}
			double num6 = num3 / Math.Pow(10.0, num5);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < 3 && num6 >= sqr[i]; i++)
			{
			}
			double num7 = vint[i] * Math.Pow(10.0, num5);
			double num8 = xmin / num7;
			long num9 = (long)num8;
			if (num8 < 0.0)
			{
				num9--;
			}
			if (Math.Abs((double)num9 + 1.0 - num8) < num2)
			{
				num9++;
			}
			double num10 = num7 * (double)num9;
			double num11 = xmax / num7;
			long num12 = (long)(num11 + 1.0);
			if (num11 < -1.0)
			{
				num12--;
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num11 + 1.0 - (double)num12) < num2)
			{
				num12--;
			}
			double num13 = num7 * (double)num12;
			if (num10 > xmin)
			{
				num10 = xmin;
			}
			if (num13 < xmax)
			{
				num13 = xmax;
			}
			while (num10 + num7 * (double)n < num13)
			{
				num7 *= 2.0;
			}
			return new AnInterval(num10, num13, num7);
		}
	}
	public interface IProvideMeasurements
	{
		Point DataToPointPlane(double DataHorzMin, double DataHorzMax, double DataVertMin, double DataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v);

		Point DataToPointVertical(double DataMin, double DataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i);

		Point DataToPointHorizontal(double DataMin, double DataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i);

		PointF DataToPointPlaneF(double DataHorzMin, double DataHorzMax, double DataVertMin, double DataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v);

		PointF DataToPointVerticalF(double DataMin, double DataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i);

		PointF DataToPointHorizontalF(double DataMin, double DataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i);

		double DataToDouble(double DataMin, double DataMax, double p1, double p2, double d_i);

		Point angularToCartesian(Point center, double radius, double theta);

		Point angularToCartesianReverse(Point center, double radius, double theta);

		double DataToAngle(double DataMin, double DataMax, double thetaMin, double thetaMax, double d_i);

		int SetDataItem(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i);

		int SetDataSet(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i);

		double SetDataItemWidth(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth);

		float DateDataDate(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, float totalWidth, DateTime d_i);

		Color Data2Color(Color startColor, Color endColor, double DataMax, double DataMin, double val);
	}
	public class LinearMeasurements : IProvideMeasurements
	{
		public Point DataToPointPlane(double DataHorzMin, double DataHorzMax, double DataVertMin, double DataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v)
		{
			Point result = default(Point);
			Point point = new Point(leftTop.X, bottomRight.Y);
			Point p = bottomRight;
			Point p2 = point;
			Point p3 = leftTop;
			result.X = DataToPointHorizontal(DataHorzMin, DataHorzMax, point, p, d_h).X;
			result.Y = DataToPointVertical(DataVertMin, DataVertMax, p2, p3, d_v).Y;
			return result;
		}

		public Point DataToPointVertical(double DataMin, double DataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = p1.X,
				Y = p1.Y - (int)((double)Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y) * (d_i - DataMin) / Math.Abs(DataMax - DataMin))
			};
		}

		public Point DataToPointHorizontal(double DataMin, double DataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = p1.X + (int)((double)Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X) * (d_i - DataMin) / Math.Abs(DataMax - DataMin)),
				Y = p1.Y
			};
		}

		public PointF DataToPointPlaneF(double DataHorzMin, double DataHorzMax, double DataVertMin, double DataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v)
		{
			PointF result = default(PointF);
			PointF pointF = new PointF(leftTop.X, bottomRight.Y);
			PointF p = bottomRight;
			PointF p2 = pointF;
			PointF p3 = leftTop;
			result.X = DataToPointHorizontalF(DataHorzMin, DataHorzMax, pointF, p, d_h).X;
			result.Y = DataToPointVerticalF(DataVertMin, DataVertMax, p2, p3, d_v).Y;
			return result;
		}

		public PointF DataToPointVerticalF(double DataMin, double DataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new PointF
			{
				X = p1.X,
				Y = p1.Y - (float)((double)Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y) * (d_i - DataMin) / Math.Abs(DataMax - DataMin))
			};
		}

		public PointF DataToPointHorizontalF(double DataMin, double DataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new PointF
			{
				X = p1.X + (float)((double)Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X) * (d_i - DataMin) / Math.Abs(DataMax - DataMin)),
				Y = p1.Y
			};
		}

		public double DataToDouble(double DataMin, double DataMax, double p1, double p2, double d_i)
		{
			return Math.Abs(p2 - p1) * Math.Abs(d_i - DataMin) / Math.Abs(DataMax - DataMin);
		}

		public Point angularToCartesian(Point center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = center.X + (int)(radius * Math.Cos(theta)),
				Y = center.Y + (int)(radius * Math.Sin(theta))
			};
		}

		public Point angularToCartesianReverse(Point center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = center.X + (int)(radius * Math.Sin(theta)),
				Y = center.Y + (int)(radius * Math.Cos(theta))
			};
		}

		public double DataToAngle(double DataMin, double DataMax, double thetaMin, double thetaMax, double d_i)
		{
			return (thetaMax - thetaMin) * d_i / (DataMax - DataMin);
		}

		public int SetDataItem(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i)
		{
			double num = SetDataItemWidth(itemCount, inSetCount, interSeriesSpacing, interBarSpacing, totalWidth);
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)(item_i / inSetCount));
			double num3 = (double)(interSeriesSpacing * num2 + interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1) * num2 + item_i) * num;
			int num4 = item_i % inSetCount;
			double num5 = num * (double)interBarSpacing * (double)num4;
			return (int)(num3 + num5);
		}

		public int SetDataSet(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i)
		{
			double num = SetDataItemWidth(itemCount, inSetCount, interSeriesSpacing, interBarSpacing, totalWidth);
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)(item_i / inSetCount));
			double num3 = (double)(interSeriesSpacing * num2 + interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1) * num2 + item_i) * num;
			return (int)num3;
		}

		public double SetDataItemWidth(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth)
		{
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			double num = itemCount / inSetCount;
			double num2 = (double)interSeriesSpacing * (num - 1.0) + (double)(interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1)) * num + (double)itemCount;
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			return (double)totalWidth / num2;
		}

		public float DateDataDate(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, float totalWidth, DateTime d_i)
		{
			long ticks = startDate.Ticks;
			long ticks2 = endDate.Ticks;
			long ticks3 = d_i.Ticks;
			long num = ticks2 - ticks;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			return (float)(ticks3 - ticks) * totalWidth / (float)num;
		}

		public Color Data2Color(Color startColor, Color endColor, double DataMax, double DataMin, double val)
		{
			if (startColor.Equals(endColor) || DataMax == DataMin)
			{
				return startColor;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((endColor.R - startColor.R) * (endColor.R - startColor.R) + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * (endColor.G - startColor.G) + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * (endColor.B - startColor.B)));
			double num2 = (val - DataMin) / (DataMax - DataMin);
			int num3 = (int)((double)num * num2);
			int num4 = startColor.R + num3 * (endColor.R - startColor.R) / num;
			int num5 = startColor.G + num3 * (endColor.G - startColor.G) / num;
			int num6 = startColor.B + num3 * (endColor.B - startColor.B) / num;
			num4 = ((num4 > 255) ? 255 : num4);
			num5 = ((num5 > 255) ? 255 : num5);
			num6 = ((num6 > 255) ? 255 : num6);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			num5 = ((num5 >= 0) ? num5 : 0);
			num6 = ((num6 >= 0) ? num6 : 0);
			return Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, num4, num5, num6);
		}
	}

		public Color Data2Color(Color startColor, Color endColor, double DataMax, double DataMin, double val)
		{
			if (startColor.Equals(endColor) || DataMax == DataMin)
			{
				return startColor;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((endColor.R - startColor.R) * (endColor.R - startColor.R) + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * (endColor.G - startColor.G) + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * (endColor.B - startColor.B)));
			double num2 = (val - DataMin) / (DataMax - DataMin);
			int num3 = (int)((double)num * num2);
			int num4 = startColor.R + num3 * (endColor.R - startColor.R) / num;
			int num5 = startColor.G + num3 * (endColor.G - startColor.G) / num;
			int num6 = startColor.B + num3 * (endColor.B - startColor.B) / num;
			num4 = ((num4 > 255) ? 255 : num4);
			num5 = ((num5 > 255) ? 255 : num5);
			num6 = ((num6 > 255) ? 255 : num6);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			num5 = ((num5 >= 0) ? num5 : 0);
			num6 = ((num6 >= 0) ? num6 : 0);
			return Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, num4, num5, num6);
		}
	}
	public interface IProvidePrimitives
	{
		Primitive GetPrimitiveFromRowColumn(int row, int column, Type primitiveType);
	}

		public virtual void SetupDataFilter(DataAppearance dataApp)
		{
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = (IChartDataFilter)data;
			if (chartDataFilter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			chartDataFilter.ResetColumnList();
			IChartData rawData = chartDataFilter.GetRawData();
			int columnCount = rawData.GetColumnCount();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				if (data.GetUseRowLabels() && data.GetRowLabelsColumn() == i)
				{
					rawData.SetRowLabelsColumn(i);
					rawData.SetUseRowLabels(use: true);
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (rawData.IsColumnString(i))
				{
					if (!flag && !data.GetUseRowLabels())
					{
						rawData.SetRowLabelsColumn(i);
						rawData.SetUseRowLabels(use: true);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (rawData.IsColumnDateTime(i) && !flag)
				{
					rawData.SetRowLabelsColumn(i);
					rawData.SetUseRowLabels(use: true);
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (rawData.IsColumnNumeric(i))
				{
					if (dataApp.IsColumnExcluded(i))
					{
						chartDataFilter.IncludeColumn(i, include: false);
					}
					else
					{
						chartDataFilter.IncludeColumn(i, include: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetupDataFilter()
		{
			SetupDataFilter((DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data));
		}

		public Layer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore chartCore)

		{
			if (data.GetColumnCount() < 1 || data.GetRowCount() < 1)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = true;
			}
		}

		}

		}

		{

		}

		}

	public abstract class ChartLayer : Layer
	{
		private static Hashtable ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes;

		private static Hashtable ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked;

		private bool _hasEmptyValues;

		private NullHandling _nullHandling;

		private bool stacked;

		protected internal bool EmptyValues
		{
			get
			{
				return _hasEmptyValues;
			}
			set
			{
				_hasEmptyValues = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasEmptyValues => EmptyValues;

		protected NullHandling NullHandling
		{
			get
			{
				return _nullHandling;
			}
			set
			{
				_nullHandling = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Stacked
		{
			get
			{
				return stacked;
			}
			set
			{
				stacked = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal void DrawInvalidMessage(SceneGraph scene, string message)
		{
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit = true;
			labelStyle.WrapText = true;
			labelStyle.FontColor = Color.Red;
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartDataInvalidEventArgs e = new ChartDataInvalidEventArgs(message, labelStyle);
				ChartComponent.DataValidity(validity: false, e);
				message = e.Text;
				labelStyle = e.LabelStyle;
			}
			Text value = new Text(GetInnerBounds(), message, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
		}

		protected internal bool ValidateSeriesCollectionForStackedChart(SeriesCollection seriesCol)
		{
			object dataMinimum = seriesCol.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
			object dataMaximum = seriesCol.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (dataMinimum is double)
			{
				num = (double)dataMinimum;
			}
			if (dataMaximum is double)
			{
				num2 = (double)dataMaximum;
			}
			return num * num2 >= 0.0;
		}

		static ChartLayer()
		{
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes = new Hashtable();
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked = new Hashtable();
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(AreaLayer), ChartType.AreaChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(BarLayer), ChartType.BarChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(BubbleLayer), ChartType.BubbleChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(CandleLayer), ChartType.CandleChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(ColumnLayer), ChartType.ColumnChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(DoughnutLayer), ChartType.DoughnutChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(GanttLayer), ChartType.GanttChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(HeatMapLayer), ChartType.HeatMapChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(LineLayer), ChartType.LineChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(ParetoLayer), ChartType.ParetoChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(PieLayer), ChartType.PieChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(PolarLayer), ChartType.PolarChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(RadarLayer), ChartType.RadarChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(ScatterLayer), ChartType.ScatterChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(ProbabilityLayer), ChartType.ProbabilityChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(SplineAreaLayer), ChartType.SplineAreaChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(SplineLayer), ChartType.SplineChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.Add(typeof(StepLineLayer), ChartType.StepLineChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(AreaLayer), ChartType.StackAreaChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(BarLayer), ChartType.StackBarChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(ColumnLayer), ChartType.StackColumnChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(LineLayer), ChartType.StackLineChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(SplineAreaLayer), ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart);
			ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.Add(typeof(SplineLayer), ChartType.StackSplineChart);
		}

		protected internal virtual InterpolateValuesEventArgs InterpolateValues(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, int arrayWidth)
		{
			InterpolateValuesEventArgs e = new InterpolateValuesEventArgs();
			e.Type = type;
			if (type == typeof(double))
			{
				e.Values = new object[primitives.Count];
			}
			else if (type == typeof(double[]) || type == typeof(object[]))
			{
				e.Values = new object[primitives.Count, arrayWidth];
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				Primitive primitive = primitives[i];
				if (primitive.Value is Array array)
				{
					switch (array.Length)
					{
					case 2:
					{
						object value = array.GetValue(0);
						object value2 = array.GetValue(1);
						e.Values.SetValue(value, i, 0);
						e.Values.SetValue(value2, i, 1);
						if (value == null || value2 == null)
						{
							arrayList.Add(i);
						}
						continue;
					}
					}
					if (arrayWidth == 3)
					{
						object value = array.GetValue(0);
						object value2 = array.GetValue(1);
						object value3 = array.GetValue(2);
						e.Values.SetValue(value, i, 0);
						e.Values.SetValue(value2, i, 1);
						e.Values.SetValue(value3, i, 2);
						if (value == null || value2 == null || value3 == null)
						{
							arrayList.Add(i);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						object obj = ((array.GetValue(1) != null || !(array.GetValue(2) is NumericTimeDataPoint)) ? array.GetValue(1) : ((object)((NumericTimeDataPoint)array.GetValue(2)).NumericValue));
						e.Values.SetValue(obj, i);
						if (obj == null)
						{
							arrayList.Add(i);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (primitive == null || primitive.Empty)
				{
					arrayList.Add(i);
					e.Values.SetValue(null, i);
				}
				else
				{
					e.Values.SetValue(primitive.Value, i);
				}
			}
			e.NullValueIndices = new int[arrayList.Count];
			arrayList.CopyTo(e.NullValueIndices);
			NullHandling nullHandling = NullHandling;
			if (nullHandling == NullHandling.InterpolateCustom && ChartComponent.IsDesignMode())
			{
				nullHandling = NullHandling.InterpolateSimple;
			}
			switch (nullHandling)
			{
			case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
				ChartComponent.OnInterpolateValues(e);
				break;
			default:
				e.Values = InterpolateSimple(e);
				break;
			}
			return e;
		}

		protected virtual PrimitiveCollection InterpolatePrimitives(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type)
		{
			return InterpolatePrimitives(primitives, type, 1);
		}

		private ChartType GetChartTypeForCompositeChart()
		{
			Type type = GetType();
			if (Stacked && ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked.ContainsKey(type) && ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked[type] is ChartType)
			{
				return (ChartType)ChartTypesForChartLayerTypesStacked[type];
			}
			if (ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes.ContainsKey(type) && ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes[type] is ChartType)
			{
				return (ChartType)ChartTypesForChartLayerTypes[type];
			}
			return ChartType.Composite;
		}

		internal static InterpolateValuesEventArgs InterpolateNumericTimeValues(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, ChartLayer layer)
		{
			InterpolateValuesEventArgs e = new InterpolateValuesEventArgs();
			e.Type = type;
			e.Values = new object[primitives.Count, 2];
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				if (primitives[i] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int row = primitives[i].Row;
				object obj = null;
				object obj2 = null;
				if (primitives[i].DataPoint != null && primitives[i].DataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
				{
					NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = (NumericTimeDataPoint)primitives[i].DataPoint;
					if (!numericTimeDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						obj = numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue;
						obj2 = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
					}
					else
					{
						if (numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue != DateTime.MinValue)
						{
							obj = numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue;
						}
						if (!IsNaNOrZero(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue))
						{
							obj2 = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					obj = layer.data.GetObjectValue(row, 0);
					obj2 = layer.data.GetObjectValue(row, 1);
				}
				e.Values.SetValue(obj, i, 0);
				e.Values.SetValue(obj2, i, 1);
				if (obj == null || obj2 == null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(i);
				}
			}
			e.NullValueIndices = (int[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(int));
			NullHandling nullHandling = layer.NullHandling;
			if (nullHandling == NullHandling.InterpolateCustom && layer.ChartComponent.IsDesignMode())
			{
				nullHandling = NullHandling.InterpolateSimple;
			}
			switch (nullHandling)
			{
			case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
				layer.ChartComponent.OnInterpolateValues(e);
				break;
			default:
				e.Values = layer.InterpolateSimple(e);
				break;
			}
			return e;
		}

		private static bool IsNaNOrZero(double num)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && num != 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual PrimitiveCollection InterpolatePrimitives(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, int arrayWidth)
		{
			InterpolateValuesEventArgs e = InterpolateValues(primitives, type, arrayWidth);
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = base.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis3 = base.Grid["X2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis4 = base.Grid["Y2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			object obj = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				Primitive primitive = null;
				ChartType chartType = ((primitives[i].Chart != ChartType.Composite) ? primitives[i].Chart : GetChartTypeForCompositeChart());
				switch (chartType)
				{
				case ChartType.LineChart:
				case ChartType.SplineChart:
				case ChartType.StackLineChart:
				case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
					if (advanceAxis is TimeAxis)
					{
						object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
						object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
						if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
						{
							Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(obj2), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
							primitive = new DataPoint(p);
						}
						else
						{
							primitive = primitives[i];
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = e.Values.GetValue(i);
						primitive = ((obj == null) ? primitives[i] : new DataPoint((int)advanceAxis.Map(i), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj)));
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.AreaChart:
				case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
				case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
				case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
					if (advanceAxis is TimeAxis || type == typeof(object[]))
					{
						object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
						object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
						if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
						{
							object d_i = ((!(advanceAxis is SetLabelAxis)) ? obj2 : ((object)i));
							Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(d_i), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
							primitive = new DataPoint(p);
						}
						else
						{
							primitive = primitives[i];
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = e.Values.GetValue(i);
						primitive = ((obj == null) ? primitives[i] : new DataPoint((int)advanceAxis.Map(i), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj)));
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.ParetoChart:
					primitive = primitives[i];
					primitive.Value = e.Values.GetValue(i);
					break;
				case ChartType.ColumnChart:
				case ChartType.BarChart:
				case ChartType.StackBarChart:
				case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
				{
					if (!(primitives[i] is Box box))
					{
						break;
					}
					obj = e.Values.GetValue(i);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
						break;
					}
					double num3;
					double num4;
					double num7;
					double num8;
					if (chartType == ChartType.ColumnChart || chartType == ChartType.StackColumnChart || chartType == ChartType.ParetoChart)
					{
						num3 = box.rect.Left;
						num4 = box.rect.Width;
						double num5 = advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero);
						double num6 = advanceAxis2.Map(obj);
						if (num6 <= num5)
						{
							num7 = num6;
							num8 = num5 - num7;
						}
						else
						{
							num7 = num5;
							num8 = num6 - num5;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num7 = box.rect.Top;
						num8 = box.rect.Height;
						double num9 = advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero);
						double num10 = advanceAxis.Map(obj);
						if (num10 >= num9)
						{
							num3 = num9;
							num4 = num10 - num9;
						}
						else
						{
							num3 = num10;
							num4 = num9 - num10;
						}
					}
					primitive = new Box(new Rectangle((int)num3, (int)num7, (int)num4, (int)num8));
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.BubbleChart:
				{
					object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
					object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
					object value = e.Values.GetValue(i, 2);
					if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null && value != null)
					{
						int radius = (int)advanceAxis4.Map(value);
						Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(obj2), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
						BubbleChartAppearance bubbleChartAppearance = null;
						if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
						{
							bubbleChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as BubbleChartAppearance;
						}
						if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
						{
							bubbleChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Bubble) as BubbleChartAppearance;
						}
						primitive = BubbleLayer.GetShape(bubbleChartAppearance.BubbleShape, radius, p);
						primitive.PE = primitives[i].PE;
						((PrimitiveShape)primitive).lineStyle = ((PrimitiveShape)primitives[i]).lineStyle;
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.ScatterChart:
				case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
				{
					object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
					object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
					if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
					{
						Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(obj2), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
						primitive = new DataPoint(p);
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
					obj = e.Values.GetValue(i);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (primitives[i] is Box)
						{
							Rectangle rect = ((Box)primitives[i]).rect;
							double num11 = rect.Left;
							double num12 = rect.Width;
							double num13 = advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero);
							double num14 = advanceAxis2.Map(obj);
							double num15;
							double num16;
							if (num14 <= num13)
							{
								num15 = num14;
								num16 = num13 - num15;
							}
							else
							{
								num15 = num13;
								num16 = num14 - num13;
							}
							primitive = new Box(new Rectangle((int)num11, (int)num15, (int)num12, (int)num16));
						}
						else if (primitives[i] is DataPoint)
						{
							primitive = new DataPoint((int)advanceAxis3.Map(i), (int)advanceAxis4.Map(e.Values.GetValue(i)));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
					if (!(primitives[i] is DataPoint))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (primitives[i].Value is double)
					{
						obj = e.Values.GetValue(i);
						primitive = ((obj == null) ? primitives[i] : new DataPoint((int)advanceAxis3.Map(i), (int)advanceAxis4.Map(obj)));
					}
					else if (primitives[i].Value is Array)
					{
						object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
						object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
						if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
						{
							Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(obj2), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
							primitive = new DataPoint(p);
						}
						else
						{
							primitive = primitives[i];
						}
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.StepLineChart:
				case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				{
					object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
					object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
					if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
					{
						Point p = new Point((int)advanceAxis.Map(obj2), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
						primitive = new DataPoint(p);
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.PolarChart:
				{
					if (!(this is PolarLayer polarLayer))
					{
						break;
					}
					object obj2 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
					object obj3 = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
					if (obj2 != null && !(obj2 is double))
					{
						double result = double.NaN;
						if (double.TryParse(obj2.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result))
						{
							obj2 = result;
						}
					}
					if (obj3 != null && !(obj3 is double))
					{
						double result2 = double.NaN;
						if (double.TryParse(obj3.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2))
						{
							obj3 = result2;
						}
					}
					if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null && obj2 is double && obj3 is double)
					{
						double num = Math.Abs(advanceAxis2.Map(obj3));
						double num2 = advanceAxis.Map(obj2);
						int x = polarLayer.CenterResolved.X + (int)(num * Math.Cos(num2));
						int y = polarLayer.CenterResolved.Y + (int)(num * Math.Sin(num2));
						Point p = new Point(x, y);
						primitive = new DataPoint(p);
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = primitives[i];
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.RadarChart:
					primitive = primitives[i];
					primitive.Value = e.Values.GetValue(i);
					break;
				}
				if (primitive != null)
				{
					if (primitives[i] != null)
					{
						primitive.Empty = primitives[i] == null || primitives[i].Empty;
						primitive.Caps = primitives[i].Caps;
						primitive.Value = primitives[i].Value;
						primitive.Row = primitives[i].Row;
						primitive.Column = primitives[i].Column;
						primitive.Layer = primitives[i].Layer;
						primitive.Chart = primitives[i].Chart;
						primitive.Tags = primitives[i].Tags;
						primitive.DataPoint = primitives[i].DataPoint;
						primitive.Series = primitives[i].Series;
					}
					primitiveCollection.Add(primitive);
				}
			}
			return primitiveCollection;
		}

		private int GetIndexOfPreviousNonNullValue(int index, object[] values)
		{
			for (int num = index; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (values[num] != null)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(int index, object[] values)
		{
			for (int i = index; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (values[i] != null)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private object[] InterpolateDateTimesSimple(Array values)
		{
			object[] array = new object[values.Length];
			values.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (i == 0)
				{
					int indexOfNextNonNullValue = GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(i, array);
					if (indexOfNextNonNullValue == -1)
					{
						array[i] = DateTime.MinValue;
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = array[indexOfNextNonNullValue];
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (i == array.Length - 1)
				{
					int indexOfPreviousNonNullValue = GetIndexOfPreviousNonNullValue(i, array);
					if (indexOfPreviousNonNullValue == -1)
					{
						array[i] = DateTime.MaxValue;
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue];
					}
					continue;
				}
				int indexOfNextNonNullValue2 = GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(i, array);
				int indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 = GetIndexOfPreviousNonNullValue(i, array);
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
				DateTime dateTime2 = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					dateTime = ((!(array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2] is DateTime)) ? DateTime.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2].ToString()) : ((DateTime)array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2]));
				}
				if (indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					dateTime2 = ((!(array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2] is DateTime)) ? DateTime.Parse(array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2].ToString()) : ((DateTime)array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2]));
				}
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 == -1 && indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime2;
				}
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 != -1 && indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 == -1)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime;
				}
				array[i] = new DateTime(dateTime2.Ticks / 2 + dateTime.Ticks / 2);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private int[] GetIndexOfNextNonNull(int yDirection, int xDirection, int[] startIndex, object[,] matrix)
		{
			if (startIndex.Length != 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("startIndex must be 2 integers.", "startIndex");
			}
			if (matrix.Rank != 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("matrix must be a 2-dimensional array.", "matrix");
			}
			int num = matrix.GetUpperBound(0) + 1;
			int num2 = matrix.GetUpperBound(1) + 1;
			if (yDirection == -1 && xDirection == 0)
			{
				for (int num3 = startIndex[0] - 1; num3 > -1; num3--)
				{
					if (matrix[num3, startIndex[1]] != null)
					{
						return new int[2]
						{
							num3,
							startIndex[1]
						};
					}
				}
				return new int[2] { -1, -1 };
			}
			if (yDirection == 1 && xDirection == 0)
			{
				for (int i = startIndex[0] + 1; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (matrix[i, startIndex[1]] != null)
					{
						return new int[2]
						{
							i,
							startIndex[1]
						};
					}
				}
				return new int[2] { -1, -1 };
			}
			if (yDirection == 0 && xDirection == -1)
			{
				for (int num4 = startIndex[1] - 1; num4 > -1; num4--)
				{
					if (matrix[startIndex[0], num4] != null)
					{
						return new int[2]
						{
							startIndex[0],
							num4
						};
					}
				}
				return new int[2] { -1, -1 };
			}
			if (yDirection == 0 && xDirection == 1)
			{
				for (int j = startIndex[1] + 1; j < num2; j++)
				{
					if (matrix[startIndex[0], j] != null)
					{
						return new int[2]
						{
							startIndex[0],
							j
						};
					}
				}
				return new int[2] { -1, -1 };
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("yDirection and xDirection must be one of the following combinations: {-1, 0} (up), {1, 0} (down), {0, -1} (left), {0, 1} (right)");
		}

		private Array InterpolateMatrixOfDoublesSimple(Array values)
		{
			object[,] array = values as object[,];
			object[,] array2 = array.Clone() as object[,];
			int num = array.GetUpperBound(1) + 1;
			int num2 = array.GetUpperBound(0) + 1;
			if (array != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						if (array[i, j] == null)
						{
							int[] indexOfNextNonNull = GetIndexOfNextNonNull(-1, 0, new int[2] { i, j }, array);
							int[] indexOfNextNonNull2 = GetIndexOfNextNonNull(1, 0, new int[2] { i, j }, array);
							int[] indexOfNextNonNull3 = GetIndexOfNextNonNull(0, -1, new int[2] { i, j }, array);
							int[] indexOfNextNonNull4 = GetIndexOfNextNonNull(0, 1, new int[2] { i, j }, array);
							double num3 = 0.0;
							double num4 = 0.0;
							double num5 = 0.0;
							double num6 = 0.0;
							if (indexOfNextNonNull[0] > -1 && indexOfNextNonNull[1] > -1)
							{
								num3 = double.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNull[0], indexOfNextNonNull[1]].ToString());
							}
							if (indexOfNextNonNull2[0] > -1 && indexOfNextNonNull2[1] > -1)
							{
								num4 = double.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNull2[0], indexOfNextNonNull2[1]].ToString());
							}
							if (indexOfNextNonNull3[0] > -1 && indexOfNextNonNull3[1] > -1)
							{
								num5 = double.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNull3[0], indexOfNextNonNull3[1]].ToString());
							}
							if (indexOfNextNonNull4[0] > -1 && indexOfNextNonNull4[1] > -1)
							{
								num6 = double.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNull4[0], indexOfNextNonNull4[1]].ToString());
							}
							if (j == 0 && i == 0)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num4 + num6) / 2.0;
							}
							else if (j == num - 1 && i == 0)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num4 + num5) / 2.0;
							}
							else if (j == 0 && i == num2 - 1)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num6) / 2.0;
							}
							else if (j == num - 1 && i == 0)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num5) / 2.0;
							}
							else if (j == 0)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num4 + num6) / 3.0;
							}
							else if (j == num - 1)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num4 + num5) / 3.0;
							}
							else if (i == 0)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num4 + num5 + num6) / 3.0;
							}
							else if (i == num2 - 1)
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num5 + num6) / 3.0;
							}
							else
							{
								array2[i, j] = (num3 + num4 + num5 + num6) / 4.0;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return array2;
			}
			return values;
		}

		private object[] InterpolateDoublesSimple(Array values)
		{
			object[] array = new object[values.Length];
			values.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (i == 0)
				{
					int indexOfNextNonNullValue = GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(i, array);
					if (indexOfNextNonNullValue == -1)
					{
						array[i] = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = array[indexOfNextNonNullValue];
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (i == array.Length - 1)
				{
					int indexOfPreviousNonNullValue = GetIndexOfPreviousNonNullValue(i, array);
					if (indexOfPreviousNonNullValue == -1)
					{
						array[i] = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue];
					}
					continue;
				}
				int indexOfNextNonNullValue2 = GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(i, array);
				int indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 = GetIndexOfPreviousNonNullValue(i, array);
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					num = ((!(array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2] is NumericDataPoint)) ? double.Parse(array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2].ToString()) : ((NumericDataPoint)array[indexOfNextNonNullValue2]).Value);
				}
				if (indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					num2 = ((!(array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2] is NumericDataPoint)) ? double.Parse(array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2].ToString()) : ((NumericDataPoint)array[indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2]).Value);
				}
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 == -1 && indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 != -1)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				if (indexOfNextNonNullValue2 != -1 && indexOfPreviousNonNullValue2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
				array[i] = num2 / 2.0 + num / 2.0;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected internal Array InterpolateSimple(InterpolateValuesEventArgs e)
		{
			Array array = null;
			if (e.Type == typeof(double))
			{
				array = InterpolateDoublesSimple(e.Values);
			}
			else if (e.Type == typeof(double[]) && e.Values.Rank == 2)
			{
				array = (Array)e.Values.Clone();
				int length = e.Values.GetLength(0);
				int num = e.Values.GetUpperBound(1) + 1;
				object[] array2 = new object[length];
				object[] array3 = new object[length];
				object[] array4 = null;
				if (num == 3)
				{
					array4 = new object[length];
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = e.Values.GetValue(i, 0);
					array3[i] = e.Values.GetValue(i, 1);
					if (num == 3)
					{
						array4[i] = e.Values.GetValue(i, 2);
					}
				}
				array2 = InterpolateDoublesSimple(array2);
				array3 = InterpolateDoublesSimple(array3);
				if (num == 3)
				{
					array4 = InterpolateDoublesSimple(array4);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					array.SetValue(array2[j], j, 0);
					array.SetValue(array3[j], j, 1);
					if (num == 3)
					{
						array.SetValue(array4[j], j, 2);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (e.Type == typeof(object[]) && e.Values.Rank == 2)
			{
				array = (Array)e.Values.Clone();
				int length2 = e.Values.GetLength(0);
				int num2 = e.Values.GetUpperBound(1) + 1;
				if (num2 == 2 && length2 > 0)
				{
					object[] array5 = new object[length2];
					object[] array6 = new object[length2];
					for (int k = 0; k < length2; k++)
					{
						array5[k] = e.Values.GetValue(k, 0);
						array6[k] = e.Values.GetValue(k, 1);
					}
					int indexOfNextNonNullValue = GetIndexOfNextNonNullValue(0, array5);
					if (indexOfNextNonNullValue != -1 && array.GetValue(indexOfNextNonNullValue, 0) is DateTime)
					{
						array5 = InterpolateDateTimesSimple(array5);
						array6 = InterpolateDoublesSimple(array6);
						for (int l = 0; l < length2; l++)
						{
							array.SetValue(array5[l], l, 0);
							array.SetValue(array6[l], l, 1);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						array = InterpolateMatrixOfDoublesSimple(array);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array = InterpolateMatrixOfDoublesSimple(array);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected virtual PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series)
		{
			return GetPE(prim, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns: false);
		}

		public virtual PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns)
		{
			return GetPE(prim, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns, allowFromColorModel: true);
		}

		internal PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns, bool allowFromColorModel)
		{
			if (point != null)
			{
				if (point.PE != null && point.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
				{
					return point.PE;
				}
				if (series != null && series.PEs != null && series.PEs.Count > 0)
				{
					PaintElement paintElement = null;
					IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
					if (points != null)
					{
						int num = points.IndexOf(point);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							paintElement = series.PEs[num % series.PEs.Count];
							if (paintElement != null && paintElement.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
							{
								return paintElement;
							}
						}
					}
					if (prim != null && prim.Column >= 0)
					{
						paintElement = series.PEs[prim.Column % series.PEs.Count];
						if (paintElement != null && paintElement.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
						{
							return paintElement;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (series != null && series.PEs != null && series.PEs.Count > 0)
			{
				return series.PEs[0];
			}
			if (!allowFromColorModel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (prim != null)
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (prim.Value != null)
				{
					double.TryParse(prim.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
				}
				Color fillColor;
				Color outlineColor;
				if (swapRowsAndColumns)
				{
					fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(Math.Max(prim.Column, 0), Math.Max(prim.Row, 0), result);
					outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(Math.Max(prim.Column, 0), Math.Max(prim.Row, 0), result);
				}
				else
				{
					fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(Math.Max(prim.Row, 0), Math.Max(prim.Column, 0), result);
					outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(Math.Max(prim.Row, 0), Math.Max(prim.Column, 0), result);
				}
				PaintElement paintElement2 = new PaintElement();
				paintElement2.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
				paintElement2.Fill = fillColor;
				paintElement2.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
				paintElement2.Stroke = outlineColor;
				paintElement2.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
				if (prim.Layer != null && prim.Layer is AreaLayer)
				{
					paintElement2.StrokeWidth = ((AreaChartAppearance)((AreaLayer)prim.Layer).GetAppearance()).LineThickness;
				}
				return paintElement2;
			}
			return new PaintElement();
		}

		protected virtual IAdvanceAxis InitAdvanceAxis(AxisNumber axisNum, double worldMax, double worldMin, int screenMax, int screenMin)
		{
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = null;
			switch (axisNum)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Z"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["X2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Y2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			}
			try
			{
				switch (advanceAxis.RangeType)
				{
				case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
					advanceAxis.Maximum = worldMax;
					advanceAxis.Minimum = worldMin;
					break;
				case AxisRangeType.Custom:
					advanceAxis.Maximum = advanceAxis.RangeMax;
					advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.RangeMin;
					break;
				}
				advanceAxis.MapMaximum = screenMax;
				advanceAxis.MapMinimum = screenMin;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
			}
			return advanceAxis;
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateZeroLine(IAdvanceAxis axis)
		{
			if (!(axis.Minimum is double) || !(axis.Maximum is double))
			{
				return CalculateZeroLine();
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			double num = (double)axis.Minimum;
			double num2 = (double)axis.Maximum;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				result = num2;
			}
			else if (num > 0.0)
			{
				result = num;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateZeroLine()
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			if (dataMax < 0.0)
			{
				result = dataMax;
			}
			else if (dataMin > 0.0)
			{
				result = dataMin;
			}
			return result;
		}

			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (data == null || data.GetColumnCount() < 1 || data.GetRowCount() < 1)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDataValidForChart()
		{
			if (data is ChartDemoData)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ValidateDataForChart();
			return dataIsValid;
		}

			return SR.GetString("SR_1011");
		}
