	public class ChartLayer3D : ChartLayer
	{
		public ChartLayer3D(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		protected override IAdvanceAxis InitAdvanceAxis(AxisNumber axisNum, double worldMax, double worldMin, int screenMax, int screenMin)
		{
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = null;
			switch (axisNum)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Z"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["X2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				advanceAxis = base.Grid["Y2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				break;
			}
			try
			{
				switch (advanceAxis.RangeType)
				{
				case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
					advanceAxis.Maximum = worldMax;
					advanceAxis.Minimum = worldMin;
					break;
				case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				{
					double num;
					double num2;
					if (!base.Stacked && (this is Bar3DLayer || this is Column3DLayer || this is Line3DLayer || this is Heatmap3DLayer))
					{
						num = (double)advanceAxis.RangeMax;
						num2 = (double)advanceAxis.RangeMin;
					}
					else
					{
						num = Math.Max((double)advanceAxis.RangeMax, worldMax);
						num2 = Math.Min((double)advanceAxis.RangeMin, worldMin);
					}
					advanceAxis.Maximum = num;
					advanceAxis.Minimum = num2;
					break;
				}
				}
				advanceAxis.MapMaximum = screenMax;
				advanceAxis.MapMinimum = screenMin;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
			}
			return advanceAxis;
		}

		internal void PreparePathPrimitives(ArrayList invisible, ArrayList visible, ColorAppearance colApp, SceneGraph scene, View3DAppearance viewApp, ChartType chartType)
		{
			foreach (Path3D item in invisible)
			{
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path();
				path.OutlineOnly = true;
				path.Caps = PCaps.HitTest;
				if (colApp.ModelStyle != ColorModels.Wireframe)
				{
					path.PE.StrokeOpacity = item.FillColor.A;
					path.Brush = item.Brush;
				}
				else
				{
					path.PE.Stroke = item.OutlineColor;
					path.PE.StrokeWidth = (int)item.LineWidth;
				}
				path.GraphicsPath = item.Path;
				scene.Add(path);
			}
			foreach (Path3D item2 in visible)
			{
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path2 = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path();
				path2.Chart = ChartType.PieChart3D;
				if (item2.Info != null)
				{
					path2.Row = item2.Info.Row;
					path2.Column = item2.Info.Column;
					path2.Series = item2.Info.Series;
					path2.DataPoint = item2.Info.DataPoint;
					if (path2.DataPoint != null && path2.DataPoint.Empty)
					{
						path2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest;
					}
					else
					{
						path2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
					switch (chartType)
					{
					case ChartType.AreaChart3D:
						path2.Value = ((AreaLineInfo)item2.Info).valueEnd;
						break;
					case ChartType.LineChart3D:
						path2.Value = ((AreaLineInfo)item2.Info).valueEnd;
						break;
					case ChartType.HeatMapChart3D:
						path2.Value = ((HeatMapInfo)item2.Info).valueEnd;
						break;
					case ChartType.PointChart3D:
					case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
						path2.Value = ((BubbleInfo)item2.Info).Y;
						break;
					default:
						path2.Value = (item2.Info.StackedValue.HasValue ? item2.Info.StackedValue.Value : item2.Info.Value);
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					path2.Row = -1;
					path2.Column = -1;
					path2.Value = null;
				}
				path2.Layer = this;
				path2.PE.Fill = item2.FillColor;
				path2.PE.FillOpacity = item2.FillColor.A;
				path2.PE.Stroke = item2.OutlineColor;
				path2.PE.StrokeWidth = (int)item2.LineWidth;
				path2.Outline = viewApp.Outline;
				if (item2.outlineOnly)
				{
					path2.Outline = true;
				}
				if (colApp.ModelStyle == ColorModels.Wireframe)
				{
					path2.Outline = true;
				}
				if (viewApp.Light)
				{
					path2.Brush = item2.Brush;
				}
				if (chartType == ChartType.HeatMapChart3D)
				{
					path2.Outline = true;
				}
				path2.Chart = chartType;
				path2.GraphicsPath = item2.Path;
				scene.Add(path2);
			}
		}

		internal void GetColors(out Color clrFill, out Color clrOutline, IColorModel chartColorModel, int row, int column, double val, ColorAppearance colApp, object objectValue, IChartData data, bool stacked, bool pie)
		{
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection && objectValue is NumericDataPoint)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = objectValue as NumericDataPoint;
				NumericSeries numericSeries = null;
				numericSeries = ((!stacked && !(this is Hierarchical3DLayer)) ? (seriesCollection[row] as NumericSeries) : (seriesCollection[column] as NumericSeries));
				if (numericDataPoint.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
				{
					clrFill = Color.FromArgb(numericDataPoint.PE.FillOpacity, numericDataPoint.PE.Fill);
					clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(numericDataPoint.PE.StrokeOpacity, numericDataPoint.PE.Stroke);
					return;
				}
				if (numericSeries != null && numericSeries.PEs.Count > 0)
				{
					int num = numericSeries.Points.IndexOf(numericDataPoint);
					int num2 = (((stacked || this is Doughnut3DLayer || this is Pie3DLayer || this is Hierarchical3DLayer) && num >= 0) ? (num % numericSeries.PEs.Count) : 0);
					if (numericSeries.PEs.Count > num2 && numericSeries.PEs[num2].ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
					{
						PaintElement paintElement = numericSeries.PEs[num2];
						clrFill = Color.FromArgb(paintElement.FillOpacity, paintElement.Fill);
						clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(paintElement.StrokeOpacity, paintElement.Stroke);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			clrFill = chartColorModel.getFillColor(row, column, val);
			clrOutline = chartColorModel.getOutlineColor(row, column, val);
			if (colApp.ModelStyle == ColorModels.CustomSkin && colApp.Skin.PEs.Count > 0)
			{
				int num3 = row;
				if (!colApp.Skin.ApplyRowWise)
				{
					num3 = column;
				}
				num3 %= colApp.Skin.PEs.Count;
				clrFill = Color.FromArgb(colApp.Skin.PEs[num3].FillOpacity, colApp.Skin.PEs[num3].Fill);
				clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(colApp.Skin.PEs[num3].StrokeOpacity, colApp.Skin.PEs[num3].Stroke);
			}
			foreach (Override @override in ChartComponent.Override.Overrides)
			{
				if ((@override.Row == row && @override.Column == column) || (@override.Row == row && @override.Column == -2) || (@override.Row == -2 && @override.Column == column) || (@override.Row == -2 && @override.Column == -2))
				{
					clrFill = Color.FromArgb(@override.PE.FillOpacity, @override.PE.Fill);
					clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(@override.PE.StrokeOpacity, @override.PE.Stroke);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool GetData(int row, int column, ref object objectValue, ref double dValue)
		{
			objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(row, column);
			if (objectValue != null && objectValue is DataPointBase && !(objectValue is NumericDataPoint))
			{
				return true;
			}
			dValue = 0.0;
			if (objectValue == null)
			{
				switch (base.NullHandling)
				{
				case NullHandling.DontPlot:
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dValue = data.GetValue(row, column);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FindStackMinMax(ref double minimum, ref double maximum)
		{
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			minimum = double.MaxValue;
			maximum = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(i, j);
					if (objectValue == null)
					{
						NullHandling nullHandling = base.NullHandling;
						if (nullHandling == NullHandling.DontPlot)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					num += data.GetValue(i, j);
				}
				minimum = Math.Min(num, minimum);
				maximum = Math.Max(num, maximum);
			}
			if (minimum < 0.0)
			{
				maximum = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				minimum = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private double CalculateInterval(AxisAppearance axisApp, ref double dataMin, ref double dataMax)
		{
			double interval = 0.0;
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				StackAppearance stackAppearance = (StackAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Stack);
				if (stackAppearance.StackStyle == StackStyle.Complete && axisApp.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart)
				{
					return 20.0;
				}
			}
			switch (axisApp.TickmarkStyle)
			{
			case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
				AxisSmartScale(ref dataMin, ref dataMax, out interval, axisApp.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
				interval = ((!(axisApp.TickmarkInterval > 0.0)) ? ((dataMax - dataMin) * axisApp.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0) : axisApp.TickmarkInterval);
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
				interval = (dataMax - dataMin) * axisApp.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0;
				break;
			}
			return interval;
		}

		public void CalculateDataParams(AxisAppearance axisApp, out double dataMin, out double dataMax, out double interval)
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				dataMin = (dataMax = 0.0);
				FindStackMinMax(ref dataMin, ref dataMax);
			}
			else
			{
				dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			}
			if (axisApp.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom && axisApp.RangeMin < axisApp.RangeMax)
			{
				dataMin = axisApp.RangeMin;
				dataMax = axisApp.RangeMax;
			}
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				StackAppearance stackAppearance = (StackAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Stack);
				if (stackAppearance.StackStyle == StackStyle.Complete)
				{
					dataMin = 0.0;
					dataMax = 100.0;
				}
			}
			if (dataMin == dataMax)
			{
				dataMax = dataMin + 1.0;
			}
			if (axisApp.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				if (dataMin == 0.0)
				{
					dataMin = axisApp.LogZero;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(dataMin) || double.IsInfinity(dataMin) || dataMin <= 0.0)
				{
					dataMin = double.Epsilon;
				}
				else
				{
					dataMin = Math.Floor(Math.Log(dataMin, axisApp.LogBase));
				}
				dataMax = Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(dataMax, axisApp.LogBase));
				if (double.IsNaN(dataMin) || double.IsNaN(dataMax) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(dataMin) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(dataMax))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
				}
			}
			interval = CalculateInterval(axisApp, ref dataMin, ref dataMax);
		}

		internal void AxisSmartScale(ref double min, ref double max, out double interval, bool isLogarithmic)
		{
			interval = (max - min) / 5.0;
			int num = 0;
			if (interval < 1.0)
			{
				for (num = 0; num <= 308; num++)
				{
					if (interval > 1.0)
					{
						interval = Math.Floor(interval);
						break;
					}
					interval *= 10.0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (num = 0; num >= -308; num--)
				{
					if (interval < 10.0)
					{
						interval = Math.Floor(interval);
						break;
					}
					interval /= 10.0;
				}
			}
			min = Math.Floor(min * Math.Pow(10.0, num));
			max *= Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling((max - min) / interval);
			if (num2 > 7.0)
			{
				interval *= 2.0;
			}
			num2 = Math.Ceiling((max - min) / interval);
			max = min + interval * num2;
			double num3 = (max - min) / 10.0;
			if (num3 == 4.0 || num3 == 5.0 || num3 == 6.0 || num3 == 7.0)
			{
				interval = 10.0;
			}
			min /= Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			max /= Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			if (isLogarithmic)
			{
				interval = 1.0;
			}
			else
			{
				interval /= Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetSceneElements(Scene3D scene3D, ChartLayer3D chartLayer, LabelPos labelPos)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisApp = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisApp2 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisApp3 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			AxisAppearance axisApp4 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			AxisAppearance axisApp5 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			AxisAppearance axisApp6 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ2);
			chartLayer.CalculateDataParams(axisApp2, out var _, out var _, out var _);
			SetLabelAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp, Axis3DNew.X, "Grid.X", AxisLabelType.colLabel, front: true, labelPos);
			SetNumericAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp2, Axis3DNew.Y, "Grid.Y", front: true);
			if (!chartLayer.Stacked)
			{
				SetLabelAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp3, Axis3DNew.Z, "Grid.Z", AxisLabelType.rowLabel, front: true, labelPos);
			}
			SetLabelAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp4, Axis3DNew.X2, "Grid.X2", AxisLabelType.colLabel, front: false, labelPos);
			SetNumericAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp5, Axis3DNew.Y2, "Grid.Y2", front: false);
			if (!chartLayer.Stacked)
			{
				SetLabelAxisElements(scene3D, chartLayer, axisApp6, Axis3DNew.Z2, "Grid.Z2", AxisLabelType.rowLabel, front: false, labelPos);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetLabelAxisElements(Scene3D scene3D, ChartLayer3D chartLayer, AxisAppearance axisApp, Axis3DNew axisId, string labelPath, AxisLabelType labelType, bool front, LabelPos labelPos)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = ((!chartLayer.Stacked) ? ((labelType == AxisLabelType.rowLabel) ? chartLayer.GetData().GetRowCount() : chartLayer.GetData().GetColumnCount()) : ((labelType == AxisLabelType.rowLabel) ? chartLayer.GetData().GetColumnCount() : chartLayer.GetData().GetRowCount()));
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (axisApp.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				num2 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(0.0, axisApp.RangeMin)));
				num3 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Floor(Math.Min(num, axisApp.RangeMax + 1.0)));
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 0;
				num3 = num;
			}
			if (axisApp.MajorGridLines.Visible)
			{
				for (int i = num2; i < num3; i++)
				{
					Color color = Color.FromArgb(axisApp.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisApp.MajorGridLines.Color);
					scene3D.AddGridline(axisId, i, color, Column3DLayer.GetDashStyle(axisApp.MajorGridLines.DrawStyle), axisApp.MajorGridLines.Thickness);
				}
			}
			if (!axisApp.Labels.Visible || !axisApp.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = num2; j < num3; j++)
			{
				object obj = ((!chartLayer.Stacked) ? ((labelType == AxisLabelType.rowLabel) ? chartLayer.GetData().GetRowLabel(j) : chartLayer.GetData().GetColumnLabel(j)) : ((labelType == AxisLabelType.rowLabel) ? chartLayer.GetData().GetColumnLabel(j) : chartLayer.GetData().GetRowLabel(j)));
				string itemFormatString = axisApp.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				Hashtable environment = chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment;
				object value = (chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = obj);
				environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = value;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = (double)j;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
				string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment, itemFormatString);
				if (itemFormatString == "")
				{
					text = obj as string;
				}
				LabelStyle style = axisApp.Labels.LabelStyle.Copy();
				Text text2 = new Text(new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0), text, style);
				text2.Path = labelPath;
				scene3D.AddLabel(axisId, (labelPos == LabelPos.posBeg) ? ((double)j) : ((double)j + 0.5), text2);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetNumericAxisElements(Scene3D scene3D, ChartLayer3D chartLayer, AxisAppearance axisApp, Axis3DNew axisId, string labelPath, bool front)
		{
			chartLayer.CalculateDataParams(axisApp, out var dataMin, out var dataMax, out var interval);
			double num = interval;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (axisApp.MajorGridLines.Visible)
			{
				for (double num3 = dataMin; num3 <= dataMax; num3 += num)
				{
					Color color;
					if (num3 > dataMin && axisApp.MinorGridLines.Visible)
					{
						double num4;
						double num5;
						if (axisApp.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							num4 = Math.Pow(axisApp.LogBase, num2);
							num5 = Math.Pow(axisApp.LogBase, num3);
						}
						else
						{
							num4 = num2;
							num5 = num3;
						}
						double num6 = (num5 - num4) / 5.0;
						for (double num7 = num4 + num6; num7 < num5; num7 += num6)
						{
							color = Color.FromArgb(axisApp.MinorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisApp.MinorGridLines.Color);
							double value = ((axisApp.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic) ? num7 : Math.Log(num7, axisApp.LogBase));
							scene3D.AddGridline(axisId, value, color, Column3DLayer.GetDashStyle(axisApp.MinorGridLines.DrawStyle), axisApp.MinorGridLines.Thickness);
						}
					}
					color = Color.FromArgb(axisApp.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisApp.MajorGridLines.Color);
					scene3D.AddGridline(axisId, num3, color, Column3DLayer.GetDashStyle(axisApp.MajorGridLines.DrawStyle), axisApp.MajorGridLines.Thickness);
					num2 = num3;
				}
			}
			if (axisApp.StripLines.Visible)
			{
				for (double num8 = dataMin; num8 <= dataMax - num; num8 += num * (double)axisApp.StripLines.Interval)
				{
					Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(axisApp.StripLines.PE.FillOpacity, axisApp.StripLines.PE.Fill);
					if (axisApp.StripLines.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent)
					{
						scene3D.AddStripline(axisId, num8, num, color2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!axisApp.Labels.Visible || !axisApp.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (double num9 = dataMin; num9 <= dataMax + num / 2.0; num9 += num)
			{
				if (num9 > dataMax)
				{
					num9 = dataMax;
				}
				double num10 = num9;
				if (axisApp.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					num10 = Math.Pow(axisApp.LogBase, num9);
				}
				string value2 = num10.ToString();
				string itemFormatString = axisApp.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = value2;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = num10;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
				string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment, itemFormatString);
				LabelStyle style = axisApp.Labels.LabelStyle.Copy();
				Text text2 = new Text(new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0), text, style);
				text2.Path = labelPath;
				scene3D.AddLabel(axisId, num9, text2);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldDecreaseScale()
		{
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			if (view3DAppearance.Scale == 65f)
			{
				AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
				AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
				AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ2);
				if (axisAppearance.Visible || axisAppearance2.Visible || axisAppearance3.Visible)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class Area3DLayer : ChartLayer3D
	{
		public Area3DLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Area);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1000");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			_ = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			ColorAppearance colApp = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int num = data.GetColumnCount();
			object obj = null;
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) as ChartGridAppearance;
			Color backColor = chartGridAppearance.BackColor;
			float num2 = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * 0.8f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num2 /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)outerBounds.X + (float)outerBounds.Width * (1f - num2) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Y - (float)outerBounds.Height * 0.1f + (float)outerBounds.Height * (1f - num2) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Width * num2, (float)outerBounds.Height * num2);
			float width = rectangleF.Width;
			bool flag = num == 1;
			if (flag)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			if (rowCount > num)
			{
				rectangleF.X += (rectangleF.Width - rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)num) / 2f;
				rectangleF.Width = rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)num;
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)num;
			}
			else
			{
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)num;
			}
			CalculateDataParams((AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY), out var dataMin, out var dataMax, out var _);
			Scene3D scene3D = new Scene3D(rectangleF, width, 5f, 0.0, num, dataMin, dataMax, 0.0, rowCount, backColor);
			ChartLayer3D.SetSceneElements(scene3D, this, LabelPos.posMid);
			double num3 = dataMin;
			if (num3 < 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 0.0;
			}
			AreaLineChart3D areaLineChart3D = new AreaLineChart3D(scene3D, (float)((double)((view3DAppearance.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, 0.4, view3DAppearance.EdgeSize, dataMin, dataMax, flashMode: false, view3DAppearance.Outline, num3, AreaLineType.Area);
			if (this is SplineArea3DLayer)
			{
				areaLineChart3D.Splined = true;
				areaLineChart3D.Flatness = ((SplineAreaChart3DAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.SplineArea3D)).Flatness;
			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				obj = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					ISeries series = null;
					if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > j)
					{
						series = seriesCollection[j];
					}
					double dValue = 0.0;
					double dValue2 = 0.0;
					if (!GetData(j, i, ref obj, ref dValue))
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							dValue2 = dValue;
						}
						else if (GetData(j, i + 1, ref obj, ref dValue2))
						{
							continue;
						}
						IDataPoint dataPoint = obj as IDataPoint;
						GetColors(out var clrFill, out var clrOutline, ChartColorModel, j, i, dValue, colApp, obj, data, stacked: false, pie: false);
						if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							dValue = Math.Log(dValue, axisAppearance.LogBase);
							dValue2 = Math.Log(dValue2, axisAppearance.LogBase);
						}
						dValue = Math.Min(dValue, dataMax);
						dValue2 = Math.Min(dValue2, dataMax);
						dValue = Math.Max(dValue, dataMin);
						dValue2 = Math.Max(dValue2, dataMin);
						areaLineChart3D.Add(j, i + 1, (double)i + 0.5, (double)i + 1.5, (double)j + 0.5, dValue, dValue2, clrFill, clrOutline, i == 0, i == num - 2, dataPoint, series);
					}
				}
			}
			areaLineChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(view3DAppearance.Light, cylinder: false);
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			scene3D.AddLabels(rectangleF, scene, OuterBound);
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, ChartCore.ChartType);
		}
	}

		public abstract void IntervalCountWindow(int n);

		public abstract void IntervalCountTotal(int n);

		public abstract void IntervalFit(double totalWidth, double itemWidth);

		protected virtual void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
		}

		public abstract double Map(object d_i);

		public abstract object MapInverse(double m_i);

		public abstract bool ItemVisible(object d_i);

		public virtual object Add(object addendum, object addendee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(addendum) + NumericOf(addendee));
		}

		public virtual object Subtract(object subtractum, object subtractee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(subtractum) - NumericOf(subtractee));
		}

		public virtual object Divide(object dividend, object divisor)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(dividend) / NumericOf(divisor));
		}

		public virtual object Multiply(object multiplicand, object multiplier)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(multiplicand) * NumericOf(multiplier));
		}

		public object Max(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) > NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public object Min(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) < NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public virtual object NullValue(object input)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual double NumericOf(object d_i)
		{
			return MapMinimum;
		}

		public virtual object InverseNumericOf(double d_i)
		{
			return WindowMinimum;
		}

		public virtual int Compare(object obj1, object obj2)
		{
			if (NumericOf(obj1) < NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (NumericOf(obj1) > NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected Axis3D(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			this.axisNumber = axisNumber;
		}

		public int GetExtent()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				widthOrHeight = axisAppearance.Extent;
			}
			return widthOrHeight;
		}

		public void SetExtent(int worh)
		{
			widthOrHeight = worh;
		}

		protected virtual void RetrieveAppearanceProperties()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				widthOrHeight = axisAppearance.Extent;
				if (axisAppearance.Visible)
				{
					addStyle(1048576);
				}
				else
				{
					removeStyle(1048576);
				}
				lineThickness = axisAppearance.LineThickness;
				lineColor = axisAppearance.LineColor;
				lineStyle.EndStyle = axisAppearance.LineEndCapStyle;
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.LineDrawStyle;
				setStyle(256, axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Visible);
				majorGridLineColor = Color.FromArgb(axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Color);
				majorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.DrawStyle;
				majorGridLineThickness = axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Thickness;
				setStyle(512, axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Visible);
				minorGridLineColor = Color.FromArgb(axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Color);
				minorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.DrawStyle;
				minorGridLineThickness = axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Thickness;
				labelStyle.Font = axisAppearance.Labels.Font;
				labelStyle.FontColor = axisAppearance.Labels.FontColor;
				itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				seriesLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString;
				seriesLabelStyle.Font = axisAppearance.Labels.Font;
				seriesLabelStyle.FontColor = axisAppearance.Labels.FontColor;
				setStyle(262144, axisAppearance.Labels.Visible);
				setStyle(524288, axisAppearance.Labels.Visible);
				tickInterval = axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval;
				tickPercentage = axisAppearance.TickmarkPercentage;
				switch (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle)
				{
				case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
					addStyle(8);
					removeStyle(16);
					removeStyle(4);
					break;
				case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
					addStyle(4);
					removeStyle(8);
					removeStyle(16);
					break;
				}
				if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					mRangeType = AxisRangeType.Custom;
					mRangeMax = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
					mRangeMin = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
					dataMax = (double)mRangeMax;
					dataMin = (double)mRangeMin;
				}
				else
				{
					CorrectWindowMinMax();
					dataMax = (double)WindowMaximum;
					dataMin = (double)WindowMinimum;
				}
				if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					m_LogBase = axisAppearance.LogBase;
				}
				RulerType = axisAppearance.NumericAxisType;
				MajorLabelStyle = axisAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle.Clone();
			}
		}

		public void addStyle(int st)
		{
			drawingStyle |= st;
		}

		public void removeStyle(int st)
		{
			drawingStyle &= ~st;
		}

		public void setStyle(int st)
		{
			drawingStyle = st;
		}

		public void setStyle(int st, bool set)
		{
			if (set)
			{
				addStyle(st);
			}
			else
			{
				removeStyle(st);
			}
		}

		public void setLabels(string[] list)
		{
			labelArray = list;
		}

		public object[] getLabels()
		{
			return labelArray;
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			int num = (int)axisNumber;
			return component.GetChartAppearance(mapping[num]);
		}
	}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{

			data.GetColumnCount();

			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			double interval = 0.0;
			double interval2 = 0.0;
			double interval3 = 0.0;
			MinMaxValues(out var minX, out var minY, out var minZ, out var maxX, out var maxY, out var maxZ);
			if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance, ref minX, ref maxX);
			}
			if (axisAppearance2.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance2, ref minY, ref maxY);
			}
			if (axisAppearance3.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance3, ref minZ, ref maxZ);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance2))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minY, ref maxY, out interval2, axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minX, ref maxX, out interval, axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance3))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minZ, ref maxZ, out interval3, axisAppearance3.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			object obj = null;
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) as ChartGridAppearance;
			Color backColor = chartGridAppearance.BackColor;
			float num = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * 0.8f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)outerBounds.X + (float)outerBounds.Width * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Y - (float)outerBounds.Height * 0.1f + (float)outerBounds.Height * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Width * num, (float)outerBounds.Height * num);
			float width = rectangleF.Width;
			Scene3D scene3D = new Scene3D(rectangleF, width, 5f, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ, backColor);
			double dataPointSizeZ = ((interval3 != 0.0) ? interval3 : ((maxZ - minZ) / 20.0));
			SetSceneElements(scene3D, minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ, interval, interval2, interval3, this);
			AreaLineType areaLineType = AreaLineType.PointCube;
			areaLineType = ((pointChart3DAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon3D.Cube) ? AreaLineType.PointCube : ((pointChart3DAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon3D.Diamond) ? AreaLineType.PointDiamond : ((pointChart3DAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon3D.Pyramid) ? AreaLineType.PointPyramid : ((pointChart3DAppearance.Icon != SymbolIcon3D.PyramidDown) ? AreaLineType.PointSphere : AreaLineType.PointPyramidDown))));
			float edgeSize = ((pointChart3DAppearance.IconSize == SymbolIconSize.Large) ? 2f : ((pointChart3DAppearance.IconSize != SymbolIconSize.Medium) ? 0f : 1f));
			double x = 0.0;
			double y = 0.0;
			double z = 0.0;
			AreaLineChart3D areaLineChart3D = new AreaLineChart3D(scene3D, (float)((double)((view3DAppearance.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, dataPointSizeZ, edgeSize, minY, maxY, flashMode: false, view3DAppearance.Outline, minY, areaLineType);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			obj = null;
			int num2 = seriesCollection?.Count ?? 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				ISeries series = null;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					series = seriesCollection[i];
				}
				int num3 = series?.GetPoints().Count ?? rowCount;
				for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
				{
					XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = null;
					IDataPoint dataPoint;
					if (series != null)
					{
						obj = (xYZDataPoint = series.GetPoints()[j] as XYZDataPoint);
						if (xYZDataPoint == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						x = xYZDataPoint.ValueX;
						y = xYZDataPoint.ValueY;
						z = xYZDataPoint.ValueZ;
						dataPoint = xYZDataPoint;
					}
					else
					{
						if (GetData(j, i, ref obj, ref x, ref y, ref z))
						{
							continue;
						}
						xYZDataPoint = new XYZDataPoint(x, y, z, "", empty: false);
						dataPoint = xYZDataPoint;
					}
					Color clrFill;
					Color clrOutline;
					if (num2 == 1)
					{
						GetColors(out clrFill, out clrOutline, ChartColorModel, j, 0, y, colApp, obj, data);
					}
					else
					{
						GetColors(out clrFill, out clrOutline, ChartColorModel, i, j, y, colApp, obj, data);
					}
					if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
					{
						x = Math.Log(x, axisAppearance.LogBase);
					}
					if (axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
					{
						y = Math.Log(y, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
					}
					if (axisAppearance3.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
					{
						z = Math.Log(z, axisAppearance3.LogBase);
					}
					if (y >= minY && y <= maxY && x >= minX && x <= maxX && z >= minZ && z <= maxZ)
					{
						areaLineChart3D.Add(j, i, x, y, z, 0.0, clrFill, clrOutline, dataPoint, series);
					}
				}
			}
			areaLineChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(view3DAppearance.Light, cylinder: false);
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			scene3D.AddLabels(rectangleF, scene, OuterBound);
			ChartType chartType = ChartType.PointChart3D;
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, chartType);
		}

		protected static void SetCustomRangeMinMax(AxisAppearance app, ref double min, ref double max)
		{
			if (!(app.RangeMin < app.RangeMax))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (app.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				min = Math.Log(app.RangeMin, app.LogBase);
				max = Math.Log(app.RangeMax, app.LogBase);
				if (double.IsNaN(min) || double.IsNaN(max) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(min) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(max))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				min = app.RangeMin;
				max = app.RangeMax;
			}
		}

		protected void CalculateParams(AxisAppearance axisApp, ref double dataMin, ref double dataMax)
		{
			if (axisApp.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				if (dataMin == 0.0)
				{
					dataMin = axisApp.LogZero;
				}
				dataMin = Math.Floor(Math.Log(dataMin, axisApp.LogBase));
				dataMax = Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(dataMax, axisApp.LogBase));
				if (double.IsNaN(dataMin) || double.IsNaN(dataMax) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(dataMin) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(dataMax))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetSceneElements(Scene3D scene3D, double minX, double minY, double minZ, double maxX, double maxY, double maxZ, double intervalX, double intervalY, double intervalZ, ChartLayer3D chartLayer)
		{
			AxisAppearance app = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance app2 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance app3 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			AxisAppearance app4 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			AxisAppearance app5 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			AxisAppearance app6 = (AxisAppearance)chartLayer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ2);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minX, maxX, intervalX, app, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.X);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minY, maxY, intervalY, app2, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.Y);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minZ, maxZ, intervalZ, app3, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.Z);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minX, maxX, intervalX, app4, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.X2);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minY, maxY, intervalY, app5, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.Y2);
			SetAxisElements(scene3D, minZ, maxZ, intervalZ, app6, chartLayer, Axis3DNew.Z2);
		}

		internal void SetAxisElements(Scene3D scene3D, double min, double max, double interval, AxisAppearance app, ChartLayer3D chartLayer, Axis3DNew axisType)
		{
			if (min == max)
			{
				max = min + 1.0;
			}
			chartLayer.GetData().GetColumnCount();
			chartLayer.GetData().GetRowCount();
			double num = 0.0;
			switch (app.TickmarkStyle)
			{
			case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
				num = ((app.TickmarkInterval == 0.0) ? interval : app.TickmarkInterval);
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
				num = interval;
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
				num = (max - min) * app.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0;
				break;
			}
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (app.MajorGridLines.Visible)
			{
				for (double num3 = min; num3 <= max; num3 += num)
				{
					Color color;
					if (num3 > min && app.MinorGridLines.Visible)
					{
						double num4;
						double num5;
						if (app.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							num4 = Math.Pow(app.LogBase, num2);
							num5 = Math.Pow(app.LogBase, num3);
						}
						else
						{
							num4 = num2;
							num5 = num3;
						}
						double num6 = (num5 - num4) / 5.0;
						for (double num7 = num4 + num6; num7 < num5; num7 += num6)
						{
							color = Color.FromArgb(app.MinorGridLines.AlphaLevel, app.MinorGridLines.Color);
							double value = ((app.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Logarithmic) ? num7 : Math.Log(num7, app.LogBase));
							scene3D.AddGridline(axisType, value, color, Column3DLayer.GetDashStyle(app.MinorGridLines.DrawStyle), app.MinorGridLines.Thickness);
						}
					}
					color = Color.FromArgb(app.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, app.MajorGridLines.Color);
					scene3D.AddGridline(axisType, num3, color, Column3DLayer.GetDashStyle(app.MajorGridLines.DrawStyle), app.MajorGridLines.Thickness);
					num2 = num3;
				}
			}
			if (app.StripLines.Visible)
			{
				for (double num8 = min; num8 <= max - num; num8 += num * (double)app.StripLines.Interval)
				{
					Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(app.StripLines.PE.FillOpacity, app.StripLines.PE.Fill);
					if (app.StripLines.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent)
					{
						scene3D.AddStripline(axisType, num8, num, color2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!app.Labels.Visible || !app.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (double num9 = min; num9 <= max + num / 2.0; num9 += num)
			{
				if (num9 > max)
				{
					num9 = max;
				}
				double num10 = num9;
				if (app.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					num10 = Math.Pow(app.LogBase, num9);
				}
				string value2 = num10.ToString();
				string itemFormatString = app.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = value2;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = num10;
				chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
				string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartLayer.ChartCore.Environment, itemFormatString);
				LabelStyle style = app.Labels.LabelStyle.Copy();
				Text text2 = new Text(new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0), text, style);
				text2.Path = "Grid.";
				switch (app.axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					text2.Path += "X";
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					text2.Path += "Y";
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
					text2.Path += "Z";
					break;
				}
				Color.FromArgb(app.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, app.MajorGridLines.Color);
				scene3D.AddLabel(axisType, num9, text2);
			}
		}

		internal bool GetData(int row, int column, ref object objectValue, ref double x, ref double y, ref double z)
		{
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection && seriesCollection.Count > row && seriesCollection[row] is XYZSeries && seriesCollection[row].GetPoints().Count > column)
			{
				XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = ((XYZSeries)seriesCollection[row]).Points[column];
				x = xYZDataPoint.ValueX;
				y = xYZDataPoint.ValueY;
				z = xYZDataPoint.ValueZ;
				return false;
			}
			if (data.GetRowCount() > row && data.GetColumnCount() > 2)
			{
				x = data.GetValue(row, 0);
				y = data.GetValue(row, 1);
				z = data.GetValue(row, 2);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void MinMaxValues(out double minX, out double minY, out double minZ, out double maxX, out double maxY, out double maxZ)
		{
			minX = double.MaxValue;
			minY = double.MaxValue;
			minZ = double.MaxValue;
			maxX = double.MinValue;
			maxY = double.MinValue;
			maxZ = double.MinValue;
			if (data is SeriesCollection)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
				foreach (SeriesBase item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (!(item is XYZSeries))
					{
						continue;
					}
					XYZSeries xYZSeries = item as XYZSeries;
					foreach (XYZDataPoint point in xYZSeries.Points)
					{
						minX = Math.Min(minX, point.ValueX);
						minY = Math.Min(minY, point.ValueY);
						minZ = Math.Min(minZ, point.ValueZ);
						maxX = Math.Max(maxX, point.ValueX);
						maxY = Math.Max(maxY, point.ValueY);
						maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, point.ValueZ);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
				for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
				{
					minX = Math.Min(minX, data.GetValue(i, 0));
					minY = Math.Min(minY, data.GetValue(i, 1));
					minZ = Math.Min(minZ, data.GetValue(i, 2));
					maxX = Math.Max(maxX, data.GetValue(i, 0));
					maxY = Math.Max(maxY, data.GetValue(i, 1));
					maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, data.GetValue(i, 2));
				}
			}
			double num = (maxX - minX) * 0.2;
			double num2 = (maxY - minY) * 0.2;
			double num3 = (maxZ - minZ) * 0.2;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				num += 1.0;
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num2 += 1.0;
			}
			if (num3 == 0.0)
			{
				num3 += 1.0;
			}
			minX -= num;
			maxX += num;
			minY -= num2;
			maxY += num2;
			minZ -= num3;
			maxZ += num3;
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX), ref minX, ref maxX);
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY), ref minY, ref maxY);
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ), ref minZ, ref maxZ);
		}

		internal void GetColors(out Color clrFill, out Color clrOutline, IColorModel chartColorModel, int row, int column, double val, ColorAppearance colApp, object objectValue, IChartData data)
		{
			if (objectValue is XYZDataPoint)
			{
				XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = objectValue as XYZDataPoint;
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
				XYZSeries xYZSeries = seriesCollection[row] as XYZSeries;
				if (xYZDataPoint.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
				{
					clrFill = Color.FromArgb(xYZDataPoint.PE.FillOpacity, xYZDataPoint.PE.Fill);
					clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(xYZDataPoint.PE.StrokeOpacity, xYZDataPoint.PE.Stroke);
					return;
				}
				if (xYZSeries != null && xYZSeries.PEs.Count > 0)
				{
					int index = column % xYZSeries.PEs.Count;
					if (xYZSeries.PEs[index].ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
					{
						clrFill = Color.FromArgb(xYZSeries.PEs[index].FillOpacity, xYZSeries.PEs[index].Fill);
						clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(xYZSeries.PEs[index].StrokeOpacity, xYZSeries.PEs[index].Stroke);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			clrFill = chartColorModel.getFillColor(row, column, val);
			clrOutline = chartColorModel.getOutlineColor(row, column, val);
			if (colApp.ModelStyle == ColorModels.CustomSkin && colApp.Skin.PEs.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = row;
				if (!colApp.Skin.ApplyRowWise)
				{
					num = column;
				}
				num %= colApp.Skin.PEs.Count;
				clrFill = Color.FromArgb(colApp.Skin.PEs[num].FillOpacity, colApp.Skin.PEs[num].Fill);
				clrOutline = Color.FromArgb(colApp.Skin.PEs[num].StrokeOpacity, colApp.Skin.PEs[num].Stroke);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool UseSmartScaleInterval(AxisAppearance axisAppearance)
		{
			if (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle != AxisTickStyle.Smart)
			{
				if (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.DataInterval)
				{
					return axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval == 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (this is Bubble3DLayer)
			{
				return;
			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			XYZSeries xYZSeries = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					xYZSeries = item as XYZSeries;
					if (xYZSeries != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				dataIsValid &= xYZSeries != null;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid &= data.GetRowCount() > 0 && data.GetColumnCount() > 2;
			}
		}
	}
	public class Bubble3DLayer : Point3DLayer
	{
		public Bubble3DLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			_ = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			ColorAppearance colApp = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			double interval = 0.0;
			double interval2 = 0.0;
			double interval3 = 0.0;
			MinMaxValues(out var minX, out var minY, out var minZ, out var maxX, out var maxY, out var maxZ);
			if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				Point3DLayer.SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance, ref minX, ref maxX);
			}
			if (axisAppearance2.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				Point3DLayer.SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance2, ref minY, ref maxY);
			}
			if (axisAppearance3.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				Point3DLayer.SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance3, ref minZ, ref maxZ);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance2))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minY, ref maxY, out interval2, axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minX, ref maxX, out interval, axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			if (UseSmartScaleInterval(axisAppearance3))
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref minZ, ref maxZ, out interval3, axisAppearance3.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			object obj = null;
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) as ChartGridAppearance;
			Color backColor = chartGridAppearance.BackColor;
			float num = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * 0.8f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)outerBounds.X + (float)outerBounds.Width * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Y - (float)outerBounds.Height * 0.1f + (float)outerBounds.Height * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Width * num, (float)outerBounds.Height * num);
			float width = rectangleF.Width;
			Scene3D scene3D = new Scene3D(rectangleF, width, 5f, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ, backColor);
			SetSceneElements(scene3D, minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ, interval, interval2, interval3, this);
			double x = 0.0;
			double y = 0.0;
			double z = 0.0;
			double r = 0.0;
			AreaLineChart3D areaLineChart3D = new AreaLineChart3D(scene3D, (float)((double)((view3DAppearance.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, 0.0, 1f, minY, maxY, flashMode: false, view3DAppearance.Outline, minY, AreaLineType.Bubble);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			int num2 = seriesCollection?.Count ?? rowCount;
			double num3 = FindMaxRadius(axisAppearance2, seriesCollection, num2, columnCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				obj = null;
				ISeries series = null;
				int num4;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					series = seriesCollection[i];
					num4 = series.GetPoints().Count;
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = columnCount;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < num4; j++)
				{
					if (!GetData(i, j, ref obj, ref x, ref y, ref z, ref r))
					{
						IDataPoint dataPoint = obj as IDataPoint;
						GetColors(out var clrFill, out var clrOutline, ChartColorModel, i, j, y, colApp, obj, data);
						if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							x = Math.Log(x, axisAppearance.LogBase);
						}
						if (axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							y = Math.Log(y, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
							r = num3 * Math.Log(r, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
						}
						if (axisAppearance3.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							z = Math.Log(z, axisAppearance3.LogBase);
						}
						if (y >= minY && y <= maxY && x >= minX && x <= maxX && z >= minZ && z <= maxZ)
						{
							areaLineChart3D.Add(i, j, x, y, z, r, clrFill, clrOutline, dataPoint, series);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			areaLineChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(view3DAppearance.Light, cylinder: false);
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			scene3D.AddLabels(rectangleF, scene, OuterBound);
			ChartType chartType = ChartType.BubbleChart3D;
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, chartType);
		}

		private double FindMaxRadius(AxisAppearance app, SeriesCollection seriesCol, int seriesCount, int columns)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (app.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < seriesCount; i++)
				{
					int num2;
					if (seriesCol != null && seriesCol.Count > i)
					{
						ISeries series = seriesCol[i];
						num2 = series.GetPoints().Count;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = columns;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(i, j);
						if (objectValue is FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, ((FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint)objectValue).ValueW);
						}
						else if (objectValue != null && Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.NumericTypes.ContainsKey(objectValue.GetType()))
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, data.GetValue(i, 3));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				return 2.0 / 15.0 / Math.Log(num, app.LogBase);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal new void MinMaxValues(out double minX, out double minY, out double minZ, out double maxX, out double maxY, out double maxZ)
		{
			minX = double.MaxValue;
			minY = double.MaxValue;
			minZ = double.MaxValue;
			maxX = double.MinValue;
			maxY = double.MinValue;
			maxZ = double.MinValue;
			double num = double.MinValue;
			if (data is SeriesCollection)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
				foreach (SeriesBase item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (!(item is FourDimensionalNumericSeries))
					{
						continue;
					}
					FourDimensionalNumericSeries fourDimensionalNumericSeries = item as FourDimensionalNumericSeries;
					foreach (FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint point in fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Points)
					{
						minX = Math.Min(minX, point.ValueX);
						minY = Math.Min(minY, point.ValueY);
						minZ = Math.Min(minZ, point.ValueZ);
						maxX = Math.Max(maxX, point.ValueX);
						maxY = Math.Max(maxY, point.ValueY);
						maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, point.ValueZ);
						num = Math.Max(num, Math.Abs(point.ValueW));
					}
				}
				num /= 1.5;
				maxX += num;
				minX -= num;
				maxY += num;
				minY -= num;
				maxZ += num;
				minZ -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
				for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
				{
					minX = Math.Min(minX, data.GetValue(i, 0));
					minY = Math.Min(minY, data.GetValue(i, 1));
					minZ = Math.Min(minZ, data.GetValue(i, 2));
					maxX = Math.Max(maxX, data.GetValue(i, 0));
					maxY = Math.Max(maxY, data.GetValue(i, 1));
					maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, data.GetValue(i, 2));
					num = Math.Max(num, data.GetValue(i, 3));
				}
			}
			num /= 1.5;
			maxX += num;
			minX -= num;
			maxY += num;
			minY -= num;
			maxZ += num;
			minZ -= num;
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX), ref minX, ref maxX);
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY), ref minY, ref maxY);
			CalculateParams((AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ), ref minZ, ref maxZ);
		}

		internal bool GetData(int row, int column, ref object objectValue, ref double x, ref double y, ref double z, ref double r)
		{
			objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(row, column);
			if (objectValue is FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint)
			{
				FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint = objectValue as FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint;
				x = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueX;
				y = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueY;
				z = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueZ;
				r = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueW;
				return false;
			}
			if (objectValue != null && Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.NumericTypes.ContainsKey(objectValue.GetType()))
			{
				x = data.GetValue(row, 0);
				y = data.GetValue(row, 1);
				z = data.GetValue(row, 2);
				r = data.GetValue(row, 3);
				objectValue = new FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint(r, x, y, z, string.Empty, empty: false);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void FillSphereLight(out GraphicsPath path, out Brush brush, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			if (rect.Width == 0f || rect.Height == 0f)
			{
				rect.Width += 1f;
				rect.Height += 1f;
			}
			brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, GradientColor(Color.Black, color, 0.4f), GradientColor(Color.White, color, 1f), -45f);
			path = new GraphicsPath();
			path.AddEllipse(rect);
		}

		internal static void FillSphereLightSpot(out GraphicsPath path, out Brush brush, RectangleF rect, Color color)
		{
			if (rect.Width == 0f || rect.Height == 0f)
			{
				rect.Width += 1f;
				rect.Height += 1f;
			}
			float num = (float)RGBtoLuminance(color) / 240f;
			RectangleF rect2 = new RectangleF(rect.X + rect.Width / 6f, rect.Y - rect.Height / 8f, rect.Width * 0.9f, rect.Height * 0.9f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect2);
			PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(graphicsPath);
			if ((double)num > 0.7)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = GradientColor(Color.White, Color.Transparent, 1f - num);
			}
			else if ((double)num <= 0.7 && (double)num > 0.3)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = GradientColor(Color.White, Color.Transparent, num - 0.1f);
			}
			else if ((double)num <= 0.3)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = GradientColor(Color.White, Color.Transparent, num + 0.1f);
			}
			pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { Color.Transparent };
			brush = pathGradientBrush;
			path = new GraphicsPath();
			path.AddEllipse(rect);
		}

		private static int RGBtoLuminance(Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float num4 = ((num > num2) ? ((!(num > num3)) ? num3 : num) : ((!(num2 > num3)) ? num3 : num2));
			float num5 = ((num < num2) ? ((!(num < num3)) ? num3 : num) : ((!(num2 < num3)) ? num3 : num2));
			float num6 = (num4 + num5) / 2f;
			return (int)(num6 * 239f);
		}

		private static Color GradientColor(Color colorStart, Color colorEnd, float coefficient)
		{
			if (coefficient < 0f)
			{
				coefficient = 0f;
			}
			if (coefficient > 1f)
			{
				coefficient = 1f;
			}
			int alpha = (int)((float)(int)colorStart.A + (float)(colorEnd.A - colorStart.A) * coefficient);
			int red = (int)((float)(int)colorStart.R + (float)(colorEnd.R - colorStart.R) * coefficient);
			int green = (int)((float)(int)colorStart.G + (float)(colorEnd.G - colorStart.G) * coefficient);
			int blue = (int)((float)(int)colorStart.B + (float)(colorEnd.B - colorStart.B) * coefficient);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			FourDimensionalNumericSeries fourDimensionalNumericSeries = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					fourDimensionalNumericSeries = item as FourDimensionalNumericSeries;
					if (fourDimensionalNumericSeries != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				dataIsValid &= fourDimensionalNumericSeries != null;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid &= data.GetRowCount() > 0 && data.GetColumnCount() > 3;
			}
		}
	}

		internal static Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle GetLineStyle(DashStyle style)
		{
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			switch (style)
			{
			case DashStyle.Solid:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dot:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Dot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDotDot:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.DashDotDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDot:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.DashDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dash:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Dash;
				break;
			default:
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
				break;
			}
			return lineStyle;
		}

		internal static DashStyle GetDashStyle(LineDrawStyle style)
		{
			return style switch
			{
				LineDrawStyle.Solid => DashStyle.Solid, 
				LineDrawStyle.Dot => DashStyle.Dot, 
				LineDrawStyle.DashDotDot => DashStyle.DashDotDot, 
				LineDrawStyle.DashDot => DashStyle.DashDot, 
				LineDrawStyle.Dash => DashStyle.Dash, 
				_ => DashStyle.Solid, 
			};
		}

	public abstract class Hierarchical3DLayer : ChartLayer3D, IPointsInOthers
	{
		private NumericDataPointCollection _PointsInOthers = new NumericDataPointCollection();

		private NumericDataPoint _OthersPoint;

		protected abstract ChartType ForChartType { get; }

		public virtual NumericDataPointCollection PointsInOthers => _PointsInOthers;

		IList IPointsInOthers.PointsInOthers => PointsInOthers;

		IDataPoint IPointsInOthers.OthersPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return OthersPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				OthersPoint = value as NumericDataPoint;
			}
		}

		public virtual NumericDataPoint OthersPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _OthersPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_OthersPoint = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual float TransformOffsetX => 0f;

		protected virtual float TransformOffsetY => 0f;

		protected Hierarchical3DLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			Hierarchical3DAppearance hierarchical3DAppearance = (Hierarchical3DAppearance)GetAppearance();
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			ColorAppearance colApp = (ColorAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			PointsInOthers.Clear();
			float num = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num /= 2f;
			}
			float num2 = num * (float)Math.Min(OuterBound.Width, OuterBound.Height);
			PointF pointF = new PointF((float)OuterBound.Left + (float)OuterBound.Width / 2f, (float)OuterBound.Top + (float)OuterBound.Height / 2f);
			RectangleF bounds = new RectangleF(pointF.X - num2 / 2f, pointF.Y - num2 / 2f, num2, num2);
			double num3 = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(144f - view3DAppearance.XRotation + TransformOffsetX);
			double num4 = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(12f - view3DAppearance.YRotation + TransformOffsetY);
			double num5 = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(0f - view3DAppearance.ZRotation);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle(hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Font, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Center, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
			FunnelChart3D funnelChart3D = new FunnelChart3D(bounds, (float)num3, (float)num4, (float)num5, (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, hierarchical3DAppearance);
			HierarchicalLayer.GetFunnelPointsResult funnelPoints = HierarchicalLayer.GetFunnelPoints(ChartData, hierarchical3DAppearance.OthersCategoryText, hierarchical3DAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent, hierarchical3DAppearance.Sort, PointsInOthers, labelStyle, ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance, ChartCore, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FormatString);
			int column = ((ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection) ? seriesCollection.IndexOf(funnelPoints.Series) : 0);
			if (this is Pyramid3DLayer || this is Cone3DLayer)
			{
				funnelPoints.Points.Reverse();
			}
			_OthersPoint = funnelPoints.OthersPoint;
			for (int i = 0; i < funnelPoints.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = funnelPoints.Points[i];
				int row = ((numericDataPoint != funnelPoints.OthersPoint) ? funnelPoints.Series.Points.IndexOf(numericDataPoint) : funnelPoints.OthersRow);
				GetColors(out var clrFill, out var clrOutline, ChartColorModel, row, column, numericDataPoint.Value, colApp, numericDataPoint, ChartData, stacked: false, pie: false);
				funnelChart3D.AddPartInfo(numericDataPoint.Value, clrFill, clrOutline, row, 0, numericDataPoint, funnelPoints.Series, numericDataPoint.Value / funnelPoints.Total * 100.0, numericDataPoint.Label);
			}
			funnelChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = funnelChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(new PointF(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2f, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2f));
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = funnelChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, ForChartType);
			if (!hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>(funnelChart3D.Labels.Count);
			foreach (Label3DPosition label3 in funnelChart3D.Labels)
			{
				list.Add(Pie3DLayer.GetBounds(label3, LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(ChartCore.Environment, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FormatString), hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Font, OuterBound));
			}
			double[] array = Geometry.OptimizedRectanglesVerticalPositions(list, OuterBound);
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				((Label3DPosition)funnelChart3D.Labels[j]).AxisPosition.Y = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round(array[j] - (double)list[j].Height / 2.0));
			}
			Font fontDef = new Font(hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Font, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Font.Style);
			Pie3DLayer.ResolveOverlaps(funnelChart3D.Labels, fontDef, OuterBound, adjustX: true);
			foreach (Label3DPosition label4 in funnelChart3D.Labels)
			{
				Pie3DLayer.CreateLabelElements(label4, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FormatString, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.Font, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.BorderColor, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FillColor, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.BorderThickness, scene, ChartCore, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.LeaderLineThickness, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.LeaderLinesVisible, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.LeaderLineEndStyle, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.LeaderLineDrawStyle, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.BorderDrawStyle, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.FontColor, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.LeaderLineColor, OuterBound, ChartComponent != null && ChartComponent.RenderingType == RenderingType.Flash, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.HorizontalAlign, hierarchical3DAppearance.Labels.VerticalAlign, Rectangle.Empty, concentric: false);
			}
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_20062_57");
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				{
					foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
					{
						if (!(item is NumericSeries numericSeries))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries.Points)
						{
							if (point.Value < 0.0)
							{
								dataIsValid = false;
								break;
							}
						}
						dataIsValid = dataIsValid;
						break;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			dataIsValid &= data.GetDataMinColumn(0) >= 0.0;
		}
	}
