	public class Heatmap3DLayer : ChartLayer3D
	{
		public Heatmap3DLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.HeatMap);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1004");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			_ = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			ColorAppearance colApp = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			double min = data.GetDataMin();
			double max = data.GetDataMax();
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			if (axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				if (min == 0.0)
				{
					min = axisAppearance2.LogZero;
				}
				min = Math.Floor(Math.Log(min, axisAppearance2.LogBase));
				max = Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(max, axisAppearance2.LogBase));
				if (double.IsNaN(min) || double.IsNaN(max) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(min) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(max))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
				}
			}
			object obj = null;
			double interval = 0.0;
			if (axisAppearance2.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom && axisAppearance2.RangeMin < axisAppearance2.RangeMax)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance2, out min, out max);
			}
			double min2;
			double max2;
			if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance, out min2, out max2);
			}
			else
			{
				min2 = 0.0;
				max2 = columnCount - 1;
			}
			double min3;
			double max3;
			if (axisAppearance3.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				SetCustomRangeMinMax(axisAppearance3, out min3, out max3);
			}
			else
			{
				min3 = 0.0;
				max3 = rowCount - 1;
			}
			if (axisAppearance2.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart)
			{
				AxisSmartScale(ref min, ref max, out interval, axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic);
			}
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) as ChartGridAppearance;
			Color backColor = chartGridAppearance.BackColor;
			float num = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * 0.8f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)outerBounds.X + (float)outerBounds.Width * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Y - (float)outerBounds.Height * 0.1f + (float)outerBounds.Height * (1f - num) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Width * num, (float)outerBounds.Height * num);
			float width = rectangleF.Width;
			if (rowCount > columnCount)
			{
				rectangleF.X += (rectangleF.Width - rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)columnCount) / 2f;
				rectangleF.Width = rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)columnCount;
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)columnCount;
			}
			else
			{
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)columnCount;
			}
			Scene3D scene3D = new Scene3D(rectangleF, width, 5f, min2, max2, min, max, min3, max3, backColor);
			ChartLayer3D.SetSceneElements(scene3D, this, LabelPos.posBeg);
			AreaLineChart3D areaLineChart3D = new AreaLineChart3D(scene3D, (float)((double)((view3DAppearance.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, 0.0, view3DAppearance.EdgeSize, min, max, flashMode: false, view3DAppearance.Outline, min, AreaLineType.HeatMap);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount - 1 && !((double)i >= max2); i++)
			{
				obj = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount - 1 && !((double)j >= max3); j++)
				{
					ISeries series = null;
					if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > j)
					{
						series = seriesCollection[j];
					}
					double dValue = 0.0;
					double dValue2 = 0.0;
					double dValue3 = 0.0;
					double dValue4 = 0.0;
					if (GetData(j, i, ref obj, ref dValue))
					{
						continue;
					}
					IDataPoint dataPoint = obj as IDataPoint;
					if (!GetData(j, i + 1, ref obj, ref dValue2) && !GetData(j + 1, i, ref obj, ref dValue3) && !GetData(j + 1, i + 1, ref obj, ref dValue4))
					{
						Color clrOutline = Color.White;
						GetColors(out var clrFill, out clrOutline, ChartColorModel, j, i, dValue, colApp, obj, data, stacked: false, pie: false);
						Color fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, 0.0);
						Color fillColor2 = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(rowCount - 1, columnCount - 1, data.GetDataMax());
						clrFill = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, (dValue + dValue2 + dValue3) / 3.0);
						Color altitudeColor = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, dValue);
						Color altitudeColor2 = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, dValue2);
						Color altitudeColor3 = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, dValue3);
						Color altitudeColor4 = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, dValue4);
						if (axisAppearance2.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							dValue = Math.Log(dValue, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
							dValue2 = Math.Log(dValue2, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
							dValue3 = Math.Log(dValue3, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
							dValue4 = Math.Log(dValue4, axisAppearance2.LogBase);
						}
						areaLineChart3D.Add(j, i, i, i + 1, i, j, j, j + 1, dValue, dValue2, dValue3, clrFill, clrOutline, altitudeColor, altitudeColor2, altitudeColor3, dataPoint, series);
						clrFill = GetAltitudeColor(fillColor, fillColor2, (dValue2 + dValue3 + dValue4) / 3.0);
						areaLineChart3D.Add(j, i + 1, i + 1, i + 1, i, j, j + 1, j + 1, dValue2, dValue4, dValue3, clrFill, clrOutline, altitudeColor2, altitudeColor4, altitudeColor3, dataPoint, series);
					}
				}
			}
			areaLineChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(view3DAppearance.Light, cylinder: false);
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			scene3D.AddLabels(rectangleF, scene, OuterBound);
			ChartType chartType = ChartType.HeatMapChart3D;
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, chartType);
		}

		private static void SetCustomRangeMinMax(AxisAppearance app, out double min, out double max)
		{
			if (app.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				min = Math.Log(app.RangeMin, app.LogBase);
				max = Math.Log(app.RangeMax, app.LogBase);
				if (double.IsNaN(min) || double.IsNaN(max) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(min) || double.IsNegativeInfinity(max))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				min = app.RangeMin;
				max = app.RangeMax;
			}
		}

		protected Color GetAltitudeColor(Color startColor, Color endColor, double val)
		{
			if (startColor.Equals(endColor))
			{
				return Color.FromArgb(ChartColorModel.GetAlpha(), startColor);
			}
			int num = endColor.R - startColor.R;
			int num2 = endColor.G - startColor.G;
			int num3 = endColor.B - startColor.B;
			int num4 = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3));
			double num5 = (val - data.GetDataMin()) / (data.GetDataMax() - data.GetDataMin());
			int num6 = (int)((double)num4 * num5);
			int red = Math.Min(Math.Max(startColor.R + num6 * num / num4, 0), 255);
			int green = Math.Min(Math.Max(startColor.G + num6 * num2 / num4, 0), 255);
			int blue = Math.Min(Math.Max(startColor.B + num6 * num3 / num4, 0), 255);
			return Color.FromArgb(ChartColorModel.GetAlpha(), red, green, blue);
		}

		protected Color ScaleColor(Color color1, Color color2)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color1.A, (color1.R + color2.R) / 2, (color1.G + color2.G) / 2, (color1.B + color2.B) / 2);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (data.GetColumnCount() < 2 || data.GetRowCount() < 2)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class Line3DLayer : ChartLayer3D
	{
		public Line3DLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1005");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			_ = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);
			ColorAppearance colApp = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int num = data.GetColumnCount();
			object obj = null;
			ChartGridAppearance chartGridAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) as ChartGridAppearance;
			Color backColor = chartGridAppearance.BackColor;
			float num2 = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * 0.8f;
			if (ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num2 /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF((float)outerBounds.X + (float)outerBounds.Width * (1f - num2) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Y - (float)outerBounds.Height * 0.1f + (float)outerBounds.Height * (1f - num2) / 2f, (float)outerBounds.Width * num2, (float)outerBounds.Height * num2);
			float width = rectangleF.Width;
			bool flag = num == 1;
			if (flag)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			if (rowCount > num)
			{
				rectangleF.X += (rectangleF.Width - rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)num) / 2f;
				rectangleF.Width = rectangleF.Width / (float)rowCount * (float)num;
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)num;
			}
			else
			{
				width = rectangleF.Width * (float)rowCount / (float)num;
			}
			CalculateDataParams((AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY), out var dataMin, out var dataMax, out var _);
			Scene3D scene3D = new Scene3D(rectangleF, width, 5f, 0.0, num, dataMin, dataMax, 0.0, rowCount, backColor);
			ChartLayer3D.SetSceneElements(scene3D, this, LabelPos.posMid);
			AreaLineChart3D areaLineChart3D = new AreaLineChart3D(scene3D, (float)((double)((view3DAppearance.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, 0.4, view3DAppearance.EdgeSize, dataMin, dataMax, flashMode: false, view3DAppearance.Outline, dataMin, AreaLineType.Line);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			if (this is Spline3DLayer)
			{
				areaLineChart3D.Splined = true;
				areaLineChart3D.Flatness = ((SplineChart3DAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Spline3D)).Flatness;
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				obj = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					ISeries series = null;
					if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > j)
					{
						series = seriesCollection[j];
					}
					double dValue = 0.0;
					double dValue2 = 0.0;
					if (GetData(j, i, ref obj, ref dValue))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						dValue2 = dValue;
					}
					else if (GetData(j, i + 1, ref obj, ref dValue2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					IDataPoint dataPoint = obj as IDataPoint;
					GetColors(out var clrFill, out var clrOutline, ChartColorModel, j, i, dValue, colApp, obj, data, stacked: false, pie: false);
					if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
					{
						dValue = Math.Log(dValue, axisAppearance.LogBase);
						dValue2 = Math.Log(dValue2, axisAppearance.LogBase);
					}
					bool flag3 = dValue < dataMin || dValue > dataMax;
					bool flag4 = dValue2 < dataMin || dValue2 > dataMax;
					if ((areaLineChart3D.Splined || !(dValue >= dataMax) || !(dValue2 > dataMax)) && (areaLineChart3D.Splined || !(dValue <= dataMin) || !(dValue2 < dataMin)) && (areaLineChart3D.Splined || !(dValue > dataMax) || !(dValue2 >= dataMax) || (dValue <= dataMin && dValue2 >= dataMax)) && (areaLineChart3D.Splined || !(dValue < dataMin) || !(dValue2 <= dataMin) || (dValue <= dataMin && dValue2 >= dataMax)))
					{
						if (flag3 || flag4)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						areaLineChart3D.Add(j, i + 1, (double)i + 0.5, (double)i + 1.5, (double)j + 0.5, dValue, dValue2, clrFill, clrOutline, i == 0, i == num - 2, dataPoint, series);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				double num3 = axisAppearance.RangeMax - axisAppearance.RangeMin;
				int num4 = GetData().GetColumnCount() + 1;
				RectangleF window = new RectangleF(0f, (float)axisAppearance.RangeMin, num4, (float)num3);
				foreach (AreaLineInfo areaLine in areaLineChart3D.areaLineList)
				{
					List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>(2);
					list.Add(new PointF((float)areaLine.xStart, (float)areaLine.valueStart));
					list.Add(new PointF((float)areaLine.xEnd, (float)areaLine.valueEnd));
					List<PointF> points = list;
					IList<IList<PointF>> list2 = new List<IList<PointF>>(1);
					ClipPolyline(list2, points, isClosed: false, RectangleF.Empty, window);
					if (list2.Count > 0)
					{
						IList<PointF> list3 = list2[0];
						if (list3.Count == 2)
						{
							areaLine.xStart = list3[0].X;
							areaLine.valueStart = list3[0].Y;
							areaLine.xEnd = list3[1].X;
							areaLine.valueEnd = list3[1].Y;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			areaLineChart3D.Initialize();
			ArrayList fillPrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(view3DAppearance.Light, cylinder: false);
			ArrayList outlinePrimitives = areaLineChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
			scene3D.AddLabels(rectangleF, scene, OuterBound);
			PreparePathPrimitives(outlinePrimitives, fillPrimitives, colApp, scene, view3DAppearance, ChartCore.ChartType);
		}

		private static void ClipPolyline(IList<IList<PointF>> list, IList<PointF> points, bool isClosed, RectangleF rect, RectangleF window)
		{
			list.Clear();
			List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>();
			Clipper.ClipTo(list2, points, isClosed, rect, window, isPolyline: true);
			List<PointF> list3 = new List<PointF>();
			list.Add(list3);
			foreach (PointF item in list2)
			{
				if (float.IsNaN(item.X) || float.IsNaN(item.Y))
				{
					if (list3.Count > 0)
					{
						list3 = new List<PointF>();
						list.Add(list3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list3.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class NumericAxis3D : Axis3D
	{
		private double m_WindowInterval;

		private double m_WindowMinimum;

		private double m_WindowMaximum;

		private LinearAxisType axisType;

		public override object Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMin;
			}
			set
			{
				dataMin = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMax;
			}
			set
			{
				dataMax = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMinimum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMaximum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				if (m_WindowInterval > (double)WindowRange)
				{
					m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object WindowRange => m_WindowMaximum - m_WindowMinimum;

		public override object TotalRange => dataMax - dataMin;

		public override double IntervalPercentageWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)WindowRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)WindowRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override double IntervalPercentageTotal
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)TotalRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)TotalRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override void IntervalCountWindow(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalCountTotal(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalFit(double totalWidth, double itemWidth)
		{
			WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange * itemWidth / totalWidth;
		}

		private void CorrectScrollScale()
		{
			m_Scale = (double)WindowRange / (double)TotalRange;
			m_Scroll = (m_WindowMinimum - dataMin) / ((1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange);
		}

		protected override void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
			m_WindowMinimum = dataMin + m_Scroll * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
			m_WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
		}

		public override double Map(object d_i)
		{
			double d_i2 = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			double windowMinimum = m_WindowMinimum;
			if (base.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmap(d_i2);
			}
			return linear(d_i2);
		}

		private double linear(double d_i)
		{
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * (d_i - m_WindowMinimum) / (double)WindowRange;
		}

		private double logmap(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
		}

		public override object MapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			if (base.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmapInverse(d_i);
			}
			return linearInverse(d_i);
		}

		private double linearInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return m_WindowMinimum + (m_i - base.MapMinimum) * (double)WindowRange / base.MapRange;
		}

		private double logmapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
		}

		public override bool ItemVisible(object d_i)
		{
			double num = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			if (num >= m_WindowMinimum)
			{
				return num <= m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public NumericAxis3D(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(component, core, axisNumber)
		{
			axisType = LinearAxisType.NumericData;
			if (this.axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
			{
				labelStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisXLabelStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				labelStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisYLabelStyle;
			}
			if (axisType == LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling || axisType == LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling)
			{
				itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
			}
			else
			{
				itemLabelFormat = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
			}
		}
	}

			View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)layer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.View3D);

			bool flashMode = false;
			if (!(layer is IPointsInOthers pointsInOthers) || layer.OuterBound.Height <= 0 || layer.OuterBound.Width <= 0)

				return;
			}
			pointsInOthers.OthersPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
			pointsInOthers.OthersPoint.Label = pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText;

			PieType pieType = (pieChartAppearance.Concentric ? ((!(layer is Doughnut3DLayer)) ? PieType.ConcentricPie : PieType.ConcentricDoughnut) : ((layer is Doughnut3DLayer) ? PieType.Doughnut : PieType.Pie));

			}

			}
			new Point(layer.OuterBound.X + layer.OuterBound.Width / 2, layer.OuterBound.Y + layer.OuterBound.Height / 2);
			int num = PieLayer.GetPieColumnIndex(layer.ChartData, pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex);
			IList onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices = pieChartAppearance.GetOnlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = layer.ChartData as SeriesCollection;
			int num2 = layer.ChartData.GetRowCount();
			int val = layer.ChartData.GetColumnCount();
			if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				val = layer.ChartData.GetRowCount();
				num2 = layer.ChartData.GetColumnCount();
				if (layer.ChartColorModel is LinearColorModel linearColorModel)
				{
					linearColorModel.ItemCount = num2;
				}
			}
			float num3 = Math.Max(0f, Math.Min(1f, (float)pieChartAppearance.RadiusFactor / 100f));
			float num4 = view3DAppearance.Scale / 100f * num3;
			if (layer.ShouldDecreaseScale())
			{
				num4 /= 2f;
			}
			RectangleF boundingRect = new RectangleF((float)layer.OuterBound.X + (float)layer.OuterBound.Width * (1f - num4) / 2f, (float)layer.OuterBound.Y + (float)layer.OuterBound.Height * (1f - num4) / 2f, (float)layer.OuterBound.Width * num4, (float)layer.OuterBound.Height * num4);
			boundingRect.X += boundingRect.Width * 0.1f;
			boundingRect.Width *= 0.8f;
			switch (pieType)
			{
			case PieType.Pie:
			case PieType.Doughnut:
				val = 1;
				break;
			default:
				val = Math.Min(val, 3);
				break;
			}
			float num5 = view3DAppearance.YRotation + (float)pieChartAppearance.StartAngle;
			PieChart3D pieChart3D = new PieChart3D(pieType, boundingRect, (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.XRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)((num5 + 90f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(view3DAppearance.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)view3DAppearance.Perspective, val, pieChartAppearance.PieThickness, view3DAppearance.EdgeSize, pieChartAppearance.BreakDistancePercentage, flashMode, view3DAppearance.Outline);
			for (int i = 0; i < val; i++)
			{
				NumericSeries numericSeries = null;
				NumericSeries numericSeries2;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					num2 = seriesCollection[i].GetPoints().Count;
					numericSeries2 = seriesCollection[i] as NumericSeries;
					if (numericSeries2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					numericSeries2 = null;
					numericSeries = new NumericSeries();
				}
				switch (pieType)
				{
				case PieType.ConcentricDoughnut:
				case PieType.ConcentricPie:
					num = i;
					break;
				}
				int num6 = ((num != -1) ? num : 0);
				double num7 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					double num8 = ((numericSeries2 == null || numericSeries2.Points.Count <= j) ? Math.Abs(layer.ChartData.GetValue(j, num)) : Math.Abs(numericSeries2.Points[j].Value));
					num7 += num8;
				}
				double num9 = num7 * pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent / 100.0;
				double num10 = 0.0;
				int num11 = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
				{
					double num12;
					if (numericSeries2 != null && numericSeries2.Points.Count > k)
					{
						num12 = Math.Abs(numericSeries2.Points[k].Value);
						if (num12 <= num9)
						{
							pointsInOthers.PointsInOthers.Add(numericSeries2.Points[k]);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num12 = Math.Abs(layer.ChartData.GetValue(k, num));
					}
					if (num12 != 0.0 && num12 <= num9)
					{
						num10 += num12;
						num11 = k;
					}
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < num2; l++)
				{
					bool exploded = pieChartAppearance.BreakAllSlices || (pieChartAppearance.BreakAlternatingSlices && l % 2 == 0) || (onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices != null && onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices.Count > 0 && onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices.Contains(l));
					bool flag = numericSeries2 != null && numericSeries2.Points.Count > l;
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint;
					if (flag)
					{
						numericDataPoint = numericSeries2.Points[l];
					}
					else
					{
						numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint.Value = layer.ChartData.GetValue(l, num);
						numericSeries?.Points.Add(numericDataPoint);
					}
					double num13 = Math.Abs(numericDataPoint.Value);
					if (num13 == 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num13 <= num9)
					{
						pointsInOthers.PointsInOthers.Add(numericDataPoint);
						continue;
					}
					layer.GetColors(out var clrFill, out var clrOutline, layer.ChartColorModel, l, num6, num13, colApp, numericDataPoint, layer.ChartData, stacked: true, pie: true);
					if (flag)

					}
					object rowLabel = layer.ChartData.GetRowLabel(l);
					if (rowLabel != null)

						numericDataPoint.Label = rowLabel.ToString();

					pieChart3D.AddSlice(num13, clrFill, clrOutline, exploded, i, l, num, numericDataPoint.Label, numericDataPoint, numericSeries, otherSlice: false, "");
				}

					if (numericSeries2 != null && numericSeries2.Points.Count > num11)

		internal static Font ResolveOverlaps(ArrayList labels, Font fontDef, Rectangle outerBound, bool adjustX)
		{
			Point point = new Point(outerBound.X + outerBound.Width / 2, outerBound.Y + outerBound.Height / 2);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in labels)
			{
				if (label.LabelPosition.X < (float)point.X)
				{
					arrayList.Add(label);
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList2.Add(label);
				}
			}
			SizeF stringSizePixels;
			int num;
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("Test String", fontDef);
				stringSizePixels.Height = (float)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Height) + 2f;
				num = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)outerBound.Height / (double)stringSizePixels.Height) + 1;
				flag = num >= arrayList.Count && num >= arrayList2.Count;
				if (!flag)
				{
					fontDef = new Font(fontDef.Name, Math.Max(fontDef.Size - 1f, 0.1f), fontDef.Style);
				}
			}
			while (!(fontDef.Size <= 1f) && !flag);
			TextSlot[] array = new TextSlot[num];
			TextSlot[] array2 = new TextSlot[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Point pos = new Point(outerBound.Left + 10, (int)((float)i * stringSizePixels.Height));
				Point pos2 = new Point(outerBound.Right - 10, (int)((float)i * stringSizePixels.Height));
				array[i] = new TextSlot(pos);
				array2[i] = new TextSlot(pos2);
			}
			if (array.Length > 0)
			{
				foreach (Label3DPosition item in arrayList)
				{
					int num2 = (int)(item.AxisPosition.Y / stringSizePixels.Height);
					int num3 = (int)(item.AxisPosition.Y % stringSizePixels.Height);
					if ((double)num3 >= (double)stringSizePixels.Height / 2.0 && num2 + 1 < array.Length)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = 0;
					}
					if (num2 >= array.Length)
					{
						num2 = array.Length - 1;
					}
					array[num2].Labels.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (array2.Length > 0)
			{
				foreach (Label3DPosition item2 in arrayList2)
				{
					int num4 = (int)(item2.AxisPosition.Y / stringSizePixels.Height);
					int num5 = (int)(item2.AxisPosition.Y % stringSizePixels.Height);
					if ((double)num5 >= (double)stringSizePixels.Height / 2.0 && num4 + 1 < array2.Length)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num4 = 0;
					}
					if (num4 >= array.Length)
					{
						num4 = array.Length - 1;
					}
					array2[num4].Labels.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			Spread(array);
			Spread(array2);
			Rectangle rectangle = outerBound;
			rectangle.Inflate(0, -3);
			int num6 = Convert.ToInt32(stringSizePixels.Height - 2f);
			int num7 = Math.Min(GetSlotsTopBound(array, rectangle.Bottom), GetSlotsTopBound(array2, rectangle.Bottom));
			int num8 = Math.Max(GetSlotsBottomBound(array, rectangle.Top), GetSlotsBottomBound(array2, rectangle.Top)) + num6;
			int offsetTopY = 0;
			int num9 = 0;
			if (num7 < rectangle.Top)
			{
				offsetTopY = rectangle.Top - num7;
			}
			if (num8 > rectangle.Bottom)
			{
				num9 = num8 - rectangle.Bottom;
			}
			SetAndAdjustSlotsForTopBound(array, offsetTopY, num6, rectangle.Bottom, adjustX);
			SetAndAdjustSlotsForTopBound(array2, offsetTopY, num6, rectangle.Bottom, adjustX);
			if (num9 > 0)
			{
				AdjustSlotsForBottomBound(array, -num9, num6, rectangle.Top);
				AdjustSlotsForBottomBound(array2, -num9, num6, rectangle.Top);
			}
			return fontDef;
		}

		private static void SetAndAdjustSlotsForTopBound(TextSlot[] slots, int offsetTopY, int textSize, int bottomBound, bool adjustX)
		{
			foreach (TextSlot textSlot in slots)
			{
				foreach (Label3DPosition label in textSlot.Labels)
				{
					if (adjustX)
					{
						label.AxisPosition.X = textSlot.Position.X;
					}
					label.AxisPosition.Y = textSlot.Position.Y;
					if (offsetTopY > 0 && label.AxisPosition.Y + (float)offsetTopY < (float)bottomBound)
					{
						label.AxisPosition.Y += offsetTopY;
					}
				}
				if (textSlot.Labels.Count == 0 && offsetTopY > 0)
				{
					offsetTopY -= textSize;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AdjustSlotsForBottomBound(TextSlot[] slots, int offsetBottomY, int textSize, int topBound)
		{
			for (int num = slots.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				TextSlot textSlot = slots[num];
				foreach (Label3DPosition label in textSlot.Labels)
				{
					if (offsetBottomY < 0 && label.AxisPosition.Y + (float)offsetBottomY > (float)topBound)
					{
						label.AxisPosition.Y += offsetBottomY;
					}
				}
				if (textSlot.Labels.Count == 0 && offsetBottomY < 0)
				{
					offsetBottomY += textSize;
				}
			}
		}

		private static int GetSlotsTopBound(TextSlot[] slots, int defaultValue)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
			{
				if (slots[i].Labels.Count > 0)
				{
					return slots[i].Position.Y;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private static int GetSlotsBottomBound(TextSlot[] slots, int defaultValue)
		{
			for (int num = slots.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (slots[num].Labels.Count > 0)
				{
					return slots[num].Position.Y;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		internal static void Spread(TextSlot[] slots)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			while (!flag && num++ < 100)
			{
				flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
				{
					if (slots[i].Labels.Count > 1)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (i + 1 < slots.Length)
						{
							PushOneLabelUpFrom(slots, i);
						}
					}
				}
				for (int num2 = slots.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (slots[num2].Labels.Count > 1)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (num2 - 1 >= 0)
						{
							PushOneLabelDownFrom(slots, num2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetBounds(Label3DPosition label, string textValue, Font font, Rectangle outerBounds)
		{
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(textValue, font, outerBounds.Width, new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces));
			Size size = new Size((int)(stringSizePixels.Width * 1.1f), (int)(stringSizePixels.Height * 1.2f));
			return (!(label.LabelPosition.X > label.AxisPosition.X)) ? new Rectangle(new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y - size.Height / 2), size) : new Rectangle(new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X - size.Width, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y - size.Height / 2), size);
		}

		internal static void PushOneLabelUpFrom(TextSlot[] slots, int i)
		{
			Label3DPosition label3DPosition = (Label3DPosition)slots[i].Labels[0];
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in slots[i].Labels)
			{
				if (label.LabelPosition.Y > label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y)
				{
					label3DPosition = label;
				}
			}
			slots[i].Labels.Remove(label3DPosition);
			slots[i + 1].Labels.Add(label3DPosition);
		}

		internal static void PushOneLabelDownFrom(TextSlot[] slots, int i)
		{
			Label3DPosition label3DPosition = (Label3DPosition)slots[i].Labels[0];
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in slots[i].Labels)
			{
				if (label.LabelPosition.Y < label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y)
				{
					label3DPosition = label;
				}
			}
			slots[i].Labels.Remove(label3DPosition);
			slots[i - 1].Labels.Add(label3DPosition);
		}

		internal static void CreateLabelElements(Label3DPosition label, string formatString, Font font, Color borderColor, Color fillColor, int borderThickness, SceneGraph scene, ChartCore core, int leaderLineThickness, bool leaderLinesVisible, LineCapStyle leaderEndStyle, LineDrawStyle leaderDrawStyle, LineDrawStyle borderDrawStyle, Color fontColor, Color leaderLineColor, Rectangle outerBounds, bool pushLabelsOut, StringAlignment hAlign, StringAlignment vAlign, Rectangle doNotOverlap, bool concentric)
		{
			Line line = new Line(new Point((int)label.LabelPosition.X, (int)label.LabelPosition.Y), new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y), new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, leaderEndStyle, leaderDrawStyle));
			if (leaderLineColor == Color.Empty)
			{
				line.PE.Stroke = label.color;
			}
			else
			{
				line.PE.Stroke = leaderLineColor;
			}
			line.PE.StrokeWidth = leaderLineThickness;
			Text text = CreatePieLabel(label, formatString, core, font, fontColor);
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text.GetTextString(), font, outerBounds.Width, new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces));
			Size size = new Size((int)(stringSizePixels.Width * 1.1f), (int)(stringSizePixels.Height * 1.2f));
			Rectangle rectangle = ((text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign != StringAlignment.Near) ? new Rectangle(new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X - size.Width, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y - size.Height / 2), size) : new Rectangle(new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y - size.Height / 2), size));
			if (!concentric && doNotOverlap.IntersectsWith(rectangle))
			{
				int num = rectangle.Right - doNotOverlap.Left;
				int num2 = doNotOverlap.Right - rectangle.Left;
				int num3 = rectangle.Bottom - doNotOverlap.Top;
				int num4 = doNotOverlap.Bottom - rectangle.Top;
				int[] array = new int[4] { num, num2, num3, num4 };
				Array.Sort(array);
				if (array[0] == num)
				{
					rectangle.Offset(-num, 0);
					line.p2.Offset(-num, 0);
				}
				else if (array[0] == num2)
				{
					rectangle.Offset(num2, 0);
					line.p2.Offset(num2, 0);
				}
				else if (array[0] == num3)
				{
					rectangle.Offset(0, -num3);
					line.p2.Offset(0, -num3);
				}
				else if (array[0] == num4)
				{
					rectangle.Offset(0, num4);
					line.p2.Offset(0, num4);
				}
			}
			int num5 = Math.Max(0, outerBounds.Left - rectangle.Left);
			int num6 = Math.Max(0, rectangle.Right - outerBounds.Right);
			int num7 = num5 - num6;
			line.p2.Offset(num7, 0);
			text.bounds.Offset(num7, 0);
			rectangle.Offset(num7, 0);
			if (pushLabelsOut)
			{
				int num8 = rectangle.Left - outerBounds.Left;
				int num9 = outerBounds.Right - rectangle.Right;
				if (num8 < num9)
				{
					line.p2.Offset(-num8, 0);
					text.bounds.Offset(-num8, 0);
					rectangle.Offset(-num8, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					line.p2.Offset(num9, 0);
					text.bounds.Offset(num9, 0);
					rectangle.Offset(num9, 0);
				}
			}
			text.bounds = rectangle;
			text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = hAlign;
			text.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = vAlign;
			Box box = new Box(rectangle, new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, borderDrawStyle));
			box.PE.StrokeOpacity = borderColor.A;
			box.PE.Stroke = borderColor;
			box.PE.StrokeWidth = borderThickness;
			if (fillColor == Color.Empty)
			{
				box.PE.Fill = label.color;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = label.color.A;
			}
			else
			{
				box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			}
			if (borderThickness == 0)
			{
				box.PE.Stroke = box.PE.Fill;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = box.PE.FillOpacity;
			}
			scene.Add(box);
			scene.Add(text);
			if (leaderLinesVisible && !Geometry.PointInsideRectangle(line.p1, rectangle) && !Geometry.PointInsideRectangle(line.p2, rectangle))
			{
				scene.Add(line);
			}
		}

		internal static Text CreatePieLabel(Label3DPosition label, PieChartAppearance pieApp, ChartCore core)
		{
			return CreatePieLabel(label, pieApp.Labels.FormatString, core, pieApp.Labels.Font, pieApp.Labels.FontColor);
		}

		internal static Text CreatePieLabel(Label3DPosition label, string formatString, ChartCore core, Font font, Color fontColor)
		{
			core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = label.Value;
			core.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = label.Label;
			core.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = label.PercentValue;
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(core.Environment, formatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = font;
			labelStyle.FontColor = fontColor;
			int num = 0;
			if (label.LabelPosition.X > label.AxisPosition.X)
			{
				num -= 3;
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
			}
			else
			{
				num += 3;
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
			}
			return new Text(new Point((int)label.AxisPosition.X + num, (int)label.AxisPosition.Y), text, labelStyle);
		}

		[Obsolete("Please use Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Geometry.RadianToDegree instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public double RadianToDegree(double theta)

		}

		[Obsolete("Please use Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Geometry.DegreeToRadian instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return Geometry.DegreeToRadian(degree);
		}

		public int GetSliceCount()
		{
			return sliceCount;
		}

		public double GetOthersValue()
		{
			return othersCumulativeTotal;
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1006");
		}

		public ArrayList GetOthersListValue()
		{
			return othersArrayList;
		}
	}
	public class SetAxis3D : Axis3D
	{
		private double m_WindowInterval;

		private double m_WindowMinimum;

		private double m_WindowMaximum;

		internal SetLabelAxisType axisType;

		public override object Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMin;
			}
			set
			{
				dataMin = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMax;
			}
			set
			{
				dataMax = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMinimum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMaximum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				if (m_WindowInterval > (double)WindowRange)
				{
					m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object WindowRange => m_WindowMaximum - m_WindowMinimum;

		public override object TotalRange => dataMax - dataMin;

		public override double IntervalPercentageWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)WindowRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)WindowRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override double IntervalPercentageTotal
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)TotalRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)TotalRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override void IntervalCountWindow(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalCountTotal(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalFit(double totalWidth, double itemWidth)
		{
			WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange * itemWidth / totalWidth;
		}

		private void CorrectScrollScale()
		{
			m_Scale = (double)WindowRange / (double)TotalRange;
			m_Scroll = (m_WindowMinimum - dataMin) / ((1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange);
		}

		protected override void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
			m_WindowMinimum = dataMin + m_Scroll * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
			m_WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
		}

		public override double Map(object d_i)
		{
			double d_i2 = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			double windowMinimum = m_WindowMinimum;
			if (base.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmap(d_i2);
			}
			return linear(d_i2);
		}

		private double linear(double d_i)
		{
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * (d_i - m_WindowMinimum) / (double)WindowRange;
		}

		private double logmap(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
		}

		public override object MapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			if (base.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmapInverse(d_i);
			}
			return linearInverse(d_i);
		}

		private double linearInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return m_WindowMinimum + (m_i - base.MapMinimum) * (double)WindowRange / base.MapRange;
		}

		private double logmapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
			return base.MapMinimum + base.MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
		}

		public override bool ItemVisible(object d_i)
		{
			double num = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			if (num >= m_WindowMinimum)
			{
				return num <= m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public SetAxis3D(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber, SetLabelAxisType AxisTypePara)
			: base(component, core, axisNumber)
		{
			axisType = AxisTypePara;
		}
	}
	public class ThreeDGridLayer : ChartLayer3D
	{
		private ChartType charttype = ChartType.ColumnChart3D;

		public bool zeroAlign = true;

		private Axis3D[] AX = new Axis3D[6];

		private bool[] VS = new bool[6];

		private LabelStyle[] ST = new LabelStyle[6];

		public Color XYPlaneColor = DefaultConstants.D_Grid3DXYPlaneColor;

		public Color XZPlaneColor = DefaultConstants.D_Grid3DXZPlaneColor;

		public Color YZPlaneColor = DefaultConstants.D_Grid3DYZPlaneColor;

		public byte planeAlphaValue = 150;

		private string[] AxNames = new string[6] { "Y", "Z", "X", "Y2", "Z2", "X2" };

		public ThreeDGridLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		private void SetPathInAxis()
		{
			Axis3D[] aX = AX;
			foreach (Layer layer in aX)
			{
				if (layer != null)
				{
					layer.Path = Path;
				}
			}
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Column);
		}

		public void SetChartType(ChartType type)
		{
			charttype = type;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				VS[i] = true;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++)
			{
				ST[j] = new LabelStyle(DefaultConstants.D_AxisLabelFont, Color.Red, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Near, StringAlignment.Center, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
			}
			switch (charttype)
			{
			case ChartType.ColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart:
			case ChartType.CylinderStackColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.PointChart3D:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
				AX[1] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z_Axis);
				AX[0] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[2] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[4] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z2_Axis);
				AX[3] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[5] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[1].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[4].addStyle(65536);
				AX[1].addStyle(65536);
				if (charttype == ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart || charttype == ChartType.CylinderStackColumnChart3D)
				{
					AX[5].itemLabelFormat = "";
					AX[2].itemLabelFormat = "";
				}
				else
				{
					AX[5].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
					AX[2].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.AreaChart3D:
			case ChartType.LineChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart3D:
				AX[1] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z_Axis);
				AX[0] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[2] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				AX[4] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z2_Axis);
				AX[3] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[5] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				AX[0].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[3].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[5].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[2].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[1].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[4].addStyle(65536);
				AX[1].addStyle(65536);
				break;
			case ChartType.HeatMapChart3D:
				AX[0] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[1] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z_Axis);
				AX[2] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				AX[3] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[4] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z2_Axis);
				AX[5] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				AX[0].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[3].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[5].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[2].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[1].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[4].addStyle(65536);
				AX[1].addStyle(65536);
				break;
			case ChartType.BarChart3D:
			case ChartType.Stack3DBarChart:
			case ChartType.CylinderStackBarChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderBarChart3D:
				AX[0] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[1] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[2] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis);
				AX[3] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Z2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[4] = new SetAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				AX[5] = new NumericAxis3D(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis);
				if (charttype == ChartType.BarChart3D)
				{
					AX[1].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
					AX[4].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				}
				else
				{
					AX[1].itemLabelFormat = "";
					AX[4].itemLabelFormat = "";
				}
				AX[5].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[2].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance3.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[2].addStyle(8192);
				AX[5].addStyle(4096);
				AX[0].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[3].itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				AX[2].addStyle(32768);
				AX[5].addStyle(32768);
				break;
			}
			switch (charttype)
			{
			default:
				ResetAxisLabelFormat();
				break;
			case ChartType.PieChart3D:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart3D:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart3D:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart3D:
			case ChartType.ConeChart3D:
				break;
			}
			SetPathInAxis();
			for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
			{
				base.Grid[AxNames[k]] = AX[k];
			}
		}

		public void ResetAxisLabelFormat()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = null;
			if (charttype == ChartType.BarChart3D || charttype == ChartType.Stack3DBarChart)
			{
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[2].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[5].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[1].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[4].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[0].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[3].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[2].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[5].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[0].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[3].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
				axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisZ);
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[1].itemLabelFormat;
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = AX[1].itemLabelFormat;

		internal Rectangle ClipBounds
		{

			}

			{
				_ClipBounds = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{

				adornmentSceneGraph.Dispose();
			}

		public AdornmentLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)

		internal void InitializeClipBounds()
		{
			if (ChartCore != null && ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				ClipBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite) as CompositeChartAppearance;
				{
					foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers)
					{
						if (item.ChartArea != null)
						{
							if (ClipBounds == Rectangle.Empty)
							{
								ClipBounds = item.ChartArea.InnerBounds;
							}
							else
							{
								ClipBounds = Rectangle.Union(ClipBounds, item.ChartArea.InnerBounds);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			ClipBounds = OuterBound;
		}

		internal void RefreshClipBoundsForCompositeChart(Primitive primitive)
		{
			CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite) as CompositeChartAppearance;
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers)
			{
				if (primitive.Layer == item.ChartLayer && item.ChartArea != null)
				{
					ClipBounds = item.ChartArea.InnerBounds;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(WinTooltipAppearance tooltipApp, SceneGraph scene, Primitive p)
		{
			if (tooltipApp.HighlightDataPoint)
			{
				ClipBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				if (ChartCore != null && ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
				{
					RefreshClipBoundsForCompositeChart(p);
				}
				else
				{
					ClipBounds = OuterBound;
				}
				if (ClipBounds != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
					graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(ClipBounds);
					scene.Add(graphicsContext);
				}
				p.Highlight(scene, tooltipApp.HighlightOutlineColor, tooltipApp.HighlightFillColor);
				if (ClipBounds != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					GraphicsContext graphicsContext2 = new GraphicsContext();
					graphicsContext2.ResetClip();
					scene.Add(graphicsContext2);
				}
			}
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph1(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			highlightPrimitive = null;
			adornmentSceneGraph.Clear();
		}

		public bool OnMouseClick(int x, int y)
		{
			WinTooltipAppearance winTooltipAppearance = (WinTooltipAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (winTooltipAppearance.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseClick)
			{
				return CheckForPrimitiveAtPoint(x, y);
			}
			if (winTooltipAppearance.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseMove)
			{
				highlightPrimitive = null;
				return CheckForPrimitiveAtPoint(x, y);
			}
			if (winTooltipAppearance.Display == TooltipDisplay.Never)
			{
				if (Core.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(new Point(x, y)) != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool OnMouseMove(int x, int y)
		{
			WinTooltipAppearance winTooltipAppearance = (WinTooltipAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (winTooltipAppearance.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseMove)
			{
				return CheckForPrimitiveAtPoint(x, y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool CheckForPrimitiveAtPoint(int x, int y)
		{
			Point point = new Point(x, y);
			Primitive chartPrimitiveFromPoint = Core.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point);
			if (!object.ReferenceEquals(chartPrimitiveFromPoint, highlightPrimitive))
			{
				highlightPrimitive = chartPrimitiveFromPoint;
				mousePoint = point;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsPrimitiveHighlighted()
		{
			return highlightPrimitive != null;
		}
	}
	public class AnnotationLayer : Layer
	{
		private IAdvanceAxis xAxis;

		private IAdvanceAxis yAxis;

		public AnnotationLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)

		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Annotations);
		}

		private bool Match(Location location, Primitive primitive)
		{
			if (primitive.Path != null && primitive.Path.IndexOf("Legend") >= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num;
			int num2;
			if (ChartCore.GetGridLayer().ChartData is ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter && chartDataFilter.GetSwapRowsAndColumns())
			{
				num = primitive.Column;
				num2 = primitive.Row;
			}
			else
			{
				num = primitive.Row;
				num2 = primitive.Column;
			}
			if (location.Row != -1 && location.Column != -1 && num != -1 && num2 != -1 && (location.Row == num || location.Row == -2 || num == -2))
			{
				if (location.Column != num2 && location.Column != -2)
				{
					return num2 == -2;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Point GetPointFromLocation(Location location)
		{
			Point result = Point.Empty;
			switch (location.Type)
			{
			case LocationType.DataValues:
				if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
				{
					if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite) is CompositeChartAppearance { ChartLayers: not null } compositeChartAppearance && compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers.Count > 0 && compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[0].ChartLayer != null && compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[0].ChartLayer.Grid != null)
					{
						xAxis = compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[0].ChartLayer.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
						yAxis = compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers[0].ChartLayer.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					xAxis = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
					yAxis = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
				}
				if (xAxis != null && yAxis != null)
				{
					if (xAxis is TimeAxis)
					{
						result.X = (int)xAxis.Map(xAxis.InverseNumericOf(location.ValueX));
					}
					else
					{
						result.X = (int)xAxis.Map(location.ValueX);
					}
					result.Y = (int)yAxis.Map(location.ValueY);
				}
				break;
			case LocationType.Percentage:
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ChartCore.GetBorderLayer().GetOuterBounds();
				if (location.LocationX > 0.0)
				{
					result.X = (int)((double)(rectangle.Width - rectangle.Left) * (location.LocationX / 100.0));
				}
				else
				{
					result.X = 0;
				}
				if (location.LocationY > 0.0)
				{
					result.Y = (int)((double)(rectangle.Height - rectangle.Top) * (location.LocationY / 100.0));
				}
				else
				{
					result.Y = 0;
				}
				break;
			}
			case LocationType.Pixels:
				result = new Point((int)location.LocationX, (int)location.LocationY);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private PrimitiveCollection GetLocationParents(SceneGraph scene, Location location)
		{
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			if (location.Type == LocationType.RowColumn)
			{
				foreach (Primitive item in scene)
				{
					if (item is PointSet || item is Polyline || item is Polygon)
					{
						DataPoint[] array = null;
						if (item is PointSet)
						{
							array = ((PointSet)item).points;
						}
						else if (item is Polyline)
						{
							array = ((Polyline)item).points;
						}
						else if (item is Polygon)
						{
							if (item.Layer is HierarchicalLayer)
							{
								primitiveCollection.Add(item);
							}
							else
							{
								array = ((Polygon)item).DataPoints;
							}
						}
						if (array == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						DataPoint[] array2 = array;
						foreach (DataPoint dataPoint in array2)
						{
							if (dataPoint != null && Match(location, dataPoint))
							{
								primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (Match(location, item))
					{
						primitiveCollection.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return primitiveCollection;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ResetClip();
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			AnnotationsAppearance annotationsAppearance = (AnnotationsAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (!annotationsAppearance.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = Core.GetChartLayer().GetOuterBounds();
			foreach (IAnnotation annotation3 in annotationsAppearance.Annotations)
			{
				if (annotation3 is Annotation annotation2)
				{
					if (!annotation2.Visible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (annotation2 is LineAnnotation)
					{
						LineAnnotation lineAnnotation = (LineAnnotation)annotation2;
						lineAnnotation.DefaultOffsetHeight = rectangle.Height / 4;
						lineAnnotation.DefaultOffsetWidth = rectangle.Width / 4;
					}
					else if (annotation2 is LineImageAnnotation)
					{
						LineImageAnnotation lineImageAnnotation = (LineImageAnnotation)annotation2;
						lineImageAnnotation.DefaultOffsetHeight = rectangle.Height / 4;
						lineImageAnnotation.DefaultOffsetWidth = rectangle.Width / 4;
					}
				}
				AddAnnotation(scene, annotation3);
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotationForAllParents(SceneGraph scene, IAnnotation annotation, PrimitiveCollection parents)
		{
			foreach (Primitive parent in parents)
			{
				annotation.RenderAnnotation(scene, parent);
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotationForAllParents(SceneGraph scene, OffsetableAnnotation offsetable, PrimitiveCollection parents, PrimitiveCollection offsetParents)
		{
			foreach (Primitive parent in parents)
			{
				foreach (Primitive offsetParent in offsetParents)
				{
					offsetable.RenderAnnotation(scene, parent, offsetParent);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotationForAllParents(SceneGraph scene, OffsetableAnnotation offsetable, PrimitiveCollection parents, Point offsetPoint)
		{
			foreach (Primitive parent in parents)
			{
				offsetable.RenderAnnotation(scene, parent, offsetPoint);
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotationForAllParents(SceneGraph scene, OffsetableAnnotation offsetable, Point renderPoint, PrimitiveCollection offsetParents)
		{
			foreach (Primitive offsetParent in offsetParents)
			{
				offsetable.RenderAnnotation(scene, renderPoint, offsetParent);
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotation(SceneGraph scene, IAnnotation annotation)
		{
			if (annotation.Location.Type == LocationType.RowColumn)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection locationParents = GetLocationParents(scene, annotation.Location);
				if (annotation is OffsetableAnnotation)
				{
					OffsetableAnnotation offsetableAnnotation = (OffsetableAnnotation)annotation;
					if (offsetableAnnotation.OffsetMode == LocationOffsetMode.Automatic)
					{
						AddAnnotationForAllParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation, locationParents);
					}
					else if (offsetableAnnotation.Offset.Type == LocationType.RowColumn)
					{
						PrimitiveCollection locationParents2 = GetLocationParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation.Offset);
						AddAnnotationForAllParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation, locationParents, locationParents2);
					}
					else
					{
						Point pointFromLocation = GetPointFromLocation(offsetableAnnotation.Offset);
						AddAnnotationForAllParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation, locationParents, pointFromLocation);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AddAnnotationForAllParents(scene, annotation, locationParents);
				}
				return;
			}
			Point pointFromLocation2 = GetPointFromLocation(annotation.Location);
			if (pointFromLocation2.X < -1073741951 || pointFromLocation2.X > 1073741951 || pointFromLocation2.Y < -1073741951 || pointFromLocation2.Y > 1073741951)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (annotation is OffsetableAnnotation)
			{
				OffsetableAnnotation offsetableAnnotation2 = (OffsetableAnnotation)annotation;
				if (offsetableAnnotation2.OffsetMode == LocationOffsetMode.Automatic)
				{
					offsetableAnnotation2.RenderAnnotation(scene, pointFromLocation2);
				}
				else if (offsetableAnnotation2.Offset.Type == LocationType.RowColumn)
				{
					PrimitiveCollection locationParents3 = GetLocationParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation2.Offset);
					AddAnnotationForAllParents(scene, offsetableAnnotation2, pointFromLocation2, locationParents3);
				}
				else
				{
					Point pointFromLocation3 = GetPointFromLocation(offsetableAnnotation2.Offset);
					offsetableAnnotation2.RenderAnnotation(scene, pointFromLocation2, pointFromLocation3);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				annotation.RenderAnnotation(scene, pointFromLocation2);
			}
		}
	}
