						{
							object d_i3;
							object d_i4;
							if (numericTimeDataPoint != null)
							{
								d_i3 = ((!(advanceAxis is TimeAxis)) ? ((object)j) : ((object)numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue));
								d_i4 = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
							}
							else
							{
								d_i3 = j;
								d_i4 = numericDataPoint.Value;
							}
							int x2 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(d_i3);
							dataPoint2.point.X = x2;
							dataPoint2.point.Y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(d_i4);
						}
						else
						{
							dataPoint2.point = Point.Empty;
						}
						dataPoint2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						object d_i5;
						object d_i6;
						if (numericTimeDataPoint != null)
						{
							d_i5 = ((!(advanceAxis is TimeAxis)) ? ((object)j) : ((object)numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue));
							d_i6 = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
						}
						else
						{
							d_i5 = j;
							d_i6 = numericDataPoint.Value;
						}
						int x3 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(d_i5);
						dataPoint2.point.X = x3;
						dataPoint2.point.Y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(d_i6);
						dataPoint2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
					dataPoint2.Row = i;
					dataPoint2.Column = j;
					dataPoint2.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					dataPoint2.Layer = this;
					object obj5 = null;
					if (j < num - 1)
					{
						obj5 = data.GetObjectValue(i, j + 1);
					}
					dataPoint2.Value = new object[3] { obj4, obj2, obj5 };
					if (flag6)
					{
						primitiveCollection2.Add(dataPoint2);
					}
					if (num == 1)
					{
						DataPoint dataPoint3;
						object d_i7;
						if (numericTimeDataPoint != null)
						{
							dataPoint3 = new DataPoint(Axis.dataToPointLinearPlane(0.0, num, dataMin, dataMax, location, bottomRight, advanceAxis.MapMaximum, numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue));
							_ = advanceAxis.MapMaximum;
							d_i7 = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
						}
						else
						{
							dataPoint3 = new DataPoint(Axis.dataToPointLinearPlane(0.0, num, dataMin, dataMax, location, bottomRight, 1.0, numericDataPoint.Value));
							d_i7 = numericDataPoint.Value;
						}
						primitiveCollection3.Add(dataPoint3);
						dataPoint3.point.X = (int)advanceAxis.MapMaximum;
						dataPoint3.point.Y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(d_i7);
						dataPoint3.Row = i;
						dataPoint3.Column = j;
						dataPoint3.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
						if (numericTimeDataPoint != null)
						{
							object value = (dataPoint3.Value = new object[3] { null, numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue, null });
							dataPoint2.Value = value;
						}
						else
						{
							dataPoint2.Value = new object[3] { null, numericDataPoint.Value, null };
							dataPoint3.Value = new object[3] { null, numericDataPoint.Value, null };
						}
						dataPoint3.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
						dataPoint3.Layer = this;
						primitiveCollection2.Add(dataPoint3);
					}
					bool flag7 = false;
					for (int k = 0; k < areaChartAppearance.ChartText.Count; k++)
					{
						if (!areaChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Match(i, j) || !areaChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Visible)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (areaChartAppearance.ChartText[k].ClipText)
						{
							if (!flag7)
							{
								GraphicsContext graphicsContext2 = new GraphicsContext();
								graphicsContext2.SetClipBounds(new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, 0, outerBounds.Width + outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Height + outerBounds.Y));
								scene.Add(graphicsContext2);
								flag7 = true;
							}
						}
						else if (flag7)
						{
							scene.Add(graphicsContext);
							flag7 = false;
						}
						putText(dataPoint2, scene, areaChartAppearance.ChartText[k]);
					}
					if (flag7)
					{
						scene.Add(graphicsContext);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (advanceAxis is TimeAxis || series is NumericTimeSeries)
					{
						primitiveCollection2 = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection2, typeof(object[]), 2);
						primitiveCollection3 = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection3, typeof(object[]), 2);
					}
					else
					{
						primitiveCollection2 = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection2, typeof(double));
						primitiveCollection3 = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection3, typeof(double));
					}
				}
				bool spline = this is SplineAreaLayer;
				PointsVisibilityFilter pointsVisibilityFilter = new PointsVisibilityFilter((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), advanceAxis, spline);
				DataPoint[] visiblePoints = pointsVisibilityFilter.GetVisiblePoints();
				Polyline polyline = new Polyline(visiblePoints, lineStyle);
				polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = areaChartAppearance.LineThickness;
				polyline.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(areaChartAppearance);
				if (ChartComponent != null && ChartComponent.RenderingType == RenderingType.Svg)
				{
					RenderPointsToScene(areaChartAppearance, primitiveCollection, primitiveCollection2, i, polygon: false, 0, series);
				}
				else
				{
					RenderPointsToScene(areaChartAppearance, scene, primitiveCollection2, i, polygon: false, 0, series);
				}
				int baseLineMapped = GetBaseLineMapped(advanceAxis2);
				RenderPointsToScene(areaChartAppearance, scene, primitiveCollection3, i, polygon: true, baseLineMapped, series);
			}
			if (ChartComponent != null && ChartComponent.RenderingType == RenderingType.Svg)
			{
				scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection.ToArray());
			}
		}

		protected internal override void putText(DataPoint b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance)
		{
			base.putText(b1, scene, chartTextAppearance);
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			if (b1.Value is object[])
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = ((object[])b1.Value)[1];
			}
			else
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			}
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			labelStyle.ClipText = chartTextAppearance.ClipText;
			Text value = new Text(b1.point, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
		}

		private PaintElement GetPolyPE(int row, AreaChartAppearance areaApp)
		{
			return GetPolyPE(row, areaApp, null, null);
		}

		private PaintElement GetPolyPE(int row, AreaChartAppearance areaApp, Primitive prim, ISeries series)
		{
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			byte b = 10;
			byte val = 150;
			PaintElement pE = GetPE(prim, prim.DataPoint, prim.Series, swapRowsAndColumns: true, areaApp);
			pE.FillOpacity = Math.Min(val, pE.FillOpacity);
			byte b2 = (byte)Math.Min(b, pE.FillOpacity - (pE.FillOpacity - b) / rowCount);
			pE.FillOpacity -= b2;
			if (pE.FillOpacity < b)
			{
				pE.FillOpacity = b;
			}
			return pE;
		}

		private PaintElement GetPE(int row, AreaChartAppearance areaApp)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
			Color outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(row, 0, ChartData.GetDataMaxRow(row));
			Color fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(row, 0, ChartData.GetDataMaxRow(row));
			paintElement.Stroke = outlineColor;
			paintElement.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			paintElement.Fill = fillColor;
			paintElement.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			paintElement.StrokeWidth = areaApp.LineThickness;
			return paintElement;
		}

		private Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle GetLineStyle(AreaChartAppearance areaApp)
		{
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(areaApp.LineStartCapStyle, areaApp.LineEndCapStyle, areaApp.LineDrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = areaApp.MidPointAnchors;
			lineStyle.DrawStyle = areaApp.LineDrawStyle;
			lineStyle.EndStyle = areaApp.LineEndCapStyle;
			lineStyle.StartStyle = areaApp.LineStartCapStyle;
			return lineStyle;
		}

		protected virtual void AddPolygonToScene(Polygon oly, int row, bool empty, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			AddPolygonToScene(oly, row, empty, scene, null);
		}

		public virtual PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns, AreaChartAppearance areaApp)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = base.GetPE(prim, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns).Clone();
			paintElement.StrokeWidth = areaApp.LineThickness;
			return paintElement;
		}

		protected virtual void AddPolygonToScene(Polygon oly, int row, bool empty, IList scene, ISeries series)
		{
			AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as AreaChartAppearance;
			int column = (oly.Row = row);
			oly.Column = column;
			if (empty)
			{
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ((areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles == null || areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count <= 0) ? (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance) : areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles[row % areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count]);
				if (EmptyStylesUsed != null && !EmptyStylesUsed.Contains(emptyAppearance) && (emptyAppearance.EnablePoint || emptyAppearance.EnablePE))
				{
					EmptyStylesUsed.Add(emptyAppearance);
				}
				if (emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					oly.PE = emptyAppearance.PE.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					oly.PE = GetPE(oly, null, series, swapRowsAndColumns: false, areaChartAppearance);
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					oly.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle.Clone();
				}
				else if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					oly.lineStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].LineStyle;
				}
				else
				{
					oly.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(areaChartAppearance);
				}
				if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					LineLayer.ApplyCurrentLineStyle(areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count], oly, scene);
				}
				else if (areaChartAppearance is SplineAreaChartAppearance)
				{
					oly.splineTension = ((SplineAreaChartAppearance)areaChartAppearance).SplineTension;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				oly.PE = GetPolyPE(row, areaChartAppearance, oly, oly.Series).Clone();
				oly.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
				oly.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(areaChartAppearance);
			}
			oly.flatBottom = flatBottom;
			oly.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
			if (ChartComponent == null || ChartComponent.RenderingType != RenderingType.Svg)
			{
				oly.Caps |= PCaps.Tooltip;
			}
			oly.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
			oly.Layer = this;
			oly.Path = Path;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
			{
				LineLayer.ApplyCurrentLineStyle(areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count], oly, primitiveCollection);
			}
			else if (areaChartAppearance is SplineAreaChartAppearance)
			{
				oly.splineTension = ((SplineAreaChartAppearance)areaChartAppearance).SplineTension;
			}
			scene.Add(oly);
			foreach (Primitive item in primitiveCollection)
			{
				scene.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddLineToScene(Polyline line, int row, bool empty, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			AddLineToScene(line, row, empty, scene, null);
		}

		protected virtual void AddLineToScene(Polyline line, int row, bool empty, IList scene, ISeries series)
		{
			AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as AreaChartAppearance;
			int column = (line.Row = row);
			line.Column = column;
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ((areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count <= 0) ? (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance) : areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles[row % areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count]);
			if (empty)
			{
				if (!EmptyStylesUsed.Contains(emptyAppearance) && (emptyAppearance.EnablePE || emptyAppearance.EnablePoint))
				{
					EmptyStylesUsed.Add(emptyAppearance);
				}
				if (emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					line.PE = emptyAppearance.PE.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					line.PE = GetPE(line, null, series, swapRowsAndColumns: false);
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					line.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle.Clone();
				}
				else if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					line.lineStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].LineStyle;
				}
				else
				{
					line.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(areaChartAppearance);
				}
				if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					line.splineTension = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].SplineTension;
				}
				else if (areaChartAppearance is SplineAreaChartAppearance)
				{
					line.splineTension = ((SplineAreaChartAppearance)areaChartAppearance).SplineTension;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				for (int i = 0; i < line.points.Length; i++)
				{
					if (line.points[i] != null && line.points[i].Empty)
					{
						DataPoint value = new DataPoint(line.points[i].point);
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				line.PE = GetPE(line, null, series, swapRowsAndColumns: false).Clone();
				if (areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].Thickness;
					line.lineStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].LineStyle;
					line.splineTension = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].SplineTension;
				}
				else
				{
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = areaChartAppearance.LineThickness;
					line.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(areaChartAppearance);
					line.splineTension = splineTension;
				}
			}
			line.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			line.Chart = ChartType.AreaChart;
			line.Path = Path;
			line.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
			line.Layer = this;
			scene.Add(line);
			if (emptyAppearance == null || !emptyAppearance.EnablePoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			DataPoint[] points = line.points;
			foreach (DataPoint dataPoint in points)
			{
				if (dataPoint.Empty)
				{
					primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint);
				}
			}
			PointSet pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
			pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE.Clone();
			scene.Add(pointSet);
		}

		private void RenderPointsToScene(AreaChartAppearance areaApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, bool polygon)
		{
			RenderPointsToScene(areaApp, scene, pointsForLineUnderConstruction, row, polygon, 0);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPointsToScene(AreaChartAppearance areaApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, bool polygon, int baseLineMapped)
		{
			RenderPointsToScene(areaApp, scene, pointsForLineUnderConstruction, row, polygon, baseLineMapped, null);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPointsToScene(AreaChartAppearance areaApp, IList scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, bool polygon, int baseLineMapped, ISeries series)
		{
			if (pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataPoint[] points = (DataPoint[])pointsForLineUnderConstruction.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
			IAdvanceAxis axis = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			bool spline = this is SplineAreaLayer;
			PointsVisibilityFilter pointsVisibilityFilter = new PointsVisibilityFilter(points, axis, spline);
			points = pointsVisibilityFilter.GetVisiblePoints();
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(areaApp.LineStartCapStyle, areaApp.LineEndCapStyle, areaApp.LineDrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = areaApp.MidPointAnchors;
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ((areaApp.EmptyStyles.Count <= 0) ? (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance) : areaApp.EmptyStyles[row % areaApp.EmptyStyles.Count]);
			if (emptyAppearance != null)
			{
				if ((emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle && !polygon) || (emptyAppearance.EnablePE && polygon))
				{
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
					while (num < points.Length)
					{
						PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
						arrayList.Add(primitiveCollection);
						bool empty = points[num].Empty;
						bool flag = false;
						while (!flag)
						{
							flag = num == points.Length - 1 || points[num].Empty != points[num + 1].Empty;
							primitiveCollection.Add(points[num]);
							num++;
						}
						if (empty)
						{
							if (num2 > 0)
							{
								int num3 = pointsForLineUnderConstruction.IndexOf(primitiveCollection[0]) - 1;
								primitiveCollection.Insert(0, points[num3]);
							}
							if (num < points.Length)
							{
								primitiveCollection.Add(points[num]);
							}
						}
						DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[primitiveCollection.Count];
						primitiveCollection.CopyTo(array);
						if (primitiveCollection.Count != 1)
						{
							if (polygon)
							{
								Polygon polygon2 = new Polygon(GetPolygonPoints(array, baseLineMapped));
								polygon2.Series = series;
								AddPolygonToScene(polygon2, row, empty, scene, series);
							}
							else
							{
								Polyline polyline = new Polyline(array);
								polyline.Series = series;
								AddLineToScene(polyline, row, empty, scene, series);
							}
						}
						num2++;
					}
				}
				else if (polygon)
				{
					Polygon polygon3 = new Polygon(GetPolygonPoints(points, baseLineMapped));
					polygon3.Series = series;
					AddPolygonToScene(polygon3, row, empty: false, scene, series);
				}
				else
				{
					Polyline polyline2 = new Polyline(points, lineStyle);
					polyline2.Series = series;
					AddLineToScene(polyline2, row, empty: false, scene, series);
				}
			}
			else if (polygon)
			{
				Polygon polygon4 = new Polygon(GetPolygonPoints(points, baseLineMapped));
				polygon4.Series = series;
				AddPolygonToScene(polygon4, row, empty: false, scene, series);
			}
			else
			{
				Polyline polyline3 = new Polyline(points, lineStyle);
				polyline3.Series = series;
				AddLineToScene(polyline3, row, empty: false, scene, series);
			}
			pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Clear();
		}

		protected virtual DataPoint[] GetPolygonPoints(DataPoint[] points, int baseLineMapped)
		{
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			primitiveCollection.AddRange(points);
			DataPoint dataPoint = primitiveCollection[0] as DataPoint;
			DataPoint dataPoint2 = primitiveCollection[primitiveCollection.Count - 1] as DataPoint;
			if (dataPoint != null && dataPoint2 != null)
			{
				primitiveCollection.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint2.point.X, baseLineMapped));
				primitiveCollection.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint.point.X, baseLineMapped));
			}
			return (DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
		}

		private static ChartType ResolveStackedChartType(ChartLayer layer)
		{
			if (layer.ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				if (layer is LineLayer)
				{
					return ChartType.StackLineChart;
				}
				if (layer is AreaLayer)
				{
					return ChartType.StackAreaChart;
				}
				if (layer is SplineLayer)
				{
					return ChartType.StackSplineChart;
				}
				if (layer is SplineAreaLayer)
				{
					return ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart;
				}
				return layer.ChartCore.ChartType;
			}
			return layer.ChartCore.ChartType;
		}

		internal static void FillSceneGraphStacked(ChartLayer layer, StackStyle stackedType, NullHandling nullHandling, IAdvanceAxis yAxis, IAdvanceAxis xAxis, float splineTension, SceneGraph scene, int strokeWidth, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			IMultiEmptyStyles multiEmptyStyles = layer as IMultiEmptyStyles;
			if (multiEmptyStyles != null && multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed != null)
			{
				multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed.Clear();
			}
			IChartData chartData = layer.GetData();
			int rowCount = chartData.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = chartData.GetColumnCount();
			DataPoint[,] array = new DataPoint[rowCount, columnCount];
			bool[] array2 = new bool[rowCount];
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = chartData as SeriesCollection;
			if (seriesCollection != null && !layer.ValidateSeriesCollectionForStackedChart(seriesCollection))
			{
				layer.DrawInvalidMessage(scene, layer.GetDataInvalidMessage());
			}
			else
			{
				if (rowCount < 1 || columnCount < 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				ChartTypeAppearance chartTypeAppearance = layer.GetAppearance() as ChartTypeAppearance;
				LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance = chartTypeAppearance as LineChartAppearance;
				AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = chartTypeAppearance as AreaChartAppearance;
				LineAppearanceCollection lineAppearanceCollection = null;
				EmptyAppearanceCollection emptyAppearanceCollection = null;
				if (lineChartAppearance != null)
				{
					lineAppearanceCollection = lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances;
					emptyAppearanceCollection = lineChartAppearance.EmptyStyles;
				}
				else if (areaChartAppearance != null)
				{
					lineAppearanceCollection = areaChartAppearance.LineAppearances;
					emptyAppearanceCollection = areaChartAppearance.EmptyStyles;
				}
				bool flag = xAxis is TimeAxis;
				for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
				{
					DataPoint[] array3 = new DataPoint[rowCount];
					for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
					{
						ISeries series = null;
						IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
						NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
						NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = null;
						if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > j)
						{
							series = seriesCollection[j];
							provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
							if (provideDataPoints != null && provideDataPoints.Count > i)
							{
								numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[i] as NumericDataPoint;

		private static PrimitiveCollection BreakUpNullsStacked(DataPoint[] points, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, bool polygon, bool spline)
		{
			bool enablePE = emptyApp.EnablePE;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			if (spline)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection3 = new PrimitiveCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
				{
					primitiveCollection3.Add(points[i]);
					if (!points[i].Empty)
					{
						primitiveCollection2.Add(points[i]);
					}
				}
				Primitive primitive;
				Primitive primitive2;
				if (polygon)
				{
					primitive = new Polygon((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
					primitive2 = new Polygon((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection3.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
				}
				else
				{
					primitive = new Polyline((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
					primitive2 = new Polyline((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection3.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
				}
				primitive2.Empty = true;
				primitive.Empty = false;
				primitiveCollection.Add(primitive2);
				primitiveCollection.Add(primitive);
			}
			else if (polygon)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (num < points.Length / 2)
				{
					int num2 = num;
					bool flag = false;
					bool empty = points[num].Empty;
					PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection4 = new PrimitiveCollection();
					while (!flag)
					{
						primitiveCollection4.Add(points[num]);
						flag = (double)num >= (double)points.Length / 2.0 - 1.0 || (points[num].Empty != points[num + 1].Empty && enablePE);
						num++;
					}
					int num3 = num - 1;
					if (empty)
					{
						if (num > 1 && num2 > 0)
						{
							primitiveCollection4.Insert(0, points[num2 - 1].Clone());
							num2--;
						}
						if ((double)num < (double)points.Length / 2.0 - 1.0)
						{
							num3++;
							primitiveCollection4.Add(points[num].Clone());
						}
					}
					if (primitiveCollection4.Count > 1)
					{
						for (int j = points.Length - 2 - num3; j <= points.Length - 2 - num2; j++)
						{
							primitiveCollection4.Add(points[j]);
						}
						if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < points.Length)
						{
							primitiveCollection4.Add(points[num2]);
						}
						Polygon polygon2 = new Polygon((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection4.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
						polygon2.Empty = empty;
						primitiveCollection.Add(polygon2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = 0;
				while (num4 < points.Length)
				{
					int num5 = num4;
					PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection5 = new PrimitiveCollection();
					bool empty2 = points[num4].Empty;
					bool flag2 = false;
					while (!flag2)
					{
						primitiveCollection5.Add(points[num4]);
						flag2 = num4 == points.Length - 1 || points[num4].Empty != points[num4 + 1].Empty;
						num4++;
					}
					if (empty2)
					{
						if (num4 > 1 && num5 > 0)
						{
							primitiveCollection5.Insert(0, points[num5 - 1].Clone());
							num5--;
						}
						if (num4 < points.Length)
						{
							primitiveCollection5.Add(points[num4].Clone());
						}
					}
					if (primitiveCollection5.Count > 1)
					{
						Polyline polyline = new Polyline((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection5.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
						polyline.Empty = empty2;
						primitiveCollection.Add(polyline);
					}
				}
			}
			return primitiveCollection;
		}

		internal static double GetStackedMaxSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					num2 += data.GetValue(j, i);
				}
				num = Math.Max(num, num2);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double GetStackedMinSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					num2 += data.GetValue(j, i);
				}
				num = Math.Min(num, num2);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int GetBaseLineMapped(IAdvanceAxis Y)
		{
			double num = (double)Y.Minimum;
			double num2 = (double)Y.Maximum;
			if (num < 0.0 && num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				return (int)Y.Map(Y.Maximum);
			}
			if (num < 0.0 && num2 > 0.0)
			{
				return (int)Y.Map(Y.Zero);
			}
			return (int)Y.Map(Y.Minimum);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				if ((!(dataMin >= 0.0) || !(dataMax >= 0.0)) && (!(dataMin <= 0.0) || !(dataMax <= 0.0)))
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}

				if (m_RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					return double.Epsilon;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		private bool IsLayoutPossible(AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, AxisAppearance axisApp, Rectangle bounds, bool hasRotation)
		{
			Font font = ((!labels.ForSeries) ? axisApp.Labels.Font : axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Font);
			if (font == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SizeF stringSizePixels;
			using (Font font2 = new Font(font.FontFamily, 6.5f, font.Style))
			{
				stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("o", font2);
			}
			int num;
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				num = bounds.Height;
				break;
			default:
				num = bounds.Width;
				break;
			}
			float num2 = ((!hasRotation) ? Math.Min(stringSizePixels.Height, stringSizePixels.Width) : Math.Max(stringSizePixels.Height, stringSizePixels.Width));
			return num2 * (float)labels.Count < (float)num;
		}

		private bool IsLayoutNecessary(AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, AxisAppearance axisApp, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				if (labels.Tallest != -1)
				{
					if (bounds.Height >= labels.Tallest * labels.Count)
					{
						return bounds.Width < labels.Widest;
					}
					return true;
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (labels.Widest != -1)
				{
					int num = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
					int num2 = labels.Widest * labels.Count;
					if (ChartLayerAppearance is ColumnChartAppearance columnChartAppearance && labels.Count > 0)
					{
						num2 += (columnChartAppearance.ColumnSpacing * labels.Count - 1) * labels.Widest;
					}
					return num < num2;
				}
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ApplyLayoutBehaviors(AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection effectsToUse, ref Rectangle bounds, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			Rectangle bounds2 = bounds;
			if (labels == null || effectsToUse == null || labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsLayoutPossible(labels, axisApp, bounds, hasRotation: false))
			{
				foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)labels)
				{
					item.TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				bounds = new Rectangle(bounds.Location, Size.Empty);
				return;
			}
			new DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior().Apply(bounds, this, axisApp, labels, out bounds);
			if (axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior == AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.Auto && !IsLayoutNecessary(labels, axisApp, bounds))
			{
				new DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior().Apply(bounds2, this, axisApp, labels, out bounds);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			foreach (AxisLabelLayoutBehavior item2 in (IEnumerable)effectsToUse)
			{
				if (!item2.Enabled)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag3 = flag2 && (!flag || (labels != null && (labels.FindCollisions() || labels.FindTextOverflow())));
				if (!flag3)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					else if (item2.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!item2.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions || flag3)
				{
					AxisLabelInfoCollection oldVersion = labels.Clone() as AxisLabelInfoCollection;
					flag = item2.Apply(bounds, this, axisApp, labels, out var boundsUsed);
					flag2 = true;
					if (flag)
					{
						bounds = boundsUsed;
					}
					else if (item2.EnableRollback)
					{
						labels.RollbackTo(oldVersion);
					}
				}
			}
			new DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior().Apply(bounds2, this, axisApp, labels, out bounds);
		}

		private void ApplyRotationLayoutBehaviors(AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection effectsToUse, ref Rectangle bounds, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			if (labels == null || labels.Count == 0 || effectsToUse == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsLayoutPossible(labels, axisApp, bounds, hasRotation: true))
			{
				foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)labels)
				{
					item.TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				bounds = new Rectangle(bounds.Location, Size.Empty);
				return;
			}
			DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior = new DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior();
			defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior.Apply(bounds, this, axisApp, labels, out bounds);
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			foreach (AxisLabelLayoutBehavior item2 in (IEnumerable)effectsToUse)
			{
				if (!item2.Enabled)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag3 = flag2 && (!flag || (labels != null && (labels.FindCollisions() || labels.FindTextOverflow())));
				if (!flag3)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					else if (item2.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!item2.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions || flag3)
				{
					AxisLabelInfoCollection oldVersion = labels.Clone() as AxisLabelInfoCollection;
					flag = item2.Apply(bounds, this, axisApp, labels, out var boundsUsed);
					flag2 = true;
					if (flag)
					{
						bounds = boundsUsed;
					}
					else if (item2.EnableRollback)
					{
						labels.RollbackTo(oldVersion);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyLayoutBehaviors(Rectangle bounds, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection seriesLabels)
		{
			ChartType chartType = ChartCore.ChartType;
			if (chartType == ChartType.RadarChart || chartType == ChartType.PolarChart)
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection effectsToUse = null;
			SplitBounds(bounds, axisNumber, itemLabels, seriesLabels, out var itemLabelBounds, out var seriesLabelBounds, axisApp);
			if (axisApp.Labels.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && axisApp.Labels.OrientationAngle % 90 != 0)
			{
				if (axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior != AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None)
				{
					effectsToUse = axisApp.Labels.Layout.BehaviorCollection;
				}
				ApplyRotationLayoutBehaviors(itemLabels, effectsToUse, ref itemLabelBounds, axisApp);
			}
			else if (axisApp.Labels.Visible)
			{
				if (itemLabelBounds.Width < 0 || itemLabelBounds.Height < 0)
				{
					itemLabelBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					seriesLabelBounds = bounds;
				}
				ApplyLayoutBehaviors(itemLabels, axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior switch
				{
					AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.UseCollection => (axisApp.Labels.Layout.BehaviorCollection.Count != 0) ? axisApp.Labels.Layout.BehaviorCollection : AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.GetDefaultCollection(axisApp.Labels), 
					AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None => null, 
					_ => AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.GetDefaultCollection(axisApp.Labels), 
				}, ref itemLabelBounds, axisApp);
				if (itemLabelBounds != Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					seriesLabelBounds = axisNumber switch
					{
						AxisNumber.X_Axis => new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.Left, itemLabelBounds.Bottom + axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding + axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Width, bounds.Height - itemLabelBounds.Height - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding - axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding), 
						AxisNumber.X2_Axis => new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.Left, seriesLabelBounds.Top, seriesLabelBounds.Width, bounds.Height - itemLabelBounds.Height - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding), 
						AxisNumber.Y_Axis => new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.Left, seriesLabelBounds.Top, bounds.Width - itemLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding - axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Height), 
						AxisNumber.Y2_Axis => new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.Left + itemLabelBounds.Width + axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Top, bounds.Width - itemLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Height), 
						_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unrecognized AxisNumber in Axis"), 
					};
				}
			}
			AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection effectsToUse2;
			if (axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.OrientationAngle % 90 != 0)
			{
				effectsToUse2 = null;
			}
			else
			{
				effectsToUse2 = axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Behavior switch
				{
					AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.UseCollection => (axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.BehaviorCollection.Count != 0) ? axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.BehaviorCollection : AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.GetDefaultCollection(axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels), 
					AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None => (axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior != AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.Auto) ? null : AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.GetDefaultCollection(axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels), 
					_ => AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.GetDefaultCollection(axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels), 
				};
				if (seriesLabelBounds.Height < 0 || seriesLabelBounds.Width < 0)
				{
					seriesLabelBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}
			ApplyLayoutBehaviors(seriesLabels, effectsToUse2, ref seriesLabelBounds, axisApp);
		}

		protected virtual double GetSeriesLabelSpanRatio(bool vertical, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection seriesLabels, Rectangle bounds, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			if (seriesLabels == null || seriesLabels.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (itemLabels == null || itemLabels.Count == 0)
			{
				return 2.0;
			}
			if (axisApp.Labels.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && axisApp.Labels.OrientationAngle % 90 != 0 && axisApp.Labels.OrientationAngle > 15 && axisApp.Labels.OrientationAngle < 165)
			{
				return 2.0;
			}
			SizeF maxLabelSize = itemLabels.GetMaxLabelSize();
			SizeF maxLabelSize2 = seriesLabels.GetMaxLabelSize();
			double num;
			double num2;
			if (vertical)
			{
				num = (double)(maxLabelSize.Width / (float)bounds.Width) * 2.0;
				num2 = (double)(maxLabelSize2.Width / (float)bounds.Width) * 2.0;
			}
			else
			{
				num = (double)(maxLabelSize.Height / (float)bounds.Height) * 2.0;
				num2 = (double)(maxLabelSize2.Height / (float)bounds.Height) * 2.0;
			}
			double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, 2.0 - (num + num2));
			if (vertical)
			{
				return Math.Min(num2, (double)maxLabelSize2.Width / (double)maxLabelSize.Width) + num3 / 2.0;
			}
			return Math.Min(num2, (double)maxLabelSize2.Height / (double)maxLabelSize.Height) + num3 / 2.0;
		}

		protected virtual void SplitBounds(Rectangle originalBounds, AxisNumber axisNumber, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection seriesLabels, out Rectangle itemLabelBounds, out Rectangle seriesLabelBounds, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			if (itemLabels != null && itemLabels.Count > 0 && axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior == AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None)
			{
				int num = int.MaxValue;
				int num2 = int.MaxValue;
				int num3 = int.MinValue;
				int num4 = int.MinValue;
				foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)itemLabels)
				{
					if (item.TextPrimitive != null)
					{
						Rectangle actualBounds = item.TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
						num = Math.Min(num, actualBounds.Left);
						num2 = Math.Min(num2, actualBounds.Top);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, actualBounds.Right);
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, actualBounds.Bottom);
					}
				}
				itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(num, num2, num4 - num, num3 - num2);
				seriesLabelBounds = Rectangle.Round(Geometry.RectangleExclude(originalBounds, itemLabelBounds));
			}
			else if (seriesLabels != null && seriesLabels.Count > 0 && axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Behavior == AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None && axisApp.Labels.Layout.Behavior != AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.Auto)
			{
				int num5 = int.MaxValue;
				int num6 = int.MaxValue;
				int num7 = int.MinValue;
				int num8 = int.MinValue;
				foreach (AxisLabelInfo item2 in (IEnumerable)seriesLabels)
				{
					if (item2.TextPrimitive != null)
					{
						Rectangle actualBounds2 = item2.TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
						num5 = Math.Min(num5, actualBounds2.Left);
						num6 = Math.Min(num6, actualBounds2.Top);
						num8 = Math.Max(num8, actualBounds2.Right);
						num7 = Math.Max(num7, actualBounds2.Bottom);
					}
				}
				seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(num5, num6, num8 - num5, num7 - num6);
				itemLabelBounds = Rectangle.Round(Geometry.RectangleExclude(originalBounds, seriesLabelBounds));
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y_Axis || axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y2_Axis;
				double seriesLabelSpanRatio = GetSeriesLabelSpanRatio(flag, itemLabels, seriesLabels, originalBounds, axisApp);
				int num9 = ((!flag) ? ((int)((double)(originalBounds.Height / 2) * seriesLabelSpanRatio)) : ((int)((double)(originalBounds.Width / 2) * seriesLabelSpanRatio)));
				switch (axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top, originalBounds.Width, originalBounds.Height - num9);
					seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top + itemLabelBounds.Height, originalBounds.Width, num9);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top + num9, originalBounds.Width, originalBounds.Height - num9);
					seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top, originalBounds.Width, num9);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left + num9, originalBounds.Top, originalBounds.Width - num9, originalBounds.Height);
					seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top, num9, originalBounds.Height);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left, originalBounds.Top, originalBounds.Width - num9, originalBounds.Height);
					seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(originalBounds.Left + itemLabelBounds.Width, originalBounds.Top, num9, originalBounds.Height);
					break;
				default:
					itemLabelBounds = (seriesLabelBounds = Rectangle.Empty);
					break;
				}
			}
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(itemLabelBounds.X, itemLabelBounds.Y + axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, itemLabelBounds.Width, itemLabelBounds.Height - -axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding);
				seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.X, seriesLabelBounds.Y + axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Width, seriesLabelBounds.Height - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding);
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(itemLabelBounds.X, itemLabelBounds.Y, itemLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, itemLabelBounds.Height);
				seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.X, seriesLabelBounds.Y, seriesLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Height);
				break;
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(itemLabelBounds.X, itemLabelBounds.Y, itemLabelBounds.Width, itemLabelBounds.Height - -axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding);
				seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.X, seriesLabelBounds.Y, seriesLabelBounds.Width, seriesLabelBounds.Height - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding);
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				itemLabelBounds = new Rectangle(itemLabelBounds.X + axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, itemLabelBounds.Y, itemLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding, itemLabelBounds.Height);
				seriesLabelBounds = new Rectangle(seriesLabelBounds.X + axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Y, seriesLabelBounds.Width - axisApp.Labels.SeriesLabels.Layout.Padding, seriesLabelBounds.Height);
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int GetScrollbarSpan(AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				return axisApp.ScrollScale.Width;
			default:
				return axisApp.ScrollScale.Height;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int GetCorrectLabelBoundsWidth(int scrollbarSize, int originalWidth)
		{
			return originalWidth;
		}

		protected virtual Rectangle GetLabelBounds(int scrollbarSize)
		{
			int num;
			int y;
			int height;
			int originalWidth;
			switch (AxisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				num = startPoint.X;
				y = startPoint.Y + scrollbarSize;
				originalWidth = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
				height = innerBounds.Bottom - startPoint.Y - scrollbarSize;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				num = startPoint.X;
				y = innerBounds.Top - scrollbarSize;
				originalWidth = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
				height = startPoint.Y - innerBounds.Top - scrollbarSize;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				num = innerBounds.Left;
				y = endPoint.Y;
				originalWidth = startPoint.X - scrollbarSize - num;
				height = startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				num = startPoint.X + scrollbarSize;
				y = endPoint.Y;
				originalWidth = innerBounds.Right - startPoint.X - scrollbarSize;
				height = startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y;
				break;
			default:
				y = (num = (height = (originalWidth = 0)));
				break;
			}
			originalWidth = GetCorrectLabelBoundsWidth(scrollbarSize, originalWidth);
			AxisNumber axisNumber = AxisNumber;
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis || axisNumber == AxisNumber.X2_Axis)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(startPoint.X - OuterBound.Left, OuterBound.Right - endPoint.X);
				num -= num2;
				originalWidth += 2 * num2;
			}
			return new Rectangle(num, y, originalWidth, height);
		}

		public virtual object Add(object addendum, object addendee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(addendum) + NumericOf(addendee));
		}

		public virtual object Subtract(object subtractum, object subtractee)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(subtractum) - NumericOf(subtractee));
		}

		public virtual object Divide(object dividend, object divisor)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(dividend) / NumericOf(divisor));
		}

		public virtual object Multiply(object multiplicand, object multiplier)
		{
			return InverseNumericOf(NumericOf(multiplicand) * NumericOf(multiplier));
		}

		public virtual object Max(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) > NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public virtual object Min(object left, object right)
		{
			if (NumericOf(left) < NumericOf(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			return right;
		}

		public virtual object NullValue(object input)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public abstract double NumericOf(object d_i);

		public abstract object InverseNumericOf(double d_i);

		public virtual int Compare(object obj1, object obj2)
		{
			if (NumericOf(obj1) < NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (NumericOf(obj1) > NumericOf(obj2))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected Axis(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			this.axisNumber = axisNumber;
			MajorLabelStyle.Font = DefaultConstants.D_LabelFont;
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
			{
				return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			}
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y2_Axis)
			{
				return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			}
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X2_Axis)
			{
				return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
		}

		public int GetExtent()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				widthOrHeight = axisAppearance.Extent;
			}
			return widthOrHeight;
		}

		public void SetExtent(int worh)
		{
			widthOrHeight = worh;
		}

		protected virtual void RetrieveAppearanceProperties()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				LogZero = axisAppearance.LogZero;
				widthOrHeight = axisAppearance.Extent;
				if (axisAppearance.Visible)
				{
					addStyle(1048576);
				}
				else
				{
					removeStyle(1048576);
				}
				lineThickness = axisAppearance.LineThickness;
				lineColor = axisAppearance.LineColor;
				lineStyle.EndStyle = axisAppearance.LineEndCapStyle;
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.LineDrawStyle;
				setStyle(256, axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Visible);
				majorGridLineColor = Color.FromArgb(axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Color);
				majorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.DrawStyle;
				majorGridLineThickness = axisAppearance.MajorGridLines.Thickness;
				setStyle(512, axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Visible);
				minorGridLineColor = Color.FromArgb(axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.AlphaLevel, axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Color);
				minorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle = axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.DrawStyle;
				minorGridLineThickness = axisAppearance.MinorGridLines.Thickness;
				itemLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
				seriesLabelFormat = axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString;
				if (!(MainChartLayer is RadarLayer) && !ForRadarLayer)
				{
					setStyle(262144, axisAppearance.Labels.Visible);
					setStyle(524288, axisAppearance.Labels.Visible);
				}
				tickInterval = axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval;
				tickPercentage = axisAppearance.TickmarkPercentage;
				switch (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle)
				{
				case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
				case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
					addStyle(8);
					removeStyle(16);
					removeStyle(4);
					break;
				case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
					addStyle(4);
					removeStyle(8);
					removeStyle(16);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void FillSceneGraphTime(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			IsTimeAxis = true;
			WorkerFillSceneGraph(scene);
			IsTimeAxis = false;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (scene == ChartCore.ScrollScene && ((ChartCore.ScrollType == 0 && axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y_Axis) || (ChartCore.ScrollType == 1 && axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)))
			{
				AxisRangeType rangeType = RangeType;
				if (rangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
					Maximum = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
					Minimum = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				WorkerFillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
		}

		private void FixTheAlignmentForHorizontalOrientation()
		{
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				switch (MajorLabelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					break;
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					break;
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				switch (MajorLabelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					break;
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					break;
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					MajorLabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void RenderAxisLine(SceneGraph scene, Point axisLineStart, Point axisLineEnd)
		{
			this.axisLineStart = axisLineStart;
			this.axisLineEnd = axisLineEnd;
			RenderAxisLine(scene);
		}

		private void RenderAxisLine(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance { Visible: false })
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x100000) > 0)
			{
				AxisLinePrimitive = new Line(axisLineStart, axisLineEnd);
				AxisLinePrimitive.lineStyle = lineStyle;
				AxisLinePrimitive.PE.Stroke = lineColor;
				AxisLinePrimitive.PE.StrokeOpacity = lineColor.A;
				if (lineVisible)
				{
					AxisLinePrimitive.PE.StrokeWidth = lineThickness;
				}
				else
				{
					AxisLinePrimitive.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
				}
				AxisLinePrimitive.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(AxisLinePrimitive);
			}
			delayAxisLineRender = false;
		}

		public void WorkerFillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			RetrieveAppearanceProperties();
			if (!delayAxisLineRender && scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene)
			{
				RenderAxisLine(scene);
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			Scale = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scale;
			Scroll = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scroll;
			if (!IsTimeAxis)
			{
				RangeType = axisAppearance.RangeType;
				RangeMax = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
				RangeMin = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
				AxisRangeType rangeType = RangeType;
				if (rangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					Maximum = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
					Minimum = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RangeType = axisAppearance.RangeType;
				RangeMax = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance.RangeMax);
				RangeMin = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance.RangeMin);
				AxisRangeType rangeType2 = RangeType;
				if (rangeType2 == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					Maximum = RangeMax;
					Minimum = RangeMin;
				}
			}
			RulerType = axisAppearance.NumericAxisType;
			LabelDx = 0;
			LabelDy = 0;
			switch (ChartCore.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.RadarChart:
				Scale = 1.0;
				m_ShowScrollbar = false;
				break;
			case ChartType.Composite:
				if ((axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis && MajorLabelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing) || MajorLabelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing)
				{
					LabelDy = 4;
				}
				break;
			default:
				switch (axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					LabelDy = 4;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					LabelDx = -4;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					LabelDy = -4;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					LabelDx = 4;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (mOffsetLabels || (m_ShowScrollbar && axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Visible))
			{
				switch (axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					LabelDy += axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Height;
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
					num = (LabelDx += -axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Width);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					num2 = (LabelDy += -axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Height);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					LabelDx += axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Width;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (m_ShowScrollbar && axisAppearance.Visible && axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Visible)
			{
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.ScrollBar chartScrollBar = MainChartLayer.ChartCore.ChartScrollBar;
				chartScrollBar.Layer = this;
				PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
				paintElement.Fill = Color.Black;
				PaintElement arrowPE = (chartScrollBar.PlusPE = paintElement);
				chartScrollBar.ArrowPE = arrowPE;
				chartScrollBar.Path = Path + ".ScrollBar";
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
				{
					chartScrollBar.Thickness = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					chartScrollBar.Thickness = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Width;
				}
				chartScrollBar.Enabled = true;
				chartScrollBar.Minimum = 0f;
				chartScrollBar.Maximum = 1f;
				chartScrollBar.Orientation = (drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0;
				if (chartScrollBar.Orientation)
				{
					chartScrollBar.P1 = new PointF(startPoint.X + num, (float)MapMinimum + (float)num2);
					chartScrollBar.P2 = new PointF(endPoint.X + num, (float)MapMaximum + (float)num2);
				}
				else
				{
					chartScrollBar.P1 = new PointF((float)MapMinimum + (float)num, startPoint.Y + num2);
					chartScrollBar.P2 = new PointF((float)MapMaximum + (float)num, endPoint.Y + num2);
				}
				double num3 = (Scale = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scale);
				chartScrollBar.Scale = (float)num3;
				double num4 = (Scroll = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scroll);
				chartScrollBar.Scroll = (float)num4;
				chartScrollBar.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			ValidateDataForChart();
			if (!dataIsValid && !(ChartData is SeriesCollection))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("Exception_invalid_data_for_log_20073"));
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				if (Minimum is DateTime && Maximum is DateTime)
				{
					dataIsValid = (DateTime)Minimum >= DateTime.MinValue && (DateTime)Maximum <= DateTime.MaxValue;
				}
				else
				{
					dataIsValid = (double)Maximum > 0.0 && (double)Minimum > 0.0;
				}
				if (RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					dataIsValid = (double)RangeMax > 0.0 && (double)RangeMin > 0.0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetStartAndEndPoints()
		{
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0)
			{
				axisLineStart = new Point(axisLineStart.X, (int)MapMinimum);
				axisLineEnd = new Point(axisLineEnd.X, (int)MapMaximum);
			}
			else
			{
				axisLineStart = new Point((int)MapMinimum, axisLineStart.Y);
				axisLineEnd = new Point((int)MapMaximum, axisLineEnd.Y);
			}
		}

		public static Point dataToPointLinearPlane(double dataHorzMin, double dataHorzMax, double dataVertMin, double dataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v)
		{
			Point result = default(Point);
			Point point = new Point(leftTop.X, bottomRight.Y);
			Point p = bottomRight;
			Point p2 = point;
			Point p3 = leftTop;
			result.X = dataToPointLinearHorizontal(dataHorzMin, dataHorzMax, point, p, d_h).X;
			result.Y = dataToPointLinearVertical(dataVertMin, dataVertMax, p2, p3, d_v).Y;
			return result;
		}

		public static double dataToLogVert(double logBase, double dataMin, double dataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			double num = Math.Log(dataMin, logBase);
			double num2 = Math.Log(dataMax, logBase);
			double num3 = num2 - num;
			double num4 = Math.Log(d_i, logBase);
			return (double)Math.Min(p1.Y, p2.Y) + (double)Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y) * ((num4 - num) / num3);
		}

		public static double dataToLogHorz(double logBase, double dataMin, double dataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			double num = Math.Log(dataMin, logBase);
			double num2 = Math.Log(dataMax, logBase);
			double num3 = num2 - num;
			double num4 = Math.Log(d_i, logBase);
			return (double)Math.Min(p1.X, p2.X) + (double)Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X) * ((num4 - num) / num3);
		}

		public static Point dataToPointLinearVertical(double dataMin, double dataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = p1.X,
				Y = p1.Y - (int)((double)Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y) * (d_i - dataMin) / Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin))
			};
		}

		public static Point dataToPointLinearHorizontal(double dataMin, double dataMax, Point p1, Point p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = p1.X + (int)((double)Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X) * (d_i - dataMin) / Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin)),
				Y = p1.Y
			};
		}

		public static PointF dataToPointLinearPlaneF(double dataHorzMin, double dataHorzMax, double dataVertMin, double dataVertMax, Point leftTop, Point bottomRight, double d_h, double d_v)
		{
			PointF result = default(PointF);
			PointF pointF = new PointF(leftTop.X, bottomRight.Y);
			PointF p = bottomRight;
			PointF p2 = pointF;
			PointF p3 = leftTop;
			result.X = dataToPointLinearHorizontalF(dataHorzMin, dataHorzMax, pointF, p, d_h).X;
			result.Y = dataToPointLinearVerticalF(dataVertMin, dataVertMax, p2, p3, d_v).Y;
			return result;
		}

		public static PointF dataToPointLinearVerticalF(double dataMin, double dataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new PointF
			{
				X = p1.X,
				Y = p1.Y - (float)((double)Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y) * (d_i - dataMin) / Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin))
			};
		}

		public static PointF dataToPointLinearHorizontalF(double dataMin, double dataMax, PointF p1, PointF p2, double d_i)
		{
			return new PointF
			{
				X = p1.X + (float)((double)Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X) * (d_i - dataMin) / Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin)),
				Y = p1.Y
			};
		}

		public static double dataToDoubleLinear(double dataMin, double dataMax, double p1, double p2, double d_i)
		{
			return Math.Abs(p2 - p1) * Math.Abs(d_i - dataMin) / Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin);
		}
