		public static double dataToAngleLinear(double dataMin, double dataMax, double thetaMin, double thetaMax, double d_i)
		{
			return (thetaMax - thetaMin) * (d_i / (dataMax - dataMin));
		}

		public static int setDataItemLinear(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i)
		{
			double num = setDataItemWidth(itemCount, inSetCount, interSeriesSpacing, interBarSpacing, totalWidth);
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)(item_i / inSetCount));
			double num3 = (double)(interSeriesSpacing * num2 + interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1) * num2 + item_i) * num;
			int num4 = item_i % inSetCount;
			double num5 = num * (double)interBarSpacing * (double)num4;
			return (int)(num3 + num5);
		}

		public static int setDataSetLinear(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth, int item_i)
		{
			double num = setDataItemWidth(itemCount, inSetCount, interSeriesSpacing, interBarSpacing, totalWidth);
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)(item_i / inSetCount));
			double num3 = (double)(interSeriesSpacing * num2 + interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1) * num2 + item_i) * num;
			return (int)num3;
		}

		public static double setDataItemWidth(int itemCount, int inSetCount, int interSeriesSpacing, int interBarSpacing, int totalWidth)
		{
			if (inSetCount == 0)
			{
				inSetCount = 1;
			}
			double num = itemCount / inSetCount;
			double num2 = (double)interSeriesSpacing * (num - 1.0) + (double)(interBarSpacing * (inSetCount - 1)) * num + (double)itemCount;
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			return (double)totalWidth / num2;
		}

		public static float dateDataDateLinear(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, float totalWidth, DateTime d_i)
		{
			long ticks = startDate.Ticks;
			long ticks2 = endDate.Ticks;
			long ticks3 = d_i.Ticks;
			long num = ticks2 - ticks;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			return (float)(ticks3 - ticks) * totalWidth / (float)num;
		}

		public static Color Data2ColorLinear(Color startColor, Color endColor, double DataMax, double DataMin, double val)
		{
			if (startColor.Equals(endColor) || DataMax == DataMin)
			{
				return startColor;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((endColor.R - startColor.R) * (endColor.R - startColor.R) + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * (endColor.G - startColor.G) + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * (endColor.B - startColor.B)));
			double num2 = (val - DataMin) / (DataMax - DataMin);
			int num3 = (int)((double)num * num2);
			int num4 = startColor.R + num3 * (endColor.R - startColor.R) / num;
			int num5 = startColor.G + num3 * (endColor.G - startColor.G) / num;
			int num6 = startColor.B + num3 * (endColor.B - startColor.B) / num;
			num4 = ((num4 > 255) ? 255 : num4);
			num5 = ((num5 > 255) ? 255 : num5);
			num6 = ((num6 > 255) ? 255 : num6);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			num5 = ((num5 >= 0) ? num5 : 0);
			num6 = ((num6 >= 0) ? num6 : 0);
			return Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, num4, num5, num6);
		}

		protected virtual void MajorLineAt(IList scene, double d_x, string minorFmt, string majorFmt)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(d_x))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = Map(d_x);
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
			{
				Point point = new Point(0, 0);
				point.X = (int)num;
				point.Y = startPoint.Y - 2;
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0)
				{
					Point p = new Point(point.X, span_1);
					Point p2 = new Point(point.X, span_2);
					Line line = new Line(p, p2);
					line.lineStyle = majorGridLineStyle;
					line.PE.Stroke = majorGridLineColor;
					line.PE.StrokeOpacity = majorGridLineColor.A;
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = majorGridLineThickness;
					line.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x40000) > 0)
				{
					Text text = new Text(new Point(point.X + LabelDx, point.Y + LabelDy), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, majorFmt), MajorLabelStyle);
					text.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(text);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Point point2 = new Point(0, 0);
				point2.Y = (int)num;
				point2.X = startPoint.X - 2;
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0)
				{
					Point p3 = new Point(span_1, point2.Y);
					Point p4 = new Point(span_2, point2.Y);
					Line line2 = new Line(p3, p4);
					line2.lineStyle = majorGridLineStyle;
					line2.PE.Stroke = majorGridLineColor;
					line2.PE.StrokeOpacity = majorGridLineColor.A;
					line2.PE.StrokeWidth = majorGridLineThickness;
					line2.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line2);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x40000) > 0)
				{
					Text text2 = new Text(new Point(point2.X + LabelDx, point2.Y + LabelDy), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, majorFmt), MajorLabelStyle);
					text2.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(text2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void MinorLineAt(IList scene, double d_x, string minorFmt, string majorFmt)
		{
			double num = Map(d_x);
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0 && num <= MapMaximum)
			{
				Point point = new Point(0, 0);
				point.X = (int)num;
				point.Y = startPoint.Y - 2;
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0)
				{
					Point p = new Point(point.X, point.Y - minorTickWidth);
					Point p2 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + minorTickWidth);
					Line line = new Line(p, p2);
					line.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0)
				{
					Point p3 = new Point(point.X, span_1);
					Point p4 = new Point(point.X, span_2);
					Line line2 = new Line(p3, p4);
					line2.lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
					line2.PE.Stroke = minorGridLineColor;
					line2.PE.StrokeOpacity = minorGridLineColor.A;
					line2.PE.StrokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
					line2.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line2);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x80000) > 0)
				{
					Text text = new Text(new Point(point.X + LabelDx, point.Y + LabelDy), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, minorFmt), MajorLabelStyle);
					text.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(text);
				}
			}
			else if (num >= MapMaximum)
			{
				Point point2 = new Point(0, 0);
				point2.Y = (int)num;
				point2.X = startPoint.X - 2;
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0)
				{
					Point p5 = new Point(point2.X - minorTickWidth, point2.Y);
					Point p6 = new Point(point2.X + minorTickWidth, point2.Y);
					Line line3 = new Line(p5, p6);
					line3.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line3);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0)
				{
					Point p7 = new Point(span_1, point2.Y);
					Point p8 = new Point(span_2, point2.Y);
					Line line4 = new Line(p7, p8);
					line4.lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
					line4.PE.Stroke = minorGridLineColor;
					line4.PE.StrokeOpacity = minorGridLineColor.A;
					line4.PE.StrokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
					line4.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line4);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x80000) > 0)
				{
					Text text2 = new Text(new Point(point2.X + LabelDx, point2.Y + LabelDy), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, minorFmt), MajorLabelStyle);
					text2.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(text2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class BarLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		private StackStyle stackStyle;

		protected override PrimitiveCollection InterpolatePrimitives(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type)
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				return ColumnLayer.InterpolatePrimitivesStacked(this, primitives, type, base.NullHandling);
			}
			return base.InterpolatePrimitives(primitives, type);
		}

		public BarLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Bar);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				return string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_1030"), "Bar");
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1008");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				FillSceneGraphStacked(scene);
			}
			else
			{
				FillSceneGraphRegularAdvance(scene);
			}
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphRegularAdvance(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			BarChartAppearance barChartAppearance = (BarChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			base.NullHandling = barChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			int seriesSpacing = barChartAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			int barSpacing = barChartAppearance.BarSpacing;
			object obj = null;
			int num = 0;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				ISeries series = null;
				IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					series = seriesCollection[i];
					provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
				}
				obj = null;
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				bool flag = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					Core.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = j;
					Core.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = i;
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
					if (provideDataPoints != null)
					{
						numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[j] as NumericDataPoint;
						if (numericDataPoint != null)
						{
							if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
							{
								obj = null;
								switch (base.NullHandling)
								{
								case NullHandling.Zero:
									base.EmptyValues = true;
									numericDataPoint.Value = 0.0;
									break;
								case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
								case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
									flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
									break;
								case NullHandling.DontPlot:
									continue;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								obj = numericDataPoint.Value;
							}
						}
					}
					int num2 = i * columnCount + j;
					if (advanceAxis2.ItemVisible(num2 + 1 + num) || advanceAxis2.ItemVisible(num2 + num))
					{
						int num3 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis2.Map((double)(num2 + num)));
						int num4 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis2.Map((double)(num2 + num + 1)));
						if (numericDataPoint == null)
						{
							numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
							obj = data.GetObjectValue(i, j);
							numericDataPoint.Label = data.GetColumnLabel(j) as string;
							numericDataPoint.Value = 0.0;
							if (obj == null)
							{
								numericDataPoint.Empty = true;
								switch (base.NullHandling)
								{
								case NullHandling.Zero:
									base.EmptyValues = true;
									numericDataPoint.Value = 0.0;
									break;
								case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
								case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
									flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
									break;
								case NullHandling.DontPlot:
									continue;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								numericDataPoint.Value = data.GetValue(i, j);
							}
						}
						int num5 = Convert.ToInt32(MathFunctions.GetBoundedValue(advanceAxis.MapMinimum, advanceAxis.MapMaximum, Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero))));
						int num6 = Convert.ToInt32(MathFunctions.GetBoundedValue(advanceAxis.MapMinimum, advanceAxis.MapMaximum, Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map(numericDataPoint.Value))));
						Box box = null;
						box = ((num6 <= num5) ? new Box(new Rectangle(num6, num4, num5 - num6, num3 - num4)) : new Box(new Rectangle(num5, num4, num6 - num5, num3 - num4)));
						box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
						box.Series = series;
						if (obj == null)
						{
							box.Empty = true;
							box.Value = null;
							box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						}
						else
						{
							box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
							box.Value = numericDataPoint.Value;
						}
						box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
						box.Row = i;
						box.Column = j;
						box.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
						box.Layer = this;
						if (useMinMax)
						{
							if (minValue <= numericDataPoint.Value && maxValue >= numericDataPoint.Value)
							{
								primitiveCollection.Add(box);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							primitiveCollection.Add(box);
						}
						for (int k = 0; k < barChartAppearance.ChartText.Count; k++)
						{
							if (barChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Match(i, j) && barChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Visible)
							{
								putText(box, primitiveCollection, barChartAppearance.ChartText[k], stacked: false);
							}
						}
					}
					if (j != columnCount - 1)
					{
						num += barSpacing;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					primitiveCollection = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection, typeof(double));
				}
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
				foreach (Primitive item in primitiveCollection)
				{
					if (!(item is Box box2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (emptyAppearance != null && box2.Empty)
					{
						if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
						{
							box2.PE = emptyAppearance.PE;
						}
						else
						{
							box2.PE = GetBoxPE(box2);
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
						{
							box2.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle;
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.PointStyle != null && emptyAppearance.EnablePoint)
						{
							int x = ((!((double)box2.rect.Left < Math.Floor(advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero)))) ? box2.rect.Right : box2.rect.Left);
							DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(x, box2.rect.Top + box2.rect.Height / 2);
							PointSet pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
							pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
							scene.Add(pointSet);
						}
						box2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						box2.PE = GetBoxPE(box2);
						box2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
				}
				scene.AddRange((Primitive[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(Primitive)));
				num += seriesSpacing;
			}
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphStacked(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			BarChartAppearance barChartAppearance = (BarChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			StackAppearance stackAppearance = (StackAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Stack);
			stackStyle = stackAppearance.StackStyle;
			base.NullHandling = barChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			if (rowCount == 0 || columnCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int barSpacing = barChartAppearance.BarSpacing;
			int num = rowCount + (rowCount - 1) * barSpacing;
			switch (advanceAxis2.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				advanceAxis2.Maximum = num;
				advanceAxis2.Minimum = advanceAxis2.Zero;
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				if (advanceAxis2.RangeMin is double)
				{
					num3 = (int)(double)advanceAxis2.RangeMin;
				}
				else if (advanceAxis2.RangeMin is int)
				{
					num3 = (int)advanceAxis2.RangeMin;
				}
				while (num3 > rowCount)
				{
					num2++;
					num3 -= rowCount;
				}
				int num4 = rowCount - 1;
				int num5 = 0;
				if (advanceAxis2.RangeMax is double)
				{
					num5 = (int)(double)advanceAxis2.RangeMax;
				}
				else if (advanceAxis2.RangeMax is int)
				{
					num5 = (int)advanceAxis2.RangeMax;
				}
				while (num5 > rowCount)
				{
					num4++;
					num5 -= rowCount;
				}
				int num6 = barChartAppearance.BarSpacing * (num4 - num2);
				num6 += num4 - num2 + 1;
				advanceAxis2.Maximum = num6;
				advanceAxis2.Minimum = advanceAxis2.Zero;
				break;
			}
			}
			int num7 = 0;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				ISeries series = null;
				IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					series = seriesCollection[i];
					provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
				}
				object obj = advanceAxis.Zero;
				object obj2 = advanceAxis.Zero;
				double num8 = 1.0;
				double num9 = 1.0;
				bool flag = dataMin < 0.0 && dataMax > 0.0;
				if (stackStyle == StackStyle.Complete)
				{
					double num10 = Math.Abs((double)advanceAxis.Maximum - (double)advanceAxis.Minimum);
					double num11 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(ColumnLayer._getPositiveStackForRow(data, i)), Math.Abs(ColumnLayer._getNegativeStackForRow(data, i)));
					num8 = num10 / num11;
					num9 = num8;
					if (flag)
					{
						double num12 = Math.Abs(Math.Max((double)advanceAxis.Minimum, (double)advanceAxis.Maximum));
						advanceAxis.Minimum = 0.0 - num12;
						advanceAxis.Maximum = num12;
						num8 = (double)advanceAxis.Maximum / ColumnLayer._getPositiveStackForRow(data, i);
						num9 = (double)advanceAxis.Minimum / ColumnLayer._getNegativeStackForRow(data, i);
					}
				}
				int num13 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(num - i - num7);
				int num14 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(num - i - num7 - 1);
				int height = num14 - num13;
				if (dataMax > 0.0)
				{
					int num15 = (int)advanceAxis.MapMinimum;
				}
				else
				{
					int num15 = (int)advanceAxis.MapMaximum;
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
					if (provideDataPoints != null)
					{
						numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[j] as NumericDataPoint;
					}
					if (numericDataPoint == null)
					{
						numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint.Value = data.GetValue(i, j);
						object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(i, j);
						numericDataPoint.Empty = objectValue == null;
					}
					else
					{
						_ = numericDataPoint.Value;
					}
					if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						switch (base.NullHandling)
						{
						case NullHandling.Zero:
							base.EmptyValues = true;
							break;
						case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
						case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
							flag2 = (base.EmptyValues = true);
							break;
						}
					}
					object obj3;
					int num16;
					int num15;
					if (numericDataPoint.Value > 0.0)
					{
						obj3 = advanceAxis.Add(obj, numericDataPoint.Value);
						num16 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Multiply(obj, num8));
						num15 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Multiply(obj3, num8));
						obj = obj3;
					}
					else
					{
						obj3 = advanceAxis.Add(obj2, numericDataPoint.Value);
						num15 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Multiply(obj2, num9));
						num16 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Multiply(obj3, num9));
						obj2 = obj3;
					}
					Box box = new Box(new Point(num16, num13), num15 - num16, height);
					if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						box.Empty = true;
						box.Value = null;
						box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						box.Value = obj3;
						box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
					box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
					box.Series = series;
					box.Row = i;
					box.Column = j;
					box.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					box.Layer = this;
					box.Path = Path;
					box.AccumulatedElementsValue = ColumnLayer.getStackedValueForColumnSeries(data, i);
					box.Layer = this;
					primitiveCollection.Add(box);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					primitiveCollection = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection, typeof(double));
				}
				IEnumerator enumerator = primitiveCollection.GetEnumerator();
				if (useMinMax)
				{
					if (advanceAxis.Compare(minValue, obj2) <= 0 && advanceAxis.Compare(maxValue, obj) >= 0)
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							Box value = (Box)enumerator.Current;
							scene.Add(value);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						Box box2 = (Box)enumerator.Current;
						scene.Add(box2);
						for (int k = 0; k < barChartAppearance.ChartText.Count; k++)
						{
							if (barChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Match(box2.Row, box2.Column) && barChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Visible)
							{
								putText(box2, scene, barChartAppearance.ChartText[k], stacked: true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
				foreach (Box item in primitiveCollection)
				{
					if (emptyAppearance != null && item.Empty && base.NullHandling != NullHandling.DontPlot)
					{
						if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
						{
							item.PE = emptyAppearance.PE;
						}
						else
						{
							item.PE = GetBoxPE(item);
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
						{
							item.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle;
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.PointStyle != null && emptyAppearance.EnablePoint)
						{
							int x = ((!(item.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2)) ? item.rect.Right : ((!(numericDataPoint2.Value >= 0.0)) ? item.rect.Left : item.rect.Right));
							DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(x, item.rect.Top + item.rect.Height / 2);
							PointSet pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
							pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
							scene.Add(pointSet);
						}
						item.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						item.PE = GetBoxPE(item);
						item.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
				}
				primitiveCollection.Clear();
				num7 += barSpacing;
			}
		}

		private PaintElement GetBoxPE(Box box)
		{
			return GetPE(box, box.DataPoint, box.Series);
		}

		private void putText(Box b1, IList scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance, bool stacked)
		{
			int x = 0;
			int y = 0;
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				if (b1.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_ITEM"] = numericDataPoint.Value;
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			int num = (int)Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont).Width;
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			labelStyle.ClipText = chartTextAppearance.ClipText;
			Text value;
			if (stacked)
			{
				value = new Text(b1.rect, text, labelStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				BarChartAppearance barChartAppearance = (BarChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2 = b1.DataPoint as NumericDataPoint;
				bool flag = true;
				switch (barChartAppearance.ChartTextValueAlignment)
				{
				case ValueAlignment.Negative:
					flag = false;
					break;
				case ValueAlignment.PositiveAndNegative:
					if (numericDataPoint2 != null && numericDataPoint2.Value < 0.0)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					switch (chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign)
					{
					case StringAlignment.Near:
						x = Math.Max(b1.rect.X + b1.rect.Width - num - 1, 0);
						break;
					case StringAlignment.Center:
						x = Math.Max(b1.rect.X + b1.rect.Width, 0);
						break;
					case StringAlignment.Far:
						x = Math.Max(b1.rect.X + b1.rect.Width, 0) + num + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					x = Math.Max(b1.rect.X, 0);
				}
				switch (chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					y = b1.rect.Y;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					y = b1.rect.Y + b1.rect.Height / 2;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					y = b1.rect.Y + b1.rect.Height;
					break;
				}
				Point pos = new Point(x, y);
				value = new Text(pos, text, labelStyle);
			}
			scene.Add(value);
		}
	}
	public class BorderLayer : Layer
	{
		private Color backgroundColor = DefaultConstants.D_TitleLayerBackgroundColor;

		private Color borderColor = Color.Navy;

		private Image backgroundImage;

		private ImageFitStyle image_fit_style = ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit;

		private PaintElement _PE;

		public ImageFitStyle BackgroundImageStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return image_fit_style;
			}
			set
			{
				image_fit_style = value;
			}
		}

		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _PE;
			}
			set
			{
				_PE = value;
			}
		}

		public Color GetBackgroundColor()
		{
			return backgroundColor;
		}

		public void SetBackgroundColor(Color color)
		{
			backgroundColor = color;
		}

		public Color GetBorderColor()
		{
			return borderColor;
		}

		public void SetBorderColor(Color color)
		{
			borderColor = color;
		}

		public Image GetBackgroundImage()
		{
			return backgroundImage;
		}

		public void SetBackgroundImage(Image backImage)
		{
			backgroundImage = backImage;
		}

		public BorderLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Border);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			BorderAppearance borderAppearance = (BorderAppearance)GetAppearance();
			int num = borderAppearance.Thickness / 2;
			Box box = new Box(new Point(outerBounds.X + num, outerBounds.Y + num), outerBounds.Width - borderAppearance.Thickness, outerBounds.Height - borderAppearance.Thickness);
			if (PE == null)
			{
				box.PE.Fill = backgroundColor;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = backgroundColor.A;
				box.lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			}
			else
			{
				box.PE = PE.Clone();
			}
			box.Roundness = borderAppearance.CornerRadius;
			box.lineStyle.DrawStyle = borderAppearance.DrawStyle;
			box.PE.StrokeWidth = borderAppearance.Thickness;
			box.PE.Stroke = borderAppearance.Color;
			box.PE.StrokeOpacity = borderAppearance.Color.A;
			box.Path = Path;
			if (borderAppearance.Raised)
			{
				box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				box.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Raise;
			}
			if (backgroundImage != null)
			{
				box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Image;
				box.PE.FillImage = backgroundImage;
				box.PE.ImageFitStyle = BackgroundImageStyle;
				box.PE.ImageWrapMode = WrapMode.Tile;
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = backgroundColor.R > 128 || backgroundColor.G > 128 || backgroundColor.B > 128;
				Color fill = ((!borderAppearance.Raised) ? backgroundColor : ((!flag) ? MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(backgroundColor, 40) : MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(backgroundColor, -40)));
				box.PE = box.PE.Clone();
				box.PE.Fill = fill;
			}
			scene.Add(box);
		}

		protected override void CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			BorderAppearance borderAppearance = (BorderAppearance)GetAppearance();
			innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + borderAppearance.Thickness, outerBounds.Y + borderAppearance.Thickness, outerBounds.Width - borderAppearance.Thickness * 2, outerBounds.Height - borderAppearance.Thickness * 2);
			int num = Math.Min(Math.Min(innerBounds.Width, innerBounds.Height) / 3, borderAppearance.CornerRadius);
			int num2 = (int)((double)num / (Math.Sqrt(2.0) * 2.0));
			if (borderAppearance.CornerRadius > 0 && num > 3)
			{
				innerBounds.Inflate(-num2, -num2);
			}
			num2 = (int)((double)Math.Min(innerBounds.Width, innerBounds.Height) * 0.01);
			if (borderAppearance.Raised)
			{
				innerBounds.Inflate(-num2, -num2);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BoxChartLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			_ = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			BoxChartAppearance boxChartAppearance = (BoxChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			BoxSetSeries boxSetSeries = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is BoxSetSeries)
					{
						boxSetSeries = (BoxSetSeries)item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (boxSetSeries == null)
			{
				if (data.GetColumnCount() < 5)
				{
					return;
				}
				boxSetSeries = new BoxSetSeries();
				if (ChartData != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < ChartData.GetRowCount(); i++)
					{
						BoxSet value = new BoxSet(ChartData.GetRowLabel(i).ToString(), ChartData.GetValue(i, 0), ChartData.GetValue(i, 1), ChartData.GetValue(i, 2), ChartData.GetValue(i, 3), ChartData.GetValue(i, 4));
						boxSetSeries.BoxSets.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			Rectangle outerBound = OuterBound;
			double num = double.MinValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (BoxSet boxSet3 in boxSetSeries.BoxSets)
			{
				if (num < boxSet3.Max)
				{
					num = boxSet3.Max;
				}
				if (boxSet3.Min < num2)
				{
					num2 = boxSet3.Min;
				}
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) < 1E-323)
			{
				num = num2 + 1.0;
			}
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = base.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			if (boxSetSeries.BoxSets.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = outerBound.Bottom;
				_ = axisAppearance.Extent;
				int num3 = (int)((advanceAxis2.Map(2.0) - advanceAxis2.Map(1.0)) * boxChartAppearance.BoxWidthFactor);
				int num4 = num3 / 2;
				for (int j = 0; j < boxSetSeries.BoxSets.Count; j++)
				{
					BoxSet boxSet2 = boxSetSeries.BoxSets[j];
					int num5 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map((double)j + 0.5);
					int num6 = num5 - num4;
					int val = (int)advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Q3);
					int y = (int)advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Q2);
					int val2 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Q1);
					int height = (int)Math.Abs(advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Q1) - advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Q3));
					int y2 = Math.Min(val2, val);
					Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(num6, y2, num3, height);
					Box box = new Box(rect);
					int column = (box.Row = j);
					box.Column = column;
					box.DataPoint = boxSet2;
					box.Series = boxSetSeries;
					box.Layer = this;
					box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					box.PE = GetPE(box, box.DataPoint, box.Series);
					box.Value = new double[5] { boxSet2.Min, boxSet2.Q1, boxSet2.Q2, boxSet2.Q3, boxSet2.Max };
					box.Chart = ChartType.BoxChart;
					scene.Add(box);
					int y3 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Max);
					int y4 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(boxSet2.Min);
					int x = num6 + num3;
					Line line = new Line(new Point(num6, y3), new Point(x, y3));
					line.PE = boxSet2.PE;
					line.Layer = this;
					scene.Add(line);
					Line line2 = new Line(new Point(num6, y), new Point(x, y));
					line2.PE = boxSet2.PE;
					line2.lineStyle.DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Dash;
					line2.Layer = this;
					scene.Add(line2);
					Line line3 = new Line(new Point(num6, y4), new Point(x, y4));
					line3.PE = boxSet2.PE;
					line3.Layer = this;
					scene.Add(line3);
					Line line4 = new Line(new Point(num5, y3), new Point(num5, y4));
					line4.PE = boxSet2.PE;
					line4.Layer = this;
					scene.Add(line4);
				}
			}
		}

		public BoxChartLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is BoxSetSeries && ((BoxSetSeries)item).BoxSets.Count > 0)
					{
						dataIsValid = true;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			dataIsValid = dataIsValid && data.GetColumnCount() > 4 && data.GetRowCount() > 0;
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance chartAppearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (chartAppearance == null)
			{
				chartAppearance = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.BoxChart);
			}
			return chartAppearance;
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_20061_1");
		}
	}
	public class XYChartLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		public XYChartLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (data == null)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if (data is SeriesCollection)
				{
					return;
				}
				int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
				IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = data as IChartDataFilter;
				ScatterChartAppearance scatterChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as ScatterChartAppearance;
				BubbleChartAppearance bubbleChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as BubbleChartAppearance;
				if (chartDataFilter != null)
				{
					int filteredColumnNumber;
					int filteredColumnNumber2;
					int num;
					if (scatterChartAppearance != null)
					{
						filteredColumnNumber = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(scatterChartAppearance.ColumnX);
						filteredColumnNumber2 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(scatterChartAppearance.ColumnY);
						num = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						filteredColumnNumber = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnX);
						filteredColumnNumber2 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnY);
						num = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnZ);
					}
					if (filteredColumnNumber >= columnCount || filteredColumnNumber2 >= columnCount || num >= columnCount || filteredColumnNumber == -1 || filteredColumnNumber2 == -1 || num == -1)
					{
						dataIsValid = false;
					}
				}
				else if (scatterChartAppearance != null)
				{
					if (data.IsColumnNumeric(0, scatterChartAppearance.ColumnX) && data.IsColumnNumeric(0, scatterChartAppearance.ColumnY))
					{
						dataIsValid = true;
					}
					else
					{
						dataIsValid = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					int num2 = 0;
					dataIsValid = false;
					if (data.GetRowCount() <= 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					int columnCount2 = data.GetColumnCount();
					for (int i = 0; i < columnCount2; i++)
					{
						if (data.IsColumnNumeric(i))
						{
							num2++;
							if (num2 == 3)
							{
								dataIsValid = true;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void SetupDataFilter()
		{
			base.SetupDataFilter();
			if (!(data is IChartDataFilter))
			{
				return;
			}
			ScatterChartAppearance scatterChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as ScatterChartAppearance;
			BubbleChartAppearance bubbleChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as BubbleChartAppearance;
			int num;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (scatterChartAppearance != null)
			{
				num = scatterChartAppearance.ColumnX;
				num2 = scatterChartAppearance.ColumnY;
				num3 = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnX;
				num2 = bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnY;
				num3 = bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnZ;
			}
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = (IChartDataFilter)data;
			if (chartDataFilter.GetSwapRowsAndColumns())
			{
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num))
				{
					num = chartDataFilter.GetRealRowNumber(num);
				}
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num2))
				{
					num2 = chartDataFilter.GetRealRowNumber(num2);
				}
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num3))
				{
					num3 = chartDataFilter.GetRealRowNumber(num3);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num))
				{
					num = chartDataFilter.GetRealColumnNumber(num);
				}
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num2))
				{
					num2 = chartDataFilter.GetRealColumnNumber(num2);
				}
				if (!chartDataFilter.IsColumnIncluded(num3))
				{
					num3 = chartDataFilter.GetRealColumnNumber(num3);
				}
			}
			if (scatterChartAppearance != null)
			{
				scatterChartAppearance.columnXVar = num;
				scatterChartAppearance.columnYVar = num2;
			}
			else if (bubbleChartAppearance != null)
			{
				bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnX = num;
				bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnY = num2;
				bubbleChartAppearance.ColumnZ = num3;
			}
		}
	}
	public class BubbleLayer : XYChartLayer
	{
		internal class RadiusKey : IComparable
		{
			private delegate int CompareDeleg(object other);

			private CompareDeleg doComparison;

			private double myRadius;

			private int myBubbleID;

			private Queue myAdornments;

			internal int BubbleID => myBubbleID;

			internal double Radius => myRadius;

			internal Queue Adornments => myAdornments;

			private int ResultToCompare(double rawDifference)
			{
				if (rawDifference > 0.0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (rawDifference < 0.0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}

			private int CompareDescending(object other)
			{
				double rawDifference = 0.0;
				if (other is RadiusKey radiusKey)
				{
					rawDifference = radiusKey.Radius - myRadius;
				}
				return ResultToCompare(rawDifference);
			}

			private int CompareAscending(object other)
			{
				double rawDifference = 0.0;
				if (other is RadiusKey radiusKey)
				{
					rawDifference = myRadius - radiusKey.Radius;
				}
				return ResultToCompare(rawDifference);
			}

			public int CompareTo(object other)
			{
				return doComparison(other);
			}

			internal RadiusKey(double zValue, int indexOfBubble, ChartSortType sortDirection)
			{
				myRadius = zValue;
				myBubbleID = indexOfBubble;
				myAdornments = new Queue();
				switch (sortDirection)
				{
				case ChartSortType.Ascending:
					doComparison = CompareAscending;
					break;
				case ChartSortType.Descending:
					doComparison = CompareDescending;
					break;
				default:
					doComparison = CompareDescending;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private ChartTextAppearance unmatchableChartTextAppearance;

		private ArrayList sortedKeys;

		private ArrayList sortedBubbles;

		private Queue labelQueue;

		public virtual PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns, int seriesNumber)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = GetPE(prim, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns, allowFromColorModel: false);
			if (paintElement == null && prim != null)
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (prim.Value != null)
				{
					double.TryParse(prim.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
				}
				Color fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(seriesNumber, seriesNumber, result);
				Color outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(seriesNumber, seriesNumber, result);
				PaintElement paintElement2 = new PaintElement();
				paintElement2.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
				paintElement2.Fill = fillColor;
				paintElement2.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
				paintElement2.Stroke = outlineColor;
				paintElement2.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
				return paintElement2;
			}
			if (paintElement == null)
			{
				paintElement = new PaintElement();
			}
			return paintElement;
		}

		public BubbleLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			unmatchableChartTextAppearance = new ChartTextAppearance(component, int.MinValue, 0, visiblePara: false, DefaultConstants.D_ChartTextFont, Color.Black, string.Empty, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Center, 0);
			labelQueue = new Queue();
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Bubble);
		}

		public override void SetupDataFilter()
		{
			base.SetupDataFilter();
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is XYZSeries && item.GetPoints().Count > 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!ColorCueColumnIsValid())
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			string result = SR.GetString("SR_1009");
			if (!ColorCueColumnIsValid())
			{
				result = SR.GetString("SR_1035");
			}
			return result;
		}

		private BubbleChartAppearance GetBubbleAppearance()
		{
			return GetAppearance() as BubbleChartAppearance;
		}

		private int GetRealColorCueColumn()
		{
			return ((IChartDataFilter)data).GetFilteredColumnNumber(GetBubbleAppearance().ColorCueColumn);
		}

		private bool ColorCueColumnIsValid()
		{
			if (GetBubbleAppearance().ColorCueColumn > -1)
			{
				return GetRealColorCueColumn() > -1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitSortedBubbles(int rowCount, ChartSortType direction)
		{
			if (sortedBubbles != null)
			{
				sortedBubbles.Clear();
				sortedKeys.Clear();
			}
			if (direction != ChartSortType.None)
			{
				sortedBubbles = new ArrayList(rowCount);
				sortedKeys = new ArrayList(rowCount);
			}
			else
			{
				sortedBubbles = null;
				sortedKeys = null;
			}
		}

		private void AddSortedBubble(PrimitiveShape bubble, double radius, ref ChartTextAppearance nextChartText, Point textDrawPoint, ChartSortType direction, BubbleChartAppearance bubbleApp)
		{
			sortedBubbles.Add(bubble);
			RadiusKey radiusKey = new RadiusKey(radius, sortedBubbles.Count - 1, direction);
			while (nextChartText.Row == bubble.Row)
			{
				radiusKey.Adornments.Enqueue(nextChartText);
				radiusKey.Adornments.Enqueue(textDrawPoint);
				nextChartText = GetNextChartText(labelQueue);
			}
			foreach (ChartTextAppearance item in bubbleApp.ChartText)
			{
				if (item.Row == -2)
				{
					radiusKey.Adornments.Enqueue(nextChartText);
					radiusKey.Adornments.Enqueue(textDrawPoint);
				}
			}
			sortedKeys.Add(radiusKey);
		}

		private void AddToSceneGraph(PrimitiveCollection bubbles, PrimitiveCollection chartTextPrimitives, PrimitiveShape bubble, double radius, Point textDrawPoint, ref ChartTextAppearance nextChartText, ChartSortType direction, BubbleChartAppearance bubbleApp)
		{
			if (direction == ChartSortType.None)
			{
				bubbles.Add(bubble);
				for (int i = 0; i < bubbleApp.ChartText.Count; i++)
				{
					if (bubbleApp.ChartText[i].Match(bubble.Row, bubble.Column) && bubbleApp.ChartText[i].Visible)
					{
						putText(bubble, chartTextPrimitives, bubbleApp.ChartText[i], textDrawPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AddSortedBubble(bubble, radius, ref nextChartText, textDrawPoint, direction, bubbleApp);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDeferredPrimitives(PrimitiveCollection bubbles, PrimitiveCollection chartTextPrimitives)
		{
			ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance = unmatchableChartTextAppearance;
			Point point = default(Point);
			if (sortedBubbles == null || sortedBubbles.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			sortedKeys.Sort();
			foreach (object sortedKey in sortedKeys)
			{
				try
				{
					int bubbleID = (sortedKey as RadiusKey).BubbleID;
					PrimitiveShape primitiveShape = (PrimitiveShape)sortedBubbles[bubbleID];
					bubbles.Add(primitiveShape);
					while ((sortedKey as RadiusKey).Adornments.Count >= 2)
					{
						try
						{
							chartTextAppearance = (ChartTextAppearance)(sortedKey as RadiusKey).Adornments.Dequeue();
							point = (Point)(sortedKey as RadiusKey).Adornments.Dequeue();
							putText(primitiveShape, chartTextPrimitives, chartTextAppearance, point);
						}
						catch (InvalidCastException)
						{
							(sortedKey as RadiusKey).Adornments.Clear();
						}
					}
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private Queue GetSortedChartTextQueue(ChartTextCollection collection)
		{
			int count = collection.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(collection);
				arrayList.Sort();
				return new Queue(arrayList);
			}
			return new Queue();
		}

		private ChartTextAppearance GetNextChartText(Queue sortedChartTextQ)
		{
			ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance = unmatchableChartTextAppearance;
			if (sortedChartTextQ.Count > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					chartTextAppearance = sortedChartTextQ.Dequeue() as ChartTextAppearance;
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
				if (!chartTextAppearance.Visible)
				{
					chartTextAppearance = unmatchableChartTextAppearance;
					sortedChartTextQ.Clear();
				}
			}
			return chartTextAppearance;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			BubbleChartAppearance bubbleChartAppearance = (BubbleChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;

		private void putText(PrimitiveShape b1, PrimitiveCollection chartTextPrimitives, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance, Point textDrawPoint)
		{
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = b1.Column;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = b1.Row;
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			itemFormatString = DrawBubbleSpecificToolTips(itemFormatString, (object[])b1.Value);
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.ClipText = chartTextAppearance.ClipText;
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Text p = new Text(textDrawPoint, text, labelStyle);
			chartTextPrimitives.Add(p);
		}

		private string DrawBubbleSpecificToolTips(string toolTipFormatString, object[] x)
		{
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = x[0];
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = x[1];
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_RADIUS"] = x[2];
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = x[2];
			return toolTipFormatString;
		}

		internal static PrimitiveShape GetShape(BubbleShape shape, int radius, Point center)
		{
			PrimitiveShape primitiveShape;
			switch (shape)
			{
			case BubbleShape.Triangle:
			case BubbleShape.InvertedTriangle:
				primitiveShape = new Polygon(new Point[0]);
				break;
			case BubbleShape.Square:
				primitiveShape = new Box(Rectangle.Empty);
				break;
			default:
				primitiveShape = new Ellipse();
				break;
			}
			FixShape(primitiveShape, shape, radius, center);
			return primitiveShape;
		}

		internal static Point GetCenter(PrimitiveShape existingPrimitive, BubbleShape shape)
		{
			switch (shape)
			{
			case BubbleShape.InvertedTriangle:
				if (existingPrimitive is Polygon polygon2 && polygon2.Points.Length == 3)
				{
					return new Point(polygon2.Points[0].X, polygon2.Points[0].Y - GetRadius(existingPrimitive, shape));
				}
				break;
			case BubbleShape.Triangle:
				if (existingPrimitive is Polygon polygon && polygon.Points.Length == 3)
				{
					return new Point(polygon.Points[0].X, polygon.Points[0].Y + GetRadius(existingPrimitive, shape));
				}
				break;
			case BubbleShape.Square:
				if (existingPrimitive is Box box)
				{
					return new Point(box.rect.Left + box.rect.Width / 2, box.rect.Top + box.rect.Height / 2);
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (existingPrimitive is Ellipse ellipse)
				{
					return ellipse.GetCenterPoint();
				}
				break;
			}
			return Point.Empty;
		}

		internal static int GetRadius(PrimitiveShape existingPrimitive, BubbleShape shape)
		{
			switch (shape)
			{
			case BubbleShape.Triangle:
			case BubbleShape.InvertedTriangle:
				if (existingPrimitive is Polygon polygon && polygon.Points.Length == 3)
				{
					return Math.Abs(polygon.Points[0].Y - polygon.Points[1].Y) / 2;
				}
				break;
			case BubbleShape.Square:
				if (existingPrimitive is Box box)
				{
					return box.rect.Width / 2;
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (existingPrimitive is Ellipse ellipse)
				{
					return ellipse.p2.X / 2;
				}
				break;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal static void FixShape(PrimitiveShape existingPrimitive, BubbleShape shape, int radius, Point center)
		{
			if (existingPrimitive == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point[] array = new Point[3];
			switch (shape)
			{
			case BubbleShape.InvertedTriangle:
			{
				double num = center.Y + 2 * radius - (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(Math.PI * 5.0 / 6.0));
				num /= Math.Sqrt(2.0);
				ref Point reference4 = ref array[0];
				reference4 = new Point(center.X, center.Y + 2 * radius - (int)num);
				ref Point reference5 = ref array[1];
				reference5 = new Point((int)((double)center.X + (double)radius * Math.Cos(Math.PI / 6.0)), (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(Math.PI / 6.0)) - (int)num);
				ref Point reference6 = ref array[2];
				reference6 = new Point((int)((double)center.X + (double)radius * Math.Cos(Math.PI * 5.0 / 6.0)), (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(Math.PI * 5.0 / 6.0)) - (int)num);
				if (existingPrimitive is Polygon)
				{
					((Polygon)existingPrimitive).Points = array;
				}
				break;
			}
			case BubbleShape.Triangle:
			{
				double num = center.Y - 2 * radius - (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(3.665191429188092));
				num /= Math.Sqrt(2.0);
				ref Point reference = ref array[0];
				reference = new Point(center.X, center.Y - 2 * radius - (int)num);
				ref Point reference2 = ref array[1];
				reference2 = new Point((int)((double)center.X + (double)radius * Math.Cos(-Math.PI / 6.0)), (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(-Math.PI / 6.0)) - (int)num);
				ref Point reference3 = ref array[2];
				reference3 = new Point((int)((double)center.X + (double)radius * Math.Cos(3.665191429188092)), (int)((double)center.Y + (double)radius * Math.Sin(3.665191429188092)) - (int)num);
				if (existingPrimitive is Polygon)
				{
					((Polygon)existingPrimitive).Points = array;
				}
				break;
			}
			case BubbleShape.Square:
				if (existingPrimitive is Box)
				{
					((Box)existingPrimitive).rect = new Rectangle(new Point(center.X - radius, center.Y - radius), new Size(radius * 2, radius * 2));
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (existingPrimitive is Ellipse ellipse)
				{
					ellipse.p1 = new Point(center.X - radius, center.Y - radius);
					ellipse.p2 = new Point(radius * 2, radius * 2);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private double GetDataValue(object objectValue, ref bool unresolvedNulls, int row, int column, ref bool resumeNext)
		{
			if (objectValue == null)
			{
				switch (base.NullHandling)
				{
				case NullHandling.DontPlot:
					resumeNext = true;
					return double.NegativeInfinity;
				case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
				case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
					base.EmptyValues = (unresolvedNulls = true);
					return 0.0;
				default:
					base.EmptyValues = true;
					return 0.0;
				}
			}
			return data.GetValue(row, column);
		}
	}
	public class CandleLayer : ChartLayer
	{

			: base(component, core)

		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Candle);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CandleChartAppearance candleChartAppearance = (CandleChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			if (seriesCollection == null)
			{
				Math.Min(Math.Min(data.GetDataMinColumn(1), data.GetDataMinColumn(2)), Math.Min(data.GetDataMinColumn(3), data.GetDataMinColumn(4)));
				Math.Max(Math.Max(data.GetDataMaxColumn(1), data.GetDataMaxColumn(2)), Math.Max(data.GetDataMaxColumn(3), data.GetDataMaxColumn(4)));
			}
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis3 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y2"];
			if (candleChartAppearance.VolumeVisible)
			{
				if (seriesCollection == null)
				{
					data.GetDataMinColumn(5);
					data.GetDataMaxColumn(5);
				}
				AxisRangeType rangeType = advanceAxis3.RangeType;
				if (rangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					advanceAxis3.Maximum = advanceAxis3.RangeMax;
					advanceAxis3.Minimum = advanceAxis3.RangeMin;
				}
			}
			AxisRangeType rangeType2 = advanceAxis2.RangeType;
			if (rangeType2 == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				advanceAxis2.Maximum = advanceAxis2.RangeMax;
				advanceAxis2.Minimum = advanceAxis2.RangeMin;
			}
			switch (advanceAxis.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				if (seriesCollection == null)
				{
					advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.Zero;
					advanceAxis.Maximum = data.GetRowCount();
				}
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				advanceAxis.Maximum = advanceAxis.RangeMax;
				advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.RangeMin;
				break;
			}
			CandleSeries candleSeries = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is CandleSeries)
					{
						candleSeries = (CandleSeries)item;
						if (advanceAxis.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
						{
							advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.Zero;
							advanceAxis.Maximum = candleSeries.Points.Count;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (candleSeries == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			int num = candleSeries?.Points.Count ?? data.GetRowCount();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!advanceAxis.ItemVisible(i - 1) && !advanceAxis.ItemVisible(i + 1))
				{
					continue;
				}
				CandleDataPoint candleDataPoint = null;
				if (candleSeries != null)
				{
					candleDataPoint = candleSeries.Points[i];
				}
				if (candleDataPoint == null)
				{
					if (data.GetColumnCount() < 6)
					{
						continue;
					}
					candleDataPoint = new CandleDataPoint();
					candleDataPoint.Open = data.GetValue(i, 1);
					candleDataPoint.High = data.GetValue(i, 2);
					candleDataPoint.Low = data.GetValue(i, 3);
					candleDataPoint.Close = data.GetValue(i, 4);
					candleDataPoint.Volume = data.GetValue(i, 5);
				}
				int num2 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(candleDataPoint.Open);
				int num3 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(candleDataPoint.Close);
				int num4 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(i);
				int num5 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(i + 1);
				int num6 = Math.Abs(num2 - num3);
				if (num6 == 0)
				{
					num6 = 1;
				}
				if (candleChartAppearance.VolumeVisible)
				{
					int num7 = (int)advanceAxis3.Map(candleDataPoint.Volume);
					int num8 = (int)advanceAxis3.Map(advanceAxis3.WindowMinimum);
					Box box = new Box(new Rectangle(num4, num7, Math.Abs(num5 - num4), Math.Abs(num7 - num8)));
					box.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					box.Layer = this;
					box.DataPoint = candleDataPoint;
					box.Series = candleSeries;
					byte alpha = ChartColorModel.GetAlpha();
					Color outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(0, 0, 0.0);
					Color fill = Color.FromArgb(alpha, candleChartAppearance.VolumeColor);
					box.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
					box.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
					box.PE.Fill = fill;
					box.PE.FillOpacity = fill.A;
					box.PE.FillOpacity = alpha;
					box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					box.Row = i;
					box.Column = 5;
					box.Value = candleDataPoint.Volume;
					scene.Add(box);
				}
				if (candleChartAppearance.OpenCloseVisible)
				{
					byte alpha2 = ChartColorModel.GetAlpha();
					Box box2;
					if (candleDataPoint.Close > candleDataPoint.Open)
					{
						box2 = new Box(new Point(num4, num3), num5 - num4, num6);
						box2.PE.Fill = candleChartAppearance.PositiveRangeColor;
						box2.PE.FillOpacity = alpha2;
					}
					else
					{
						box2 = new Box(new Point(num4, num2), num5 - num4, num6);
						box2.PE.Fill = candleChartAppearance.NegativeRangeColor;
						box2.PE.FillOpacity = alpha2;
					}
					box2.DataPoint = candleDataPoint;
					box2.Series = candleSeries;
					box2.PE.FillOpacity = alpha2;
					Color outlineColor2 = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(0, 0, 0.0);
					box2.PE.Stroke = outlineColor2;
					box2.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor2.A;
					box2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					box2.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					box2.Layer = this;
					box2.Row = i;
					box2.Column = 4;
					box2.Value = candleDataPoint.Close;
					primitiveCollection.Add(box2);
				}
				if (candleChartAppearance.HighLowVisible)
				{
					Point p = new Point((num4 + num5) / 2, (int)advanceAxis2.Map(candleDataPoint.High));
					Point p2 = new Point((num4 + num5) / 2, (int)advanceAxis2.Map(candleDataPoint.Low));
					Line line = new Line(p, p2);
					line.DataPoint = candleDataPoint;
					line.PE.StrokeOpacity = ChartColorModel.GetAlpha();
					line.PE.Stroke = candleChartAppearance.WickColor;
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = candleChartAppearance.WickThickness;
					line.Caps = PCaps.None;
					line.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					line.Layer = this;
					line.Row = i;
					line.Column = 2;
					line.Value = "high: " + candleDataPoint.High.ToString("###0.00") + "low: " + candleDataPoint.Low.ToString("###0.00");
					line.Path = Path;
					primitiveCollection2.Add(line);
				}
			}
			if (candleChartAppearance.WicksInForeground)
			{
				scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection.ToArray());
				scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection2.ToArray());
			}
			else
			{
				scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection2.ToArray());
				scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection.ToArray());
			}
		}

		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			CandleChartAppearance candleChartAppearance = (CandleChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			double dataMin = Math.Min(Math.Min(data.GetDataMinColumn(1), data.GetDataMinColumn(2)), Math.Min(data.GetDataMinColumn(3), data.GetDataMinColumn(4)));

				double value = data.GetValue(i, 1);
				double value2 = data.GetValue(i, 4);

					num2 = Math.Abs(topLeft2.Y - topLeft.Y);

						num2 = 1.0;
					}
					box = new Box(topLeft, num / 2, (int)num2);
					box.PE.Fill = candleChartAppearance.NegativeRangeColor;
					box.PE.FillOpacity = alpha;

				box.PE.FillOpacity = alpha;
				Color outlineColor = ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(0, 0, 0.0);

				box.Column = 1;
				if (candleChartAppearance.VolumeVisible)
				{
					double value3 = data.GetValue(i, 5);
					Point topLeft3 = Axis.dataToPointLinearVertical(dataMinColumn, dataMaxColumn, p, p2, value3);
					topLeft3.X -= num / 4;
					Box box2 = new Box(topLeft3, num / 2, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height - topLeft3.Y - 1);
					Color fill = Color.FromArgb(alpha, candleChartAppearance.VolumeColor);

					int column = (box2.Row = i);
					box2.Column = column;
					box2.Column = 1;
					scene.Add(box2);
				}
				if (candleChartAppearance.HighLowVisible)
				{
					p = new Point(outerBounds.X + num3 + num / 4, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height);
					p2 = new Point(outerBounds.X + num3 + num / 4, outerBounds.Y);
					double value4 = data.GetValue(i, 2);
					double value5 = data.GetValue(i, 3);
					Point p3 = Axis.dataToPointLinearVertical(dataMin, dataMax, p, p2, value4);

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is CandleSeries && item.GetPoints().Count > 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				dataIsValid = flag;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = data != null && data.GetColumnCount() > 5 && data.GetRowCount() > 0 && data.IsColumnDateTime(0) && data.IsColumnNumeric(1) && data.IsColumnNumeric(2) && data.IsColumnNumeric(3) && data.IsColumnNumeric(4) && data.IsColumnNumeric(5) && !((DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data)).SwapRowsAndColumns;
			}
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1010");
		}

		public override void SetupDataFilter()
		{
			base.SetupDataFilter();
			((IChartDataFilter)data)?.IncludeColumn(0, include: true);
		}
	}
	public class LegendLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		internal static readonly Font MORE_FONT_DEFAULT = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 7f);

		protected ChartLayer chart;

		protected int boundsBuffer = 5;

		protected int iconBuffer = 8;

		protected virtual void RedirectToCompositeLegend(LegendAppearance legendApp, SeriesCollection seriesCol, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			CompositeLegend compositeLegend = new CompositeLegend(component);
			compositeLegend.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance = new ChartLayerAppearance();
			chartLayerAppearance.ChartType = ChartCore.ChartType;
			ChartLayer chartLayer = ChartCore.GetChartLayer();
			if (chartLayer != null)
			{
				chartLayerAppearance.ChartLayer = chartLayer;
				chartLayerAppearance.ChartTypeAppearance = chartLayer.GetAppearance() as ChartTypeAppearance;
				if (chartLayer.ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
				{
					foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
					{
						chartLayerAppearance.Series.Add(item);
					}
				}
				else if (chartLayer.ChartData is GanttDataAdapter)
				{
					GanttDataAdapter ganttDataAdapter = (GanttDataAdapter)chartLayer.ChartData;
					foreach (ISeries item2 in ganttDataAdapter.GanttData.Series)
					{
						chartLayerAppearance.Series.Add(item2);
					}
					chartLayerAppearance.LegendItem = LegendItemType.Series;
				}
			}
			compositeLegend.ChartLayers.Add(chartLayerAppearance);
			compositeLegend.Bounds = GetOuterDrawRect();
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			Rectangle clipBounds = graphicsContext.GetClipBounds();
			graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(compositeLegend.Bounds);
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			if (legendApp != null)
			{
				if (compositeLegend.PE == null)
				{
					compositeLegend.PE = new PaintElement();
				}
				compositeLegend.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
				compositeLegend.PE.Fill = legendApp.BackgroundColor;
				PaintElement pE = compositeLegend.PE;
				byte fillOpacity = (compositeLegend.PE.StrokeOpacity = legendApp.AlphaLevel);
				pE.FillOpacity = fillOpacity;
				BorderAppearance border = compositeLegend.Border;
				Color color = (compositeLegend.PE.Stroke = legendApp.BorderColor);
				border.Color = color;
				BorderAppearance border2 = compositeLegend.Border;
				int thickness = (compositeLegend.PE.StrokeWidth = legendApp.BorderThickness);
				border2.Thickness = thickness;
				compositeLegend.LabelStyle.Font = legendApp.Font;
				compositeLegend.LabelStyle.FontColor = legendApp.FontColor;
				compositeLegend.LabelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				compositeLegend.LabelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				compositeLegend.LabelStyle.ClipText = true;
				compositeLegend.Border.DrawStyle = legendApp.BorderStyle;
				compositeLegend.FormatString = legendApp.FormatString;
			}
			graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(clipBounds);
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			compositeLegend.FillSceneGraph(scene, ChartComponent, ChartCore);
		}

		public LegendLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Legend);
		}

		public void SetChart(ChartLayer chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		public override void SetData(IChartData data)
		{
			base.data = data;
		}

		internal void SetBounds(Rectangle bounds, bool reCalculateAfter)
		{
			outerBounds = bounds;
			if (reCalculateAfter)
			{
				CalculateInnerBounds();
			}
		}

		public override void SetBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			outerBounds = bounds;
			CalculateInnerBounds();
		}

		public override bool IsVisible()
		{
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			return legendAppearance.Visible;
		}

		public static void CalculateBounds(ref Rectangle innerBounds, ref Rectangle outerBounds, LegendLocation legendLocation, int legendSpanPercentage)
		{
			switch (legendLocation)
			{
			case LegendLocation.Top:
			{
				int num = outerBounds.Height * legendSpanPercentage / 100;
				innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y + num, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height - num);
				outerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, num);
				break;
			}
			case LegendLocation.Left:
			{
				int num = outerBounds.Width * legendSpanPercentage / 100;
				innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + num, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width - num, outerBounds.Height);
				outerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, num, outerBounds.Height);
				break;
			}
			case LegendLocation.Right:
			{
				int num = outerBounds.Width * legendSpanPercentage / 100;
				innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width - num, outerBounds.Height);
				outerBounds = new Rectangle(innerBounds.X + innerBounds.Width, innerBounds.Y, num, innerBounds.Height);
				break;
			}
			case LegendLocation.Bottom:
			{
				int num = outerBounds.Height * legendSpanPercentage / 100;
				innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height - num);
				outerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, innerBounds.Y + innerBounds.Height, outerBounds.Width, num);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override void CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			CalculateBounds(ref innerBounds, ref outerBounds, legendAppearance.Location, legendAppearance.SpanPercentage);
		}

		protected void FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(SceneGraph scene, bool isHeatMap)
		{
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			Rectangle innerDrawRect = GetInnerDrawRect();
			if (innerDrawRect.Width <= 0 || innerDrawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Box box = null;
			Text text = null;
			Text text2 = null;
			Text text3 = null;
			double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			double num = (dataMax + dataMin) / 2.0;
			Color fillColor;
			Color fillColor2;
			if (isHeatMap)
			{
				fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, 0.0);
				fillColor2 = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(data.GetRowCount() - 1, data.GetColumnCount() - 1, dataMax);
			}
			else
			{
				fillColor2 = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, dataMin);
				fillColor = ChartColorModel.getFillColor(data.GetRowCount() - 1, data.GetColumnCount() - 1, dataMax);
			}
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			labelStyle.Font = legendAppearance.Font;
			labelStyle.FontColor = legendAppearance.FontColor;
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(dataMin.ToString(), labelStyle.Font);
			if (legendAppearance.Location == LegendLocation.Left || legendAppearance.Location == LegendLocation.Right)
			{
				box = new Box(innerDrawRect);
				box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				box.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Vertical;
				box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				box.PE.FillStopColor = fillColor2;
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(innerDrawRect.Left, innerDrawRect.Top - boundsBuffer + innerDrawRect.Height / 2, innerDrawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				Rectangle bounds2 = new Rectangle(innerDrawRect.Left, innerDrawRect.Top + boundsBuffer, innerDrawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				Rectangle bounds3 = new Rectangle(innerDrawRect.Left, innerDrawRect.Bottom - boundsBuffer - (int)stringSizePixels.Height, innerDrawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				if (isHeatMap)
				{
					text = new Text(bounds2, dataMin.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
					text3 = new Text(bounds3, dataMax.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
				}
				else
				{
					text = new Text(bounds3, dataMin.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
					text3 = new Text(bounds2, dataMax.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
				}
				text2 = new Text(bounds, num.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				box = new Box(innerDrawRect);
				box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				box.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Horizontal;
				if (isHeatMap)
				{
					box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
					box.PE.FillStopColor = fillColor2;
				}
				else
				{
					box.PE.FillStopColor = fillColor;
					box.PE.Fill = fillColor2;
				}
				labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
				text = new Text(new Point(innerDrawRect.Left + (int)stringSizePixels.Height + boundsBuffer, innerDrawRect.Top + innerDrawRect.Height / 2), dataMin.ToString("#0.0#"), labelStyle);
				text3 = new Text(new Point(innerDrawRect.Right - (int)stringSizePixels.Height - boundsBuffer, innerDrawRect.Top + innerDrawRect.Height / 2), dataMax.ToString("#0.0#"), labelStyle);
				text2 = new Text(new Point(innerDrawRect.Left + innerDrawRect.Width / 2 + boundsBuffer, innerDrawRect.Top + innerDrawRect.Height / 2), num.ToString("#0.0#"), labelStyle);
			}
			Box box2 = box;
			Text text4 = text;
			Text text5 = text3;
			string text6 = (text2.Path = Path);
			string text7 = (text5.Path = text6);
			string path2 = (text4.Path = text7);
			box2.Path = path2;
			scene.Add(box);
			scene.Add(text);
			scene.Add(text2);
			scene.Add(text3);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			Rectangle outerDrawRect = GetOuterDrawRect();
			if (outerDrawRect.Width > 0 && outerDrawRect.Height > 0)
			{
				Box box = new Box(outerDrawRect);
				box.PE.FillOpacity = legendAppearance.AlphaLevel;
				box.PE.Fill = legendAppearance.BackgroundColor;
				box.PE.Stroke = legendAppearance.BorderColor;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = legendAppearance.BorderColor.A;
				if (legendAppearance.BorderThickness == 0)
				{
					box.PE.Stroke = Color.Empty;
					box.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
				}
				box.PE.StrokeWidth = legendAppearance.BorderThickness;
				box.lineStyle.DrawStyle = legendAppearance.BorderStyle;
				box.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(box);
			}
		}

		protected Rectangle GetOuterDrawRect()
		{
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			return new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + legendAppearance.Margins.Left, outerBounds.Y + legendAppearance.Margins.Top, outerBounds.Width - legendAppearance.Margins.Left - legendAppearance.Margins.Right - 1, outerBounds.Height - legendAppearance.Margins.Top - legendAppearance.Margins.Bottom - 1);
		}

		protected Rectangle GetInnerDrawRect()
		{
			Rectangle outerDrawRect = GetOuterDrawRect();
			return new Rectangle(outerDrawRect.X + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Y + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Width - boundsBuffer * 2, outerDrawRect.Height - boundsBuffer * 2);
		}

		protected virtual void AddEmptyIndicator(SceneGraph scene, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, Rectangle drawRect, int rowOffsetX, int legendBoxWidth, int legendBoxHeight, int textHeight, int columnWidth, int rowNumber)
		{
			AddEmptyIndicator(scene, emptyApp, drawRect, rowOffsetX, legendBoxWidth, legendBoxHeight, textHeight, columnWidth, rowNumber, Path, GetAppearance() as LegendAppearance, drawLabel: true);
		}

		internal static void AddEmptyIndicator(SceneGraph scene, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, Rectangle drawRect, int rowOffsetX, int legendBoxWidth, int legendBoxHeight, int textHeight, int columnWidth, int rowNumber, string path, LegendAppearance legendApp, bool drawLabel)
		{
			AddEmptyIndicator(scene, emptyApp, drawRect, rowOffsetX, legendBoxWidth, legendBoxHeight, textHeight, columnWidth, rowNumber, path, legendApp, drawLabel, new Rectangle(drawRect.X + rowOffsetX, drawRect.Y + textHeight * rowNumber, legendBoxWidth, legendBoxHeight));
		}

		internal static void AddEmptyIndicator(SceneGraph scene, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, Rectangle drawRect, int rowOffsetX, int legendBoxWidth, int legendBoxHeight, int textHeight, int columnWidth, int rowNumber, string path, LegendAppearance legendApp, bool drawLabel, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (emptyApp == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (emptyApp.LegendDisplayType)
			{
			case LegendEmptyDisplayType.Point:
				switch (emptyApp.PointStyle.Icon)
				{
				case SymbolIcon.Character:
				{
					char character = emptyApp.PointStyle.Character;
					Text text = new Text(new Point(drawRect.X + rowOffsetX, drawRect.Y + textHeight * rowNumber), character.ToString());
					Font font = new Font(emptyApp.PointStyle.CharacterFont.FontFamily, emptyApp.PointStyle.CharacterFont.SizeInPoints, emptyApp.PointStyle.CharacterFont.Style);
					text.GetLabelStyle().Font = font;
					text.PE = emptyApp.PointPE.Clone();
					scene.Add(text);
					break;
				}
				case SymbolIcon.Random:
				{
					Symbol symbol2 = new Symbol(new Point(rect.X + rect.Width / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2), emptyApp.RandomIcon, emptyApp.PointStyle.IconSize);
					symbol2.PE = emptyApp.PointPE.Clone();
					scene.Add(symbol2);
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					_ = emptyApp.PointStyle.IconSize;
					Symbol symbol = new Symbol(new Point(rect.X + rect.Width / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2), emptyApp.PointStyle.Icon, emptyApp.PointStyle.IconSize);
					symbol.PE = emptyApp.PointPE.Clone();
					scene.Add(symbol);
					break;
				}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				Box box = new Box(rect);
				if (emptyApp.EnablePE)
				{
					box.PE = emptyApp.PE;
				}
				if (emptyApp.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					box.lineStyle = emptyApp.LineStyle;
				}
				box.Path = path;
				box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
				scene.Add(box);
				break;
			}
			}
			if (drawLabel)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(drawRect.X + rowOffsetX + legendBoxWidth, drawRect.Y + textHeight * rowNumber, columnWidth, drawRect.Height);
				Text text2 = new Text(bounds, emptyApp.Text, new LabelStyle());
				if (legendApp != null)
				{
					text2.labelStyle.Font = legendApp.Font;
					text2.labelStyle.FontColor = legendApp.FontColor;
				}
				text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				text2.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				text2.Path = path;
				scene.Add(text2);
			}
		}

		public static Ellipse NestEllipse(Ellipse parent, double radiusFactor)
		{
			int radius = (int)((double)(parent.p2.X / 2) * radiusFactor);
			return new Ellipse(parent.GetCenterPoint(), radius);
		}
	}

				break;

				result = SR.GetString("SR_1020");
				break;

				break;

				break;
			case 3:
				result = candleChartAppearance.VolumeColor;
				break;
			case 4:
				result = candleChartAppearance.VolumeColor;
				break;

		private PrimitiveShape DrawLegendIcons(int drawRectX, int rowOffsetX, int drawRectY, int textHeight, int rowNumber, int innerWidth, int innerHeight, int legendNo)
		{
			PrimitiveShape result = null;
			switch (legendNo)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			{
				Box box3 = new Box(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), innerWidth / 2, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor3 = GetOutlineColor(legendNo);
				Color fillColor3 = GetFillColor(legendNo);
				box3.PE.Stroke = outlineColor3;
				box3.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor3.A;
				box3.PE.Fill = fillColor3;
				box3.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor3.A;
				result = box3;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				Line line = new Line(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber + textHeight / 2), new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX + innerWidth, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber + textHeight / 2));
				Color wickColor = ((CandleChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Candle)).WickColor;
				line.PE.StrokeOpacity = wickColor.A;
				line.PE.Stroke = wickColor;
				line.PE.StrokeWidth = ((CandleChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Candle)).WickThickness;
				result = line;
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				Box box2 = new Box(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), innerWidth, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor2 = GetOutlineColor(legendNo);
				Color fillColor2 = GetFillColor(legendNo);
				box2.PE.Stroke = outlineColor2;
				box2.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor2.A;
				box2.PE.Fill = fillColor2;
				box2.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor2.A;
				result = box2;
				break;
			}
			case 4:
			{
				Box box = new Box(new Point(drawRectX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), 0, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor = GetOutlineColor(legendNo);
				Color fillColor = GetFillColor(legendNo);

	public class ChartLayerCollection : ChartAppearance, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private ArrayList _List = new ArrayList();

		private static readonly ChartType[] StackedChartTypesByPoint = new ChartType[4]
		{
			ChartType.StackAreaChart,
			ChartType.StackLineChart,
			ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart,
			ChartType.StackSplineChart
		};

		private static readonly ChartType[] StackedChartTypesBySeries = new ChartType[4]
		{
			ChartType.Stack3DBarChart,
			ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart,
			ChartType.StackBarChart,
			ChartType.StackColumnChart
		};

		protected ArrayList List

				_List = value;
			}
		}

		public ChartLayerAppearance this[int index]
		{

				return List[index] as ChartLayerAppearance;
			}
			set

				List[index] = value;

			}
		}

		public int Count => List.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => List.IsSynchronized;
