		public int Add(ChartLayerAppearance layer)
		{
			if (layer.component == null)
			{
				layer.SetComponent(component);
			}
			if (layer.Key == null || layer.Key.Length == 0)
			{
				int num = Count;
				string key;
				do
				{
					num++;
					key = "chartLayer" + num;
				}
				while (FromKey(key) != null);
				layer.Key = key;
			}
			int result = List.Add(layer);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		public ChartLayerAppearance FromKey(string key)
		{
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Key == key)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ChartLayerCollection Clone()
		{
			ChartLayerCollection chartLayerCollection = new ChartLayerCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				chartLayerCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return chartLayerCollection;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{

		}

		internal object GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType dataType)
		{
			if (dataType == AxisDataType.Numeric)
			{
				double num = double.MinValue;
				foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)this)
				{
					SeriesCollection seriesCollection = ((!item.SwapRowsAndColumns) ? item.Series : SeriesSwap.Swap(item.Series));
					if (Array.IndexOf(StackedChartTypesByPoint, item.ChartType) != -1)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
						for (int i = 0; i < seriesCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							if (seriesCollection[i] is NumericSeries)
							{
								NumericSeries numericSeries = (NumericSeries)seriesCollection[i];
								for (int j = 0; j < numericSeries.Points.Count; j++)
								{
									if (arrayList.Count == j)
									{
										arrayList.Add(0.0);
									}
									arrayList[j] = (double)arrayList[j] + numericSeries.Points[j].Value;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								if (!(seriesCollection[i] is NumericTimeSeries))
								{
									continue;
								}
								NumericTimeSeries numericTimeSeries = (NumericTimeSeries)seriesCollection[i];
								for (int k = 0; k < numericTimeSeries.Points.Count; k++)
								{
									if (arrayList.Count == k)
									{
										arrayList.Add(0.0);
									}
									arrayList[k] = (double)arrayList[k] + numericTimeSeries.Points[k].NumericValue;
								}
							}
						}
						foreach (double item2 in arrayList)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, item2);
						}
					}
					else if (Array.IndexOf(StackedChartTypesBySeries, item.ChartType) != -1)
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < seriesCollection.Count; l++)
						{
							double num2 = 0.0;
							ISeries series = seriesCollection[l];
							if (series is NumericSeries)
							{
								NumericSeries numericSeries2 = (NumericSeries)series;
								foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries2.Points)
								{
									if (point.Value > 0.0)
									{
										num2 += point.Value;
									}
								}
							}
							num = Math.Max(num, num2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						object dataMaximum = seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
						if (dataMaximum is double)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, (double)dataMaximum);
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal object GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType dataType)
		{
			if (dataType == AxisDataType.Numeric)
			{
				double num = double.MaxValue;
				foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)this)
				{
					SeriesCollection seriesCollection = ((!item.SwapRowsAndColumns) ? item.Series : SeriesSwap.Swap(item.Series));
					if (Array.IndexOf(StackedChartTypesByPoint, item.ChartType) != -1)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
						for (int i = 0; i < seriesCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							if (seriesCollection[i] is NumericSeries)
							{
								NumericSeries numericSeries = (NumericSeries)seriesCollection[i];
								for (int j = 0; j < numericSeries.Points.Count; j++)
								{
									if (arrayList.Count == j)
									{
										arrayList.Add(0.0);
									}
									arrayList[j] = (double)arrayList[j] + numericSeries.Points[j].Value;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								if (!(seriesCollection[i] is NumericTimeSeries))
								{
									continue;
								}
								NumericTimeSeries numericTimeSeries = (NumericTimeSeries)seriesCollection[i];
								for (int k = 0; k < numericTimeSeries.Points.Count; k++)
								{
									if (arrayList.Count == k)
									{
										arrayList.Add(0.0);
									}
									arrayList[k] = (double)arrayList[k] + numericTimeSeries.Points[k].NumericValue;
								}
							}
						}
						foreach (double item2 in arrayList)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, item2);
						}
					}
					else if (Array.IndexOf(StackedChartTypesBySeries, item.ChartType) != -1)
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < seriesCollection.Count; l++)
						{
							double num2 = 0.0;
							ISeries series = seriesCollection[l];
							if (series is NumericSeries)
							{
								NumericSeries numericSeries2 = (NumericSeries)series;
								foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries2.Points)
								{
									if (point.Value < 0.0)
									{
										num2 += point.Value;
									}
								}
							}
							num = Math.Min(num, num2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						object dataMinimum = seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Numeric);
						if (dataMinimum is double)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, (double)dataMinimum);
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		private delegate string getLayerID();

		private StackStyle stackStyle;

		private getLayerID goGetLayerID;

		public override string LayerID
		{
			get
			{
				return goGetLayerID();
			}
			set
			{
				base.LayerID = value;
			}
		}

		internal static PrimitiveCollection InterpolatePrimitivesStacked(ChartLayer layer, PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, NullHandling nullHandling)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			InterpolateValuesEventArgs e = new InterpolateValuesEventArgs();
			e.Values = new object[primitives.Count];
			double result = 0.0;
			double result2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				if (primitives[i] == null || primitives[i].Value == null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(i);
					continue;
				}
				double.TryParse(primitives[i].Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
				e.Values.SetValue(result - result2, i);
				double.TryParse(primitives[i].Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
			}
			e.NullValueIndices = new int[arrayList.Count];
			arrayList.CopyTo(e.NullValueIndices);
			e.Type = type;
			if (nullHandling == NullHandling.InterpolateCustom && layer.ChartComponent.IsDesignMode())
			{
				nullHandling = NullHandling.InterpolateSimple;
			}
			switch (nullHandling)
			{
			case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
				layer.ChartComponent.OnInterpolateValues(e);
				break;
			default:
				e.Values = layer.InterpolateSimple(e);
				break;
			}
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = layer.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = layer.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			bool flag = layer.ChartData.GetDataMax() > 0.0;
			double num = advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero);
			double num2 = advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero);
			for (int j = 0; j < primitives.Count; j++)
			{
				Box box = primitives[j] as Box;
				Box box2;
				if (layer is ColumnLayer)
				{
					double num3;
					double num4;
					if (flag)
					{
						num3 = advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero) - advanceAxis2.Map(e.Values.GetValue(j));
						num4 = num2 - num3;
						num2 = num4;
					}
					else
					{
						num3 = advanceAxis2.Map(e.Values.GetValue(j)) - advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero);
						num4 = num2;
						num2 = num4 + num3;
					}
					box2 = new Box(new Rectangle(box.rect.Left, (int)num4, box.rect.Width, (int)num3));
				}
				else
				{
					double num5;
					double num6;
					if (flag)
					{
						num5 = advanceAxis.Map(e.Values.GetValue(j)) - advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero);
						num6 = num + num5;
						num = num6;
					}
					else
					{
						num5 = advanceAxis.Map(advanceAxis.Zero) - advanceAxis.Map(e.Values.GetValue(j));
						num6 = num;
						num = num6 - num5;
					}
					int x = (int)(num6 - num5);
					box2 = new Box(new Rectangle(x, box.rect.Top, (int)num5, box.rect.Height));
				}
				box2.Series = box.Series;
				box2.DataPoint = box.DataPoint;
				box2.Row = box.Row;
				box2.Column = box.Column;
				box2.AccumulatedElementsValue = box.AccumulatedElementsValue;
				box2.Value = box.Value;
				box2.lineStyle = box.lineStyle;
				box2.PE = box.PE;
				box2.Chart = box.Chart;
				box2.Layer = box.Layer;
				box2.Empty = box.Empty;
				if (box.Empty)
				{
					box2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
				}
				else
				{
					box2.Caps = box.Caps;
				}
				primitiveCollection.Add(box2);
			}
			return primitiveCollection;
		}

		protected override PrimitiveCollection InterpolatePrimitives(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type)
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				return InterpolatePrimitivesStacked(this, primitives, type, base.NullHandling);
			}
			return base.InterpolatePrimitives(primitives, type);
		}

		public ColumnLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			goGetLayerID = getLayerStandardID;
			if (core != null && core.ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart)
			{
				goGetLayerID = getLayerHybridID;
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			if (Core.ChartType == ChartType.ColumnChart || Core.ChartType == ChartType.StackColumnChart)
			{
				return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Column);
			}
			return ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).Column;
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				return string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_1030"), "Column");
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1012");
		}

		private string getLayerStandardID()
		{
			return base.LayerID;
		}

		private string getLayerHybridID()
		{
			return "00";
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				FillSceneGraphStacked(scene);
			}
			else
			{
				FillSceneGraphRegularAdvance(scene);
			}
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphStacked(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			ColumnChartAppearance columnChartAppearance = (ColumnChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			base.NullHandling = columnChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			StackAppearance stackAppearance = (StackAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Stack);
			stackStyle = stackAppearance.StackStyle;
			double num = data.GetDataMin();
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			if (rowCount == 0 || columnCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int columnSpacing = columnChartAppearance.ColumnSpacing;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (stackStyle == StackStyle.Complete && data.GetDataMax() <= 0.0 && data.GetDataMin() <= 0.0)
			{
				dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				num = _getLowestNegativeStack(data);
			}
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				ISeries series = null;
				IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > i)
				{
					series = seriesCollection[i];
					if (series != null)
					{
						provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
					}
				}
				object obj = advanceAxis2.Zero;
				object obj2 = advanceAxis2.Zero;
				double num3 = 1.0;
				double num4 = 1.0;
				bool flag = num < 0.0 && dataMax > 0.0;
				if (stackStyle == StackStyle.Complete)
				{
					double num5 = Math.Abs((double)advanceAxis2.Maximum - (double)advanceAxis2.Minimum);
					double num6 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(_getPositiveStackForRow(data, i)), Math.Abs(_getNegativeStackForRow(data, i)));
					num3 = num5 / num6;
					num4 = num3;
					if (flag)
					{
						num3 = (double)advanceAxis2.Maximum / _getPositiveStackForRow(data, i);
						num4 = (double)advanceAxis2.Minimum / _getNegativeStackForRow(data, i);
					}
				}
				int num7 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(i + num2);
				int num8 = (int)advanceAxis.Map(i + num2 + 1);
				int width = num8 - num7;
				int num9 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(0);
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
					if (provideDataPoints != null)
					{
						numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[j] as NumericDataPoint;
					}
					if (numericDataPoint == null)
					{
						numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint.Label = data.GetColumnLabel(j) as string;
						numericDataPoint.Value = data.GetValue(i, j);
						numericDataPoint.Empty = data.GetObjectValue(i, j) == null;
					}
					if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						switch (base.NullHandling)
						{
						case NullHandling.Zero:
							base.EmptyValues = true;
							break;
						case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
						case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
							flag2 = (base.EmptyValues = true);
							break;
						}
					}
					object obj3;
					int num10;
					if (numericDataPoint.Value > 0.0)
					{
						obj3 = advanceAxis2.Add(obj, numericDataPoint.Value);
						num10 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Multiply(obj, num3));
						num9 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Multiply(obj3, num3));
						obj = obj3;
					}
					else
					{
						obj3 = advanceAxis2.Add(obj2, numericDataPoint.Value);
						num9 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Multiply(obj2, num4));
						num10 = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Multiply(obj3, num4));
						obj2 = obj3;
					}
					Box box = new Box(new Point(num7, num9), width, num10 - num9);
					if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						box.Empty = true;
						box.Value = null;
						box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						box.Value = advanceAxis2.NumericOf(obj3);
						box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
					box.Row = i;
					box.Column = j;
					box.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					box.Layer = this;
					box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
					box.Series = series;
					box.Path = Path;
					box.AccumulatedElementsValue = getStackedValueForColumnSeries(data, i);
					primitiveCollection.Add(box);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					primitiveCollection = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection, typeof(double));
				}
				IEnumerator enumerator = primitiveCollection.GetEnumerator();
				if (useMinMax)
				{
					if (advanceAxis2.Compare(minValue, obj2) <= 0 && advanceAxis2.Compare(maxValue, obj) >= 0)
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							Box value = (Box)enumerator.Current;
							scene.Add(value);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						Box box2 = (Box)enumerator.Current;
						scene.Add(box2);
						for (int k = 0; k < columnChartAppearance.ChartText.Count; k++)
						{
							if (columnChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Match(box2.Row, box2.Column) && columnChartAppearance.ChartText[k].Visible)
							{
								putText(box2, scene, columnChartAppearance.ChartText[k], stacked: true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
				foreach (Box item in primitiveCollection)
				{
					if (emptyAppearance != null && item.Empty && base.NullHandling != NullHandling.DontPlot)
					{
						if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
						{
							item.PE = emptyAppearance.PE;
						}
						else
						{
							item.PE = GetBoxPE(item);
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
						{
							item.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle;
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.PointStyle != null && emptyAppearance.EnablePoint)
						{
							DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(y: (!(item.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2)) ? item.rect.Top : ((!(numericDataPoint2.Value >= 0.0)) ? item.rect.Bottom : item.rect.Top), x: item.rect.X + item.rect.Width / 2);
							PointSet pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(new DataPoint[1] { dataPoint }, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
							pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
							scene.Add(pointSet);
						}
						item.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						item.PE = GetBoxPE(item);
						item.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
				}
				primitiveCollection.Clear();
				num2 += columnSpacing;
			}
		}

		private PaintElement GetBoxPE(Box box)

			return GetBoxPE(box, box.DataPoint, box.Series);
		}

		private PaintElement GetBoxPE(Box box, IDataPoint point, ISeries series)
		{
			return GetPE(box, point, series);
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphRegularAdvance(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);

			base.NullHandling = columnChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			int seriesSpacing = columnChartAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			int columnSpacing = columnChartAppearance.ColumnSpacing;
			int num = rowCount * columnCount + (rowCount - 1) * seriesSpacing + (columnCount - 1) * columnSpacing * rowCount;
			switch (advanceAxis.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				advanceAxis.Maximum = num;
				advanceAxis.Minimum = 0;
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				advanceAxis.Maximum = advanceAxis.RangeMax;
				advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.RangeMin;
				break;
			}
			object obj = null;
			int num2 = 0;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ResetClip();
			for (int num3 = scene.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{

				{
					Rectangle clipBounds = ((GraphicsContext)scene[num3]).GetClipBounds();
					graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(new Rectangle(clipBounds.X, 0, clipBounds.Width, clipBounds.Height + clipBounds.Y));
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				obj = null;
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				object[] array = new object[columnCount];
				bool flag = false;
				IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
				ISeries series;
				if (seriesCollection != null)
				{
					if (seriesCollection.Count <= i || seriesCollection[i] == null)

				Core.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = i;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					Core.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = j;
					int num4 = i * columnCount + j;
					if (advanceAxis.ItemVisible(num4 + 1 + num2) || advanceAxis.ItemVisible(num4 + num2))
					{
						int num5 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map((double)(num4 + num2)));
						int num6 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map((double)(num4 + num2 + 1)));
						NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
						if (provideDataPoints != null)
						{
							numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[j] as NumericDataPoint;
							if (numericDataPoint == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
							{
								switch (base.NullHandling)
								{
								case NullHandling.Zero:
									base.EmptyValues = true;
									break;
								case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
								case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
									flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
									break;
								case NullHandling.DontPlot:
									continue;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
							numericDataPoint.Label = data.GetColumnLabel(j) as string;
							if ((array[j] = data.GetObjectValue(i, j)) == null)
							{
								numericDataPoint.Empty = true;
								switch (base.NullHandling)
								{
								case NullHandling.Zero:
									base.EmptyValues = true;
									break;
								case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
								case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
									flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
									break;
								case NullHandling.DontPlot:
									continue;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								numericDataPoint.Value = data.GetValue(i, j);
							}

						int num7 = Convert.ToInt32(MathFunctions.GetBoundedValue(advanceAxis2.MapMaximum, advanceAxis2.MapMinimum, Math.Round(advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.Zero))));
						int num8 = Convert.ToInt32(MathFunctions.GetBoundedValue(advanceAxis2.MapMaximum, advanceAxis2.MapMinimum, Math.Round(advanceAxis2.Map(numericDataPoint.Value))));
						Box box = ((num8 <= num7) ? new Box(new Rectangle(num5, num8, num6 - num5, num7 - num8)) : new Box(new Rectangle(num5, num7, num6 - num5, num8 - num7)));

							}
							box.Row = i;
							box.Column = j;

							box.Layer = this;

							if (useMinMax)
							{
								if (minValue <= numericDataPoint.Value && maxValue >= numericDataPoint.Value)

		private void putText(Box b1, IList scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance, bool stacked)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				if (b1.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_ITEM"] = numericDataPoint.Value;
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			if (b1.Series != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = b1.Series.Label;
			}
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			labelStyle.ClipText = chartTextAppearance.ClipText;
			Text text2;
			if (stacked)
			{
				text2 = new Text(b1.rect, text, labelStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				num = b1.rect.X + b1.rect.Width / 2;
				ColumnChartAppearance columnChartAppearance = (ColumnChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2 = b1.DataPoint as NumericDataPoint;
				bool flag = true;
				switch (columnChartAppearance.ChartTextValueAlignment)
				{
				case ValueAlignment.Negative:
					flag = false;
					break;
				case ValueAlignment.PositiveAndNegative:
					if (numericDataPoint2 != null && numericDataPoint2.Value < 0.0)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = b1.rect.Y;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = b1.rect.Bottom;
					int num3 = (int)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Height);
					switch (chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign)
					{
					case StringAlignment.Near:
						num2 -= num3;
						break;
					case StringAlignment.Far:
						num2 += num3;
						break;
					}
				}
				Point pos = new Point(num, num2);
				text2 = new Text(pos, text, labelStyle);
			}
			Rectangle actualBounds = text2.GetActualBounds();
			if (innerBounds.Bottom < actualBounds.Bottom)
			{
				text2.bounds.Offset(0, innerBounds.Bottom - actualBounds.Bottom);
			}
			scene.Add(text2);
		}

		internal static double _getPositiveStackForRow(IChartData data, int rowno)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
			{
				double value = data.GetValue(rowno, i);
				if (value > 0.0)
				{
					num += value;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double _getNegativeStackForRow(IChartData data, int rowno)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
			{
				double value = data.GetValue(rowno, i);
				if (value < 0.0)
				{
					num += value;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double _getHighestPositiveStack(IChartData data)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
				{
					double value = data.GetValue(i, j);
					if (value > 0.0)
					{
						num2 += value;
					}
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double _getLowestNegativeStack(IChartData data)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
				{
					double value = data.GetValue(i, j);
					if (value < 0.0)
					{
						num2 += value;
					}
				}
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static float getStackedValueForColumnSeries(IChartData data, int rowno)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
			{
				num = (float)data.GetValue(rowno, i) + num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static float getStackedMaxSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
				{
					num2 = (float)data.GetValue(i, j) + num2;
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static float getStackedMinSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			float num = getStackedMaxSeries(data);
			float num2 = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
				{
					num2 = (float)data.GetValue(i, j) + num2;
				}
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static float getStackedMinNegativeSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			float num = (float)data.GetDataMin();
			float num2 = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
				{
					num2 = (float)data.GetValue(i, j) + num2;
				}
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static float getStackedMaxNegativeSeries(IChartData data)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
			{
				num = (float)data.GetValue(0, i) + num;
			}
			float num2 = 0f;
			for (int j = 0; j < data.GetRowCount(); j++)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
				for (int k = 0; k < data.GetColumnCount(); k++)
				{
					num2 = (float)data.GetValue(j, k) + num2;
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class CrossHairLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		public int hairx = -1;

		public int hairy = -1;

		private ChartType _ChartType;

		private Point _Center;

		private int _Radius = 200;

		public ChartType ChartType
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartType;
			}
			set
			{
				_ChartType = value;
			}
		}

		public Point Center
		{
			get
			{
				return _Center;
			}
			set
			{
				_Center = value;
			}
		}

		public int Radius
		{
			get
			{
				return _Radius;
			}
			set
			{
				_Radius = value;
			}
		}

		public CrossHairLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (_ChartType == ChartType.PolarChart)
			{
				Point point = new Point(hairy - _Center.Y, hairx - _Center.X);
				double num = Math.Atan2(point.X, point.Y);
				double num2 = Math.Sqrt(point.X * point.X + point.Y * point.Y);
				if (num2 < (double)_Radius)
				{
					Point p = new Point((int)((double)_Radius * Math.Cos(num)), (int)((double)_Radius * Math.Sin(num)));
					p.Offset(_Center.X, _Center.Y);
					Line value = new Line(_Center, p);
					scene.Add(value);
					if (num2 > 5.0)
					{
						Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(_Center, (int)num2);
						ellipse.PE.FillOpacity = 0;
						scene.Add(ellipse);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Line line = new Line(new Point(innerBounds.X, hairy), new Point(innerBounds.Width, hairy));
				Line line2 = new Line(new Point(hairx, innerBounds.Y), new Point(hairx, innerBounds.Height));
				string path = (line2.Path = Path);
				line.Path = path;
				scene.Add(line);
				scene.Add(line2);
			}
		}
	}

		private bool PieHelper()
		{
			bool result = false;
			rowsToShow = new ArrayList();
			rowsToShowPercentValue = new Hashtable();
			rowsToShowDataValues = new Hashtable();
			PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance = null;
			if (chart is PieLayer)
			{
				PieLayer pieLayer = (PieLayer)chart;
				pieChartAppearance = (PieChartAppearance)pieLayer.GetAppearance();
			}
			else if (chart is Doughnut3DLayer)
			{
				Doughnut3DLayer doughnut3DLayer = (Doughnut3DLayer)chart;
				pieChartAppearance = (PieChartAppearance)doughnut3DLayer.GetAppearance();
			}
			else if (chart is HierarchicalLayer)
			{
				HierarchicalChartAppearance hierarchicalChartAppearance = chart.GetAppearance() as HierarchicalChartAppearance;
				pieChartAppearance = new PieChartAppearance();
				pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText = hierarchicalChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText;
				pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent = hierarchicalChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent;
				pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex = -1;
			}
			else if (chart is Hierarchical3DLayer)
			{
				Hierarchical3DAppearance hierarchical3DAppearance = chart.GetAppearance() as Hierarchical3DAppearance;
				pieChartAppearance = new PieChartAppearance();
				pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText = hierarchical3DAppearance.OthersCategoryText;
				pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent = hierarchical3DAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent;
				pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				Pie3DLayer pie3DLayer = (Pie3DLayer)chart;
				pieChartAppearance = (PieChartAppearance)pie3DLayer.GetAppearance();
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex;
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = null;
			if (data is IChartDataFilter)
			{
				chartDataFilter = (IChartDataFilter)data;
				num2 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex);
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
			}
			else if (data is SeriesCollection)
			{
				num2 = ((pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex > -1) ? pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex : 0);
			}
			else if (data is ChartDemoData)
			{
				num2 = -1;
			}
			int rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
			for (int i = num2; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				double num3 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowCount; j++)
				{
					num3 += Math.Abs(data.GetValue(j, i));
				}
				double num4 = 0.0;
				num = 0.0;
				for (int k = 0; k < rowCount; k++)
				{
					num4 = data.GetValue(k, i);
					double num5 = Math.Abs(num4) * 100.0 / num3;
					rowsToShowPercentValue[k] = num5;
					rowsToShowDataValues[k] = num4;
					rowsToShowPercentValue[k] = num5;
					if (num5 <= pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent)
					{
						num += Math.Abs(num4);
						othersRow = k;
					}
					else if (rowsToShow.IndexOf(k) < 0)
					{
						rowsToShow.Add(k);
					}
					if (num > 0.0 && pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent > 0.0)
					{
						rowsToShowPercentValue["other"] = 100.0 * num / num3;
						rowsToShowDataValues["other"] = num;
						result = true;
					}
				}
				if (!pieChartAppearance.Concentric)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = GetAppearance() as LegendAppearance;
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				RedirectToCompositeLegend(legendAppearance, seriesCollection, scene);
				return;
			}
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (chart is HistogramLayer { HistogramData: not null } histogramLayer)
			{
				data = histogramLayer.HistogramData;
			}
			Type type = ChartColorModel.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(DataValueLinearColorModel))
			{
				FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(scene, isHeatMap: false);
				return;
			}
			if ((chart is PieLayer || chart is Pie3DLayer || chart is Doughnut3DLayer || chart is HierarchicalLayer || chart is Hierarchical3DLayer) && type != typeof(DataValueCustomColorModel))
			{
				FillSceneGraphPie(scene);
				return;
			}
			Rectangle outerDrawRect = GetOuterDrawRect();
			Rectangle drawRect = new Rectangle(outerDrawRect.X + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Y + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Width - boundsBuffer * 2, outerDrawRect.Height - boundsBuffer * 2);
			if (drawRect.Width <= 0 || drawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 10;
			bool colorByRow = GetColorByRow();
			int num2;
			if (type == typeof(DataValueCustomColorModel))
			{
				num2 = ((DataValueCustomColorModel)ChartColorModel).CustomPaletteLength;
			}
			else if (ChartCore.ChartType != ChartType.StepAreaChart && ChartCore.ChartType != ChartType.StepLineChart)
			{
				num2 = ((data != null) ? ((!colorByRow) ? data.GetColumnCount() : data.GetRowCount()) : 0);
			}
			else if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				num2 = 0;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is NumericTimeSeries)
					{
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 1;
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
			bool flag = chart.HasEmptyValues && emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.ShowInLegend && (emptyAppearance.EnablePE || emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle);
			int num3 = num2;
			IMultiEmptyStyles multiEmptyStyles = chart as IMultiEmptyStyles;
			if (multiEmptyStyles != null && multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed != null && multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (EmptyAppearance item2 in multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed)
				{
					if (item2.ShowInLegend)
					{
						num3++;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				num3++;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			ParetoChartAppearance paretoChartAppearance = null;
			if (chart is ParetoLayer)
			{
				paretoChartAppearance = chart.GetAppearance() as ParetoChartAppearance;
				if (paretoChartAppearance != null && paretoChartAppearance.ShowLineInLegend)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					num3++;
				}
			}
			int num4 = num * drawRect.Width / 100;
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("Test String", legendAppearance.Font);
			int num5 = 1;
			string[] array = new string[num3];
			int[] array2 = new int[num2];
			if ((ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.StepAreaChart || ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.StepLineChart) && type != typeof(DataValueCustomColorModel) && !(data is SeriesCollection))
			{
				array[0] = GetLabel(1, legendAppearance.FormatString);
				array2[0] = 1;
				num5 = (int)stringSizePixels.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				int num6 = 0;
				for (num6 = 0; num6 < num2; num6++)
				{
					array[num6] = GetLabel(num6, legendAppearance.FormatString, colorByRow, type);

		private string GetLabel(int i, string format)
		{
			return GetLabel(i, format, GetColorByRow());
		}

		private string GetLabel(int i, string format, bool pColorByRow)
		{
			return GetLabel(i, format, pColorByRow, ChartColorModel.GetType());
		}

		private string GetLabel(int i, string format, bool pColorByRow, Type colorModelType)
		{
			ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.ChartLayer;
			ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_NUMBER"] = i;
			if (rowsToShowPercentValue != null && rowsToShowDataValues != null)
			{
				object value = -1;
				if (rowsToShowPercentValue[i] != null)
				{
					value = rowsToShowPercentValue[i];
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = value;
				object value2 = -1;
				if (rowsToShowDataValues[i] != null)
				{
					value2 = rowsToShowDataValues[i];
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = value2;
			}
			if (colorModelType == typeof(DataValueCustomColorModel))
			{
				DataValueCustomColorModel dataValueCustomColorModel = (DataValueCustomColorModel)ChartColorModel;
				double itemRangeBottomAt = dataValueCustomColorModel.GetItemRangeBottomAt(i);
				double itemRangeTopAt = dataValueCustomColorModel.GetItemRangeTopAt(i);
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_MIN"] = itemRangeBottomAt;
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_MAX"] = itemRangeTopAt;
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = itemRangeBottomAt + " ... " + itemRangeTopAt;
			}
			else if (i >= 0)
			{
				if (pColorByRow && i < data.GetRowCount())
				{
					if (chart is ParetoLayer)
					{
						ParetoLayer paretoLayer = (ParetoLayer)chart;
						if (paretoLayer.Columns[i] != null)
						{
							ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetRowLabel(paretoLayer.Columns[i].Row);
							ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = paretoLayer.Columns[i].Row;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetRowLabel(i);
						ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = i;
					}
				}
				else if (chart is StepLineLayer && data is SeriesCollection)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetRowLabel(i);
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = i;
				}
				else if (i < data.GetColumnCount())
				{
					if (chart is ParetoLayer)
					{
						ParetoLayer paretoLayer2 = (ParetoLayer)chart;
						if (i < paretoLayer2.Columns.Count && paretoLayer2.Columns[i] != null)
						{
							ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetColumnLabel(paretoLayer2.Columns[i].Column);
							ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = paretoLayer2.Columns[i].Column;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetColumnLabel(i);
						ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = i;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = rowsToShowPercentValue["other"];
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = rowsToShowDataValues["other"];
					if (ChartCore.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() is IOthersCategory othersCategory)
					{
						ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = othersCategory.OthersCategoryText;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = rowsToShowPercentValue["other"];
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = rowsToShowDataValues["other"];
				if (ChartCore.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() is IOthersCategory othersCategory2)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = othersCategory2.OthersCategoryText;
				}
			}
			return LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, format);
		}

		private Color GetFillColor(int i, Type colorModelType)
		{
			if (colorModelType == typeof(DataValueCustomColorModel))
			{
				DataValueCustomColorModel dataValueCustomColorModel = (DataValueCustomColorModel)ChartColorModel;
				return dataValueCustomColorModel.GetFillColorAtIndex(i);
			}
			if (GetColorByRow())
			{
				return ChartColorModel.getFillColor(i, 0, 0.0);
			}
			return ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, i, 0.0);
		}

		private Color GetFillColor(int i)
		{
			return GetFillColor(i, ChartColorModel.GetType());
		}

		private Color GetOutlineColor(int i)
		{
			return ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(0, i, 0.0);
		}

		private bool GetColorByRow()
		{
			return ((SimpleColorModel)ChartColorModel).GetColorByRow();
		}
	}

		private void RenderRing(int col, int outerRadius, int innerRadius, int totalRadius, PieChartAppearance pieApp, Point center, IList breakAwayFlag, IChartDataFilter filter, double minVisible, double maxVisible, bool useMinMax, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			ISeries series = null;
			NumericSeries numericSeries = null;
			IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				series = ((!pieApp.Concentric) ? seriesCollection[0] : seriesCollection[col]);
				if (series != null)
				{
					provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
					for (int i = 0; i < provideDataPoints.Count; i++)
					{
						if (provideDataPoints[i] is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
						{
							num++;
							num2 += numericDataPoint.Value;
						}
					}
					if (ChartColorModel is LinearColorModel linearColorModel)
					{
						linearColorModel.ItemCount = num;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = data.GetRowCount();
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					num2 += Math.Abs(data.GetValue(j, col));
				}
				numericSeries = new NumericSeries();
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				AddTextLabelsToScene(scene, "0.0", pieApp, center, 0, 0.0);
				return;
			}
			ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.ChartLayer;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = col;
			double num3 = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(pieApp.StartAngle);
			double num4 = 0.0;
			bool flag = pieApp.BreakAllSlices || pieApp.BreakOthersSlice || pieApp.BreakAlternatingSlices || (breakAwayFlag != null && breakAwayFlag.Count > 0);
			othersCumulativeTotal = 0.0;
			othersArrayList.Clear();
			PointsInOthersWedge.Clear();
			bool[] array = new bool[num];
			bool flag2 = this is DoughnutLayer;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			int k;
			for (k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = k;
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2 = null;
				if (provideDataPoints != null && provideDataPoints.Count > k && provideDataPoints[k] != null)
				{
					numericDataPoint2 = provideDataPoints[k] as NumericDataPoint;
				}
				if (numericDataPoint2 == null)
				{
					numericDataPoint2 = new NumericDataPoint();
					numericDataPoint2.Value = data.GetValue(k, col);
					object rowLabel = data.GetRowLabel(k);
					if (rowLabel != null)
					{
						numericDataPoint2.Label = rowLabel.ToString();
					}
				}
				if (numericDataPoint2.Value == 0.0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint2.Value;
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = numericDataPoint2.Label;
				ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = Math.Abs(numericDataPoint2.Value) * 100.0 / num2;
				totalVal += numericDataPoint2.Value;
				int num5 = filter?.GetRealRowNumber(k) ?? k;
				double num6 = Math.Abs(numericDataPoint2.Value) * 100.0 / num2;
				if (num6 <= pieApp.OthersCategoryPercent)
				{
					othersArrayList.Add(Math.Abs(numericDataPoint2.Value));
					PointsInOthersWedge.Add(numericDataPoint2);
					othersCumulativeTotal += Math.Abs(numericDataPoint2.Value);
					numericSeries?.Points.Add(numericDataPoint2);
					continue;
				}
				double num7 = Axis.dataToAngleLinear(0.0, num2, 0.0, Math.PI * 2.0, Math.Abs(numericDataPoint2.Value));
				Point location = new Point(center.X, center.Y);
				int radius = outerRadius;
				int completeRadius = totalRadius;
				if (flag)
				{
					radius = outerRadius - (int)((double)(pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage * outerRadius) / 100.0);
					completeRadius = totalRadius - (int)((double)(pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage * outerRadius) / 100.0);
				}
				array[k] = pieApp.BreakAllSlices || (pieApp.BreakAlternatingSlices && k % 2 == 0) || (breakAwayFlag != null && breakAwayFlag.Count > 0 && breakAwayFlag.Contains(num5));
				if (array[k])
				{
					location = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage, num3 + num7 / 2.0);
				}
				float startAngle;
				float angleSweep;
				if (numericDataPoint2.Value == num2)
				{
					startAngle = 0f;
					angleSweep = 360f;
				}
				else
				{
					startAngle = (float)Geometry.RadianToDegree(num3);
					angleSweep = (float)Geometry.RadianToDegree(num7);
				}
				Wedge wedge = new Wedge(location, radius, startAngle, angleSweep);
				wedge.RadiusInner = Math.Max(Math.Min(innerRadius, wedge.Radius - 1), 0);
				Hashtable environment = ChartCore.Environment;
				int num8 = (wedge.Row = k);
				environment["DATA_ROW"] = num8;
				Hashtable environment2 = ChartCore.Environment;
				int num10 = (wedge.Column = col);
				environment2["DATA_COLUMN"] = num10;
				wedge.PE = GetPE(wedge, numericDataPoint2, series, ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite);
				if (numericSeries != null)
				{
					numericSeries.Points.Add(numericDataPoint2);
					wedge.Series = numericSeries;
				}
				else
				{
					wedge.Series = series;
				}
				wedge.DataPoint = numericDataPoint2;
				wedge.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
				if (flag2)
				{
					wedge.Chart = ChartType.DoughnutChart;
				}
				else
				{
					wedge.Chart = ChartType.PieChart;
				}
				wedge.Layer = this;
				wedge.Value = numericDataPoint2.Value;
				wedge.Path = Path;
				if (useMinMax)
				{
					if (minVisible <= num4 && maxVisible >= num4)
					{
						scene.Add(wedge);
						primitiveCollection.Add(wedge);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					scene.Add(wedge);
					primitiveCollection.Add(wedge);
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < pieApp.ChartText.Count; l++)
				{
					if (pieApp.ChartText[l].Match(wedge.Row, -2) && pieApp.ChartText[l].Visible)
					{
						putText(wedge, scene, pieApp.ChartText[l], num6);
					}
				}
				ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.ChartLayer;
				if (pieApp.Labels.Format != PieLabelFormat.None)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint2.Value;
					object percent = (ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = num6);
					wedge.Percent = percent;
					string labelStr = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, pieApp.Labels.FormatString);
					if (useMinMax)
					{
						if (minVisible <= num4 && maxVisible >= num4)
						{
							AddTextLabelsToScene(scene, labelStr, pieApp, center, completeRadius, innerRadius, outerRadius, num3 + num7 / 2.0, array[k]);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						AddTextLabelsToScene(scene, labelStr, pieApp, center, completeRadius, innerRadius, outerRadius, num3 + num7 / 2.0, array[k]);
					}
				}
				num3 += num7;
			}
			if (othersCumulativeTotal > 0.0 && pieApp.OthersCategoryPercent > 0.0)
			{
				double num6 = Math.Abs(othersCumulativeTotal) * 100.0 / num2;
				double num7 = Axis.dataToAngleLinear(0.0, num2, 0.0, Math.PI * 2.0, Math.Abs(othersCumulativeTotal));
				Point location2 = new Point(center.X, center.Y);
				int radius2 = outerRadius;
				int completeRadius2 = totalRadius;
				if (flag)
				{
					radius2 = outerRadius - (int)((double)(pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage * outerRadius) / 100.0);
					completeRadius2 = totalRadius - (int)((double)(pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage * outerRadius) / 100.0);
				}
				if (pieApp.BreakAllSlices || pieApp.BreakOthersSlice)
				{
					location2 = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage, num3 + num7 / 2.0);
				}
				Wedge wedge2 = new Wedge(location2, radius2, (float)Geometry.RadianToDegree(num3), (float)Geometry.RadianToDegree(num7));
				if (wedge2.Tags == null)
				{
					wedge2.Tags = new Hashtable();

		internal static int GetPieColumnIndex(IChartData data, int columnIndexSetting)
		{
			if (data is IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter)
			{
				if (columnIndexSetting == -1)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
					{
						if (data.IsColumnNumeric(i))
						{
							return i;
						}
					}
					return columnIndexSetting;
				}
				return Math.Max(0, chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(columnIndexSetting));
			}
			if (data is ChartDemoData)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return columnIndexSetting;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			Point center = new Point(outerBounds.X + outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height / 2);
			pieLabelList.Clear();
			totalVal = 0.0;
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance = (PieChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			sliceCount = 0;
			IList onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices = pieChartAppearance.GetOnlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices();
			IChartDataFilter filter = ChartData as IChartDataFilter;
			int num = GetPieColumnIndex(ChartData, pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex);
			int num2 = 15;
			int num3 = (pieChartAppearance.Labels.Visible ? num2 : 0);
			int num4 = ((outerBounds.Width < outerBounds.Height) ? outerBounds.Width : outerBounds.Height) / 2 - num3;
			num4 = num4 * pieChartAppearance.RadiusFactor / 100;
			if (pieChartAppearance.Concentric)
			{
				int num5 = (int)((double)num4 * ((double)innerRadius / 100.0));
				int num6 = num4 - num5;
				int num7;
				int num8;
				if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
				{
					num = 0;
					num7 = (num8 = seriesCollection.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					num8 = data.GetColumnCount();
					num7 = num8 - num;
				}
				if (num7 == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num9 = num6 / num7;
				double num10 = num9 * pieChartAppearance.ConcentricSpacing;
				double num11 = ((double)num6 - num10 * (double)num7) / (double)num7;
				int num12 = 0;
				while (num < num8)
				{
					int outerRadius = (int)((double)num4 - (double)num12 * num11 - (double)num12 * num10);
					int num13 = (int)((double)num4 - (double)(num12 + 1) * num11 - (double)num12 * num10);
					if (num == num8 - 1)
					{
						num13 = (int)((double)num4 * ((double)innerRadius / 100.0));
					}
					RenderRing(num, outerRadius, num13, num4, pieChartAppearance, center, onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices, filter, minValue, maxValue, useMinMax, scene);
					num++;
					num12++;
				}
				DrawLabels();
			}
			else
			{
				RenderRing(num, num4, innerRadius, num4, pieChartAppearance, center, onlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices, filter, minValue, maxValue, useMinMax, scene);
				DrawLabels();
			}
		}

		private void putText(Wedge b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance, double dataPercentage)
		{
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = dataPercentage;
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Point pos = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(b1.Center, (b1.RadiusInner + b1.Radius) * chartTextAppearance.PositionFromRadius / 100, Geometry.DegreeToRadian(b1.startAngle + b1.angleSweep / 2f));
			Text value = new Text(pos, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
		}

		public double RadianToDegree(double theta)
		{
			double num;
			for (num = Math.Round(theta * 180.0 / Math.PI, 2); num > 360.0; num -= 360.0)
			{
			}
			for (; num < 0.0; num += 360.0)
			{
			}
			return num;
		}

		[Obsolete("Please use Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Geometry.DegreeToRadian instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return Geometry.DegreeToRadian(degree);
		}

		private void AddTextLabels(Rectangle bounds, SceneGraph scene, string labelStr, PieChartAppearance pieApp, Point center, int completeRadius, int innerRadius, int outerRadius, double theta, bool breakSlice)
		{
			int x = Math.Max(OuterBound.Left - bounds.Left, 0) - Math.Max(bounds.Right - OuterBound.Right, 0);
			int y = Math.Max(OuterBound.Top - bounds.Top, 0) - Math.Max(bounds.Bottom - OuterBound.Bottom, 0);
			bounds.Offset(x, y);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = fontDef;
			labelStyle.FontColor = pieApp.Labels.FontColor;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			Text text = new Text(bounds, labelStr, labelStyle);
			if (pieApp.Labels.LeaderLinesVisible)
			{
				int num = (innerRadius + outerRadius) / 2;
				if (breakSlice)
				{
					num += pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage;
					completeRadius += pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage;
				}
				double[] array = new double[4]
				{
					Math.Sqrt((Math.Abs(center.X - bounds.Left) ^ 2) + (Math.Abs(center.Y - bounds.Top) ^ 2)),
					Math.Sqrt((Math.Abs(center.X - bounds.Right) ^ 2) + (Math.Abs(center.Y - bounds.Top) ^ 2)),
					Math.Sqrt((Math.Abs(center.X - bounds.Right) ^ 2) + (Math.Abs(center.Y - bounds.Bottom) ^ 2)),
					Math.Sqrt((Math.Abs(center.X - bounds.Left) ^ 2) + (Math.Abs(center.Y - bounds.Bottom) ^ 2))
				};
				double num2 = double.MaxValue;
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i] < num2)
					{
						num2 = array[i];
						num3 = i;
					}
				}
				Point p = Point.Empty;
				switch (num3)
				{
				case 0:
					p = new Point(bounds.Left, (bounds.Top + bounds.Bottom) / 2);
					break;
				case 1:
					p = new Point(bounds.Right, (bounds.Top + bounds.Bottom) / 2);
					break;
				case 2:
					p = new Point(bounds.Right, (bounds.Top + bounds.Bottom) / 2);
					break;
				case 3:
					p = new Point(bounds.Left, (bounds.Top + bounds.Bottom) / 2);
					break;
				}
				Point p2 = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, num, theta);
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
				lineStyle.DrawStyle = pieApp.Labels.LeaderDrawStyle;
				lineStyle.EndStyle = pieApp.Labels.LeaderEndStyle;
				Line line = new Line(p2, p, lineStyle);
				if (pieApp.Labels.LeaderLineColor != Color.Empty)
				{
					line.PE.Stroke = pieApp.Labels.LeaderLineColor;
				}
				line.PE.StrokeWidth = pieApp.Labels.LeaderLineThickness;
				line.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(line);
			}
			Box box = new Box(bounds, new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, pieApp.Labels.BorderDrawStyle));
			box.PE.StrokeOpacity = pieApp.Labels.BorderColor.A;
			box.PE.Stroke = pieApp.Labels.BorderColor;
			box.PE.StrokeWidth = pieApp.Labels.BorderThickness;
			box.PE.Fill = pieApp.Labels.FillColor;
			box.PE.FillOpacity = pieApp.Labels.FillColor.A;
			if (pieApp.Labels.BorderThickness == 0)
			{
				box.PE.Stroke = pieApp.Labels.FillColor;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = pieApp.Labels.FillColor.A;
			}
			box.Path = Path;
			scene.Add(box);
			text.Path = Path;
			if (pieApp.Labels.Visible)
			{
				scene.Add(text);
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance = (PieChartAppearance)GetAppearance();

			if (pieChartAppearance.ColumnIndex != -1 && (num >= data.GetColumnCount() || num < 0 || !data.IsColumnNumeric(num)))

				columnIndexIsValid = false;
			}
		}

		private void AddTextLabelsToSceneList(SceneGraph scene, string labelStr, PieChartAppearance pieApp, Point center, int completeRadius, int innerRadius, int outerRadius, double theta, bool breakSlice)
		{
			PieLabel pieLabel = new PieLabel();
			pieLabel.scene = scene;
			pieLabel.labelStr = labelStr;
			pieLabel.pieApp = pieApp;
			pieLabel.center = center;
			pieLabel.breakSlice = breakSlice;
			pieLabel.completeRadius = completeRadius;
			if (breakSlice)
			{
				pieLabel.completeRadius += pieApp.BreakDistancePercentage * outerRadius / 100;
			}
			pieLabel.innerRadius = innerRadius;
			pieLabel.outerRadius = outerRadius;
			if (Math.Abs(theta) > Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				int num = (int)(theta / (Math.PI * 2.0));
				theta -= (double)num * (Math.PI * 2.0);
			}
			pieLabel.theta = theta;
			pieLabelList.Add(pieLabel);
		}

		private void DrawLabels()
		{
			fontDef = new Font(((PieChartAppearance)GetAppearance()).Labels.Font, ((PieChartAppearance)GetAppearance()).Labels.Font.Style);
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				CalcOldPosition();
				flag = CalcYPositions();
				if (flag)
				{
					fontDef = new Font(fontDef.Name, fontDef.Size - 1f, fontDef.Style);
				}
			}
			while (!(fontDef.Size <= 1f) && flag);
			CalcOldPosition();
			flag = CalcYPositions();
			Point center = new Point(OuterBound.Left + OuterBound.Width / 2, OuterBound.Top + OuterBound.Height / 2);
			fontDef = ResolveOverlaps(fontDef, center, pieLabelList, OuterBound);
			foreach (PieLabel pieLabel in pieLabelList)
			{
				AddTextLabels(pieLabel.bounds, pieLabel.scene, pieLabel.labelStr, pieLabel.pieApp, pieLabel.center, pieLabel.completeRadius, pieLabel.innerRadius, pieLabel.outerRadius, pieLabel.theta, pieLabel.breakSlice);
			}
		}

		internal static Font ResolveOverlaps(Font fontDef, Point center, ArrayList pieLabelList, Rectangle outerBound)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			string str = "";
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (PieLabel pieLabel6 in pieLabelList)
			{
				if (pieLabel6.bounds.Left < center.X)
				{
					arrayList.Add(pieLabel6);
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList2.Add(pieLabel6);
				}
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(pieLabel6.labelStr, fontDef);
				if (stringSizePixels.Height > num)
				{
					num = stringSizePixels.Height;
					str = pieLabel6.labelStr;
				}
			}
			SizeF stringSizePixels2;
			int num2;
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				stringSizePixels2 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(str, fontDef);
				stringSizePixels2.Height += 2f;
				num2 = (int)((double)outerBound.Height / (double)stringSizePixels2.Height);
				flag = num2 >= arrayList.Count && num2 >= arrayList2.Count;
				if (!flag)
				{
					fontDef = new Font(fontDef.Name, Math.Max(fontDef.Size - 1f, 0.1f), fontDef.Style);
				}
			}
			while (!(fontDef.Size <= 1f) && !flag);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				return fontDef;
			}
			Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] array = new Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[num2];
			Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] array2 = new Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[num2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				int y = (int)((float)outerBound.Top + (float)i * stringSizePixels2.Height);
				Point pos = new Point(outerBound.Left + 10, y);
				Point pos2 = new Point(outerBound.Right - 10, y);
				array[i] = new Pie3DLayer.TextSlot(pos);
				array2[i] = new Pie3DLayer.TextSlot(pos2);
			}
			if (array.Length > 0)
			{
				foreach (PieLabel item in arrayList)
				{
					int num3 = item.bounds.Y - outerBound.Top;
					int num4 = (int)((float)num3 / stringSizePixels2.Height);
					int num5 = (int)((float)num3 % stringSizePixels2.Height);
					if ((double)num5 >= (double)stringSizePixels2.Height / 2.0 && num4 + 1 < array.Length)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num4 = 0;
					}
					if (num4 >= array.Length)
					{
						num4 = array.Length - 1;
					}
					array[num4].Labels.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (array2.Length > 0)
			{
				foreach (PieLabel item2 in arrayList2)
				{
					int num6 = item2.bounds.Y - outerBound.Top;
					int num7 = (int)((float)num6 / stringSizePixels2.Height);
					int num8 = (int)((float)num6 % stringSizePixels2.Height);
					if ((double)num8 >= (double)stringSizePixels2.Height / 2.0 && num7 + 1 < array2.Length)
					{
						num7++;
					}
					if (num7 < 0)
					{
						num7 = 0;
					}
					if (num7 >= array.Length)
					{
						num7 = array.Length - 1;
					}
					array2[num7].Labels.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			Spread(array);
			Spread(array2);
			Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] array3 = array;
			foreach (Pie3DLayer.TextSlot textSlot in array3)
			{
				foreach (PieLabel label in textSlot.Labels)
				{
					label.bounds.Y = textSlot.Position.Y;
				}
			}
			Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] array4 = array2;
			foreach (Pie3DLayer.TextSlot textSlot2 in array4)
			{
				foreach (PieLabel label2 in textSlot2.Labels)
				{
					label2.bounds.Y = textSlot2.Position.Y;
				}
			}
			return fontDef;
		}

		internal static void Spread(Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] slots)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			while (!flag && num++ < 100)
			{
				flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
				{
					if (slots[i].Labels.Count > 1)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (i + 1 < slots.Length)
						{
							PushOneLabelUpFrom(slots, i);
						}
					}
				}
				for (int num2 = slots.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (slots[num2].Labels.Count > 1)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (num2 - 1 >= 0)
						{
							PushOneLabelDownFrom(slots, num2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void PushOneLabelUpFrom(Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] slots, int i)
		{
			PieLabel pieLabel = (PieLabel)slots[i].Labels[0];
			foreach (PieLabel label in slots[i].Labels)
			{
				if (label.bounds.Y > pieLabel.bounds.Y)
				{
					pieLabel = label;
				}
			}
			slots[i].Labels.Remove(pieLabel);
			slots[i + 1].Labels.Add(pieLabel);
		}

		internal static void PushOneLabelDownFrom(Pie3DLayer.TextSlot[] slots, int i)
		{
			PieLabel pieLabel = (PieLabel)slots[i].Labels[0];
			foreach (PieLabel label in slots[i].Labels)
			{
				if (label.bounds.Y < pieLabel.bounds.Y)
				{
					pieLabel = label;
				}
			}
			slots[i].Labels.Remove(pieLabel);
			slots[i - 1].Labels.Add(pieLabel);
		}

		private void CalcOldPosition()
		{
			foreach (PieLabel pieLabel in pieLabelList)
			{
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(pieLabel.labelStr, fontDef);
				stringSizePixels.Width += 2f;
				stringSizePixels.Height += 2f;
				pieLabel.textRadius = (int)((double)pieLabel.completeRadius * 1.3);
				if (pieLabel.theta >= Math.PI / 2.0 && pieLabel.theta <= 4.71238898038469)
				{
					Point point = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(pieLabel.center, pieLabel.textRadius, pieLabel.theta);
					pieLabel.bounds = new Rectangle(new Point((int)((float)point.X - stringSizePixels.Width), (int)((float)point.Y - stringSizePixels.Height / 2f)), stringSizePixels.ToSize());
				}
				else
				{
					Point point2 = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(pieLabel.center, pieLabel.textRadius, pieLabel.theta);
					pieLabel.bounds = new Rectangle(new Point(point2.X, (int)((float)point2.Y - stringSizePixels.Height / 2f)), stringSizePixels.ToSize());
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CalcYPositions()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			int num2 = 0;
			PieRow pieRow = default(PieRow);
			foreach (PieLabel pieLabel in pieLabelList)
			{
				if (pieLabel.theta < Math.PI / 2.0 || pieLabel.theta > 4.71238898038469)
				{
					pieRow.Y = pieLabel.bounds.Y + pieLabel.bounds.Height / 2;
					pieRow.Number = 1;
					pieRow.Index = num2;
					arrayList.Add(pieRow);
					num = pieLabel.bounds.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					pieRow.Y = pieLabel.bounds.Y + pieLabel.bounds.Height / 2;
					pieRow.Number = 1;
					pieRow.Index = num2;
					arrayList2.Add(pieRow);
					num = pieLabel.bounds.Height;
				}
				num2++;
			}
			SortLabels(arrayList);
			SortLabels(arrayList2);
			bool flag = ArrangeLabels(arrayList, num);
			bool flag2 = ArrangeLabels(arrayList2, num);
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			Rectangle rect = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (pieLabelList.Count > 0)
			{
				empty = ((PieLabel)pieLabelList[0]).center;
				int num3 = (int)((double)((PieLabel)pieLabelList[0]).completeRadius * 2.5);
				rect = new Rectangle(empty.X - num3 / 2, empty.Y - num3 / 2, num3, num3);
			}
			if ((double)rect.Height < (double)arrayList2.Count * num || (double)rect.Height < (double)arrayList.Count * num)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (flag2 || flag)
			{
				TrimLabel(arrayList, num, rect);
				TrimLabel(arrayList2, num, rect);
				foreach (PieRow item in arrayList)
				{
					((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item.Index]).bounds.Y = (int)(item.Y - num / 2.0);
					((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item.Index]).bounds.X = CalcXPosition((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item.Index]);
				}
				foreach (PieRow item2 in arrayList2)
				{
					((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item2.Index]).bounds.Y = (int)(item2.Y - num / 2.0);
					((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item2.Index]).bounds.X = CalcXPosition((PieLabel)pieLabelList[item2.Index]);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void TrimLabel(ArrayList labels, double height, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((PieRow)labels[0]).Y < (double)rect.Y)
			{
				double num = (double)rect.Y - ((PieRow)labels[0]).Y;
				for (int i = 0; i <= labels.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					PieRow pieRow = (PieRow)labels[i];
					pieRow.Y += num;
					labels[i] = pieRow;
					if (i < labels.Count - 1)
					{
						if (((PieRow)labels[i]).Y + height < ((PieRow)labels[i + 1]).Y)
						{
							break;
						}
						num = ((PieRow)labels[i]).Y + height - ((PieRow)labels[i + 1]).Y;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!(((PieRow)labels[labels.Count - 1]).Y + height > (double)rect.Bottom))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = ((PieRow)labels[labels.Count - 1]).Y + height - (double)rect.Bottom;
			for (int num3 = labels.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				PieRow pieRow2 = (PieRow)labels[num3];
				pieRow2.Y -= num2;
				labels[num3] = pieRow2;
				if (num3 > 0)
				{
					if (((PieRow)labels[num3]).Y > ((PieRow)labels[num3 - 1]).Y + height)
					{
						break;
					}
					num2 = ((PieRow)labels[num3 - 1]).Y + height - ((PieRow)labels[num3]).Y;
				}
			}
		}

		private int CalcXPosition(PieLabel label)
		{
			double num = (double)Math.Abs(label.center.Y - label.bounds.Y) / ((double)label.textRadius * 1.2);
			num = ((num > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num);
			num = ((num < -1.0) ? (-1.0) : num);
			double d = Math.Asin(num);
			if (label.theta >= Math.PI / 2.0 && label.theta <= 4.71238898038469)
			{
				return (int)((double)(label.center.X - label.bounds.Width) - (double)label.textRadius * Math.Cos(d));
			}
			return (int)((double)label.center.X + (double)label.textRadius * Math.Cos(d));
		}

		private bool ArrangeLabels(ArrayList rows, double height)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				double y = ((PieRow)rows[i]).Y;
				double num2 = (double)((PieRow)rows[i]).Number * height;
				double y2 = ((PieRow)rows[i + 1]).Y;
				double num3 = (double)((PieRow)rows[i + 1]).Number * height;
				if (y + num2 / 2.0 > y2 - num3 / 2.0)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int j = 0; j < rows.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != num && j != num + 1)
				{
					PieRow pieRow = (PieRow)rows[j];
					arrayList.Add(pieRow);
				}
				else if (j == num)
				{
					PieRow pieRow2 = (PieRow)rows[j];
					PieRow pieRow3 = (PieRow)rows[j + 1];
					arrayList.Add(new PieRow
					{
						Y = (pieRow2.Y * (double)pieRow2.Number + pieRow3.Y * (double)pieRow3.Number) / (double)(pieRow2.Number + pieRow3.Number),
						Number = pieRow2.Number + pieRow3.Number
					});
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				ArrangeLabels(arrayList, height);
				for (int k = 0; k < rows.Count; k++)
				{
					if (k != num && k != num + 1)
					{
						if (k < num)
						{
							rows[k] = (PieRow)arrayList[k];
						}
						else
						{
							rows[k] = (PieRow)arrayList[k - 1];
						}
					}
					else if (k == num)
					{
						PieRow pieRow4 = (PieRow)rows[num];
						PieRow pieRow5 = (PieRow)rows[num + 1];
						PieRow pieRow6 = (PieRow)arrayList[num];
						pieRow4.Y = pieRow6.Y - (double)pieRow6.Number * height / 2.0 + (double)pieRow4.Number * height / 2.0;
						rows[num] = pieRow4;
						pieRow5.Y = pieRow6.Y - (double)pieRow6.Number * height / 2.0 + (double)pieRow4.Number * height + (double)pieRow5.Number * height / 2.0;
						rows[num + 1] = pieRow5;
					}
				}
			}
			return num != -1;
		}

		private void SortLabels(ArrayList rows)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				for (int j = i + 1; j < rows.Count; j++)
				{
					PieRow pieRow = (PieRow)rows[i];
					PieRow pieRow2 = (PieRow)rows[j];
					if (pieRow.Y > pieRow2.Y)
					{
						PieRow pieRow3 = pieRow;
						rows[i] = pieRow2;
						rows[j] = pieRow3;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private readonly int drillBoxHeight = 10;

		public DrillLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)

			drillBoxColor = Color.Green;
			drillBoxAlign = ContentAlignment.TopLeft;

		public DrillLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, Color itsColor)
			: base(component, core)

			drillBoxAlign = ContentAlignment.TopLeft;

			: base(component, core)

			drillBoxColor = itsColor;
			drillBoxAlign = itsAlign;
			if (itsAlign != ContentAlignment.TopLeft)

				throw new NotSupportedException("Only ContentAlignment.TopLeft is supported by DrillLayer() constructor.");

			{
				Point topLeft = Point.Empty;
				ContentAlignment contentAlignment = drillBoxAlign;
				if (contentAlignment == ContentAlignment.TopLeft)
				{
					topLeft = outerBounds.Location;
				}
				Box box = new Box(topLeft, drillBoxWidth, drillBoxHeight);
				box.Path = "Drill.Prev";
				box.PE.Fill = drillBoxColor;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = drillBoxColor.A;
				box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
				scene.Add(box);
			}
		}

	public abstract class HierarchicalLayer : ChartLayer, IPointsInOthers
	{
		internal class GetFunnelPointsResult
		{
			private double _Total;

			private NumericDataPointCollection _Points;

			private NumericSeries _Series;
