		internal static GetFunnelPointsResult GetFunnelPoints(IChartData data, string othersCategoryText, double othersCategoryPercent, SortStyle sort, NumericDataPointCollection pointsInOthers, LabelStyle labelStyle, DataAppearance dataApp, ChartCore chartCore, string labelsFormatString)
		{
			GetFunnelPointsResult getFunnelPointsResult = new GetFunnelPointsResult();
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					getFunnelPointsResult.Series = item as NumericSeries;
					if (getFunnelPointsResult.Series != null)
					{
						getFunnelPointsResult.OthersRow = getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Points.Count;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (getFunnelPointsResult.Series == null)
			{
				getFunnelPointsResult.Series = new NumericSeries();
				getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Label = data.GetColumnLabel(0) as string;
				int num = (getFunnelPointsResult.OthersRow = data.GetRowCount());
				int num2 = num;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
					object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(i, 0);
					double result = double.NaN;
					if (objectValue != null)
					{
						if (objectValue is IConvertible)
						{
							result = Convert.ToDouble(objectValue);
						}
						else
						{
							numericDataPoint.Empty |= double.TryParse(objectValue.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
						}
					}
					if (dataApp == null || !dataApp.UseMinMax || (!(result < dataApp.MinValue) && !(result > dataApp.MaxValue)))
					{
						numericDataPoint.Value = result;
						numericDataPoint.Empty |= objectValue == null;
						object rowLabel = data.GetRowLabel(i);
						if (rowLabel != null)
						{
							numericDataPoint.Label = rowLabel.ToString();
						}
						getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Points.Add(numericDataPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			getFunnelPointsResult.Total = 0.0;
			getFunnelPointsResult.Max = double.MinValue;
			foreach (NumericDataPoint point in getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Points)
			{
				bool flag = dataApp != null && dataApp.UseMinMax && (point.Value < dataApp.MinValue || point.Value > dataApp.MaxValue);
				if (!point.Empty && !flag)
				{
					getFunnelPointsResult.Total += point.Value;
				}
			}
			getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
			getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint.Label = othersCategoryText;
			getFunnelPointsResult.WidestLabel = int.MinValue;
			NumericDataPointCollection numericDataPointCollection = new NumericDataPointCollection();
			chartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Label;
			chartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Points.Count; j++)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint3 = getFunnelPointsResult.Series.Points[j];
				bool flag2 = dataApp != null && dataApp.UseMinMax && (numericDataPoint3.Value < dataApp.MinValue || numericDataPoint3.Value > dataApp.MaxValue);
				if (!numericDataPoint3.Empty && !flag2)
				{
					if (numericDataPoint3.Value <= othersCategoryPercent * 0.01 * getFunnelPointsResult.Total)
					{
						getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint.Value += numericDataPoint3.Value;
						pointsInOthers.Add(numericDataPoint3);
						continue;
					}
					numericDataPointCollection.Add(numericDataPoint3);
					chartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = j;
					chartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = numericDataPoint3.Label;
					chartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint3.Value;
					SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartCore.Environment, labelsFormatString), labelStyle);
					getFunnelPointsResult.WidestLabel = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(getFunnelPointsResult.WidestLabel, labelSizePixels.Width));
					getFunnelPointsResult.Max = Math.Max(getFunnelPointsResult.Max, numericDataPoint3.Value);
				}
			}
			if (getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint.Value != 0.0)
			{
				numericDataPointCollection.Add(getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint);
				chartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint.Label;
				SizeF labelSizePixels2 = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartCore.Environment, labelsFormatString), labelStyle);
				getFunnelPointsResult.WidestLabel = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(getFunnelPointsResult.WidestLabel, labelSizePixels2.Width));
				getFunnelPointsResult.Max = Math.Max(getFunnelPointsResult.Max, getFunnelPointsResult.OthersPoint.Value);
			}
			getFunnelPointsResult.Points = new NumericDataPointCollection();
			getFunnelPointsResult.Points.AddRange(numericDataPointCollection.ToArray());
			switch (sort)
			{
			case SortStyle.Ascending:
				getFunnelPointsResult.Points.Sort();
				break;
			case SortStyle.Descending:
				getFunnelPointsResult.Points.Sort();
				getFunnelPointsResult.Points.Reverse();
				break;
			}
			return getFunnelPointsResult;
		}

		protected abstract double GetRadiusMax();

		protected abstract double GetRadiusMin();

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			PointsInOthers.Clear();
			HierarchicalChartAppearance hierarchicalChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as HierarchicalChartAppearance;
			GetFunnelPointsResult funnelPoints = GetFunnelPoints(ChartData, hierarchicalChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText, hierarchicalChartAppearance.OthersCategoryPercent, hierarchicalChartAppearance.Sort, PointsInOthers, hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle, ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance, ChartCore, hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.FormatString);
			if (funnelPoints.Points.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_OthersPoint = funnelPoints.OthersPoint;
			Rectangle labelBounds;
			Rectangle funnelBounds;
			if (hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.Visible)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(OuterBound.Width / 2, funnelPoints.WidestLabel);
				int height = OuterBound.Height;
				switch (hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.Location)
				{
				case FunnelLabelLocation.Left:
					labelBounds = new Rectangle(OuterBound.Left, OuterBound.Top, num, height);
					funnelBounds = new Rectangle(OuterBound.Left + labelBounds.Width, OuterBound.Top, OuterBound.Width - num, OuterBound.Height);
					break;
				default:
					labelBounds = new Rectangle(OuterBound.Right - num, OuterBound.Top, num, height);
					funnelBounds = new Rectangle(OuterBound.Left, OuterBound.Top, OuterBound.Width - num, OuterBound.Height);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				labelBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				funnelBounds = OuterBound;
			}
			double num2 = (double)funnelBounds.Width * GetRadiusMax();
			double num3 = (double)funnelBounds.Width * GetRadiusMin();
			NumericRuler numericRuler = new NumericRuler(0.0, funnelPoints.Total);
			numericRuler.MapMinimum = 0.0;
			numericRuler.MapMaximum = funnelBounds.Height;
			NumericRuler numericRuler2 = new NumericRuler(0.0, funnelPoints.Max);
			numericRuler2.MapMinimum = num3;
			numericRuler2.MapMaximum = num2 / 2.0;
			double num4 = (num2 / 2.0 - num3 / 2.0) / (double)funnelPoints.Series.Points.Count;
			double num5 = funnelBounds.Height / funnelPoints.Series.Points.Count;
			double num6 = ((hierarchicalChartAppearance.Sort != SortStyle.Ascending) ? (num2 / 2.0) : ((!(num3 > 0.0) || hierarchicalChartAppearance.Axis == HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightAndRadius || hierarchicalChartAppearance.Axis == HierarchicalChartAxis.Radius) ? (num3 / 2.0) : (num2 / 2.0)));
			double num7 = funnelBounds.Top;
			IList<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
			IList<Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Tuple<Text, Primitive>> list2 = new List<Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Tuple<Text, Primitive>>();
			ChartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = funnelPoints.Series.Label;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < funnelPoints.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = funnelPoints.Points[i];
				if (!numericDataPoint.Empty)
				{
					double num8 = num6;
					double num9 = num7;
					double num10 = numericRuler.Map(numericDataPoint.Value);
					double num11 = numericRuler2.Map(numericDataPoint.Value);
					double num12;
					double num13;
					switch (hierarchicalChartAppearance.Axis)
					{
					case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithRadiusIncrementConstant:
						num12 = num8 - num4;
						num13 = num9 + num10;
						break;
					case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightAndRadius:
						num12 = num11;
						num13 = num9 + num10;
						break;
					case HierarchicalChartAxis.Radius:
						num12 = num11;
						num13 = num9 + num5;
						break;
					case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithSlopeConstant:
					{
						num13 = num9 + num10;
						double num14 = num13 - num9;
						double num15 = num14 / (double)OuterBound.Height;
						double num16 = (num2 - num3) / 2.0;
						double num17 = num15 * num16;
						num12 = num8 - num17;
						break;
					}
					default:
						num12 = 1.0;
						num13 = 1.0;
						break;
					}
					double num18 = (num13 - num9) * hierarchicalChartAppearance.Spacing / 2.0;
					num9 += num18;
					num13 -= num18;
					int num19 = ((numericDataPoint != funnelPoints.OthersPoint) ? funnelPoints.Series.Points.IndexOf(numericDataPoint) : funnelPoints.OthersRow);
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = num19;
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = numericDataPoint.Label;
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint.Value;
					ChartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint.Value / funnelPoints.Total * 100.0;
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Tuple<Text, Primitive> tuple = AddPart(scene, num8, num12, num9, num13, num19, 0, numericDataPoint, funnelPoints.Series, funnelBounds, labelBounds, hierarchicalChartAppearance);
					if (tuple.Item1 != null)
					{
						list.Add(tuple.Item1.bounds);
						list2.Add(tuple);
					}
					num13 += num18;
					num6 = num12;
					num7 = num13;
				}
			}
			if (hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle.FontSizeBestFit)
			{
				list = Geometry.OptimizeRectanglesHeightPositions(list, innerBounds);
			}
			double[] array = Geometry.OptimizedRectanglesVerticalPositions(list, innerBounds);
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				Text item = list2[j].Item1;
				double num20 = array[j];
				double num21 = (double)list[j].Height / 2.0;
				item.bounds.Y = (int)(num20 - num21);
				item.bounds.Height = list[j].Height;
				int y = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round((double)item.bounds.Y + num21));
				if (list2[j].Item2 != null)
				{
					if (hierarchicalChartAppearance.Labels.LeaderLineStyle.MidPointAnchors)
					{
						Polyline polyline = (Polyline)list2[j].Item2;
						polyline.points[polyline.points.Length - 1].point.Y = y;
					}
					else
					{
						Line line = (Line)list2[j].Item2;
						line.p2.Y = y;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Tuple<Text, Primitive> AddPart(SceneGraph scene, double startRadius, double endRadius, double startLoc, double endLoc, int row, int col, NumericDataPoint dataPoint, NumericSeries series, Rectangle funnelBounds, Rectangle labelBounds, HierarchicalChartAppearance funnelApp)
		{
			if (dataPoint == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataPoint");
			}
			Text text = null;
			Primitive item = null;
			int num = funnelBounds.Left + funnelBounds.Width / 2;
			int num2 = (int)((double)num - startRadius);
			int num3 = (int)((double)num + startRadius);
			int num4 = (int)((double)num - endRadius);
			int num5 = (int)((double)num + endRadius);
			int num6 = (int)startLoc;
			int num7 = (int)endLoc;
			Point point = new Point(num2, num6);
			Point point2 = new Point(num3, num6);
			Point point3 = new Point(num5, num7);
			Point point4 = new Point(num4, num7);
			Point[] points = new Point[5] { point, point2, point3, point4, point };
			Polygon polygon = new Polygon(points);
			polygon.PE = new PaintElement(Color.Red);
			polygon.PE.FillOpacity = 150;
			polygon.PE.Stroke = Color.Blue;
			polygon.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			polygon.Chart = ForChartType;
			polygon.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			polygon.Series = series;
			polygon.Empty = dataPoint.Empty;
			polygon.Layer = this;
			polygon.Path = Path;
			polygon.Row = row;
			polygon.Column = col;
			polygon.Value = dataPoint.Value;
			polygon.PE = GetPE(polygon, polygon.DataPoint, polygon.Series);
			scene.Add(polygon);
			int num8 = Math.Min(point.X, Math.Min(point4.X, Math.Min(point2.X, point3.X)));
			int num9 = Math.Min(point.Y, Math.Min(point4.Y, Math.Min(point2.Y, point3.Y)));
			int num10 = Math.Max(point.X, Math.Max(point4.X, Math.Max(point2.X, point3.X)));
			int num11 = Math.Max(point.Y, Math.Max(point4.Y, Math.Max(point2.Y, point3.Y)));
			int width = num10 - num8;
			int height = num11 - num9;
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(num8, num9, width, height);
			foreach (ChartTextAppearance item2 in funnelApp.ChartText)
			{
				if (item2.Visible && item2.Match(row, 0))
				{
					string text2 = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(ChartCore.Environment, item2.ItemFormatString);
					Text value = new Text(bounds, text2, new LabelStyle(item2.ChartTextFont, item2.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, item2.HorizontalAlign, item2.VerticalAlign, TextOrientation.Horizontal));
					scene.Add(value);
				}
			}
			if (funnelApp.Labels.Visible)
			{
				string text3 = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(ChartCore.Environment, funnelApp.Labels.FormatString);
				LabelStyle style = funnelApp.Labels.LabelStyle.Clone();
				Size size = Size.Round(Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text3, style));
				int y = num6 + (num7 - num6) / 2 - size.Height / 2;
				text = new Text(new Rectangle(labelBounds.Left, y, size.Width, size.Height), text3, style);
				scene.Add(text);
				TextOrientation orientation = text.labelStyle.Orientation;
				if (orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && text.labelStyle.RotationAngle % 90 != 0)
				{
					text.bounds = new Rectangle(text.bounds.Left + text.bounds.Width / 2, text.bounds.Top + text.bounds.Height / 2, 0, 0);
				}
				Rectangle actualBounds = text.GetActualBounds();
				int y2 = num7 - (num7 - num6) / 2;
				int y3 = actualBounds.Bottom - (actualBounds.Bottom - actualBounds.Top) / 2;
				int num14;
				int num15;
				bool flag;
				switch (funnelApp.Labels.Location)
				{
				case FunnelLabelLocation.Left:
				{
					int num16 = Math.Min(num4, num5);
					int num17 = Math.Min(num2, num3);
					num14 = text.bounds.Right;
					num15 = num16 - (num16 - num17) / 2;
					flag = num14 < num15 - 1;
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					int num12 = Math.Max(num5, num4);
					int num13 = Math.Max(num3, num2);
					num14 = text.bounds.Left;
					num15 = num12 - (num12 - num13) / 2;
					flag = num15 < num14 - 1;
					break;
				}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Point point5 = new Point(num15, y2);
					Point point6 = new Point(num14, y3);
					Primitive primitive;
					if (funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineStyle.MidPointAnchors)
					{
						DataPoint[] points2 = new DataPoint[3]
						{
							new DataPoint(point5),
							new DataPoint(new Point((point5.X + point6.X) / 2, (point5.Y + point6.Y) / 2)),
							new DataPoint(point6)
						};
						primitive = new Polyline(points2, funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineStyle);
					}
					else
					{
						primitive = new Line(point5, point6, funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineStyle);
					}
					if (funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineColor == Color.Empty)
					{
						PaintElement pE = primitive.PE;
						Color stroke = (primitive.PE.Fill = polygon.PE.Fill);
						pE.Stroke = stroke;
					}
					else
					{
						PaintElement pE2 = primitive.PE;
						Color stroke2 = (primitive.PE.Fill = funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineColor);
						pE2.Stroke = stroke2;
					}
					primitive.PE.StrokeWidth = funnelApp.Labels.LeaderLineThickness;
					scene.Add(primitive);
					item = primitive;
				}
			}
			return new Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Tuple<Text, Primitive>(text, item);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_20062_57");
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				{
					foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
					{
						if (!(item is NumericSeries numericSeries))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries.Points)
						{
							if (point.Value < 0.0)
							{
								dataIsValid = false;
								break;
							}
						}
						dataIsValid = dataIsValid;
						break;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			dataIsValid &= data.GetDataMinColumn(0) >= 0.0;
		}
	}

	public class GanttLayer : ChartLayer

		{

			{
				return SR.GetString("SR_1038");
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1037");
		}

		{

			if (appearance != null)

			if (ganttDataAdapter == null && ChartData is ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter)
			{
				ganttDataAdapter = chartDataFilter.GetRawData() as GanttDataAdapter;
			}
			if (ganttDataAdapter != null)

			dataIsValid = GanttData != null && GanttData.Series.HasTimeEntries;
		}

		private void InitializeGanttDataForCompositeChart()
		{
			if (!(data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection))
			{
				return;
			}
			GanttDataSource ganttDataSource = new GanttDataSource();
			foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (item is GanttSeries)
				{
					ganttDataSource.Series.Add((GanttSeries)item);
				}
			}
			GanttData = ganttDataSource;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				InitializeGanttDataForCompositeChart();
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			GanttChartAppearance ganttAppearance = GanttAppearance;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)(Math.Abs(advanceAxis2.MapRange) / (double)advanceAxis2.WindowRange);
			double num2 = 0.5;
			int num3 = 0;
			GanttDataSource ganttData = GanttData;
			if (ganttData == null || ganttData.Series.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ganttData.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				num2 += (double)ganttAppearance.ItemSpacing / 2.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < ganttData.Series[i].Items.Count; j++)
				{
					int y = (int)(advanceAxis2.Map(num2) - (double)(num / 2));
					for (int k = 0; k < ganttData.Series[i].Items[j].Times.Count; k++)
					{
						GanttTimeEntry ganttTimeEntry = ganttData.Series[i].Items[j].Times[k];
						int num4 = (int)Math.Min(advanceAxis.MapMaximum, Math.Max(advanceAxis.MapMinimum, advanceAxis.Map(ganttTimeEntry.Start)));
						int num5 = (int)Math.Min(advanceAxis.MapMaximum, Math.Max(advanceAxis.MapMinimum, advanceAxis.Map(ganttTimeEntry.End)));
						int width = num5 - num4;
						Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(num4, y, width, num);
						Box box = new Box(rect);
						box.Row = i;
						box.Column = num3;
						box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
						box.Layer = this;
						box.Chart = ChartType.GanttChart;
						box.DataPoint = ganttData.Series[i].Items[j];
						box.Series = ganttData.Series[i];
						if (box.Tags == null)
						{
							box.Tags = new Hashtable();
						}
						box.Tags.Add("TIME_ENTRY_INDEX", k);
						box.Tags.Add("PERCENT_VALUE", ganttTimeEntry.PercentComplete);
						box.PE = GetPE(box, box.DataPoint, box.Series, swapRowsAndColumns: false);
						box.Value = new DateTime[2] { ganttTimeEntry.Start, ganttTimeEntry.End };
						arrayList.Add(box);
						arrayList2.Add(ganttTimeEntry);
						scene.Add(box);
						if (ganttAppearance.ShowCompletePercentages && ganttTimeEntry.PercentComplete > -1.0)
						{
							Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height / 4, rect.Width, rect.Height / 2);
							Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, (int)((double)rectangle.Width * (ganttTimeEntry.PercentComplete * 0.01)), rectangle.Height);
							Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(rect2.Right, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width - rect2.Width, rectangle.Height);
							Box box2 = new Box(rect2);
							box2.PE = ganttAppearance.CompletePercentagesPE;
							Box box3 = new Box(rect3);
							box3.PE = ganttAppearance.EmptyPercentagesPE;
							scene.Add(box2);
							scene.Add(box3);
						}
					}
					num3++;
					num2 += 1.0;
					if (j < ganttData.Series[i].Items.Count - 1)
					{
						num2 += (double)ganttAppearance.ItemSpacing;
					}
				}
				num2 += (double)ganttAppearance.ItemSpacing / 2.0;
				num2 += (double)ganttAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			}
			if (ganttAppearance.ShowLinks)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < arrayList2.Count; l++)
				{
					if (!(arrayList2[l] is GanttTimeEntry { LinkToID: >=0 } ganttTimeEntry2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Box box4 = arrayList[l] as Box;
					ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
					for (int m = 0; m < arrayList2.Count; m++)
					{
						if (arrayList2[m] is GanttTimeEntry ganttTimeEntry3 && ganttTimeEntry3.ID == ganttTimeEntry2.LinkToID && arrayList[m] is Box box5)
						{
							arrayList3.Add(new Point(box5.rect.X, box5.rect.Y + box5.rect.Height / 2));
						}
					}
					foreach (Point item in arrayList3)
					{
						DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(new Point(box4.rect.Right, box4.rect.Y + box4.rect.Height / 2));
						int num6 = item.X - dataPoint.point.X;
						int num7 = item.Y - dataPoint.point.Y;
						DataPoint dataPoint2 = new DataPoint(dataPoint.point.X + num6 / 2, dataPoint.point.Y);
						DataPoint dataPoint3 = new DataPoint(dataPoint2.point.X, dataPoint2.point.Y + num7);
						DataPoint dataPoint4 = new DataPoint(item);
						DataPoint[] points = new DataPoint[4] { dataPoint, dataPoint2, dataPoint3, dataPoint4 };
						Polyline polyline = new Polyline(points, ganttAppearance.LinkLineStyle);
						polyline.PE.Fill = ganttAppearance.LinkLineColor;
						polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = ganttAppearance.LinkLineWidth;
						scene.Add(polyline);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!ganttAppearance.ShowOwners)
			{
				return;
			}
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ClipText = true;
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			for (int n = 0; n < arrayList2.Count; n++)
			{
				GanttTimeEntry ganttTimeEntry4 = arrayList2[n] as GanttTimeEntry;
				if (ganttTimeEntry4.Owner != null && ganttTimeEntry4.Owner.Length > 0)
				{
					Rectangle rect4 = ((Box)arrayList[n]).rect;
					if (rect4.Width > 0)

						Point pos = new Point(rect4.X + rect4.Width / 2, rect4.Y + rect4.Height / 2);
						Text value = ((ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle.ClipText || ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle.WrapText || ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle.FontSizeBestFit) ? new Text(rect4, ganttTimeEntry4.Owner, ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle) : ((ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Horizontal) ? new Text(pos, ganttTimeEntry4.Owner, ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle) : (ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign switch
						{
							StringAlignment.Near => new Text(new Point(rect4.Left, pos.Y), ganttTimeEntry4.Owner, ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle), 
							StringAlignment.Far => new Text(new Point(rect4.Right, pos.Y), ganttTimeEntry4.Owner, ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle), 
							_ => new Text(pos, ganttTimeEntry4.Owner, ganttAppearance.OwnersLabelStyle), 
						})));
						scene.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext2 = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext2.ClipText = false;
			scene.Add(graphicsContext2);
		}

		public override PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns)
		{
			if (prim != null && prim.Tags != null && prim.Tags.ContainsKey("TIME_ENTRY_INDEX") && prim.Tags["TIME_ENTRY_INDEX"] is int && prim.DataPoint is GanttItem)
			{
				GanttItem ganttItem = (GanttItem)prim.DataPoint;
				int num = (int)prim.Tags["TIME_ENTRY_INDEX"];
				if (ganttItem.Times != null && ganttItem.Times.Count > num && ganttItem.Times[num].PE != null && ganttItem.Times[num].PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
				{
					return ganttItem.Times[num].PE;
				}
			}
			return base.GetPE(prim, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns);
		}

		{
			base.SetupDataFilter();
		}

	public abstract class LabelAxisBase : Axis
	{
		private double m_WindowInterval;

		private double m_WindowMinimum;

		private double m_WindowMaximum;

		private double _Minimum;

		private double _Maximum;

		public override object Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return _Minimum;
			}
			set
			{
				_Minimum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return _Maximum;
			}
			set
			{
				_Maximum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMinimum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowMaximum = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				CorrectScrollScale();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = double.Parse(value.ToString());
				if (m_WindowInterval > (double)WindowRange)
				{
					m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object WindowRange => m_WindowMaximum - m_WindowMinimum;

		public override object TotalRange => _Maximum - _Minimum;

		public override double IntervalPercentageWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)WindowRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)WindowRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override double IntervalPercentageTotal
		{
			get
			{
				return m_WindowInterval * 100.0 / (double)TotalRange;
			}
			set
			{
				m_WindowInterval = value * (double)TotalRange / 100.0;
			}
		}

		public override double NumericOf(object d_i)
		{
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(d_i);
			}
			catch
			{
				return MapMinimum;
			}
		}

		public override object InverseNumericOf(double d_i)
		{
			return d_i;
		}

		protected LabelAxisBase(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(component, core, axisNumber)
		{
		}

		private void CorrectScrollScale()
		{
			m_Scale = (double)WindowRange / (double)TotalRange;
			m_Scroll = (m_WindowMinimum - _Minimum) / ((1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange);
		}

		protected override void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
			m_WindowMinimum = _Minimum + m_Scroll * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
			m_WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
		}

		public override void IntervalCountWindow(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalCountTotal(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalFit(double totalWidth, double itemWidth)
		{
			WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange * itemWidth / totalWidth;
		}

		public override double Map(object d_i)
		{
			double d_i2 = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			double windowMinimum = m_WindowMinimum;
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmap(d_i2);
			}
			return linear(d_i2);
		}

		private double linear(double d_i)
		{
			if (Minimum is double && Maximum is double && Math.Abs((double)Maximum - (double)Minimum) < 1E-323)
			{
				return MapMinimum;
			}
			return MapMinimum + MapRange * (d_i - m_WindowMinimum) / (double)WindowRange;
		}

		private double logmap(double d_i)
		{
			double num = ((d_i == 0.0) ? 1.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
			return MapMinimum + MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
		}

		public override object MapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmapInverse(d_i);
			}
			return linearInverse(d_i);
		}

		private double linearInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return m_WindowMinimum + (m_i - MapMinimum) * (double)WindowRange / MapRange;
		}

		private double logmapInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return Math.Pow(base.LogBase, (m_i - MapMinimum) * base.Exponent_Range / MapRange + base.Exponent_min);
		}

		public override bool ItemVisible(object d_i)
		{
			double num = double.Parse(d_i.ToString());
			if (num >= m_WindowMinimum)
			{
				return num <= m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GroupedLabelAxis : LabelAxisBase
	{

				return true;
			}

		}

		private void InitializeMinimumAndMaximum(out int itemSpacing, out int seriesSpacing)
		{
			itemSpacing = 0;
			seriesSpacing = 0;
			ChartTypeAppearance chartTypeAppearance = ((ChartCore.ChartType != ChartType.Composite) ? ((ChartTypeAppearance)ChartCore.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance()) : ChartLayerAppearance);
			if (chartTypeAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				GanttChartAppearance ganttChartAppearance = (GanttChartAppearance)chartTypeAppearance;
				itemSpacing = ganttChartAppearance.ItemSpacing;
				seriesSpacing = ganttChartAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			}
			else if (chartTypeAppearance is ColumnChartAppearance)
			{
				ColumnChartAppearance columnChartAppearance = (ColumnChartAppearance)chartTypeAppearance;
				itemSpacing = columnChartAppearance.ColumnSpacing;
				seriesSpacing = columnChartAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			}
			else if (chartTypeAppearance is BarChartAppearance)
			{
				BarChartAppearance barChartAppearance = (BarChartAppearance)chartTypeAppearance;
				itemSpacing = barChartAppearance.BarSpacing;
				seriesSpacing = barChartAppearance.SeriesSpacing;
			}
			if (data is SeriesCollection groupedLabelProvider)
			{
				GroupedLabelProvider = groupedLabelProvider;
			}
			if (base.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Automatic)
			{
				int num = (GroupedLabelProvider.SeriesCountTotal - 1) * seriesSpacing;
				int num2 = GroupedLabelProvider.ItemCountTotal * itemSpacing;
				Minimum = 0;
				Maximum = GroupedLabelProvider.ItemCountTotal + num2 + num;
			}
			else
			{
				Minimum = base.RangeMin;
				Maximum = base.RangeMax;
			}
		}

					num = axisLineStart.Y;

		private Color ScaleColor(Color color1, Color color2, Color color3, Color color4)

		private Box GetBox(Rectangle cell, bool empty, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, IList emptyPoints, Color color1, Color color2, Color color3, Color color4, int row, int column)
		{
			Color fill = ScaleColor(color1, color2, color3, color4);
			Box box = new Box(cell);
			if (empty && emptyApp != null)
			{
				box.Empty = true;
				if (emptyApp.EnablePE)
				{
					box.PE = emptyApp.PE;
				}
				else
				{
					box.PE.Fill = fill;
					box.PE.FillOpacity = fill.A;
					box.PE.Stroke = Color.Transparent;
					box.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
				}
				if (emptyApp.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					box.lineStyle = emptyApp.LineStyle;
				}
				if (emptyApp.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.None)
				{
					emptyPoints.Add(new DataPoint(new Point(box.rect.X + box.rect.Width / 2, box.rect.Y + box.rect.Height / 2)));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				box.PE.Fill = fill;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = fill.A;
				box.PE.Stroke = Color.Transparent;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
			}
			box.Row = row;
			box.Column = column;
			if (!box.Empty)

		}

		{
			Color startColor = ScaleColor(topLeftColor, bottomRightColor);
			Color endColor = ScaleColor(bottomLeftColor, topRightColor);
			Color color = ScaleColor(startColor, endColor);
			Color color2 = ScaleColor(topLeftColor, topRightColor);
			Color color3 = ScaleColor(topLeftColor, bottomLeftColor);
			Color color4 = ScaleColor(topRightColor, bottomRightColor);
			Color color5 = ScaleColor(bottomLeftColor, bottomRightColor);
			int num = (int)((double)cell.Width / 2.0 + 0.5);
			int num2 = (int)((double)cell.Height / 2.0 + 0.5);
			Rectangle cell2 = new Rectangle(cell.Left, cell.Top, num, num2);
			Rectangle cell3 = new Rectangle(cell.Left + num, cell.Top, num, num2);
			Rectangle cell4 = new Rectangle(cell.Left, cell.Top + num2, num, num2);
			Rectangle cell5 = new Rectangle(cell.Left + num, cell.Top + num2, num, num2);
			if (subsets > 1)
			{
				PaintCell(scene, cell2, topLeftColor, color2, color3, color, subsets - 1, i, j, X, Y, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints);
				PaintCell(scene, cell3, color2, topRightColor, color, color4, subsets - 1, i, j, X, Y, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints);
				PaintCell(scene, cell4, color3, color, bottomLeftColor, color5, subsets - 1, i, j, X, Y, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints);
				PaintCell(scene, cell5, color, color4, color5, bottomRightColor, subsets - 1, i, j, X, Y, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints);
			}
			else
			{
				scene.Add(GetBox(cell2, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints, topLeftColor, color, color2, color3, i, j));
				scene.Add(GetBox(cell3, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints, topRightColor, color, color2, color4, i, j));
				scene.Add(GetBox(cell4, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints, topRightColor, color, color2, color4, i, j));
				scene.Add(GetBox(cell5, empty, emptyApp, emptyPoints, bottomRightColor, color, color5, color4, i, j));
			}
		}

		private void DrawText(SceneGraph scene, Rectangle rect, TextPosition textPosition, object[] vals, int row, int column, HeatMapChartAppearance heatMapApp)
		{
			Point b = new Point(rect.X, rect.Y);
			Point b2 = new Point(rect.X + rect.Width, rect.Y);
			Point b3 = new Point(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height);
			Point b4 = new Point(rect.X + rect.Width, rect.Y + rect.Height);
			Text text = null;
			switch (textPosition)
			{
			case TextPosition.TOP_LEFT:
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < heatMapApp.ChartText.Count; l++)
				{
					if (heatMapApp.ChartText[l].Match(row, column) && heatMapApp.ChartText[l].Visible)
					{
						putText(b, scene, heatMapApp.ChartText[l], vals[0]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case TextPosition.TOP_RIGHT:
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < heatMapApp.ChartText.Count; j++)
				{
					if (heatMapApp.ChartText[j].Match(row, column) && heatMapApp.ChartText[j].Visible)
					{
						putText(b2, scene, heatMapApp.ChartText[j], vals[1]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case TextPosition.BOTTOM_LEFT:
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < heatMapApp.ChartText.Count; k++)
				{
					if (heatMapApp.ChartText[k].Match(row, column) && heatMapApp.ChartText[k].Visible)
					{
						putText(b3, scene, heatMapApp.ChartText[k], vals[2]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case TextPosition.BOTTOM_RIGHT:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < heatMapApp.ChartText.Count; i++)
				{
					if (heatMapApp.ChartText[i].Match(row, column) && heatMapApp.ChartText[i].Visible)
					{
						putText(b4, scene, heatMapApp.ChartText[i], vals[3]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				scene.Add(text);
			}
		}

		protected void PaintCell(SceneGraph scene, Rectangle cell, Color topLeftColor, Color topRightColor, Color bottomLeftColor, Color bottomRightColor, int subsets, int i, int j, IAdvanceAxis X, IAdvanceAxis Y)
		{
			PaintCell(scene, cell, topLeftColor, topRightColor, bottomLeftColor, bottomRightColor, subsets, i, j, X, Y, empty: false, null, null);
		}

		private void putText(Point b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance, object val)
		{
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = val;
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Text value = new Text(b1, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
		}

		protected Color GetAltitudeColor(Color startColor, Color endColor, double val)
		{
			if (startColor.Equals(endColor))
			{
				return startColor;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt((endColor.R - startColor.R) * (endColor.R - startColor.R) + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * (endColor.G - startColor.G) + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * (endColor.B - startColor.B)));
			double num2 = (val - data.GetDataMin()) / (data.GetDataMax() - data.GetDataMin());
			int num3 = (int)((double)num * num2);
			int num4 = startColor.R + num3 * (endColor.R - startColor.R) / num;
			int num5 = startColor.G + num3 * (endColor.G - startColor.G) / num;
			int num6 = startColor.B + num3 * (endColor.B - startColor.B) / num;
			num4 = ((num4 > 255) ? 255 : num4);
			num5 = ((num5 > 255) ? 255 : num5);
			num6 = ((num6 > 255) ? 255 : num6);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			num5 = ((num5 >= 0) ? num5 : 0);
			num6 = ((num6 >= 0) ? num6 : 0);
			return Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, num4, num5, num6);
		}

		protected Color ScaleColor(Color startColor, Color endColor)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, (startColor.R + endColor.R) / 2, (startColor.G + endColor.G) / 2, (startColor.B + endColor.B) / 2);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1013");
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (data.GetColumnCount() < 2 || data.GetRowCount() < 2)
			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddToScene(SceneGraph scene, Box b)
		{
			scene.Add(b);
			HeatMapChartAppearance heatMapChartAppearance = (HeatMapChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (b.Value is object[])
			{
				object[] array = (object[])b.Value;
				if (array.Length == 4 && array[0] is double && array[1] is double && array[1] is double && array[2] is double && array[3] is double)
				{
					num = ((double)array[0] + (double)array[1] + (double)array[2] + (double)array[3]) / 4.0;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < heatMapChartAppearance.ChartText.Count; i++)
			{
				if (heatMapChartAppearance.ChartText[i].Match(b.Row, b.Column) && heatMapChartAppearance.ChartText[i].Visible)
				{
					Core.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = b.Column;
					Core.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = b.Row;
					Point b2 = new Point(b.rect.X + b.rect.Width / 2, b.rect.Y + b.rect.Height / 2);
					putText(b2, scene, heatMapChartAppearance.ChartText[i], num);
				}
			}
		}
	}

			double[] array2 = new double[21]

				0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45,
				0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95,

			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];

			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null || advanceAxis3 == null || advanceAxis4 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HistogramChartAppearance histogramChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as HistogramChartAppearance;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			if (histogramChartAppearance != null && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance != null && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.Visible)
			{
				double num = histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.ColumnSpacing;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				double num2 = Bins.Count;
				if (!histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis && BinSize > 0.0)
				{
					num2 *= BinSize;
				}
				double num3 = advanceAxis.MapMaximum - advanceAxis.MapMinimum;
				double num4 = ((!histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis) ? (Math.Abs(advanceAxis.Map(2.0) - advanceAxis.Map(1.0)) * BinSize) : (num3 / ((double)Bins.Count + (double)(Bins.Count - 1) * num)));
				int num5 = 0;
				NumericSeries numericSeries = new NumericSeries();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<double, int> bin in Bins)
				{
					double num6 = Convert.ToDouble(bin.Value);
					double a = advanceAxis2.MapMinimum - advanceAxis2.Map(num6);
					double num7 = num5;
					if (!histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis && BinSize > 0.0)
					{
						num7 = bin.Key;
					}
					double num8 = advanceAxis.Map(num7);
					Rectangle rect = new Rectangle((int)num8, (int)advanceAxis2.Map(num6), (int)num4, (int)Math.Ceiling(a));
					Box box = new Box(rect);
					NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint(num6, bin.Key.ToString(), empty: false);
					numericSeries.Points.Add(numericDataPoint);
					box.Row = 0;
					box.Column = num5;
					box.Layer = this;
					box.Path = string.Empty;
					box.Value = num6;
					box.Visible = true;
					box.Chart = ChartType.HistogramChart;
					box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;

					box.PE = GetPE(box, box.DataPoint, box.Series);
					box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
					box.Series = numericSeries;

				NumericSeries numericSeries2 = new NumericSeries();
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)

					double num9 = LineMin + (LineMax - LineMin) * array2[i];
					double num10 = 1.0 / (StdDev * Math.Sqrt(Math.PI * 2.0)) * Math.Pow(Math.E, Math.Pow(num9 - Mean, 2.0) / (2.0 * StdDev * StdDev) * -1.0);
					double num11 = advanceAxis3.Map(num9);
					double num12 = advanceAxis4.Map(num10);
					int x = ((!(num11 <= 2147483647.0)) ? int.MaxValue : Convert.ToInt32(num11));

					array[i] = new DataPoint(x, y);

		private int GetLargestTotal(SortedList list)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in list)
			{
				if ((int)item.Value > num)
				{
					num = (int)item.Value;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void InitializeChartData()
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			Bins.Clear();
			Data.Clear();
			HistogramChartAppearance histogramChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as HistogramChartAppearance;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Series) as SeriesCollection;
			if (histogramChartAppearance != null && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex >= 0 && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex < seriesCollection.Count)
			{
				seriesCollection = seriesCollection.Clone();
				ISeries series = seriesCollection[histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex];
				seriesCollection.Clear();
				seriesCollection.Add(series);
			}
			if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				ISeries[] array = seriesCollection.ToArray();
				foreach (ISeries series2 in array)
				{
					if (!(series2 is NumericSeries numericSeries))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries.Points)
					{
						Data.Add(point.Value);
						double value = point.Value;
						if (!Bins.ContainsKey(value))
						{
							Bins.Add(value, 1);
						}
						else
						{
							Bins[value] += 1;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetRowCount(); j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < data.GetColumnCount(); k++)
					{
						double num;
						if (histogramChartAppearance != null && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex >= 0 && histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex < data.GetColumnCount())
						{
							num = Convert.ToDouble(data.GetObjectValue(j, histogramChartAppearance.ColumnIndex));
							k = data.GetColumnCount();
						}
						else
						{
							num = Convert.ToDouble(data.GetObjectValue(j, k));
						}
						Data.Add(num);
						if (!Bins.ContainsKey(num))
						{
							Bins.Add(num, 1);
						}
						else
						{
							Bins[num] += 1;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (Data.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Data.Sort();
			if (histogramChartAppearance != null && !histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis)
			{
				double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(Data[0]);
				double num3 = Convert.ToDouble(Data[Data.Count - 1]);
				AxisAppearance axisAppearance = null;
				Axis axis = base.Grid["X"] as Axis;
				if (axis is NumericAxis)
				{
					axisAppearance = axis.GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					if (axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormat != AxisItemLabelFormat.Custom)
					{
						axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.DataValue;
					}
					axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				}
				if (axisAppearance != null)
				{
					if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
					{
						num2 = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
						num3 = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
						if (num2 > num3)
						{
							num2 = num3;
						}
					}
					switch (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle)
					{
					case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
						BinSize = axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval;
						break;
					case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
						if (axisAppearance.TickmarkPercentage != 0.0)
						{
							BinSize = (num3 - num2) * axisAppearance.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0;
						}
						else
						{
							BinSize = 1.0;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (BinSize == 0.0)
					{
						BinSize = 1.0;
					}
					Bins.Clear();
					decimal num4 = Convert.ToDecimal(num2);
					decimal num5 = Convert.ToDecimal(num3);
					decimal num6 = Convert.ToDecimal(BinSize);
					for (decimal num7 = num4; num7 < num5; num7 += num6)
					{
						Bins.Add(Convert.ToDouble(num7), 0);
					}
					if (Bins.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < Data.Count; l++)
						{
							double num8 = Convert.ToDouble(Data[l]);
							int index = (int)Math.Min(Bins.Count - 1, Math.Floor(Math.Round(Math.Abs(num8 - num2) / BinSize, 5)));
							double key = Bins.Keys[index];
							Bins[key] += 1;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (Bins.Count > 0)
			{
				object[] array2 = new object[Bins.Count];
				foreach (KeyValuePair<double, int> bin in Bins)
				{
					dataTable.Columns.Add(bin.Key.ToString(), typeof(double));
					array2[Bins.IndexOfKey(bin.Key)] = bin.Value;
				}
				dataTable.Rows.Add(array2);
			}
			HistogramData = new DataTableToChartAdapter(dataTable);
			if (Data.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			LineMin = Convert.ToDouble(Data[0]);
			LineMax = Convert.ToDouble(Data[Data.Count - 1]);
			if (LineMin == LineMax)
			{
				LineData = null;
				return;
			}
			_ = LineMax;
			_ = LineMin;
			double num9 = Data.Count;
			double num10 = 0.0;
			for (int m = 0; (double)m < num9; m++)
			{
				num10 += Convert.ToDouble(Data[m]);
			}
			Mean = num10 / num9;
			double num11 = 0.0;
			for (int n = 0; (double)n < num9; n++)
			{
				num11 += Math.Pow(Convert.ToDouble(Data[n]) - Mean, 2.0);
			}
			StdDev = Math.Sqrt(num11 / num9);
			LinePeak = 1.0 / (StdDev * Math.Sqrt(Math.PI * 2.0));
			LineData = new IListToChartAdapter(Data);
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return (HistogramChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Histogram);
		}
	}
	public class IconLegendLayer : LegendLayer

			: base(component, core)

		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			LegendAppearance legendApp = GetAppearance() as LegendAppearance;
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				RedirectToCompositeLegend(legendApp, seriesCollection, scene);
				return;
			}
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (chart != null && ChartColorModel != null && data != null)
			{
				if (ChartColorModel is DataValueLinearColorModel)
				{
					FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(scene, isHeatMap: false);
				}
				else if (chart is ScatterLayer || chart is PolarLayer)
				{
					FillSceneGraphScatter(scene);
				}
				else if (chart is Point3DLayer)
				{
					FillSceneGraphScatter3D(scene);
				}
				else if (chart is BubbleLayer)
				{
					FillSceneGraphBubble(scene);
				}
				else if (chart is HeatMapLayer)
				{
					FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(scene, isHeatMap: true);
				}
				else if (chart is Heatmap3DLayer)
				{
					FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(scene, isHeatMap: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsAxisInverted
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					return (double)base.RangeMin > (double)base.RangeMax;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _Minimum;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value is double)
				{
					_Minimum = (double)value;
				}
				if (value is int)
				{
					_Minimum = (int)value;
				}
				if (value is long)
				{
					_Minimum = (long)value;
				}
				if (value is float)
				{
					_Minimum = (float)value;
				}
				if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && base.RangeType != AxisRangeType.Custom && _Minimum > (double)base.Zero && !double.IsNaN(base.LogZero))
				{
					_Minimum /= base.LogBase;
				}
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		public override object WindowRange => m_WindowMaximum - m_WindowMinimum;

		private double ActualWindowRangeWhenScrollEqualsZero
		{
			get
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = _Minimum + num * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
				double num3 = num2 + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
				if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					return Math.Log(num3, base.LogBase) - Math.Log(num2, base.LogBase);
				}
				return num3 - num2;
			}
		}

		private double WindowMaximumWhenScrollEqualsZero
		{
			get
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = _Minimum + num * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
				return num2 + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
			}
		}

		public override object TotalRange => _Maximum - _Minimum;

		{

		public override void IntervalCountWindow(int n)
		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)WindowRange / (double)n;
		}

		{
			m_WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange / (double)n;
		}

		public override void IntervalFit(double totalWidth, double itemWidth)
		{
			WindowInterval = (double)TotalRange * itemWidth / totalWidth;
		}

		private void CorrectScrollScale()
		{
			m_Scale = (double)WindowRange / (double)TotalRange;
			if (m_Scale == 1.0)
			{
				m_Scroll = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				m_Scroll = (m_WindowMinimum - _Minimum) / ((1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange);
			}
		}

		protected override void CorrectWindowMinMax()
		{
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && m_Scroll != 0.0)
			{
				if (_Maximum == 1.0)
				{
					m_WindowMaximum = Math.Pow(base.LogBase, Math.Log(WindowMaximumWhenScrollEqualsZero, base.LogBase) * (1.0 - m_Scroll));
				}
				else
				{
					double num = Math.Log(WindowMaximumWhenScrollEqualsZero, base.LogBase) / Math.Log(_Maximum, base.LogBase);
					double num2 = num + (1.0 - num) * m_Scroll;
					m_WindowMaximum = Math.Pow(base.LogBase, num2 * Math.Log(_Maximum, base.LogBase));
				}
				double y = Math.Log(m_WindowMaximum, base.LogBase) - ActualWindowRangeWhenScrollEqualsZero;
				m_WindowMinimum = Math.Pow(base.LogBase, y);
			}
			else
			{
				m_WindowMinimum = _Minimum + m_Scroll * (1.0 - m_Scale) * (double)TotalRange;
				m_WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + m_Scale * (double)TotalRange;
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Linear && axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Visible && base.Scale != 1.0)
			{
				RoundWindowMinMax();
			}
		}

		protected void RoundWindowMinMax()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			double tickmarkInterval = axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval;
			if (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.DataInterval && tickmarkInterval != 0.0)
			{
				double num = (double)WindowRange;
				int num2 = (int)Math.Round(m_WindowMinimum / tickmarkInterval);
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					m_WindowMinimum = (double)num2 * tickInterval;
					WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + num;
				}
				return;
			}
			int num3 = (int)Math.Round(((double)Maximum - (double)Minimum) * base.Scale);
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				double num4 = (double)WindowRange;
				int num5 = (int)Math.Log10(num3) - 1;
				if (num5 == 0)
				{
					m_WindowMinimum = Math.Round(m_WindowMinimum);
				}
				else
				{
					m_WindowMinimum = (double)(int)Math.Round(m_WindowMinimum / Math.Pow(10.0, num5)) * Math.Pow(10.0, num5);
				}
				WindowMaximum = m_WindowMinimum + num4;
			}
		}

		internal double gaussionmap(double x)
		{
			x -= (double)Minimum;
			x /= (double)WindowRange;
			x = gaussion(x);
			x *= (double)WindowRange;
			x += (double)Minimum;
			return linear(x);
		}

		internal double gaussion(double x)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < _NormalizedValue.Length && !(x <= _NormalizedValue[i]); i++)
			{
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (i > 0 && i < _NormalizedValue.Length)
			{
				double num2 = (x - _NormalizedValue[i - 1]) / (_NormalizedValue[i] - _NormalizedValue[i - 1]);
				num = 0.005 * (double)(i - 1) - 4.0 + num2 * 0.005;
			}
			if (i == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (i > _NormalizedValue.Length - 1)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return (num + 4.0) / 8.0;
		}

		public override double Map(object d_i)
		{
			double result;
			if (d_i is IConvertible)
			{
				result = Convert.ToDouble(d_i);
			}
			else if (!double.TryParse(d_i.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (_NormalDistribution)
			{
				return gaussionmap(result);
			}
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmap(result);
			}
			return linear(result);
		}

		public override object MapInverse(double d_i)
		{
			if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				return logmapInverse(d_i);
			}
			return linearInverse(d_i);
		}

		private double linear(double d_i)
		{
			if ((double)WindowRange == 0.0)
			{
				return -10.0;
			}
			return MapMinimum + MapRange * (d_i - m_WindowMinimum) / (double)WindowRange;
		}

		private double linearInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return m_WindowMinimum + (m_i - MapMinimum) * (double)WindowRange / MapRange;
		}

		private double logmapInverse(double m_i)
		{
			return Math.Pow(base.LogBase, (m_i - MapMinimum) * base.Exponent_Range / MapRange + base.Exponent_min);
		}

		private double logmap(double d_i)
		{
			if (d_i == 0.0)
			{
				if (base.LogZero > 0.0)
				{
					return logmap(base.LogZero);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (d_i > 0.0)
			{
				double num = ((d_i == 1.0) ? 0.0 : Math.Log(d_i, base.LogBase));
				return MapMinimum + MapRange * ((num - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
			}
			switch (base.LogNegativeHandling)
			{
			case LogNegativeHandling.DontPlot:
				return double.NaN;
			default:
			{
				double num2 = ((d_i == 1.0) ? 0.0 : Math.Log(Math.Abs(d_i), base.LogBase));
				return MapMinimum + MapRange * ((num2 - base.Exponent_min) / base.Exponent_Range);
			}
			}
		}

		public override bool ItemVisible(object d_i)
		{
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(d_i);
			if (IsAxisInverted)
			{
				if (num >= m_WindowMaximum)
				{
					return num <= m_WindowMinimum;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (num >= m_WindowMinimum)
			{
				return num <= m_WindowMaximum;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ItemVisibleWithError(object d_i)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(m_WindowMaximum - m_WindowMinimum) / 1000000000000000.0;
			double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(d_i);
			if (IsAxisInverted)
			{
				if (m_WindowMinimum + num >= num2)
				{
					return num2 >= m_WindowMaximum - num;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (m_WindowMinimum - num <= num2)
			{
				return num2 <= m_WindowMaximum + num;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public NumericAxis(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber, LinearAxisType axisType)
			: base(component, core, axisNumber)
		{
			AxisType = axisType;
			switch (AxisType)
			{
			case LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling:
			case LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling:
				itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
				break;
			default:
				itemLabelFormat = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
				break;
			}
			base.Scale = 1.0;
			base.Scroll = 0.0;
		}

		private void DrawTickHorizontal(int itemNum, SceneGraph scene, Point p_i_min, Point p_i_maj, double increment_major, double increment_minor, PrimitiveCollection majorLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels)
		{
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0 && (increment_minor <= _Maximum || (increment_minor >= _Maximum && IsAxisInverted)))
			{
				DrawTickHorizontalLine(p_i_min, Axis.minorTickWidth, scene);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x20) > 0)
			{
				DrawTickHorizontalLine(p_i_maj, Axis.majorTickWidth, scene);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0 && ItemVisible(increment_minor) && Core.ChartType != ChartType.RadarChart)
			{
				DrawGridLine(p_i_min.X, p_i_min.X, span_1, span_2, minorGridLineStyle, minorGridLineColor, minorGridLineColor.A, minorGridLineThickness, scene);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0 && ItemVisible(increment_major) && Core.ChartType != ChartType.RadarChart && p_i_maj.X != base.startPoint.X)
			{
				DrawGridLine(p_i_maj.X, p_i_maj.X, span_1, span_2, majorGridLineStyle, majorGridLineColor, majorGridLineColor.A, majorGridLineThickness, scene);
			}
			DrawLabeling(itemNum, p_i_maj, increment_major, majorLabels, itemLabels);
		}

		private void DrawTickHorizontalLine(Point p, int tickWidth, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			Point p2 = new Point(p.X, p.Y - tickWidth);
			Point p3 = new Point(p.X, p.Y + tickWidth);
			Line line = new Line(p2, p3);
			line.Path = Path;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		private void DrawGridLine(int x1, int x2, int y1, int y2, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle, Color lineColor, byte opacity, int width, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			Point p = new Point(x1, y1);
			Point p2 = new Point(x2, y2);
			Line line = new Line(p, p2);
			line.lineStyle = lineStyle;
			line.PE.Stroke = lineColor;
			line.PE.StrokeOpacity = opacity;
			line.PE.StrokeWidth = width;
			line.Path = Path;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		private void DrawTickVertical(int itemNum, SceneGraph scene, Point p_i_min, Point p_i_maj, double increment_major, double increment_minor, PrimitiveCollection majorLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels)
		{
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0 && (increment_minor <= _Maximum || (IsAxisInverted && increment_minor >= _Maximum)))
			{
				DrawTickVerticalLine(p_i_min, Axis.minorTickWidth, scene);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x20) > 0)
			{
				DrawTickVerticalLine(p_i_maj, Axis.majorTickWidth, scene);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0 && ItemVisible(increment_minor))
			{
				DrawGridLine(span_1, span_2, p_i_min.Y, p_i_min.Y, minorGridLineStyle, minorGridLineColor, minorGridLineColor.A, minorGridLineThickness, scene);
			}
			bool flag = p_i_maj.Y <= base.startPoint.Y && p_i_maj.Y >= base.endPoint.Y;
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0 && flag)
			{
				DrawGridLine(span_1, span_2, p_i_maj.Y, p_i_maj.Y, majorGridLineStyle, majorGridLineColor, majorGridLineColor.A, majorGridLineThickness, scene);
			}
			DrawLabeling(itemNum, p_i_maj, increment_major, majorLabels, itemLabels);
		}

		private void DrawTickVerticalLine(Point p, int tickWidth, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			Point p2 = new Point(p.X - tickWidth, p.Y);
			Point p3 = new Point(p.X + tickWidth, p.Y);
			Line line = new Line(p2, p3);
			line.Path = Path;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		private void DrawLabeling(int itemNum, Point p_i_maj, double increment_major, PrimitiveCollection majorLabels, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels)
		{
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x40000) <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = increment_major;
			if (labelArray != null && labelArray.Length > itemNum)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = labelArray[itemNum];
			}
			else
			{
				switch (AxisType)
				{
				case LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling:
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetRowLabel(itemNum);
					break;
				case LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling:
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = data.GetColumnLabel(itemNum);
					break;
				default:
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = null;
					break;
				}
			}
			ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
			if (ItemVisibleWithError(increment_major))
			{
				Text text = null;
				switch (axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
					text = new Text(new Point((int)Map(increment_major) + LabelDx, p_i_maj.Y + LabelDy - lineThickness), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemLabelFormat), base.MajorLabelStyle);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					text = new Text(new Point((int)Map(increment_major) + LabelDx, p_i_maj.Y + LabelDy + lineThickness), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemLabelFormat), base.MajorLabelStyle);
					break;
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
					text = new Text(new Point(p_i_maj.X + LabelDx, (int)Map(increment_major) + LabelDy), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemLabelFormat), base.MajorLabelStyle);
					break;
				}
				text.Path = Path;
				majorLabels.Add(text);
				AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = new AxisLabelInfo();
				axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap = increment_major;
				axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive = text;
				itemLabels.Add(axisLabelInfo);
			}
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			FillSceneGraph(scene, ChartCore.ChartType != ChartType.RadarChart);
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, bool setStartAndEndPoints)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (axisAppearance.Visible)
			{
				if (setStartAndEndPoints)
				{
					SetStartAndEndPoints();
				}
				base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
				base.MajorLabelStyle = axisAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle.Clone();
				CorrectWindowMinMax();
				if (RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					FillSceneGraphLog(scene, axisAppearance);
				}
				else if (stackIt)
				{
					FillSceneGraphStacked(scene);
				}
				else
				{
					FillSceneGraphNonStacked(scene);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.RangeType = axisAppearance.RangeType;
				base.RangeMin = axisAppearance.RangeMin;
				base.RangeMax = axisAppearance.RangeMax;
			}
			if (base.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom && axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle != AxisTickStyle.Smart)
			{
				Minimum = base.RangeMin;
				Maximum = base.RangeMax;
			}
		}

		private double GetDataIncrement()
		{
			if (AxisType == LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling)
			{
				return Math.Abs((double)TotalRange) / (double)(data.GetRowCount() - 1);
			}
			if (AxisType == LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling)
			{
				return Math.Round(Math.Abs((double)TotalRange) / (double)(data.GetColumnCount() - 1));
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 4) > 0)
			{
				return tickPercentage * Math.Abs((double)TotalRange) / 100.0;
			}
			if (tickInterval != 0.0)
			{
				return tickInterval;
			}
			return Math.Abs((double)TotalRange) * 0.1;
		}

		public void FillSceneGraphStacked(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (stackStyle == StackStyle.Complete)
			{
				if (data.GetDataMax() > 0.0 && data.GetDataMin() < 0.0)
				{
					Minimum = -100.0;
					Maximum = 100.0;
				}
				else if (data.GetDataMax() >= 0.0 && data.GetDataMin() >= 0.0)
				{
					Minimum = 0.0;
					Maximum = 100;
				}
				else
				{
					Minimum = -100;
					Maximum = 0;
				}
			}
			if (!(GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance axisAppearance))
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels = new AxisLabelInfoCollection();
			if ((drawingStyle & 2) > 0)
			{
				double dataIncrement = GetDataIncrement();
				if (dataIncrement < 1E-323)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				if (((TwoDGridLayer)ChartCore.GetGridLayer()).zeroAlign && AxisType == LinearAxisType.NumericData && _Minimum * _Maximum < 0.0)
				{
					num = Math.Abs(_Minimum) % dataIncrement;
				}
				double num2 = _Minimum + num;
				double num3 = num2 + dataIncrement / 2.0;
				double num4 = Math.Abs(dataIncrement / 4.0);
				int num5 = 0;
				double num6 = Convert.ToDouble(WindowMaximum);
				if (IsAxisInverted)
				{
					while (num2 >= num6 - num4)
					{
						DrawStackedData(scene, itemLabels, num2, num3, num5);
						num2 -= dataIncrement;
						num3 -= dataIncrement;
						num5++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					while (num2 <= num6 + num4)
					{
						DrawStackedData(scene, itemLabels, num2, num3, num5);
						num2 += dataIncrement;
						num3 += dataIncrement;
						num5++;
					}
				}
			}
			int scrollbarSize = ((axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Visible || scene == ChartCore.ScrollScene) ? GetScrollbarSpan(axisAppearance) : 0);
			ApplyLayoutBehaviors(GetLabelBounds(scrollbarSize), axisAppearance, itemLabels, null);
		}

		private void DrawStackedData(SceneGraph scene, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels, double increment_major, double increment_minor, int itemNum)
		{
			int num = (int)Map(increment_major);
			int num2 = (int)Map(increment_minor);
			Point p;
			Point point;
			switch (base.AxisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
			{
				int y = base.startPoint.Y - axisSpan;
				p = new Point(num2, y);
				point = new Point(num, y);
				break;
			}
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				p = new Point(num2, base.startPoint.Y);
				point = new Point(num, base.startPoint.Y);
				break;
			default:
				p = new Point(base.startPoint.X, num2);
				point = new Point(base.startPoint.X, num);
				break;
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0 && (increment_minor <= _Maximum || (IsAxisInverted && increment_minor >= _Maximum)))
			{
				switch (base.AxisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					DrawTickHorizontalLine(p, Axis.minorTickWidth, scene);
					break;
				default:
					DrawTickVerticalLine(p, Axis.minorTickWidth, scene);
					break;
				}
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x20) > 0)
			{
				switch (base.AxisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					DrawTickHorizontalLine(point, Axis.majorTickWidth, scene);
					break;
				default:
					DrawTickVerticalLine(point, Axis.majorTickWidth, scene);
					break;
				}
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0 && ItemVisible(increment_minor))
			{
				switch (base.AxisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					DrawGridLine(p.X, p.X, span_1, span_2, minorGridLineStyle, minorGridLineColor, minorGridLineColor.A, minorGridLineThickness, scene);
					break;
				default:
					DrawGridLine(span_1, span_2, p.Y, p.Y, minorGridLineStyle, minorGridLineColor, minorGridLineColor.A, minorGridLineThickness, scene);
					break;
				}
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0 && ItemVisible(increment_major))
			{
				switch (base.AxisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
					if (ChartCore.GetGridLayer() is TwoDGridLayer { Y: not null } twoDGridLayer)
					{
						DrawGridLine(point.X, point.X, twoDGridLayer.Y.axisLineEnd.Y, twoDGridLayer.Y.axisLineStart.Y, majorGridLineStyle, majorGridLineColor, majorGridLineColor.A, majorGridLineThickness, scene);
					}
					else
					{
						DrawGridLine(point.X, point.X, span_1, span_2, majorGridLineStyle, majorGridLineColor, majorGridLineColor.A, majorGridLineThickness, scene);
					}
					break;
				default:
					DrawGridLine(span_1, span_2, point.Y, point.Y, majorGridLineStyle, majorGridLineColor, majorGridLineColor.A, majorGridLineThickness, scene);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (((drawingStyle & 0x10000) <= 0 || ChartCore.ScrollType != 0 || scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene) && (drawingStyle & 0x40000) > 0)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				DrawLabeling(itemNum, point, increment_major, primitiveCollection, itemLabels);
				bool flag = ItemVisible(increment_major);
				AxisNumber axisNumber = base.AxisNumber;
				if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis || axisNumber == AxisNumber.X2_Axis)
				{
					flag |= MathFunctions.BetweenOrEqualTo(MapMinimum, MapMaximum, point.X);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					scene.AddRange((Text[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(Text)));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance { NumericAxisType: NumericAxisType.Logarithmic, RangeType: AxisRangeType.Custom } axisAppearance)
			{

			}
		}

		public void FillSceneGraphLog(SceneGraph scene, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			if ((double)Maximum <= 0.0 || (double)Minimum <= 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 10000;
			int finiteLoop = 1000;
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			Match match = Regex.Match(itemLabelFormat, "atmajor\\((.+?)\\)");
			if (match.Success)
			{
				text = match.Groups[1].Value;
			}
			Match match2 = Regex.Match(itemLabelFormat, "atminor\\((.+?)\\)");
			if (match2.Success)
			{
				text2 = match2.Groups[1].Value;
			}
			if (!match.Success && !match2.Success)
			{
				text = itemLabelFormat;
			}
			text2 = text2.Trim();
			text = text.Trim();
			double logBase = axisApp.LogBase;
			base.LogBase = axisApp.LogBase;
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
			{
				_ = base.endPoint.X;
				_ = base.startPoint.X;
			}
			else
			{
				_ = base.endPoint.Y;
				_ = base.startPoint.Y;
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
			{
				_ = base.startPoint.X;
			}
			else
			{
				_ = base.startPoint.Y;
			}
			if (logBase < 0.0)
			{
				throw new Exception("invalid ticks_per_cycle");
			}
			double num2 = Math.Log(Math.Max(_Minimum, double.Epsilon), base.LogBase);
			double num3 = Math.Log(Math.Max(_Maximum, double.Epsilon), base.LogBase);
			double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - num2);
			double num5 = (double)WindowMinimum;
			double num6 = (double)WindowMaximum;
			if (num5 <= 0.0)
			{
				num5 = double.Epsilon;
			}
			if (num6 <= 0.0)
			{
				num6 = num5 + base.LogBase * double.Epsilon;
			}
			base.Exponent_min = Math.Log(num5, base.LogBase);
			base.Exponent_max = Math.Log(num6, base.LogBase);
			double num7 = num5;
			double num8 = 100.0;
			switch (axisApp.TickmarkStyle)
			{
			case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
				num8 = num4 / 10.0;
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
				num8 = axisApp.TickmarkInterval;
				break;
			case AxisTickStyle.Percentage:
				num8 = num4 * axisApp.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0;
				break;
			}
			num7 = _Minimum;
			double num9 = Math.Pow(base.LogBase, num8);
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels = new AxisLabelInfoCollection();
			if (num8 > 0.0)
			{
				if (IsAxisInverted)
				{
					while (num7 > num6 - num8 / 2.0 && --num > 0)
					{
						DrawLogAxisMajorLine(num7, text2, text, primitiveCollection, itemLabels);
						double old_d_x = num7;
						num7 /= num9;
						DrawLogAxisMinorLine(num7, old_d_x, num, finiteLoop, text2, text, primitiveCollection);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					while (num7 < num6 + num8 / 2.0 && --num > 0)
					{
						DrawLogAxisMajorLine(num7, text2, text, primitiveCollection, itemLabels);
						double old_d_x = num7;
						num7 *= num9;
						DrawLogAxisMinorLine(num7, old_d_x, num, finiteLoop, text2, text, primitiveCollection);
					}
				}
			}
			if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				double num10 = double.MinValue;
				double num11 = double.MinValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < primitiveCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					if (primitiveCollection[i] != null && primitiveCollection[i] is Text)
					{
						Text text3 = (Text)primitiveCollection[i];
						SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text3.GetTextString(), text3.labelStyle);
						num10 = Math.Max(num10, (int)labelSizePixels.Width);
						num11 = Math.Max(num11, (int)labelSizePixels.Height);
					}
				}
				double num12 = double.NaN;
				double num13 = double.NaN;
				if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y_Axis)
				{
					num12 = (double)base.startPoint.X - num10 + (double)LabelDx;
				}
				else if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
				{
					switch (base.MajorLabelStyle.Orientation)
					{
					case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
					case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					{
						StringAlignment horizontalAlign = base.MajorLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
						num13 = ((horizontalAlign != StringAlignment.Near) ? ((double)base.startPoint.Y + num11 + (double)LabelDy) : ((double)(base.startPoint.Y + LabelDy + lineThickness + 1)));
						break;
					}
					default:
						num13 = (double)base.startPoint.Y + num11 + (double)LabelDy;
						break;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < primitiveCollection.Count; j++)
				{
					if (primitiveCollection[j] != null && primitiveCollection[j] is Text)
					{
						Text text4 = (Text)primitiveCollection[j];
						int x = ((!double.IsNaN(num12)) ? ((int)num12) : text4.bounds.X);
						int y = ((!double.IsNaN(num13)) ? ((int)num13) : text4.bounds.Y);
						text4.bounds = new Rectangle(x, y, text4.bounds.Width, text4.bounds.Height);
					}
				}
			}
			scene.AddRange((Primitive[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(Primitive)));
			int scrollbarSize = ((axisApp.ScrollScale.Visible || scene == ChartCore.ScrollScene) ? GetScrollbarSpan(axisApp) : 0);
			ApplyLayoutBehaviors(GetLabelBounds(scrollbarSize), axisApp, itemLabels, null);
		}

		private void DrawLogAxisMinorLine(double d_x, double old_d_x, int finiteLoop, int finiteLoop2, string minorFmt, string majorFmt, PrimitiveCollection labels)
		{
			double num = d_x / base.LogBase;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = old_d_x + num;
			while (num3 + num <= d_x)
			{
				if (!(num > 0.0))
				{
					continue;
				}
				while (num3 - num2 <= d_x && --finiteLoop2 > 0)
				{
					ChartCore.Environment["LOG_BASE"] = base.LogBase;
					ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = num3;
					ChartCore.Environment["LOG_VALUE"] = Math.Log(num3, base.LogBase);
					ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
					if (ItemVisibleWithError(num3))
					{
						MinorLineAt(labels, num3, minorFmt, majorFmt);
					}
					num3 += num;
					num2 = ((!(Math.Abs(d_x - num3) < num3 * 0.01)) ? 0.0 : (num3 * 0.01));
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawLogAxisMajorLine(double d_x, string minorFmt, string majorFmt, PrimitiveCollection labels, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels)
		{
			ChartCore.Environment["LOG_BASE"] = base.LogBase;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = d_x;
			ChartCore.Environment["LOG_VALUE"] = Math.Log(d_x, base.LogBase);
			ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
			if (ItemVisibleWithError(d_x))
			{
				MajorLineAt(labels, d_x, minorFmt, majorFmt);
			}
			AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = new AxisLabelInfo();
			axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap = d_x;
			if (labels.Count > 0)
			{
				axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive = labels[labels.Count - 1] as Text;
			}
			itemLabels.Add(axisLabelInfo);
		}

		private int CalculateIntegral(double logBase, double x)
		{
			if (x == 1.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (logBase == 1.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (logBase == 0.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int i = 0;
			if (x < 1.0)
			{
				while (x < Math.Pow(logBase, i))
				{
					i--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (; x > Math.Pow(logBase, i); i++)
				{
				}
			}
			return i;
		}
	}
	public class LineLayer : ChartLayer, IMultiEmptyStyles

		private getLayerID goGetLayerID;

		internal ArrayList EmptyStylesUsed => _EmptyStylesUsed;

		ArrayList IMultiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed => EmptyStylesUsed;

		public override string LayerID
		{
			get
			{
				return goGetLayerID();
			}

			{
				base.LayerID = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override InterpolateValuesEventArgs InterpolateValues(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, int arrayWidth)
		{
			if (type == typeof(object[]))

				return ChartLayer.InterpolateNumericTimeValues(primitives, type, this);
			}
			return base.InterpolateValues(primitives, type, arrayWidth);

		public LineLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			goGetLayerID = getLayerStandardID;
			if (core != null && (core.ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart || core.ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart))
			{
				goGetLayerID = getLayerHybridID;
			}
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				if ((!(dataMin >= 0.0) || !(dataMax >= 0.0)) && (!(dataMin <= 0.0) || !(dataMax <= 0.0)))
				{
					return SR.GetString("SR_1073");
				}
			}
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					flag = flag || item is NumericSeries;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return SR.GetString("SR_20071_1");
				}
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1014");
		}

		private string getLayerStandardID()
		{
			return base.LayerID;
		}

		private string getLayerHybridID()
		{
			return 3.ToString("D2");
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			if (Core.ChartType == ChartType.LineChart || ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.StackLineChart)
			{
				return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line);
			}
			if (Core.ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
			{
				return ((ScatterLineAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).Line;
			}
			return ((ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).Line;
		}

		private PaintElement GetPE(int row, LineChartAppearance lineApp, Primitive line, IDataPoint point, ISeries series)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = base.GetPE(line, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns: true).Clone();
			if (lineApp.LineAppearances != null && lineApp.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
			{
