			}
			else
			{
				paintElement.StrokeWidth = lineApp.Thickness;
			}
			return paintElement;
		}

		private Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle GetLineStyle(LineChartAppearance lineApp)
		{
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(lineApp.StartStyle, lineApp.EndStyle, lineApp.DrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = lineApp.MidPointAnchors;
			return lineStyle;
		}

		internal static void ApplyCurrentLineStyle(LineAppearance currentLineApp, Primitive prim, IList scene)
		{
			Polyline polyline = prim as Polyline;
			Polygon polygon = prim as Polygon;
			DataPoint[] points;
			if (polyline != null)
			{
				polyline.splineTension = currentLineApp.SplineTension;
				polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = currentLineApp.Thickness;
				points = polyline.points;
			}
			else
			{
				if (polygon == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				polygon.splineTension = currentLineApp.SplineTension;
				points = polygon.DataPoints;
			}
			if (prim.Layer is AreaLayer && polyline != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PointSet pointSet;
			if (currentLineApp.IconAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon.Character)
			{
				pointSet = new PointSet(points, currentLineApp.IconAppearance.CharacterFont, currentLineApp.IconAppearance.Character);
			}
			else
			{
				SymbolIcon icon = ((currentLineApp.IconAppearance.Icon != SymbolIcon.Random) ? currentLineApp.IconAppearance.Icon : ((SymbolIcon)ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(2, 8)));
				SymbolIconSize symbolIconSize;
				if (currentLineApp.IconAppearance.IconSize == SymbolIconSize.Auto)
				{
					int num = ((prim.Series != null) ? prim.Series.GetPoints().Count : ((prim.Layer == null || prim.Layer.ChartData == null) ? (-1) : prim.Layer.ChartData.GetColumnCount()));
					if (num < 0)
					{
						symbolIconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;
					}
					symbolIconSize = ((num < 6) ? SymbolIconSize.Large : ((num >= 11) ? SymbolIconSize.Small : SymbolIconSize.Medium));
				}
				else
				{
					symbolIconSize = currentLineApp.IconAppearance.IconSize;
				}
				pointSet = new PointSet(points, icon, symbolIconSize);
			}
			if (currentLineApp.IconAppearance.PE != null && currentLineApp.IconAppearance.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				pointSet.PE = currentLineApp.IconAppearance.PE;
			}
			else
			{
				pointSet.PE = prim.PE;
			}
			scene.Add(pointSet);
		}

		protected virtual void AddLineToScene(Polyline line, int row, bool empty, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			AddLineToScene(line, row, empty, scene, null);
		}

		protected virtual void AddLineToScene(Polyline line, int row, bool empty, SceneGraph scene, ISeries series)
		{
			LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance = GetAppearance() as LineChartAppearance;
			int column = (line.Row = row);
			line.Column = column;
			line.Layer = this;
			if (empty)
			{
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance;
				if (lineChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count > 0)
				{
					emptyAppearance = lineChartAppearance.EmptyStyles[row % lineChartAppearance.EmptyStyles.Count];
					if (!EmptyStylesUsed.Contains(emptyAppearance) && (emptyAppearance.EnablePE || emptyAppearance.EnablePoint))
					{
						EmptyStylesUsed.Add(emptyAppearance);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					line.PE = emptyAppearance.PE.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					line.PE = GetPE(row, lineChartAppearance, line, line.DataPoint, series);
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					line.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle.Clone();
				}
				else if (lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					line.lineStyle = lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count].LineStyle;
				}
				else
				{
					line.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(lineChartAppearance);
				}
				if (lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					ApplyCurrentLineStyle(lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count], line, scene);
				}
				else if (lineChartAppearance is SplineChartAppearance)
				{
					line.splineTension = ((SplineChartAppearance)lineChartAppearance).SplineTension;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				for (int i = 0; i < line.points.Length; i++)
				{
					if (line.points[i] != null && line.points[i].Empty)
					{
						DataPoint value = new DataPoint(line.points[i].point);
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnablePoint)
				{
					DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[arrayList.Count];
					arrayList.CopyTo(array);
					PointSet pointSet = emptyAppearance.GetPointSet(array);
					scene.Add(pointSet);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				line.PE = GetPE(row, lineChartAppearance, line, line.DataPoint, series);
				if (lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count > 0)
				{
					LineAppearance lineAppearance = lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances[row % lineChartAppearance.LineAppearances.Count];
					line.lineStyle = lineAppearance.LineStyle;
					ApplyCurrentLineStyle(lineAppearance, line, scene);
				}
				else
				{
					line.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(lineChartAppearance);
					line.splineTension = splineTension;
				}
			}
			line.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			line.Chart = ChartType.LineChart;
			line.Path = Path;
			line.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
			line.HighLightLine = lineChartAppearance.HighLightLines;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPointsToScene(LineChartAppearance lineApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, int baseLineDataMapped)
		{
			RenderPointsToScene(lineApp, scene, pointsForLineUnderConstruction, row, baseLineDataMapped, null);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPointsToScene(LineChartAppearance lineApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, int baseLineDataMapped, ISeries series)
		{
			if (pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDataPoint dataPoint = null;
			if (series != null)
			{
				IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
				if (points != null && points.Count > 0)
				{
					dataPoint = points[0];
				}
			}
			DataPoint[] array = (DataPoint[])pointsForLineUnderConstruction.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
			_ = (IAdvanceAxis)((ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart || ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart) ? base.Grid["X2"] : base.Grid["X"]);
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(lineApp.StartStyle, lineApp.EndStyle, lineApp.DrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = lineApp.MidPointAnchors;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			while (num < array.Length)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				arrayList.Add(primitiveCollection);
				bool empty = array[num].Empty;
				bool flag = false;
				while (!flag)
				{
					flag = num == array.Length - 1 || array[num].Empty != array[num + 1].Empty;
					primitiveCollection.Add(array[num]);
					num++;
				}
				if (empty)
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						int num3 = pointsForLineUnderConstruction.IndexOf(primitiveCollection[0]) - 1;
						primitiveCollection.Insert(0, array[num3]);
					}
					if (num < array.Length)
					{
						primitiveCollection.Add(array[num]);
					}
				}
				DataPoint[] array2 = new DataPoint[primitiveCollection.Count];
				primitiveCollection.CopyTo(array2);
				Polyline polyline = new Polyline(array2);
				polyline.Series = series;
				polyline.DataPoint = dataPoint;
				AddLineToScene(polyline, row, empty, scene, series);
				num2++;
			}
			pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override void putText(DataPoint b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance)
		{
			base.putText(b1, scene, chartTextAppearance);
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.ClipText = chartTextAppearance.ClipText;
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Text value = new Text(b1.point, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			base.ValidateDataForChart();
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				if ((!(dataMin >= 0.0) || !(dataMax >= 0.0)) && (!(dataMin <= 0.0) || !(dataMax <= 0.0)))
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
			if (!(GetAppearance() is LineChartAppearance { TreatDateTimeAsString: false }))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is NumericTimeSeries)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				dataIsValid &= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				if (ChartData == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int columnCount = ChartData.GetColumnCount();
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
				{
					if (Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.DateTimeFromObject(ChartData.GetColumnLabel(i)) != DateTime.MinValue)
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PointsVisibilityFilter
	{
		private DataPoint[] visiblePoints;

		private DataPoint[] points;

		private IAdvanceAxis axis;

		private int startIndex;

		private int endIndex;

		private bool spline;

		public DataPoint[] VisiblePoints => visiblePoints;

		public int StartIndex => startIndex;

		public int EndIndex => endIndex;

		public PointsVisibilityFilter(DataPoint[] points, IAdvanceAxis axis)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.axis = axis;
		}

		public PointsVisibilityFilter(DataPoint[] points, IAdvanceAxis axis, bool spline)
			: this(points, axis)
		{
			this.spline = spline;
		}

		public DataPoint[] GetVisiblePoints()
		{
			return GetVisiblePoints(stacked: false);
		}

		public DataPoint[] GetVisiblePoints(bool stacked)
		{
			if (stacked && spline)
			{
				CorrectVisibleIndexesStackSpline();
			}
			else
			{
				CorrectVisibleIndexes();
			}
			return visiblePoints;
		}

		private void CorrectVisibleIndexes()
		{
			FindVisibleIndexes();
			if (spline)
			{
				if (startIndex > 0)
				{
					startIndex--;
				}
				if (endIndex < points.Length - 1)
				{
					endIndex++;
				}
			}
			CopyVisiblePoints();
		}

		private void CorrectVisibleIndexesStackSpline()
		{
			if (points.Length == 0)
			{
				visiblePoints = points;
				return;
			}
			FindVisibleIndexes();
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = endIndex; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint = points[i];
				if (dataPoint.DataPoint == null || !dataPoint.DataPoint.Empty)
				{
					endIndex = i;
					num++;
					if (num > 1)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				endIndex = points.Length - 1;
			}
			flag = false;
			num = 0;
			for (int num2 = startIndex; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint2 = points[num2];
				if (dataPoint2.DataPoint == null || !dataPoint2.DataPoint.Empty)
				{
					startIndex = num2;
					num++;
					if (num > 1)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				startIndex = 0;
			}
			CopyVisiblePoints();
		}

		private void CopyVisiblePoints()
		{
			int num = endIndex - startIndex + 1;
			visiblePoints = new DataPoint[num];
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				visiblePoints[i - startIndex] = points[i];
			}
		}

		private void FindVisibleIndexes()
		{
			startIndex = 0;
			endIndex = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool isTimeAxis = axis is TimeAxis;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint = points[i];
				object valueToMap = GetValueToMap(dataPoint, isTimeAxis);
				bool flag2 = axis.ItemVisible(valueToMap);
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag = true;
						startIndex = i - 1;
					}
				}
				else if (!flag2)
				{
					endIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (startIndex == 0 && endIndex == 0)
			{
				FindSurroundIndexes();
			}
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				startIndex = 0;
			}
			if (endIndex == 0)
			{
				endIndex = points.Length - 1;
			}
		}

		private void FindSurroundIndexes()
		{
			startIndex = 0;
			endIndex = 0;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double mapMinimum = axis.MapMinimum;
			double mapMaximum = axis.MapMaximum;
			bool isTimeAxis = axis is TimeAxis;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint = points[i];
				object valueToMap = GetValueToMap(dataPoint, isTimeAxis);
				double num3 = axis.Map(valueToMap);
				double num4 = mapMinimum - num3;
				if (num4 > 0.0)
				{
					if (num > num4)
					{
						num = num4;
						startIndex = i;
					}
					continue;
				}
				num4 = num3 - mapMaximum;
				if (!(num4 <= 0.0) && num2 > num4)
				{
					num2 = num4;
					endIndex = i;
				}
			}
		}

		private object GetValueToMap(DataPoint dataPoint, bool isTimeAxis)
		{
			NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = dataPoint.DataPoint as NumericTimeDataPoint;
			if (dataPoint != null && numericTimeDataPoint != null && isTimeAxis)
			{
				return numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue;
			}
			return dataPoint.Column;
		}
	}

		Area,

		PointSphere,
		Bubble
	}

	internal class AreaLineChart3D : ChartType3D
	{
		private ZOrderAreaLine3D zOrder = new ZOrderAreaLine3D();

		private double valueCross;

		private float depth;

		internal Scene3D scene;

		internal ArrayList areaLineList = new ArrayList();

		private double dataPointSizeZ = 0.5;

		private ArrayList elements = new ArrayList();

		private float edgeSize = 2f;

		private double min;

		private double max;

		private AreaLineType areaLineType;

		private float _Flatness = 0.1f;

		private bool _Splined;

		internal float Flatness
		{
			get
			{
				return _Flatness;
			}
			set
			{
				_Flatness = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool Splined
		{
			get
			{
				return _Splined;
			}
			set
			{
				_Splined = value;
			}
		}

		internal AreaLineChart3D(Scene3D scene, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, double dataPointSizeZ, float edgeSize, double min, double max, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode, double valueCross, AreaLineType areaLineType)
			: base(angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective)
		{
			base.angleX = angleX;
			base.angleY = angleY;
			base.angleZ = angleZ;
			this.areaLineType = areaLineType;
			this.valueCross = valueCross;
			zOrder.Flash = flashMode;
			zOrder.Outline = outlineMode;
			base.perspective = perspective;
			this.scene = scene;
			this.dataPointSizeZ = dataPointSizeZ;
			this.edgeSize = edgeSize;
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			matrix.RotateX(angleX);
			matrix.RotateY(angleY);
			matrix.RotateZ(angleZ);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Min(scene.boundingRectangle.Width, scene.boundingRectangle.Height) * 1.5f + (float)((100 - perspective) * 5);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Max(matrix.EyeDistance, 250f);
			PointF center = new PointF(scene.boundingRectangle.X + scene.boundingRectangle.Width / 2f, scene.boundingRectangle.Y + scene.boundingRectangle.Height / 2f);
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			matrix2.Translate(new Vector3(center.X, center.Y, 0f));
			zOrder.Center = center;
			scene.Transform(matrix);
			scene.Transform(matrix2);
			scene.Add(zOrder, "Scene");
			if (Splined)
			{
				areaLineList = Spline(areaLineList);
			}
			foreach (AreaLineInfo areaLine in areaLineList)
			{
				if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.Area)
				{
					if (areaLine.valueStart >= 0.0 && areaLine.valueEnd >= 0.0)
					{
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, areaLine.valueStart, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition2 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, areaLine.valueEnd, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition3 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition4 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition.PointF, columnPixelPosition2.PointF, columnPixelPosition3.PointF, columnPixelPosition4.PointF, columnPixelPosition2.Z, columnPixelPosition.Z - columnPixelPosition2.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
					}
					else if (areaLine.valueStart < 0.0 && areaLine.valueEnd < 0.0)
					{
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition5 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition6 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition7 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, areaLine.valueStart, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition8 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, areaLine.valueEnd, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition5.PointF, columnPixelPosition6.PointF, columnPixelPosition7.PointF, columnPixelPosition8.PointF, columnPixelPosition6.Z, columnPixelPosition5.Z - columnPixelPosition6.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
					}
					else if (areaLine.valueStart >= 0.0 && areaLine.valueEnd < 0.0)
					{
						double x = -1.0 * (areaLine.xStart - areaLine.xEnd) / (areaLine.valueStart - areaLine.valueEnd) * areaLine.valueStart + areaLine.xStart;
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition9 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, areaLine.valueStart, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition10 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition11 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition12 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition9.PointF, columnPixelPosition10.PointF, columnPixelPosition11.PointF, columnPixelPosition12.PointF, columnPixelPosition10.Z, columnPixelPosition9.Z - columnPixelPosition10.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
						columnPixelPosition9 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition10 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition11 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition12 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, areaLine.valueEnd, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition9.PointF, columnPixelPosition10.PointF, columnPixelPosition11.PointF, columnPixelPosition12.PointF, columnPixelPosition10.Z, columnPixelPosition9.Z - columnPixelPosition10.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
					}
					else if (areaLine.valueStart < 0.0 && areaLine.valueEnd >= 0.0)
					{
						double x2 = -1.0 * (areaLine.xStart - areaLine.xEnd) / (areaLine.valueStart - areaLine.valueEnd) * areaLine.valueStart + areaLine.xStart;
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition13 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition14 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x2, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition15 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, areaLine.valueStart, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						Vector3 columnPixelPosition16 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x2, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition13.PointF, columnPixelPosition14.PointF, columnPixelPosition15.PointF, columnPixelPosition16.PointF, columnPixelPosition14.Z, columnPixelPosition13.Z - columnPixelPosition14.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
						columnPixelPosition13 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x2, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition14 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, areaLine.valueEnd, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition15 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(x2, valueCross, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
						columnPixelPosition16 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, valueCross, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
						AddArea(columnPixelPosition13.PointF, columnPixelPosition14.PointF, columnPixelPosition15.PointF, columnPixelPosition16.PointF, columnPixelPosition14.Z, columnPixelPosition13.Z - columnPixelPosition14.Z, "Area", areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
					}
				}
				else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.Line)
				{
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition17 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xStart, areaLine.valueStart, areaLine.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition18 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(areaLine.xEnd, areaLine.valueEnd, areaLine.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
					AddLine(columnPixelPosition17.PointF, columnPixelPosition18.PointF, columnPixelPosition18.Z, columnPixelPosition17.Z - columnPixelPosition18.Z, "Line", edgeSize, areaLine, areaLine.startSide, areaLine.endSide);
				}
				else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.HeatMap)
				{
					HeatMapInfo heatMapInfo = areaLine as HeatMapInfo;
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition19 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(heatMapInfo.xStart, heatMapInfo.valueStart, heatMapInfo.zStart);
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition20 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(heatMapInfo.xEnd, heatMapInfo.valueEnd, heatMapInfo.zEnd);
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition21 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(heatMapInfo.xHeat, heatMapInfo.valueHeat, heatMapInfo.zHeat);
					AddHeatMap(columnPixelPosition19.PointF, columnPixelPosition20.PointF, columnPixelPosition21.PointF, columnPixelPosition19.Z, columnPixelPosition20.Z, columnPixelPosition21.Z, "HeatMap", 20f, heatMapInfo);
				}
				else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.Bubble)
				{
					BubbleInfo bubbleInfo = areaLine as BubbleInfo;
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition22 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(bubbleInfo.X, bubbleInfo.Y, bubbleInfo.Z);
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition23 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(bubbleInfo.X, bubbleInfo.Y + bubbleInfo.R, bubbleInfo.Z);
					float size = Math.Abs(columnPixelPosition23.Y - columnPixelPosition22.Y) / 2f;
					AddSphere(columnPixelPosition22.PointF, columnPixelPosition23.Z, size, "", size, areaLine);
				}
				else
				{
					BubbleInfo bubbleInfo2 = areaLine as BubbleInfo;
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition24 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(bubbleInfo2.X, bubbleInfo2.Y, bubbleInfo2.Z - dataPointSizeZ);
					Vector3 columnPixelPosition25 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(bubbleInfo2.X, bubbleInfo2.Y, bubbleInfo2.Z + dataPointSizeZ);
					float num = 0f;
					num = ((edgeSize == 0f) ? 5f : ((edgeSize != 1f) ? 20f : 10f));
					if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.PointCube)
					{
						AddPointCube(columnPixelPosition24.PointF, columnPixelPosition25.Z, columnPixelPosition24.Z - columnPixelPosition25.Z, "Point", num, areaLine);
					}
					else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.PointDiamond)
					{
						AddPointDiamond(columnPixelPosition24.PointF, columnPixelPosition25.Z, columnPixelPosition24.Z - columnPixelPosition25.Z, "Point", num, areaLine);
					}
					else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.PointPyramid)
					{
						AddPointPyramid(columnPixelPosition24.PointF, columnPixelPosition25.Z, columnPixelPosition24.Z - columnPixelPosition25.Z, "Point", num, areaLine);
					}
					else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.PointPyramidDown)
					{
						AddPointPyramidDown(columnPixelPosition24.PointF, columnPixelPosition25.Z, columnPixelPosition24.Z - columnPixelPosition25.Z, "Point", num, areaLine);
					}
					else
					{
						AddSphere(columnPixelPosition24.PointF, columnPixelPosition25.Z, columnPixelPosition24.Z - columnPixelPosition25.Z, "", num, areaLine);
					}
				}
			}
			Transform(matrix);
			Transform(matrix2);
			Add(zOrder, "AreaLine");
			zOrder.Sort(areaLineType == AreaLineType.HeatMap);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(bool light, bool cylinder)
		{
			return zOrder.GetFillPrimitives(light, cylinder);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return zOrder.GetOutlinePrimitives();
		}

		private void Add(ZOrder3D order, string objectName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				num++;
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					order.Add((GraphicsPath3D)element);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Split();
					order.Add((ComplexPath3D)element);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double xStart, double xEnd, double z, double valueStart, double valueEnd, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, bool startSide, bool endSide, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			AreaLineInfo areaLineInfo = new AreaLineInfo();
			areaLineInfo.xStart = xStart;
			areaLineInfo.xEnd = xEnd;
			areaLineInfo.Z = z;
			areaLineInfo.Column = column;
			areaLineInfo.Row = row;
			areaLineInfo.valueStart = valueStart;
			areaLineInfo.valueEnd = valueEnd;
			areaLineInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			areaLineInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			areaLineInfo.startSide = startSide;
			areaLineInfo.endSide = endSide;
			areaLineInfo.Series = series;
			areaLineInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			if (areaLineInfo.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
			{
				areaLineInfo.Value = numericDataPoint.Value;
			}
			areaLineList.Add(areaLineInfo);
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double y, double z, double r, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			BubbleInfo bubbleInfo = new BubbleInfo();
			bubbleInfo.X = x;
			bubbleInfo.Y = y;
			bubbleInfo.Z = z;
			bubbleInfo.R = r;
			bubbleInfo.Column = column;
			bubbleInfo.Row = row;
			bubbleInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			bubbleInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			bubbleInfo.Series = series;
			bubbleInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			areaLineList.Add(bubbleInfo);
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double xStart, double xEnd, double xHeat, double zStart, double zEnd, double zHeat, double valueStart, double valueEnd, double valueHeat, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, Color startColor, Color endColor, Color heatColor, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			HeatMapInfo heatMapInfo = new HeatMapInfo();
			heatMapInfo.xStart = xStart;
			heatMapInfo.xEnd = xEnd;
			heatMapInfo.xHeat = xHeat;
			heatMapInfo.zStart = zStart;
			heatMapInfo.zEnd = zEnd;
			heatMapInfo.zHeat = zHeat;
			heatMapInfo.Column = column;
			heatMapInfo.Row = row;
			heatMapInfo.valueStart = valueStart;
			heatMapInfo.valueEnd = valueEnd;
			heatMapInfo.valueHeat = valueHeat;
			heatMapInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			heatMapInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			heatMapInfo.colPt1 = startColor;
			heatMapInfo.colPt2 = endColor;
			heatMapInfo.colPt3 = heatColor;
			heatMapInfo.Series = series;
			heatMapInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			areaLineList.Add(heatMapInfo);
		}

			};

		private void AddPointCube(PointF center, float z, float depth, string name, float size, AreaLineInfo info)
		{
			depth = Math.Max(depth, 0f);
			float num = z + depth / 2f;
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = name + "- Top";
			Vector3[] array = new Vector3[4]
			{
				new Vector3(center.X - size, center.Y - size, num - size),
				new Vector3(center.X + size, center.Y - size, num - size),
				new Vector3(center.X + size, center.Y - size, num + size),
				new Vector3(center.X - size, center.Y - size, num + size)
			};
			graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[0]);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1]);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[2]);
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];

		private void AddHeatMap(PointF pt1, PointF pt2, PointF pt3, float z1, float z2, float z3, string name, float size, HeatMapInfo info)
		{
			depth = Math.Max(depth, 0f);
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "HeatMap";
			Vector3[] array = new Vector3[3]
			{
				new Vector3(pt1.X, pt1.Y, z1),
				new Vector3(pt2.X, pt2.Y, z2),
				new Vector3(pt3.X, pt3.Y, z3)
			};
			graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[2]);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1]);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[0]);
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = Vector3.Multiply(new Vector3(pt2.X - pt1.X, pt2.Y - pt1.Y, z2 - z1), new Vector3(pt3.X - pt2.X, pt3.Y - pt2.Y, z3 - z2));
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3((pt1.X + pt2.X + pt3.X) / 3f, 0f, (z1 + z2 + z3) / 3f);
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		private ArrayList Spline(ArrayList infoListAll)
		{
			int num = 0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (AreaLineInfo item in infoListAll)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, item.Row + 1);
			}
			NumericRuler numericRuler = new NumericRuler(scene.MinY, scene.MaxY);
			numericRuler.MapMinimum = 0.0;
			numericRuler.MapMaximum = 500.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
				foreach (AreaLineInfo item2 in infoListAll)
				{
					if (i == item2.Row)
					{
						arrayList2.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				if (arrayList2.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PointF[] array = new PointF[arrayList2.Count + 1];
				int num2 = 1;
				array[0].X = 0f;
				array[0].Y = (float)numericRuler.Map(((AreaLineInfo)arrayList2[0]).valueStart);
				foreach (AreaLineInfo item3 in arrayList2)
				{
					array[num2].X = num2;
					array[num2].Y = (float)numericRuler.Map(item3.valueEnd);
					num2++;
				}
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddCurve(array);
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = graphicsPath.Clone() as GraphicsPath;
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), Flatness);
				if (graphicsPath2.PathPoints.Length < 10000)
				{
					graphicsPath.Dispose();
					graphicsPath = graphicsPath2;
				}
				else
				{
					graphicsPath2.Dispose();
				}
				PointF[] pathPoints = graphicsPath.PathPoints;
				int num3 = pathPoints.Length;
				for (int j = 1; j < num3; j++)
				{
					double num4 = (double)numericRuler.MapInverse(pathPoints[j - 1].Y);
					double num5 = (double)numericRuler.MapInverse(pathPoints[j].Y);
					int val = (int)((double)(pathPoints[j].X - pathPoints[j - 1].X) / 2.0 + (double)pathPoints[j - 1].X);
					val = Math.Min(val, arrayList2.Count - 1);
					AreaLineInfo areaLineInfo4 = arrayList2[val] as AreaLineInfo;
					if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.Line)
					{
						if (num4 > max || num5 > max || num4 < min || num5 < min)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (areaLineType == AreaLineType.Area)
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, max);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, min);
						num5 = Math.Min(num5, max);
						num5 = Math.Max(num5, min);
					}
					AreaLineInfo areaLineInfo5 = new AreaLineInfo();
					areaLineInfo5.Column = areaLineInfo4.Column;
					areaLineInfo5.DataPoint = areaLineInfo4.DataPoint;
					areaLineInfo5.endSide = areaLineInfo4.endSide;
					areaLineInfo5.FillColor = areaLineInfo4.FillColor;
					areaLineInfo5.OutlineColor = areaLineInfo4.OutlineColor;
					areaLineInfo5.Row = areaLineInfo4.Row;
					areaLineInfo5.Series = areaLineInfo4.Series;
					areaLineInfo5.startSide = areaLineInfo4.startSide;
					areaLineInfo5.Value = areaLineInfo4.Value;
					areaLineInfo5.valueEnd = num5;
					areaLineInfo5.valueStart = num4;
					areaLineInfo5.xEnd = (double)pathPoints[j].X + 0.5;
					areaLineInfo5.xStart = (double)pathPoints[j - 1].X + 0.5;
					areaLineInfo5.Z = areaLineInfo4.Z;
					arrayList.Add(areaLineInfo5);
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}
	}
	internal class ValueInfo
	{
		internal class ValueComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object a, object b)
			{
				ValueInfo valueInfo = a as ValueInfo;
				ValueInfo valueInfo2 = b as ValueInfo;
				if (a != null && b != null)
				{
					return (int)(valueInfo.Value - valueInfo2.Value);
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal double Value;

		internal Color FillColor;

		internal Color OutlineColor;

		internal int Column = -1;

		internal int Row = -1;

		private ISeries _Series;

		private IDataPoint _DataPoint;

		internal double? StackedValue;

		internal ISeries Series
		{
			get
			{
				return _Series;
			}
			set
			{
				_Series = value;
			}
		}

		internal IDataPoint DataPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _DataPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_DataPoint = value;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class BarChart3D : ChartType3D
	{
		private ZOrderBar3D zOrder = new ZOrderBar3D();

		internal Scene3D scene;

		internal ArrayList columnList = new ArrayList();

		private double columnSizeX = 0.5;

		private double columnSizeZ = 0.5;

		private ArrayList elements = new ArrayList();

		private float flatten = 0.2f;

		private float edgeSize = 2f;

		private int pointIndex;

		private bool cylinder;

		private bool stacked;

		private bool percent;

		private double min;

		private double max;

		private double logBase;

		internal BarChart3D(Scene3D scene, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, double columnSizeX, double columnSizeZ, float edgeSize, bool cylinder, bool stacked, bool percent, double min, double max, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode, double logBase)
			: base(angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective)
		{
			base.angleX = angleX;
			base.angleY = angleY;
			base.angleZ = angleZ;
			zOrder.Flash = flashMode;
			zOrder.Outline = outlineMode;
			base.perspective = perspective;
			this.scene = scene;
			this.edgeSize = edgeSize;
			this.columnSizeX = columnSizeX;
			this.columnSizeZ = columnSizeZ;
			this.cylinder = cylinder;
			this.stacked = stacked;
			this.percent = percent;
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			this.logBase = logBase;
		}

		internal BarChart3D(Scene3D scene, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, double columnSizeX, double columnSizeZ, float edgeSize, bool cylinder, bool stacked, bool percent, double min, double max, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode)
			: this(scene, angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective, columnSizeX, columnSizeZ, edgeSize, cylinder, stacked, percent, min, max, flashMode, outlineMode, 0.0)
		{
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			matrix.RotateX(angleX);
			matrix.RotateY(angleY);
			matrix.RotateZ(angleZ);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Min(scene.boundingRectangle.Width, scene.boundingRectangle.Height) * 1.5f + (float)((100 - perspective) * 5);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Max(matrix.EyeDistance, 250f);
			PointF center = new PointF(scene.boundingRectangle.X + scene.boundingRectangle.Width / 2f, scene.boundingRectangle.Y + scene.boundingRectangle.Height / 2f);
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			matrix2.Translate(new Vector3(center.X, center.Y, 0f));
			zOrder.Center = center;
			scene.Transform(matrix);
			scene.Transform(matrix2);
			scene.Add(zOrder, "Scene");
			ColumnChart3D.StartGetColumnValues();
			float val = float.MaxValue;
			foreach (ColumnInfo column in columnList)
			{
				ColumnChart3D.GetColumnValues(column, out var startValue, out var endValue, percent, stacked, columnList, min, max, logBase);
				Vector3 barPixelPosition = scene.GetBarPixelPosition(column.X - columnSizeX, endValue, column.Z - columnSizeZ);
				Vector3 barPixelPosition2 = scene.GetBarPixelPosition(column.X + columnSizeX, startValue, column.Z + columnSizeZ);
				val = Math.Min(val, barPixelPosition2.Y - barPixelPosition.Y);
			}
			ColumnChart3D.StartGetColumnValues();
			foreach (ColumnInfo column2 in columnList)
			{
				float num = edgeSize;
				ColumnChart3D.GetColumnValues(column2, out var startValue2, out var endValue2, percent, stacked, columnList, min, max, logBase);
				Vector3 barPixelPosition3 = scene.GetBarPixelPosition(column2.X - columnSizeX, endValue2, column2.Z - columnSizeZ);
				Vector3 barPixelPosition4 = scene.GetBarPixelPosition(column2.X + columnSizeX, startValue2, column2.Z + columnSizeZ);
				RectangleF rectangle = new RectangleF(barPixelPosition4.X, barPixelPosition4.Y, barPixelPosition3.X - barPixelPosition4.X, barPixelPosition3.Y - barPixelPosition4.Y);
				if (rectangle.Width <= num * 2f || rectangle.Height <= num * 2f || barPixelPosition3.Z - barPixelPosition4.Z <= num * 2f)
				{
					num = 0f;
				}
				if ((!percent || !double.IsNaN(endValue2)) && !(rectangle.Width < 0f) && !(rectangle.Height < 0f) && !(barPixelPosition3.Z - barPixelPosition4.Z <= 0f))
				{
					if (rectangle.Width == 0f)
					{
						rectangle.Width = 0.01f;
					}
					if (rectangle.Height == 0f)
					{
						rectangle.Height = 0.01f;
					}
					if (cylinder)
					{
						AddBarCylinder(rectangle, barPixelPosition4.Z, barPixelPosition3.Z - barPixelPosition4.Z, "Column", num, column2);
					}
					else
					{
						AddBar(rectangle, barPixelPosition4.Z, barPixelPosition3.Z - barPixelPosition4.Z, "Column", num, column2);
					}
				}
			}
			Transform(matrix);
			Transform(matrix2);
			Add(zOrder, "Column");
			zOrder.Sort(cylinder && stacked);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(bool light, bool cylinder)
		{
			return zOrder.GetFillPrimitives(light, cylinder);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return zOrder.GetOutlinePrimitives();
		}

		private void Add(ZOrder3D order, string objectName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				num++;
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					order.Add((GraphicsPath3D)element);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Split();
					order.Add((ComplexPath3D)element);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double z, double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor)
		{
			Add(row, column, x, z, value, fillColor, outlineColor, null, null);
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double z, double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			ColumnInfo columnInfo = new ColumnInfo();
			columnInfo.X = x;
			columnInfo.Z = z;
			columnInfo.Column = column;
			columnInfo.Row = row;
			columnInfo.Value = value;
			columnInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			columnInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			columnInfo.Series = series;
			columnInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			columnList.Add(columnInfo);
		}

		private void AddBar(RectangleF rectangle, float z, float depth, string name, float edge, ColumnInfo info)
		{
			if (depth < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("depth", "Invalid depth value.");
			}
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = name + " - Top";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth));
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Top);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
			graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = name + " - Bottom";
			graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth));
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Bottom);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
			graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = name + " - Back";
			graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, rectangle.Height));
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, -10f);
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
			graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = name + " - Front";

		private void AddBarCylinder(RectangleF rectangle, float z, float depth, string name, float edge, ColumnInfo info)
		{
			if (depth < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("depth", "Invalid depth value.");
			}
			pointIndex++;
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			complexPath3D.Info = info;
			complexPath3D.Name = "MainCurve";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(z, rectangle.Y, depth, rectangle.Height), -180f, 360f);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.X + edge);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(z, rectangle.Y, depth, rectangle.Height), 180f, -360f);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.Right - edge);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.GradientSize = rectangle.Height;
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
			if (edge != 0f)
			{
				graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
				graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
				complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
				complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
				complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
				complexPath3D.Info = info;
				complexPath3D.Name = "UpCurve";
				graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(z, rectangle.Y, depth, rectangle.Height), -180f, 360f);
				graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.Right - edge);
				graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(z + edge, rectangle.Y + edge, depth - 2f * edge, rectangle.Height - 2f * edge), 180f, -360f);
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.Right);
				complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
				complexPath3D.Curve = true;
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
				complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
				elements.Add(complexPath3D);
				graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
				graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
				complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
				complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
				complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
				complexPath3D.Info = info;
				complexPath3D.Name = "DownCurve";
				graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(z + edge, rectangle.Y + edge, depth - 2f * edge, rectangle.Height - 2f * edge), -180f, 360f);
				graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.X);
				graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(z, rectangle.Y, depth, rectangle.Height), 180f, -360f);
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.X + edge);
				complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
				complexPath3D.Curve = true;
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
				complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
				elements.Add(complexPath3D);
			}
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D3.Name = name + "Cylinder Top";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath3 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath3.AddEllipse(new RectangleF(z + edge, rectangle.Y + edge, depth - 2f * edge, rectangle.Height - 2f * edge));
			graphicsPath3.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D3.Set(graphicsPath3, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.Right);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Y, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(10f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D3.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D3.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
			graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D3.Name = name + "Cylinder Bottom";
			graphicsPath3 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath3.AddEllipse(new RectangleF(z + edge, rectangle.Y + edge, depth - 2f * edge, rectangle.Height - 2f * edge));
			graphicsPath3.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D3.Set(graphicsPath3, Axis3DNew.Z, Axis3DNew.Y, rectangle.X);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(-10f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D3.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D3.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
		}
	}
	internal enum Bar3DChartType
	{
		Bar,
		Column,
		StackBar,
		StackColumn,
		CylinderBar,
		CylinderColumn,
		CylinderStackBar,
		CylinderStackColumn
	}
	internal class ColumnChart3D : ChartType3D
	{
		private static List<int> startedRows = new List<int>();

		private ZOrderColumn3D zOrder = new ZOrderColumn3D();

		internal Scene3D scene;

		internal ArrayList columnList = new ArrayList();

		private double columnSizeX = 0.5;

		private double columnSizeZ = 0.5;

		private ArrayList elements = new ArrayList();

		private float flatten = 0.2f;

		private float edgeSize = 2f;

		private int pointIndex;

		private bool cylinder;

		private bool stacked;

		private bool percent;

		private double min;

		private double max;

		private double logBase;

		internal ColumnChart3D(Scene3D scene, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, double columnSizeX, double columnSizeZ, float edgeSize, bool cylinder, bool stacked, bool percent, double min, double max, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode, double logBase)
			: base(angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective)
		{
			base.angleX = angleX;
			base.angleY = angleY;
			base.angleZ = angleZ;
			zOrder.Flash = flashMode;
			zOrder.Outline = outlineMode;
			base.perspective = perspective;
			this.scene = scene;
			this.columnSizeX = columnSizeX;
			this.columnSizeZ = columnSizeZ;
			if (cylinder && stacked)
			{
				this.edgeSize = edgeSize * 2f;
			}
			else
			{
				this.edgeSize = edgeSize;
			}
			this.cylinder = cylinder;
			this.stacked = stacked;
			this.percent = percent;
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			this.logBase = logBase;
		}

		internal ColumnChart3D(Scene3D scene, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, double columnSizeX, double columnSizeZ, float edgeSize, bool cylinder, bool stacked, bool percent, double min, double max, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode)
			: this(scene, angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective, columnSizeX, columnSizeZ, edgeSize, cylinder, stacked, percent, min, max, flashMode, outlineMode, 0.0)
		{
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			matrix.RotateX(angleX);
			matrix.RotateY(angleY);
			matrix.RotateZ(angleZ);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Min(scene.boundingRectangle.Width, scene.boundingRectangle.Height) * 1.5f + (float)((100 - perspective) * 5);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Max(matrix.EyeDistance, 250f);
			PointF center = new PointF(scene.boundingRectangle.X + scene.boundingRectangle.Width / 2f, scene.boundingRectangle.Y + scene.boundingRectangle.Height / 2f);
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			matrix2.Translate(new Vector3(center.X, center.Y, 0f));
			zOrder.Center = center;
			scene.Transform(matrix);
			scene.Transform(matrix2);
			scene.Add(zOrder, "Scene");
			float val = float.MaxValue;
			StartGetColumnValues();
			foreach (ColumnInfo column in columnList)
			{
				GetColumnValues(column, out var startValue, out var endValue, percent, stacked, columnList, min, max, logBase);
				Vector3 columnPixelPosition = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(column.X - columnSizeX, endValue, column.Z - columnSizeZ);
				Vector3 columnPixelPosition2 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(column.X + columnSizeX, startValue, column.Z + columnSizeZ);
				val = Math.Min(val, columnPixelPosition2.Y - columnPixelPosition.Y);
			}
			StartGetColumnValues();
			foreach (ColumnInfo column2 in columnList)
			{
				float num = edgeSize;
				GetColumnValues(column2, out var startValue2, out var endValue2, percent, stacked, columnList, min, max, logBase);
				Vector3 columnPixelPosition3 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(column2.X - columnSizeX, endValue2, column2.Z - columnSizeZ);
				Vector3 columnPixelPosition4 = scene.GetColumnPixelPosition(column2.X + columnSizeX, startValue2, column2.Z + columnSizeZ);
				RectangleF rectangle = new RectangleF(columnPixelPosition3.X, columnPixelPosition3.Y, columnPixelPosition4.X - columnPixelPosition3.X, columnPixelPosition4.Y - columnPixelPosition3.Y);
				if (rectangle.Width <= num * 2f || rectangle.Height <= num * 2f || columnPixelPosition3.Z - columnPixelPosition4.Z <= num * 2f)
				{
					num = 0f;
				}
				if (!(rectangle.Width < 0f) && !(rectangle.Height < 0f) && !(columnPixelPosition3.Z - columnPixelPosition4.Z <= 0f))
				{
					if (rectangle.Width == 0f)
					{
						rectangle.Width = 0.01f;
					}
					if (rectangle.Height == 0f)
					{
						rectangle.Height = 0.01f;
					}
					if (cylinder)
					{
						AddColumnCylinder(rectangle, columnPixelPosition4.Z, columnPixelPosition3.Z - columnPixelPosition4.Z, "Column", num, column2);
					}
					else
					{
						AddColumn(rectangle, columnPixelPosition4.Z, columnPixelPosition3.Z - columnPixelPosition4.Z, "Column", num, column2);
					}
				}
			}
			Transform(matrix);
			Transform(matrix2);
			Add(zOrder, "Column");
			Vector3 eyeLocation = new Vector3(center.X, center.Y, matrix.EyeDistance);
			zOrder.Sort(cylinder && stacked, eyeLocation);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(bool light, bool cylinder)
		{
			return zOrder.GetFillPrimitives(light, cylinder);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return zOrder.GetOutlinePrimitives();
		}

		private void Add(ZOrder3D order, string objectName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				num++;
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					order.Add((GraphicsPath3D)element);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Split();
					order.Add((ComplexPath3D)element);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double z, double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor)
		{
			Add(row, column, x, z, value, fillColor, outlineColor, null, null);
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double z, double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			Add(row, column, x, z, value, null, fillColor, outlineColor, dataPoint, series);
		}

		internal void Add(int row, int column, double x, double z, double value, double? stackedValue, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			ColumnInfo columnInfo = new ColumnInfo();
			columnInfo.X = x;
			columnInfo.Z = z;
			columnInfo.Column = column;
			columnInfo.Row = row;
			columnInfo.Value = value;
			columnInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			columnInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			columnInfo.Series = series;
			columnInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			columnList.Add(columnInfo);
			columnInfo.StackedValue = stackedValue;
		}
