		internal void AddColumnCylinder(RectangleF rectangle, float z, float depth, string name, float edge, ColumnInfo info)
		{
			if (depth < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("depth", "Invalid depth value.");
			}
			pointIndex++;
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			complexPath3D.Info = info;
			complexPath3D.Name = "MainCurve";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X, z, rectangle.Width, depth), -90f, 360f);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Y + edge);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X, z, rectangle.Width, depth), 270f, -360f);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Bottom - edge);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, 0f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = true;
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, rectangle.Y, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.GradientPoints[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, rectangle.Bottom, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.GradientSize = rectangle.Width;
			graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
			if (edge != 0f)
			{
				graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
				graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
				complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
				complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
				complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
				complexPath3D.Info = info;
				complexPath3D.Name = "UpCurve";
				graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z + edge, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth - 2f * edge), -90f, 360f);
				graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Y);
				graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X, z, rectangle.Width, depth), 270f, -360f);
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Y + edge);
				complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
				complexPath3D.Curve = true;
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, 0f, z + depth / 2f);
				graphicsPath3D.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = true;
				complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
				elements.Add(complexPath3D);
				graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
				graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
				complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
				complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
				complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
				complexPath3D.Info = info;
				complexPath3D.Name = "DownCurve";
				graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X, z, rectangle.Width, depth), -90f, 360f);
				graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Bottom - edge);
				graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath2.AddArc(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z + edge, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth - 2f * edge), 270f, -360f);
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
				graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Bottom);
				complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
				complexPath3D.Curve = true;
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, 0f, z + depth / 2f);
				graphicsPath3D.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = true;
				complexPath3D.PointIndex = pointIndex;
				elements.Add(complexPath3D);
			}
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D3.Name = name + "Cylinder Top";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath3 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath3.AddEllipse(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z + edge, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth - 2f * edge));
			graphicsPath3.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D3.Set(graphicsPath3, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Top);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Y, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D3.YMainPosition = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, 0f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D3.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = true;
			graphicsPath3D3.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
			graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D3.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D3.Name = name + "Cylinder Bottom";
			graphicsPath3 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath3.AddEllipse(new RectangleF(rectangle.X + edge, z + edge, rectangle.Width - 2f * edge, depth - 2f * edge));
			graphicsPath3.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D3.Set(graphicsPath3, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, rectangle.Bottom);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z + depth);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(rectangle.X, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom, z);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
			graphicsPath3D3.YMainPosition = new Vector3(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, 0f, z + depth / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D3.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = true;
			graphicsPath3D3.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
		}

		internal static void GetColumnValues(ColumnInfo info, out double startValue, out double endValue, bool percent, bool stacked, ArrayList columnList, double min, double max, double logBase)
		{
			if (percent)
			{
				if (info.Value >= 0.0)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					foreach (ColumnInfo column in columnList)
					{
						if (column.Value >= 0.0 && info.X == column.X && info.Z == column.Z)
						{
							num += column.Value;
						}
					}
					startValue = 0.0;
					endValue = info.Value / num * 100.0;
					{
						foreach (ColumnInfo column2 in columnList)
						{
							if (column2.Value >= 0.0)
							{
								if (info == column2)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (info.X == column2.X && info.Z == column2.Z)
								{
									startValue += column2.Value / num * 100.0;
									endValue += column2.Value / num * 100.0;
								}
							}
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (ColumnInfo column3 in columnList)
				{
					if (column3.Value < 0.0 && info.X == column3.X && info.Z == column3.Z)
					{
						num2 += column3.Value;
					}
				}
				num2 = Math.Abs(num2);
				startValue = info.Value / num2 * 100.0;
				endValue = 0.0;
				{
					foreach (ColumnInfo column4 in columnList)
					{
						if (column4.Value < 0.0)
						{
							if (info == column4)
							{
								break;
							}
							if (info.X == column4.X && info.Z == column4.Z)
							{
								startValue += column4.Value / num2 * 100.0;
								endValue += column4.Value / num2 * 100.0;
							}
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (info.Value > 0.0)
			{
				if (stacked)
				{
					if (startedRows.Contains(info.Row))
					{
						startValue = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						if (min < 0.0)
						{
							startValue = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							startValue = min;
						}
						startedRows.Add(info.Row);
					}
					endValue = info.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (min < 0.0)
					{
						startValue = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						startValue = min;
					}
					endValue = info.Value;
				}
				{
					foreach (ColumnInfo column5 in columnList)
					{
						if (!(column5.Value > 0.0))
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (info == column5)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (info.X != column5.X || info.Z != column5.Z)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (logBase > 0.0)
						{
							double num3 = Math.Pow(logBase, column5.Value);
							endValue = Math.Pow(logBase, endValue);
							if (startValue > 0.0)
							{
								startValue = Math.Pow(logBase, startValue);
							}
							startValue = Math.Log(num3 + startValue, logBase);
							endValue = Math.Log(num3 + endValue, logBase);
						}
						else
						{
							startValue += column5.Value;
							endValue += column5.Value;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (stacked)
			{
				if (startedRows.Contains(info.Row))
				{
					endValue = 0.0;
					startValue = info.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					if (min < 0.0)
					{
						startValue = info.Value;
					}
					else
					{
						startValue = min;
					}
					if (max < 0.0)
					{
						endValue = max;
					}
					else
					{
						endValue = 0.0;
					}
					startedRows.Add(info.Row);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (min < 0.0)
				{
					startValue = info.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					startValue = min;
				}
				if (max < 0.0)
				{
					endValue = max;
				}
				else
				{
					endValue = 0.0;
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnInfo column6 in columnList)
			{
				if (column6.Value < 0.0)
				{
					if (info == column6)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (info.X == column6.X && info.Z == column6.Z)
					{
						startValue += column6.Value;
						endValue += column6.Value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void StartGetColumnValues()
		{
			startedRows.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal class ColumnInfo : ValueInfo
	{
		internal double X;

		internal double Z;
	}
	internal class Path3D
	{
		internal RectangleF Bound;

		internal RectangleF BoundingRect;

		internal bool Curve;

		internal Color FillColor;

		internal string FillColorName;

		internal bool Inner;

		internal string Name;

		internal string ObjectName;

		internal Color OutlineColor;

		internal float LineWidth = 1f;

		internal GraphicsPath Path;

		internal Plane3D Plane;

		internal Vector3[] Visibles;

		internal Vector3 YMainPosition = new Vector3();

		internal bool DisableYMainPositionPerspective;

		internal Vector3 ZMainPosition = new Vector3();

		internal Vector3 ZOrder;

		internal bool Exploded;

		internal Vector3 AnglePosition = new Vector3();

		internal int PointIndex;

		internal Brush Brush;

		internal ValueInfo Info;

		internal bool outlineOnly;

		internal Vector3[] Light;

		internal Vector3[] GradientPoints;

		internal float GradientSize;

		internal DashStyle LineStyle;

		internal Path3D()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void Add(ZOrder3D order)
		{
		}

		internal void SetAttributes(Path3D value)
		{
			Bound = value.Bound;
			BoundingRect = value.BoundingRect;
			Curve = value.Curve;
			FillColor = value.FillColor;
			Inner = value.Inner;
			Name = value.Name;
			ObjectName = value.ObjectName;
			OutlineColor = value.OutlineColor;
			Path = value.Path;
			Plane = value.Plane;
			Visibles = value.Visibles;
			YMainPosition = value.YMainPosition;
			DisableYMainPositionPerspective = value.DisableYMainPositionPerspective;
			ZMainPosition = value.ZMainPosition;
			ZOrder = value.ZOrder;
			Exploded = value.Exploded;
			FillColorName = value.FillColor.Name;
			AnglePosition = value.AnglePosition;
			PointIndex = value.PointIndex;
			Brush = value.Brush;
			Info = value.Info;
			outlineOnly = value.outlineOnly;
			Light = value.Light;
			GradientPoints = value.GradientPoints;
			GradientSize = value.GradientSize;
			LineWidth = value.LineWidth;
			LineStyle = value.LineStyle;
		}

		internal bool IsVisible()
		{
			Vector3 vt = Visibles[0];
			Vector3 vt2 = Visibles[1];
			Vector3 vt3 = Visibles[2];
			return IsVisible(vt, vt2, vt3);
		}

		protected bool IsVisible(Vector3 vt1, Vector3 vt2, Vector3 vt3)
		{
			float num = ZOrder3D.FindAngle(vt1.PointF, vt2.PointF) * 180f / (float)Math.PI;
			float num2 = ZOrder3D.FindAngle(vt2.PointF, vt3.PointF) * 180f / (float)Math.PI;
			float num3 = num - num2;
			if (Math.Abs(num3) >= 180f)
			{
				if (num3 > 0f)
				{
					num3 -= 360f;
				}
				else if (num3 < 0f)
				{
					num3 += 360f;
				}
			}
			if (num3 > 0f)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ComplexPath3D : Path3D
	{
		private GraphicsPath3D curve1;

		private GraphicsPath3D curve2;

		private int numPaths = 1;

		private GraphicsPath[] paths = new GraphicsPath[3];

		private Vector3[] zOrders = new Vector3[3];

		internal new Vector3[][] Visibles = new Vector3[3][];

		internal GraphicsPath[] GetPaths()
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = new GraphicsPath[numPaths];
			for (int i = 0; i < numPaths; i++)
			{
				array[i] = paths[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal Vector3[] GetZOrders()
		{
			Vector3[] array = new Vector3[numPaths];
			for (int i = 0; i < numPaths; i++)
			{
				array[i] = zOrders[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal ComplexPath3D()
		{
		}

		internal void Set(GraphicsPath3D curve1, GraphicsPath3D curve2)
		{
			this.curve1 = curve1;
			this.curve2 = curve2;
		}

		private GraphicsPath Get()
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddPath(curve1.Get(), connect: true);
			graphicsPath.AddPath(curve2.Get(), connect: true);
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			curve1.Transform(matrix);
			curve2.Transform(matrix);
		}

		internal void Split()
		{
			PointF[] points = curve1.GetPoints();
			PointF[] points2 = curve2.GetPoints();
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			float num = float.MinValue;
			float num2 = float.MinValue;
			float num3 = float.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < points2.Length; j++)
				{
					LineFunction(points[i], points2[j], out var a, out var b);
					if (!IsBorderLine(a, b, points, points2, i, j) || i == 0 || j == 0 || i == points.Length - 1 || j == points2.Length - 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (float.IsNaN(a))
					{
						if (num != points[i].X)
						{
							arrayList.Add(i);
							arrayList2.Add(j);
							num = points[i].X;
						}
					}
					else if (num2 != a || num3 != b)
					{
						arrayList.Add(i);
						arrayList2.Add(j);
					}
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count != arrayList2.Count && arrayList2.Count > 2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("ComplexPath3D - Error in extreme points.");
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < arrayList.Count - 1; k++)
			{
				if ((int)arrayList[k] >= (int)arrayList[k + 1] || (int)arrayList2[k] <= (int)arrayList2[k + 1])
				{
					arrayList.RemoveAt(k);
					arrayList2.RemoveAt(k);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				paths[0] = Get();
				zOrders[0] = CalcZOrder(0, points.Length, 0, points2.Length);
				Visibles[0] = CreateVisiblesMid(0, points.Length, 0, points2.Length);
			}
			else if (arrayList.Count == 1)
			{
				paths[0] = ConnectPoints(points, points2, (int)arrayList[0], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				paths[1] = ConnectPoints(points, points2, 0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				zOrders[0] = CalcZOrder((int)arrayList[0], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				zOrders[1] = CalcZOrder(0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				Visibles[0] = CreateVisiblesMid((int)arrayList[0], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				Visibles[1] = CreateVisiblesMid(0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				numPaths = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				int index = arrayList.Count - 1;
				int index2 = arrayList2.Count - 1;
				paths[0] = ConnectPoints(points, points2, (int)arrayList[index], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[index2] + 1);
				paths[1] = ConnectPoints(points, points2, (int)arrayList[0], (int)arrayList[index] + 1, (int)arrayList2[index2], (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				paths[2] = ConnectPoints(points, points2, 0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				zOrders[0] = CalcZOrder((int)arrayList[index], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[index2] + 1);
				zOrders[1] = CalcZOrder((int)arrayList[0], (int)arrayList[index] + 1, (int)arrayList2[index2], (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				zOrders[2] = CalcZOrder(0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				Visibles[0] = CreateVisiblesMid((int)arrayList[index], points.Length, 0, (int)arrayList2[index2] + 1);
				Visibles[1] = CreateVisiblesMid((int)arrayList[0], (int)arrayList[index] + 1, (int)arrayList2[index2], (int)arrayList2[0] + 1);
				Visibles[2] = CreateVisiblesMid(0, (int)arrayList[0] + 1, (int)arrayList2[0], points2.Length);
				numPaths = 3;
			}
		}

		private Vector3[] CreateVisiblesMid(int from1, int to1, int from2, int to2)
		{
			Vector3[] array = new Vector3[3];
			Vector3[] pointsTD = curve1.GetPointsTD();
			Vector3[] pointsTD2 = curve2.GetPointsTD();
			int num = (from1 + to1) / 2;
			int num2 = (from2 + to2) / 2;
			bool flag = true;
			if (num == to1 - 1)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			array[0] = new Vector3(pointsTD[from1 + 1].X, pointsTD[from1 + 1].Y, pointsTD[from1 + 1].Z);
			array[1] = new Vector3(pointsTD[from1].X, pointsTD[from1].Y, pointsTD[from1].Z);
			array[2] = new Vector3(pointsTD2[to2 - 1].X, pointsTD2[to2 - 1].Y, pointsTD2[to2 - 1].Z);
			bool flag2 = IsVisible(array[0], array[1], array[2]);
			array[0] = new Vector3(pointsTD2[from2 + 1].X, pointsTD2[from2 + 1].Y, pointsTD2[from2 + 1].Z);
			array[1] = new Vector3(pointsTD2[from2].X, pointsTD2[from2].Y, pointsTD2[from2].Z);
			array[2] = new Vector3(pointsTD[to1 - 1].X, pointsTD[to1 - 1].Y, pointsTD[to1 - 1].Z);
			bool flag3 = IsVisible(array[0], array[1], array[2]);
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				array[0] = new Vector3(pointsTD[num + 1].X, pointsTD[num + 1].Y, pointsTD[num + 1].Z);
				array[1] = new Vector3(pointsTD[num].X, pointsTD[num].Y, pointsTD[num].Z);
				array[2] = new Vector3(pointsTD2[num2].X, pointsTD2[num2].Y, pointsTD2[num2].Z);
				flag4 = IsVisible(array[0], array[1], array[2]);
			}
			if (flag2 || flag3 || flag4)
			{
				array[2] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
				array[1] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
				array[0] = new Vector3(10f, 10f, 0f);
			}
			else
			{
				array[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
				array[1] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
				array[2] = new Vector3(10f, 10f, 0f);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private Vector3 CalcZOrder(int from1, int to1, int from2, int to2)
		{
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			Vector3[] pointsTD = curve1.GetPointsTD();
			Vector3[] pointsTD2 = curve2.GetPointsTD();
			for (int i = from1; i < to1; i++)
			{
				vector.X += pointsTD[i].X;
				vector.Y += pointsTD[i].Y;
				vector.Z += pointsTD[i].Z;
			}
			for (int j = from2; j < to2; j++)
			{
				vector.X += pointsTD2[j].X;
				vector.Y += pointsTD2[j].Y;
				vector.Z += pointsTD2[j].Z;
			}
			int num = to1 - from1 + to2 - from2;
			return new Vector3(vector.X / (float)num, vector.Y / (float)num, vector.Z / (float)num);
		}

		private GraphicsPath ConnectPoints(PointF[] pathPoints1, PointF[] pathPoints2, int from1, int to1, int from2, int to2)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = from1; i < to1; i++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(pathPoints1[i]);
			}
			for (int j = from2; j < to2; j++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(pathPoints2[j]);
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Chart 3D - ConnectPoints error - zero size array.");
			}
			return CreatePath(arrayList);
		}

		private GraphicsPath CreatePath(ArrayList newPoints)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[newPoints.Count];
			byte[] array2 = new byte[newPoints.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < newPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = 1;
				ref PointF reference = ref array[i];
				reference = (PointF)newPoints[i];
			}
			array2[0] = 0;
			return new GraphicsPath(array, array2);
		}

		private bool IsBorderLineFast(float a, float b, PointF[] points1, PointF[] points2, int firstIndex, int secondIndex)
		{
			if (firstIndex == 0 || firstIndex == points1.Length - 1 || secondIndex == 0 || secondIndex == points2.Length - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag;
			bool result;
			if (float.IsNaN(a))
			{
				flag = points1[firstIndex - 1].X > points1[firstIndex].X && points1[firstIndex + 1].X > points1[firstIndex].X && points2[secondIndex - 1].X > points2[secondIndex].X && points2[secondIndex + 1].X > points2[secondIndex].X;
				result = points1[firstIndex - 1].X < points1[firstIndex].X && points1[firstIndex + 1].X < points1[firstIndex].X && points2[secondIndex - 1].X < points2[secondIndex].X && points2[secondIndex + 1].X < points2[secondIndex].X;
				if (!flag)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return true;
			}
			flag = a * points1[firstIndex - 1].X + b - points1[firstIndex - 1].Y > 0f && a * points1[firstIndex + 1].X + b - points1[firstIndex + 1].Y > 0f && a * points2[secondIndex - 1].X + b - points2[secondIndex - 1].Y > 0f && a * points2[secondIndex + 1].X + b - points2[secondIndex + 1].Y > 0f;
			result = a * points1[firstIndex - 1].X + b - points1[firstIndex - 1].Y < 0f && a * points1[firstIndex + 1].X + b - points1[firstIndex + 1].Y < 0f && a * points2[secondIndex - 1].X + b - points2[secondIndex - 1].Y < 0f && a * points2[secondIndex + 1].X + b - points2[secondIndex + 1].Y < 0f;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsBorderLine(float a, float b, PointF[] points1, PointF[] points2, int firstIndex, int secondIndex)
		{
			if (!IsBorderLineFast(a, b, points1, points2, firstIndex, secondIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (float.IsNaN(a) || float.IsNaN(a))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < points1.Length; i++)
				{
					if (firstIndex != i)
					{
						if (points1[firstIndex].X > points1[i].X)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (points1[firstIndex].X < points1[i].X)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (flag && flag2)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < points2.Length; j++)
				{
					if (secondIndex != j)
					{
						if (points2[secondIndex].X > points2[j].X)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (points2[secondIndex].X < points2[j].X)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (flag && flag2)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			for (int k = 0; k < points1.Length; k++)
			{
				if (firstIndex != k)
				{
					if (a * points1[k].X + b > points1[k].Y)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					if (a * points1[k].X + b < points1[k].Y)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					if (flag3 && flag4)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < points2.Length - 1; l++)
			{
				if (secondIndex != l)
				{
					if (a * points2[l].X + b > points2[l].Y)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					if (a * points2[l].X + b < points2[l].Y)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					if (flag3 && flag4)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void LineFunction(PointF pnt1, PointF pnt2, out float a, out float b)
		{
			if (pnt1.X == pnt2.X)
			{
				a = float.NaN;
				b = float.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				a = (pnt2.Y - pnt1.Y) / (pnt2.X - pnt1.X);
				b = (0f - a) * pnt1.X + pnt1.Y;
			}
		}

		internal override void Add(ZOrder3D order)
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = GetPaths();
			Vector3[] array2 = GetZOrders();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				Path3D path3D = new Path3D();
				path3D.SetAttributes(this);
				path3D.Path = array[i];
				path3D.ZOrder = array2[i];
				path3D.YMainPosition = curve1.YMainPosition.Copy();
				path3D.DisableYMainPositionPerspective = curve1.DisableYMainPositionPerspective;
				path3D.ZMainPosition = curve1.ZMainPosition.Copy();
				path3D.AnglePosition = curve1.AnglePosition.Copy();
				path3D.Bound = path3D.Path.GetBounds();
				path3D.Visibles = Visibles[i];
				path3D.Light = curve1.Light;
				path3D.GradientPoints = curve1.GradientPoints;
				path3D.GradientSize = curve1.GradientSize;
				order.AddPath(path3D);
			}
		}
	}

		internal void AddPartInfo(double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, int row, int column, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series, double percentValue, string label)
		{
			FunnelPartInfo funnelPartInfo = new FunnelPartInfo();
			funnelPartInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
			funnelPartInfo.Series = series;
			funnelPartInfo.Value = value;
			funnelPartInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
			funnelPartInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
			funnelPartInfo.Column = column;

		}

		private void AddPart(FunnelPartInfo info, float topRadius, float bottomRadius, float topZ, float bottomZ, bool includeTop, bool includeBottom, bool flat)
		{
			float midPoint = (topZ + bottomZ) / 2f;
			if (flat)
			{
				if (includeTop)
				{
					AddPlane(info, topRadius, topZ, top: true, midPoint);
				}
				AddMainSides(info, topRadius, bottomRadius, topZ, bottomZ);
				if (includeBottom)
				{
					AddPlane(info, bottomRadius, bottomZ, top: false, midPoint);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (includeTop)
				{
					AddCircularPlane(info, topRadius, topZ, top: true, midPoint);
				}
				AddMainCurve(info, topRadius, bottomRadius, topZ, bottomZ);
				if (includeBottom)
				{
					AddCircularPlane(info, bottomRadius, bottomZ, top: false, midPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddCircularPlane(FunnelPartInfo info, float radius, float z, bool top, float midPoint)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top";
			new RectangleF(Center.X - radius, Center.Y - radius, radius * 2f, radius * 2f);
			new PointF(Center.X, Center.Y - radius);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddEllipse(0f - radius, 0f - radius, radius * 2f, radius * 2f);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), 0.1f);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, z);
			graphicsPath3D.BoundingRect = Bounds;
			graphicsPath3D.Curve = false;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, midPoint, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10000f);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			if (top)
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top Up";
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(0f, z, 1f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(1f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
				graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top Down";
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(1f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(0f, z, 1f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
				graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			}
			Elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		private void AddPlane(FunnelPartInfo info, float radius, float z, bool top, float midPoint)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top";
			new RectangleF(Center.X - radius, Center.Y - radius, radius * 2f, radius * 2f);
			new PointF(Center.X, Center.Y - radius);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(new Vector3[4]
			{
				new Vector3(0f - radius, z, 0f - radius),
				new Vector3(radius, z, 0f - radius),
				new Vector3(radius, z, radius),
				new Vector3(0f - radius, z, radius)
			});
			graphicsPath3D.Curve = false;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = info;
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, midPoint, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10000f);
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			if (top)
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top Up";
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(0f, z, 1f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(1f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
				graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top Down";
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(1f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(0f, z, 1f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
				graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
			}
			Elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		private void AddMainCurve(FunnelPartInfo info, float topRadius, float bottomRadius, float topZ, float bottomZ)
		{
			if ((double)topRadius < 0.5)
			{
				topRadius = 0.5f;
			}
			if ((double)bottomRadius < 0.5)
			{
				bottomRadius = 0.5f;
			}
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = info.FillColor;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = info.OutlineColor;
			complexPath3D.Info = info;
			complexPath3D.Name = "MainCurve";
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(0f - topRadius, 0f - topRadius, topRadius * 2f, topRadius * 2f);
			RectangleF rect = new RectangleF(0f - bottomRadius, 0f - bottomRadius, bottomRadius * 2f, bottomRadius * 2f);
			if (rectangleF.Size.Height <= 0f || rectangleF.Size.Width <= 0f)
			{
				rectangleF.Size = new SizeF(1f, 1f);
			}
			if (rect.Size.Height <= 0f || rect.Size.Width <= 0f)
			{
				rect.Size = new SizeF(1f, 1f);
			}
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rectangleF, -180f, 360f);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), 0.1f);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, topZ);
			graphicsPath3D.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, topZ, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, (topZ + bottomZ) / 2f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10000f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(rect, 180f, -360f);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), 0.1f);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, bottomZ);
			graphicsPath3D2.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, bottomZ, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, (topZ + bottomZ) / 2f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.AnglePosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10000f);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			complexPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, (topZ + bottomZ) / 2f, 0f);
			complexPath3D.AnglePosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10000f);
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect = rectangleF;
			Elements.Add(complexPath3D);
		}
