		internal void Initialize()
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			matrix.RotateX(angleX);
			matrix.RotateY(angleY);
			matrix.RotateZ(angleZ);
			matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Min(Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height) * 1.2f + (100f - (float)perspective) * 5f;
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			matrix2.Translate(new Vector3(Center.X, Center.Y, 0f));
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			if (FunnelParts == null || FunnelParts.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FunnelPartInfo funnelPart in FunnelParts)
			{
				num += funnelPart.Value;
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, funnelPart.Value);
			}
			Funnel3DAppearance funnel3DAppearance = FunnelApp as Funnel3DAppearance;
			double num3;
			double num4;
			bool flat;
			if (funnel3DAppearance != null)
			{
				num3 = funnel3DAppearance.RadiusMax;
				num4 = funnel3DAppearance.RadiusMin;
				flat = funnel3DAppearance.Flat;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = 0.5;
				num4 = 0.0;
				flat = FunnelApp is Pyramid3DAppearance;
			}
			double num5 = (double)Bounds.Height * num3;
			double num6 = (double)Bounds.Height * num4;
			NumericRuler numericRuler = new NumericRuler(0.0, num);
			numericRuler.MapMinimum = 0.0;
			numericRuler.MapMaximum = Bounds.Height;
			NumericRuler numericRuler2 = new NumericRuler(0.0, num2);
			numericRuler2.MapMinimum = num6;
			numericRuler2.MapMaximum = num5;
			bool flag = FunnelApp.ChartComponent == null || ((ColorAppearance)FunnelApp.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color)).AlphaLevel == byte.MaxValue;
			bool flag2 = FunnelApp.Spacing > 0.0 && flag;
			bool flag3 = FunnelApp.Spacing > 0.0 && flag;
			float num7 = (float)((num5 - num6) / (double)FunnelParts.Count);
			float num8 = (float)num5;
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (FunnelApp.Axis != HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithRadiusIncrementConstant && FunnelApp.Axis != HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithSlopeConstant)
			{
				_ = FunnelApp.Sort;
				bool flag5 = FunnelApp is Pyramid3DAppearance || FunnelApp is Cone3DAppearance;
				switch (FunnelApp.Sort)
				{
				case SortStyle.Descending:
					if (flag5)
					{
						num8 = (float)num6;
						flag4 = true;
					}
					break;
				case SortStyle.Ascending:
					if (!flag5)
					{
						num8 = (float)num6;
						flag4 = true;
					}
					break;
				case SortStyle.None:
					if (funnel3DAppearance != null && FunnelParts.Count > 0)
					{
						num8 = (float)numericRuler2.Map(((FunnelPartInfo)FunnelParts[0]).Value);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			float num9 = (0f - Bounds.Height) / 2f;
			for (int i = 0; i < FunnelParts.Count; i++)
			{
				FunnelPartInfo funnelPartInfo2 = FunnelParts[i] as FunnelPartInfo;
				float num10 = num8;
				float num11 = num9;
				double num12 = numericRuler.Map(funnelPartInfo2.Value);
				double num13 = numericRuler2.Map(funnelPartInfo2.Value);
				float num14;
				float num15;
				switch (FunnelApp.Axis)
				{
				case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithRadiusIncrementConstant:
					num14 = ((!flag4) ? (num10 - num7) : (num10 + num7));
					num15 = num11 + (float)num12;
					break;
				case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightAndRadius:
					num14 = (float)num13;
					num15 = num11 + (float)num12;
					break;
				case HierarchicalChartAxis.Radius:
					num14 = (float)num13;
					num15 = num11 + num7 * 2f;
					break;
				case HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightWithSlopeConstant:
				{
					num15 = num11 + (float)num12;
					float num16 = num15 - num11;
					float num17 = num16 / Bounds.Height;
					float num18 = (float)(num5 - num6);
					float num19 = num17 * num18;
					num14 = num10 - num19;
					break;
				}
				default:
					num14 = 1f;
					num15 = 1f;
					break;
				}
				float num20 = (float)((double)(num15 - num11) * FunnelApp.Spacing / 2.0);
				num11 += num20;
				num15 -= num20;
				AddPart(funnelPartInfo2, num10, num14, num11, num15, flag2 || i == 0, flag3 || i == FunnelParts.Count - 1, flat);
				float num21 = num11 + (num15 - num11) / 2f;
				float num22 = num10 + (num14 - num10) / 2f;
				float x = (float)num5 - num22;
				double value = Geometry.RadianToDegree(angleX);
				double value2 = Geometry.RadianToDegree(angleY);
				bool flag6 = !MathFunctions.Between(90.0, 270.0, Math.Abs(value2) % 360.0);
				if (MathFunctions.Between(90.0, 270.0, Math.Abs(value) % 360.0))
				{
					flag6 = !flag6;
				}
				if (flag6)
				{
					AddLabel(new PointF(0f, num22), new PointF(x, num22), num21, num21, funnelPartInfo2);
				}
				else
				{
					AddLabel(new PointF(0f, 0f - num22), new PointF(x, 0f - num22), num21, num21, funnelPartInfo2);
				}
				num15 += num20;
				num8 = num14;
				num9 = num15;
			}
			Transform(matrix);
			Transform(matrix2);
			InitializeZOrder();
			ZOrder.Sort();
		}

		private void AddLabel(PointF startLoc, PointF endLoc, float startY, float endY, FunnelPartInfo info)
		{
			if (!(Bounds.Width <= 0f) && !(Bounds.Height <= 0f))
			{
				Label3DPosition label3DPosition = new Label3DPosition();
				label3DPosition.LabelPosition = new Vector3(startLoc.X, startY, startLoc.Y);
				label3DPosition.AxisPosition = new Vector3(endLoc.X, endY, endLoc.Y);
				label3DPosition.color = info.FillColor;
				label3DPosition.Value = info.Value;
				label3DPosition.PercentValue = info.PercentValue;
				label3DPosition.Label = info.Label;
				Labels.Add(label3DPosition);
			}
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(PointF center)
		{
			return ZOrder.GetFillPrimitives(center);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return ZOrder.GetOutlinePrimitives();
		}

		internal void InitializeZOrder()
		{
			foreach (object element in Elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D)
				{
					graphicsPath3D.Add(ZOrder);
				}
				else if (element is ComplexPath3D complexPath3D)
				{
					complexPath3D.Split();
					complexPath3D.Add(ZOrder);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (object element in Elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D)
				{
					graphicsPath3D.Transform(matrix);
				}
				else if (element is ComplexPath3D complexPath3D)
				{
					complexPath3D.Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in Labels)
			{
				matrix.Transform(label.LabelPosition);
				matrix.Transform(label.AxisPosition);
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum Axis3DNew
	{
		X,
		Y,
		Z,
		X2,
		Y2,
		Z2
	}
	internal enum AxisLabelType
	{
		colLabel,
		rowLabel
	}
	internal enum LabelPos
	{
		posBeg,
		posMid
	}
	internal class GraphicsPath3D : Path3D
	{
		private Vector3[] pathPointsTD;

		private GraphicsPath graphicsPath;

		private PointF[] pathPoints;

		private byte[] pathTypes;

		private Vector3 curveCenter = new Vector3();

		internal Vector3 CurveCenter
		{
			get
			{
				return curveCenter;
			}
			set
			{
				curveCenter = value;
			}
		}

		internal void Set(Vector3[] points)
		{
			pathPointsTD = new Vector3[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				pathPointsTD[i] = points[i];
			}
		}

		internal void Set(GraphicsPath path, Axis3DNew x, Axis3DNew y, float z)
		{
			if (path.PointCount == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Empty path points – GraphicsPath3D:Set.");
			}
			graphicsPath = (GraphicsPath)path.Clone();
			pathPoints = graphicsPath.PathPoints;
			pathTypes = graphicsPath.PathTypes;
			pathPointsTD = new Vector3[pathPoints.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pathPoints.Length; i++)
			{
				pathPointsTD[i] = new Vector3();
				if (x == Axis3DNew.X && y == Axis3DNew.Y)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].X = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = z;
				}
				else if (x == Axis3DNew.Y && y == Axis3DNew.X)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].X = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = z;
				}
				else if (x == Axis3DNew.X && y == Axis3DNew.Z)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].X = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = z;
				}
				else if (x == Axis3DNew.Z && y == Axis3DNew.X)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].X = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = z;
				}
				else if (x == Axis3DNew.Y && y == Axis3DNew.Z)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].X = z;
				}
				else if (x == Axis3DNew.Z && y == Axis3DNew.Y)
				{
					pathPointsTD[i].Z = pathPoints[i].X;
					pathPointsTD[i].Y = pathPoints[i].Y;
					pathPointsTD[i].X = z;
				}
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsPath Get()
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[pathPointsTD.Length];
			byte[] array2 = new byte[pathPointsTD.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].X = pathPointsTD[i].X;
				array[i].Y = pathPointsTD[i].Y;
				array2[i] = 1;
			}
			array2[0] = 0;
			return new GraphicsPath(array, array2);
		}

		internal PointF[] GetPoints()
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[pathPointsTD.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].X = pathPointsTD[i].X;
				array[i].Y = pathPointsTD[i].Y;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal Vector3[] GetPointsTD()
		{
			return pathPointsTD;
		}

		internal float[] GetZPoints()
		{
			float[] array = new float[pathPointsTD.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pathPointsTD[i].Z;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal Vector3 GetZOrder()
		{
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			for (int i = 0; i < pathPointsTD.Length; i++)
			{
				vector.X += pathPointsTD[i].X;
				vector.Y += pathPointsTD[i].Y;
				vector.Z += pathPointsTD[i].Z;
			}
			return new Vector3(vector.X / (float)pathPointsTD.Length, vector.Y / (float)pathPointsTD.Length, vector.Z / (float)pathPointsTD.Length);
		}

		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathPointsTD.Length; i++)
			{
				matrix.Transform(pathPointsTD[i]);
			}
			matrix.Transform(curveCenter);
			matrix.Transform(YMainPosition, !DisableYMainPositionPerspective);
			matrix.Transform(AnglePosition);
			if (Plane != null)
			{
				Plane.Transform(matrix);
			}
			if (GradientPoints != null)
			{
				matrix.Transform(GradientPoints[0], perspective: true);
				matrix.Transform(GradientPoints[1], perspective: true);
			}
			if (Visibles != null)
			{
				matrix.Transform(Visibles[0], perspective: true);
				matrix.Transform(Visibles[1], perspective: true);
				matrix.Transform(Visibles[2], perspective: true);
			}
			if (Light != null)
			{
				matrix.Transform(Light[0], perspective: false);
				matrix.Transform(Light[1], perspective: false);
			}
		}

		internal override void Add(ZOrder3D order)
		{
			Path3D path3D = new Path3D();
			path3D.SetAttributes(this);
			path3D.Path = Get();
			path3D.ZOrder = GetZOrder();
			path3D.Bound = path3D.Path.GetBounds();
			order.AddPath(path3D);
		}
	}
	internal class Matrix3
	{
		private PointF center = new PointF(0f, 0f);

		private float eyeDistance;

		private float scale = 1f;

		private float[] elements = new float[16];

		internal PointF Center
		{
			get
			{
				return center;
			}
			set
			{
				center = value;
			}
		}

		internal float EyeDistance
		{
			get
			{
				return eyeDistance;
			}
			set
			{
				eyeDistance = value;
			}
		}

		internal float Scale
		{
			get
			{
				return scale;
			}
			set
			{
				scale = value;
			}
		}

		internal Matrix3()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		private void SetElements(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= 15; i++)
			{
				elements[i] = matrix.elements[i];
			}
		}

		private float GetElement(int row, int column)
		{
			int num = column + row * 4;
			return elements[num];
		}

		private void SetElement(int row, int column, float value)
		{
			if (row > 3 || row < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("row", row, "Matrix3 – A row index is Out Of Range.");
			}
			if (column > 3 || column < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("column", column, "Matrix3 – A column index is Out Of Range.");
			}
			int num = column + row * 4;
			elements[num] = value;
		}

		private void Multiply(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			for (int i = 0; i <= 3; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j <= 3; j++)
				{
					float num = 0f;
					for (int k = 0; k <= 3; k++)
					{
						num += GetElement(j, k) * matrix.GetElement(k, i);
						matrix2.SetElement(j, i, num);
					}
				}
			}
			SetElements(matrix2);
		}

		private void Multiply(Vector3 vector)
		{
			float x = vector.X;
			float y = vector.Y;
			float z = vector.Z;
			vector.X = elements[0] * x + elements[1] * y + elements[2] * z + elements[3];
			vector.Y = elements[4] * x + elements[5] * y + elements[6] * z + elements[7];
			vector.Z = elements[8] * x + elements[9] * y + elements[10] * z + elements[11];
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			Reset(this);
		}

		private static void Reset(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= 15; i++)
			{
				matrix.elements[i] = 0f;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j <= 3; j++)
			{
				matrix.SetElement(j, j, 1f);
			}
		}

		internal void RotateX(float angle)
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			if (angle != 0f)
			{
				matrix.SetElement(1, 1, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
				matrix.SetElement(1, 2, (float)(0.0 - Math.Sin(0f - angle)));
				matrix.SetElement(2, 1, (float)Math.Sin(0f - angle));
				matrix.SetElement(2, 2, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
			}
			Multiply(matrix);
		}

		internal void RotateY(float angle)
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			if (angle != 0f)
			{
				matrix.SetElement(0, 0, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
				matrix.SetElement(0, 2, (float)Math.Sin(0f - angle));
				matrix.SetElement(2, 0, (float)(0.0 - Math.Sin(0f - angle)));
				matrix.SetElement(2, 2, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
			}
			Multiply(matrix);
		}

		internal void RotateZ(float angle)
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			if (angle != 0f)
			{
				matrix.SetElement(0, 0, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
				matrix.SetElement(0, 1, (float)(0.0 - Math.Sin(0f - angle)));
				matrix.SetElement(1, 0, (float)Math.Sin(0f - angle));
				matrix.SetElement(1, 1, (float)Math.Cos(angle));
			}
			Multiply(matrix);
		}

		internal void Translate(Vector3 point)
		{
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			matrix.SetElement(0, 0, 1f);
			matrix.SetElement(1, 1, 1f);
			matrix.SetElement(2, 2, 1f);
			matrix.SetElement(3, 3, 1f);
			matrix.SetElement(0, 3, point.X);
			matrix.SetElement(1, 3, point.Y);
			matrix.SetElement(2, 3, point.Z);
			Multiply(matrix);
		}

		internal void Transform(Vector3 point)
		{
			Transform(point, perspective: true);
		}

		internal void Transform(Vector3 point, bool perspective)
		{
			Multiply(point);
			if (perspective)
			{
				ApplyPerspective(point);
			}
			ApplyScale(point);
		}

		private void ApplyPerspective(Vector3 point)
		{
			if (eyeDistance != 0f)
			{
				point.X = point.X / (EyeDistance - point.Z) * EyeDistance;
				point.Y = point.Y / (EyeDistance - point.Z) * EyeDistance;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyScale(Vector3 point)
		{
			point.X = (point.X - center.X) * scale + center.X;
			point.Y = (point.Y - center.Y) * scale + center.Y;
		}
	}
	internal class Pie3D
	{
		private ArrayList elements = new ArrayList();

		private int pieOrder;

		private PointF absoluteCenter;

		private float flatten = 0.1f;

		private float edge;

		private RectangleF rect;

		private RectangleF innerRect;

		private float height;

		private Color fill;

		private Color outline;

		private float explodedRadius;

		private PointF center = new PointF(0f, 0f);

		private float radius;

		private float innerRadius;

		private int sliceIndex;

		private PieType pieType = PieType.Doughnut;

		private ValueInfo dataInfo;

		internal PieType PieType
		{
			get
			{
				return pieType;
			}
			set
			{
				pieType = value;
			}
		}

		internal Pie3D(PieType pieType, float radius, float innerRadius, float height, float explodedRadius, int pieOrder, PointF absoluteCenter, float edge)
		{
			this.absoluteCenter = absoluteCenter;
			this.pieType = pieType;
			rect = new RectangleF(center.X - radius / 2f, center.Y - radius / 2f, radius, radius);
			innerRect = new RectangleF(rect.X + (rect.Width - innerRadius) / 2f, rect.Y + (rect.Height - innerRadius) / 2f, innerRadius, innerRadius);
			this.pieOrder = pieOrder * 10;
			this.height = height;
			this.explodedRadius = explodedRadius;
			this.radius = radius;
			this.innerRadius = innerRadius;
			this.edge = edge * 2f;
			if (this.height < this.edge * 5f)
			{
				this.edge = this.height / 5f;
			}
		}

		internal void Add(ZOrderPie3D order, string objectName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				num++;
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					order.Add((GraphicsPath3D)element);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Split();
					order.Add((ComplexPath3D)element);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddSlice(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, Color fill, Color outline, bool exploded, bool side, ValueInfo info)
		{
			dataInfo = info;
			RectangleF rectangleF = rect;
			RectangleF rectangleF2 = innerRect;
			PointF pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + sweepAngle / 2f, explodedRadius);
			if (exploded)
			{
				rect.X += pointFromAngle.X;
				rect.Y += pointFromAngle.Y;
				innerRect.X += pointFromAngle.X;
				innerRect.Y += pointFromAngle.Y;
			}
			this.fill = fill;
			this.outline = outline;
			if (rect.Width <= edge * 2f || rect.Height <= edge * 2f || innerRect.Width <= edge * 2f || innerRect.Height <= edge * 2f)
			{
				edge = 0f;
			}
			if (!(rect.Width <= 0f) && !(rect.Height <= 0f) && !(innerRect.Width <= 0f) && !(innerRect.Height <= 0f))
			{
				AddMainCurve(startAngle, sweepAngle, exploded);
				if (pieType == PieType.Pie)
				{
					AddTopPie(startAngle, sweepAngle, height / 2f, exploded);
					AddTopPie(startAngle, sweepAngle, (0f - height) / 2f, exploded);
				}
				else
				{
					AddInnerCurve(startAngle, sweepAngle);
					AddTop(startAngle, sweepAngle, height / 2f);
					AddTop(startAngle, sweepAngle, (0f - height) / 2f);
				}
				AddUpCurve(startAngle, sweepAngle, exploded);
				AddDownCurve(startAngle, sweepAngle, exploded);
				if (side)
				{
					AddSide(startAngle, sweepAngle, end: false, height / 2f, pieType == PieType.Pie, exploded);
					AddSide(startAngle, sweepAngle, end: true, height / 2f, pieType == PieType.Pie, exploded);
				}
				if (exploded)
				{
					rect = rectangleF;
					innerRect = rectangleF2;
				}
				sliceIndex++;
			}
		}

		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddMainCurve(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, bool exploded)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			complexPath3D.Name = "MainCurve";
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = sliceIndex;
			complexPath3D.Exploded = exploded;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect, startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, height / 2f - edge);
			graphicsPath3D.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f - edge, 0f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(rect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, (0f - height) / 2f + edge);
			graphicsPath3D2.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f + edge, 0f);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			int num = 7 + pieOrder;
			if (exploded)
			{
				num = 9 + pieOrder;
			}
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			complexPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect = rect;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect.Offset(absoluteCenter);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			graphicsPath3D2.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
		}

		private void AddUpCurve(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, bool exploded)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			complexPath3D.Name = "UpCurve";
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = sliceIndex;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rect.X + edge, rect.Y + edge, rect.Width - edge * 2f, rect.Height - edge * 2f), startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, height / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f, 0f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(rect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, height / 2f - edge);
			graphicsPath3D2.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f - edge, 0f);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			int num = 6 + pieOrder;
			if (exploded)
			{
				num = 8 + pieOrder;
			}
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			complexPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect = rect;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect.Offset(absoluteCenter);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f - edge, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			graphicsPath3D2.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f - edge, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
		}

		private void AddDownCurve(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, bool exploded)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			complexPath3D.Name = "DownCurve";
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = sliceIndex;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rect.X + edge, rect.Y + edge, rect.Width - edge * 2f, rect.Height - edge * 2f), startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, (0f - height) / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f, 0f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(rect, startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, (0f - height) / 2f + edge);
			graphicsPath3D2.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f + edge, 0f);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			int num = 6 + pieOrder;
			if (exploded)
			{
				num = 8 + pieOrder;
			}
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			complexPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect = rect;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect.Offset(absoluteCenter);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f + edge, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			graphicsPath3D2.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f + edge, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, num);
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
		}

		private void AddInnerCurve(float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
			ComplexPath3D complexPath3D = new ComplexPath3D();
			complexPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			complexPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			complexPath3D.Name = "InnerCurve";
			complexPath3D.Inner = true;
			complexPath3D.PointIndex = sliceIndex;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(innerRect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.Flatten();
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, height / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, height / 2f, 0f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath2.AddArc(innerRect, startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath2.Flatten();
			graphicsPath3D2.Set(graphicsPath2, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, (0f - height) / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D2.CurveCenter = new Vector3(0f, (0f - height) / 2f, 0f);
			complexPath3D.Set(graphicsPath3D, graphicsPath3D2);
			complexPath3D.Curve = true;
			complexPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect = rect;
			complexPath3D.BoundingRect.Offset(absoluteCenter);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 2 + pieOrder);
			graphicsPath3D2.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D2.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 2 + pieOrder);
			elements.Add(complexPath3D);
		}

		private void AddTop(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float z)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top";
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rect.X + edge, rect.Y + edge, rect.Width - edge * 2f, rect.Height - edge * 2f), startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(innerRect, startAngle + sweepAngle, 0f - sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, z);
			PointF pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f);
			PointF pointFromAngle2 = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle, innerRect.Width / 2f);
			PointF pointFromAngle3 = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + 10f, innerRect.Width / 2f);
			graphicsPath3D.Curve = false;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			if (z < 0f)
			{
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, z, pointFromAngle.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z, pointFromAngle2.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, z, pointFromAngle.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z, pointFromAngle2.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			}
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		private void AddTopPie(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, float z, bool exploded)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "Top";
			PointF pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f);
			PointF pointFromAngle2 = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle, 0f);
			GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + sweepAngle, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f);
			if (exploded)
			{
				pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f + explodedRadius);
				pointFromAngle2 = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + sweepAngle / 2f, explodedRadius);
				GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + sweepAngle, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f + explodedRadius);
			}
			PointF pointFromAngle3 = GetPointFromAngle(startAngle + 10f, (rect.Width - edge * 2f) / 2f);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddLine(pointFromAngle2, pointFromAngle2);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(new RectangleF(rect.X + edge, rect.Y + edge, rect.Width - edge * 2f, rect.Height - edge * 2f), startAngle, sweepAngle);
			graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			graphicsPath.Flatten(new Matrix(), flatten);
			graphicsPath3D.Set(graphicsPath, Axis3DNew.X, Axis3DNew.Z, z);
			graphicsPath3D.Curve = false;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, z, 0f);
			if (z < 0f)
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, z, pointFromAngle.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z, pointFromAngle2.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, z, pointFromAngle.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z, pointFromAngle2.Y);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			}
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		private void AddSide(float startAngle, float sweepAngle, bool end, float z, bool pie, bool exploded)
		{
			GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
			graphicsPath3D.FillColor = fill;
			graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = outline;
			graphicsPath3D.Name = "SideMid";
			graphicsPath3D.Exploded = exploded;
			graphicsPath3D.PointIndex = sliceIndex;
			Vector3[] array = new Vector3[7];
			float angle = startAngle;
			if (end)
			{
				angle = startAngle + sweepAngle;
			}
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition.X = GetPointFromAngle(angle, 100f).X;
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition.Y = 0f;
			graphicsPath3D.AnglePosition.Z = GetPointFromAngle(angle, 100f).Y;
			PointF pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(angle, innerRect.Width / 2f);
			if (pie)
			{
				pointFromAngle = GetPointFromAngle(angle, 0f);
			}
			PointF pointFromAngle2 = GetPointFromAngle(angle, rect.Width / 2f);
			PointF pointFromAngle3 = GetPointFromAngle(angle, rect.Width / 2f - edge);
			pointFromAngle.X += innerRect.Left + innerRect.Width / 2f;
			pointFromAngle.Y += innerRect.Top + innerRect.Height / 2f;
			pointFromAngle2.X += rect.Left + rect.Width / 2f;
			pointFromAngle2.Y += rect.Top + rect.Height / 2f;
			pointFromAngle3.X += rect.Left + rect.Width / 2f;
			pointFromAngle3.Y += rect.Top + rect.Height / 2f;
			array[0] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z - edge, pointFromAngle2.Y);
			array[1] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, 0f - z + edge, pointFromAngle2.Y);
			array[2] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, 0f - z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			array[3] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, 0f - z, pointFromAngle.Y);
			array[4] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle.X, z, pointFromAngle.Y);
			array[5] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle3.X, z, pointFromAngle3.Y);
			array[6] = new Vector3(pointFromAngle2.X, z - edge, pointFromAngle2.Y);
			graphicsPath3D.YMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
			graphicsPath3D.ZMainPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 4 + pieOrder);
			graphicsPath3D.Plane = new Plane3D(array[0], array[1], array[3]);
			graphicsPath3D.Curve = false;
			graphicsPath3D.Info = dataInfo;
			if (!end)
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[0]);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1]);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[3]);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[3]);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1]);
				graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[0]);
			}
			graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
			elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
		}

		internal PointF GetPointFromAngle(float angle, float radius)
		{
			return new PointF(radius * (float)Math.Cos((double)angle * Math.PI / 180.0), radius * (float)Math.Sin((double)angle * Math.PI / 180.0));
		}
	}
	internal class PieChart3D : ChartType3D
	{
		private int ringCount = 1;

		private ArrayList pieSlices = new ArrayList();

		private ZOrderPie3D zOrder = new ZOrderPie3D();

		private PieType type;

		private int pieThickness = 20;

		internal RectangleF boundingRect;

		internal ArrayList labelsTop = new ArrayList();

		internal ArrayList labelsBottom = new ArrayList();

		private float edgeSize = 1f;

		private int explodedDistance;

		internal PieChart3D(PieType type, RectangleF boundingRect, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ, int perspective, int ringCount, int pieThickness, float edgeSize, int explodedDistance, bool flashMode, bool outlineMode)
			: base(angleX, angleY, angleZ, perspective)
		{
			ringCount = Math.Min(3, Math.Max(1, ringCount));
			this.ringCount = ringCount;
			this.boundingRect = boundingRect;
			base.angleX = angleX;
			base.angleY = angleY;
			base.angleZ = angleZ;
			zOrder.Flash = flashMode;
			zOrder.Outline = outlineMode;
			base.perspective = perspective;
			this.type = type;
			this.pieThickness = pieThickness;
			this.edgeSize = edgeSize;
			this.explodedDistance = explodedDistance;
			if (this.explodedDistance > 20)
			{
				this.explodedDistance = 20;
			}
		}

		internal void AddSlice(double value, Color fillColor, Color outlineColor, bool exploded, int ring, int row, int column, string labelText, IDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series, bool otherSlice, string otherLabel)
		{
			if (type != PieType.ConcentricDoughnut && type != PieType.ConcentricPie)
			{
				ring = 0;
			}
			if (ring >= 0 && ring <= ringCount - 1)
			{
				PieSliceInfo pieSliceInfo = new PieSliceInfo();
				pieSliceInfo.Value = value;
				pieSliceInfo.Label = labelText;
				pieSliceInfo.FillColor = fillColor;
				pieSliceInfo.OutlineColor = outlineColor;
				pieSliceInfo.Exploded = exploded;
				pieSliceInfo.Ring = ring;
				pieSliceInfo.Row = row;
				pieSliceInfo.Column = column;
				pieSliceInfo.Series = series;
				pieSliceInfo.DataPoint = dataPoint;
				pieSliceInfo.Other = otherSlice;
				pieSliceInfo.OtherLabel = otherLabel;
				pieSlices.Add(pieSliceInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			labelsTop.Clear();
			labelsBottom.Clear();
			Matrix3 matrix = new Matrix3();
			Matrix3 matrix2 = new Matrix3();
			for (int i = 0; i < ringCount; i++)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < pieSlices.Count; j++)
				{
					PieSliceInfo pieSliceInfo = (PieSliceInfo)pieSlices[j];
					if (pieSliceInfo.Ring == i)
					{
						num += pieSliceInfo.Value;
					}
				}
				double num2 = 360.0 / num;
				float num3 = 0f;
				float num4 = 0f;
				for (int k = 0; k < pieSlices.Count; k++)
				{
					PieSliceInfo pieSliceInfo2 = (PieSliceInfo)pieSlices[k];
					if (pieSliceInfo2.Ring == i)
					{
						num4 = (float)(pieSliceInfo2.Value * num2);
						pieSliceInfo2.StartAngle = num3;
						pieSliceInfo2.SweepAngle = num4;
						pieSliceInfo2.Percent = pieSliceInfo2.Value / num * 100.0;
						num3 += num4;
						if (pieSliceInfo2.Exploded && pieSliceInfo2.Ring == 0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				flag &= type != PieType.ConcentricDoughnut && type != PieType.ConcentricPie;
				matrix = new Matrix3();
				matrix.RotateX(angleX);
				matrix.RotateY(angleY);
				matrix.RotateZ(angleZ);
				matrix.EyeDistance = Math.Min(boundingRect.Width, boundingRect.Height) * 1.2f + (float)((100 - perspective) * 5);
				PointF absoluteCenter = new PointF(boundingRect.X + boundingRect.Width / 2f, boundingRect.Y + boundingRect.Height / 2f);
				matrix2 = new Matrix3();
				matrix2.Translate(new Vector3(absoluteCenter.X, absoluteCenter.Y, 0f));
				float num5 = edgeSize;
				Pie3D pie3D;
				switch (type)
				{
				case PieType.ConcentricDoughnut:
				case PieType.ConcentricPie:
				{
					float num7 = Math.Min(boundingRect.Width, boundingRect.Height);
					float num6 = num7 / (float)ringCount * (float)(ringCount - i);
					PieType pieType = ((i != ringCount - 1 || type != PieType.ConcentricPie) ? type : PieType.Pie);
					pie3D = new Pie3D(pieType, num6, num6 - num7 * 0.25f, num7 * (float)pieThickness / 100f, num7 / 10f, ringCount - i, absoluteCenter, num5);
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					float num6 = Math.Min(boundingRect.Width, boundingRect.Height) * 0.95f;
					pie3D = new Pie3D(type, num6, num6 * 0.6f, num6 * (float)pieThickness / 100f, num6 * (float)explodedDistance / 100f, i, absoluteCenter, num5);
					break;
				}
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < pieSlices.Count; l++)
				{
					if ((type == PieType.Pie || type == PieType.Doughnut) && i > 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					PieSliceInfo pieSliceInfo3 = (PieSliceInfo)pieSlices[l];
					if (pieSliceInfo3.Ring != i)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag2 = pieSliceInfo3.Exploded;
					if (!flag)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					pie3D.AddSlice(pieSliceInfo3.StartAngle, pieSliceInfo3.SweepAngle, pieSliceInfo3.FillColor, pieSliceInfo3.OutlineColor, flag2, flag, pieSliceInfo3);
					switch (type)
					{
					case PieType.ConcentricDoughnut:
					case PieType.ConcentricPie:
					{
						float num11 = Math.Min(boundingRect.Width, boundingRect.Height);
						float num6 = num11 / (float)(i + 1);
						float num9 = num6;
						float num10 = num11 * 0.95f;
						if (flag2)
						{
							num9 *= 1f + (float)explodedDistance / 50f;
							num10 *= 1f + (float)explodedDistance / 50f;
						}
						PointF pointFromAngle = pie3D.GetPointFromAngle(pieSliceInfo3.StartAngle + pieSliceInfo3.SweepAngle / 2f, num9 * 0.5f - num5);
						PointF pointFromAngle2 = pie3D.GetPointFromAngle(pieSliceInfo3.StartAngle + pieSliceInfo3.SweepAngle / 2f, num10 * 0.7f);
						AddLabel(pointFromAngle, pointFromAngle2, num6 * (float)pieThickness / 200f, pieSliceInfo3);
						break;
					}
					default:
					{
						float num8 = Math.Min(boundingRect.Width, boundingRect.Height);
						float num6 = num8 / (float)ringCount * (float)(i + 1);
						float num9 = num6;
						float num10 = num8 * 0.95f;
						PointF pointFromAngle = pie3D.GetPointFromAngle(pieSliceInfo3.StartAngle + pieSliceInfo3.SweepAngle / 2f, num9 * 0.5f - num5);
						PointF pointFromAngle2 = pie3D.GetPointFromAngle(pieSliceInfo3.StartAngle + pieSliceInfo3.SweepAngle / 2f, num10 * 0.7f);
						AddLabel(pointFromAngle, pointFromAngle2, num8 * (float)pieThickness / 200f, pieSliceInfo3);
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				pie3D.Transform(matrix);
				pie3D.Transform(matrix2);
				pie3D.Add(zOrder, "Pie1");
			}
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3(0f, 10f, 0f);
			matrix.Transform(vector);
			matrix2.Transform(vector);
			if (vector.Z > 0f)
			{
				foreach (Label3DPosition item in labelsTop)
				{
					matrix.Transform(item.LabelPosition);
					matrix2.Transform(item.LabelPosition);
					matrix.Transform(item.AxisPosition);
					matrix2.Transform(item.AxisPosition);
				}
				labelsBottom.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Label3DPosition item2 in labelsBottom)
				{
					matrix.Transform(item2.LabelPosition);
					matrix2.Transform(item2.LabelPosition);
					matrix.Transform(item2.AxisPosition);
					matrix2.Transform(item2.AxisPosition);
				}
				labelsTop.Clear();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				zOrder.SortSide();
			}
			else
			{
				zOrder.SortNoSide();
			}
		}

		private void AddLabel(PointF topLabel, PointF bottomLabel, float thickness, PieSliceInfo info)
		{
			if (!(boundingRect.Width <= 0f) && !(boundingRect.Height <= 0f))
			{
				Label3DPosition label3DPosition = new Label3DPosition();
				label3DPosition.LabelPosition = new Vector3(topLabel.X, thickness, topLabel.Y);
				label3DPosition.AxisPosition = new Vector3(bottomLabel.X, thickness, bottomLabel.Y);
				label3DPosition.Value = info.Value;
				if (info.DataPoint != null && info.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
				{
					label3DPosition.Value = numericDataPoint.Value;
				}
				label3DPosition.color = info.FillColor;
				label3DPosition.PercentValue = info.Percent;
				label3DPosition.Label = info.Label;
				if (info.Other)
				{
					label3DPosition.Label = info.OtherLabel;
				}
				labelsTop.Add(label3DPosition);
				label3DPosition = new Label3DPosition();
				label3DPosition.LabelPosition = new Vector3(topLabel.X, 0f - thickness, topLabel.Y);
				label3DPosition.AxisPosition = new Vector3(bottomLabel.X, 0f - thickness, bottomLabel.Y);
				label3DPosition.color = info.FillColor;
				label3DPosition.Value = info.Value;
				if (info.DataPoint != null && info.DataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2)
				{
					label3DPosition.Value = numericDataPoint2.Value;
				}
				label3DPosition.PercentValue = info.Percent;
				label3DPosition.Label = info.Label;
				if (info.Other)
				{
					label3DPosition.Label = info.OtherLabel;
				}
				labelsBottom.Add(label3DPosition);
			}
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives()
		{
			return zOrder.GetFillPrimitives();
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return zOrder.GetOutlinePrimitives();
		}
	}
	internal enum PieType
	{
		Pie,
		Doughnut,
		ConcentricDoughnut,
		ConcentricPie
	}
	internal class PieSliceInfo : ValueInfo
	{
		internal float StartAngle;

		internal float SweepAngle;

		internal bool Exploded;

		internal int Ring;

		internal double Percent;

		internal string Label;

		internal bool Other;

		internal string OtherLabel = string.Empty;
	}
	internal class Plane3D
	{
		private Vector3 p1;

		private Vector3 p2;

		private Vector3 p3;

		internal Plane3D(Vector3 p1, Vector3 p2, Vector3 p3)
		{
			this.p1 = new Vector3(p1);
			this.p2 = new Vector3(p2);
			this.p3 = new Vector3(p3);
		}

		private float GetA()
		{
			return (p2.Y - p1.Y) * (p3.Z - p1.Z) - (p3.Y - p1.Y) * (p2.Z - p1.Z);
		}

		private float GetB()
		{
			return (p2.Z - p1.Z) * (p3.X - p1.X) - (p3.Z - p1.Z) * (p2.X - p1.X);
		}

		private float GetC()
		{
			return (p2.X - p1.X) * (p3.Y - p1.Y) - (p3.X - p1.X) * (p2.Y - p1.Y);
		}

		private float GetD()
		{
			return (0f - p1.X) * GetA() - p1.Y * GetB() - p1.Z * GetC();
		}

		internal float GetZ(Vector3 point)
		{
			return (point.X * GetA() + point.Y * GetB() + GetD()) / (-1f * GetC());
		}

		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			matrix.Transform(p1);
			matrix.Transform(p2);
			matrix.Transform(p3);
		}
	}
	internal class Scene3D
	{
		private ArrayList elements = new ArrayList();

		private double minX;

		private double maxX;

		private double minY;

		private double maxY;

		private double minZ;

		private double maxZ;

		private float sceneDepth;

		private float wallSize;

		internal ArrayList labels = new ArrayList();

		internal RectangleF boundingRectangle;

		private RectangleF boundingSceneRect;

		internal double MinY => minY;

		internal double MaxY => maxY;

		internal Scene3D(RectangleF boundingRect, float depth, float wallSize, double minX, double maxX, double minY, double maxY, double minZ, double maxZ, Color fillColor)
		{
			boundingRectangle = boundingRect;
			sceneDepth = depth;
			this.wallSize = wallSize;
			this.minX = minX;
			this.maxX = maxX;
			this.minY = minY;
			this.maxY = maxY;
			this.minZ = minZ;
			this.maxZ = maxZ;
			if (this.minX == this.maxX)
			{
				this.maxX = this.minX + 1.0;
			}
			if (this.minY == this.maxY)
			{
				this.maxY = this.minY + 1.0;
			}
			if (this.minZ == this.maxZ)
			{
				this.maxZ = this.minZ + 1.0;
			}
			if (minX > maxX || minY > maxY || minZ > maxZ)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Scene 3D - Invalid Min - Max axes values.");
			}
			PointF pointF = new PointF(boundingRectangle.X + boundingRectangle.Width / 2f, boundingRectangle.Y + boundingRectangle.Height / 2f);
			boundingSceneRect = new RectangleF(boundingRectangle.X - pointF.X, boundingRectangle.Y - pointF.Y, boundingRectangle.Width, boundingRectangle.Height);
			if (!(boundingSceneRect.Width <= 0f) && !(boundingSceneRect.Height <= 0f) && !(sceneDepth - wallSize <= 0f))
			{
				AddCube(new RectangleF(boundingSceneRect.X + wallSize, boundingSceneRect.Bottom - wallSize, boundingSceneRect.Width - wallSize, wallSize), (0f - sceneDepth) / 2f + wallSize, sceneDepth - wallSize, "Scene - Bottom Side", fillColor);
				AddCube(new RectangleF(boundingSceneRect.X, boundingSceneRect.Y, wallSize, boundingSceneRect.Height), (0f - sceneDepth) / 2f + wallSize, sceneDepth - wallSize, "Scene - Left Side", fillColor);
				AddCube(boundingSceneRect, (0f - sceneDepth) / 2f, wallSize, "Scene - Back Side", fillColor);
			}
		}

		internal Vector3 GetColumnPixelPosition(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			if (maxX == minX)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid x values for the scene.");
			}
			if (maxY == minY)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid y values for the scene.");
			}
			if (maxZ == minZ)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid z values for the scene.");
			}
			float x2 = (float)((double)(boundingSceneRect.Left + wallSize) + (double)(boundingSceneRect.Width - wallSize) / (maxX - minX) * (x - minX));
			float y2 = (float)((double)(boundingSceneRect.Bottom - wallSize) - (double)(boundingSceneRect.Height - wallSize) / (maxY - minY) * (y - minY));
			float z2 = (float)((double)(sceneDepth / 2f) - (double)(sceneDepth - wallSize) / (maxZ - minZ) * (z - minZ));
			return new Vector3(x2, y2, z2);
		}

		internal Vector3 GetBarPixelPosition(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			if (maxX == minX)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid x values for the scene.");
			}
			if (maxY == minY)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid y values for the scene.");
			}
			if (maxZ == minZ)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid z values for the scene.");
			}
			float x2 = (float)((double)(boundingSceneRect.X + wallSize) + (double)(boundingSceneRect.Width - wallSize) / (maxX - minX) * (y - minX));
			float y2 = (float)((double)(boundingSceneRect.Bottom - wallSize) - (double)(boundingSceneRect.Height - wallSize) / (maxY - minY) * (x - minY));
			float z2 = (float)((double)(sceneDepth / 2f) - (double)(sceneDepth - wallSize) / (maxZ - minZ) * (z - minZ));
			return new Vector3(x2, y2, z2);
		}

		internal void AddLabel(Axis3DNew axis, double value, object textObject)
		{
			if (!(boundingRectangle.Width <= 0f) && !(boundingRectangle.Height <= 0f))
			{
				Label3DPosition label3DPosition = new Label3DPosition();
				label3DPosition.axis = axis;
				label3DPosition.front = axis == Axis3DNew.X || axis == Axis3DNew.Y || axis == Axis3DNew.Z;
				label3DPosition.textObject = textObject;
				switch (axis)
				{
				case Axis3DNew.X:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, minZ);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Z += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition((minX + maxX) / 2.0, minY, minZ);
					break;
				case Axis3DNew.X2:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(value, maxY, maxZ);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y -= wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Z -= wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition((minX + maxX) / 2.0, maxY, maxZ);
					break;
				case Axis3DNew.Y:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, minZ);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.X -= wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Z += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, (minY + maxY) / 2.0, minZ);
					break;
				case Axis3DNew.Y2:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, value, maxZ);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.X += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Z -= wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, (minY + maxY) / 2.0, maxZ);
					break;
				case Axis3DNew.Z:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, value);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.X += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y += wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, (minZ + maxZ) / 2.0);
					break;
				case Axis3DNew.Z2:
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, maxY, value);
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.X -= wallSize * 2f;
					label3DPosition.LabelPosition.Y -= wallSize * 4f;
					label3DPosition.AxisPosition = GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, (minZ + maxZ) / 2.0);
					break;
				}
				labels.Add(label3DPosition);
			}
		}

		internal void AddGridline(Axis3DNew axis, double value, Color color, DashStyle lineStyle, float lineWidth)
		{
			if (!(boundingRectangle.Width <= 0f) && !(boundingRectangle.Height <= 0f))
			{
				AddTickMark(axis, value, color, lineStyle, lineWidth);
				switch (axis)
				{
				case Axis3DNew.X:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D3.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D3.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D3.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D3.outlineOnly = true;
					Vector3[] array3 = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, minZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D3.Set(array3);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array3[0].X, array3[0].Y, array3[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array3[1].X, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array3[1].X + 10f, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
					graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D3.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D3.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D3.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D3.outlineOnly = true;
					array3 = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, maxY, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D3.Set(array3);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array3[0].X, array3[0].Y, array3[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array3[1].X, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array3[1].X + 10f, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
					break;
				}
				case Axis3DNew.Y:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D2.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D2.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D2.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D2.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D2.outlineOnly = true;
					Vector3[] array2 = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, minZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D2.Set(array2);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array2[0].X, array2[0].Y, array2[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y, array2[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y + 10f, array2[1].Z);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D2);
					graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D2.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D2.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D2.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D2.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D2.outlineOnly = true;
					array2 = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, value, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D2.Set(array2);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array2[0].X, array2[0].Y, array2[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y, array2[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y + 10f, array2[1].Z);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D2);
					break;
				}
				case Axis3DNew.Z:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D.outlineOnly = true;
					Vector3[] array = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, value)
					};
					graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[0].X, array[0].Y, array[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1].X, array[1].Y, array[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[1].X, array[1].Y, array[1].Z + 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
					graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D.LineStyle = lineStyle;
					graphicsPath3D.LineWidth = lineWidth;
					graphicsPath3D.Name = "GridLine";
					graphicsPath3D.outlineOnly = true;
					array = new Vector3[2]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, maxY, value)
					};
					graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[0].X, array[0].Y, array[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1].X, array[1].Y, array[1].Z);

					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddStripline(Axis3DNew axis, double value, double width, Color color)
		{
			if (!(boundingRectangle.Width <= 0f) && !(boundingRectangle.Height <= 0f))
			{
				switch (axis)
				{
				case Axis3DNew.X:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D3.Name = "StripLine";
					Vector3[] array3 = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, minZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value + width, minY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value + width, minY, minZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D3.Set(array3);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array3[0].X, array3[0].Y, array3[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array3[1].X, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array3[2].X, array3[2].Y, array3[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
					graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
					graphicsPath3D3 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D3.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D3.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D3.Name = "StripLine";
					array3 = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, minY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value, maxY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value + width, maxY, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(value + width, minY, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D3.Set(array3);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array3[0].X, array3[0].Y, array3[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array3[1].X, array3[1].Y, array3[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array3[2].X, array3[2].Y, array3[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D3.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D3.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					graphicsPath3D3.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D3);
					break;
				}
				case Axis3DNew.Y:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D2.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D2.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D2.Name = "StripLine";
					Vector3[] array2 = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, minZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value + width, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value + width, minZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D2.Set(array2);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array2[2].X, array2[2].Y, array2[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y, array2[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array2[0].X, array2[0].Y, array2[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D2.Light[0] = new Vector3(10f, 0f, 0f);
					graphicsPath3D2.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D2);
					graphicsPath3D2 = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D2.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D2.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D2.Name = "StripLine";
					array2 = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, value, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, value + width, maxZ),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, value + width, maxZ)
					};
					graphicsPath3D2.Set(array2);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array2[2].X, array2[2].Y, array2[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array2[1].X, array2[1].Y, array2[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array2[0].X, array2[0].Y, array2[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D2.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D2.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					graphicsPath3D2.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D2);
					break;
				}
				case Axis3DNew.Z:
				{
					GraphicsPath3D graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D.Name = "StripLine";
					Vector3[] array = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(maxX, minY, value + width),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value + width)
					};
					graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[2].X, array[2].Y, array[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1].X, array[1].Y, array[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[0].X, array[0].Y, array[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(0f, -10f, 0f);
					graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
					graphicsPath3D = new GraphicsPath3D();
					graphicsPath3D.FillColor = color;
					graphicsPath3D.OutlineColor = Color.Transparent;
					graphicsPath3D.Name = "StripLine";
					array = new Vector3[4]
					{
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, maxY, value),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, maxY, value + width),
						GetColumnPixelPosition(minX, minY, value + width)
					};
					graphicsPath3D.Set(array);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles = new Vector3[3];
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[0] = new Vector3(array[0].X, array[0].Y, array[0].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[1] = new Vector3(array[1].X, array[1].Y, array[1].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Visibles[2] = new Vector3(array[2].X, array[2].Y, array[2].Z);
					graphicsPath3D.Light = new Vector3[2];
					graphicsPath3D.Light[0] = new Vector3(10f, 0f, 0f);
					graphicsPath3D.Light[1] = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f);
					elements.Add(graphicsPath3D);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Add(ZOrder3D order, string objectName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				num++;
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					order.Add((GraphicsPath3D)element);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).ObjectName = objectName;
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Split();
					order.Add((ComplexPath3D)element);
				}
			}
		}
