		internal void Transform(Matrix3 matrix)
		{
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in labels)
			{
				matrix.Transform(label.AxisPosition);
				matrix.Transform(label.LabelPosition);
			}
			foreach (object element in elements)
			{
				if (element is GraphicsPath3D)
				{
					((GraphicsPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
				if (element is ComplexPath3D)
				{
					((ComplexPath3D)element).Transform(matrix);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddLabels(RectangleF boundRect, SceneGraph scene, Rectangle outerBounds)
		{
			InitLabels(new PointF(boundRect.X + boundRect.Width / 2f, boundRect.Y + boundRect.Height / 2f));
			int labelNumChar = GetLabelNumChar(Label3DOrientation.Top);
			int labelNumChar2 = GetLabelNumChar(Label3DOrientation.Bottom);
			float num = float.MinValue;
			float num2 = float.MinValue;
			float num3 = float.MaxValue;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			float num4 = float.MinValue;
			float num5 = float.MinValue;
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in labels)
			{
				Text text = label.textObject as Text;
				if (label.LabelPosition == null || text == null || text.labelStyle == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text.GetTextString(), text.labelStyle.Font);
				if (label.orientation == Label3DOrientation.Bottom)
				{
					switch (label.axis)
					{
					case Axis3DNew.X:
					case Axis3DNew.X2:
						flag |= label.LabelPosition.X < num;
						num = label.LabelPosition.X + stringSizePixels.Width;
						num4 = Math.Max(stringSizePixels.Width, num4);
						break;
					case Axis3DNew.Z:
					case Axis3DNew.Z2:
						flag2 |= label.LabelPosition.X < num2 && label.LabelPosition.Y + stringSizePixels.Height > num3;
						num2 = label.LabelPosition.X + stringSizePixels.Width;
						num3 = label.LabelPosition.Y;
						num5 = Math.Max(stringSizePixels.Width, num5);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag3 = !flag && num + num4 < (float)outerBounds.Right;
			bool flag4 = !flag2 && num2 + num5 < (float)outerBounds.Right;
			foreach (Label3DPosition label2 in labels)
			{
				Text text2 = label2.textObject as Text;
				bool flag5 = text2.labelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom;
				switch (label2.orientation)
				{
				case Label3DOrientation.Left:
					text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
					if (label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z2 && text2.labelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom)
					{
						SizeF stringSizePixels5 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text2.GetTextString(), text2.labelStyle.Font);
						label2.LabelPosition.X += stringSizePixels5.Width - 2f * wallSize;
					}
					break;
				case Label3DOrientation.Right:
					text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
					if (label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z2 && text2.labelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom)
					{
						SizeF stringSizePixels4 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text2.GetTextString(), text2.labelStyle.Font);
						label2.LabelPosition.X -= stringSizePixels4.Width - 2f * wallSize;
					}
					break;
				case Label3DOrientation.Top:
					if (labelNumChar < 4)
					{
						text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
						text2.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
						text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
						break;
					}
					if (label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z2 && text2.labelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom)
					{
						SizeF stringSizePixels3 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text2.GetTextString(), text2.labelStyle.Font);
						label2.LabelPosition.Y += stringSizePixels3.Width - 2f * wallSize;
					}
					text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
					break;
				default:
					if (labelNumChar2 < 4 || ((label2.axis == Axis3DNew.X || label2.axis == Axis3DNew.X2) && flag3) || ((label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z || label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z2) && flag4))
					{
						text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
						text2.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
						text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
						break;
					}
					if (label2.axis == Axis3DNew.Z2 && text2.labelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom)
					{
						SizeF stringSizePixels2 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text2.GetTextString(), text2.labelStyle.Font);
						label2.LabelPosition.Y -= stringSizePixels2.Width - 2f * wallSize;
					}
					text2.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
					break;
				}
				if (flag5)
				{
					text2.labelStyle.Orientation = TextOrientation.Custom;
				}
				text2.bounds.Location = new Point((int)label2.LabelPosition.PointF.X, (int)label2.LabelPosition.PointF.Y);
				scene.Add(text2);
			}
		}

		private int GetLabelNumChar(Label3DOrientation orientation)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in labels)
			{
				if (label.orientation == orientation)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, ((Text)label.textObject).GetTextString().Length);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void InitLabels(PointF center)
		{
			foreach (Label3DPosition label in labels)
			{
				float num = ZOrder3D.FindAngle(center, label.AxisPosition.PointF) * 180f / (float)Math.PI;
				if (num > -45f && num <= 45f)
				{
					label.orientation = Label3DOrientation.Right;
				}
				else if (num > 45f && num <= 135f)
				{
					label.orientation = Label3DOrientation.Bottom;
				}
				else if (num > 135f && num <= 225f)
				{
					label.orientation = Label3DOrientation.Left;
				}
				else if ((num > 225f && num <= 270f) || (num > -90f && num <= -45f))
				{
					label.orientation = Label3DOrientation.Top;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum Label3DOrientation
	{
		Left,
		Right,
		Top,
		Bottom
	}
	internal class Label3DPosition
	{
		internal bool front = true;

		internal Axis3DNew axis;

		internal Vector3 LabelPosition;

		internal Vector3 AxisPosition;

		internal object textObject;

		internal Label3DOrientation orientation;

		internal Color color;

		internal double Value;

		internal double PercentValue;

		internal string Label;

		internal int PointIndex;
	}
	internal class Vector3
	{
		internal float X;

		internal float Y;

		internal float Z;

		internal PointF PointF => new PointF(X, Y);

		internal Vector3()
		{
		}

		internal Vector3(float x, float y, float z)
		{
			X = x;
			Y = y;
			Z = z;
		}

		internal Vector3(Vector3 vector)
		{
			X = vector.X;
			Y = vector.Y;
			Z = vector.Z;
		}

		internal Vector3 Copy()
		{
			return new Vector3(X, Y, Z);
		}

		internal static Vector3 Multiply(Vector3 vt1, Vector3 vt2)
		{
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3();
			vector.X = vt1.Y * vt2.Z - vt1.Z * vt2.Y;
			vector.Y = vt1.Z * vt2.X - vt1.X * vt2.Z;
			vector.Z = vt1.X * vt2.Y - vt1.Y * vt2.X;
			return vector;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "{Vector3} X: " + X + ", Y: " + Y + ", Z: " + Z;
		}
	}
	internal class ZOrder3D
	{
		internal enum SceneSideElement
		{
			Left,
			Bottom,
			Back,
			GridLine,
			TickMark,
			StripLine
		}

		internal bool sceneVisibleBottom = true;

		internal bool sceneVisibleLeft = true;

		internal bool sceneVisibleBack = true;

		internal bool Flash;

		internal bool Outline;

		internal ZOrder3D()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
		}

		internal void Add(Path3D path)
		{
			path.Add(this);
		}

		internal static float FindAngle(PointF vt1Start, PointF vt1End)
		{
			if (vt1End.X - vt1Start.X == 0f)
			{
				if (vt1End.Y < vt1Start.Y)
				{
					return -(float)Math.PI / 2f;
				}
				return (float)Math.PI / 2f;
			}
			float num = (float)Math.Atan((vt1End.Y - vt1Start.Y) / (vt1End.X - vt1Start.X));
			if (vt1End.X - vt1Start.X < 0f)
			{
				num = (float)Math.PI + num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected float FindAngle3D(Vector3 first, Vector3 second)
		{
			return (float)Math.Acos((first.X * second.X + first.Y * second.Y + first.Z * second.Z) / GetVectorSize(first) / GetVectorSize(second));
		}

		private static float GetVectorSize(Vector3 vector)
		{
			return (float)Math.Sqrt(vector.X * vector.X + vector.Y * vector.Y + vector.Z * vector.Z);
		}

		protected Color GradientPosition(Color color, bool dark, float coefficient)
		{
			if (!dark)
			{
				return GetColor(color.A, (int)((float)(int)color.R + (float)(255 - color.R) * coefficient), (int)((float)(int)color.G + (float)(255 - color.G) * coefficient), (int)((float)(int)color.B + (float)(255 - color.B) * coefficient));
			}
			return GetColor(color.A, (int)((float)(int)color.R - (float)(int)color.R * coefficient), (int)((float)(int)color.G - (float)(int)color.G * coefficient), (int)((float)(int)color.B - (float)(int)color.B * coefficient));
		}

		private Color GetColor(int alpha, int red, int green, int blue)
		{
			alpha = ((alpha >= 0) ? alpha : 0);
			alpha = ((alpha > 255) ? 255 : alpha);
			red = ((red >= 0) ? red : 0);
			red = ((red > 255) ? 255 : red);
			green = ((green >= 0) ? green : 0);
			green = ((green > 255) ? 255 : green);
			blue = ((blue >= 0) ? blue : 0);
			blue = ((blue > 255) ? 255 : blue);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
		}

		protected void VisibleSceneSides(ArrayList elements)
		{
			foreach (Path3D element in elements)
			{
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Bottom Side - Top")
				{
					sceneVisibleBottom = element.IsVisible();
				}
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Back Side - Front")
				{
					sceneVisibleBack = element.IsVisible();
				}
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Left Side - Right")
				{
					sceneVisibleLeft = element.IsVisible();
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsDisabledSceneSides(Path3D pathElement)
		{
			int alpha = 150;
			if (pathElement.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Bottom Side") && !sceneVisibleBottom)
			{
				pathElement.Brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(alpha, pathElement.FillColor));
				return true;
			}
			if (pathElement.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Back Side") && !sceneVisibleBack)
			{
				pathElement.Brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(alpha, pathElement.FillColor));
				return true;
			}
			if (pathElement.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Left Side") && !sceneVisibleLeft)
			{
				pathElement.Brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(alpha, pathElement.FillColor));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected RectangleF GetBound(ArrayList elements, string elementName, int index)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = Rectangle.Empty;
			foreach (Path3D element in elements)
			{
				if (element.Name == elementName && element.PointIndex == index)
				{
					rectangleF = ((!rectangleF.IsEmpty) ? RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, element.Bound) : element.Bound);
				}
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}

		protected bool SplitSceneElements(ArrayList elements, SceneSideElement side, ArrayList sideElements)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				Path3D path3D = (Path3D)elements[i];
				if (side == SceneSideElement.Left && path3D.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Left Side"))
				{
					if (path3D.Name.EndsWith("Right"))
					{
						result = path3D.IsVisible();
					}
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
				else if (side == SceneSideElement.Bottom && path3D.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Bottom Side"))
				{
					if (path3D.Name.EndsWith("Top"))
					{
						result = path3D.IsVisible();
					}
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
				else if (side == SceneSideElement.Back && path3D.Name.StartsWith("Scene - Back Side"))
				{
					if (path3D.Name.EndsWith("Front"))
					{
						result = path3D.IsVisible();
					}
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
				else if (side == SceneSideElement.GridLine && path3D.Name.StartsWith("GridLine"))
				{
					result = path3D.IsVisible();
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
				else if (side == SceneSideElement.TickMark && path3D.Name.StartsWith("TickMark"))
				{
					result = path3D.IsVisible();
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
				else if (side == SceneSideElement.StripLine && path3D.Name.StartsWith("StripLine"))
				{
					result = path3D.IsVisible();
					sideElements.Add(path3D);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < sideElements.Count; j++)
			{
				elements.Remove(sideElements[j]);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives(ArrayList pathPrimitivesInvisible, ArrayList pathPrimitives, PointF center)
		{
			foreach (Path3D item in pathPrimitivesInvisible)
			{
				Brush brush = null;
				if (item.outlineOnly)
				{
					brush = new SolidBrush(item.FillColor);
					item.Brush = brush;
					continue;
				}
				if (item.Name.StartsWith("Scene"))
				{
					item.Brush = new SolidBrush(item.FillColor);
					continue;
				}
				if (item.Name.StartsWith("StripLine"))
				{
					item.Brush = new SolidBrush(item.OutlineColor);
					continue;
				}
				item.Path.CloseAllFigures();
				if (!item.Curve)
				{
					if (item.Light == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("ZOrder3D - Light not initialized.");
					}
					brush = new SolidBrush(item.FillColor);
					Color color = item.FillColor;
					if (item.Name.EndsWith("edge"))
					{
						color = GradientPosition(color, dark: false, 0.2f);
					}
					Vector3 first = new Vector3(item.Light[0].X - center.X, item.Light[0].Y - center.Y, item.Light[0].Z);
					float num = FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
					float num2 = (float)((double)num / Math.PI);
					float num3 = 0.2f;
					brush = ((!(num2 < num3)) ? new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(color, dark: true, num2 - num3)) : new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(color, dark: false, num3 - num2)));
				}
				else if (item.Name == "MainCurve")
				{
					float angle = FindAngle(item.GradientPoints[0].PointF, item.GradientPoints[1].PointF) * 180f / (float)Math.PI - 90f;
					RectangleF bound = GetBound(pathPrimitives, "MainCurve", item.PointIndex);
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(new RectangleF(bound.X + bound.Width / 2f, bound.Y + bound.Height / 2f, item.GradientSize, item.GradientSize), GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), angle);
					linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					brush = linearGradientBrush;
				}
				item.Brush = brush;
			}
			return pathPrimitivesInvisible;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(bool light, ArrayList pathPrimitives, PointF center, bool column, bool cylinder)
		{
			if (light)
			{
				foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
				{
					if (pathPrimitive.Name == "HeatMap")
					{
						PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.Path);
						pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = pathPrimitive.FillColor;
						Color[] array = new Color[3];
						HeatMapInfo heatMapInfo = pathPrimitive.Info as HeatMapInfo;
						ref Color reference = ref array[0];
						reference = heatMapInfo.colPt1;
						ref Color reference2 = ref array[1];
						reference2 = heatMapInfo.colPt2;
						ref Color reference3 = ref array[2];
						reference3 = heatMapInfo.colPt3;
						pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = array;
						pathPrimitive.Brush = pathGradientBrush;
						continue;
					}
					if (pathPrimitive.Name.StartsWith("SphereLight"))
					{
						float z = pathPrimitive.ZMainPosition.Z;
						Bubble3DLayer.FillSphereLight(rect: new RectangleF(pathPrimitive.AnglePosition.X - z, pathPrimitive.AnglePosition.Y - z, 2f * z, 2f * z), path: out pathPrimitive.Path, brush: out pathPrimitive.Brush, color: pathPrimitive.FillColor);
						continue;
					}
					if (pathPrimitive.Name.StartsWith("SphereSpot"))
					{
						float z2 = pathPrimitive.ZMainPosition.Z;
						Bubble3DLayer.FillSphereLightSpot(rect: new RectangleF(pathPrimitive.AnglePosition.X - z2, pathPrimitive.AnglePosition.Y - z2, 2f * z2, 2f * z2), path: out pathPrimitive.Path, brush: out pathPrimitive.Brush, color: pathPrimitive.FillColor);
						continue;
					}
					Brush brush = null;
					if (pathPrimitive.outlineOnly)
					{
						brush = new SolidBrush(pathPrimitive.FillColor);
						pathPrimitive.Brush = brush;
					}
					else
					{
						if (IsDisabledSceneSides(pathPrimitive))
						{
							continue;
						}
						pathPrimitive.Path.CloseAllFigures();
						if (!pathPrimitive.Curve)
						{
							if (pathPrimitive.Light == null)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException("ZOrder3D - Light not initialized.");
							}
							Color color = pathPrimitive.FillColor;
							brush = new SolidBrush(pathPrimitive.FillColor);
							if (pathPrimitive.Name.EndsWith("edge"))
							{
								color = GradientPosition(color, dark: false, 0.2f);
							}
							Vector3 first = new Vector3(pathPrimitive.Light[0].X - center.X, pathPrimitive.Light[0].Y - center.Y, pathPrimitive.Light[0].Z);
							float num = FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
							float num2 = (float)((double)num / Math.PI);
							float num3 = 0.1f;
							if (cylinder)
							{
								num3 = 0.2f;
							}
							brush = ((!(num2 < num3)) ? new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(color, dark: true, num2 - num3)) : new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(color, dark: false, num3 - num2)));
						}
						else if (pathPrimitive.Name == "MainCurve")
						{
							float angle = FindAngle(pathPrimitive.GradientPoints[0].PointF, pathPrimitive.GradientPoints[1].PointF) * 180f / (float)Math.PI - 90f;
							RectangleF bound = GetBound(pathPrimitives, "MainCurve", pathPrimitive.PointIndex);
							LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = ((!column) ? new LinearGradientBrush(new RectangleF(bound.X + bound.Width / 2f, bound.Y + bound.Height / 2f, pathPrimitive.GradientSize, pathPrimitive.GradientSize), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), angle) : new LinearGradientBrush(new RectangleF(bound.X + bound.Width / 2f, bound.Y + bound.Height / 2f, pathPrimitive.GradientSize, pathPrimitive.GradientSize), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), angle));
							Blend blend = new Blend(3);
							blend.Factors[0] = 0f;
							blend.Positions[0] = 0f;
							if (column)
							{
								blend.Factors[1] = 0.7f;
								blend.Positions[1] = 0.3f;
							}
							else
							{
								blend.Factors[1] = 0.3f;
								blend.Positions[1] = 0.7f;
							}
							blend.Factors[2] = 1f;
							blend.Positions[2] = 1f;
							linearGradientBrush.Blend = blend;
							linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
							brush = linearGradientBrush;
						}
						else if (pathPrimitive.Name == "UpCurve" || pathPrimitive.Name == "DownCurve")
						{
							LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2 = ((!column) ? new LinearGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.Bound, GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.3f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), 90f) : new LinearGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.Bound, GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.3f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), 0f));
							linearGradientBrush2.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
							linearGradientBrush2.TranslateTransform(pathPrimitive.Bound.Width * 0.5f, 0f);
							brush = linearGradientBrush2;
						}
						if (Flash)
						{
							if (brush is SolidBrush)
							{
								((SolidBrush)brush).Color = Color.FromArgb(128, ((SolidBrush)brush).Color);
							}
							else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush)
							{
								Color[] linearColors = new Color[2]
								{
									Color.FromArgb(128, ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[0]),
									Color.FromArgb(128, ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[1])
								};
								((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors = linearColors;
							}
						}
						pathPrimitive.Brush = brush;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive2 in pathPrimitives)
				{
					if (Flash)
					{
						pathPrimitive2.Brush = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(128, pathPrimitive2.FillColor));
						pathPrimitive2.FillColor = Color.FromArgb(128, pathPrimitive2.FillColor);
					}
					else if (pathPrimitive2.Name.StartsWith("SphereLight"))
					{
						float z3 = pathPrimitive2.ZMainPosition.Z;
						Bubble3DLayer.FillSphereLight(rect: new RectangleF(pathPrimitive2.AnglePosition.X - z3, pathPrimitive2.AnglePosition.Y - z3, 2f * z3, 2f * z3), path: out pathPrimitive2.Path, brush: out pathPrimitive2.Brush, color: pathPrimitive2.FillColor);
					}
					else if (pathPrimitive2.Name.StartsWith("SphereSpot"))
					{
						float z4 = pathPrimitive2.ZMainPosition.Z;
						Bubble3DLayer.FillSphereLightSpot(rect: new RectangleF(pathPrimitive2.AnglePosition.X - z4, pathPrimitive2.AnglePosition.Y - z4, 2f * z4, 2f * z4), path: out pathPrimitive2.Path, brush: out pathPrimitive2.Brush, color: pathPrimitive2.FillColor);
					}
					else
					{
						pathPrimitive2.Brush = new SolidBrush(pathPrimitive2.FillColor);
					}
				}
			}
			return pathPrimitives;
		}

		protected void SetCurveZ(Path3D[] pathPrimitives)
		{
			int num = -1;
			foreach (Path3D path3D in pathPrimitives)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, path3D.PointIndex);
			}
			for (int j = 1; j <= num; j++)
			{
				Path3D path3D2 = null;
				Path3D path3D3 = null;
				foreach (Path3D path3D4 in pathPrimitives)
				{
					if (path3D4.PointIndex == j && path3D4.Name == "ColumnCylinder Top")
					{
						path3D2 = path3D4;
					}
					if (path3D4.PointIndex == j && path3D4.Name == "ColumnCylinder Bottom")
					{
						path3D3 = path3D4;
					}
					if (path3D2 != null || path3D3 != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (path3D2 != null)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < pathPrimitives.Length; l++)
					{
						if (pathPrimitives[l].PointIndex == path3D2.PointIndex && pathPrimitives[l].Name == "UpCurve")
						{
							pathPrimitives[l].ZOrder.Z = path3D2.ZOrder.Z;
						}
					}
				}
				if (path3D3 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < pathPrimitives.Length; m++)
				{
					if (pathPrimitives[m].PointIndex == path3D3.PointIndex && pathPrimitives[m].Name == "DownCurve")
					{
						pathPrimitives[m].ZOrder.Z = path3D3.ZOrder.Z;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ZOrderAreaLine3D : ZOrder3D
	{
		private ArrayList pathPrimitives = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList pathPrimitivesInvisible = new ArrayList();

		internal PointF Center;

		internal ZOrderAreaLine3D()
		{
		}

		internal override void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
			pathPrimitives.Add(path);
		}

		private Path3D GetElement(int index)
		{
			return (Path3D)pathPrimitives[index];
		}

		internal GraphicsPath[] Get()
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = new GraphicsPath[pathPrimitives.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
			{
				array[num] = pathPrimitive.Path;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void Sort(bool heatMap)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			PointF perspectiveCenter;
			bool flag = IsTopView(pathPrimitives, out perspectiveCenter);
			VisibleSceneSides(pathPrimitives);
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D element = GetElement(i);
				if (element.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!element.IsVisible() && element.Name != "" && !element.Name.StartsWith("Sphere") && !element.Name.StartsWith("HeatMap"))
					{
						pathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(element);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(element);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(element);
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = arrayList;
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag2 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Left, arrayList2);
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag3 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Bottom, arrayList3);
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag4 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Back, arrayList4);
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.GridLine, arrayList5);
			ArrayList arrayList6 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.TickMark, arrayList6);
			ArrayList arrayList7 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.StripLine, arrayList7);
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			Path3D[] array = new Path3D[count];
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				array[j] = (Path3D)pathPrimitives[j];
			}
			if (flag && !heatMap)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					for (int l = k + 1; l < count; l++)
					{
						Path3D path3D = array[k];
						Path3D path3D2 = array[l];
						double num = (double)path3D.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						double num2 = (double)path3D2.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D2.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D2.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						if (num > num2)
						{
							array[k] = path3D2;
							array[l] = path3D;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < count; m++)
				{
					for (int n = m + 1; n < count; n++)
					{
						Path3D path3D3 = array[m];
						Path3D path3D4 = array[n];
						double num3 = (double)path3D3.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D3.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D3.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						double num4 = (double)path3D4.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D4.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D4.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						if (num3 == num4 && path3D3.ZOrder.Z > path3D4.ZOrder.Z)
						{
							array[m] = path3D4;
							array[n] = path3D3;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 < count; num5++)
				{
					for (int num6 = num5 + 1; num6 < count; num6++)
					{
						Path3D path3D5 = array[num5];
						Path3D path3D6 = array[num6];
						if (path3D5.YMainPosition.Z > path3D6.YMainPosition.Z)
						{
							array[num5] = path3D6;
							array[num6] = path3D5;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!heatMap)
				{
					for (int num7 = 0; num7 < count; num7++)
					{
						for (int num8 = num7 + 1; num8 < count; num8++)
						{
							Path3D path3D7 = array[num7];
							Path3D path3D8 = array[num8];
							if (path3D7.YMainPosition.Z == path3D8.YMainPosition.Z && path3D7.ZOrder.Z > path3D8.ZOrder.Z)
							{
								array[num7] = path3D8;
								array[num8] = path3D7;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives.Clear();
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(array);
			foreach (Path3D item in arrayList6)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item);
			}
			foreach (Path3D item2 in arrayList5)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item2);
			}
			foreach (Path3D item3 in arrayList7)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item3);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item4 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item4);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item5 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item5);
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item6 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item6);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item7 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item7);
				}
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item8 in arrayList4)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item8);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (Path3D item9 in arrayList4)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Add(item9);
			}
		}

		private bool IsTopView(ArrayList elements, out PointF perspectiveCenter)
		{
			perspectiveCenter = PointF.Empty;
			foreach (Path3D element in elements)
			{
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Bottom Side - Top")
				{
					perspectiveCenter = new PointF(element.AnglePosition.X, element.AnglePosition.Y);
					Vector3 first = new Vector3(element.Light[0].X - Center.X, element.Light[0].Y - Center.Y, element.Light[0].Z);
					float num = FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
					if (element.Path.IsVisible(perspectiveCenter) || num < 0.6f)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(bool light, bool cylinder)
		{
			return GetFillPrimitives(light, pathPrimitives, Center, column: true, cylinder);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			return GetOutlinePrimitives(pathPrimitivesInvisible, pathPrimitives, Center);
		}
	}
	internal class ZOrderBar3D : ZOrder3D
	{
		private ArrayList pathPrimitives = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList pathPrimitivesInvisible = new ArrayList();

		internal PointF Center;

		internal ZOrderBar3D()
		{
		}

		internal override void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
			pathPrimitives.Add(path);
		}

		private Path3D GetElement(int index)
		{
			return (Path3D)pathPrimitives[index];
		}

		internal GraphicsPath[] Get()
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = new GraphicsPath[pathPrimitives.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
			{
				array[num] = pathPrimitive.Path;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void Sort(bool stackedCylinder)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			PointF perspectiveCenter;
			bool flag = IsTopView(pathPrimitives, out perspectiveCenter);
			VisibleSceneSides(pathPrimitives);
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D element = GetElement(i);
				if (element.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!element.IsVisible())
					{
						pathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(element);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(element);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(element);
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = arrayList;
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag2 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Left, arrayList2);
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag3 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Bottom, arrayList3);
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag4 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Back, arrayList4);
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.GridLine, arrayList5);
			ArrayList arrayList6 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.TickMark, arrayList6);
			ArrayList arrayList7 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.StripLine, arrayList7);
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			Path3D[] array = new Path3D[count];
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				array[j] = (Path3D)pathPrimitives[j];
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					for (int l = k + 1; l < count; l++)
					{
						Path3D path3D = array[k];
						Path3D path3D2 = array[l];
						double num = (double)path3D.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						double num2 = (double)path3D2.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D2.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D2.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						if (num > num2)
						{
							array[k] = path3D2;
							array[l] = path3D;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < count; m++)
				{
					for (int n = m + 1; n < count; n++)
					{
						Path3D path3D3 = array[m];
						Path3D path3D4 = array[n];
						double num3 = (double)path3D3.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D3.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D3.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						double num4 = (double)path3D4.YMainPosition.Z - (Math.Pow(path3D4.YMainPosition.X - perspectiveCenter.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(path3D4.YMainPosition.Y - perspectiveCenter.Y, 2.0));
						if (num3 == num4 && path3D3.ZOrder.Z > path3D4.ZOrder.Z)
						{
							array[m] = path3D4;
							array[n] = path3D3;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 < count; num5++)
				{
					for (int num6 = num5 + 1; num6 < count; num6++)
					{
						Path3D path3D5 = array[num5];
						Path3D path3D6 = array[num6];
						if (path3D5.YMainPosition.Z > path3D6.YMainPosition.Z)
						{
							array[num5] = path3D6;
							array[num6] = path3D5;
						}
					}
				}
				if (stackedCylinder)
				{
					SetCurveZ(array);
				}
				for (int num7 = 0; num7 < count; num7++)
				{
					for (int num8 = num7 + 1; num8 < count; num8++)
					{
						Path3D path3D7 = array[num7];
						Path3D path3D8 = array[num8];
						if (path3D7.YMainPosition.Z == path3D8.YMainPosition.Z && path3D7.ZOrder.Z > path3D8.ZOrder.Z)
						{
							array[num7] = path3D8;
							array[num8] = path3D7;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives.Clear();
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(array);
			foreach (Path3D item in arrayList5)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item);
			}
			foreach (Path3D item2 in arrayList7)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item2);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item3 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item3);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item4 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item4);
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item5 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item5);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item6 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item6);
				}
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item7 in arrayList4)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item7);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item8 in arrayList4)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item8);
				}
			}
			foreach (Path3D item9 in arrayList6)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Add(item9);
			}
		}

		private bool IsTopView(ArrayList elements, out PointF perspectiveCenter)
		{
			perspectiveCenter = PointF.Empty;
			foreach (Path3D element in elements)
			{
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Left Side - Right")
				{
					perspectiveCenter = new PointF(element.AnglePosition.X, element.AnglePosition.Y);
					Vector3 first = new Vector3(element.Light[0].X - Center.X, element.Light[0].Y - Center.Y, element.Light[0].Z);
					FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
					if (element.Path.IsVisible(perspectiveCenter))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal class ZOrderColumn3D : ZOrder3D
	{
		private ArrayList pathPrimitives = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList pathPrimitivesInvisible = new ArrayList();

		internal PointF Center;

		internal ZOrderColumn3D()
		{
		}

		internal override void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
			pathPrimitives.Add(path);
		}

		private Path3D GetElement(int index)
		{
			return (Path3D)pathPrimitives[index];
		}

		internal GraphicsPath[] Get()
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = new GraphicsPath[pathPrimitives.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
			{
				array[num] = pathPrimitive.Path;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal double GetDistanceFromEye(Vector3 targetPoint, Vector3 eyeLocation)
		{
			return Math.Pow(targetPoint.Z - eyeLocation.Z, 2.0) + Math.Pow(targetPoint.X - eyeLocation.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(targetPoint.Y - eyeLocation.Y, 2.0);
		}

		internal void SortPathsBasedOnCameraDistance(Path3D[] path3D, Vector3 eyeLocation)
		{
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = i + 1; j < count; j++)
				{
					Path3D path3D2 = path3D[i];
					Path3D path3D3 = path3D[j];
					double distanceFromEye = GetDistanceFromEye(path3D2.YMainPosition, eyeLocation);
					double distanceFromEye2 = GetDistanceFromEye(path3D3.YMainPosition, eyeLocation);
					if (distanceFromEye < distanceFromEye2)
					{
						path3D[i] = path3D3;
						path3D[j] = path3D2;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				for (int l = k + 1; l < count; l++)
				{
					Path3D path3D4 = path3D[k];
					Path3D path3D5 = path3D[l];
					double distanceFromEye3 = GetDistanceFromEye(path3D4.YMainPosition, eyeLocation);
					double distanceFromEye4 = GetDistanceFromEye(path3D5.YMainPosition, eyeLocation);
					if (distanceFromEye3 == distanceFromEye4 && path3D4.ZOrder.Z > path3D5.ZOrder.Z)
					{
						path3D[k] = path3D5;
						path3D[l] = path3D4;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Sort(bool stackedCylinder, Vector3 eyeLocation)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			VisibleSceneSides(pathPrimitives);
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D element = GetElement(i);
				if (element.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!element.IsVisible())
					{
						pathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(element);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(element);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(element);
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = arrayList;
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Left, arrayList2);
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag2 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Bottom, arrayList3);
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag3 = SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.Back, arrayList4);
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.GridLine, arrayList5);
			ArrayList arrayList6 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.TickMark, arrayList6);
			ArrayList arrayList7 = new ArrayList();
			SplitSceneElements(pathPrimitives, SceneSideElement.StripLine, arrayList7);
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			Path3D[] array = new Path3D[count];
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				array[j] = (Path3D)pathPrimitives[j];
			}
			SortPathsBasedOnCameraDistance(array, eyeLocation);
			pathPrimitives.Clear();
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(array);
			foreach (Path3D item in arrayList5)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item);
			}
			foreach (Path3D item2 in arrayList7)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item2);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item3 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item3);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item4 in arrayList3)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item4);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item5 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item5);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item6 in arrayList2)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item6);
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				foreach (Path3D item7 in arrayList4)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Insert(0, item7);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Path3D item8 in arrayList4)
				{
					pathPrimitives.Add(item8);
				}
			}
			foreach (Path3D item9 in arrayList6)
			{
				pathPrimitives.Add(item9);
			}
		}

		private bool IsTopView(ArrayList elements, out PointF perspectiveCenter)
		{
			perspectiveCenter = PointF.Empty;
			foreach (Path3D element in elements)
			{
				if (element.Name == "Scene - Bottom Side - Top")
				{
					perspectiveCenter = new PointF(element.AnglePosition.X, element.AnglePosition.Y);
					Vector3 first = new Vector3(element.Light[0].X - Center.X, element.Light[0].Y - Center.Y, element.Light[0].Z);
					float num = FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
					if (element.Path.IsVisible(perspectiveCenter) || num < 0.6f)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal class ZOrderFunnel3D : ZOrder3D
	{
		private ArrayList _PathPrimitives = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList _PathPrimitivesInvisible = new ArrayList();

		internal ArrayList PathPrimitives => _PathPrimitives;

		internal ArrayList PathPrimitivesInvisible => _PathPrimitivesInvisible;

		internal ZOrderFunnel3D()
		{
		}

		internal override void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
			PathPrimitives.Add(path);
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives(PointF center)
		{
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in PathPrimitives)
			{
				if (pathPrimitive.Path != null)
				{
					pathPrimitive.Path.CloseAllFigures();
				}
				string name;
				Brush brush;
				if ((name = pathPrimitive.Name) != null && name == "MainCurve")
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.4f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					Blend blend = new Blend(3);
					blend.Factors[0] = 0f;
					blend.Positions[0] = 0f;
					blend.Factors[1] = 0.8f;
					blend.Positions[1] = 0.4f;
					blend.Factors[2] = 1f;
					blend.Positions[2] = 1f;
					linearGradientBrush.Blend = blend;
					linearGradientBrush.TranslateTransform(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush;
				}
				else
				{
					Vector3 first = new Vector3(pathPrimitive.Light[0].X - center.X, pathPrimitive.Light[0].Y - center.Y, pathPrimitive.Light[0].Z);
					float num = FindAngle3D(first, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 10f));
					float num2 = (float)((double)num / Math.PI);
					float num3 = 0.1f;
					brush = ((!(num2 < num3)) ? new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, num2 - num3)) : new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, num3 - num2)));
				}
				if (Flash)
				{
					if (brush is SolidBrush solidBrush)
					{
						solidBrush.Color = Color.FromArgb(128, solidBrush.Color);
					}
					else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2)
					{
						linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors = new Color[2]
						{
							Color.FromArgb(128, linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[0]),
							Color.FromArgb(128, linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[1])
						};
					}
				}
				pathPrimitive.Brush = brush;
			}
			return PathPrimitives;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			foreach (Path3D item in PathPrimitivesInvisible)
			{
				item.Path.CloseAllFigures();
				string name;
				Brush brush;
				if ((name = item.Name) != null && name == "MainCurve")
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(item.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: true, 0.5f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					linearGradientBrush.TranslateTransform(item.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush;
				}
				else
				{
					brush = new SolidBrush(item.FillColor);
				}
				item.Brush = brush;
			}
			return PathPrimitivesInvisible;
		}

		internal void Sort()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < PathPrimitives.Count; i++)
			{
				Path3D path3D = PathPrimitives[i] as Path3D;
				if (path3D != null && path3D.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!path3D.IsVisible())
					{
						PathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(path3D);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(path3D);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(path3D);
				}
			}
			PathPrimitives.Clear();
			PathPrimitives.AddRange(arrayList.ToArray());
			if (PathPrimitives.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < PathPrimitives.Count; j++)
			{
				string name = ((Path3D)PathPrimitives[j]).Name;
				if (name == "Top Up")
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (name == "Top Down")
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < PathPrimitives.Count; k++)
				{
					for (int l = k + 1; l < PathPrimitives.Count; l++)
					{
						if (((Path3D)PathPrimitives[k]).YMainPosition.Z > ((Path3D)PathPrimitives[l]).YMainPosition.Z)
						{
							Path3D value = (Path3D)PathPrimitives[k];
							PathPrimitives[k] = PathPrimitives[l];
							PathPrimitives[l] = value;
						}
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in PathPrimitives)
			{
				if (pathPrimitive.Name == "Top Up" || pathPrimitive.Name == "Top Down")
				{
					if (pathPrimitive.Name == "Top Up")
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			bool flag5 = true;
			for (int m = 0; m < PathPrimitives.Count; m++)
			{
				if (flag4)
				{
					if (((Path3D)PathPrimitives[m]).Name == "Top Down" && flag5)
					{
						flag5 = false;
						num--;
					}
				}
				else if (((Path3D)PathPrimitives[m]).Name == "Top Up" && flag5)
				{
					flag5 = false;
					num--;
				}
				num = ((!flag5) ? (num - 1) : (num + 1));
				((Path3D)PathPrimitives[m]).PointIndex = num;
			}
			for (int n = 0; n < PathPrimitives.Count; n++)
			{
				for (int num2 = n + 1; num2 < PathPrimitives.Count; num2++)
				{
					if (((Path3D)PathPrimitives[n]).PointIndex > ((Path3D)PathPrimitives[num2]).PointIndex)
					{
						Path3D value2 = (Path3D)PathPrimitives[n];
						PathPrimitives[n] = PathPrimitives[num2];
						PathPrimitives[num2] = value2;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ZOrderPie3D : ZOrder3D
	{
		private ArrayList pathPrimitives = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList pathPrimitivesInvisible = new ArrayList();

		internal ZOrderPie3D()
		{
		}

		internal override void AddPath(Path3D path)
		{
			pathPrimitives.Add(path);
		}

		private Path3D GetElement(int index)
		{
			return (Path3D)pathPrimitives[index];
		}

		internal void SortNoSide()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D element = GetElement(i);
				if (element.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!element.IsVisible())
					{
						pathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(element);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(element);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(element);
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = arrayList;
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				for (int k = j + 1; k < count; k++)
				{
					if (GetElement(j).ZOrder.Z > GetElement(k).ZOrder.Z)
					{
						Path3D element2 = GetElement(j);
						pathPrimitives[j] = GetElement(k);
						pathPrimitives[k] = element2;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
			{
				if (GetElement(l).ZOrder.Z < 0f)
				{
					Path3D path3D = new Path3D();
					path3D = GetElement(l);
					path3D.ZMainPosition.Z *= -1f;
					pathPrimitives[l] = path3D;
				}
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < count; m++)
			{
				for (int n = m + 1; n < count; n++)
				{
					_ = GetElement(m).FillColor.Name;
					_ = GetElement(n).FillColor.Name;
					if (GetElement(m).ZMainPosition.Z > GetElement(n).ZMainPosition.Z)
					{
						Path3D element3 = GetElement(m);
						pathPrimitives[m] = GetElement(n);
						pathPrimitives[n] = element3;
					}
				}
			}
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				for (int num2 = num + 1; num2 < count; num2++)
				{
					if ((!GetElement(num).Curve || !GetElement(num2).Curve || (!(GetElement(num).Name == "MainCurve") && !(GetElement(num2).Name == "MainCurve"))) && GetElement(num).YMainPosition.Z > GetElement(num2).YMainPosition.Z)
					{
						Path3D element4 = GetElement(num2);
						pathPrimitives.RemoveAt(num2);
						pathPrimitives.Insert(num, element4);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SortSide()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList6 = new ArrayList();
			int count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D element = GetElement(i);
				if (element.Visibles != null)
				{
					if (!element.IsVisible())
					{
						pathPrimitivesInvisible.Add(element);
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(element);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(element);
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(arrayList);
			arrayList.Clear();
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				if (GetElement(j).Name == "Top")
				{
					arrayList2.Add(GetElement(j));
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(GetElement(j));
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(arrayList);
			arrayList.Clear();
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				if (GetElement(k).Name == "InnerCurve")
				{
					if (GetElement(k).ZOrder.Z < 0f)
					{
						arrayList5.Add(GetElement(k));
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList4.Add(GetElement(k));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(GetElement(k));
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(arrayList);
			arrayList.Clear();
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
			{
				if (GetElement(l).Name == "DownCurve" || GetElement(l).Name == "UpCurve")
				{
					arrayList6.Add(GetElement(l));
					arrayList.Add(GetElement(l));
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(GetElement(l));
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(arrayList);
			arrayList.Clear();
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int m = 0; m < count; m++)
			{
				if (GetElement(m).ZOrder.Z < 0f)
				{
					arrayList3.Add(GetElement(m));
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(GetElement(m));
				}
			}
			pathPrimitives = new ArrayList(arrayList);
			count = pathPrimitives.Count;
			for (int n = 0; n < count; n++)
			{
				if (GetElement(n).ZOrder.Z < 0f)
				{
					Path3D path3D = new Path3D();
					path3D = GetElement(n);
					path3D.ZMainPosition.Z *= -1f;
					pathPrimitives[n] = path3D;
				}
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				for (int num2 = num + 1; num2 < count; num2++)
				{
					if (GetElement(num).YMainPosition.Z == GetElement(num2).YMainPosition.Z && GetElement(num).ZMainPosition.Z > GetElement(num2).ZMainPosition.Z)
					{
						Path3D element2 = GetElement(num);
						pathPrimitives[num] = GetElement(num2);
						pathPrimitives[num2] = element2;
					}
				}
			}
			count = arrayList4.Count;
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < count; num3++)
			{
				for (int num4 = num3 + 1; num4 < count; num4++)
				{
					Path3D path3D2 = (Path3D)arrayList4[num3];
					Path3D path3D3 = (Path3D)arrayList4[num4];
					if (path3D2.ZOrder.Z > path3D3.ZOrder.Z)
					{
						arrayList4[num3] = path3D3;
						arrayList4[num4] = path3D2;
					}
				}
			}
			count = arrayList5.Count;
			for (int num5 = 0; num5 < count; num5++)
			{
				for (int num6 = num5 + 1; num6 < count; num6++)
				{
					Path3D path3D4 = (Path3D)arrayList5[num5];
					Path3D path3D5 = (Path3D)arrayList5[num6];
					if (path3D4.ZOrder.Z > path3D5.ZOrder.Z)
					{
						arrayList5[num5] = path3D5;
						arrayList5[num6] = path3D4;
					}
				}
			}
			ExplodedSortPositive(pathPrimitives, arrayList4);
			ExplodedSortNegative(arrayList3, arrayList5);
			pathPrimitives.InsertRange(0, arrayList3);
			pathPrimitives.InsertRange(pathPrimitives.Count, arrayList2);
		}

		internal void ExplodedSortPositive(ArrayList elements, ArrayList inner)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			int count = elements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D path3D = (Path3D)elements[i];
				if (path3D.Name == "MainCurve")
				{
					arrayList.Add(elements[i]);
				}
				else if (path3D.Name == "DownCurve" || path3D.Name == "UpCurve")
				{
					arrayList3.Add(elements[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList2.Add(elements[i]);
				}
			}
			count = arrayList.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				for (int k = j + 1; k < count; k++)
				{
					Path3D path3D2 = (Path3D)arrayList[j];
					Path3D path3D3 = (Path3D)arrayList[k];
					if (path3D2.ZOrder.Z > path3D3.ZOrder.Z)
					{
						arrayList[j] = path3D3;
						arrayList[k] = path3D2;
					}
				}
			}
			count = arrayList2.Count;
			for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
			{
				for (int m = l + 1; m < count; m++)
				{
					Path3D path3D4 = (Path3D)arrayList2[l];
					Path3D path3D5 = (Path3D)arrayList2[m];
					if (path3D4.AnglePosition.Z > path3D5.AnglePosition.Z)
					{
						arrayList2[l] = path3D5;
						arrayList2[m] = path3D4;
					}
				}
			}
			elements.Clear();
			bool[] array = new bool[arrayList.Count];
			bool[] array2 = new bool[arrayList2.Count];
			bool[] array3 = new bool[arrayList3.Count];
			int count2 = arrayList2.Count;
			int count3 = arrayList.Count;
			int count4 = arrayList3.Count;
			for (int n = 0; n < count2; n++)
			{
				Path3D path3D6 = (Path3D)arrayList2[n];
				for (int num = 0; num < count3; num++)
				{
					Path3D path3D7 = (Path3D)arrayList[num];
					if (path3D7.PointIndex != path3D6.PointIndex || !(path3D6.Plane.GetZ(new Vector3(path3D7.ZOrder.X, path3D7.ZOrder.Y, path3D7.ZOrder.Z)) > path3D7.ZOrder.Z))
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < count4; num2++)
					{
						Path3D path3D8 = (Path3D)arrayList3[num2];
						if (path3D8.PointIndex == path3D6.PointIndex && path3D6.Plane.GetZ(new Vector3(path3D8.ZOrder.X, path3D8.ZOrder.Y, path3D8.ZOrder.Z)) > path3D8.ZOrder.Z)
						{
							elements.Add(path3D8);
							array3[num2] = true;
						}
					}
					elements.Add(path3D7);
					elements.Add(path3D6);
					array[num] = true;
					array2[n] = true;
					break;
				}
				if (!array2[n])
				{
					elements.Add(path3D6);
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < arrayList3.Count; num3++)
			{
				if (!array3[num3])
				{
					elements.Add(arrayList3[num3]);
				}
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < arrayList.Count; num4++)
			{
				if (!array[num4])
				{
					elements.Add(arrayList[num4]);
				}
			}
			bool[] array4 = new bool[inner.Count];
			for (int num5 = 0; num5 < inner.Count; num5++)
			{
				for (int num6 = 0; num6 < elements.Count; num6++)
				{
					Path3D path3D9 = (Path3D)inner[num5];
					Path3D path3D10 = (Path3D)elements[num6];
					if (path3D9.PointIndex == path3D10.PointIndex)
					{
						elements.Insert(num6, path3D9);
						array4[num5] = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num7 = 0; num7 < inner.Count; num7++)
			{
				if (!array4[num7])
				{
					elements.Add(inner[num7]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ExplodedSortNegative(ArrayList elements, ArrayList inner)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			int count = elements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Path3D path3D = (Path3D)elements[i];
				if (path3D.Name == "MainCurve")
				{
					arrayList.Add(elements[i]);
				}
				else if (path3D.Name == "DownCurve" || path3D.Name == "UpCurve")
				{
					arrayList3.Add(elements[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList2.Add(elements[i]);
				}
			}
			arrayList = inner;
			count = arrayList.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				for (int k = j + 1; k < count; k++)
				{
					Path3D path3D2 = (Path3D)arrayList[j];
					Path3D path3D3 = (Path3D)arrayList[k];
					if (path3D2.ZOrder.Z > path3D3.ZOrder.Z)
					{
						arrayList[j] = path3D3;
						arrayList[k] = path3D2;
					}
				}
			}
			count = arrayList2.Count;
			for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
			{
				for (int m = l + 1; m < count; m++)
				{
					Path3D path3D4 = (Path3D)arrayList2[l];
					Path3D path3D5 = (Path3D)arrayList2[m];
					if (path3D4.AnglePosition.Z > path3D5.AnglePosition.Z)
					{
						arrayList2[l] = path3D5;
						arrayList2[m] = path3D4;
					}
				}
			}
			elements.Clear();
			bool[] array = new bool[arrayList.Count];
			bool[] array2 = new bool[arrayList2.Count];
			bool[] array3 = new bool[arrayList3.Count];
			int count2 = arrayList2.Count;
			int count3 = arrayList.Count;
			int count4 = arrayList3.Count;
			for (int n = 0; n < count2; n++)
			{
				Path3D path3D6 = (Path3D)arrayList2[n];
				for (int num = 0; num < count3; num++)
				{
					Path3D path3D7 = (Path3D)arrayList[num];
					if (path3D7.PointIndex != path3D6.PointIndex)
					{
						continue;
					}
					elements.Add(path3D6);
					elements.Add(path3D7);
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < count4; num2++)
					{
						Path3D path3D8 = (Path3D)arrayList3[num2];
						if (path3D8.PointIndex == path3D6.PointIndex)
						{
							elements.Add(path3D8);
							array3[num2] = true;
						}
					}
					array[num] = true;
					array2[n] = true;
					break;
				}
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < arrayList3.Count; num3++)
				{
					Path3D path3D9 = (Path3D)arrayList3[num3];
					if (!array3[num3] && path3D9.PointIndex == path3D6.PointIndex)
					{
						array3[num3] = true;
						elements.Add(arrayList3[num3]);
					}
				}
				if (!array2[n])
				{
					elements.Add(path3D6);
				}
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < arrayList.Count; num4++)
			{
				if (!array[num4])
				{
					elements.Add(arrayList[num4]);
				}
			}
			for (int num5 = 0; num5 < arrayList3.Count; num5++)
			{
				if (!array3[num5])
				{
					elements.Add(arrayList3[num5]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsPath[] Get()
		{
			GraphicsPath[] array = new GraphicsPath[pathPrimitives.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
			{
				array[num] = pathPrimitive.Path;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetOutlinePrimitives()
		{
			foreach (Path3D item in pathPrimitivesInvisible)
			{
				item.Path.CloseAllFigures();
				Brush brush;
				if (item.Name == "MainCurve" || item.Name == "InnerCurve")
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(item.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: true, 0.5f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					linearGradientBrush.TranslateTransform(item.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush;
				}
				else if (item.Name == "UpCurve" || item.Name == "DownCurve")
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2 = new LinearGradientBrush(item.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: false, 0.3f), GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: true, 0.4f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush2.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					linearGradientBrush2.TranslateTransform(item.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush2;
				}
				else
				{
					brush = ((!(item.Name == "SideMid")) ? new SolidBrush(item.FillColor) : new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(item.FillColor, dark: true, 0.4f)));
				}
				item.Brush = brush;
			}
			return pathPrimitivesInvisible;
		}

		internal ArrayList GetFillPrimitives()
		{
			foreach (Path3D pathPrimitive in pathPrimitives)
			{
				pathPrimitive.Path.CloseAllFigures();
				Brush brush;
				if (pathPrimitive.Name == "MainCurve" || pathPrimitive.Name == "InnerCurve")
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.2f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.4f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					Blend blend = new Blend(3);
					blend.Factors[0] = 0f;
					blend.Positions[0] = 0f;
					blend.Factors[1] = 0.8f;
					blend.Positions[1] = 0.4f;
					blend.Factors[2] = 1f;
					blend.Positions[2] = 1f;
					linearGradientBrush.Blend = blend;
					linearGradientBrush.TranslateTransform(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush;
				}
				else if (!(pathPrimitive.Name == "UpCurve") && !(pathPrimitive.Name == "DownCurve"))
				{
					brush = ((!(pathPrimitive.Name == "SideMid")) ? new SolidBrush(pathPrimitive.FillColor) : new SolidBrush(GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.4f)));
				}
				else
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2 = new LinearGradientBrush(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect, GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: false, 0.5f), GradientPosition(pathPrimitive.FillColor, dark: true, 0.2f), 0f);
					linearGradientBrush2.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
					Blend blend2 = new Blend(3);
					blend2.Factors[0] = 0f;
					blend2.Positions[0] = 0f;
					blend2.Factors[1] = 0.9f;
					blend2.Positions[1] = 0.2f;
					blend2.Factors[2] = 1f;
					blend2.Positions[2] = 1f;
					linearGradientBrush2.Blend = blend2;
					linearGradientBrush2.TranslateTransform(pathPrimitive.BoundingRect.Width * 0.8f, 0f);
					brush = linearGradientBrush2;
				}
				if (Flash)
				{
					if (brush is SolidBrush)
					{
						((SolidBrush)brush).Color = Color.FromArgb(128, ((SolidBrush)brush).Color);
					}
					else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush)
					{
						Color[] linearColors = new Color[2]
						{
							Color.FromArgb(128, ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[0]),
							Color.FromArgb(128, ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[1])
						};
						((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors = linearColors;
					}
				}
				pathPrimitive.Brush = brush;
			}
			return pathPrimitives;
		}
	}
	public class ParetoLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		private PrimitiveCollection _columns;

		internal PrimitiveCollection Columns
		{
			get
			{
				return _columns;
			}
			set
			{
				_columns = value;
			}
		}

		public ParetoLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Pareto);
		}

		private void SortColumns(PrimitiveCollection columnsIn)
		{
			columnsIn.Sort(new PrimitiveComparer(), ascending: false);
		}

		private PaintElement GetPE(int colIndex, double val, bool empty, EmptyAppearance emptyApp)
		{
			return GetPE(null, colIndex, val, empty, emptyApp);
		}

		private PaintElement GetPE(Primitive prim, int colIndex, double val, bool empty, EmptyAppearance emptyApp)
		{
			if (empty && emptyApp != null && emptyApp.EnablePE)
			{
				return emptyApp.PE;
			}
			return GetPE(prim, prim.DataPoint, prim.Series, swapRowsAndColumns: false);
		}

		private Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle GetLineStyle(bool empty, EmptyAppearance emptyApp)
		{
			if (empty && emptyApp != null && emptyApp.EnableLineStyle)
			{
				return emptyApp.LineStyle;
			}
			return new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			ParetoChartAppearance paretoChartAppearance = (ParetoChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			base.NullHandling = paretoChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			double minValue = dataAppearance.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataAppearance.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataAppearance.UseMinMax;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = base.Grid["X"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = base.Grid["Y"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis3 = base.Grid["Y2"] as IAdvanceAxis;
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null || advanceAxis3 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (data is SeriesCollection { Count: >0 } seriesCollection)
			{
				seriesCollection[0].GetPoints();
			}
			int count = Columns.Count;
			switch (advanceAxis.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				advanceAxis.Maximum = count;
				advanceAxis.Minimum = 0;
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				advanceAxis.Maximum = advanceAxis.RangeMax;
				advanceAxis.Minimum = advanceAxis.RangeMin;
				break;
			}
			switch (advanceAxis2.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				if (advanceAxis2 is Axis axis && axis.GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance { TickmarkStyle: not AxisTickStyle.Smart })
				{
					advanceAxis2.Maximum = data.GetDataMax();
					advanceAxis2.Minimum = data.GetDataMin();
				}
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				advanceAxis2.Maximum = (double)advanceAxis2.RangeMax;
				advanceAxis2.Minimum = (double)advanceAxis2.RangeMin;
				break;
			}
			EmptyAppearance emptyApp = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
			PrimitiveCollection columns = Columns;
			double[] array = new double[count];
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = (int)advanceAxis2.MapMinimum;
			int num3 = (int)((advanceAxis.Map(1) - advanceAxis.Map(0)) * paretoChartAppearance.ColumnSpacing / 2.0);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num4 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map((double)i));
				int num5 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis.Map((double)(i + 1)));
				num4 += num3;
				num5 -= num3;
				array[i] = 0.0;
				if (i < columns.Count && columns[i] != null && columns[i].Value != null)
				{
					double.TryParse(columns[i].Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out array[i]);
				}
				num += array[i];
				int num6 = (int)Math.Round(advanceAxis2.Map(array[i]));
				if (i >= columns.Count || !(columns[i] is Box box))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num6 > num2)
				{
					box.rect = new Rectangle(num4, num2, num5 - num4, num6 - num2);
				}
				else
				{
					box.rect = new Rectangle(num4, num6, num5 - num4, num2 - num6);
				}
				box.PE = GetPE(box, i, array[i], box.Empty, emptyApp);
				box.lineStyle = GetLineStyle(box.Empty, emptyApp);
				box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
				if (!box.Empty)
				{
					box.Caps = box.Caps | PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Tooltip;
				}
				if (useMinMax)
				{
					if (minValue <= array[i] && maxValue >= array[i])
					{
						scene.Add(box);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					scene.Add(box);
				}
			}
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis3 == null || num == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2) is AxisAppearance { RangeType: not AxisRangeType.Automatic } axisAppearance2))
			{
				advanceAxis3.Minimum = advanceAxis3.Zero;
				advanceAxis3.Maximum = 100;
			}
			else
			{
				advanceAxis3.Minimum = axisAppearance2.RangeMin;
				advanceAxis3.Maximum = axisAppearance2.RangeMax;
			}
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			double num7 = 0.0;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				int x = (int)advanceAxis.Map((double)j + 0.5);
				double num8 = array[j] / num * 100.0;
				num7 += num8;
				int y = (int)advanceAxis3.Map(num7);
				DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(x, y);
				if (j < columns.Count && columns[j] != null)
				{
					dataPoint.Row = columns[j].Row;
					dataPoint.Column = columns[j].Column;
					dataPoint.Empty = columns[j].Empty;
					dataPoint.DataPoint = columns[j].DataPoint;
					dataPoint.Series = columns[j].Series;
				}
				dataPoint.Chart = ChartType.ParetoChart;
				dataPoint.Layer = this;
				dataPoint.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
				dataPoint.Value = num7;
				if (!dataPoint.Empty)
				{
					dataPoint.Caps = dataPoint.Caps | PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Tooltip;
				}
				primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint);
			}
			RenderPointsToScene(paretoChartAppearance, scene, primitiveCollection, emptyApp);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderPointsToScene(ParetoChartAppearance paretoApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, EmptyAppearance emptyApp)
		{
			if (pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataPoint[] array = (DataPoint[])pointsForLineUnderConstruction.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
			_ = base.Grid["X"];
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			while (num < array.Length)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				arrayList.Add(primitiveCollection);
				bool empty = array[num].Empty;
				bool flag = false;
				while (!flag)
				{
					flag = num == array.Length - 1 || array[num].Empty != array[num + 1].Empty;
					primitiveCollection.Add(array[num]);
					num++;
				}
				if (empty)
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						int num3 = pointsForLineUnderConstruction.IndexOf(primitiveCollection[0]) - 1;
						primitiveCollection.Insert(0, array[num3]);
					}
					if (num < array.Length)
					{
						primitiveCollection.Add(array[num]);
					}
				}
				DataPoint[] array2 = new DataPoint[primitiveCollection.Count];
				primitiveCollection.CopyTo(array2);
				if (primitiveCollection.Count != 1)
				{
					Polyline line = new Polyline(array2);
					AddLineToScene(line, empty, scene, paretoApp, emptyApp);
				}
				num2++;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddLineToScene(Polyline line, bool empty, SceneGraph scene, ParetoChartAppearance paretoApp, EmptyAppearance emptyApp)
		{
			if (empty)
			{
				if (base.NullHandling == NullHandling.DontPlot)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (emptyApp.EnablePE)
				{
					line.PE = emptyApp.PE.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					line.PE = paretoApp.LinePE.Clone();
				}
				if (emptyApp.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					line.lineStyle = emptyApp.LineStyle.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					line.lineStyle = paretoApp.LineStyle.Clone();
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				for (int i = 0; i < line.points.Length; i++)
				{
					if (line.points[i] != null && line.points[i].Empty)
					{
						DataPoint value = new DataPoint(line.points[i].point);
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
				if (emptyApp.EnablePoint)
				{
					DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[arrayList.Count];
					arrayList.CopyTo(array);
					PointSet pointSet = ((emptyApp.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(array, emptyApp.PointStyle.Icon, emptyApp.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(array, emptyApp.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyApp.PointStyle.Character));
					pointSet.PE = emptyApp.PointPE.Clone();
					scene.Add(pointSet);
				}
				line.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
			}
			else
			{
				line.PE = paretoApp.LinePE.Clone();
				line.lineStyle = paretoApp.LineStyle.Clone();
				line.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			}
			line.Chart = ChartType.ParetoChart;
			line.Path = Path;
			line.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
			line.Layer = this;
			int column = (line.Row = 0);
			line.Column = column;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1053");
		}

		internal void InitializeColumns()
		{
			base.NullHandling = ((ParetoChartAppearance)GetAppearance()).NullHandling;
			bool flag = false;
			Columns = new PrimitiveCollection();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			ISeries series = null;
			IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = null;
			if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				series = seriesCollection[0];
				provideDataPoints = series.GetPoints();
			}
			int num = provideDataPoints?.Count ?? data.GetColumnCount();
			base.EmptyValues = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Box box = new Box(Rectangle.Empty);
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = null;
				if (provideDataPoints != null)
				{
					numericDataPoint = provideDataPoints[i] as NumericDataPoint;
					if (numericDataPoint != null)
					{
						if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
						{
							box.Value = null;
						}
						else
						{
							box.Value = numericDataPoint.Value;
						}
					}
				}
				if (numericDataPoint == null)
				{
					numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
					box.Value = data.GetObjectValue(0, i);
					numericDataPoint.Empty = box.Value == null;
				}
				box.Empty = numericDataPoint.Empty;
				if (numericDataPoint.Empty)
				{
					switch (base.NullHandling)
					{
					case NullHandling.Zero:
						base.EmptyValues = true;
						box.Value = 0.0;
						break;
					case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
					case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
						flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
						break;
					}
				}
				box.Row = 0;
				box.Column = i;
				box.Layer = this;
				box.Chart = ChartType.ParetoChart;
				box.DataPoint = numericDataPoint;
				box.Series = series;
				Columns.Add(box);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Columns = InterpolatePrimitives(Columns, typeof(double));
			}
			SortColumns(Columns);
		}
	}

			{

			{
				ChartType.ProbabilityChart => ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Probability), 
				ChartType.ScatterChart => ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Scatter),

			};

		{

			{
				dataIsValid = false;
			}
			else if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if ((item is XYSeries || item is NumericTimeSeries) && item.GetPoints().Count > 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
				if (columnCount < 2 || data.GetRowCount() < 1)
				{
					dataIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected new virtual void putText(DataPoint b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance)
		{
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			itemFormatString = DrawScatterSpecificToolTips(itemFormatString, b1.DataPoint);
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = b1.Column;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = b1.Row;
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Text text2 = new Text(b1.point, text, labelStyle);
			text2.Row = b1.Row;
			text2.Column = b1.Column;
			text2.bounds = text2.GetActualBounds();
			text2.Path = Path;
			text2.Layer = b1.Layer;
			scene.Add(text2);
		}

		private string DrawScatterSpecificToolTips(string toolTipFormatString, IDataPoint dataPoint)
		{
			if (dataPoint is XYDataPoint)
			{
				XYDataPoint xYDataPoint = dataPoint as XYDataPoint;
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = xYDataPoint.ValueX;
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = xYDataPoint.ValueY;

		protected int CreateSeriesHashtable(ScatterChartAppearance scatterApp)
		{
			map.Clear();
			orderedKeys.Clear();
			int num = 0;
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = data as IChartDataFilter;
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			if (chartDataFilter != null)

			{
				num = seriesCollection.Count;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				string text = null;
				if (chartDataFilter != null)
				{
					text = chartDataFilter.GetRawData().GetStringValue(i, scatterApp.GroupByColumn);
				}
				else if (seriesCollection != null)
				{
					text = seriesCollection[i].Label;
					if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
					{
						text = seriesCollection[i].Key;
					}
				}
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "_null";
				}
				else if (text.Length == 0)
				{
					text = "_empty";
				}
				text = text.Trim();
				if (map.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					map[text] = (int)map[text] + 1;
					continue;
				}
				map.Add(text, 1);
				orderedKeys.Add(text);
			}
			return map.Count;
		}

		protected virtual PrimitiveCollection BreakUpNulls(PointSet pointSet)
		{
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < pointSet.points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pointSet.points[i] != null)
				{
					primitiveCollection2.Add(pointSet.points[i]);
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			while (num < pointSet.points.Length)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection3 = new PrimitiveCollection();
				arrayList.Add(primitiveCollection3);
				bool flag = pointSet.points[num] == null || pointSet.points[num].Empty;
				bool flag2 = false;
				while (!flag2)
				{
					flag2 = num == pointSet.points.Length - 1 || pointSet.points[num] == null != (pointSet.points[num + 1] == null);
					if (!flag2 && pointSet.points[num] != null)
					{
						flag2 = pointSet.points[num].Empty != pointSet.points[num + 1].Empty;
					}
					if (pointSet.points[num] != null)
					{
						primitiveCollection3.Add(pointSet.points[num]);
					}
					num++;
				}
				DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[primitiveCollection3.Count];
				primitiveCollection3.CopyTo(array);
				PointSet pointSet2 = (flag ? GetEmptyPointSet(array, pointSet) : ((pointSet.icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(array, pointSet.icon, pointSet.iconSize) : new PointSet(array, pointSet.font, pointSet.character)));
				if (pointSet2 != null)
				{
					pointSet2.DataPoint = pointSet.DataPoint;
					pointSet2.Series = pointSet.Series;
					pointSet2.Row = pointSet.Row;
					pointSet2.Column = pointSet.Column;
					primitiveCollection.Add(pointSet2);
				}
				num2++;
			}
			return primitiveCollection;
		}

		protected virtual PointSet GetEmptyPointSet(DataPoint[] points, PointSet original)
		{
			PointSet pointSet = null;
			if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) is EmptyAppearance { PointStyle: not null, EnablePoint: not false } emptyAppearance)
			{
				pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(points, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(points, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
				if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
				}
				else
				{
					pointSet.PE = original.PE;
				}
				pointSet.Empty = true;
			}
			return pointSet;
		}
