	public class RadarLayer : ChartLayer
	{
		private bool _zeroAligned;

		private bool ZeroAligned
		{
			get
			{
				return _zeroAligned;
			}
			set
			{
				_zeroAligned = value;
			}
		}

		public RadarLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore chartcore)
			: base(component, chartcore)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Radar);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			RadarChartAppearance radarChartAppearance = (RadarChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			base.NullHandling = radarChartAppearance.NullHandling;
			ZeroAligned = ((DataAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data)).ZeroAligned;
			Point center = new Point(outerBounds.X + outerBounds.Width / 2, outerBounds.Y + outerBounds.Height / 2);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			NumericAxis numericAxis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
			numericAxis.SetData(data);
			numericAxis.Path = "Border.Title.Grid.Y";
			int num;
			if (radarChartAppearance.SpacingAroundChart != -1)
			{
				num = radarChartAppearance.SpacingAroundChart;
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
				if (axisAppearance2.Labels.Visible)
				{
					if (seriesCollection != null)
					{
						foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
						{
							if (!(item is NumericSeries numericSeries))
							{
								continue;
							}
							foreach (NumericDataPoint point in numericSeries.Points)
							{
								ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = point.Value;
								ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
								ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = point.Label;
								string str = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString);
								num2 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Max(num2, Platform.GetStringSizePixels(str, axisAppearance2.Labels.Font).Width));
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < data.GetColumnCount(); i++)
						{
							object columnLabel = data.GetColumnLabel(i);
							ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
							ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = columnLabel;
							string str2 = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, axisAppearance2.Labels.ItemFormatString);
							num2 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Max(num2, Platform.GetStringSizePixels(str2, axisAppearance2.Labels.Font).Width));
						}
					}
				}
				num = num2;
				if (Math.Min(OuterBound.Height, OuterBound.Width) == OuterBound.Height && Math.Abs(OuterBound.Height - OuterBound.Width) >= num)
				{
					num /= 2;
				}
				if (num > Math.Min(OuterBound.Height, OuterBound.Width))
				{

		private double GetRange(double min, double max)
		{
			if (max <= 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Abs(max - min);
			}
			if (min * max < 0.0)
			{
				return max + Math.Abs(min);
			}
			if (min > 0.0)
			{
				return max - min;
			}
			return max;
		}

		private void ConfigureAxisForAngle(NumericAxis axMain, Point center, double radius, double angle)
		{
			Point point = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, radius, Geometry.DegreeToRadian(angle));
			axMain.axisLineStart = center;
			axMain.axisLineEnd = point;
			axMain.startPoint = center;
			axMain.endPoint = point;
			axMain.MapMinimum = center.Y;
			axMain.MapMaximum = point.Y;
		}

		private Point Map(NumericAxis axMain, double dataValue, Point center, double angle)
		{
			double num = axMain.Map(dataValue);
			double radius = Math.Abs(num - axMain.MapMinimum);
			return Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, radius, Geometry.DegreeToRadian(angle));
		}

		public Point[] DrawRadialAxis(int radius, Point center, RadarChartAppearance radarApp, SceneGraph scene, NumericAxis axMain, AxisAppearance axisAppX)
		{
			return DrawRadialAxis(radius, center, radarApp, scene, axMain, axisAppX, 1.0);
		}

		private Point[] DrawRadialAxis(int radius, Point center, RadarChartAppearance radarApp, SceneGraph scene, NumericAxis axMain, AxisAppearance axisAppX, double resultInflation)
		{
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			Point[] array = new Point[columnCount];
			double num = 360.0 / (double)columnCount;
			double num2 = -90.0;
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
			if (axisAppX.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				axMain.Minimum = axisAppX.RangeMin;
				axMain.Maximum = axisAppX.RangeMax;
			}
			else
			{
				axMain.Maximum = dataMax;
				if (dataMin > 0.0 && ZeroAligned && axMain.RangeType != AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					axMain.Minimum = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					axMain.Minimum = dataMin;
				}
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)axMain.GetAppearance();
			if ((double)axMain.Minimum == 0.0 && axMain.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				axMain.Minimum = axisAppearance.LogZero;
			}
			axMain.addStyle(65536);
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				ConfigureAxisForAngle(axMain, center, radius, num2);
				Point point = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(center, (double)radius * resultInflation, Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num2));
				array[i] = point;
				bool forRadarLayer = false;
				axMain.ForRadarLayer = true;
				if (i != 0)
				{
					axMain.setStyle(262144, set: false);
				}
				else
				{
					axMain.RulerType = axisAppearance.NumericAxisType;
					axisAppearance.SmartAxisTickmarks(axMain);
					dataMax = (double)axMain.Maximum;
					dataMin = (double)axMain.Minimum;
				}
				axMain.ShowScrollbar = i == 0;
				axMain.FillSceneGraph(scene, setStartAndEndPoints: false);
				axMain.ForRadarLayer = forRadarLayer;
				if (axisAppX.Labels.Visible)
				{
					object columnLabel = data.GetColumnLabel(i);
					Text text = new Text(axMain.endPoint, columnLabel.ToString());
					if (i == 0)
					{
						text.bounds.Y -= 5;
					}
					text.labelStyle.FontColor = axisAppX.Labels.FontColor;
					text.labelStyle.Font = axisAppX.Labels.Font;
					ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.Axis;
					ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = columnLabel;
					string textString = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, axisAppX.Labels.ItemFormatString);
					text.SetTextString(textString);
					if (num2 > -90.0 && num2 < 90.0)
					{
						text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					}
					else if (num2 == 90.0 || num2 == -90.0)
					{
						text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					}
					else
					{
						text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					}
					if (num2 > 0.0 && num2 < 180.0)
					{
						text.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
					}
					else if (num2 == 0.0 || num2 == 180.0)
					{
						text.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					}
					else
					{
						text.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
					}
					Rectangle actualBounds = text.GetActualBounds();
					int num3 = Math.Max(0, actualBounds.Right - OuterBound.Right);
					int num4 = Math.Max(0, OuterBound.Left - actualBounds.Left);
					int num5 = Math.Max(0, OuterBound.Top - actualBounds.Top);
					int num6 = Math.Max(0, actualBounds.Bottom - OuterBound.Bottom);
					actualBounds.Offset(num4 - num3, num5 - num6);
					LabelStyle labelStyle = text.labelStyle;
					StringAlignment verticalAlign = (text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center);
					labelStyle.VerticalAlign = verticalAlign;
					text.bounds = actualBounds;
					text.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(text);
				}
				num2 += num;
			}
			ConfigureAxisForAngle(axMain, center, radius, -90.0);
			return array;
		}

		private PointSet[] BreakUpNulls(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection3 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (points[i] != null)
				{
					primitiveCollection.Add(points[i]);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < points.Length; j++)
			{
				if (points[j] != null)
				{
					if (points[j].Empty)
					{
						primitiveCollection3.Add(points[j]);
					}
					else
					{
						primitiveCollection2.Add(points[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			PointSet pointSet = new PointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), SymbolIcon.None, SymbolIconSize.Small);
			PointSet pointSet2 = null;
			PointSet pointSet3 = null;
			if (primitiveCollection.Count != primitiveCollection2.Count)
			{
				pointSet3 = new PointSet(points, SymbolIcon.None, SymbolIconSize.Small);
				pointSet3.Empty = true;
			}
			if (primitiveCollection3.Count > 0)
			{
				pointSet2 = GetEmptyPointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection3.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
			}
			return new PointSet[3] { pointSet, pointSet3, pointSet2 };
		}

		protected virtual PointSet GetEmptyPointSet(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			PointSet pointSet = null;
			if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) is EmptyAppearance { PointStyle: not null, EnablePoint: not false } emptyAppearance)
			{
				pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet(points, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet(points, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
				if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
				}
				pointSet.Empty = true;
			}
			return pointSet;
		}

		private PaintElement GetPE(Primitive line, IDataPoint point, ISeries series, bool swapRowsAndColumns, RadarChartAppearance radarApp)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = base.GetPE(line, point, series, swapRowsAndColumns).Clone();
			paintElement.StrokeWidth = radarApp.LineThickness;
			return paintElement;
		}

		public double RadianToDegree(double theta)
		{
			double num;
			for (num = theta * 180.0 / Math.PI; num > 360.0; num -= 360.0)
			{
			}
			for (; num < 0.0; num += 360.0)
			{
			}
			return num;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("Please use Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Geometry.DegreeToRadian instead.")]
		public double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return Geometry.DegreeToRadian(degree);
		}

		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_1052");
		}

	public enum SetLabelAxisType

	public class SetLabelAxis : LabelAxisBase
	{
		internal SetLabelAxisType axisType;

		private void GetMaxLabelSizes(SeriesCollection seriesCol, out int widestItemLabel, out int tallestItemLabel, out int widestSeriesLabel, out int tallestSeriesLabel)
		{
			widestItemLabel = (tallestItemLabel = (widestSeriesLabel = (tallestSeriesLabel = -1)));
			if (seriesCol == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesCol.Count; i++)
			{
				SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(seriesCol[i].Label, base.GroupLabelStyle);
				widestSeriesLabel = Math.Max(widestSeriesLabel, (int)labelSizePixels.Width);
				tallestSeriesLabel = Math.Max(tallestSeriesLabel, (int)labelSizePixels.Height);
				IProvideDataPoints points = seriesCol[i].GetPoints();
				if (points != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
					{
						SizeF labelSizePixels2 = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(points[j].Label, base.MajorLabelStyle);
						widestItemLabel = Math.Max(widestItemLabel, (int)labelSizePixels2.Width);
						tallestItemLabel = Math.Max(tallestItemLabel, (int)labelSizePixels2.Height);
					}
				}
				switch (base.MajorLabelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				{
					int num = widestItemLabel;
					widestItemLabel = tallestItemLabel;
					tallestItemLabel = num;
					break;
				}
				}
				switch (base.GroupLabelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				{
					int num2 = widestSeriesLabel;
					widestSeriesLabel = tallestSeriesLabel;
					tallestSeriesLabel = num2;
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		public SetLabelAxis(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, AxisNumber axisNumber, SetLabelAxisType labelAxisType)
			: base(component, core, axisNumber)
		{
			axisType = labelAxisType;
			if (axisType == SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData)
			{
				itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
				seriesLabelFormat = "";
			}
			else
			{
				itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
				seriesLabelFormat = "<SERIES_LABEL>";
			}
		}

		internal void SetMinAndMax(IGroupSpacing groupSpacing)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			base.Scale = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scale;
			base.Scroll = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scroll;
			AxisRangeType rangeType = base.RangeType;
			if (rangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				Maximum = base.RangeMax;
				Minimum = base.RangeMin;
				return;
			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			switch (axisType)
			{
			case SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries:
				if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X2_Axis && ChartCore.getProperDataForMultipleChart(axisNumber) != null)
				{
					Maximum = ChartCore.getProperDataForMultipleChart(axisNumber).GetColumnCount() * ChartCore.getProperDataForMultipleChart(axisNumber).GetRowCount();
				}
				else if (groupSpacing != null)
				{
					int rowCount;
					int columnCount;
					if (data is SeriesCollection)
					{
						rowCount = data.GetRowCount();
						columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
					}
					else
					{
						rowCount = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetRowCount();
						columnCount = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount();
					}
					if (stackIt)
					{
						Maximum = rowCount + (rowCount - 1) * groupSpacing.ItemSpacing;
					}
					else
					{
						Maximum = rowCount * columnCount + (rowCount - 1) * groupSpacing.SeriesSpacing + (columnCount - 1) * groupSpacing.ItemSpacing * rowCount;
					}
				}
				else if (stackIt)
				{
					Maximum = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount() - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					Maximum = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount() * ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetRowCount();
				}
				break;
			case SetLabelAxisType.DateData:
				if (seriesCollection == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is CandleSeries)
					{
						Minimum = base.Zero;
						Maximum = item.GetPoints().Count;
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			case SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData:
				switch (ChartCore.ChartType)
				{
				case ChartType.ParetoChart:
				{
					ChartLayer chartLayer = ChartCore.GetChartLayer();
					if (chartLayer != null && chartLayer.ChartData is SeriesCollection)
					{
						SeriesCollection seriesCollection2 = (SeriesCollection)chartLayer.ChartData;
						foreach (ISeries item2 in seriesCollection2)
						{
							if (item2 is NumericSeries)
							{
								Maximum = item2.GetPoints().Count;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Maximum = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount();
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.BoxChart:
					if (seriesCollection != null)
					{
						foreach (ISeries item3 in seriesCollection)
						{
							if (item3 is BoxSetSeries)
							{
								Maximum = item3.GetPoints().Count;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Maximum = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetRowCount();
					}
					break;
				default:
					Maximum = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount() - 1;
					break;
				case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
				case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				case ChartType.Composite:
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			Minimum = base.Zero;
		}

		private void BarsAndGroups(out int bars, out int groups)
		{
			switch (axisType)
			{
			case SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData:
				groups = 1;
				bars = data.GetColumnCount() - 1;
				interItemSpacing = 0;
				interSeriesSpacing = 0;
				break;
			case SetLabelAxisType.DateData:
				groups = 1;
				if (data is SeriesCollection)
				{
					bars = ((IProvideGroupedLabels)data).ItemCountTotal;
				}
				else
				{
					bars = data.GetRowCount() - 1;
				}
				interItemSpacing = 0;
				interSeriesSpacing = 0;
				break;
			default:
				groups = data.GetRowCount();
				bars = data.GetColumnCount();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void DrawGridLine(bool major, int loc, SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (MathFunctions.BetweenOrEqualTo(MapMinimum, MapMaximum, loc))
			{
				Line line = (((drawingStyle & 0x8000) <= 0) ? new Line(new Point(span_1, loc), new Point(span_2, loc)) : new Line(new Point(loc, span_1), new Point(loc, span_2)));
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle;
				Color stroke;
				int strokeWidth;
				if (major)
				{
					lineStyle = majorGridLineStyle;
					stroke = majorGridLineColor;
					strokeWidth = majorGridLineThickness;
				}
				else
				{
					lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
					stroke = minorGridLineColor;
					strokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
				}
				line.lineStyle = lineStyle;
				line.PE.Stroke = stroke;
				line.PE.StrokeOpacity = stroke.A;
				line.PE.StrokeWidth = strokeWidth;
				line.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(line);
			}
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphDateData(SceneGraph scene, SeriesCollection seriesCol, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			AxisLabelInfoCollection axisLabelInfoCollection = new AxisLabelInfoCollection();
			axisLineStart.X -= interItemSpacing;
			int num = 0;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = new TimeSpan(1, 0, 0, 0);
			CandleSeries candleSeries = null;
			if (seriesCol != null)
			{
				startDate = DateTime.MaxValue;
				endDate = DateTime.MinValue;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCol)
				{
					if (item is CandleSeries)
					{
						candleSeries = (CandleSeries)item;
						DateTime dateTime = ((CandleSeries)item).GetStartDate();
						DateTime dateTime2 = ((CandleSeries)item).GetEndDate();
						if (dateTime.CompareTo(startDate) < 0)
						{
							startDate = dateTime;
						}
						if (dateTime2.CompareTo(endDate) > 0)
						{
							endDate = dateTime2;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (candleSeries == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			timeSpan = (((drawingStyle & 4) <= 0) ? DateInterval : new TimeSpan((long)((double)(endDate.Ticks - startDate.Ticks) * tickPercentage / 100.0)));
			if (ChartLayerAppearance is CandleChartAppearance)
			{
				DateSkipN = ((CandleChartAppearance)ChartLayerAppearance).SkipN;
			}
			if (DateSkipN > 0)
			{
				timeSpan = timeSpan.Add(new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Ticks * DateSkipN));
			}
			int totalWidth = 0;
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
			{
				totalWidth = ((!(outerBounds == Rectangle.Empty)) ? outerBounds.Width : (axisLineEnd.X - axisLineStart.X));
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0)
			{
				totalWidth = ((!(outerBounds == Rectangle.Empty)) ? outerBounds.Height : (axisLineStart.Y - axisLineEnd.Y));

						}
					}

					{

						if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
						{

			case SetLabelAxisType.DateData:

		private Point CalculateTextLoc(int seriesStartLoc, int seriesMidLoc, int seriesEndLoc, int otherSeriesCoordinate, Size textSize)
		{
			Point point = default(Point);
			return ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0) ? ((base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle % 90 == 0) ? new Point(seriesMidLoc, otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDy) : (((base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle <= 90 || base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle >= 180) && (base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle <= 270 || base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle >= 360)) ? new Point(seriesEndLoc - textSize.Width / 2, otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDy) : new Point(seriesMidLoc + textSize.Width / 2, otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDy))) : ((base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle % 90 == 0) ? new Point(otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDx, seriesMidLoc) : (((base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle <= 90 || base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle >= 180) && (base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle <= 270 || base.GroupLabelStyle.RotationAngle >= 360)) ? new Point(otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDx, seriesMidLoc + textSize.Height / 2) : new Point(otherSeriesCoordinate + LabelDx, seriesStartLoc - textSize.Height / 2)));
		}

		internal int GetSeriesWidth()
		{
			IGroupSpacing groupSpacing = GetGroupSpacing();
			int numItems = GetNumItems();
			int num = groupSpacing?.ItemSpacing ?? 0;
			double num2 = Map(base.Zero);
			int num3 = numItems + (numItems - 1) * num;
			double num4 = Map(num3);
			return (int)Math.Round(num4 - num2);
		}

		private int GetNumItems()
		{
			switch (ChartCore.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.Composite:
				if (base.MainChartLayer is ParetoLayer || base.MainChartLayer is BoxChartLayer)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt32(Maximum);
				}
				return data.GetColumnCount();
			case ChartType.ParetoChart:
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
				return Convert.ToInt32(Maximum);
			default:
				return data.GetColumnCount();
			}
		}

		protected override int GetCorrectLabelBoundsWidth(int scrollbarSize, int originalWidth)
		{
			if (axisNumber != AxisNumber.X_Axis && axisNumber != AxisNumber.X2_Axis)
			{
				return base.GetCorrectLabelBoundsWidth(scrollbarSize, originalWidth);
			}
			if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.ColumnChart || ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.BarChart)
			{
				return CorrectLabelBoundsWidthForBars();
			}
			return base.GetCorrectLabelBoundsWidth(scrollbarSize, originalWidth);
		}

		private int CorrectLabelBoundsWidthForBars()
		{
			BarsAndGroups(out var bars, out var groups);
			int num = GetNumItems();
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return (int)MapRange;
			}
			if (stackIt)
			{
				bars = 1;
				num = 1;
			}
			IGroupSpacing groupSpacing = ChartLayerAppearance as IGroupSpacing;
			if (groupSpacing == null)
			{
				groupSpacing = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() as IGroupSpacing;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = (int)Math.Round(Map(num2));
			if (groupSpacing != null)
			{
				num2 = groups * (num - 1) * groupSpacing.ItemSpacing;
				int num4 = (stackIt ? groupSpacing.ItemSpacing : groupSpacing.SeriesSpacing);
				num2 += (groups - 1) * num4;
			}
			int num5 = (int)Math.Round(Map((double)(num * groups + num2 - 1)));
			int num6 = Math.Abs(num5 - num3);
			return (int)((double)num6 * m_Scale);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (axisAppearance == null || !axisAppearance.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Scale = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scale;
			base.Scroll = axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Scroll;
			if (axisAppearance.NumericAxisType != NumericAxisType.Linear)
			{
				axisAppearance.NumericAxisType = NumericAxisType.Linear;
			}
			base.MajorLabelStyle = axisAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle.Clone();
			SetStartAndEndPoints();
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (data != null && data.GetRowCount() != 0)
			{
				if (stackIt)
				{
					FillSceneGraphStacked(scene);
				}
				else
				{
					FillSceneGraphNonStacked(scene);
				}
				if (!delayAxisLineRender && scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene)
				{
					RenderAxisLine(scene, axisLineStart, axisLineEnd);
				}
			}
		}

			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			data.GetColumnCount();
			BarsAndGroups(out var bars, out var groups);

				Text[] array = new Text[groups];
				int num4 = 0;
				GetMaxLabelSizes(seriesCollection, out var _, out var _, out var widestSeriesLabel, out var tallestSeriesLabel);
				for (int i = 0; i < groups; i++)
				{
					int num5 = axisNumber switch

						AxisNumber.X2_Axis => base.startPoint.Y - 2 + LabelDy,

						string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, seriesLabelFormat);
						int num9 = 2;
						if (axisType == SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries && (drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0 && text != null && text.Length > 0)

							SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text, base.GroupLabelStyle);

							{
								int num10 = (int)((float)num5 + labelSizePixels.Height / 2f) + num9;
								if (num10 > base.startPoint.Y)
								{
									num5 -= num10 - base.startPoint.Y;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								int num11 = (int)((float)num5 - labelSizePixels.Height / 2f) - num9;
								if (num11 < base.startPoint.Y)
								{
									num5 += base.startPoint.Y - num11;
								}
							}

	public class SkinLayer : Layer
	{
		public SkinLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			ColorAppearance colorAppearance = (ColorAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color);
			if (colorAppearance.ModelStyle == ColorModels.CustomSkin)
			{
				SkinAppearance skinApp = (SkinAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Skin);
				FillSceneGraphPaintElement(scene, skinApp);
			}
			EffectsAppearance effects = (EffectsAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects);
			FillSceneGraphEffects(scene, effects);
			OverrideAppearance overrides = (OverrideAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Override);
			FillSceneGraphOverride(scene, overrides);
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphOverride(SceneGraph scene, OverrideAppearance overrides)
		{
			if (!overrides.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Override @override in overrides.Overrides)
			{
				if (@override.Enabled)
				{
					@override.Apply(scene);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FillSceneGraphEffects(SceneGraph scene, EffectsAppearance effects)
		{
			if (!effects.Enabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IEffect effect3 in effects.Effects)
			{
				if (!(effect3 is Effect { Enabled: false }))
				{
					effect3.Apply(scene);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillSceneGraphPaintElement(SceneGraph scene, SkinAppearance skinApp)
		{
			PaintElementCollection elements = skinApp.GetElements();
			if (elements == null || elements.Count == 0 || scene == null || scene.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in scene)
			{
				Text text = item as Text;
				if (!(item is PrimitiveShape) && !(item is Symbol) && (text == null || !(text.Layer is IconLegendLayer)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Primitive primitive = (Primitive)item;
				if (primitive.Path != null && primitive.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") > -1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PaintElement pE = primitive.PE;
				if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.Skin) == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (skinApp.ApplyRowWise)
				{
					if (primitive.Row >= 0)
					{
						primitive.PE = elements[primitive.Row % elements.Count];
					}
				}
				else if (primitive.Column >= 0)
				{
					primitive.PE = elements[primitive.Column % elements.Count];
				}
				if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.NoFill) != PCaps.None)
				{
					primitive.PE = primitive.PE.Clone();
					primitive.PE.FillOpacity = 0;
				}
				if (primitive.Path != null && primitive.Path.IndexOf("Legend") > -1 && pE != null)
				{
					primitive.PE = primitive.PE.Clone();
					primitive.PE.StrokeWidth = pE.StrokeWidth;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SplineAreaLayer : AreaLayer
	{
		public SplineAreaLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance chartAppearance = base.GetAppearance() as SplineAreaChartAppearance;
			if (chartAppearance != null)
			{
				return chartAppearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.SplineArea);
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				if ((!(dataMin >= 0.0) || !(dataMax >= 0.0)) && (!(dataMin <= 0.0) || !(dataMax <= 0.0)))
				{
					return SR.GetString("SR_1073");
				}
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1007");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			SplineAreaChartAppearance splineAreaChartAppearance = (SplineAreaChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			splineTension = splineAreaChartAppearance.SplineTension;
			flatBottom = true;
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
		}

		protected override void RenderPointsToScene(AreaChartAppearance areaApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, bool polygon, int baseLineMapped)
		{
			if (pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataPoint[] p = (DataPoint[])pointsForLineUnderConstruction.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(areaApp.LineStartCapStyle, areaApp.LineEndCapStyle, areaApp.LineDrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = areaApp.MidPointAnchors;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			primitiveCollection.AddRange(p);
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (DataPoint item in primitiveCollection)
			{
				if (item.Empty)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					primitiveCollection2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (polygon)
			{
				DataPoint dataPoint2 = primitiveCollection2[0] as DataPoint;
				DataPoint dataPoint3 = primitiveCollection2[primitiveCollection2.Count - 1] as DataPoint;
				if (dataPoint2 != null && dataPoint3 != null)
				{
					primitiveCollection2.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint3.point.X, baseLineMapped));
					primitiveCollection2.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint2.point.X, baseLineMapped));
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					dataPoint2 = primitiveCollection[0] as DataPoint;
					dataPoint3 = primitiveCollection[primitiveCollection.Count - 1] as DataPoint;
					if (dataPoint2 != null && dataPoint3 != null)
					{
						primitiveCollection.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint3.point.X, baseLineMapped));
						primitiveCollection.Add(new DataPoint(dataPoint2.point.X, baseLineMapped));
					}
				}
			}
			if (primitiveCollection2.Count != 1)
			{
				EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
				DataPoint[] points;
				if (polygon)
				{
					points = ((!emptyAppearance.EnablePE) ? ((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint))) : ((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint))));
					Polygon oly = new Polygon(GetPolygonPoints(points, baseLineMapped));
					AddPolygonToScene(oly, row, empty: false, scene);
				}
				else
				{
					points = ((!emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle) ? ((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint))) : ((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint))));
					Polyline line = new Polyline(points);
					AddLineToScene(line, row, empty: false, scene);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (polygon && emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
					{
						Polygon oly2 = new Polygon(GetPolygonPoints(points, baseLineMapped));
						AddPolygonToScene(oly2, row, empty: true, scene);
					}
					else if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
					{
						Polyline line2 = new Polyline(points);
						AddLineToScene(line2, row, empty: true, scene);
					}
				}
			}
			pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class SplineLayer : LineLayer
	{
		public SplineLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			if (base.Stacked)
			{
				double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
				double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
				if ((!(dataMin >= 0.0) || !(dataMax >= 0.0)) && (!(dataMin <= 0.0) || !(dataMax <= 0.0)))
				{
					return SR.GetString("SR_1073");
				}
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_1014");
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance chartAppearance = base.GetAppearance() as SplineChartAppearance;
			if (chartAppearance != null)
			{
				return chartAppearance;
			}
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Spline);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			SplineChartAppearance splineChartAppearance = (SplineChartAppearance)GetAppearance();
			splineTension = splineChartAppearance.SplineTension;
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
		}

		protected override void RenderPointsToScene(LineChartAppearance lineApp, SceneGraph scene, PrimitiveCollection pointsForLineUnderConstruction, int row, int baseLineDataMapped)
		{
			if (pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataPoint[] p = (DataPoint[])pointsForLineUnderConstruction.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(lineApp.StartStyle, lineApp.EndStyle, lineApp.DrawStyle);
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = lineApp.MidPointAnchors;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
			primitiveCollection.AddRange(p);
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (DataPoint item in primitiveCollection)
			{
				if (!item.Empty)
				{
					primitiveCollection2.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!(ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) is EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance) || !flag || emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle || emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
			{
				Polyline line = new Polyline((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection2.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
				AddLineToScene(line, row, empty: false, scene);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Polyline line2 = new Polyline((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
				AddLineToScene(line2, row, empty: true, scene);
			}
			pointsForLineUnderConstruction.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class StepLineLayer : ChartLayer
	{

		private bool fillIn;

		protected virtual NullHandling nullHandler
		{

				return _nullHandler;
			}

			}
		}

		public StepLineLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)

		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			if (fillIn)
			{
				return ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Area);
			}
			return ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line);
		}

		protected override void ValidateDataForChart()
		{
			if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is NumericTimeSeries && item.GetPoints().Count > 1)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				dataIsValid = flag;
			}
			else
			{
				dataIsValid = data != null && data.IsColumnDateTime(0) && data.IsColumnNumeric(1) && data.GetColumnCount() > 1 && data.GetRowCount() > 0 && !((DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data)).SwapRowsAndColumns;
			}
		}

		public override string GetDataInvalidMessage()
		{
			return SR.GetString(fillIn ? "SR_1033" : "SR_1032");
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			int dateColumn = 0;
			int valueColumn = 1;
			ChartAppearance appearance = GetAppearance();
			LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance = appearance as LineChartAppearance;
			AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = appearance as AreaChartAppearance;
			ChartTextCollection chartTextCollection = null;
			if (lineChartAppearance != null)
			{
				base.NullHandling = lineChartAppearance.NullHandling;
				chartTextCollection = lineChartAppearance.ChartText;
			}
			else if (areaChartAppearance != null)
			{
				base.NullHandling = areaChartAppearance.NullHandling;
				chartTextCollection = areaChartAppearance.ChartText;
			}
			base.EmptyValues = false;
			DataAppearance dataApp = (DataAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			int num = 0;
			ISeries series = null;
			IProvideDataPoints dataPointProvider = null;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			if (seriesCollection != null)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection2 = new SeriesCollection();
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (item is NumericTimeSeries)
					{
						seriesCollection2.Add(item);
					}
				}
				if (seriesCollection2.Count > 0)
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					foreach (ISeries item2 in seriesCollection2)
					{
						dataPointProvider = item2.GetPoints();
						if (dataPointProvider != null)
						{
							num = dataPointProvider.Count;
							RenderTheLine(data, appearance, num2++, dateColumn, num, dataPointProvider, item2, primitiveCollection, dataApp);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = data.GetRowCount();
				RenderTheLine(data, appearance, valueColumn, dateColumn, num, dataPointProvider, series, primitiveCollection, dataApp);
			}
			scene.AddRange(primitiveCollection.ToArray());
			foreach (Primitive item3 in primitiveCollection)
			{
				if (!(item3 is Polyline { points: var points }))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (DataPoint dataPoint in points)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < chartTextCollection.Count; j++)
					{
						if (chartTextCollection[j].Match(dataPoint.Row, dataPoint.Column) && chartTextCollection[j].Visible)
						{
							putText(dataPoint, scene, chartTextCollection[j]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void putText(DataPoint b1, SceneGraph scene, ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance)
		{
			base.putText(b1, scene, chartTextAppearance);
			string itemFormatString = chartTextAppearance.ItemFormatString;
			Hashtable environment = ChartCore.Environment;
			object value = (ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = b1.Column);
			environment["ITEM_NUMBER"] = value;
			ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = b1.Row;
			if (b1.Value != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = b1.Value;
			}
			if (b1.DataPoint != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = b1.DataPoint.Label;
			}
			if (b1.Series != null)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = b1.Series.Label;
			}
			string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, itemFormatString);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.ClipText = false;
			labelStyle.Font = chartTextAppearance.ChartTextFont;
			labelStyle.FontColor = chartTextAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = chartTextAppearance.VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = chartTextAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
			Text value2 = new Text(b1.point, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value2);
		}

		private void RenderTheLine(IChartData theData, ChartAppearance chartApp, int ValueColumn, int DateColumn, int pointCount, IProvideDataPoints dataPointProvider, ISeries series, IList scene, DataAppearance dataApp)
		{
			double minValue = dataApp.MinValue;
			double maxValue = dataApp.MaxValue;
			bool useMinMax = dataApp.UseMinMax;
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["X"];
			IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 = (IAdvanceAxis)base.Grid["Y"];
			if (advanceAxis == null || advanceAxis2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance = chartApp as LineChartAppearance;
			AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = chartApp as AreaChartAppearance;
			LineCapStyle startStyle;
			LineCapStyle endStyle;
			LineDrawStyle drawStyle;
			int strokeWidth;
			bool midPointAnchors;
			if (lineChartAppearance != null)
			{
				startStyle = lineChartAppearance.StartStyle;
				endStyle = lineChartAppearance.EndStyle;
				drawStyle = lineChartAppearance.DrawStyle;
				strokeWidth = lineChartAppearance.Thickness;
				midPointAnchors = lineChartAppearance.MidPointAnchors;
			}
			else if (areaChartAppearance != null)
			{
				startStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineStartCapStyle;
				endStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineEndCapStyle;
				drawStyle = areaChartAppearance.LineDrawStyle;
				strokeWidth = areaChartAppearance.LineThickness;
				midPointAnchors = areaChartAppearance.MidPointAnchors;
			}
			else
			{
				startStyle = (endStyle = LineCapStyle.NoAnchor);
				drawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
				strokeWidth = 1;
				midPointAnchors = false;
			}
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			double num = (double)advanceAxis2.Minimum;
			bool flag = false;
			if (pointCount < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < pointCount; i++)
			{
				NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = null;
				if (dataPointProvider != null && dataPointProvider.Count > i)
				{
					numericTimeDataPoint = dataPointProvider[i] as NumericTimeDataPoint;
				}
				if (numericTimeDataPoint == null)
				{
					numericTimeDataPoint = new NumericTimeDataPoint();
					numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue = DateTime.MinValue;
					object obj = theData.GetObjectValue(i, DateColumn);
					object objectValue = theData.GetObjectValue(i, ValueColumn);
					if (obj is DateTime)
					{
						numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue = (DateTime)obj;
					}
					else if (obj != null)
					{
						try
						{
							numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue = DateTime.Parse(obj.ToString());
						}
						catch (FormatException)
						{
							obj = null;
						}
					}
					numericTimeDataPoint.Empty = obj == null || objectValue == null;
					numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue = theData.GetValue(i, ValueColumn);
				}
				if (numericTimeDataPoint.Empty)
				{
					switch (base.NullHandling)
					{
					case NullHandling.Zero:
						base.EmptyValues = true;
						break;
					case NullHandling.InterpolateSimple:
					case NullHandling.InterpolateCustom:
						flag = (base.EmptyValues = true);
						break;
					case NullHandling.DontPlot:
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (useMinMax && (!(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue >= minValue) || !(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue <= maxValue)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue != num && i > 0)
				{
					int x = (int)advanceAxis.Map(numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue);
					int y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue);
					DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint(x, y);
					dataPoint.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Tooltip;
					dataPoint.Value = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
					dataPoint.Row = i;
					dataPoint.Column = ValueColumn;
					dataPoint.Chart = (fillIn ? ChartType.StepAreaChart : ChartType.StepLineChart);
					dataPoint.Layer = this;
					dataPoint.DataPoint = numericTimeDataPoint;
					dataPoint.Series = series;
					if (numericTimeDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						dataPoint.Empty = true;
						dataPoint.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						dataPoint.Value = null;
					}
					primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					DataPoint dataPoint2 = new DataPoint((int)advanceAxis.Map(numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue), (int)advanceAxis2.Map(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue));
					dataPoint2.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Tooltip;
					dataPoint2.Value = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
					dataPoint2.Row = i;
					dataPoint2.Column = ValueColumn;
					dataPoint2.Chart = (fillIn ? ChartType.StepAreaChart : ChartType.StepLineChart);
					dataPoint2.Layer = this;
					dataPoint2.DataPoint = numericTimeDataPoint;
					dataPoint2.Series = series;
					if (numericTimeDataPoint.Empty)
					{
						dataPoint2.Empty = true;
						dataPoint2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						dataPoint2.Value = null;
					}
					primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint2);
				}
				num = numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				primitiveCollection = InterpolatePrimitives(primitiveCollection, typeof(object[]), 2);
			}
			if (primitiveCollection == null || primitiveCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int y2 = ((DataPoint)primitiveCollection[0]).point.Y;
			for (int j = 1; j < primitiveCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				if (primitiveCollection[j] is DataPoint dataPoint3)
				{
					DataPoint dataPoint4 = new DataPoint(dataPoint3.point.X, y2);
					dataPoint4.Row = dataPoint3.Row;
					dataPoint4.Column = dataPoint3.Column;
					dataPoint4.Empty = dataPoint3.Empty;
					primitiveCollection.Insert(j, dataPoint4);
					y2 = dataPoint3.point.Y;
					j++;
				}
			}
			PrimitiveCollection[] array = BreakUpNulls((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)));
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
			PrimitiveCollection[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 in array2)
			{
				int num2 = 3;
				if (num2 == 4)
				{
					continue;
				}
				primitiveCollection = primitiveCollection2;
				if (primitiveCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					DataPoint[] array3 = (DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
					bool flag3 = false;
					PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection3 = new PrimitiveCollection();
					for (int l = 0; l < array3.Length; l++)
					{
						if (array3[l] == null || array3[l].Empty)
						{
							flag3 = true;
							if (array3[l].Value != null)
							{
								DataPoint p = new DataPoint(array3[l].point);
								primitiveCollection3.Add(p);
							}
						}
					}
					if (primitiveCollection3.Count > 0 && emptyAppearance != null)
					{
						PointSet pointSet = ((emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon != SymbolIcon.Character) ? new PointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection3.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Icon, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.IconSize) : new PointSet((DataPoint[])primitiveCollection3.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint)), emptyAppearance.PointStyle.CharacterFont, emptyAppearance.PointStyle.Character));
						pointSet.PE = emptyAppearance.PointPE;
						scene.Add(pointSet);
					}
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(startStyle, endStyle, drawStyle);
					lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = midPointAnchors;
					Polyline polyline = new Polyline(array3, lineStyle);
					if (array3.Length > 0 && array3[0] != null)
					{
						polyline.Column = array3[0].Column;
						polyline.Row = array3[0].Row;
					}
					else
					{
						int column = (polyline.Row = 0);
						polyline.Column = column;
					}
					polyline.Series = series;
					polyline.Chart = (fillIn ? ChartType.StepAreaChart : ChartType.StepLineChart);
					if (flag3 && emptyAppearance != null)
					{
						if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
						{
							polyline.PE = emptyAppearance.PE;
						}
						else
						{
							polyline.PE = GetPE(polyline, polyline.DataPoint, polyline.Series, swapRowsAndColumns: false).Clone();
							polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = strokeWidth;
						}
						if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
						{
							polyline.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle;
						}
						else
						{
							polyline.lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(startStyle, endStyle, drawStyle);
							polyline.lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = midPointAnchors;
						}
						polyline.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					}
					else
					{
						polyline.PE = GetPE(polyline, polyline.DataPoint, polyline.Series, swapRowsAndColumns: false).Clone();
						polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = strokeWidth;
						polyline.lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(startStyle, endStyle, drawStyle);
						polyline.lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = midPointAnchors;
						polyline.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
					}
					polyline.Path = Path;
					polyline.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
					polyline.Layer = this;
					polyline.HighLightLine = lineChartAppearance?.HighLightLines ?? false;
					if (polyline.PE.Fill.R == byte.MaxValue)
					{
						scene.Add(polyline);
					}
					else
					{
						scene.Add(polyline);
					}
					if (fillIn)
					{
						DataPoint dataPoint5 = (DataPoint)primitiveCollection[primitiveCollection.Count - 1];
						DataPoint dataPoint6 = (DataPoint)primitiveCollection[0];
						DataPoint dataPoint7 = new DataPoint(dataPoint5.point);
						dataPoint7.point.Y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.WindowMinimum);
						dataPoint7.Layer = this;
						primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint7);
						DataPoint dataPoint8 = new DataPoint(dataPoint6.point);
						dataPoint8.point.Y = (int)advanceAxis2.Map(advanceAxis2.WindowMinimum);
						dataPoint8.Layer = this;
						primitiveCollection.Add(dataPoint8);
						DataPoint[] array4 = (DataPoint[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(DataPoint));
						Polygon polygon = new Polygon(array4);
						if (array4.Length > 0 && array4[0] != null)
						{
							polygon.Column = array4[0].Column;
							polygon.Row = array4[0].Row;
						}
						else
						{
							int column2 = (polygon.Row = 0);
							polygon.Column = column2;
						}
						polygon.Series = series;
						polygon.PE = polyline.PE;
						polygon.lineStyle = polyline.lineStyle;
						polygon.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						polygon.Path = Path;
						polygon.Chart = ChartCore.ChartType;
						polygon.Layer = this;
						int column3 = (polygon.Row = 0);
						polygon.Column = column3;
						scene.Add(polygon);
					}
				}
				primitiveCollection.Clear();
			}
		}

		private bool IsPointVisible(Point point, IAdvanceAxis axisX, IAdvanceAxis axisY)
		{
			if ((double)point.X >= axisX.MapMinimum && (double)point.X <= axisX.MapMaximum && (double)point.Y <= axisY.MapMinimum)
			{
				return (double)point.Y >= axisY.MapMaximum;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetupDataFilter()
		{
			base.SetupDataFilter();
			((IChartDataFilter)data)?.IncludeColumn(0, include: true);
		}

		protected internal override InterpolateValuesEventArgs InterpolateValues(PrimitiveCollection primitives, Type type, int arrayWidth)
		{
			return ChartLayer.InterpolateNumericTimeValues(primitives, type, this);
		}

		private PrimitiveCollection[] BreakUpNulls(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			primitiveCollection.AddRange(points);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			while (num < points.Length)
			{
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection2 = new PrimitiveCollection();
				arrayList.Add(primitiveCollection2);
				bool empty = points[num].Empty;
				bool flag = false;
				while (!flag)
				{
					flag = num == points.Length - 1 || points[num].Empty != points[num + 1].Empty;
					primitiveCollection2.Add(points[num]);
					num++;
				}
				if (empty)
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						int num3 = primitiveCollection.IndexOf(primitiveCollection2[0]) - 1;
						primitiveCollection2.Insert(0, points[num3]);
					}
					if (num < points.Length)
					{
						primitiveCollection2.Add(points[num]);
					}
				}
				DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[primitiveCollection2.Count];
				primitiveCollection2.CopyTo(array);
				num2++;
			}
			return (PrimitiveCollection[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PrimitiveCollection));
		}
	}

			}

			{
				_dateColumn = value;
			}
		}

			return ruler.NumericOf(d_i);
		}
