		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				return appearance;
			}
			int num = (int)axisNumber;
			return component.GetChartAppearance(Axis.mapping[num]);
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (scene == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetStartAndEndPoints();
			FillSceneGraphTime(scene);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)GetAppearance();
			TimeAxisAppearance timeAxisStyle = axisAppearance.TimeAxisStyle;
			if ((Minimum.Equals(DateTime.MaxValue) && Maximum.Equals(DateTime.MinValue)) || Minimum.Equals(Maximum))
			{
				return;
			}
			ScrollScaleAppearance scrollScale = axisAppearance.ScrollScale;
			ruler.Scroll = scrollScale.Scroll;
			ruler.Scale = scrollScale.Scale;
			if (!axisAppearance.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.MajorLabelStyle = axisAppearance.Labels.LabelStyle;
			string text = axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString;
			DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)WindowMinimum;
			AxisLabelInfoCollection axisLabelInfoCollection = new AxisLabelInfoCollection();
			TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)WindowRange;
			double num = axisAppearance.TickmarkIntervalType switch
			{
				AxisIntervalType.Days => timeSpan.TotalDays, 
				AxisIntervalType.Hours => timeSpan.TotalHours, 
				AxisIntervalType.Minutes => timeSpan.TotalMinutes, 
				AxisIntervalType.Milliseconds => timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds, 
				AxisIntervalType.Months => timeSpan.TotalDays / 30.0, 
				AxisIntervalType.Seconds => timeSpan.TotalSeconds, 
				AxisIntervalType.Weeks => timeSpan.TotalDays / 7.0, 
				AxisIntervalType.Years => timeSpan.TotalDays / 365.0, 
				_ => timeSpan.Ticks, 
			};
			if (text == "<ITEM_LABEL>" || text == "<DATA_VALUE>")
			{
				AxisIntervalType axisIntervalType;
				if (axisAppearance.TickmarkIntervalType == AxisIntervalType.NotSet)
				{
					int val = (int)(Math.Abs(MapRange) / (double)((float)base.MajorLabelStyle.Font.Height * 1.2f));
					val = Math.Min(10, Math.Max(1, val));
					axisIntervalType = DateTimeInterval.GetScale((DateTime)Minimum, (DateTime)Maximum, val).IntervalType;
				}
				else
				{
					axisIntervalType = axisAppearance.TickmarkIntervalType;
				}
				switch (axisIntervalType)
				{
				case AxisIntervalType.Days:
				case AxisIntervalType.Weeks:
				case AxisIntervalType.Months:
				case AxisIntervalType.Years:
					text = "<ITEM_LABEL:d>";
					break;
				case AxisIntervalType.Hours:
					text = "<ITEM_LABEL:g>";
					break;
				case AxisIntervalType.Minutes:
					text = "<ITEM_LABEL:t>";
					break;
				case AxisIntervalType.Ticks:
				case AxisIntervalType.Milliseconds:
				case AxisIntervalType.Seconds:
					text = "<ITEM_LABEL:T>";
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (timeAxisStyle.TimeAxisStyle == RulerGenre.Continuous)
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = ((DateTime)WindowMaximum).Subtract((DateTime)WindowMinimum);
				long num2 = ((axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle != AxisTickStyle.DataInterval) ? ((long)Math.Round((double)timeSpan2.Ticks * axisAppearance.TickmarkPercentage / 100.0)) : ((long)Math.Round(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval)));
				timeSpan2 = new TimeSpan(num2);
				bool flag = (double)num2 / num < 0.0001;
				DateTime dateTime2 = DateTime.MinValue;
				PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
				if (num2 > 0 && !flag)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan3 = new TimeSpan(10L);
					DateTime dateTime3 = (DateTime)WindowMaximum;
					while (dateTime3.Subtract(dateTime) > timeSpan3)
					{
						ChalkIt(scene, dateTime, text, axisAppearance, timeSpan2, primitiveCollection, axisLabelInfoCollection);
						ChalkMinor(scene, dateTime.Add(new TimeSpan(timeSpan2.Ticks / 2)), axisAppearance);
						dateTime2 = dateTime;
						switch (axisAppearance.TickmarkStyle)
						{
						case AxisTickStyle.DataInterval:
						case AxisTickStyle.Smart:
							dateTime = axisAppearance.TickmarkIntervalType switch
							{
								AxisIntervalType.Days => (DateTime.Compare(dateTime, DateTime.MaxValue.AddDays(0.0 - axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval)) > 0) ? DateTime.MaxValue : dateTime.AddDays(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Hours => dateTime.AddHours(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Milliseconds => dateTime.AddMilliseconds(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Minutes => dateTime.AddMinutes(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Months => dateTime.AddMonths((int)axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Seconds => dateTime.AddSeconds(axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Weeks => dateTime.AddDays(7.0 * axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								AxisIntervalType.Years => dateTime.AddYears((int)axisAppearance.TickmarkInterval), 
								_ => dateTime.Add(timeSpan2), 
							};
							break;
						default:
							dateTime = dateTime.Add(timeSpan2);
							break;
						}
					}
					if ((drawingStyle & 0x40000) > 0)
					{
						double num3 = Map(dateTime2);
						double num4 = Map(WindowMaximum);
						double a = num4 - num3;
						Hashtable environment = ChartCore.Environment;
						object value = (ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = WindowMaximum);
						environment["DATA_VALUE"] = value;
						string text2 = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(ChartCore.Environment, text);
						if (Math.Floor(Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text2, base.MajorLabelStyle).Width) <= Math.Ceiling(a))
						{
							Point pos = new Point((int)num4, GetLabelsYLocation());
							Text text3 = new Text(pos, text2, base.MajorLabelStyle);
							text3.Path = Path;
							scene.Add(text3);
							primitiveCollection.Add(text3);
							AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = new AxisLabelInfo();
							axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap = WindowMaximum;
							axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive = text3;
							if (ItemVisible(axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap))
							{
								axisLabelInfoCollection.Add(axisLabelInfo);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
				{
					int num5 = 0;
					int num6 = base.startPoint.Y + 4;
					foreach (Text item in primitiveCollection)
					{
						if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis && item.GetActualBounds().Y < num6)
						{
							num5 = Math.Max(num5, num6 - item.GetActualBounds().Y);
						}
					}
					foreach (Text item2 in primitiveCollection)
					{
						item2.bounds.Offset(0, num5);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (data is GanttDataAdapter ganttDataAdapter)
			{
				foreach (GanttSeries item3 in ganttDataAdapter.GanttData.Series)
				{
					foreach (GanttItem item4 in item3.Items)
					{
						foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in item4.Times)
						{
							ChalkIt(scene, time.Start, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
							DateTime minorItem = new DateTime((time.Start.Ticks + time.End.Ticks) / 2);
							ChalkMinor(scene, minorItem, axisAppearance);
							ChalkIt(scene, time.End, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (data is SeriesCollection)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = (SeriesCollection)data;
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				foreach (ISeries item5 in seriesCollection)
				{
					IProvideDataPoints points = item5.GetPoints();
					for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
					{
						IDataPoint dataPoint = points[i];
						if (dataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
						{
							dateTime = ((NumericTimeDataPoint)dataPoint).TimeValue;
							if (!arrayList.Contains(dateTime))
							{
								ChalkIt(scene, dateTime, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
								arrayList.Add(dateTime);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(dataPoint is GanttItem))
							{
								continue;
							}
							GanttItem ganttItem2 = (GanttItem)dataPoint;
							foreach (GanttTimeEntry time2 in ganttItem2.Times)
							{
								ChalkIt(scene, time2.Start, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
								DateTime minorItem2 = new DateTime((time2.Start.Ticks + time2.End.Ticks) / 2);
								ChalkMinor(scene, minorItem2, axisAppearance);
								ChalkIt(scene, time2.End, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ChartCore.ChartType)
				{
				case ChartType.StepLineChart:
				case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < data.GetRowCount(); k++)
					{
						dateTime = (DateTime)data.GetObjectValue(k, DateColumn);
						ChalkIt(scene, dateTime, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < data.GetColumnCount(); j++)
					{
						dateTime = Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.DateTimeFromObject(data.GetColumnLabel(j));
						if (dateTime != DateTime.MinValue)
						{
							ChalkIt(scene, dateTime, text, axisAppearance, TimeSpan.Zero, null, axisLabelInfoCollection);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			int scrollbarSize = ((axisAppearance.ScrollScale.Visible || scene == ChartCore.ScrollScene) ? GetScrollbarSpan(axisAppearance) : 0);
			ApplyLayoutBehaviors(GetLabelBounds(scrollbarSize), axisAppearance, axisLabelInfoCollection, null);
			if (!delayAxisLineRender && scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene)
			{
				RenderAxisLine(scene, axisLineStart, axisLineEnd);
			}
		}

		private int GetLabelsYLocation()
		{
			ChartType chartType = ChartCore.ChartType;
			int num = ((chartType != ChartType.Composite) ? 8 : 0);
			return base.startPoint.Y + LabelDy + num;
		}

		private void ChalkMinor(SceneGraph scene, DateTime minorItem, AxisAppearance app)
		{
			if (!ItemVisible(minorItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			int x = (int)Map(minorItem);
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) > 0)
			{
				Point point = new Point(0, 0);
				point.X = x;
				point.Y = base.startPoint.Y - 2;
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0)
				{
					Point p = new Point(point.X, span_1);
					Point p2 = new Point(point.X, span_2);
					Line line = new Line(p, p2);
					line.lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
					line.PE.Stroke = minorGridLineColor;
					line.PE.StrokeOpacity = minorGridLineColor.A;
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
					line.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line);
				}
				if ((drawingStyle & 0x40) > 0)
				{
					Point p3 = new Point(point.X, point.Y - 3);
					Point p4 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + 8);
					Line line2 = new Line(p3, p4);
					line2.lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
					line2.PE.Stroke = app.LineColor;
					line2.PE.StrokeOpacity = app.LineColor.A;
					line2.PE.StrokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
					line2.Path = Path;
					scene.Add(line2);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ChalkIt(SceneGraph scene, DateTime item, string majorFmt, AxisAppearance app)
		{
			ChalkIt(scene, item, majorFmt, app, TimeSpan.Zero);
		}

		public void ChalkIt(SceneGraph scene, DateTime item, string majorFmt, AxisAppearance app, TimeSpan delta)
		{
			ChalkIt(scene, item, majorFmt, app, delta, null, null);
		}

		private void ChalkIt(SceneGraph scene, DateTime item, string majorFmt, AxisAppearance app, TimeSpan delta, PrimitiveCollection labelsCol, AxisLabelInfoCollection itemLabels)
		{
			Hashtable environment = ChartCore.Environment;
			object value = (ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = item);
			environment["DATA_VALUE"] = value;
			if (!ItemVisible(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			int x = (int)Map(item);
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x8000) <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = new Point(0, 0);
			point.X = x;
			point.Y = base.startPoint.Y - 2;
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x100) > 0)
			{
				Point p = new Point(point.X, span_1);
				Point p2 = new Point(point.X, span_2);
				Line line = new Line(p, p2);
				line.lineStyle = majorGridLineStyle;
				line.PE.Stroke = majorGridLineColor;
				line.PE.StrokeOpacity = majorGridLineColor.A;
				line.PE.StrokeWidth = majorGridLineThickness;
				line.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(line);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x20) > 0)
			{
				Point p3 = new Point(point.X, point.Y - 3);
				Point p4 = new Point(point.X, point.Y + 8);
				Line line2 = new Line(p3, p4);
				line2.lineStyle = majorGridLineStyle;
				line2.PE.Stroke = app.LineColor;
				line2.PE.StrokeOpacity = app.LineColor.A;
				line2.PE.StrokeWidth = majorGridLineThickness;
				line2.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(line2);
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x40000) > 0)
			{
				Text text = new Text(new Point(point.X + LabelDx, GetLabelsYLocation()), LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, majorFmt), base.MajorLabelStyle);
				text.Path = Path;
				labelsCol?.Add(text);
				scene.Add(text);
				if (itemLabels != null)
				{
					AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = new AxisLabelInfo();
					axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap = item;
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive = text;
					if (ItemVisible(axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap))
					{
						itemLabels.Add(axisLabelInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			if ((drawingStyle & 0x200) > 0 && delta != TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				int x2 = (int)Map(item.Add(new TimeSpan(delta.Ticks / 2)));
				Point p5 = new Point(x2, span_1);
				Point p6 = new Point(x2, span_2);
				Line line3 = new Line(p5, p6);
				line3.lineStyle = minorGridLineStyle;
				line3.PE.Stroke = minorGridLineColor;
				line3.PE.StrokeOpacity = minorGridLineColor.A;
				line3.PE.StrokeWidth = minorGridLineThickness;
				line3.Path = Path;
				scene.Add(line3);
			}
		}
	}
	public class TitleLayer : Layer
	{
		private int borderSize = 5;

		public TitlePanel[] titlePanels = new TitlePanel[4];

		public override string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Path;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Path = value;
				titlePanels[0].Path = value + ".Top";
				titlePanels[1].Path = value + ".Left";
				titlePanels[2].Path = value + ".Right";
				titlePanels[3].Path = value + ".Bottom";
			}
		}

		public TitleLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			CreateTitlePanels();
		}

		private void CreateTitlePanels()
		{
			titlePanels[0] = new TitlePanel(component, Core, TitleLocation.Top);
			titlePanels[1] = new TitlePanel(component, Core, TitleLocation.Left);
			titlePanels[2] = new TitlePanel(component, Core, TitleLocation.Right);
			titlePanels[3] = new TitlePanel(component, Core, TitleLocation.Bottom);
		}

		public override void SetBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			base.SetBounds(bounds);
			int num = (titlePanels[0].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[0].GetExtent() : innerBounds.Y);
			int width = (titlePanels[1].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[1].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			int num2 = (titlePanels[2].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[2].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			int num3 = (titlePanels[3].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[3].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			if (titlePanels[0].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[0].SetBounds(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, num);
			}
			if (titlePanels[1].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[1].SetBounds(outerBounds.X, num, width, outerBounds.Height - (num + num3));
			}
			if (titlePanels[2].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[2].SetBounds(outerBounds.Width - num2, num, num2, outerBounds.Height - (num + num3));
			}
			if (titlePanels[3].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[3].SetBounds(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Height - num3, outerBounds.Width, num3);
			}
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			if (titlePanels[0].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[0].FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			if (titlePanels[1].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[1].FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			if (titlePanels[2].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[2].FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			if (titlePanels[3].IsVisible())
			{
				titlePanels[3].FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
		}

		protected override void CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			int num = (titlePanels[0].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[0].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			int num2 = (titlePanels[1].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[1].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			int num3 = (titlePanels[2].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[2].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			int num4 = (titlePanels[3].IsVisible() ? titlePanels[3].GetExtent() : borderSize);
			innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X + num2, outerBounds.Y + num, outerBounds.Width - (num2 + num3), outerBounds.Height - (num + num4));
		}
	}
	public class TitlePanel : Layer
	{
		private TitleLocation location;

		public TitlePanel(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core, TitleLocation location)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			this.location = location;
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return location switch
			{
				TitleLocation.Top => component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.TitleTop), 
				TitleLocation.Left => component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.TitleLeft), 
				TitleLocation.Right => component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.TitleRight), 
				TitleLocation.Bottom => component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.TitleBottom), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public int GetExtent()
		{
			TitleAppearance titleAppearance = (TitleAppearance)GetAppearance();
			return titleAppearance.Extent;
		}

		public override bool IsVisible()
		{
			TitleAppearance titleAppearance = (TitleAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (titleAppearance.Visible && titleAppearance.Text != null)
			{
				return titleAppearance.Text.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			TitleAppearance titleAppearance = (TitleAppearance)GetAppearance();
			innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			innerBounds.X += titleAppearance.Margins.Left;
			innerBounds.Y += titleAppearance.Margins.Top;
			innerBounds.Width -= titleAppearance.Margins.Left + titleAppearance.Margins.Right;
			innerBounds.Height -= titleAppearance.Margins.Top + titleAppearance.Margins.Bottom;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			TitleAppearance titleAppearance = (TitleAppearance)GetAppearance();
			if (titleAppearance.Visible)
			{
				ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.TitleLayer;
				string text = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(Core.Environment, titleAppearance.Text);
				LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
				labelStyle.Font = titleAppearance.Font;
				labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit = titleAppearance.FontSizeBestFit;
				labelStyle.FontColor = titleAppearance.FontColor;
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = titleAppearance.HorizontalAlign;
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = titleAppearance.VerticalAlign;
				labelStyle.WrapText = titleAppearance.WrapText;
				labelStyle.Flip = titleAppearance.Flip;
				labelStyle.ReverseText = titleAppearance.ReverseText;
				labelStyle.ClipText = titleAppearance.ClipText;
				labelStyle.Orientation = titleAppearance.Orientation;
				labelStyle.RotationAngle = titleAppearance.OrientationAngle;
				Text text2 = ((labelStyle.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom || labelStyle.ClipText || labelStyle.RotationAngle % 90 == 0) ? new Text(innerBounds, text, labelStyle) : new Text(new Point(innerBounds.Left + innerBounds.Width / 2, innerBounds.Top + innerBounds.Height / 2), text, labelStyle));
				text2.Path = Path;
				if (innerBounds.Width > 0 && innerBounds.Height > 0)
				{
					scene.Add(text2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TooltipLayer : Layer
	{
		private string tooltiptext = string.Empty;

		public string Text => tooltiptext;

		public TooltipLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("component");
			}
			if (core == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("core");
			}
		}

		internal static string GetTooltip(ChartCore chartCore, IChartComponent chartComponent, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation, TooltipLayer layer)
		{
			string tooltipFormat = layer.GetTooltipFormat(chartCore.ChartType, primitiveUnderObservation);
			ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPrimitive = chartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitiveUnderObservation);
			if (primitiveUnderObservation != null && primitiveUnderObservation.Tags != null)
			{
				foreach (object key in primitiveUnderObservation.Tags.Keys)
				{
					chartCore.Environment[key] = primitiveUnderObservation.Tags[key];
				}
			}
			if (primitiveUnderObservation.DataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
			{
				chartCore.Environment["TIME_VALUE"] = ((NumericTimeDataPoint)primitiveUnderObservation.DataPoint).TimeValue;
			}
			if (chartInfoFromPrimitive != null)
			{
				Layer layer2 = null;
				if (chartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
				{
					layer2 = primitiveUnderObservation.Layer as Layer;
				}
				if (layer2 == null)
				{
					layer2 = chartCore.GetChartLayer();
				}
				chartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = chartInfoFromPrimitive.DataRow;
				chartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = chartInfoFromPrimitive.DataColumn;
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = primitiveUnderObservation.DataPoint as NumericDataPoint;
				object obj = null;
				object obj2 = null;
				object obj3 = null;
				if (chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive != null && chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.DataPoint != null && chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.Series != null)
				{
					obj2 = ((!(chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.Series.Label == string.Empty)) ? chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.Series.Label : chartInfoFromPrimitive.RowLabel);
					obj3 = ((!(chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.DataPoint.Label == string.Empty)) ? chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.DataPoint.Label : chartInfoFromPrimitive.ColumnLabel);
					if (numericDataPoint != null)
					{
						obj = numericDataPoint.Value;
					}
				}
				if (obj == null && !(layer2 is GanttLayer))
				{
					obj = chartInfoFromPrimitive.DataValue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (layer2 is ChartLayer chartLayer)
				{
					flag |= chartLayer.Stacked && chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive != null && chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.Value != null;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					chartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE_ITEM"] = obj;
					chartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = chartInfoFromPrimitive.Primitive.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					chartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = obj;
				}
				if (obj2 != null && obj3 != null)
				{
					chartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = obj2;
					chartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = obj3;
				}
				else
				{
					DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)chartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
					string value;
					string value2;
					if (dataAppearance.SwapRowsAndColumns)
					{
						value = chartInfoFromPrimitive.RowLabel;
						value2 = chartInfoFromPrimitive.ColumnLabel;
					}
					else
					{
						value = chartInfoFromPrimitive.ColumnLabel;
						value2 = chartInfoFromPrimitive.RowLabel;
					}
					if (layer2 is IPointsInOthers)
					{
						chartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = value;
						chartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = value2;
					}
					else
					{
						chartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = value2;
						chartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = value;
					}
				}
				ChartType chartType = ((chartCore.ChartType != ChartType.Composite) ? chartCore.ChartType : primitiveUnderObservation.Chart);
				if (primitiveUnderObservation.Series is NumericSeries numericSeries && numericDataPoint != null)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					for (int i = 0; i < numericSeries.Points.Count; i++)
					{
						double num2 = numericSeries.Points[i].Value;
						ChartType chartType2 = chartType;
						if (chartType2 == ChartType.PieChart || chartType2 == ChartType.DoughnutChart)
						{
							num2 = Math.Abs(num2);
						}
						num += num2;
					}
					double num3 = numericDataPoint.Value;
					ChartType chartType3 = chartType;
					if (chartType3 == ChartType.PieChart || chartType3 == ChartType.DoughnutChart)
					{
						num3 = Math.Abs(num3);
					}
					chartCore.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = num3 * 100.0 / num;
				}
				DrawChartSpecificTooltips(tooltipFormat, chartType, chartCore, primitiveUnderObservation, chartInfoFromPrimitive);
			}
			return LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartCore.Environment, tooltipFormat);
		}

		internal static string GetTooltipFormat(ChartType currentChart, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation, WinTooltipAppearance tooltipApp, ChartCore chartCore)
		{
			if (tooltipApp.Display == TooltipDisplay.Never || tooltipApp.FormatString == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (tooltipApp.FormatString == string.Empty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string formatString = tooltipApp.FormatString;
			if (currentChart == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				currentChart = primitiveUnderObservation.Chart;
			}
			return DrawChartSpecificTooltips(formatString, currentChart, chartCore, primitiveUnderObservation, chartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitiveUnderObservation));
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			return component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Tooltip);
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, string text)
		{
			WinTooltipAppearance winTooltipAppearance = (WinTooltipAppearance)GetAppearance();
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, winTooltipAppearance.Font);
			int width = (int)stringSizePixels.Width;
			int height = (int)stringSizePixels.Height;
			Rectangle rectangle = (outerBounds = new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height));
			outerBounds.Width++;
			outerBounds.Height++;
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			lineStyle.DrawStyle = winTooltipAppearance.BorderStyle;
			Box box = new Box(rectangle, lineStyle);
			if (winTooltipAppearance.BorderThickness == 0)
			{
				box.PE.Stroke = winTooltipAppearance.BackColor;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = winTooltipAppearance.AlphaLevel;
			}
			else
			{
				box.PE.Stroke = winTooltipAppearance.BorderColor;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = winTooltipAppearance.AlphaLevel;
			}
			box.PE.FillOpacity = winTooltipAppearance.AlphaLevel;
			box.PE.Fill = winTooltipAppearance.BackColor;
			if (winTooltipAppearance.PE != null)
			{
				box.PE = winTooltipAppearance.PE;
			}
			scene.Add(box);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.Font = winTooltipAppearance.Font;
			labelStyle.FontColor = winTooltipAppearance.FontColor;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			Text value = new Text(rectangle, text, labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value);
			tooltiptext = text;
		}

		private string GetTooltipFormat(ChartType currentChart, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation)
		{
			WinTooltipAppearance tooltipApp = (WinTooltipAppearance)GetAppearance();
			return GetTooltipFormat(currentChart, primitiveUnderObservation, tooltipApp, ChartCore);
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation)
		{
			tooltiptext = string.Empty;
			ChartCore.Environment["LABEL_RENDER_LOCATION"] = LabelRenderLocation.AdornmentLayer;
			string tooltip = GetTooltip(Core, ChartComponent, primitiveUnderObservation, this);
			FillSceneGraph(scene, tooltip);
		}

		internal static string DrawChartSpecificTooltips(string toolTipFormatString, ChartType chartType, ChartCore core, Primitive prim, ChartDataEventArgs primInfo)
		{
			if (prim != null)
			{
				IPointsInOthers pointsInOthers = prim.Layer as IPointsInOthers;
				ChartLayer chartLayer = prim.Layer as ChartLayer;
				if (pointsInOthers != null && prim.DataPoint != null && prim.DataPoint == pointsInOthers.OthersPoint && chartLayer != null && chartLayer.GetAppearance() is IOthersCategory othersCategory)
				{
					core.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = othersCategory.OthersCategoryText;
				}
			}
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
			case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.CylinderStackColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderStackBarChart3D:
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = prim.Value;
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_ITEM"] = primInfo.DataValue;
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_ACCUMULATED_ELEMENT"] = prim.AccumulatedElementsValue;
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
			{
				DateTime[] array4 = (DateTime[])prim.Value;
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = array4[0].ToShortDateString() + " ... " + array4[1].ToShortDateString();
				core.Environment["START_TIME"] = array4[0];
				core.Environment["END_TIME"] = array4[1];
				if (prim.Tags != null && prim.Tags.ContainsKey("TIME_ENTRY_INDEX"))
				{
					core.Environment["TIME_ENTRY_INDEX"] = prim.Tags["TIME_ENTRY_INDEX"];
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			case ChartType.FunnelChart:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart3D:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart3D:
			case ChartType.ConeChart3D:
				return DoMultiValueLabellingForFunnelChartsTooltips(core, toolTipFormatString, prim);
			case ChartType.PieChart:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
				if (toolTipFormatString.IndexOf("<DATA_VALUE") != -1 && primInfo != null)
				{
					PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance2 = core.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() as PieChartAppearance;
					if (pieChartAppearance2 == null && prim != null && prim.Layer is Layer layer)
					{
						pieChartAppearance2 = layer.GetAppearance() as PieChartAppearance;
					}
					if (pieChartAppearance2 != null && primInfo.RowLabel == pieChartAppearance2.OthersCategoryText)
					{
						return DoMultiValueLabellingForPieChartsToolTips(core, toolTipFormatString, prim);
					}
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.PieChart3D:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart3D:
				if (toolTipFormatString.IndexOf("<DATA_VALUE") != -1)
				{
					if (prim != null && prim.Layer is IPointsInOthers pointsInOthers2 && prim.DataPoint == pointsInOthers2.OthersPoint)
					{
						return DoMultiValueLabellingForPieChartsToolTips(core, toolTipFormatString, prim);
					}
					if (primInfo != null)
					{
						PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance = core.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance() as PieChartAppearance;
						if (primInfo.RowLabel == pieChartAppearance.OthersCategoryText)
						{
							return DoMultiValueLabellingForPieChartsToolTips(core, toolTipFormatString, prim);
						}
					}
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.HeatMapChart:
			{
				object[] array5 = (object[])prim.Value;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				string text2 = "";
				string[] array6 = new string[4] { "DATA_VALUE_TOPLEFT", "DATA_VALUE_TOPRIGHT", "DATA_VALUE_BOTTOMLEFT", "DATA_VALUE_BOTTOMRIGHT" };
				double num5 = double.NaN;
				if (array5.Length == 4 && array5[0] is double && array5[1] is double && array5[1] is double && array5[2] is double && array5[3] is double)
				{
					num5 = ((double)array5[0] + (double)array5[1] + (double)array5[2] + (double)array5[3]) / 4.0;
				}
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_AVG"] = num5;
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (array5[i] == null)
					{
						num3 = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf("<" + array6[i]);
						num4 = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf(">", num3);
						text2 = toolTipFormatString.Substring(num3, num4 - num3 + 1);
						toolTipFormatString = toolTipFormatString.Replace(text2, "");
					}
					else
					{
						core.Environment[array6[i]] = array5[i];
					}
				}
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = array5[0];
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
			case ChartType.PolarChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
			{
				object obj2 = null;
				object obj3 = null;
				if (prim.DataPoint is XYDataPoint xYDataPoint)
				{
					obj2 = xYDataPoint.ValueX;
					obj3 = xYDataPoint.ValueY;
				}
				else if (prim.Value is object[] array)
				{
					obj2 = array[0];
					obj3 = (core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = array[1]);
				}
				else
				{
					obj2 = prim.Column;
					obj3 = prim.Value;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = prim.Value;
				}
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = obj2;
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = obj3;
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			{
				object[] array3 = (object[])prim.Value;
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = array3[0];
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_RADIUS"] = array3[2];
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = array3[1];
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = array3[2];
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			{
				if (prim != null && prim.DataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
				{
					return toolTipFormatString;
				}
				object[] array2 = (object[])prim.Value;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				string text = "";
				if (array2 != null && array2.Length == 3)
				{
					if (array2[0] == null)
					{
						num = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf("<DATA_VALUE_LEFT");
						if (num > -1)
						{
							num2 = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf(">", num);
							text = toolTipFormatString.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
							toolTipFormatString = toolTipFormatString.Replace(text, "");
						}
					}
					else
					{
						core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_LEFT"] = array2[0];
					}
					if (array2[2] == null)
					{
						num = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf("<DATA_VALUE_RIGHT");
						if (num > -1)
						{
							num2 = toolTipFormatString.IndexOf(">", num);
							text = toolTipFormatString.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
							toolTipFormatString = toolTipFormatString.Replace(text, "");
						}
					}
					else
					{
						core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_RIGHT"] = array2[2];
					}
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = array2[1];
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
				if (prim.DataPoint is BoxSet boxSet)
				{
					Hashtable environment2 = core.Environment;
					object value2 = (core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = boxSet.Min);
					environment2["DATA_VALUE_MIN"] = value2;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_MAX"] = boxSet.Max;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Q1"] = boxSet.Q1;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Q2"] = boxSet.Q2;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Q3"] = boxSet.Q3;
					core.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = boxSet.Label;
				}
				if (prim.Series != null)
				{
					core.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = prim.Series.Label;
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
				if (prim != null && prim.DataPoint is FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint)
				{
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueX;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueY;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Z"] = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueZ;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_W"] = fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueW;
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.PointChart3D:
				if (prim != null && prim.DataPoint is XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint)
				{
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_X"] = xYZDataPoint.ValueX;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Y"] = xYZDataPoint.ValueY;
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE_Z"] = xYZDataPoint.ValueZ;
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.ParetoChart:
				if (prim != null && prim is DataPoint && ((DataPoint)prim).PolylineParent != null)
				{
					core.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = prim.Value;
					toolTipFormatString = "<PERCENT_VALUE:##>%";
				}
				return toolTipFormatString;
			case ChartType.TreeMapChart:
			{
				core.Environment["SHAPE_LABEL"] = prim.Tags["ShapeLabel"];
				core.Environment["COLOR_VALUE_LABEL"] = prim.Tags["ColorValueLabel"];
				core.Environment["SIZE_VALUE_LABEL"] = prim.Tags["SizeValueLabel"];
				core.Environment["COLOR_VALUE"] = prim.Tags["ColorValue"];
				Hashtable environment = core.Environment;
				object value = (core.Environment["SIZE_VALUE"] = prim.Tags["SizeValue"]);
				environment["DATA_VALUE"] = value;
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
			default:
				return toolTipFormatString;
			}
		}

		internal static string DoMultiValueLabellingForIPointsInOthersTooltips(ChartCore core, string tooltipFormatString, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation)
		{
			if (primitiveUnderObservation.Layer is IPointsInOthers)
			{
				IPointsInOthers pointsInOthers = (IPointsInOthers)primitiveUnderObservation.Layer;
				NumericDataPointCollection numericDataPointCollection = pointsInOthers.PointsInOthers as NumericDataPointCollection;
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = pointsInOthers.OthersPoint as NumericDataPoint;
				double[] array;
				if (numericDataPointCollection == null || primitiveUnderObservation.DataPoint == null || primitiveUnderObservation.DataPoint != numericDataPoint)
				{
					array = ((primitiveUnderObservation.Tags == null || !primitiveUnderObservation.Tags.ContainsKey("OthersList")) ? null : ((!(primitiveUnderObservation.Tags["OthersList"] is ArrayList arrayList)) ? null : (arrayList.ToArray(typeof(double)) as double[])));
				}
				else
				{
					array = new double[numericDataPointCollection.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < numericDataPointCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						array[i] = numericDataPointCollection[i].Value;
					}
				}
				if (array != null)
				{
					return GetOthersDataValueFormatString(core, tooltipFormatString, array);
				}
				return tooltipFormatString;
			}
			return tooltipFormatString;
		}

		internal static string DoMultiValueLabellingForFunnelChartsTooltips(ChartCore core, string tooltipFormatString, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation)
		{
			return DoMultiValueLabellingForIPointsInOthersTooltips(core, tooltipFormatString, primitiveUnderObservation);
		}

		private static string GetOthersDataValueFormatString(ChartCore core, string tooltipFormatString, double[] valuesInOthers)
		{
			int num = tooltipFormatString.IndexOf("<DATA_VALUE");
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return tooltipFormatString;
			}
			int num2 = tooltipFormatString.IndexOf(">", num);
			string text = tooltipFormatString.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (double num3 in valuesInOthers)
			{
				core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = num3;
				stringBuilder.Append(LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(core.Environment, text));
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 2)
			{
				stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 2, 2);
			}
			return tooltipFormatString.Replace(text, stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		internal static string DoMultiValueLabellingForPieChartsToolTips(ChartCore core, string toolTipFormatString, Primitive primitiveUnderObservation)
		{
			if (primitiveUnderObservation != null && primitiveUnderObservation.Layer is IPointsInOthers)
			{
				return DoMultiValueLabellingForIPointsInOthersTooltips(core, toolTipFormatString, primitiveUnderObservation);
			}
			ArrayList arrayList;
			if (primitiveUnderObservation != null && primitiveUnderObservation.Tags != null && primitiveUnderObservation.Tags.ContainsKey("OthersList") && primitiveUnderObservation.Tags["OthersList"] is ArrayList)
			{
				arrayList = primitiveUnderObservation.Tags["OthersList"] as ArrayList;
			}
			else if (core.ChartType == ChartType.PieChart || core.ChartType == ChartType.DoughnutChart)
			{
				PieLayer pieLayer = (PieLayer)core.GetChartLayer();
				arrayList = pieLayer.GetOthersListValue();
			}
			else
			{
				Pie3DLayer pie3DLayer = (Pie3DLayer)core.GetChartLayer();
				arrayList = pie3DLayer.GetOthersListValue();
			}
			if (arrayList != null && arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				arrayList.GetEnumerator();
				double[] array = new double[arrayList.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = (double)arrayList[i];
				}
				toolTipFormatString = GetOthersDataValueFormatString(core, toolTipFormatString, array);
			}
			return toolTipFormatString;
		}

		internal void ClearText()
		{
			tooltiptext = string.Empty;
		}
	}

		private class TMCircle
		{
			private Point _center;

			private int _radius;

			private string _label;

			private int _depth;

			private TreeMapDataPoint _dataPoint;

			private double _weight;

			private double _colorWeight;

			public Point Center
			{
				get
				{
					return _center;
				}
				set
				{
					_center = value;
				}
			}

			public int Radius
			{
				get
				{
					return _radius;
				}
				set
				{
					_radius = value;
				}
			}

			public string Label
			{
				get
				{
					return _label;
				}
				set
				{
					_label = value;
				}
			}

			public int Depth
			{
				get
				{
					return _depth;
				}
				set
				{
					_depth = value;
				}
			}

			public double SizeValue
			{
				get

					return _weight;

				set

					_weight = value;
				}
			}

			{
				get

					return _colorWeight;
				}
				set

					_colorWeight = value;

					return _dataPoint;

					_dataPoint = value;

			public TMCircle()
			{
				_center = new Point(0, 0);
				_radius = 0;
			}

			public TMCircle(Point center, int radius)
			{
				_center = center;
				_radius = radius;
			}

			public TMCircle(Point center, int radius, string label, double weight, double colorWeight)
			{
				_center = center;
				_radius = radius;
				_label = label;
				_weight = weight;
				_colorWeight = colorWeight;
			}

			public TMCircle Copy()
			{
				return new TMCircle(_center, _radius, _label, _weight, _colorWeight);
			}

			public void Translate(int delta_x, int delta_y)
			{
				int x = _center.X + delta_x;
				int y = _center.Y + delta_y;
				_center = new Point(x, y);
			}

			public void RotateAround(Point centerOfRotation, double angleOfRotation)
			{
				double num = Math.PI / 180.0 * angleOfRotation;
				double num2 = Center.X;
				double num3 = Center.Y;
				double num4 = centerOfRotation.X;
				double num5 = centerOfRotation.Y;
				num2 -= num4;
				num3 -= num5;
				double num6 = num2 * Math.Cos(num) + num3 * Math.Sin(num);
				double num7 = num3 * Math.Cos(num) - num2 * Math.Sin(num);
				num6 += num4;
				num7 += num5;
				Center = new Point(Convert.ToInt32(num6), Convert.ToInt32(num7));
			}

			public void Scale(double scale)
			{
				int x = (int)((double)_center.X * scale);
				int y = (int)((double)_center.Y * scale);
				_center = new Point(x, y);
				_radius = (int)((double)_radius * scale);
				if (_radius < 0)
				{
					_radius = -_radius;
				}
			}

			public TMCircle ExpandedAround(TMCircle c)
			{
				Point p = new Point(c.Center.X - Center.X, c.Center.Y - Center.Y);
				double num = _distanceBetweenPoints(new Point(0, 0), p);
				Point point = new Point(p.X, p.Y);
				point.X = (int)((double)point.X * ((double)Radius / num));
				point.Y = (int)((double)point.Y * ((double)Radius / num));
				Point point2 = new Point(p.X, p.Y);
				point2.X = (int)((double)point2.X * ((double)c.Radius / num));
				point2.Y = (int)((double)point2.Y * ((double)c.Radius / num));
				Point p2 = new Point(Center.X, Center.Y);
				p2.X -= point.X;
				p2.Y -= point.Y;
				Point p3 = new Point(c.Center.X, c.Center.Y);
				p3.X += point2.X;
				p3.Y += point2.Y;
				Point center = new Point((p2.X + p3.X) / 2, (p2.Y + p3.Y) / 2);
				double num2 = _distanceBetweenPoints(p2, p3) / 2.0;
				TMCircle tMCircle = new TMCircle(center, (int)num2);
				if (tMCircle.Radius > Radius)
				{
					return tMCircle;
				}
				return this;
			}

			public bool DoesOverlapWith(TMCircle c)
			{
				double num = Center.X;
				double num2 = Center.Y;
				double num3 = Radius;
				double num4 = c.Center.X;
				double num5 = c.Center.Y;
				double num6 = c.Radius;
				num3 -= 1.0;
				num6 -= 1.0;
				double num7 = num4 - num;
				double num8 = num5 - num2;
				double num9 = Math.Sqrt(num8 * num8 + num7 * num7);
				if (num9 >= num3 + num6)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public Ellipse GetEllipse()
			{
				return new Ellipse(_center, _radius);
			}
		}

		private class Gap
		{
			private TMCircle _circle1;

			private TMCircle _circle2;

			public TMCircle Circle1
			{
				get
				{
					return _circle1;
				}
				set
				{
					_circle1 = value;
				}
			}

			public TMCircle Circle2
			{
				get
				{
					return _circle2;
				}
				set
				{
					_circle2 = value;
				}
			}

			public Gap(TMCircle c1, TMCircle c2)
			{
				_circle1 = c1;
				_circle2 = c2;
			}

			public TMCircle GetCircle(int r)
			{
				double num = _circle1.Radius + r;
				double num2 = _circle2.Radius + r;
				double num3 = _distanceBetweenPoints(_circle2.Center, _circle1.Center);
				if (num3 > num + num2 || num3 < Math.Abs(num - num2))
				{
					return null;
				}
				double num4 = (num * num - num2 * num2 + num3 * num3) / (2.0 * num3);
				double num5 = Math.Sqrt(num * num - num4 * num4);
				double num6 = _circle1.Center.X;
				double num7 = _circle2.Center.X;
				double num8 = _circle1.Center.Y;
				double num9 = _circle2.Center.Y;
				double num10 = _circle1.Center.X;
				num10 += (double)(_circle2.Center.X - _circle1.Center.X) * num4 * (1.0 / num3);
				double num11 = _circle1.Center.Y;
				num11 += (double)(_circle2.Center.Y - _circle1.Center.Y) * num4 * (1.0 / num3);
				return new TMCircle(new Point((int)(num10 - num5 * (num9 - num8) / num3), (int)(num11 + num5 * (num7 - num6) / num3)), r);
			}
		}

		private void _convertChartDataToTreeMapData(TreeMapDataPoint parent, DataTable dt_in, int depth)
		{
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			DataRow[] array = dt_in.Select();
			if (_indexOrder.Length == 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					DataRow dataRow = array[i];
					TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = new TreeMapDataPoint();
					try
					{
						if (Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow[_sizeValueIndex]))
						{
							treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue = Convert.ToDouble(dataRow[_sizeValueIndex]);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
						treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue = 0.0;
					}
					try
					{
						if (Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow[_colorValueIndex]))
						{
							treeMapDataPoint.ColorValue = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							treeMapDataPoint.ColorValue = Convert.ToDouble(dataRow[_sizeValueIndex]);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
						treeMapDataPoint.ColorValue = 0.0;
					}
					treeMapDataPoint.Label = "ROW " + i;
					parent.Points.Add(treeMapDataPoint);
				}
				return;
			}
			int columnIndex = _indexOrder[depth];
			DataRow[] array2 = array;
			foreach (DataRow dataRow2 in array2)
			{
				string value = dataRow2[columnIndex] as string;
				if (!stringCollection.Contains(value))
				{
					stringCollection.Add(value);
				}
			}
			if (depth == _indexOrder.Length - 1)
			{
				StringEnumerator enumerator = stringCollection.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						string current = enumerator.Current;
						TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint2 = new TreeMapDataPoint();
						treeMapDataPoint2.Label = current;
						double num = 0.0;
						double num2 = 0.0;
						DataRow[] array3 = array;
						foreach (DataRow dataRow3 in array3)
						{
							if (dataRow3[columnIndex] as string == current)
							{
								double num3;
								try
								{
									num3 = ((!Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow3[_sizeValueIndex])) ? Convert.ToDouble(dataRow3[_sizeValueIndex]) : 0.0);
								}
								catch
								{
									num3 = 0.0;
								}
								double num4;
								try
								{
									num4 = ((!Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow3[_colorValueIndex])) ? Convert.ToDouble(dataRow3[_colorValueIndex]) : 0.0);
								}
								catch
								{
									num4 = 0.0;
								}
								num += num3;
								num2 += num4;
							}
						}
						treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue = num;
						treeMapDataPoint2.ColorValue = num2;
						if (!(current == "") || stringCollection.Count != 1)
						{
							parent.Points.Add(treeMapDataPoint2);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			StringEnumerator enumerator2 = stringCollection.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					string current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint3 = new TreeMapDataPoint();
					treeMapDataPoint3.Label = current2;
					DataTable dataTable = dt_in.Clone();
					double num5 = 0.0;
					double num6 = 0.0;
					DataRow[] array4 = array;
					foreach (DataRow dataRow4 in array4)
					{
						if (dataRow4[columnIndex] as string == current2)
						{
							dataTable.ImportRow(dataRow4);
							double num7;
							try
							{
								num7 = ((!Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow4[_sizeValueIndex])) ? Convert.ToDouble(dataRow4[_sizeValueIndex]) : 0.0);
							}
							catch
							{
								num7 = 0.0;
							}
							double num8;
							try
							{
								num8 = ((!Convert.IsDBNull(dataRow4[_colorValueIndex])) ? Convert.ToDouble(dataRow4[_colorValueIndex]) : 0.0);
							}
							catch
							{
								num8 = 0.0;
							}
							num5 += num7;
							num6 += num8;
						}
					}
					treeMapDataPoint3.SizeValue = num5;
					treeMapDataPoint3.ColorValue = num6;
					if (current2 == "" && stringCollection.Count == 1)
					{
						_convertChartDataToTreeMapData(parent, dataTable, depth + 1);
						continue;
					}
					parent.Points.Add(treeMapDataPoint3);
					_convertChartDataToTreeMapData(treeMapDataPoint3, dataTable, depth + 1);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable2)
				{
					disposable2.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private PaintElement _getPE(bool isLeaf, int depth, double value, double colorValue, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, TreeMapDataPoint dataPoint, ISeries series)
		{
			if (dataPoint != null && dataPoint.PE != null && dataPoint.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				return dataPoint.PE.Clone();
			}
			if (series != null && series.PEs != null && series.PEs.Count > 0)
			{
				return series.PEs[Math.Max(0, depth) % series.PEs.Count].Clone();
			}
			if (isLeaf)
			{
				if (Appearance.UseStaticLeafPE)
				{
					return Appearance.StaticLeafPE.Clone();
				}
				if (!Appearance.DisableColorValues && _colorValueIndex != -1)
				{
					Color fillColor;
					if (Appearance._colorIntervals.Count > 0)
					{
						fillColor = Appearance.GetColorForValue(colorValue);
					}
					else
					{
						TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval interval = _getColorIntervalFromColorModel();
						fillColor = Appearance.GetColorForValueAndInterval(colorValue, interval);
					}
					colorModel.GetAlpha();
					return new PaintElement(fillColor);
				}
			}
			if (Appearance.PEs.Count != 0)
			{
				return Appearance.PEs[(depth + 1) % Appearance.PEs.Count].Clone();
			}
			colorModel.GetAlpha();
			Color fillColor2 = colorModel.getFillColor(0, depth + 1, colorValue);
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement(fillColor2);
			paintElement.Stroke = Appearance.BorderColor;
			paintElement.StrokeWidth = Appearance.BorderWidth;
			return paintElement;
		}

		private TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval _getColorIntervalFromColorModel()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			if (!(ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection))
			{
				IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = ChartData as IChartDataFilter;
				int column = _colorValueIndex;
				if (chartDataFilter != null)
				{
					column = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(_colorValueIndex);
				}
				num = ChartData.GetDataMinColumn(column);
				num2 = ChartData.GetDataMaxColumn(column);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (!(item is TreeMapSeries treeMapSeries))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in treeMapSeries.Points)
					{
						double num3 = _findMinColorValue(point);
						if (num3 < num)
						{
							num = num3;
						}
						double num4 = _findMaxColorValue(point);
						if (num4 > num2)
						{
							num2 = num4;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ColorAppearance colorAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color) as ColorAppearance;
			Color colorBegin = colorAppearance.ColorBegin;
			Color eColor = colorAppearance.ColorEnd;
			if (num == num2)
			{
				eColor = colorBegin;
			}
			return new TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval(num, colorBegin, num2, eColor);
		}

		private void _recursiveDrawRectangular(TreeMapDataPoint parent, Rectangle bounds, int depth, SceneGraph scene, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, LabelStyle labelStyle, bool hasHeaderText, ISeries series)
		{
			COL++;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			double num = parent.SizeValue;
			List<TreeMapDataPoint> list = new List<TreeMapDataPoint>();
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in parent.Points)
			{
				if (!point.Empty)
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			int height = ((labelStyle != null && labelStyle.Font != null) ? labelStyle.Font.Height : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = list.Count - 1;
				TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint2 = list[num2 - i];
				if (treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue != 0.0 && !treeMapDataPoint2.Empty)
				{
					double num3 = Math.Abs(treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue) / num;
					Rectangle rectangle2 = default(Rectangle);
					int num4 = 0;
					int num5 = 0;
					int num6 = 0;
					int num7 = 0;
					int margin = Appearance.Margin;
					int num8 = 0;
					if (Appearance.ShowLabels && (Appearance.ShowHeadersForUnlabeledPoints || hasHeaderText) && Appearance.LabelStyle.Font.Height > Appearance.Margin)
					{
						num8 = Appearance.LabelStyle.Font.Height - Appearance.Margin;
					}
					int num9 = (int)(num3 * (double)rectangle.Width);
					int num10 = rectangle.Height - num8;
					int width = rectangle.Width;
					int num11 = (int)(num3 * ((double)rectangle.Height - (double)num8));
					int num12 = Math.Abs(num9 - num10);
					int num13 = Math.Abs(width - num11);
					if (num12 < num13)
					{
						num4 = rectangle.X + margin;
						num5 = rectangle.Y + margin + num8;
						num6 = num9;
						num7 = num10;
						rectangle2 = new Rectangle(num4, num5, num6 - 2 * margin, num7 - 2 * margin);
						rectangle = new Rectangle(rectangle.X + num6, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width - num6, rectangle.Height);
					}
					else
					{
						num4 = rectangle.X + margin;
						num5 = rectangle.Y + margin + num8;
						num6 = width;
						num7 = num11;
						rectangle2 = new Rectangle(num4, num5, num6 - 2 * margin, num7 - 2 * margin);
						rectangle = new Rectangle(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + num7, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height - num7);
					}
					TMBox tMBox = new TMBox(new Box(rectangle2));
					tMBox.SizeValue = treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue;
					tMBox.ColorValue = treeMapDataPoint2.ColorValue;
					tMBox.Label = treeMapDataPoint2.Label;
					tMBox.Depth = depth;
					tMBox.DataPoint = treeMapDataPoint2;
					_addToScene(scene, Appearance, tMBox, series);
					num -= Math.Abs(treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue);
					if (Appearance.ShowLabels)
					{
						Rectangle bounds2 = ((!treeMapDataPoint2.HasChildren) ? rectangle2 : new Rectangle(rectangle2.Left, rectangle2.Top, rectangle2.Width, height));
						Text value = new Text(bounds2, treeMapDataPoint2.Label, labelStyle);
						scene.Add(value);
					}
					if (treeMapDataPoint2.HasChildren)
					{
						_recursiveDrawRectangular(tMBox.DataPoint, rectangle2, depth + 1, scene, Appearance, labelStyle, treeMapDataPoint2.Label != null && treeMapDataPoint2.Label.Length > 0, series);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void _recursiveDrawCircular(TreeMapDataPoint parent, TMCircle RealBoundingCircle, int depth, SceneGraph scene, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, ISeries series)
		{
			COL++;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			TMCircle tMCircle = new TMCircle();
			double sizeValue = parent.SizeValue;
			if (sizeValue == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<TreeMapDataPoint> list = new List<TreeMapDataPoint>();
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in parent.Points)
			{
				if (!point.Empty)
				{
					list.Add(point);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = list.Count - 1;
				TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint2 = list[num - i];
				int num2 = _getRadiusForWeight(Math.Abs(treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue) / sizeValue);
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				TMCircle tMCircle2 = new TMCircle(new Point(0, 0), num2);
				switch (i)
				{
				case 1:
					tMCircle2.Center = new Point(((TMCircle)arrayList[0]).Radius + num2, 0);
					arrayList2.Add(new Gap((TMCircle)arrayList[0], tMCircle2));
					arrayList2.Add(new Gap(tMCircle2, (TMCircle)arrayList[0]));
					break;
				default:
				{
					Gap gap = (Gap)arrayList2[0];
					TMCircle circle = ((Gap)arrayList2[0]).GetCircle(num2);
					for (int j = 0; j < arrayList2.Count; j++)
					{
						gap = (Gap)arrayList2[j];
						circle = ((Gap)arrayList2[j]).GetCircle(num2);
						if (circle == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						bool flag = false;
						for (int k = 0; k < arrayList.Count; k++)
						{
							if (((TMCircle)arrayList[k]).DoesOverlapWith(circle))
							{
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					tMCircle2 = circle;
					if (gap != null)
					{
						arrayList2.Remove(gap);
						Gap value = new Gap(gap.Circle1, gap.Circle2);
						Gap value2 = new Gap(gap.Circle1, tMCircle2);
						Gap value3 = new Gap(tMCircle2, gap.Circle2);
						arrayList2.Add(value);
						arrayList2.Add(value2);
						arrayList2.Add(value3);
					}
					break;
				}
				case 0:
					break;
				}
				tMCircle2.SizeValue = treeMapDataPoint2.SizeValue;
				tMCircle2.ColorValue = treeMapDataPoint2.ColorValue;
				tMCircle2.Label = treeMapDataPoint2.Label;
				tMCircle2.Depth = depth;
				tMCircle2.DataPoint = treeMapDataPoint2;
				arrayList.Add(tMCircle2);
				tMCircle = ((i != 0) ? tMCircle.ExpandedAround(tMCircle2) : tMCircle2.Copy());
			}
			int delta_x = -tMCircle.Center.X;
			int delta_y = -tMCircle.Center.Y;
			tMCircle.Translate(delta_x, delta_y);
			for (int l = 0; l < arrayList.Count; l++)
			{
				((TMCircle)arrayList[l]).Translate(delta_x, delta_y);
			}
			if (arrayList.Count != 1 || !(((TMCircle)arrayList[0]).Label == ""))
			{
				RealBoundingCircle.Radius = Math.Max(0, RealBoundingCircle.Radius - Appearance.Margin);
			}
			double scale = (double)RealBoundingCircle.Radius / (double)tMCircle.Radius;
			for (int m = 0; m < arrayList.Count; m++)
			{
				((TMCircle)arrayList[m]).Scale(scale);
			}
			delta_x = RealBoundingCircle.Center.X - tMCircle.Center.X;
			delta_y = RealBoundingCircle.Center.Y - tMCircle.Center.Y;
			for (int n = 0; n < arrayList.Count; n++)
			{
				((TMCircle)arrayList[n]).Translate(delta_x, delta_y);
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < arrayList.Count; num3++)
			{
				TMCircle tMCircle3 = (TMCircle)arrayList[num3];
				_addToScene(scene, Appearance, tMCircle3, series);
				TreeMapDataPoint dataPoint = tMCircle3.DataPoint;
				if (dataPoint.HasChildren)
				{
					_recursiveDrawCircular(dataPoint, tMCircle3, depth + 1, scene, Appearance, series);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _recursiveDrawRings(TreeMapDataPoint parent, Point center, double inner_r, double outer_r, double startAngle, double endAngle, SceneGraph scene, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, int depth, List<Wedge> Wedges, ISeries series)
		{
			COL++;
			double sizeValue = parent.SizeValue;
			List<TreeMapDataPoint> list = new List<TreeMapDataPoint>();
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in parent.Points)
			{
				list.Add(point);
			}
			double num = startAngle;
			double outer_r2 = Math.Sqrt(2.0 * (outer_r * outer_r) - inner_r * inner_r);
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint item in list)
			{
				if (item.SizeValue != 0.0 && !item.Empty)
				{
					double num2 = Math.Abs(item.SizeValue) / sizeValue;
					double num3 = num2 * (endAngle - startAngle);
					Wedge wedge = new Wedge(center, (int)outer_r, (float)num, (float)num3);
					if (item.HasChildren)
					{
						wedge.RadiusInner = Math.Max(Math.Min((int)inner_r, wedge.Radius - 1), 0);
					}
					else
					{
						wedge.RadiusInner = Math.Max(Math.Min((int)inner_r, wedge.Radius - 1), 0);
					}
					_addToList(Wedges, Appearance, wedge, series, item, depth);
					_recursiveDrawRings(item, center, outer_r, outer_r2, num, num + num3, scene, Appearance, depth + 1, Wedges, series);
					COL--;
					num += num3;
				}
			}
		}

		private void _addToScene(SceneGraph scene, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, TMBox tmb, ISeries series)
		{
			Box box = tmb.Box;
			bool isLeaf = false;
			if (tmb.DataPoint != null && !tmb.DataPoint.HasChildren)
			{
				isLeaf = true;
			}
			box.PE = _getPE(isLeaf, tmb.Depth, tmb.SizeValue, tmb.ColorValue, Appearance, tmb.DataPoint, series);
			if (tmb.DataPoint == null || tmb.DataPoint.PE == null || tmb.DataPoint.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.None)
			{
				box.PE = box.PE.Clone();
				box.PE.Stroke = Appearance.BorderColor;
				box.PE.StrokeWidth = Appearance.BorderWidth;
			}
			box.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			box.Chart = ChartType.TreeMapChart;
			box.Layer = this;
			box.Row = ROW;
			box.Column = COL;
			ROW++;
			box.Value = tmb.SizeValue;
			box.DataPoint = tmb.DataPoint;
			box.Series = series;
			box.Tags = new Hashtable();
			box.Tags.Add("ShapeLabel", tmb.Label);
			box.Tags.Add("SizeValueLabel", Appearance.SizeValueLabel);
			box.Tags.Add("SizeValue", tmb.SizeValue);
			box.Tags.Add("ColorValueLabel", Appearance.ColorValueLabel);
			box.Tags.Add("ColorValue", tmb.ColorValue);
			scene.Add(box);
		}

		private void _addToScene(SceneGraph scene, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, TMCircle circle, ISeries series)
		{
			int x = OuterBound.Left + OuterBound.Width / 2;
			int y = OuterBound.Top + OuterBound.Height / 2;
			Point centerOfRotation = new Point(x, y);
			circle.RotateAround(centerOfRotation, Appearance.Rotation);
			Ellipse ellipse = circle.GetEllipse();
			bool isLeaf = false;
			if (circle.DataPoint != null && !circle.DataPoint.HasChildren)
			{
				isLeaf = true;
			}
			ellipse.PE = _getPE(isLeaf, circle.Depth, circle.SizeValue, circle.ColorValue, Appearance, circle.DataPoint, series);
			ellipse.PE.Stroke = Appearance.BorderColor;
			ellipse.PE.StrokeWidth = Appearance.BorderWidth;
			ellipse.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			ellipse.Chart = ChartType.TreeMapChart;
			ellipse.Layer = this;
			ellipse.Row = ROW;
			ellipse.Column = COL;
			ellipse.Value = circle.SizeValue;
			ROW++;
			ellipse.DataPoint = circle.DataPoint;
			ellipse.Series = series;
			ellipse.Tags = new Hashtable();
			ellipse.Tags.Add("ShapeLabel", circle.Label);
			ellipse.Tags.Add("SizeValueLabel", Appearance.SizeValueLabel);
			ellipse.Tags.Add("SizeValue", circle.SizeValue);
			ellipse.Tags.Add("ColorValueLabel", Appearance.ColorValueLabel);
			ellipse.Tags.Add("ColorValue", circle.ColorValue);
			scene.Add(ellipse);
			circle.RotateAround(centerOfRotation, 0.0 - Appearance.Rotation);
		}

		private void _addToList(List<Wedge> Wedges, TreeMapChartAppearance Appearance, Wedge wedge, ISeries series, TreeMapDataPoint point, int depth)
		{
			wedge.PE = _getPE(!point.HasChildren, depth, point.SizeValue, point.ColorValue, Appearance, point, series);
			wedge.PE.Stroke = Appearance.BorderColor;
			wedge.PE.StrokeWidth = Appearance.BorderWidth;
			wedge.Caps = PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin | PCaps.Tooltip;
			wedge.Chart = ChartType.TreeMapChart;
			wedge.Layer = this;
			wedge.Row = ROW;
			wedge.Column = COL;
			wedge.Value = point.SizeValue;
			ROW++;
			wedge.DataPoint = point;
			wedge.Series = series;
			wedge.Tags = new Hashtable();
			wedge.Tags.Add("ShapeLabel", point.Label);
			wedge.Tags.Add("SizeValueLabel", Appearance.SizeValueLabel);
			wedge.Tags.Add("SizeValue", point.SizeValue);
			wedge.Tags.Add("ColorValueLabel", Appearance.ColorValueLabel);
			wedge.Tags.Add("ColorValue", point.ColorValue);
			Wedges.Add(wedge);
		}

		private int _getRadiusForWeight(double weight)
		{
			return (int)(Math.Pow(weight, 1.0) * 2.0 * 1000.0 / 2.0);
		}

		public override ChartAppearance GetAppearance()
		{
			ChartAppearance chartAppearance = base.GetAppearance();
			if (chartAppearance == null)
			{
				chartAppearance = component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.TreeMap);
			}
			return chartAppearance;
		}

		private static double _distanceBetweenPoints(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			return (int)Math.Sqrt((p2.X - p1.X) * (p2.X - p1.X) + (p2.Y - p1.Y) * (p2.Y - p1.Y));
		}

		internal static double _findMinColorValue(TreeMapDataPoint point)
		{
			if (point.Points.Count == 0)
			{
				return point.ColorValue;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point2 in point.Points)
			{
				if (!point2.Empty)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, _findMinColorValue(point2));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double _findMaxColorValue(TreeMapDataPoint point)
		{
			if (point.Points.Count == 0)
			{
				return point.ColorValue;
			}
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point2 in point.Points)
			{
				if (!point2.Empty)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, _findMaxColorValue(point2));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class TreeMapLegendLayer : LegendLayer
	{
		private class ColorAxis
		{
			public Point StartPoint;

			public Point EndPoint;

			public double StartCoord;

			public double EndCoord;

			public ColorAxis(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, double startCoord, double endCoord)
			{
				StartPoint = startPoint;
				EndPoint = endPoint;
				StartCoord = startCoord;
				EndCoord = endCoord;
			}

			public Point Map(double coord)
			{
				if (EndCoord == StartCoord)
				{
					return new Point(StartPoint.X, StartPoint.Y);
				}
				double num = (coord - StartCoord) / (EndCoord - StartCoord);
				double num2 = (double)StartPoint.X + num * (double)(EndPoint.X - StartPoint.X);
				double num3 = (double)StartPoint.Y + num * (double)(EndPoint.Y - StartPoint.Y);
				return new Point((int)num2, (int)num3);
			}
		}

		private const int ICON_WIDTH = 30;

		private const int ICON_HEIGHT = 15;

		private const int AXIS_POINT_RADIUS = 5;

		private const int AXIS_RANGE_THICKNESS = 10;

		private TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval _DefaultColorInterval;

		private TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval DefaultColorInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return _DefaultColorInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				_DefaultColorInterval = value;
			}
		}

		public TreeMapLegendLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			base.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)GetAppearance();
			TreeMapChartAppearance treeMapChartAppearance = (TreeMapChartAppearance)((TreeMapLayer)Core.GetChartLayer()).GetAppearance();
			_ = treeMapChartAppearance.ShowColorIntervalAxis;
			DefaultColorInterval = GetDefaultColorInterval(treeMapChartAppearance);
			Rectangle outerDrawRect = GetOuterDrawRect();
			GraphicsContext graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(outerDrawRect);
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
			Rectangle drawRect = new Rectangle(outerDrawRect.X + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Y + boundsBuffer, outerDrawRect.Width - boundsBuffer * 2, outerDrawRect.Height - boundsBuffer * 2);
			if (drawRect.Width <= 0 || drawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (legendAppearance.Location == LegendLocation.Right || legendAppearance.Location == LegendLocation.Left)
			{
				int num = legendAppearance.Font.Height * 2;
				Rectangle drawRect2 = new Rectangle(drawRect.X, drawRect.Y, drawRect.Width, num);
				DrawSizeIcon(scene, drawRect2, legendAppearance, treeMapChartAppearance);
				drawRect.Y += num;
				drawRect.Height -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = legendAppearance.Font.Height * 2;
				Rectangle drawRect3 = new Rectangle(drawRect.X, drawRect.Y, num2, drawRect.Height);
				DrawSizeIcon(scene, drawRect3, legendAppearance, treeMapChartAppearance);
				drawRect.X += num2;
				drawRect.Width -= num2;
				drawRect.X += boundsBuffer;
				drawRect.Width -= boundsBuffer;
			}
			if (!treeMapChartAppearance.DisableColorValues && !treeMapChartAppearance.UseStaticLeafPE)
			{
				if (!treeMapChartAppearance.ShowColorIntervalAxis)
				{
					DrawColorIcons(scene, drawRect, legendAppearance, treeMapChartAppearance);
				}
				else if (treeMapChartAppearance.ShowColorIntervalAxis)
				{
					DrawColorAxis(scene, drawRect, legendAppearance, treeMapChartAppearance);
				}
			}
			graphicsContext = new GraphicsContext();
			graphicsContext.ResetClip();
			scene.Add(graphicsContext);
		}

		private void DrawSizeIcon(SceneGraph scene, Rectangle drawRect, LegendAppearance legendApp, TreeMapChartAppearance treeMapApp)
		{
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("+", legendApp.Font);
			if (drawRect.Width >= drawRect.Height)
			{
				if (treeMapApp.TreeMapType == TreeMapType.Circular)
				{
					double num = (double)drawRect.Right - 0.1 * (double)drawRect.Width;
					double num2 = (double)drawRect.Top + 0.5 * (double)drawRect.Height;
					double num3 = Math.Min(0.5 * (double)drawRect.Height, (double)drawRect.Right - num);
					Point p = new Point((int)num, (int)num2);
					Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(p, (int)num3);
					ellipse.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					double num4 = (double)drawRect.Top + 0.5 * (double)drawRect.Height;
					double num5 = 0.5 * num3;
					double num6 = (double)drawRect.Left + num5;
					Point p2 = new Point((int)num6, (int)num4);
					Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(p2, (int)num5);
					ellipse2.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					Point point = new Point(p2.X + (int)num5 + boundsBuffer, p2.Y);
					Point point2 = new Point(p.X - (int)num3 - boundsBuffer, p.Y);
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineDrawStyle.Solid);
					Line line = new Line(point, point2, lineStyle);
					line.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					LabelStyle style = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Near, StringAlignment.Far, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					Text value = new Text(point, "-", style);
					style = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Far, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					Text value2 = new Text(point2, "+", style);
					string sizeValueLabel = treeMapApp.SizeValueLabel;
					Point pos = new Point((point.X + point2.X) / 2, (point.Y + point2.Y) / 2);
					style = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Near, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					Text text = new Text(pos, sizeValueLabel, style);
					Rectangle actualBounds = text.GetActualBounds();
					if (actualBounds.Width >= point2.X - point.X)
					{
						text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
						text.labelStyle.ClipText = true;
						text.bounds.Width = point2.X - point.X;
						text.bounds.Height = actualBounds.Height;
						text.bounds.X -= (point2.X - point.X) / 2;
					}
					scene.Add(ellipse);
					scene.Add(ellipse2);
					scene.Add(line);
					scene.Add(value);
					scene.Add(value2);
					scene.Add(text);
				}
				else if (treeMapApp.TreeMapType == TreeMapType.Rectangular)
				{
					double num7 = Math.Min(drawRect.Height, 0.2 * (double)drawRect.Width);
					double num8 = drawRect.Top;
					double num9 = (double)drawRect.Right - num7;
					Box box = new Box(new Point((int)num9, (int)num8), (int)num7, (int)num7);
					box.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					double num10 = num7 / 2.0;
					double num11 = (double)(drawRect.Top + drawRect.Height / 2) - num10 / 2.0;
					double num12 = drawRect.Left;
					Box box2 = new Box(new Point((int)num12, (int)num11), (int)num10, (int)num10);
					box2.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					Point p3 = new Point((int)(num12 + num10 + (double)boundsBuffer), (int)(num11 + num10 / 2.0));
					Point p4 = new Point((int)(num9 - (double)boundsBuffer), (int)(num8 + num7 / 2.0));
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle2 = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineDrawStyle.Solid);
					Line line2 = new Line(p3, p4, lineStyle2);
					line2.PE.Stroke = legendApp.FontColor;
					LabelStyle style2 = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Near, StringAlignment.Far, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					int x = p3.X;
					int width = (int)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Width);
					int num13 = (int)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Height);
					int y = p3.Y - num13;
					Text text2 = new Text(new Rectangle(x, y, width, num13), "-", style2);
					style2 = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Far, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					int num14 = (int)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Width);
					int x2 = p4.X - num14;
					int num15 = (int)Math.Ceiling(stringSizePixels.Height);
					int y2 = p4.Y - num15;
					Text text3 = new Text(new Rectangle(x2, y2, num14, num15), "+", style2);
					string sizeValueLabel2 = treeMapApp.SizeValueLabel;
					Point pos2 = new Point((p3.X + p4.X) / 2, p3.Y);
					style2 = new LabelStyle(legendApp.Font, legendApp.FontColor, wrap: false, clip: false, bestFit: false, StringAlignment.Center, StringAlignment.Near, TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					Text text4 = new Text(pos2, sizeValueLabel2, style2);
					Rectangle actualBounds2 = text4.GetActualBounds();

		private void DrawColorIcons(SceneGraph scene, Rectangle drawRect, LegendAppearance legendApp, TreeMapChartAppearance treeMapApp)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = treeMapApp._colorIntervals;
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				arrayList = new ArrayList();
				arrayList.Add(DefaultColorInterval);
			}
			string[] array = new string[arrayList.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval colorInterval = (TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval)arrayList[i];
				string text = colorInterval.CustomLabel;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = ((colorInterval.StartValue != colorInterval.EndValue) ? (colorInterval.StartValue + " - " + colorInterval.EndValue) : string.Concat(colorInterval.StartValue));
				}
				array[i] = text;
			}
			int num = (int)(2.0 * (double)legendApp.Font.Height);
			int stringArrayAverageSizePixels = Platform.GetStringArrayAverageSizePixels(array, legendApp.Font, 100);
			stringArrayAverageSizePixels += 30 + boundsBuffer;
			if (stringArrayAverageSizePixels > drawRect.Width)
			{
				stringArrayAverageSizePixels = drawRect.Width;
			}
			if (num > drawRect.Height)
			{
				num = drawRect.Height;
			}
			int num2 = drawRect.Height / num;
			int num3 = drawRect.Width / stringArrayAverageSizePixels;
			stringArrayAverageSizePixels += (drawRect.Width - num3 * stringArrayAverageSizePixels) / num3;
			num += (drawRect.Height - num2 * num) / num2;
			int num4 = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
				{
					num4 = j * num2 + k;
					if (num4 >= arrayList.Count)
					{
						break;
					}
					Rectangle drawRect2 = new Rectangle(drawRect.Left + j * stringArrayAverageSizePixels, drawRect.Top + k * num, stringArrayAverageSizePixels, num);
					DrawColorIcon(scene, drawRect2, (TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval)arrayList[num4], array[num4], legendApp, treeMapApp);
				}
				if (num4 >= arrayList.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			_ = arrayList.Count;
			_ = num3 * num2;
		}

		private void DrawColorIcon(SceneGraph scene, Rectangle drawRect, TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval interval, string label, LegendAppearance legendApp, TreeMapChartAppearance treeMapApp)
		{
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(drawRect.Left, drawRect.Top + drawRect.Height / 2 - 7, 30, 15);

			Text value = new Text(pos, label, style);
			scene.Add(box);
			scene.Add(value);
		}
