		private TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval GetDefaultColorInterval(TreeMapChartAppearance treeMapApp)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			if (!(ChartData is SeriesCollection seriesCollection))
			{
				int num3 = treeMapApp.ColorValueIndex;
				if (num3 == -1)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < ChartData.GetColumnCount(); i++)
					{
						if (ChartData.IsColumnNumeric(i))
						{
							num3 = i;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (ChartData is IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter)
				{
					num3 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(num3);
				}
				num = ChartData.GetDataMinColumn(num3);
				num2 = ChartData.GetDataMaxColumn(num3);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
				{
					if (!(item is TreeMapSeries treeMapSeries))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in treeMapSeries.Points)
					{
						double num4 = TreeMapLayer._findMinColorValue(point);
						if (num4 < num)
						{
							num = num4;
						}
						double num5 = TreeMapLayer._findMaxColorValue(point);
						if (num5 > num2)
						{
							num2 = num5;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ColorAppearance colorAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color) as ColorAppearance;
			Color colorBegin = colorAppearance.ColorBegin;
			Color colorEnd = colorAppearance.ColorEnd;
			return new TreeMapChartAppearance.ColorInterval(num, colorBegin, num2, colorEnd);
		}
	}
	public class TwoDGridLayer : GridLayer
	{
		private StackStyle stackStyle;

		public override string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Path;
			}
			set
			{
				base.X.Path = value + ".X";
				base.X2.Path = value + ".X2";
				base.Y.Path = value + ".Y";
				base.Y2.Path = value + ".Y2";
				base.Path = value;
			}
		}

		public TwoDGridLayer(IChartComponent component, ChartCore core)
			: base(component, core)
		{
		}

		public override void SetChartType(ChartType type)
		{
			base.SetChartType(type);
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.HeatMapChart:
				x_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling);
				x2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling);
				break;
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.PolarChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
			{
				x_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				NumericAxis numericAxis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				numericAxis.NormalDistribution = type == ChartType.ProbabilityChart;
				y_axis = numericAxis;
				x2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.BarChart:
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
				x_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				x2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				y_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				y_axis.HorzVertLabelOffset = true;
				y2_axis.HorzVertLabelOffset = true;
				break;
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.ParetoChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
				x_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				x2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			case ChartType.ColumnChart:
			case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
				x_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				x2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				x_axis.HorzVertLabelOffset = true;
				x2_axis.HorzVertLabelOffset = true;
				break;
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
				x_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.DateData);
				x2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.DateData);
				x_axis.DateDataColumn = 0;
				x_axis.itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL:MM-dd-yy>";
				x2_axis.DateDataColumn = 0;
				x2_axis.itemLabelFormat = "<ITEM_LABEL:MM-dd-yy>";
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
				x_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				x2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				x_axis.HorzVertLabelOffset = true;
				break;
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				x_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				x2_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				x_axis = new TimeAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis);
				x2_axis = new TimeAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
				x_axis = new TimeAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis);
				x2_axis = new TimeAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis);
				y2_axis = new GroupedLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis);
				y_axis = new GroupedLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis);
				break;
			case ChartType.HistogramChart:
			{
				HistogramLayer histogramLayer = ChartCore.GetChartLayer() as HistogramLayer;
				HistogramChartAppearance histogramChartAppearance = (HistogramChartAppearance)histogramLayer.GetAppearance();
				if (histogramChartAppearance != null && !histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis)
				{
					x_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				}
				else
				{
					x_axis = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries);
				}
				x2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				y2_axis = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData);
				break;
			}
			}
			x2_axis.addStyle(4096);
			y2_axis.addStyle(2048);
			if (chartType == ChartType.HeatMapChart)
			{
				x_axis.lineVisible = false;
				y_axis.lineVisible = false;
				y2_axis.lineVisible = false;
				x2_axis.lineVisible = false;
			}
			else
			{
				x_axis.lineVisible = true;
				y_axis.lineVisible = true;
				y2_axis.lineVisible = true;
				x2_axis.lineVisible = true;
			}
			x_axis.addStyle(32768);
			y_axis.addStyle(65536);
			if (chartType == ChartType.BarChart || chartType == ChartType.StackBarChart)
			{
				y2_axis.addStyle(65536);
				x2_axis.addStyle(32768);
				x2_axis.addStyle(4096);
				y2_axis.addStyle(2048);
			}
			else
			{
				y2_axis.addStyle(65536);
				x2_axis.addStyle(32768);
			}
			base.Grid["X"] = x_axis;
			base.Grid["Y"] = y_axis;
			base.Grid["X2"] = x2_axis;
			base.Grid["Y2"] = y2_axis;
			ResetAxisLabelFormat();
		}

		private void setStripLineAttributes()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				if (axisAppearance.StripLines.Visible)
				{
					x_axis.addStyle(2097152);
				}
				else
				{
					x_axis.removeStyle(2097152);
				}
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			if (axisAppearance2 != null)
			{
				if (axisAppearance2.StripLines.Visible)
				{
					y_axis.addStyle(2097152);
				}
				else
				{
					y_axis.removeStyle(2097152);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetAxisLabelFormat()
		{
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			ChartAxisFormatSource chartAxisFormatSource = new ChartAxisFormatSource();
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = chartAxisFormatSource[chartType, AxisNumber.X_Axis];
				axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString = x_axis.seriesLabelFormat;
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				if (chartType == ChartType.CandleChart)
				{
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = x_axis.itemLabelFormat;
				}
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
			axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = chartAxisFormatSource[chartType, AxisNumber.X2_Axis];
				axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString = x2_axis.seriesLabelFormat;
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				if (chartType == ChartType.CandleChart)
				{
					axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = x2_axis.itemLabelFormat;
				}
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
			axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = chartAxisFormatSource[chartType, AxisNumber.Y_Axis];
				axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString = y_axis.seriesLabelFormat;
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
			axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			if (axisAppearance != null)
			{
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				axisAppearance.Labels.ItemFormatString = chartAxisFormatSource[chartType, AxisNumber.Y2_Axis];
				axisAppearance.Labels.SeriesLabels.FormatString = y2_axis.seriesLabelFormat;
				axisAppearance.Labels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
				axisAppearance.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		private bool IsToBeStacked()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (chartType == ChartType.Stack3DBarChart || chartType == ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart || chartType == ChartType.StackColumnChart || chartType == ChartType.StackBarChart || chartType == ChartType.StackAreaChart || chartType == ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart || chartType == ChartType.StackLineChart || chartType == ChartType.StackSplineChart)
			{
				flag = true;
				StackAppearance stackAppearance = (StackAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Stack);
				stackStyle = stackAppearance.StackStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public override void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			FillSceneGraph(scene, includeXAxes: true, includeYAxes: true);
		}

		private void InflateAxisMinMax(Axis axis, double inflation)
		{
			if (axis.GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance { NumericAxisType: not NumericAxisType.Logarithmic })
			{
				axis.Minimum = (double)axis.Minimum - inflation;
				axis.Maximum = (double)axis.Maximum + inflation;
			}
		}

		private void InflateAxisMinMax(Axis axis, long inflation)
		{
			if (axis.GetAppearance() is AxisAppearance && axis is TimeAxis)
			{
				axis.Minimum = ((DateTime)axis.Minimum).AddTicks(-inflation);
				axis.Maximum = ((DateTime)axis.Maximum).AddTicks(inflation);
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisMinAndMaxWithConsiderationForRangeType(IAdvanceAxis axis, object min, object max, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			switch (axisApp.RangeType)
			{
			case AxisRangeType.Automatic:
				SetAxisMinAndMax(axis, min, max);
				break;
			case AxisRangeType.Custom:
				SetAxisMinAndMax(axis, axisApp.RangeMin, axisApp.RangeMax);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisMinAndMax(IAdvanceAxis axis, object min, object max)
		{
			if (!(axis is TimeAxis) || (min is DateTime && max is DateTime))
			{
				axis.Minimum = min;
				axis.Maximum = max;
			}
		}

		private NullHandling GetNullHandling()
		{
			ChartAppearance appearance = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().GetAppearance();
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = appearance.GetType().GetProperty("NullHandling");
				if (property != null)
				{
					object value = property.GetValue(appearance, null);
					if (value != null && value is NullHandling)
					{
						return (NullHandling)value;
					}
				}
			}
			return NullHandling.Zero;
		}

		private void InflateAxisIfNoRange(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axis.Minimum is double && axis.Maximum is double && (double)axis.Minimum == (double)axis.Maximum)
			{
				if ((double)axis.Minimum == 0.0)
				{
					axis.Maximum = 1.0;
					switch (chartType)
					{
					case ChartType.AreaChart:
					case ChartType.LineChart:
					case ChartType.SplineChart:
					case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
						axis.Minimum = -1.0;
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InflateAxisMinMax(axis, Math.Abs((double)axis.Minimum * 0.05));
				}
			}
			if (axis.Minimum is DateTime && axis.Maximum is DateTime && (DateTime)axis.Minimum == (DateTime)axis.Maximum)
			{
				InflateAxisMinMax(axis, 864000000000L);
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisProperties(IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			axis.RulerType = axisApp.NumericAxisType;
			axis.RangeType = axisApp.RangeType;
			axis.RangeMin = axisApp.RangeMin;
			axis.RangeMax = axisApp.RangeMax;
			axis.LogZero = axisApp.LogZero;
			axis.LogNegativeHandling = axisApp.LogNegativeHandling;
			axis.LogBase = axisApp.LogBase;
		}

		private void FixZeroAxisRange(IAdvanceAxis axis)
		{
			if (axis.NumericOf(axis.Maximum) - axis.NumericOf(axis.Minimum) < 1E-323)
			{
				axis.Maximum = axis.InverseNumericOf(axis.NumericOf(axis.Minimum) + 1.0);
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisMinAndMaxForStackedCharts(double dataMin, double dataMax)
		{
			IAdvanceAxis[] array = new IAdvanceAxis[4] { base.X, base.X2, base.Y, base.Y2 };
			if (dataMin < 0.0 && dataMax > 0.0)
			{
				double num = ColumnLayer._getLowestNegativeStack(data);
				double num2 = ColumnLayer._getHighestPositiveStack(data);
				IAdvanceAxis[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis in array2)
				{
					if (advanceAxis is NumericAxis numericAxis)
					{
						numericAxis.Minimum = num;
						numericAxis.Maximum = num2;
						if (numericAxis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
						{
							numericAxis.Minimum = num;
							numericAxis.Maximum = num2 / numericAxis.LogBase;
						}
						FixZeroAxisRange(numericAxis);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (dataMin >= 0.0)
				{
					float stackedMaxSeries = ColumnLayer.getStackedMaxSeries(ChartData);
					IAdvanceAxis[] array3 = array;
					foreach (IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis2 in array3)
					{
						if (advanceAxis2 is NumericAxis numericAxis2)
						{
							numericAxis2.Maximum = stackedMaxSeries;
							if (numericAxis2.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
							{
								numericAxis2.Minimum = dataMin;
							}
							else
							{
								numericAxis2.Minimum = numericAxis2.Zero;
							}
							FixZeroAxisRange(numericAxis2);
						}
					}
				}
				if (dataMax <= 0.0)
				{
					float stackedMinNegativeSeries = ColumnLayer.getStackedMinNegativeSeries(data);
					IAdvanceAxis[] array4 = array;
					foreach (IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis3 in array4)
					{
						if (advanceAxis3 is NumericAxis numericAxis3)
						{
							numericAxis3.Minimum = stackedMinNegativeSeries;
							if (numericAxis3.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
							{
								numericAxis3.Maximum = dataMax / numericAxis3.LogBase;
							}
							else
							{
								numericAxis3.Maximum = numericAxis3.Zero;
							}
							FixZeroAxisRange(numericAxis3);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			IAdvanceAxis[] array5 = array;
			foreach (IAdvanceAxis advanceAxis4 in array5)
			{
				if (advanceAxis4 is SetLabelAxis { stackIt: not false } setLabelAxis)
				{
					IGroupSpacing groupSpacing = setLabelAxis.GetGroupSpacing();
					setLabelAxis.SetMinAndMax(groupSpacing);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void FixMinimumForLogAxis(Axis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp)
		{
			if (axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && axis.Minimum is double && (double)axis.Minimum == 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(axisApp.LogZero))
			{
				axis.Minimum = axisApp.LogZero;
			}
		}

		private void FixRangesForStepCharts(AxisAppearance yApp, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			InflateAxisIfNoRange(y_axis);
			y_axis.WindowMinimum = y_axis.Minimum;
			y_axis.WindowMaximum = y_axis.Maximum;
			if (y_axis.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
			{
				Axis axis = y_axis;
				object windowMinimum = (y_axis.Minimum = yApp.RangeMin);
				axis.WindowMinimum = windowMinimum;
				Axis axis2 = y_axis;
				object windowMaximum = (y_axis.Maximum = yApp.RangeMax);
				axis2.WindowMaximum = windowMaximum;
			}
		}

		public void FillSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, bool includeXAxes, bool includeYAxes)
		{
			InitializeAxesForCurrentChartType();
			int column = 1;
			int column2 = 2;
			setStripLineAttributes();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = data as SeriesCollection;
			NullHandling nullHandling = GetNullHandling();
			if (ChartData is ChartDataAdapter chartDataAdapter && nullHandling != NullHandling.Zero)
			{
				chartDataAdapter.ReCalculateMinMax(treatNullAsZero: false);
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.StackColumnChart && IsToBeStacked())
			{
				zeroAlign = true;
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.StackBarChart && IsToBeStacked())
			{
				zeroAlign = true;
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = x_axis.GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = x2_axis.GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = y_axis.GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance4 = y2_axis.GetAppearance() as AxisAppearance;
			SetAxisProperties(x_axis, axisAppearance);
			SetAxisProperties(x2_axis, axisAppearance2);
			SetAxisProperties(y_axis, axisAppearance3);
			SetAxisProperties(y2_axis, axisAppearance4);
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
				SetDataIntoColumnLineChart();
				break;
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				SetDataIntoScatterLineChart();
				break;
			default:
				x_axis.SetData(data);
				x2_axis.SetData(data);
				y_axis.SetData(data);
				y2_axis.SetData(data);
				break;
			}
			bool flag = (chartType == ChartType.LineChart && !((LineChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.SplineChart && !((LineChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Spline)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.AreaChart && !((AreaChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Area)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.SplineAreaChart && !((AreaChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.SplineArea)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.StackLineChart && !((LineChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.StackSplineChart && !((LineChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Spline)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.StackAreaChart && !((AreaChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Area)).TreatDateTimeAsString) || (chartType == ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart && !((AreaChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.SplineArea)).TreatDateTimeAsString);
			double dataMin = data.GetDataMin();
			double dataMax = data.GetDataMax();
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
				SetMinMaxIntoMultipleTypeChart();
				break;
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				SetMinMaxIntoMultipleTypeChart();
				InflateAxisIfNoRange(x_axis);
				InflateAxisIfNoRange(y_axis);
				InflateAxisIfNoRange(y2_axis);
				break;
			case ChartType.ParetoChart:
				SetAxisMinAndMax(x_axis, dataMin, dataMax);
				SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, dataMin, dataMax);
				SetAxisMinAndMax(y_axis, dataMin, dataMax);
				y2_axis.RulerType = ((AxisAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2)).NumericAxisType;
				SetAxisMinAndMax(y2_axis, y2_axis.Zero, 100);
				if (ChartCore.GetChartLayer() is ParetoLayer paretoLayer)
				{
					paretoLayer.InitializeColumns();
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
				if (seriesCollection != null)

							double maximum = boxSetSeries.BoxSets.GetMaximum();

							SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, x2_axis.Zero, boxSetSeries.BoxSets.Count - 1);

					SetAxisMinAndMax(y2_axis, dataMin, dataMax);
					SetAxisMinAndMax(x_axis, x_axis.Zero, rowCount);
					SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, x2_axis.Zero, rowCount);

			case ChartType.HeatMapChart:

				SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, x2_axis.Zero, data.GetRowCount() - 1);
				SetAxisMinAndMax(y_axis, y_axis.Zero, data.GetColumnCount() - 1);
				SetAxisMinAndMax(y2_axis, y2_axis.Zero, data.GetColumnCount() - 1);
				break;
			case ChartType.HistogramChart:
			{
				HistogramLayer histogramLayer = ChartCore.GetChartLayer() as HistogramLayer;
				HistogramChartAppearance histogramChartAppearance = (HistogramChartAppearance)histogramLayer.GetAppearance();
				if (histogramLayer == null)
				{
					break;
				}

				IChartData histogramData = histogramLayer.HistogramData;
				if (histogramData != null)

					}
					else

						double tickmarkInterval = (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX) as AxisAppearance).TickmarkInterval;
						if (tickmarkInterval != 0.0 && (dataMax - dataMin) % tickmarkInterval != 0.0)
						{
							num = Math.Floor((dataMax - dataMin) / tickmarkInterval) * tickmarkInterval + dataMin + tickmarkInterval - dataMax;
						}
						SetAxisMinAndMax(x_axis, dataMin, dataMax + num);
					}
					if (y_axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic && histogramData is ChartDataAdapter chartDataAdapter2)
					{
						chartDataAdapter2.SetZeroAlignment(zero: false);
					}
					SetAxisMinAndMax(y_axis, histogramData.GetDataMin(), histogramData.GetDataMax());
				}

				if (lineData != null)
				{
					x2_axis.SetData(lineData);
					y2_axis.SetData(lineData);
					SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, dataMin, dataMax);

					{
						dateTime = (DateTime)seriesCollection.GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType.Time);
						dateTime2 = (DateTime)seriesCollection.GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType.Time);

							if (dateTime3 != DateTime.MinValue)

								if (dateTime.CompareTo(dateTime3) >= 0)
								{
									dateTime = dateTime3;
								}
								if (dateTime2.CompareTo(dateTime3) <= 0)
								{
									dateTime2 = dateTime3;
								}

						SetAxisMinAndMax(x2_axis, dateTime, dateTime2);

						SetAxisMinAndMax(y2_axis, dataMin2, dataMax2);

					SetAxisMinAndMaxWithConsiderationForRangeType(y2_axis, dataMin, dataMax, axisAppearance4);
				}
				break;

				break;

					maximum2 = (axis29.WindowMaximum = maximum2);
					maximum2 = (axis28.Maximum = maximum2);
					axis27.WindowMaximum = maximum2;
					break;
				}
				TimeAxis obj26 = (TimeAxis)x_axis;
				int num2 = (((TimeAxis)x2_axis).DateColumn = 0);
				num2 = (obj26.DateColumn = num2);
				int num5 = num2;
				DateTime dateTime4 = DateTime.MaxValue;
				DateTime dateTime5 = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (data is IChartDataFilter)
				{
					((IChartDataFilter)data).IncludeColumn(num5, include: true);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < data.GetRowCount(); j++)
				{
					object objectValue = data.GetObjectValue(j, num5);
					if (objectValue == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					DateTime dateTime6;
					if (objectValue is DateTime)
					{
						dateTime6 = (DateTime)objectValue;
					}
					else
					{
						try
						{
							dateTime6 = DateTime.Parse(objectValue.ToString());
						}
						catch (FormatException)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (dateTime6.CompareTo(dateTime4) <= 0)
					{
						dateTime4 = dateTime6;
					}
					if (dateTime6.CompareTo(dateTime5) >= 0)
					{
						dateTime5 = dateTime6;
					}
				}
				if (dateTime4 == DateTime.MaxValue || dateTime5 == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				Axis axis30 = x_axis;
				maximum2 = (x_axis.Minimum = dateTime4);
				axis30.WindowMinimum = maximum2;
				Axis axis31 = x_axis;
				maximum2 = (x_axis.Maximum = dateTime5);
				axis31.WindowMaximum = maximum2;
				Axis axis32 = x2_axis;
				maximum2 = (x2_axis.Minimum = dateTime4);
				axis32.WindowMinimum = maximum2;
				Axis axis33 = x2_axis;
				maximum2 = (x2_axis.Maximum = dateTime5);
				axis33.WindowMaximum = maximum2;
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
			{
				GanttDataSource ganttData = ((GanttLayer)ChartCore.GetChartLayer()).GanttData;
				if (axisAppearance.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					x_axis.Minimum = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance.RangeMin);
					x_axis.Maximum = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance.RangeMax);
				}
				else
				{
					x_axis.Minimum = ganttData.Series.MinDateTime;
					x_axis.Maximum = ganttData.Series.MaxDateTime;
				}
				if (axisAppearance2.RangeType == AxisRangeType.Custom)
				{
					x2_axis.Minimum = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance2.RangeMin);
					x2_axis.Maximum = new DateTime((long)axisAppearance2.RangeMax);
				}
				else
				{
					x2_axis.Minimum = ganttData.Series.MinDateTime;
					x2_axis.Maximum = ganttData.Series.MaxDateTime;
				}
				GroupedLabelAxis obj33 = (GroupedLabelAxis)y2_axis;
				IProvideGroupedLabels groupedLabelProvider = (((GroupedLabelAxis)y_axis).GroupedLabelProvider = ganttData.Series);
				obj33.GroupedLabelProvider = groupedLabelProvider;
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.ColumnChart:
				if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Column) is ColumnChartAppearance columnChartAppearance2)
				{
					x_axis.Minimum = x_axis.Zero;
					int rowCount3 = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetRowCount();
					int columnCount4 = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount();
					x_axis.Maximum = rowCount3 * columnCount4 + (rowCount3 - 1) * columnChartAppearance2.SeriesSpacing + (columnCount4 - 1) * columnChartAppearance2.ColumnSpacing * rowCount3;
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.BarChart:
				if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Bar) is BarChartAppearance barChartAppearance2)
				{
					y_axis.Minimum = y_axis.Zero;
					int rowCount2 = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetRowCount();
					int columnCount3 = ChartCore.GetChartLayer().ChartData.GetColumnCount();
					y_axis.Maximum = rowCount2 * columnCount3 + (rowCount2 - 1) * barChartAppearance2.SeriesSpacing + (columnCount3 - 1) * barChartAppearance2.BarSpacing * rowCount2;
				}
				break;
			}
			axisAppearance.Margin.FixMargin(x_axis);
			axisAppearance.SmartAxisTickmarks(x_axis);
			axisAppearance3.Margin.FixMargin(y_axis);
			axisAppearance3.SmartAxisTickmarks(y_axis);
			axisAppearance2.Margin.FixMargin(x2_axis);
			axisAppearance2.SmartAxisTickmarks(x2_axis);
			axisAppearance4.Margin.FixMargin(y2_axis);
			axisAppearance4.SmartAxisTickmarks(y2_axis);
			FixMinimumForLogAxis(x_axis, axisAppearance);
			FixMinimumForLogAxis(y_axis, axisAppearance3);
			FixMinimumForLogAxis(x2_axis, axisAppearance2);
			FixMinimumForLogAxis(y2_axis, axisAppearance4);
			if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Axis) is ChartGridAppearance { PE: not null } chartGridAppearance && chartGridAppearance.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				Box box = new Box(GetInnerBounds());
				box.PE = chartGridAppearance.PE;
				scene.Add(box);
			}
			if (includeYAxes)
			{
				y_axis.FillSceneGraph(scene);
				y2_axis.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			if (includeXAxes)
			{
				x_axis.FillSceneGraph(scene);
				x2_axis.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			}
			if (includeXAxes && scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene)
			{
				if (x_axis.delayAxisLineRender)
				{
					int y = Math.Min(GetInnerBounds().Bottom, (int)y_axis.Map(y_axis.Zero));
					int x = (int)x_axis.MapMinimum;
					int x2 = (int)x_axis.MapMaximum;
					x_axis.RenderAxisLine(scene, new Point(x, y), new Point(x2, y));
				}
				if (x2_axis.delayAxisLineRender)
				{
					int y2 = Math.Min(GetInnerBounds().Top, (int)y2_axis.Map(y2_axis.Zero));
					int x3 = (int)x2_axis.MapMinimum;
					int x4 = (int)x2_axis.MapMaximum;
					x2_axis.RenderAxisLine(scene, new Point(x3, y2), new Point(x4, y2));
				}
			}
			if (includeYAxes && scene != ChartCore.ScrollScene)
			{
				if (y_axis.delayAxisLineRender)
				{
					int x5 = Math.Max(GetInnerBounds().Left, (int)x_axis.Map(x_axis.Zero));
					int y3 = (int)y_axis.MapMinimum;
					int y4 = (int)y_axis.MapMaximum;
					y_axis.RenderAxisLine(scene, new Point(x5, y3), new Point(x5, y4));
				}
				if (y2_axis.delayAxisLineRender)
				{
					int x6 = Math.Max(GetInnerBounds().Right, (int)x2_axis.Map(x2_axis.Zero));
					int y5 = (int)y2_axis.MapMinimum;
					int y6 = (int)y2_axis.MapMaximum;
					y2_axis.RenderAxisLine(scene, new Point(x6, y5), new Point(x6, y6));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CalculateInnerBounds()
		{
			if (ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				innerBounds = OuterBound;
				return;
			}
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance2 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance3 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisX2);
			AxisAppearance axisAppearance4 = (AxisAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.AxisY2);
			innerBounds = new Rectangle(outerBounds.X, outerBounds.Y, outerBounds.Width, outerBounds.Height);
			innerBounds.X += (axisAppearance2.Visible ? axisAppearance2.Extent : 0);
			innerBounds.Width -= (axisAppearance4.Visible ? axisAppearance4.Extent : 0) + (axisAppearance2.Visible ? axisAppearance2.Extent : 0);
			innerBounds.Y += (axisAppearance3.Visible ? axisAppearance3.Extent : 0);
			innerBounds.Height -= (axisAppearance3.Visible ? axisAppearance3.Extent : 0) + (axisAppearance.Visible ? axisAppearance.Extent : 0);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (axisAppearance2.Visible || axisAppearance4.Visible)
			{
				num = (2 + (int)Math.Max(Platform.GetStringSizePixels("M", axisAppearance2.Labels.Font).Height, Platform.GetStringSizePixels("M", axisAppearance4.Labels.Font).Height)) / 2;
			}
			if (axisAppearance.Visible || axisAppearance3.Visible)
			{
				num2 = (2 + (int)Math.Max(Platform.GetStringSizePixels("M", axisAppearance.Labels.Font).Width, Platform.GetStringSizePixels("M", axisAppearance3.Labels.Font).Width)) / 2;
			}
			innerBounds.Inflate(-num2, -num);
		}

		public override void SetOptionalData(IChartData[] data)
		{
			base.SetOptionalData(data);
		}

		private void GetTimeMinAndMax(out DateTime timeMin, out DateTime timeMax)
		{
			GetTimeMinAndMax(data, out timeMin, out timeMax);
		}

		private void GetTimeMinAndMax(IChartData data, out DateTime timeMin, out DateTime timeMax)
		{
			timeMin = DateTime.MaxValue;
			timeMax = DateTime.MinValue;
			int columnCount = data.GetColumnCount();
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.DateTimeFromObject(data.GetColumnLabel(i));
				if (dateTime != DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					if (timeMin.CompareTo(dateTime) >= 0)
					{
						timeMin = dateTime;
					}
					if (timeMax.CompareTo(dateTime) <= 0)
					{
						timeMax = dateTime;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetMinMaxIntoMultipleTypeChart()
		{
			if (optionalDataArray == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (optionalDataArray[0] != null)
			{
				ChartType chartType = base.chartType;
				if (chartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart)
				{
					ScatterChartAppearance scatter = ((ScatterLineAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).Scatter;
					int column = scatter.ColumnX;
					int column2 = scatter.ColumnY;
					if (optionalDataArray[0] is IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter)
					{
						column = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(column);
						column2 = chartDataFilter.GetFilteredColumnNumber(column2);
					}
					x_axis.Minimum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMinColumn(column);
					x_axis.Maximum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMaxColumn(column);
					y_axis.Minimum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMinColumn(column2);
					y_axis.Maximum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMaxColumn(column2);
				}
				else
				{
					x_axis.Minimum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMin();
					x_axis.Maximum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMax();
					y_axis.Minimum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMin();
					y_axis.Maximum = optionalDataArray[0].GetDataMax();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetAxisMinAndMax(x_axis, data.GetDataMin(), data.GetDataMax());
				SetAxisMinAndMax(y_axis, data.GetDataMin(), data.GetDataMax());
			}
			bool flag = (base.chartType == ChartType.ColumnLineChart && !((ColumnLineChartAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine)).Line.TreatDateTimeAsString) || (base.chartType == ChartType.ScatterLineChart && !((ScatterLineAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine)).Line.TreatDateTimeAsString);
			if (optionalDataArray[1] != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					GetTimeMinAndMax(optionalDataArray[1], out var timeMin, out var timeMax);
					x2_axis.Minimum = timeMin;
					x2_axis.Maximum = timeMax;
				}
				else
				{
					x2_axis.Minimum = x2_axis.Zero;
					x2_axis.Maximum = Math.Max(optionalDataArray[1].GetColumnCount() - 1, 1);
				}
				y2_axis.Minimum = optionalDataArray[1].GetDataMin();
				y2_axis.Maximum = optionalDataArray[1].GetDataMax();
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					GetTimeMinAndMax(out var timeMin2, out var timeMax2);
					x2_axis.Minimum = timeMin2;
					x2_axis.Maximum = timeMax2;
				}
				else
				{
					x2_axis.Minimum = x2_axis.Zero;
					x2_axis.Maximum = Math.Max(data.GetColumnCount() - 1, 1);
				}
				y2_axis.Minimum = data.GetDataMin();
				y2_axis.Maximum = data.GetDataMax();
			}
		}

		private void SetDataIntoColumnLineChart()
		{
			if (optionalDataArray != null)
			{
				if (optionalDataArray[0] != null)
				{
					x_axis.SetData(optionalDataArray[0]);
					y_axis.SetData(optionalDataArray[0]);
				}
				else
				{
					x_axis.SetData(data);
					y_axis.SetData(data);
				}
				if (optionalDataArray[1] != null)
				{
					x2_axis.SetData(optionalDataArray[1]);
					y2_axis.SetData(optionalDataArray[1]);
				}
				else
				{
					x2_axis.SetData(data);
					y2_axis.SetData(data);
				}
				ColumnLineChartAppearance columnLineChartAppearance = (ColumnLineChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine);
				DataAppearance dataAppearance = (DataAppearance)ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data);
				DataAppearance dataApp = ((columnLineChartAppearance.ColumnData.DataSource != null || (columnLineChartAppearance.ColumnData.excludedColumns != null && columnLineChartAppearance.ColumnData.excludedColumns.Count != 0)) ? columnLineChartAppearance.ColumnData : dataAppearance);
				DataAppearance dataApp2 = ((columnLineChartAppearance.LineData.DataSource != null || (columnLineChartAppearance.LineData.excludedColumns != null && columnLineChartAppearance.LineData.excludedColumns.Count != 0)) ? columnLineChartAppearance.LineData : dataAppearance);
				x_axis.SetupDataFilter(dataApp);
				x2_axis.SetupDataFilter(dataApp2);
			}
		}

		private void SetDataIntoScatterLineChart()
		{
			SetDataIntoColumnLineChart();
		}

		private void InitializeAxesForCurrentChartType()
		{
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
				if (data is SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (ISeries item in seriesCollection)
					{
						if (!(item is XYSeries))
						{
							if (item is NumericTimeSeries)
							{
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (!(base.Grid["X"] is TimeAxis))
						{
							Hashtable hashtable9 = base.Grid;
							Axis value9 = (base.X = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X_Axis));
							hashtable9["X"] = value9;
							base.X.addStyle(8192);
							base.X.addStyle(32768);
						}
						if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is TimeAxis))
						{
							Hashtable hashtable10 = base.Grid;
							Axis value10 = (base.X2 = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis));
							hashtable10["X2"] = value10;
							base.X2.addStyle(8192);
							base.X2.addStyle(32768);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!(base.Grid["X"] is NumericAxis))
				{
					Hashtable hashtable11 = base.Grid;
					Axis value11 = (base.X = new NumericAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData));
					hashtable11["X"] = value11;
					base.X.addStyle(8192);
					base.X.addStyle(32768);
				}
				if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is NumericAxis))
				{
					Hashtable hashtable12 = base.Grid;
					Axis value12 = (base.X2 = new NumericAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData));
					hashtable12["X2"] = value12;
					base.X2.addStyle(8192);
					base.X2.addStyle(32768);
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ScatterLine) is ScatterLineAppearance { Line: not null } scatterLineAppearance && !scatterLineAppearance.Line.TreatDateTimeAsString)
				{
					if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is TimeAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable13 = base.Grid;
						Axis value13 = (base.X2 = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis));
						hashtable13["X2"] = value13;
						base.X2.addStyle(8192);
						base.X2.addStyle(32768);
					}
				}
				else if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is SetLabelAxis))
				{
					Hashtable hashtable14 = base.Grid;
					Axis value14 = (base.X2 = new SetLabelAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData));
					hashtable14["X2"] = value14;
					base.X2.addStyle(8192);
					base.X2.addStyle(32768);
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
				if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.ColumnLine) is ColumnLineChartAppearance { Line: not null } columnLineChartAppearance && !columnLineChartAppearance.Line.TreatDateTimeAsString)
				{
					if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is TimeAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable7 = base.Grid;
						Axis value7 = (base.X2 = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis));
						hashtable7["X2"] = value7;
						base.X2.addStyle(8192);
						base.X2.addStyle(32768);
					}
				}
				else if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is SetLabelAxis))
				{
					Hashtable hashtable8 = base.Grid;
					Axis value8 = (base.X2 = new SetLabelAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData));
					hashtable8["X2"] = value8;
					base.X2.addStyle(8192);
					base.X2.addStyle(32768);
				}
				break;
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			{
				LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance = null;
				AreaChartAppearance areaChartAppearance = null;
				if (chartType == ChartType.SplineChart || chartType == ChartType.StackSplineChart)
				{
					lineChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Spline) as LineChartAppearance;
				}
				else if (chartType == ChartType.LineChart || chartType == ChartType.StackLineChart)
				{
					lineChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Line) as LineChartAppearance;
				}
				else if (chartType == ChartType.SplineAreaChart || chartType == ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart)
				{
					areaChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.SplineArea) as AreaChartAppearance;
				}
				else if (chartType == ChartType.AreaChart || chartType == ChartType.StackAreaChart)
				{
					areaChartAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Area) as AreaChartAppearance;
				}
				if ((lineChartAppearance != null && !lineChartAppearance.TreatDateTimeAsString) || (areaChartAppearance != null && !areaChartAppearance.TreatDateTimeAsString))
				{
					if (!(base.Grid["X"] is TimeAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable3 = base.Grid;
						Axis value3 = (base.X = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X_Axis));
						hashtable3["X"] = value3;
						base.X.addStyle(8192);
						base.X.addStyle(32768);
					}
					if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is TimeAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable4 = base.Grid;
						Axis value4 = (base.X2 = new TimeAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis));
						hashtable4["X2"] = value4;
						base.X2.addStyle(8192);
						base.X2.addStyle(32768);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(base.Grid["X"] is SetLabelAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable5 = base.Grid;
						Axis value5 = (base.X = new SetLabelAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData));
						hashtable5["X"] = value5;
						base.X.addStyle(8192);
						base.X.addStyle(32768);
					}
					if (!(base.Grid["X2"] is SetLabelAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable6 = base.Grid;
						Axis value6 = (base.X2 = new SetLabelAxis(ChartComponent, ChartCore, AxisNumber.X2_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData));
						hashtable6["X2"] = value6;
						base.X2.addStyle(8192);
						base.X2.addStyle(32768);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.HistogramChart:
				if (ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Histogram) is HistogramChartAppearance histogramChartAppearance && !histogramChartAppearance.ColumnAppearance.StringAxis)
				{
					if (!(base.Grid["X"] is NumericAxis))
					{
						Hashtable hashtable = base.Grid;
						Axis value = (base.X = new NumericAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, LinearAxisType.NumericData));
						hashtable["X"] = value;
						base.X.addStyle(8192);
						base.X.addStyle(32768);
					}
				}
				else if (!(base.Grid["X"] is SetLabelAxis))
				{
					Hashtable hashtable2 = base.Grid;
					Axis value2 = (base.X = new SetLabelAxis(component, Core, AxisNumber.X_Axis, SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries));
					hashtable2["X"] = value2;
					base.X.addStyle(8192);
					base.X.addStyle(32768);
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
}

{
	public class Primitive
	{
		private bool _empty;

		private IDataPoint _DataPoint;

		private ISeries _Series;

		private bool _Visible = true;

		private ChartType chartType;

		private static PaintElement defaultPE = new PaintElement();

		private ILayer _Layer;

		private PaintElement _PE;

		private SkinElement _SE;

		private string _Path;

		private int row = -1;

		private int column = -1;

		private object _Value;

		public double AccumulatedElementsValue;

		private PCaps caps;

		private Hashtable _tags;

		public bool Empty
		{
			get
			{
				return _empty;
			}
			set
			{
				_empty = value;
			}
		}

		public IDataPoint DataPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _DataPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_DataPoint = value;
			}
		}

		public ISeries Series
		{
			get
			{
				return _Series;
			}
			set
			{
				_Series = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return _Visible;
			}
			set

				_Visible = value;
			}
		}

				return _Layer;

			set
			{

		}

		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _PE;
			}
			set
			{

		[Obsolete("drawColor is obsolete.  Please use PE.Stroke instead.")]
		public Color drawColor

			{
				return Color.FromArgb(PE.StrokeOpacity, PE.Stroke.R, PE.Stroke.G, PE.Stroke.B);

		internal Color GetBaseColor()
		{
			if (PE != null && PE.Fill != Color.Transparent)
			{
				return PE.Fill;
			}
			return Color.Transparent;

			: this(-1, -1, null)
		{
		}

		public Primitive(int row, int column, ILayer layerRef)
		{
			this.row = row;
			this.column = column;
			_Layer = layerRef;
			PE = new PaintElement();
			PE.Stroke = Color.Black;
			PE.StrokeOpacity = byte.MaxValue;
		}

		public virtual IList GetPrimitives()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(Point point)
		{
			if (Layer != null && Layer.ChartComponent != null && Layer.ChartCore != null && Layer.ChartCore.ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				CompositeChartAppearance compositeChartAppearance = Layer.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite) as CompositeChartAppearance;
				foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)compositeChartAppearance.ChartLayers)
				{
					if (Layer == item.ChartLayer && item.ChartArea != null)
					{
						return item.ChartArea.InnerBounds.IntersectsWith(new Rectangle(point.X, point.Y, 1, 1));
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void SetHighlightProperties()
		{
		}

		protected static bool InsideRectangle(Rectangle rect, Point point)
		{
			if (point.X > rect.Left && point.Y >= rect.Top && point.X <= rect.Right && point.Y <= rect.Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class Box : PrimitiveShape
	{
		public Rectangle rect;

		private int mRoundness;

		public int Roundness
		{
			get
			{
				return mRoundness;
			}
			set
			{
				mRoundness = value;
			}
		}

		public int RotationAngle { get; set; }

		public Box(Point topLeft, int width, int height)
		{
			rect = new Rectangle(topLeft.X, topLeft.Y, width, height);
		}

		public Box(Point topLeft, int width, int height, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			rect = new Rectangle(topLeft.X, topLeft.Y, width, height);
		}

		public Box(Rectangle rect)
		{
			this.rect = rect;
		}

		public Box(Rectangle rect, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			this.rect = rect;
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			if ((base.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None && Primitive.InsideRectangle(rect, point))
			{
				return IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			int frameWidth = GetFrameWidth();
			Box box = new Box(Rectangle.Inflate(rect, -frameWidth, -frameWidth));
			Math.Min(box.rect.Width, 0);
			Math.Max(box.rect.Height, 0);
			box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
			box.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			box.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
			box.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			box.Path = base.Path;
			box.PE.StrokeWidth = frameWidth;
			scene.Add(box);
		}

		internal override void SetHighlightProperties()
		{
			int frameWidth = GetFrameWidth();
			base.PE.StrokeWidth = frameWidth;
			base.PE.StrokeAlignment = PenAlignment.Inset;
		}

		private int GetFrameWidth()
		{
			int num = Math.Min(rect.Width, rect.Height);
			if (num <= 2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (num <= 4)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 2;
		}

		internal Point[] GetHull()
		{
			return new Point[4]
			{
				rect.Location,
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top),
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom),
				new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom)
			};
		}
	}

	public class DataPoint : Primitive, ICloneable
	{
		public Point point;

		private Polyline polyLineParent;

		public int hitTestRadius = 4;

		public Polyline PolylineParent
		{
			get
			{
				return polyLineParent;
			}
			set
			{
				polyLineParent = value;
			}
		}

		public DataPoint()
		{
			point = new Point(0, 0);
		}

		public DataPoint(Point p)
		{
			point = p;
		}

		public DataPoint(int x, int y)
		{
			point = new Point(x, y);
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			if ((base.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None)
			{
				if (Primitive.InsideRectangle(new Rectangle(this.point.X - hitTestRadius, this.point.Y - hitTestRadius, hitTestRadius + hitTestRadius, hitTestRadius + hitTestRadius), point))
				{
					return IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(point);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(point, 10);
			ellipse.PE.Fill = Color.Transparent;
			ellipse.PE.FillOpacity = 0;
			ellipse.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
			ellipse.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			ellipse.PE.StrokeWidth = 3;
			ellipse.Path = base.Path;
			scene.Add(ellipse);
			if (polyLineParent != null && polyLineParent.HighLightLine)
			{
				polyLineParent.Highlight(scene, outlineColor, fillColor);
			}
		}

		public DataPoint Clone()
		{
			DataPoint dataPoint = new DataPoint();
			dataPoint.AccumulatedElementsValue = AccumulatedElementsValue;
			dataPoint.point = point;
			dataPoint.Caps = base.Caps;
			dataPoint.Chart = Chart;
			dataPoint.Column = base.Column;
			dataPoint.Empty = base.Empty;
			dataPoint.Layer = base.Layer;
			dataPoint.Path = base.Path;
			dataPoint.PolylineParent = PolylineParent;
			dataPoint.PE = base.PE;
			dataPoint.Row = base.Row;
			dataPoint.Value = base.Value;
			dataPoint.Visible = base.Visible;
			dataPoint.DataPoint = base.DataPoint;
			dataPoint.Series = base.Series;
			return dataPoint;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}
	}
	public class Ellipse : PrimitiveShape
	{
		public Point p1;

		public Point p2;

		public int RotationAngle { get; set; }

		public Ellipse()
		{
			p1 = new Point(0, 0);
			p2 = new Point(0, 0);
		}

		public Ellipse(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			this.p1 = p1;
			this.p2 = p2;
		}

		public Ellipse(Point p1, Point p2, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			this.p1 = p1;
			this.p2 = p2;
		}

		public Ellipse(Point p1, int radius)
		{
			this.p1 = new Point(p1.X - radius, p1.Y - radius);
			p2 = new Point(radius * 2, radius * 2);
		}

		public Ellipse(Point p1, int radius, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			this.p1 = new Point(p1.X - radius, p1.Y - radius);
			p2 = new Point(radius * 2, radius * 2);
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddEllipse(p1.X, p1.Y, p2.X, p2.Y);
			return graphicsPath.IsVisible(point);
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(p1, p2);
			ellipse.PE.Fill = fillColor;
			ellipse.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			ellipse.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
			ellipse.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			ellipse.PE.StrokeWidth = 3;
			ellipse.Path = base.Path;
			scene.Add(ellipse);
		}

		public Point GetCenterPoint()
		{
			return new Point(p1.X + p2.X / 2, p1.Y + p2.Y / 2);
		}
	}

	public class Symbol : Primitive
	{
		public static readonly Color MaskColor = Color.Transparent;

		public Point point;

		public SymbolIcon icon;

		public SymbolIconSize iconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;

		public Color fillColor = Color.Red;

		public Symbol()
		{
		}

		public Symbol(Point centerPoint, SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize)
		{
			point = centerPoint;
			this.icon = icon;
			this.iconSize = iconSize;
		}

		public Symbol(SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize)
		{
			point = new Point(0, 0);
			this.icon = icon;
			this.iconSize = iconSize;
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			int num = PointSet.DetermineHitTestRadius(icon, iconSize, ' ', DefaultConstants.D_TextFont);
			if ((base.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None)
			{
				if (Primitive.InsideRectangle(new Rectangle(this.point.X - num, this.point.Y - num, num + num, num + num), point))
				{
					return IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(point);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PointSet : Symbol
	{
		public const int IconSizeAuto = -1;

		public DataPoint[] points;

		public Font font;

		public char character;

		public PointSet(DataPoint[] points, Font font, char character)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.font = font;
			this.character = character;
			ComputeHitTestRadius();
		}

		public PointSet(DataPoint[] points, SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize)
			: base(icon, iconSize)
		{
			this.points = points;
			ComputeHitTestRadius();
		}

		internal static int DetermineHitTestRadius(SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize, char character, Font font)
		{
			if (icon == SymbolIcon.Character)
			{
				SizeF sizeF = SizeF.Empty;
				if (character != 0)
				{
					sizeF = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(character.ToString(), font);
				}
				if (sizeF.Width > sizeF.Height)
				{
					return (int)(sizeF.Width / 2f);
				}
				return (int)(sizeF.Height / 2f);
			}
			return (int)iconSize / 2;
		}

		private void ComputeHitTestRadius()
		{
			int hitTestRadius = DetermineHitTestRadius(icon, iconSize, character, font);
			if (points == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (points[i] != null)
				{
					points[i].hitTestRadius = hitTestRadius;
				}
			}
		}

		public override IList GetPrimitives()
		{
			return points;
		}
	}
	public class Polygon : PrimitiveShape
	{
		public DataPoint[] DataPoints;

		public Point[] Points;

		public float splineTension;

		public bool flatBottom;

		private bool _FlatSides;

		public bool FlatSides
		{
			get
			{
				return _FlatSides;
			}
			set
			{
				_FlatSides = value;
			}
		}

		public Polygon(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			DataPoints = points;
		}

		public Polygon(Point[] points)
		{
			Points = points;
		}

		public Polygon(DataPoint[] points, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			DataPoints = points;
		}

		public Polygon(Point[] points, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			Points = points;
		}

		public override IList GetPrimitives()
		{
			return DataPoints;
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			if ((base.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None && Points != null)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.FillMode = FillMode.Winding;
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(Points);
				if (graphicsPath.IsVisible(point))
				{
					return IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(point);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			Polygon polygon = new Polygon(DataPoints);
			polygon.Points = Points;
			polygon.PE.Fill = fillColor;
			polygon.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			polygon.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
			polygon.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			polygon.PE.StrokeWidth = 3;
			polygon.Path = base.Path;
			scene.Add(polygon);
		}
	}
	public class Polyline : PrimitiveShape
	{
		public float splineTension;

		public DataPoint[] points;

		private bool highLightLine;

		internal bool _ClosedCurve;

		public override ChartType Chart
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Chart;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Chart = value;
				if (points == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = points.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (points[i] != null)
					{
						points[i].Chart = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HighLightLine
		{
			get
			{
				return highLightLine;
			}
			set
			{
				highLightLine = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ClosedCurve
		{
			get
			{
				return _ClosedCurve;
			}
			set
			{
				_ClosedCurve = value;
			}
		}

		public Polyline(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			this.points = points;
			setPolyLineAsParent();
		}

		public Polyline(DataPoint[] points, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(style)
		{
			this.points = points;
			setPolyLineAsParent();
		}

		private void setPolyLineAsParent()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (points[i] != null)
				{
					points[i].PolylineParent = this;
				}
			}
		}

		public override IList GetPrimitives()
		{
			return points;
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			if (HighLightLine)
			{
				Polyline polyline = new Polyline(points);
				polyline.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
				polyline.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
				polyline.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				polyline.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
				polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = base.PE.StrokeWidth;
				polyline.highLightLine = true;
				scene.Add(polyline);
			}
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum PCaps
	{
		None = 0,
		HitTest = 1,
		Skin = 2,
		Tooltip = 4,
		NoFill = 8,
		SkinStrokeOnly = 0xA,
		InteractionPrimitive = 0x400
	}
	public class PrimitiveCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		public Primitive this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Primitive)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Add(Primitive p)
		{
			return base.List.Add(p);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, 0);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public virtual Array ToArray(Type type)
		{
			Array array = Array.CreateInstance(type, base.Count);
			CopyTo(array);
			return array;
		}

		public virtual Primitive[] ToArray()
		{
			Primitive[] array = new Primitive[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array);
			return array;
		}

		public int IndexOf(Primitive primitive)
		{
			return base.List.IndexOf(primitive);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Primitive primitive)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, primitive);
		}

		public void AddRange(Primitive[] p)
		{
			if (p == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("p");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < p.Length; i++)
			{
				if (p[i] != null)
				{
					Add(p[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Sort(IComparer comparer, bool ascending)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			arrayList.AddRange(ToArray(typeof(object)));
			arrayList.Sort(comparer);
			base.List.Clear();
			int num;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (ascending)
			{
				num = 0;
				num2 = arrayList.Count;
				num3 = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				num = arrayList.Count - 1;
				num2 = -1;
				num3 = -1;
			}
			for (int i = num; i != num2; i += num3)
			{
				base.List.Add(arrayList[i]);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(Primitive primitive)
		{
			base.List.Remove(primitive);
		}

		public void Reverse()
		{
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				primitiveCollection.Add(this[num]);
			}
			Clear();
			AddRange((Primitive[])primitiveCollection.ToArray(typeof(Primitive)));
		}
	}
	internal class PrimitiveComparer : IComparer
	{
		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			Primitive primitive = x as Primitive;
			Primitive primitive2 = y as Primitive;
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("PrimitiveComparer can only compare primitives.");
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			double result2 = 0.0;
			if (primitive.Value != null)
			{
				double.TryParse(primitive.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
			}
			if (primitive2.Value != null)
			{
				double.TryParse(primitive2.Value.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
			}
			if (result > result2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (result < result2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

			arrow = GetArrow(box3.rect, _Orientation ? 1 : 0);

		private Primitive GetArrow(Rectangle rect, int dir)
		{
			Primitive primitive = null;
			Point[] array = new Point[3];
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				array[i].X = (int)((float)rect.X + arrowMult[dir % 4 * 6 + 2 * i] * (float)rect.Width);
				array[i].Y = (int)((float)rect.Y + arrowMult[dir % 4 * 6 + 2 * i + 1] * (float)rect.Height);
			}
			return new Polygon(array);
		}

	public class Text : Primitive
	{

		public Text()
			: this(Rectangle.Empty, "", new LabelStyle())
		{
		}

		public Text(Point pos, string text, LabelStyle style)
			: this(new Rectangle(pos, Size.Empty), text, style)
		{
		}

		public Text(Rectangle bounds, string text, LabelStyle style)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = "";
			}
			textString = text;
			labelStyle = style;
		}

		public Text(Point pos, string text)
			: this(new Rectangle(pos, Size.Empty), text, new LabelStyle())
		{
		}

		public void SetTextString(string text)
		{
			textString = text;
		}

		public string GetTextString()
		{
			return textString;
		}

		public void SetLabelStyle(LabelStyle style)
		{
			labelStyle = style;
		}

		public LabelStyle GetLabelStyle()
		{
			if (labelStyle == null)
			{
				labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			}
			return labelStyle;
		}

		internal Rectangle GetActualBounds()
		{
			if (labelStyle == null)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(GetTextString(), labelStyle);
			if (bounds.Height == 0 && bounds.Width == 0)
			{
				int x;
				int y;
				switch (labelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					x = bounds.X - (int)labelSizePixels.Width / 2;
					y = labelStyle.HorizontalAlign switch
					{
						StringAlignment.Near => bounds.Y, 
						StringAlignment.Far => bounds.Y + (int)labelSizePixels.Height, 
						_ => bounds.Y - (int)labelSizePixels.Height / 2, 
					};
					break;
				default:
					y = labelStyle.VerticalAlign switch
					{
						StringAlignment.Near => bounds.Y, 
						StringAlignment.Far => bounds.Y - (int)labelSizePixels.Height, 
						_ => bounds.Y - (int)labelSizePixels.Height / 2, 
					};
					x = labelStyle.HorizontalAlign switch
					{
						StringAlignment.Near => bounds.X, 
						StringAlignment.Far => bounds.X - (int)labelSizePixels.Width, 
						_ => bounds.X - (int)labelSizePixels.Width / 2, 
					};
					break;
				}
				return new Rectangle(x, y, (int)Math.Ceiling(labelSizePixels.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(labelSizePixels.Height));
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		internal Rectangle GetStringBounds()
		{
			if (bounds.Height == 0 && bounds.Width == 0)
			{
				return GetActualBounds();
			}
			Size size = Size.Ceiling(Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(GetTextString(), labelStyle));
			int num = bounds.Height - size.Height;
			int num2 = bounds.Width - size.Width;
			switch (labelStyle.Orientation)
			{
			case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				return labelStyle.HorizontalAlign switch
				{
					StringAlignment.Near => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
					StringAlignment.Far => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
					_ => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num / 2, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
				};
			case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				return labelStyle.HorizontalAlign switch
				{
					StringAlignment.Far => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
					StringAlignment.Near => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
					_ => new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num / 2, bounds.Width, bounds.Height - num), 
				};
			case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
				switch (labelStyle.HorizontalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Far:
				{
					StringAlignment verticalAlign2 = labelStyle.VerticalAlign;
					if (verticalAlign2 == StringAlignment.Center)
					{
						return new Rectangle(bounds.Left + num2, bounds.Top + num / 2, bounds.Width - num2, size.Height);
					}
					return new Rectangle(bounds.Left + num2, bounds.Top, bounds.Width - num2, bounds.Height);
				}
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					return new Rectangle(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width - num2, size.Height);
				default:
				{
					StringAlignment verticalAlign = labelStyle.VerticalAlign;
					if (verticalAlign == StringAlignment.Center)
					{
						return new Rectangle(bounds.Left + num2 / 2, bounds.Top + num / 2, size.Width, size.Height);
					}
					return new Rectangle(bounds.Left + num2 / 2, bounds.Top, bounds.Width - num2, size.Height);
				}
				}
			default:
			{
				int value = (int)(Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(labelStyle.RotationAngle)) * (double)bounds.Width / 2.0);
				value = Math.Abs(value);
				Rectangle result = bounds;
				result.Inflate(0, value);
				return result;
			}
			}
		}

		internal bool TextFitsInsideBounds()
		{
			if (bounds.Height <= 0 || bounds.Width <= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(GetTextString(), labelStyle, labelStyle.Font, bounds);
			if (labelSizePixels.Height <= (float)bounds.Height)
			{
				return labelSizePixels.Width <= (float)bounds.Width;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void CopyStyleAndBoundsTo(Text copy)
		{
			copy.labelStyle = labelStyle;
			copy.bounds = bounds;
		}

		internal Text Clone()
		{
			Text text = new Text();
			text.AccumulatedElementsValue = AccumulatedElementsValue;
			text.bounds = bounds;
			text.Caps = base.Caps;
			text.Chart = Chart;
			text.Column = base.Column;
			text.DataPoint = base.DataPoint;
			text.Empty = base.Empty;
			text.labelStyle = labelStyle.Clone();
			text.Layer = base.Layer;
			text.Path = base.Path;
			text.PE = base.PE.Clone();
			text.Row = base.Row;
			text.SE = base.SE;
			text.Series = base.Series;
			text.Tags = base.Tags;
			text.Value = base.Value;
			text.Visible = base.Visible;
			text.SetTextString(GetTextString());
			return text;
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			return Geometry.PointInsideRectangle(point, GetStringBounds());
		}
	}
	public class Wedge : Arc
	{
		public object Percent;

		private int radiusInner;

		private static double AspectRatio = 1.3333333333333333;

		private static double Ninety = Math.PI / 2.0;

		private static double OneEighty = Math.PI;

		private static double TwoSeventy = 4.71238898038469;

		public int RadiusInner
		{
			get
			{
				return radiusInner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value >= 0 && value < Radius)
				{
					radiusInner = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_1028"), value, "RadiusInner", 0, Radius), "RadiusInner");
			}
		}

		public Wedge(Point location, int radius, float startAngle, float angleSweep)
			: base(location, radius, startAngle, angleSweep)
		{
		}

		public Wedge(Point location, int radius, float startAngle, float angleSweep, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle style)
			: base(location, radius, startAngle, angleSweep, style)
		{
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			bool flag = false;
			if (RadiusInner > 0)
			{
				float num = startAngle;
				float num2 = angleSweep;
				graphicsPath.AddArc(Center.X - Radius, Center.Y - Radius, 2 * Radius, 2 * Radius, num, num2);
				graphicsPath.AddArc(Center.X - RadiusInner, Center.Y - RadiusInner, 2 * RadiusInner, 2 * RadiusInner, num + num2, 0f - num2);
				graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
				flag = graphicsPath.IsVisible(point);
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath.AddPie(Center.X - Radius, Center.Y - Radius, Radius * 2, Radius * 2, startAngle, angleSweep);
				flag = graphicsPath.IsVisible(point);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return IsMyChartAreaVisibleAt(point);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Highlight(SceneGraph scene, Color outlineColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			Wedge wedge = new Wedge(Center, Radius, startAngle, angleSweep);
			wedge.RadiusInner = RadiusInner;
			wedge.PE.Fill = fillColor;
			wedge.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
			wedge.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
			wedge.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
			wedge.PE.StrokeWidth = 1;
			wedge.Path = base.Path;
			scene.Add(wedge);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("Please use Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util.Geometry.DegreeToRadian instead.")]
		public static double DegToRadians(int degrees)
		{
			return Geometry.DegreeToRadian(degrees);
		}

		public Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			if (RadiusInner > 0)
			{
				float num = startAngle;
				float num2 = angleSweep;
				graphicsPath.AddArc(Center.X - Radius, Center.Y - Radius, 2 * Radius, 2 * Radius, num, num2);
				graphicsPath.AddArc(Center.X - RadiusInner, Center.Y - RadiusInner, 2 * RadiusInner, 2 * RadiusInner, num + num2, 0f - num2);
				graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath.AddPie(Center.X - Radius, Center.Y - Radius, Radius * 2, Radius * 2, startAngle, angleSweep);
			}
			RectangleF bounds = graphicsPath.GetBounds();
			return new Rectangle((int)Math.Floor(bounds.Left), (int)Math.Floor(bounds.Top), (int)Math.Ceiling(bounds.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(bounds.Height));
		}

		private Rectangle GetBounds_bak()
		{
			Rectangle[] array = new Rectangle[4];
			int num = 0;
			int radius = Radius;
			int num2 = (int)startAngle;
			int num3 = num2 + (int)Math.Round(angleSweep);
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = 90;
			if (num2 < num5)
			{
				double d = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num2);
				double a = ((num3 <= num5) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num3) : Ninety);
				int height = (int)(((double)radius * Math.Sin(a) + 1.0) * AspectRatio);
				int width = (int)((double)radius * Math.Cos(d) + 1.0);
				ref Rectangle reference = ref array[num];
				reference = new Rectangle(radius, radius, width, height);
				num++;
			}
			num4 = num5;
			num5 += 90;
			if (num2 < num5 && num3 > num4)
			{
				double d = ((num2 >= num4) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num2) : Ninety);
				double a = ((num3 <= num5) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num3) : OneEighty);
				int height = (int)(((double)radius * Math.Sin(d) + 1.0) * AspectRatio);
				int width = (int)((double)radius * (0.0 - Math.Cos(a)) + 1.0);
				ref Rectangle reference2 = ref array[num];
				reference2 = new Rectangle(radius - width, radius, width, height);
				num++;
			}
			num4 = num5;
			num5 += 90;
			if (num2 < num5 && num3 > num4)
			{
				double d = ((num2 >= num4) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num2) : OneEighty);
				double a = ((num3 <= num5) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num3) : TwoSeventy);
				int height = (int)(((double)radius * (0.0 - Math.Sin(a)) + 1.0) * AspectRatio);
				int width = (int)((double)radius * (0.0 - Math.Cos(d)) + 1.0);
				ref Rectangle reference3 = ref array[num];
				reference3 = new Rectangle(radius - width, radius - height, width, height);
				num++;
			}
			num4 = num5;
			num5 += 90;
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				double d = ((num2 >= num4) ? Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num2) : TwoSeventy);
				double a = Geometry.DegreeToRadian(num3);
				int height = (int)(((double)radius * (0.0 - Math.Sin(d)) + 1.0) * AspectRatio);
				int width = (int)((double)radius * Math.Cos(a) + 1.0);
				ref Rectangle reference4 = ref array[num];
				reference4 = new Rectangle(radius, radius - height, width, height);
				num++;
			}
			Rectangle result = array[--num];
			while (--num >= 0)
			{
				result = Rectangle.FromLTRB(Math.Min(array[num].Left, result.Left), Math.Min(array[num].Top, result.Top), Math.Max(array[num].Right, result.Right), Math.Max(array[num].Bottom, result.Bottom));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal Point[] GetHull()
		{
			int x = (int)((double)RadiusInner * Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle)));
			int y = (int)((double)RadiusInner * Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle)));
			int x2 = (int)((double)Radius * Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle)));
			int y2 = (int)((double)Radius * Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle)));
			int x3 = (int)((double)Radius * Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle + angleSweep)));
			int y3 = (int)((double)Radius * Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle + angleSweep)));
			int x4 = (int)((double)RadiusInner * Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle + angleSweep)));
			int y4 = (int)((double)RadiusInner * Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(startAngle + angleSweep)));
			Point point = new Point(x, y);
			Point point2 = new Point(x2, y2);
			Point point3 = new Point(x3, y3);
			Point point4 = new Point(x4, y4);
			point.Offset(Center.X, Center.Y);
			point2.Offset(Center.X, Center.Y);
			point3.Offset(Center.X, Center.Y);
			point4.Offset(Center.X, Center.Y);
			if (RadiusInner > 0)
			{
				return new Point[4] { point, point2, point3, point4 };
			}
			return new Point[3] { Center, point2, point3 };
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Core

	public class SceneGraph : CollectionBase, IDisposable, IProvidePrimitives
	{
		public Primitive this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Primitive)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		public int Add(Primitive value)
		{
			return base.List.Add(value);
		}

		public void AddRange(Primitive[] values)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (values[i] != null)
				{
					base.List.Add(values[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(Primitive value)
		{
			return base.List.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Primitive value)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, value);
		}

		public void Remove(Primitive value)
		{
			base.List.Remove(value);
		}

		public bool Contains(Primitive value)
		{
			return base.List.Contains(value);
		}

		public virtual void InsertBefore(Primitive[] primitivesToInsert, Primitive beforePrimitive)
		{
			foreach (Primitive primitiveToInsert in primitivesToInsert)
			{
				InsertBefore(primitiveToInsert, beforePrimitive);
			}
		}

		public virtual void InsertBefore(Primitive primitiveToInsert, Primitive beforePrimitive)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(beforePrimitive);
			Insert(index, primitiveToInsert);
		}

		public Primitive GetPrimitiveFromRowColumn(int row, int column)
		{
			return RecursePrimitivesRowColumn(this, row, column);
		}

		public Primitive GetPrimitiveFromRowColumn(int row, int column, Type primitiveType)
		{
			if (row < 0 || column < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_1029"), (row < 0) ? row : column, (row < 0) ? "row" : "column"));
			}
			Primitive primitive = RecursePrimitivesRowColumn(this, row, column);
			if (primitive != null && primitiveType != null)
			{
				if (primitiveType.IsAssignableFrom(primitive.GetType()))
				{
					return primitive;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return primitive;
		}

		private Primitive RecursePrimitivesRowColumn(IList primitives, int row, int column)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(primitives[i] is Primitive primitive))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (primitive.GetPrimitives() != null)
				{
					Primitive primitive2 = RecursePrimitivesRowColumn(primitive.GetPrimitives(), row, column);
					if (primitive2 != null)
					{
						return primitive2;
					}
				}
				if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None && primitive.Row == row && primitive.Column == column)
				{
					return primitive;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Primitive GetPrimitiveFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			return RecursePrimitivesHitTest(this, point);
		}

		private Primitive RecursePrimitivesHitTest(IList primitives, Point point)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < primitives.Count; i++)
			{
				if (primitives[i] != null && ((Primitive)primitives[i]).Caps > (PCaps)1023)
				{
					Primitive primitive = (Primitive)primitives[i];
					if (primitive.HitTest(point))
					{
						return (Primitive)primitives[i];
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num = primitives.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (primitives[num] != null)
				{
					if (((Primitive)primitives[num]).GetPrimitives() != null)
					{
						Primitive primitive2 = RecursePrimitivesHitTest(((Primitive)primitives[num]).GetPrimitives(), point);
						if (primitive2 != null)
						{
							return primitive2;
						}
					}
					if (((Primitive)primitives[num]).HitTest(point) && (((Primitive)primitives[num]).Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None)
					{
						return (Primitive)primitives[num];
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, 0);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public Array ToArray(Type type)
		{
			Array array = Array.CreateInstance(type, base.Count);
			CopyTo(array);
			return array;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Util
