	internal static class Clipper
	{
		private abstract class EdgeClipper : IList<PointF>, ICollection<PointF>, IEnumerable<PointF>, IEnumerable
		{
			public class Generic : EdgeClipper
			{
				public PointF B;

				public PointF E;

				protected override bool IsInside(PointF pt)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}

				protected override PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}
			}

			public class Left : EdgeClipper
			{
				public float Edge;

				protected override bool IsInside(PointF pt)
				{
					return pt.X >= Edge;
				}

				protected override PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e)
				{
					float num = (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X);
					_ = b.X;
					_ = e.X;
					_ = b.X;
					_ = b.Y;
					_ = e.Y;
					_ = b.Y;
					return new PointF(Edge, b.Y + (e.Y - b.Y) * (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X));
				}
			}

			public class Bottom : EdgeClipper
			{
				public float Edge;

				protected override bool IsInside(PointF pt)
				{
					return pt.Y <= Edge;
				}

				protected override PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e)
				{
					float num = (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y);
					_ = b.X;
					_ = e.X;
					_ = b.X;
					_ = b.Y;
					_ = e.Y;
					_ = b.Y;
					return new PointF(b.X + (e.X - b.X) * (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y), Edge);
				}
			}

			public class Right : EdgeClipper
			{
				public float Edge;

				protected override bool IsInside(PointF pt)
				{
					return pt.X <= Edge;
				}

				protected override PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e)
				{
					float num = (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X);
					_ = b.X;
					_ = e.X;
					_ = b.X;
					_ = b.Y;
					_ = e.Y;
					_ = b.Y;
					return new PointF(Edge, b.Y + (e.Y - b.Y) * (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X));
				}
			}

			public class Top : EdgeClipper
			{
				public float Edge;

				protected override bool IsInside(PointF pt)
				{
					return pt.Y >= Edge;
				}

				protected override PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e)
				{
					float num = (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y);
					_ = b.X;
					_ = e.X;
					_ = b.X;
					_ = b.Y;
					_ = e.Y;
					_ = b.Y;
					return new PointF(b.X + (e.X - b.X) * (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y), Edge);
				}
			}

			public IList<PointF> dst;

			private bool init = true;

			private PointF First;

			private PointF Prev;

			private bool PrevInside;

			public bool IsClosed;

			private bool IsOutput;

			public IList<PointF> Dst
			{
				get
				{
					return dst;
				}
				set
				{
					if (dst != value)
					{
						init = true;
						dst = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool IsPolyline { get; set; }

			public bool IsReadOnly => false;

			public int Count => 0;

			public PointF this[int n]
			{
				get
				{
					return new PointF(0f, 0f);
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			public void Add(PointF cur)
			{
				if (IsPolyline && (float.IsNaN(cur.X) || float.IsNaN(cur.Y)))
				{
					init = true;
					IsOutput = false;
					Dst.Add(cur);
					return;
				}
				bool flag = IsInside(cur);
				if (init)
				{
					init = false;
					First = cur;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					if (!PrevInside)
					{
						if (IsPolyline)
						{
							Dst.Add(new PointF(float.NaN, float.NaN));
						}
						Dst.Add(Intersection(Prev, cur));
					}
					else if (!IsClosed && !IsOutput)
					{
						Dst.Add(Prev);
						IsOutput = true;
					}
					Dst.Add(cur);
				}
				else if (PrevInside)
				{
					if (!IsClosed && !IsOutput)
					{
						Dst.Add(Prev);
						IsOutput = true;
					}
					Dst.Add(Intersection(Prev, cur));
				}
				Prev = cur;
				PrevInside = flag;
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				if (IsClosed)
				{
					Add(First);
				}
				if (Dst is EdgeClipper)
				{
					(Dst as EdgeClipper).Clear();
				}
			}

			protected abstract bool IsInside(PointF pt);

			protected abstract PointF Intersection(PointF b, PointF e);

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public IEnumerator<PointF> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public bool Remove(PointF pt)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public void RemoveAt(int n)
			{
			}

			public void CopyTo(PointF[] pt, int n)
			{
			}

			public bool Contains(PointF pt)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public void Insert(int n, PointF pt)
			{
			}

			public int IndexOf(PointF pt)
			{
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBounds(IEnumerable<PointF> points)
		{
			float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
			float num2 = float.PositiveInfinity;
			float num3 = float.NegativeInfinity;
			float num4 = float.NegativeInfinity;
			foreach (PointF point in points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.Y);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			if (float.IsInfinity(num) || float.IsInfinity(num2) || float.IsInfinity(num2) || float.IsInfinity(num4))
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			return new RectangleF(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public static void ClipTo(IList<PointF> list, IList<PointF> points, bool isClosed, RectangleF rect, RectangleF window, bool isPolyline)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Count < 2 || window.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect = GetBounds(points);
			}
			if (!window.IntersectsWith(rect))
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<PointF> dst = list;
			EdgeClipper.Left left = new EdgeClipper.Left();
			left.IsPolyline = isPolyline;
			left.Edge = window.Left;
			left.Dst = dst;
			left.IsClosed = isClosed;
			dst = left;
			EdgeClipper.Bottom bottom = new EdgeClipper.Bottom();
			bottom.IsPolyline = isPolyline;
			bottom.Edge = window.Bottom;
			bottom.Dst = dst;
			bottom.IsClosed = isClosed;
			dst = bottom;
			EdgeClipper.Right right = new EdgeClipper.Right();
			right.IsPolyline = isPolyline;
			right.Edge = window.Right;
			right.Dst = dst;
			right.IsClosed = isClosed;
			dst = right;
			EdgeClipper.Top top = new EdgeClipper.Top();
			top.IsPolyline = isPolyline;
			top.Edge = window.Top;
			top.Dst = dst;
			top.IsClosed = isClosed;
			dst = top;
			foreach (PointF point in points)
			{
				dst.Add(point);
			}
			if (dst is EdgeClipper)
			{
				(dst as EdgeClipper).Clear();
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<PointF> ClipTo(IList<Point> points, bool isClosed, Rectangle rect, Rectangle window, bool isPolyline)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(new PointF(points[i].X, points[i].Y));
			}
			ClipTo(list, list2, isClosed, new RectangleF(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height), new RectangleF(window.X, window.Y, window.Width, window.Height), isPolyline);
			return list;
		}

		public static void ClipPolygon(IList<Point> list, IList<Point> points, bool isClosed, Rectangle rect, Rectangle window)
		{
			list.Clear();
			IEnumerable<PointF> enumerable = ClipTo(points, isClosed, rect, window, isPolyline: false);
			foreach (PointF item in enumerable)
			{
				list.Add(Point.Round(item));
			}
		}

		public static void ClipPolyline(IList<IList<Point>> list, IList<Point> points, bool isClosed, Rectangle rect, Rectangle window)
		{
			list.Clear();
			IEnumerable<PointF> enumerable = ClipTo(points, isClosed, rect, window, isPolyline: true);
			List<Point> list2 = new List<Point>();
			list.Add(list2);
			foreach (PointF item in enumerable)
			{
				if (float.IsNaN(item.X) || float.IsNaN(item.Y))
				{
					if (list2.Count > 0)
					{
						list2 = new List<Point>();
						list.Add(list2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(Point.Round(item));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class Geometry
	{
		private const double DegreeAsRadian = Math.PI / 180.0;

		private const double RadianAsDegree = 180.0 / Math.PI;

		public static bool PointInsideRectangle(Point point, Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (point.X > rectangle.Left && point.Y > rectangle.Top && point.X < rectangle.Right)
			{
				return point.Y < rectangle.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Geometry()
		{
		}

		public static double Distance(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt((Math.Abs(p1.X - p2.X) ^ 2) + (Math.Abs(p1.Y - p2.Y) ^ 2));
		}

		public static double Distance(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(Math.Abs(p1.X - p2.X), 2.0) + Math.Pow(Math.Abs(p1.Y - p2.Y), 2.0));
		}

		public static RectangleF InnerBoundingBox(RectangleF sourceRect, float rotationAngle)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			PointF point = new PointF(sourceRect.Left + sourceRect.Width / 2f, sourceRect.Top + sourceRect.Height / 2f);
			matrix.RotateAt(rotationAngle, point);
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(sourceRect.Left, sourceRect.Top),
				new PointF(sourceRect.Right, sourceRect.Top),
				new PointF(sourceRect.Left, sourceRect.Bottom),
				new PointF(sourceRect.Right, sourceRect.Bottom)
			};
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			float num = Math.Min(array[0].X, Math.Min(array[1].X, Math.Min(array[2].X, array[3].X)));
			float num2 = Math.Min(array[0].Y, Math.Min(array[1].Y, Math.Min(array[2].Y, array[3].Y)));
			float num3 = sourceRect.Left - num;
			float num4 = sourceRect.Top - num2;
			float val = sourceRect.Width / (sourceRect.Width + 2f * num3);
			float val2 = sourceRect.Height / (sourceRect.Height + 2f * num4);
			val = Math.Min(val, val2);
			matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Translate(point.X, point.Y);
			matrix.Scale(val, val);
			matrix.Translate(0f - point.X, 0f - point.Y);
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.RotateAt(0f - rotationAngle, point);
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			RectangleF result = new RectangleF(array[0].X, array[0].Y, array[1].X - array[0].X, array[3].Y - array[1].Y);
			if (Math.Abs(rotationAngle) / 90f % 2f == 1f)
			{
				result.Inflate((sourceRect.Height - result.Width) / 2f, (sourceRect.Width - result.Height) / 2f);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static IList<Rectangle> OptimizeRectanglesHeightPositions(IList<Rectangle> items, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = -1;
			double num2 = items[0].Height;
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (!flag && items[i + 1].Y < items[i].Y + items[i].Height)
				{
					flag = true;
					num = i + 1;
				}
				num2 += (double)items[i + 1].Height;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (num2 > (double)bounds.Height)
				{
					int num3 = bounds.Height / items.Count;
					for (int j = 0; j < items.Count; j++)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = items[j];
						items[j] = new Rectangle(rectangle.X, j * num3 + bounds.Y, rectangle.Width, num3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int k = num; k < items.Count; k++)
					{
						if (items[k].Y < items[k - 1].Y + items[k - 1].Height)
						{
							Rectangle rectangle2 = items[k];
							items[k] = new Rectangle(rectangle2.X, items[k - 1].Height + items[k - 1].Y, rectangle2.Width, rectangle2.Height);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return items;
		}

		public static double[] OptimizedRectanglesVerticalPositions(IList<Rectangle> items, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			MathFunctions.Func<double[], double> function = (double[] pos) => OptimizeRectangleVerticalPosition(pos, items, bounds);
			double[] array = new double[items.Count];
			for (int num = 0; num < items.Count; num++)
			{
				array[num] = (double)items[num].Y + (double)items[num].Height / 2.0;
			}
			return MathFunctions.Minimize(function, array, 0.01);
		}

		private static double OptimizeRectangleVerticalPosition(double[] positions, IList<Rectangle> items, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < positions.Length; i++)
			{
				double num2 = positions[i] - 0.5 * (double)items[i].Height;
				double num3 = positions[i] + 0.5 * (double)items[i].Height;
				double x = Math.Max(0.0, (double)bounds.Top - num2) + Math.Max(0.0, num3 - (double)bounds.Bottom);
				num += Math.Pow(x, 3.0);
				double num4 = 0.0;
				for (int j = i + 1; j < positions.Length; j++)
				{
					double num5 = positions[j] - 0.5 * (double)items[j].Height;
					double num6 = positions[j] + 0.5 * (double)items[j].Height;
					double num7 = (double)items[i].Y + (double)items[i].Height / 2.0;
					double num8 = (double)items[j].Y + (double)items[j].Height / 2.0;
					num4 = ((!(num7 > num8)) ? (num4 + Math.Max(num3 - num5, 0.0)) : (num4 + Math.Max(num6 - num2, 0.0)));
				}
				num += Math.Pow(num4, 2.0);
				double num9 = (double)items[i].Y + (double)items[i].Height / 2.0;
				double num10 = 2.0 * Math.Abs(positions[i] - num9) / (double)(items[i].Bottom - items[i].Top);
				if (num10 > 1.0)
				{
					num10 = 1.0 + (num10 - 1.0) * (num10 - 1.0);
				}
				num += Math.Sqrt(num10);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool RectanglesCollide(float rotationAngle, RectangleF rectA, RectangleF rectB)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
			PointF point = new PointF(rectA.Left + rectA.Width / 2f, rectA.Top + rectA.Height / 2f);
			PointF point2 = new PointF(rectB.Left + rectB.Width / 2f, rectB.Top + rectB.Height / 2f);
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(rectA.Left, rectA.Top),
				new PointF(rectA.Right, rectA.Top),
				new PointF(rectA.Right, rectA.Bottom),
				new PointF(rectA.Left, rectA.Bottom)
			};
			PointF[] array2 = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(rectB.Left, rectB.Top),
				new PointF(rectB.Right, rectB.Top),
				new PointF(rectB.Right, rectB.Bottom),
				new PointF(rectB.Left, rectB.Bottom)
			};
			matrix.RotateAt(rotationAngle, point);
			matrix2.RotateAt(rotationAngle, point2);
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			matrix2.TransformPoints(array2);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddPolygon(array);
			graphicsPath2.AddPolygon(array2);
			using Region region = new Region(graphicsPath);
			region.Intersect(graphicsPath2);
			using Bitmap image = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			using Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(image);
			return !region.IsEmpty(g);
		}

		public static bool RectanglesCollide(float rotationAngle, RectangleF[] rects)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rects.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = i + 1; j < rects.Length; j++)
				{
					if (RectanglesCollide(rotationAngle, rects[i], rects[j]))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static RectangleF RectangleExclude(RectangleF sourceRect, RectangleF removeRect)
		{
			using Region region = new Region(sourceRect);
			region.Exclude(removeRect);
			using Bitmap image = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			using Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(image);
			return region.GetBounds(g);
		}

		public static PointF AngularToCartesian(PointF center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			float x = (float)((double)center.X + radius * Math.Cos(theta));
			float y = (float)((double)center.Y + radius * Math.Sin(theta));
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public static PointF AngularToCartesianReverse(PointF center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			float x = (float)((double)center.X + radius * Math.Sin(theta));
			float y = (float)((double)center.Y + radius * Math.Cos(theta));
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public static Point AngularToCartesian(Point center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			return Point.Round(AngularToCartesian(new PointF(center.X, center.Y), radius, theta));
		}

		public static Point AngularToCartesianReverse(Point center, double radius, double theta)
		{
			return Point.Round(AngularToCartesianReverse(new PointF(center.X, center.Y), radius, theta));
		}

		public static double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return degree * (Math.PI / 180.0);
		}

		public static double RadianToDegree(double theta)
		{
			double num;
			for (num = theta * (180.0 / Math.PI); num > 360.0; num -= 360.0)
			{
			}
			for (; num < 0.0; num += 360.0)
			{
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		public static string replaceKeywords(Hashtable environment, string str)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			string text = str;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			while (str != null && num < str.Length - 1 && num > -1)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				string text2 = "";
				string text3 = "";
				flag = false;
				num = str.IndexOf('<', num);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					num3 = str.IndexOf('>', num + 1);
					int num5 = str.IndexOf('<', num + 1);
					while (num5 > -1 && num5 < num3)
					{
						num = num5;
						num5 = str.IndexOf('<', num + 1);
						num3 = str.IndexOf('>', num + 1);
					}
					num2 = str.IndexOf(':', num + 1);
					if (num3 < num2)
					{
						num2 = -1;
					}
					if (num2 > -1)
					{
						text2 = str.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
						num = num2;
						stringBuilder.Append('<');
						stringBuilder.Append(text2);
						num2 = str.IndexOf('>', num + 1);
						if (num2 > -1)
						{
							text3 = str.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
							stringBuilder.Append(':');
							stringBuilder.Append(text3);
							stringBuilder.Append('>');
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							text3 = "";
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = str.IndexOf('>', num + 1);
						if (num2 > -1)
						{
							text2 = str.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
							stringBuilder.Append('<');
							stringBuilder.Append(text2);
							stringBuilder.Append('>');
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							text2 = "";
						}
					}
					num = num2;
				}
				if (!flag || text2.Length <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				text2 = text2.Trim();
				text3 = text3.Trim();
				object obj = environment[text2];
				environment["RENDER_KEYWORD"] = text2;
				environment["RENDER_FORMAT"] = text3;
				string text4 = text3.ToLower();
				if ((text4.IndexOf('d') > -1 || text4.IndexOf('x') > -1) && (obj is float || obj is double))
				{
					obj = int.Parse(obj.ToString().Split('.')[0]);
				}
				IRenderLabel renderLabel = obj as IRenderLabel;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string oldValue = stringBuilder.ToString();
				if (text3.Length > 0)
				{
					if (renderLabel != null)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, renderLabel.ToString(environment));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is string)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((string)obj).ToString());
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is int)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((int)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is float)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((float)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is double)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((double)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is DateTime)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((DateTime)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is TimeSpan)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((TimeSpan)obj/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is long)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((long)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is short)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((short)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
					else if (obj is decimal)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, ((decimal)obj).ToString(text3));
						num4++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (renderLabel != null)
					{
						text = text.Replace(oldValue, renderLabel.ToString(environment));
					}
					text = text.Replace(oldValue, obj.ToString());
					num4++;
				}
			}
			if (num4 < 1)
			{
				return str;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static string TrimDouble(double value, int targetWidth, Font font)
		{
			string text = value.ToString();
			if (Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, font).Width <= (float)targetWidth)
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (text.IndexOf('.') != -1)
			{
				string[] array = text.Split('.');
				if (array.Length != 2)
				{
					return text;
				}
				int length = array[1].Length;
				string text2 = "";
				for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
				{
					text2 += "#";
				}
				while (text2.Length > 0)
				{
					text = value.ToString("#." + text2);
					if (Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, font).Width <= (float)targetWidth)
					{
						return text;
					}
					text2 = text2.Remove(text2.Length - 1, 1);
				}
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

	internal static class MathFunctions
	{
		internal delegate TResult Func<T, TResult>(T arg1);

		private class Bracket
		{
			public double xa;

			public double xb;

			public double xc;

			public Bracket(Func<double, double> function, double a, double b)
			{
				double num = 100.0;
				double val = 1E-20;
				xa = a;
				double a2 = function(xa);
				xb = b;
				double a3 = function(xb);
				if (a3 > a2)
				{
					double num2 = xa;
					xa = xb;
					xb = num2;
					double num3 = a3;
					a3 = a2;
					a2 = num3;
				}
				xc = xb + PHI * (xb - xa);
				double b2 = function(xc);
				while (a3 > b2)
				{
					double num4 = (xb - xa) * (a3 - b2);
					double num5 = (xb - xc) * (a3 - a2);
					double c = xb - ((xb - xc) * num5 - (xb - xa) * num4) / (2.0 * CopySign(Math.Max(Math.Abs(num5 - num4), val), num5 - num4));
					double num6 = xb + num * (xc - xb);
					double num7;
					if ((xb - c) * (c - xc) > 0.0)
					{
						num7 = function(c);
						if (num7 < b2)
						{
							xa = xb;
							xb = c;
							break;
						}
						if (num7 > a3)
						{
							xc = c;
							break;
						}
						c = xc + PHI * (xc - xb);
						num7 = function(c);
					}
					else if ((xc - c) * (c - num6) > 0.0)
					{
						num7 = function(c);
						if (num7 < b2)
						{
							Shift(ref xb, ref xc, ref c, c + PHI * (c - xc));
							Shift(ref a3, ref b2, ref num7, function(c));
						}
					}
					else if ((c - num6) * (num6 - xc) >= 0.0)
					{
						c = num6;
						num7 = function(c);
					}
					else
					{
						c = xc + PHI * (xc - xb);
						num7 = function(c);
					}
					Shift(ref xa, ref xb, ref xc, c);
					Shift(ref a2, ref a3, ref b2, num7);
				}
			}

			private static void Shift(ref double a, ref double b, ref double c, double d)
			{
				a = b;
				b = c;
				c = d;
			}
		}

		private class Brent
		{
			private double xmin;

			private double fmin;

			public double XMin => xmin;

			public double FMin => fmin;

			public Brent(Func<double, double> function, double xa, double xb, double xc, double tolerance)
			{
				double num = ((xa < xc) ? xa : xc);
				double num2 = ((xa > xc) ? xa : xc);
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double a = xb;
				double a2 = function(a);
				double b = a;
				double b2 = a2;
				double c = a;
				double c2 = a2;
				for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++)
				{
					double num5 = 0.5 * (num + num2);
					double num6 = tolerance * Math.Abs(c) + 1E-05;
					double num7 = 2.0 * num6;
					if (Math.Abs(c - num5) <= num7 - 0.5 * (num2 - num))
					{
						xmin = c;
						fmin = c2;
						return;
					}
					double num12;
					if (Math.Abs(num4) > num6)
					{
						double num8 = (c - b) * (c2 - a2);
						double num9 = (c - a) * (c2 - b2);
						double num10 = (c - a) * num9 - (c - b) * num8;
						num9 = 2.0 * (num9 - num8);
						if (num9 > 0.0)
						{
							num10 = 0.0 - num10;
						}
						num9 = Math.Abs(num9);
						double num11 = num4;
						num4 = num3;
						if (Math.Abs(num10) >= Math.Abs(0.5 * num9 * num11) || num10 <= num9 * (num - c) || num10 >= num9 * (num2 - c))
						{
							num3 = 0.381966 * (num4 = ((c >= num5) ? (num - c) : (num2 - c)));
						}
						else
						{
							num3 = num10 / num9;
							num12 = c + num3;
							if (num12 - num < num7 || num2 - num12 < num7)
							{
								num3 = CopySign(num6, num5 - c);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num3 = 0.381966 * (num4 = ((c >= num5) ? (num - c) : (num2 - c)));
					}
					num12 = ((Math.Abs(num3) >= num6) ? (c + num3) : (c + CopySign(num6, num3)));
					double num13 = function(num12);
					if (num13 <= c2)
					{
						if (num12 >= c)
						{
							num = c;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = c;
						}
						Shift(ref a, ref b, ref c, num12);
						Shift(ref a2, ref b2, ref c2, num13);
						continue;
					}
					if (num12 < c)
					{
						num = num12;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = num12;
					}
					if (num13 <= b2 || b == c)
					{
						a = b;
						b = num12;
						a2 = b2;
						b2 = num13;
					}
					else if (num13 <= a2 || a == c || a == b)
					{
						a = num12;
						a2 = num13;
					}
				}
				xmin = double.NaN;
				fmin = double.NaN;
			}

			private static void Shift(ref double a, ref double b, ref double c, double d)
			{
				a = b;
				b = c;
				c = d;
			}
		}

		public static double PHI = 1.0 + Math.Sqrt(5.0) / 2.0;

		public static bool BetweenOrEqualTo(double limitA, double limitB, double value)
		{
			if (!(value >= limitA) || !(value <= limitB))
			{
				if (value <= limitA)
				{
					return value >= limitB;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool Between(double limitA, double limitB, double value)
		{
			if (!(value > limitA) || !(value < limitB))
			{
				if (value < limitA)
				{
					return value > limitB;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double CopySign(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Sign(b) < 0)
			{
				return 0.0 - Math.Abs(a);
			}
			return Math.Abs(a);
		}

		public static T GetBoundedValue<T>(T min, T max, T value) where T : IComparable<T>
		{
			if (value.CompareTo(min) < 0)
			{
				return min;
			}
			if (value.CompareTo(max) > 0)
			{
				return max;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static double[] Minimize(Func<double[], double> function, double[] pp, double tolerance)
		{
			int num = pp.Length;
			int num2 = 200;
			double num3 = 1E-25;
			double[,] array = new double[num, num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i, i] = 1.0;
			}
			double[] array2 = new double[num];
			double[] array3 = new double[num];
			double[] array4 = new double[num];
			double[] array5 = new double[num];
			double num4 = function(array2);
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				array2[j] = pp[j];
				array3[j] = array2[j];
			}
			int num5 = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				double num6 = num4;
				int num7 = 0;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				double num9;
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
					{
						array5[l] = array[l, k];
					}
					num9 = num4;
					num4 = Linmin(function, array2, array5);
					if (num9 - num4 > num8)
					{
						num8 = num9 - num4;
						num7 = k + 1;
					}
				}
				if (2.0 * (num6 - num4) <= tolerance * (Math.Abs(num6) + Math.Abs(num4)) + num3)
				{
					return array2;
				}
				if (num5 == num2)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < num; m++)
				{
					array4[m] = 2.0 * array2[m] - array3[m];
					array5[m] = array2[m] - array3[m];
					array3[m] = array2[m];
				}
				num9 = function(array4);
				if (num9 < num6)
				{
					double num10 = 2.0 * (num6 - 2.0 * num4 + num9) * Math.Pow(num6 - num4 - num8, 2.0) - num8 * Math.Pow(num6 - num9, 2.0);
					if (num10 < 0.0)
					{
						num4 = Linmin(function, array2, array5);
						for (int n = 0; n < num; n++)
						{
							array[n, num7 - 1] = array[n, num - 1];
							array[n, num - 1] = array5[n];
						}
					}
				}
				num5++;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double Linmin(Func<double[], double> func, double[] p, double[] xi)
		{
			int n = p.Length;
			double[] xt = new double[n];
			Func<double, double> function = delegate(double x)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
				{
					xt[i] = p[i] + x * xi[i];
				}
				return func(xt);
			};
			Bracket bracket = new Bracket(function, 0.0, 1.0);
			Brent brent = new Brent(function, bracket.xa, bracket.xb, bracket.xc, 0.003);
			for (int num = 0; num < n; num++)
			{
				xi[num] *= brent.XMin;
				p[num] += xi[num];
			}
			return brent.FMin;
		}
	}

			double num2 = Math.Sin(theta);
			float num3 = (float)((double)xx * num + (double)zx * num2);
			float num4 = (float)((double)xy * num + (double)zy * num2);
			float num5 = (float)((double)xz * num + (double)zz * num2);
			float num6 = (float)((double)xo * num + (double)zo * num2);
			float num7 = (float)((double)zx * num - (double)xx * num2);
			float num8 = (float)((double)zy * num - (double)xy * num2);
			float num9 = (float)((double)zz * num - (double)xz * num2);
			float num10 = (float)((double)zo * num - (double)xo * num2);
			xo = num6;
			xx = num3;
			xy = num4;
			xz = num5;
			zo = num10;

			zy = num8;

		public void mult(Matrix3D rhs)
		{
			float num = xx * rhs.xx + yx * rhs.xy + zx * rhs.xz;
			float num2 = xy * rhs.xx + yy * rhs.xy + zy * rhs.xz;
			float num3 = xz * rhs.xx + yz * rhs.xy + zz * rhs.xz;
			float num4 = xo * rhs.xx + yo * rhs.xy + zo * rhs.xz + rhs.xo;
			float num5 = xx * rhs.yx + yx * rhs.yy + zx * rhs.yz;
			float num6 = xy * rhs.yx + yy * rhs.yy + zy * rhs.yz;
			float num7 = xz * rhs.yx + yz * rhs.yy + zz * rhs.yz;
			float num8 = xo * rhs.yx + yo * rhs.yy + zo * rhs.yz + rhs.yo;
			float num9 = xx * rhs.zx + yx * rhs.zy + zx * rhs.zz;
			float num10 = xy * rhs.zx + yy * rhs.zy + zy * rhs.zz;
			float num11 = xz * rhs.zx + yz * rhs.zy + zz * rhs.zz;
			float num12 = xo * rhs.zx + yo * rhs.zy + zo * rhs.zz + rhs.zo;
			xx = num;
			xy = num2;
			xz = num3;
			xo = num4;
			yx = num5;
			yy = num6;
			yz = num7;
			yo = num8;

			zz = num11;

		public void transform(float[] v, int[] tv, int nvert)

	public class Platform
	{
		public static SizeF GetStringSizePixels(string str, Font font)
		{
			if (str == null || str.Length == 0 || font == null)
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			using Bitmap image = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
			return graphics.MeasureString(str, font);
		}

		public static SizeF GetStringSizePixels(string str, Font font, int width, StringFormat format)
		{
			if (str == null || str.Length == 0 || font == null)
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			using Bitmap image = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
			return graphics.MeasureString(str, font, width, format);
		}

		public static SizeF GetLabelSizePixels(string str, LabelStyle style)
		{
			return GetLabelSizePixels(str, style, style.Font);
		}

		public static SizeF GetLabelSizePixels(string str, LabelStyle style, Font font)
		{
			return GetLabelSizePixels(str, style, font, Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		public static SizeF GetLabelSizePixels(string str, LabelStyle style, Font font, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (str == null || str.Length == 0)
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			SizeF stringSizePixels = GetStringSizePixels(str, font);
			if (bounds != Rectangle.Empty && style.WrapText && style.ClipText)
			{
				int num;
				switch (style.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					num = bounds.Width;
					break;
				default:
					num = bounds.Height;
					break;
				}
				int num2 = (int)Math.Max(1.0, Math.Floor((float)num / stringSizePixels.Height));
				stringSizePixels.Height *= num2;
				stringSizePixels.Width /= num2;
			}
			switch (style.Orientation)
			{
			case TextOrientation.Custom:
			{
				PointF[] array = new PointF[3]
				{
					new PointF(0f, 0f),
					new PointF(stringSizePixels.Width, 0f),
					new PointF(0f, stringSizePixels.Height)
				};
				using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix(new RectangleF(0f, 0f, stringSizePixels.Width, stringSizePixels.Height), array))
				{
					matrix.RotateAt(point: new PointF(stringSizePixels.Width / 2f, stringSizePixels.Height / 2f), angle: style.RotationAngle);
					matrix.TransformPoints(array);
				}
				float num3 = float.MaxValue;
				float num4 = float.MinValue;
				float num5 = float.MaxValue;
				float num6 = float.MinValue;
				PointF[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					PointF pointF = array2[i];
					num3 = Math.Min(pointF.X, num3);
					num5 = Math.Min(pointF.Y, num5);
					num4 = Math.Max(pointF.X, num4);
					num6 = Math.Max(pointF.Y, num6);
				}
				float width = num4 - num3;
				float height = num6 - num5;
				return new SizeF(width, height);
			}
			case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
			case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				return new SizeF(stringSizePixels.Height, stringSizePixels.Width);
			default:
				return stringSizePixels;
			}
		}

		public static int GetStringArrayAverageSizePixels(string[] strings, Font font, int percentile)
		{
			if (strings.Length <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int[] array = new int[strings.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < strings.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (int)GetStringSizePixels(strings[i], font).Width;
			}
			Array.Sort(array);
			if (percentile < 0)
			{
				percentile = 0;
			}
			else if (percentile > 100)
			{
				percentile = 100;
			}
			int num = (int)((double)strings.Length * ((double)percentile * 0.01));
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			if (num > strings.Length)
			{
				num = strings.Length;
			}
			return array[num - 1];
		}

		public static string GetBestFitString(string text, Font font, ref Rectangle bounds, StringFormat format)
		{
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(new Bitmap(1, 1));
			graphics.MeasureString(text, font, bounds.Size, format, out var charactersFitted, out var linesFilled);
			if (linesFilled == 1)
			{
				switch (format.Trimming)
				{
				case StringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter:
				case StringTrimming.EllipsisWord:
					if (charactersFitted < text.Length)
					{
						text = text.Substring(0, charactersFitted);
						text += "...";
					}
					break;
				case StringTrimming.None:
				case StringTrimming.Character:
				case StringTrimming.Word:
					text = text.Substring(0, charactersFitted);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bounds.X += 3;
				bounds.Width -= 3;
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class Transform
	{
		public static Point[] viewingTransform(Rectangle source, Rectangle destination, Point[] p1, bool keepAspectRatio)
		{
			Point[] array = new Point[p1.Length];
			double num = (double)destination.Width / (double)source.Width;
			double num2 = (double)destination.Height / (double)source.Height;
			if (keepAspectRatio)
			{
				if (num * (double)source.Height > (double)destination.Height)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				else if (num2 * (double)source.Width > (double)destination.Width)
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < p1.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].X = p1[i].X - source.X;
				array[i].Y = p1[i].Y - source.Y;
				array[i].X = (int)(num * (double)array[i].X);
				array[i].Y = (int)(num2 * (double)array[i].Y);
				array[i].X = array[i].X + destination.X;
				array[i].Y = array[i].Y + destination.Y;
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

		public static IChartData CreateAdapter(object data, string dataMember, BindingManagerBase cm, string relationName)
		{
			IChartData result = null;
			if (data is GanttDataSource)
			{
				result = new GanttDataAdapter((GanttDataSource)data);
			}
			else if (data is string)
			{
				if (data != null && data is string && ((string)data).EndsWith(".xml"))
				{
					DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
					dataSet.ReadXml((string)data);
					XMLToChartAdapter xMLToChartAdapter = new XMLToChartAdapter(dataSet.Tables[0]);
					result = xMLToChartAdapter;
					xMLToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
				}
			}
			else if (data is DataSet && dataMember != null && cm != null && relationName != null)
			{
				DataRowView dataRowView = (DataRowView)cm.Current;
				DataRow row = dataRowView.Row;
				DataRow[] childRows = row.GetChildRows(relationName);
				DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
				dataTable.Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				IEnumerator enumerator = ((DataSet)data).Tables[dataMember].Columns.GetEnumerator();
				enumerator.Reset();
				DataTable table = childRows[0].Table;
				foreach (DataColumn column in table.Columns)
				{
					DataColumn dataColumn2 = new DataColumn();
					dataColumn2.ColumnName = column.ColumnName;
					dataColumn2.DataType = column.DataType;
					dataTable.Columns.Add(dataColumn2);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < childRows.Length; i++)
				{
					dataTable.Rows.Add(childRows[i].ItemArray);
				}
				DataTableToChartAdapter dataTableToChartAdapter = new DataTableToChartAdapter(dataTable);
				result = dataTableToChartAdapter;
				dataTableToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data.GetType().Name.IndexOf("UltraDataSource") > -1)
			{
				IBindingList bindingList = (IBindingList)((IListSource)data).GetList();
				ITypedList typedList = (ITypedList)bindingList;
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = typedList.GetItemProperties(null);
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = itemProperties[0];
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = (PropertyDescriptor[])Array.CreateInstance(typeof(PropertyDescriptor), itemProperties.Count);
				itemProperties.CopyTo(array, 0);
				itemProperties = typedList.GetItemProperties(array);
				DataTable dataTable2 = new DataTable();
				dataTable2.Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
				{
					dataTable2.Columns.Add(item.Name, item.PropertyType);
				}
				IBindingList bindingList2 = (IBindingList)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(bindingList[0]);
				foreach (object item2 in bindingList2)
				{
					DataRow dataRow = dataTable2.NewRow();
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item3 in itemProperties)
					{
						object value = item3.GetValue(item2);
						if (value == null)
						{
							dataRow[item3.Name] = DBNull.Value;
						}
						else
						{
							dataRow[item3.Name] = value;
						}
					}
					dataTable2.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
				DataTableToChartAdapter dataTableToChartAdapter2 = new DataTableToChartAdapter(dataTable2);
				result = dataTableToChartAdapter2;
				dataTableToChartAdapter2.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is DataView)
			{
				DataViewToChartAdapter dataViewToChartAdapter = new DataViewToChartAdapter((DataView)data);
				result = dataViewToChartAdapter;
				dataViewToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is IBindingList)
			{
				_ = (IBindingList)data;
				result = new IListToChartAdapter2((IList)data);
			}
			else if (data is CollectionBase)
			{
				CollectionToChartAdapter collectionToChartAdapter = new CollectionToChartAdapter((CollectionBase)data);
				result = collectionToChartAdapter;
				collectionToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is StreamReader)
			{
				FileStreamToChartAdapter fileStreamToChartAdapter = new FileStreamToChartAdapter((StreamReader)data);
				result = fileStreamToChartAdapter;
				fileStreamToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is DataTable || data is DataSet)
			{
				DataTable connectTo = ((!(data is DataSet)) ? ((DataTable)data) : ((dataMember == null || dataMember.Length <= 0) ? ((DataSet)data).Tables[0] : ((DataSet)data).Tables[dataMember]));
				DataTableToChartAdapter dataTableToChartAdapter3 = new DataTableToChartAdapter(connectTo);
				result = dataTableToChartAdapter3;
				dataTableToChartAdapter3.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is object[])
			{
				object[] array2 = (object[])data;
				ChartDataAdapter chartDataAdapter = ((!(array2[0] is Array)) ? ((ChartDataAdapter)new IListToChartAdapter2(new ArrayList(array2))) : ((ChartDataAdapter)new ArrayToChartAdapter2((object[])data)));
				result = chartDataAdapter;
				chartDataAdapter.calculateMinMax();
			}
			else if (data is Array)
			{
				ArrayToChartAdapter arrayToChartAdapter = null;
				Type elementType = ((Array)data).GetType().GetElementType();
				if (Util.NumericTypes[elementType].Equals(true))
				{
					arrayToChartAdapter = new ArrayToChartAdapter((Array)data);
				}
				if (arrayToChartAdapter != null)
				{
					result = arrayToChartAdapter;
					arrayToChartAdapter.calculateMinMax();
				}
			}
			else if (data is IList)
			{
				IList list = (IList)data;
				result = ((list.Count <= 0 || list[0].GetType().IsValueType) ? ((ChartDataAdapter)new IListToChartAdapter(list)) : ((ChartDataAdapter)new IListToChartAdapter2(list)));
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(data is IListSource))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(DataConstString.DataExcpText);
				}
				IList list2 = ((IListSource)data).GetList();
				result = ((list2.Count <= 0 || list2[0].GetType().IsValueType) ? ((ChartDataAdapter)new IListToChartAdapter(list2)) : ((ChartDataAdapter)new IListToChartAdapter2(list2)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void SetZeroAlignment(bool zero)
		{
			if (zero != zeroAligned)
			{
				zeroAligned = zero;
				calculateMinMax();
			}
		}

		protected void calculateMinMax()
		{
			calculateMinMax(treatNullAsZero: true);
		}

		protected void calculateMinMax(bool treatNullAsZero)
		{
			int columnCount = GetColumnCount();
			int rowCount = GetRowCount();
			dataMax = double.MinValue;
			dataMin = double.MaxValue;
			dataMaxColumn = new double[columnCount];
			dataMinColumn = new double[columnCount];
			dataMaxRow = new double[rowCount];
			dataMinRow = new double[rowCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				dataMaxRow[i] = double.MinValue;
				dataMinRow[i] = double.MaxValue;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
			{
				dataMaxColumn[j] = double.MinValue;
				dataMinColumn[j] = double.MaxValue;
				for (int k = 0; k < rowCount; k++)
				{
					if (!IsColumnNumeric(k, j))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!treatNullAsZero)
					{
						object objectValue = GetObjectValue(k, j);
						if (objectValue == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					double value = GetValue(k, j);
					if (value > dataMax)
					{
						dataMax = value;
					}
					if (value < dataMin)
					{
						dataMin = value;
					}
					if (value > dataMaxColumn[j])
					{
						dataMaxColumn[j] = value;
					}
					if (value < dataMinColumn[j])
					{
						dataMinColumn[j] = value;
					}
					if (value > dataMaxRow[k])
					{
						dataMaxRow[k] = value;
					}
					if (value < dataMinRow[k])
					{
						dataMinRow[k] = value;
					}
				}
			}
			if (dataMin == double.MaxValue || dataMax == double.MinValue)
			{
				dataMin = 0.0;
				dataMax = 0.0;
			}
			if (zeroAligned)
			{
				if (dataMin < 0.0 && dataMax < 0.0)
				{
					dataMax = 0.0;
				}
				else if (dataMin > 0.0 && dataMax > 0.0)
				{
					dataMin = 0.0;
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < dataMinColumn.Length; l++)
				{
					if (dataMinColumn[l] < 0.0 && dataMaxColumn[l] < 0.0)
					{
						dataMaxColumn[l] = 0.0;
					}
					else if (dataMinColumn[l] > 0.0 && dataMaxColumn[l] > 0.0)
					{
						dataMinColumn[l] = 0.0;
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < dataMinRow.Length; m++)
				{
					if (dataMinRow[m] < 0.0 && dataMaxRow[m] < 0.0)
					{
						dataMaxRow[m] = 0.0;
					}
					else if (dataMinRow[m] > 0.0 && dataMaxRow[m] > 0.0)
					{
						dataMinRow[m] = 0.0;
					}
				}
			}
			if (Math.Abs(dataMax - dataMin) < 1E-323)
			{
				dataMax = dataMin + 1.0;
			}
			staleMinMax = false;
		}

		public virtual double GetDataMax()
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			return dataMax;
		}

		public virtual double GetDataMin()
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			return dataMin;
		}

		public double GetDataMaxColumn(int column)
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			if (column < 0 || column >= GetColumnCount())
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return dataMaxColumn[column];
		}

		public double GetDataMinColumn(int column)
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			if (column < 0 || column >= GetColumnCount())
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return dataMinColumn[column];
		}

		public double GetDataMaxRow(int row)
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			if (row < 0 || row >= GetRowCount())
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return dataMaxRow[row];
		}

		public double GetDataMinRow(int row)
		{
			if (staleMinMax)
			{
				calculateMinMax();
			}
			if (row < 0 || row >= GetRowCount())
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return dataMinRow[row];
		}

		public abstract object GetRowLabel(int row);

		public abstract object GetColumnLabel(int column);

		public abstract bool IsColumnNumeric(int column);

		public abstract bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column);

		public abstract bool IsColumnDateTime(int column);

		public abstract bool IsColumnString(int column);

		public void SetRowLabelsColumn(int column)
		{
			if (column >= 0 && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				rowLabelsColumn = column;
			}
		}

		public int GetRowLabelsColumn()
		{
			return rowLabelsColumn;
		}

		public void SetUseRowLabels(bool use)
		{
			useRowLabel = use;
		}

		public bool GetUseRowLabels()
		{
			return useRowLabel;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("int    GetRowCount()        =" + GetRowCount());
			stringBuilder.Append("\nint    GetColumnCount()     =" + GetColumnCount());
			stringBuilder.Append("\ndouble GetDataMax()         =" + GetDataMax());
			stringBuilder.Append("\ndouble GetDataMin()         =" + GetDataMin());
			stringBuilder.Append("\nint    GetRowLabelsColumn() =" + GetRowLabelsColumn());
			stringBuilder.Append("\nbool   GetUseRowLabels()    =" + GetUseRowLabels());
			stringBuilder.Append("\ndouble GetValue      ={");
			int rowCount = GetRowCount();
			int columnCount = GetColumnCount();
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("{");
				for (int j = 0; j < columnCount; j++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(GetValue(i, j) + ",");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("object GetObjectValue={");
			for (int k = 0; k < rowCount; k++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("{");
				for (int l = 0; l < columnCount; l++)
				{
					object objectValue = GetObjectValue(k, l);
					if (objectValue == null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("null");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(objectValue.ToString());
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("string GetStringValue={");
			for (int m = 0; m < rowCount; m++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("{");
				for (int n = 0; n < columnCount; n++)
				{
					object stringValue = GetStringValue(m, n);
					if (stringValue == null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("null");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(stringValue.ToString());
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("object GetRowLabel   ={");
			for (int num = 0; num < rowCount; num++)
			{
				object rowLabel = GetRowLabel(num);
				if (rowLabel == null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(rowLabel.ToString());
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(",");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("object GetColumnLabel={");
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < columnCount; num2++)
			{
				object columnLabel = GetColumnLabel(num2);
				if (columnLabel == null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(columnLabel.ToString());
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(",");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("double Col {min, max}={");
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < columnCount; num3++)
			{
				double num4 = GetDataMaxColumn(num3);
				double num5 = GetDataMinColumn(num3);
				stringBuilder.Append("{" + num5 + ", " + num4 + "}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("double Row {min, max}={");
			for (int num6 = 0; num6 < rowCount; num6++)
			{
				double num7 = GetDataMaxRow(num6);
				double num8 = GetDataMinRow(num6);
				stringBuilder.Append("{" + num8 + ", " + num7 + "}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("bool IsColumnNumeric={");
			for (int num9 = 0; num9 < columnCount; num9++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(IsColumnNumeric(num9).ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("bool IsColumnDateTime={");
			for (int num10 = 0; num10 < columnCount; num10++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(IsColumnDateTime(num10).ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("bool IsColumnString={");
			for (int num11 = 0; num11 < columnCount; num11++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(IsColumnString(num11).ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("}\n");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void ReCalculateMinMax(bool treatNullAsZero)
		{
			calculateMinMax(treatNullAsZero);
		}
	}
	public class ArrayToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private Array arrayConnectedTo;

		private int arrayRank;

		internal ArrayToChartAdapter(Array connectTo, bool zeroAligned)
		{
			this.zeroAligned = zeroAligned;
			arrayConnectedTo = connectTo;
			if (connectTo != null)
			{
				arrayRank = arrayConnectedTo.Rank;
			}
		}

		public ArrayToChartAdapter(Array connectTo)
		{
			arrayConnectedTo = connectTo;
			if (connectTo != null)
			{
				arrayRank = arrayConnectedTo.Rank;
			}
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(0);
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (arrayRank == 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(1);
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (arrayRank == 1)
			{
				if (row < arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(0))
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(arrayConnectedTo.GetValue(row));
				}
			}
			else if (row < arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(0) && column < arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(1))
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(arrayConnectedTo.GetValue(row, column));
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			return GetValue(row, column);
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0)
			{
				return GetStringValue(row, rowLabelsColumn);
			}
			return DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (arrayRank == 1)
			{
				if (column == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (column >= 0 && column < arrayConnectedTo.GetLength(1))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ArrayToChartAdapter2 : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private object[] arrayConnectedTo;

		public ArrayToChartAdapter2(object[] connectTo)
		{
			arrayConnectedTo = connectTo;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			if (arrayConnectedTo != null)
			{
				return arrayConnectedTo.Length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (arrayConnectedTo != null && GetRowCount() > 0)
			{
				return ((Array)arrayConnectedTo[0]).Length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(GetObjectValue(row, column));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (arrayConnectedTo != null && GetColumnCount() >= column && GetRowCount() >= row)
			{
				return ((Array)arrayConnectedTo[row]).GetValue(column);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0)
			{
				return GetStringValue(row, rowLabelsColumn);
			}
			return DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(0, column);
			if (!(objectValue is double) && !(objectValue is float) && !(objectValue is int) && !(objectValue is long) && !(objectValue is decimal) && !(objectValue is short))
			{
				return objectValue is byte;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(0, column);
			if (objectValue is DateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(0, column);
			if (objectValue is string)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}
	public class CandleChartDemoData : ChartDataAdapter, IChartData
	{
		public double MaxData = 50.0;

		public double MinData = -50.0;

		public string[] columnLabels = new string[7] { "Date", "Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume", "Adj. Close" };

		private object[,] data;

	public interface IChartDataFilter
	{
		IChartData GetRawData();

		int GetRealRowNumber(int row);

		int GetRealColumnNumber(int column);

		int GetFilteredRowNumber(int row);

		int GetFilteredColumnNumber(int column);

		void ResetColumnList();

		void IncludeColumn(int realColumnNum, bool include);

		bool IsColumnIncluded(int realColumnNum);

		bool GetZeroAlignment();

		void SetZeroAlignment(bool zero);

		bool GetSwapRowsAndColumns();

		void SetSwapRowsAndColumns(bool swap);
	}
	public class ChartDataFilter : ChartDataAdapter, IChartDataFilter
	{
		private IChartData connectTo;

		private bool swapRowsAndColumns;

		protected string[] rowLabelArray;

		protected string[] columnLabelArray;

		private ArrayList columns = new ArrayList();

		public ChartDataFilter(IChartData connectTo, bool zeroAligned)
		{
			this.connectTo = connectTo;
			this.zeroAligned = zeroAligned;
			columns.Capacity = this.connectTo.GetColumnCount();
			calculateMinMax();
		}

		public ChartDataFilter(IChartData connectTo)
		{
			this.connectTo = connectTo;
			columns.Capacity = this.connectTo.GetColumnCount();
			calculateMinMax();
		}

		public IChartData GetRawData()
		{
			return connectTo;
		}

		public int GetRealRowNumber(int row)
		{
			return row;
		}

		public int GetRealColumnNumber(int column)
		{
			if (column >= 0 && column < columns.Count)
			{
				return (int)columns[column];
			}
			return column;
		}

		public int GetFilteredRowNumber(int row)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
				{
					if ((int)columns[i] == row)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (row < 0 || row >= connectTo.GetRowCount())
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return row;
		}

		public int GetFilteredColumnNumber(int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				if (column < 0 || column >= connectTo.GetRowCount())
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return column;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((int)columns[i] == column)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public bool GetZeroAlignment()
		{
			return zeroAligned;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return columns.Count;
			}
			return connectTo.GetRowCount();
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return connectTo.GetRowCount();
			}
			return columns.Count;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return connectTo.GetValue(column, (int)columns[row]);
			}
			return connectTo.GetValue(row, (int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return connectTo.GetObjectValue(column, (int)columns[row]);
			}
			return connectTo.GetObjectValue(row, (int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return connectTo.GetStringValue(column, (int)columns[row]);
			}
			return connectTo.GetStringValue(row, (int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				if (columnLabelArray != null)
				{
					return columnLabelArray[row % columnLabelArray.Length];
				}
				return connectTo.GetColumnLabel((int)columns[row]);
			}
			if (rowLabelArray != null)
			{
				return rowLabelArray[row % rowLabelArray.Length];
			}
			return connectTo.GetRowLabel(row);
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				if (rowLabelArray != null)
				{
					return rowLabelArray[column % rowLabelArray.Length];
				}
				return connectTo.GetRowLabel(column);
			}
			if (columnLabelArray != null)
			{
				return columnLabelArray[column % columnLabelArray.Length];
			}
			return connectTo.GetColumnLabel((int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			return connectTo.IsColumnNumeric((int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return connectTo.IsColumnNumeric((int)columns[row]);
			}
			return connectTo.IsColumnNumeric((int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			return connectTo.IsColumnDateTime((int)columns[column]);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			return connectTo.IsColumnString((int)columns[column]);
		}

		public bool GetSwapRowsAndColumns()
		{
			return swapRowsAndColumns;
		}

		public void SetSwapRowsAndColumns(bool swap)
		{
			swapRowsAndColumns = swap;
		}

		public void ResetColumnList()
		{
			columns.Clear();
		}

		public void IncludeColumn(int realColumnNum, bool include)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((int)columns[i] == realColumnNum)
				{
					if (include)
					{
						return;
					}
					num = i;
					break;
				}
				if ((int)columns[i] <= realColumnNum)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!include)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = i - 1;
				if (num == -1)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (include)
				{
					columns.Insert(num, realColumnNum);
					calculateMinMax();
				}
				else
				{
					columns.RemoveAt(num);
					calculateMinMax();
				}
			}
			else if (include)
			{
				if (num == -1)
				{
					columns.Add(realColumnNum);
					calculateMinMax();
				}
				else
				{
					columns.Insert(num, realColumnNum);
					calculateMinMax();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsColumnIncluded(int realColumnNum)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((int)columns[i] == realColumnNum)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((int)columns[i] > realColumnNum)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetRowLabels(string[] labels)
		{
			rowLabelArray = labels;
		}

		public string[] GetRowLabels()
		{
			return rowLabelArray;
		}

		public void SetColumnLabels(string[] labels)
		{
			columnLabelArray = labels;
		}

		public new void SetRowLabelsColumn(int column)
		{
			if (column >= 0 && column < connectTo.GetColumnCount())
			{
				rowLabelsColumn = column;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartDemoData : ChartDataAdapter, IChartData
	{
		private int _MaxRows = 5;

		private int _MaxColumns = 5;

		private double _MaxData = 50.0;

		private double _MinData = -50.0;

		private string[] _rowLabels = new string[7] { "Kamal", "Scott", "Tim", "Naidu", "Andy", "Dean", "Don" };

		private string[] _columnLabels = new string[5] { "Pizza", "Cookies", "Sandwich", "IceCream", "Cheese Steak" };

		private double[,] data;

		private bool swapRowsAndColumns;

		public virtual int MaxRows

		{
			return false;

		public ChartDemoData()
		{
			data = new double[MaxRows, MaxColumns];
			double num = MaxData - MinData;
			for (int i = 0; i < MaxRows; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < MaxColumns; j++)
				{
					double num2 = (ChartCore.RANDOM.NextDouble() - 0.5) * num;
					if (num2 > dataMax)
					{
						dataMax = num2;
					}
					if (num2 < dataMin)
					{
						dataMin = num2;
					}
					data[i, j] = num2;
				}
			}
			calculateMinMax();
		}

		internal ChartDemoData(int rows, int columns, double maxD, double minD, bool addRowLabels, bool zeroAligned)
		{
			this.zeroAligned = zeroAligned;
			MaxRows = rows;
			MaxColumns = columns;
			MaxData = maxD;
			MinData = minD;
			data = new double[MaxRows, MaxColumns];
			double num = MaxData - MinData;
			int num2 = (addRowLabels ? 1 : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < MaxRows; i++)
			{
				for (int j = num2; j < MaxColumns; j++)
				{
					double num3 = MinData + ChartCore.RANDOM.NextDouble() * num;
					data[i, j] = num3;
				}
			}
			calculateMinMax();
			if (addRowLabels)
			{
				int maxValue = ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(1, rowLabels.Length);
				for (int k = 0; k < MaxRows; k++)
				{
					data[k, 0] = ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(0, maxValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartDemoData(int rows, int columns, double maxD, double minD, bool addRowLabels)
			: this(rows, columns, maxD, minD, addRowLabels, zeroAligned: true)
		{
		}

		public void SetSwapRowsAndColumns(bool swap)
		{
			swapRowsAndColumns = swap;
			base.staleMinMax = true;
		}

		public bool GetSwapRowsAndColumns()
		{
			return swapRowsAndColumns;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return MaxColumns;
			}
			return MaxRows;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return MaxRows;
			}
			return MaxColumns;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (swapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return data[column, row];
			}
			return data[row, column];
		}

			{

	public class CollectionToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter, IDisposable
	{
		private DataTable tableConnectedTo;

		private CollectionBase collection;

		private bool isStronglyTyped;

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && tableConnectedTo != null)
			{
				tableConnectedTo.Dispose();
				tableConnectedTo = null;
			}
		}

		public CollectionToChartAdapter(CollectionBase connectTo)
		{
			collection = connectTo;
			tableConnectedTo = new DataTable();
			tableConnectedTo.Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			FillTable();
		}

		private void FillTable()
		{
			CreateTable();
			FillData();
		}

		private void CreateTable()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.Reset();
			enumerator.MoveNext();
			if (enumerator.Current is Array array)
			{
				{
					foreach (object item in array)
					{
						Type type = item.GetType();
						if (type == typeof(double))
						{
							tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add("", typeof(double));
						}
						else if (type == typeof(int))
						{
							tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add("", typeof(int));
						}
						else if (type == typeof(float))
						{
							tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add("", typeof(float));
						}
						else if (type == typeof(DateTime))
						{
							tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add("", typeof(DateTime));
						}
						else if (type == typeof(string))
						{
							tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add("", typeof(string));
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			isStronglyTyped = true;
			NTV[] nTV = NTV.GetNTV(enumerator.Current);
			NTV[] array2 = nTV;
			foreach (NTV nTV2 in array2)
			{
				tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(nTV2.Name, nTV2.Type);
			}
		}

		private void FillData()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.Reset();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataRow dataRow = tableConnectedTo.NewRow();
				if (isStronglyTyped)
				{
					NTV[] nTV = NTV.GetNTV(enumerator.Current);
					NTV[] array = nTV;
					foreach (NTV nTV2 in array)
					{
						dataRow[nTV2.Name] = nTV2.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataRow.ItemArray = (object[])enumerator.Current;
				}
				tableConnectedTo.Rows.Add(dataRow);
			}
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				try
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column]);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				result = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (IsColumnString(column))
			{
				return (string)tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && rowLabelsColumn < tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				obj = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][rowLabelsColumn];
				if (row >= GetRowCount() || rowLabelsColumn >= GetColumnCount())
				{
					obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
			}
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].ColumnName;
		}

		public bool IsTableDataValid()
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string) || dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}

	public class DataTableToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private DataTable tableConnectedTo;

		public DataTableToChartAdapter(DataTable connectTo)
		{
			tableConnectedTo = connectTo;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				object objectValue = GetObjectValue(row, column);
				if (objectValue != null)
				{
					if (objectValue is double)
					{
						result = (double)objectValue;
					}
					else if (objectValue is IConvertible)
					{
						try
						{
							result = Convert.ToDouble(objectValue);
						}
						catch
						{
							result = 0.0;
						}
					}
					else if (!double.TryParse(objectValue.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result))
					{
						result = 0.0;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount() && row >= 0 && column >= 0 && (tableConnectedTo.Rows[row].RowState & DataRowState.Deleted) == 0)
			{
				obj = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			INullable nullable = obj as INullable;
			if (obj is DBNull || (nullable != null && nullable.IsNull))
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(row, column);
			if (IsColumnString(column))
			{
				return (string)objectValue;
			}
			if (objectValue == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			return objectValue.ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && rowLabelsColumn < tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				if (tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count > row && tableConnectedTo.Rows[row] != null && tableConnectedTo.Rows[row].ItemArray != null && tableConnectedTo.Rows[row].ItemArray.Length > rowLabelsColumn)
				{
					result = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][rowLabelsColumn];
				}
				if (row >= GetRowCount() || rowLabelsColumn >= GetColumnCount())
				{
					result = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
			}
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].ColumnName;
		}

		public bool IsTableDataValid()
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (column < 0 || column >= GetColumnCount())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string) || dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (column < 0 || column >= GetColumnCount())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime) || dataType == typeof(SqlDateTime))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (column < 0 || column >= GetColumnCount())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}
	public class DataViewToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private DataView dataViewConnectedTo;

		public DataViewToChartAdapter(DataView connectTo)
		{
			dataViewConnectedTo = connectTo;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return dataViewConnectedTo.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (dataViewConnectedTo.Table != null)
			{
				return dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				object obj = dataViewConnectedTo[row][column];
				try
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(obj);
				}
				catch
				{
					if (!double.TryParse(obj.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result))
					{
						result = 0.0;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				obj = dataViewConnectedTo[row][column];
			}
			INullable nullable = obj as INullable;
			if (obj is DBNull || (nullable != null && nullable.IsNull))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (IsColumnString(column))
			{
				return (string)dataViewConnectedTo[row][column];
			}
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			object obj = "";
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && rowLabelsColumn < dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count)
			{
				obj = dataViewConnectedTo[row][rowLabelsColumn];
				if (row >= GetRowCount() || rowLabelsColumn >= GetColumnCount())
				{
					obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (column >= dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count)
			{
				return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
			}
			return dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns[column].ColumnName;
		}

		public bool IsTableDataValid()
		{
			if (dataViewConnectedTo.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dataViewConnectedTo.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (dataViewConnectedTo == null || column >= dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string) || dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (dataViewConnectedTo == null || column >= dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (dataViewConnectedTo == null || column >= dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = dataViewConnectedTo.Table.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}

				dataTable.Rows.Add("Drink", "OJ Soda", "", 3.0, -0.1);
				dataTable.Rows.Add("Drink", "Water", "", 8.1, -0.3);
				dataTable.Rows.Add("Drink", "Cran-Ras", "", 8.0, -0.5);
				dataTable.Rows.Add("Drink", "Gatorade", "", 8.0, -0.7);
				dataTable.Rows.Add("Candy", "Skittles", "", 20.0, -1.0);
				break;
			default:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
				{
					DataColumn column = new DataColumn("COL" + i, typeof(double));
					dataTable.Columns.Add(column);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
				{
					DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
					dataRow.ItemArray = new object[3]
					{
						ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(-100, 100),
						ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(-100, 100),
						ChartCore.RANDOM.Next(-100, 100)
					};
					dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		internal static double[,] DemoArray(int number)
		{
			return number switch
			{
				0 => new double[3, 4]
				{
					{ 45.0, 50.0, 38.0, 18.0 },
					{ 60.0, 80.0, 35.0, 4.0 },
					{ 45.0, 50.0, 67.0, 7.0 }
				}, 
				1 => new double[3, 4]
				{
					{ 60.0, 90.0, 46.0, 2.0 },
					{ 65.0, 50.0, 74.0, 25.0 },
					{ 70.0, 30.0, 26.0, 7.0 }
				}, 
				_ => new double[3, 4]
				{
					{ 20.0, 34.0, 67.0, 3.0 },
					{ 70.0, 30.0, 26.0, 7.0 },
					{ 45.0, 50.0, 38.0, 18.0 }
				}, 
			};
		}
