	public class FileStreamToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter, IDisposable
	{
		private DataTable tableConnectedTo;

		private StreamReader reader;

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && tableConnectedTo != null)
			{
				tableConnectedTo.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public FileStreamToChartAdapter(StreamReader connectTo)
		{
			reader = connectTo;
			tableConnectedTo = new DataTable();
			tableConnectedTo.Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			FillTable();
		}

		private void FillTable()
		{
			CreateTable();
			FillData();
		}

		private void CreateTable()
		{
			string text = reader.ReadLine();
			string[] array = text.Split(' ', ',', '\t');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string[] array2 = array[i].Split('.');
				if (array2[1].Equals("int"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(int));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("string"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(string));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("byte"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(byte));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("decimal"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(decimal));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("float"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(float));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("double"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(double));
				}
				else if (array2[1].Equals("date"))
				{
					tableConnectedTo.Columns.Add(array2[0], typeof(DateTime));
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillData()
		{
			while (reader.Peek() != -1)
			{
				string text = reader.ReadLine();
				string[] array = text.Split('\t', ',');
				DataRow dataRow = tableConnectedTo.NewRow();
				dataRow.ItemArray = array;
				tableConnectedTo.Rows.Add(dataRow);
			}
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				object value = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
				try
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ex.ToString();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				result = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (IsColumnString(column))
			{
				return (string)tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && rowLabelsColumn < tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				obj = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][rowLabelsColumn];
				if (row >= GetRowCount() || rowLabelsColumn >= GetColumnCount())
				{
					obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
			}
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].ColumnName;
		}

		public bool IsTableDataValid()
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string) || dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}

	public class GanttDataAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private GanttDataSource _ganttData;

		public GanttDataSource GanttData
		{
			get
			{
				return _ganttData;
			}
			set
			{
				_ganttData = value;
			}
		}

		public override double GetDataMax()
		{
			long num = long.MinValue;
			foreach (GanttSeries item in GanttData.Series)
			{
				foreach (GanttItem item2 in item.Items)
				{
					foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in item2.Times)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, time.Length.Ticks);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override double GetDataMin()
		{
			long num = long.MaxValue;
			foreach (GanttSeries item in GanttData.Series)
			{
				foreach (GanttItem item2 in item.Items)
				{
					foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in item2.Times)
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, time.Length.Ticks);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public GanttDataAdapter(GanttDataSource data)
		{
			GanttData = data;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return GanttData.Series.ItemCountTotal;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int index)
		{
			return GanttData.Series.GetItemLabel(index);
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int index)
		{
			return GanttData.Series[index].Key;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			return GanttData.Series[rowIndex].Items[columnIndex];
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return GanttData.Series.Count;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			return "";
		}

		public override double GetValue(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in GanttData.Series[rowIndex].Items[columnIndex].Times)
			{
				num += (double)time.Length.Ticks;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int index)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int index)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int rowIndex, int colIndex)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int index)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]

		{
			get
			{
				return _DataBound;
			}
			set
			{
				_DataBound = value;
			}
		}

			: this("", empty: false)
		{
		}

		{
			PE = new PaintElement();
			PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.None;
			Label = label;
			Empty = empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeEmpty()
		{
			return Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			if (Label != null)

		}

		}

		protected abstract DataPointBase OnClone();

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeDataBound()
		{
			return DataBound;
		}
	}

		private string _key;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_37")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public GanttTimeEntryCollection Times => _times;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_38")]
		public string Key
		{
			get
			{
				return _key;
			}
			set
			{
				_key = value;
			}
		}

		public GanttItem()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected override DataPointBase OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public GanttItem Clone()
		{
			GanttItem ganttItem = new GanttItem(Key);
			ganttItem.Empty = Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < Times.Count; i++)
			{
				ganttItem.Times.Add(Times[i].Clone());
			}
			return ganttItem;
		}

		public GanttItem(string key)
			: base(key, empty: false)
		{
			Key = key;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Data
{
	[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.DataPointCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class GanttItemCollection : DataPointCollection
	{
		public GanttItem this[object indexOrKey]
		{
			get
			{
				if (indexOrKey is int index)
				{
					return base.List[index] as GanttItem;
				}
				if (indexOrKey is string key)
				{
					return FromKey(key);
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("indexOrKey must be a string or an integer.");
			}
			set
			{
				if (indexOrKey is int num)
				{
					this[num] = value;
				}
				if (indexOrKey is string text)
				{
					GanttItem ganttItem = FromKey(text);
					if (ganttItem != null)
					{
						int num2 = IndexOf(ganttItem);
						if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < base.Count)
						{
							this[num2] = value;
						}
					}
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("key: " + text + " not found.");
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("indexOrKey must be a string or an integer.");
			}
		}

		public GanttItemCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public GanttItemCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public GanttItem FromKey(string key)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					GanttItem ganttItem = (GanttItem)enumerator.Current;
					if (ganttItem.Key == key)
					{
						return ganttItem;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GanttItem Add(GanttItem value)
		{
			if (value.Key == null)
			{
				int num = base.Count;
				string key;
				do
				{
					num++;
					key = "item" + num;
				}
				while (FromKey(key) != null);
				value.Key = key;
			}
			return this[AddPoint(value)];
		}

		public GanttItem Add(string key)
		{
			return Add(new GanttItem(key));
		}

		public GanttItemCollection Clone()
		{
			GanttItemCollection ganttItemCollection = new GanttItemCollection(component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					GanttItem ganttItem = (GanttItem)enumerator.Current;
					ganttItemCollection.Add(ganttItem.Clone());
				}
				return ganttItemCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override DataPointCollection OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override object OnAddNew()
		{
			return Add(new GanttItem());
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Series

	public interface ISeries : ICloneable
	{
		PaintElementCollection PEs { get; }

		string Label { get; set; }

		string Key { get; set; }

		IProvideDataPoints GetPoints();
	}
	[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.DataPointCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ChartCollectionObjectConverter))]
	public abstract class SeriesBase : ISeries, ICloneable, IProvideChartComponent
	{
		private string _Key = "";

		private IChartComponent _ChartComponent;

		private PaintElementCollection _Palette;

		private string _Label = "";

		private ArrayList ListChangedDelegates = new ArrayList();

		private bool _Visible = true;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_31")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public virtual string Key
		{
			get
			{
				return _Key;
			}
			set
			{
				_Key = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public IChartComponent ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChartComponent;
			}
			set
			{
				_ChartComponent = value;
				if (PEs.Component == null)
				{
					PEs.Component = value;
				}
				if (ProvidePoints() is IProvideChartComponent provideChartComponent)
				{
					provideChartComponent.ChartComponent = ChartComponent;
				}
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_32")]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.PaintElementCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public virtual PaintElementCollection PEs => _Palette;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_33")]
		[Localizable(true)]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		public virtual string Label
		{
			get
			{
				return _Label;
			}
			set
			{
				_Label = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20063_01")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public virtual bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return _Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				_Visible = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private event ListChangedEventHandler ListChanged
		{
			add
			{
				DataView sourceDataView = GetSourceDataView();
				if (sourceDataView != null)
				{
					sourceDataView.ListChanged += value;
					ListChangedDelegates.Add(value);
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				DataView sourceDataView = GetSourceDataView();
				if (sourceDataView != null)
				{
					sourceDataView.ListChanged -= value;
					ListChangedDelegates.Remove(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected SeriesBase()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected SeriesBase(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			_ChartComponent = chartComponent;
			_Palette = new PaintElementCollection(chartComponent);
		}

		protected void SetPEs(PaintElementCollection pes)
		{
			_Palette = pes;
			_Palette.Component = ChartComponent;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Key;
		}

		protected abstract ISeries OnClone();

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return OnClone();
		}

		public abstract IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints();

		IProvideDataPoints ISeries.GetPoints()
		{
			return ProvidePoints();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeData()
		{
			IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = ProvidePoints();
			if (!(provideDataPoints is DataPointCollection dataPointCollection))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < provideDataPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (provideDataPoints[i] is DataPointBase { DataBound: not false } dataPointBase)
				{
					dataPointCollection.Remove(dataPointBase);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void DataBind()
		{
			InitializeData();
			ClearListChangedEventHandlers();
			ListChanged += BindingListChanged;
		}

		private DataView GetSourceDataView()
		{
			object dataSource = GetDataAppearance().DataSource;
			if (dataSource is DataTable)
			{
				DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)dataSource;
				return dataTable.DefaultView;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ClearListChangedEventHandlers()
		{
			DataView sourceDataView = GetSourceDataView();
			if (sourceDataView != null)
			{
				foreach (ListChangedEventHandler listChangedDelegate in ListChangedDelegates)
				{
					sourceDataView.ListChanged -= listChangedDelegate;
				}
			}
			ListChangedDelegates.Clear();
		}

		private void BindingListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		protected abstract SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance();

		public virtual void SetNoUpdate(bool noUpdate)
		{
			if (ProvidePoints() is DataPointCollection dataPointCollection)
			{
				dataPointCollection.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}
	}
}

	public class GanttSeries : SeriesBase
	{
		private GanttItemCollection _items;

		private string _key = "";

		private GanttSeriesDataAppearance _Data;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_35")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public GanttItemCollection Items => _items;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public GanttItemCollection Points => Items;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_36")]
		public override string Key
		{
			get
			{
				return _key;
			}
			set
			{
				_key = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public GanttSeriesDataAppearance Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public GanttSeries()
			: this("")
		{
		}

		public GanttSeries(string key)
			: this((IChartComponent)null)
		{
			Key = key;
		}

		public GanttSeries(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			SetPEs(new PaintElementCollection(chartComponent));
			_items = new GanttItemCollection(chartComponent);
			Data = new GanttSeriesDataAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Items;
		}

		protected override ISeries OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public GanttSeries Clone()
		{
			GanttSeries ganttSeries = new GanttSeries(Key);
			ganttSeries.Key = Key;
			ganttSeries.Visible = Visible;
			ganttSeries.ChartComponent = base.ChartComponent;
			foreach (GanttItem item in Items)
			{
				ganttSeries.Items.Add(item.Clone());
			}
			ganttSeries.Label = Label;
			ganttSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			return ganttSeries;
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data == null || Data.DataSource == null || !(Data.DataSource is DataTable))
			{
				return;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LabelColumn].ToString();
				if (Items[text] == null)
				{
					Items.Add(new GanttItem(text));
				}
				DateTime startTime = DateTime.Parse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.StartTimeColumn].ToString());
				DateTime endTime = DateTime.Parse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.EndTimeColumn].ToString());
				int index = Items[text].Times.Add(new GanttTimeEntry(startTime, endTime));
				if (Data.TimeEntryIDColumn != null)
				{
					double result = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.TimeEntryIDColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					Items[text].Times[index].ID = (int)result;
				}
				if (Data.LinkToIDColumn != null)
				{
					double result2 = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LinkToIDColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
					Items[text].Times[index].LinkToID = (int)result2;
				}
				if (Data.PercentCompleteColumn != null)
				{
					double result3 = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.PercentCompleteColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result3);
					Items[text].Times[index].PercentComplete = result3;
				}
				if (Data.OwnerColumn != null)
				{
					Items[text].Times[index].Owner = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.OwnerColumn].ToString();
				}
				Items[text].DataBound = true;
			}
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string endTimeColumn, string linkToIDColumn, string ownerColumn, string percentCompleteColumn, string startTimeColumn, string timeEntryIDColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.EndTimeColumn = endTimeColumn;
			Data.LinkToIDColumn = linkToIDColumn;
			Data.OwnerColumn = ownerColumn;
			Data.PercentCompleteColumn = percentCompleteColumn;
			Data.StartTimeColumn = startTimeColumn;
			Data.TimeEntryIDColumn = timeEntryIDColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string endTimeColumn, string linkToIDColumn, string ownerColumn, string percentCompleteColumn, string startTimeColumn, string timeEntryIDColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.EndTimeColumn = endTimeColumn;

			Data.OwnerColumn = ownerColumn;

		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string endTimeColumn, string linkToIDColumn, string ownerColumn, string percentCompleteColumn, string startTimeColumn, string timeEntryIDColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			if (dataSet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataSet");
			}
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.EndTimeColumn = endTimeColumn;
			Data.LinkToIDColumn = linkToIDColumn;
			Data.OwnerColumn = ownerColumn;
			Data.PercentCompleteColumn = percentCompleteColumn;
			Data.StartTimeColumn = startTimeColumn;
			Data.TimeEntryIDColumn = timeEntryIDColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

	public interface IProvideGroupedLabels
	{
		int ItemCountTotal { get; }

		int SeriesCountTotal { get; }

		int GetItemCountSeries(int seriesIndex);

		string GetSeriesLabel(int seriesIndex);

		string GetItemLabel(int seriesIndex, int itemIndex);
	}
	public class GanttSeriesCollection : DictionaryBase, IProvideGroupedLabels
	{
		private StringCollection _orderedKeys = new StringCollection();

		private StringCollection OrderedKeys => _orderedKeys;

		public GanttSeries this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Dictionary[key] as GanttSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Dictionary[key] = value;
			}
		}

		public GanttSeries this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Dictionary[OrderedKeys[index]] as GanttSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Dictionary[OrderedKeys[index]] = value;
			}
		}

		public int ItemCountTotal
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						GanttSeries ganttSeries = (GanttSeries)enumerator.Current;
						num += ganttSeries.Items.Count;
					}
					return num;
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasTimeEntries
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						GanttSeries ganttSeries = (GanttSeries)enumerator.Current;
						foreach (GanttItem item in ganttSeries.Items)
						{
							if (item.Times.Count > 0)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		int IProvideGroupedLabels.SeriesCountTotal => base.Count;

		public DateTime MaxDateTime
		{
			get
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						GanttSeries ganttSeries = (GanttSeries)enumerator.Current;
						foreach (GanttItem item in ganttSeries.Items)
						{
							foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in item.Times)
							{
								if (time.Start.CompareTo(dateTime) >= 0)
								{
									dateTime = time.Start;
								}
								if (time.End.CompareTo(dateTime) >= 0)
								{
									dateTime = time.End;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return dateTime;
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public DateTime MinDateTime
		{
			get
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						GanttSeries ganttSeries = (GanttSeries)enumerator.Current;
						foreach (GanttItem item in ganttSeries.Items)
						{
							foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in item.Times)
							{
								if (time.End.CompareTo(dateTime) <= 0)
								{
									dateTime = time.End;
								}
								if (time.Start.CompareTo(dateTime) <= 0)
								{
									dateTime = time.Start;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return dateTime;
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public GanttSeries Add(GanttSeries value)
		{
			OrderedKeys.Add(value.Key);
			base.Dictionary.Add(value.Key, value);
			return this[value.Key];
		}

		public GanttSeries Add(string key)
		{
			return Add(new GanttSeries(key));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public new IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return base.Dictionary.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IProvideGroupedLabels.GetItemCountSeries(int seriesIndex)
		{
			return this[seriesIndex].Items.Count;
		}

		string IProvideGroupedLabels.GetItemLabel(int seriesIndex, int itemIndex)
		{
			return this[seriesIndex].Items[itemIndex].Key;
		}

		string IProvideGroupedLabels.GetSeriesLabel(int seriesIndex)
		{
			return this[seriesIndex].Key;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string GetItemLabel(int index)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < this[i].Items.Count; j++)
				{
					if (num == index)
					{
						return this[i].Items[j].Key;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return "";
		}
	}

		public GanttTimeEntryCollection Clone()
		{
			GanttTimeEntryCollection ganttTimeEntryCollection = new GanttTimeEntryCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				ganttTimeEntryCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return ganttTimeEntryCollection;
		}

		protected override object OnAddNew()
		{
			return this[Add(DateTime.Now, DateTime.Now)];
		}
	}
	public class IListToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private IList connectedTo;

		public IListToChartAdapter(IList list)
		{
			connectedTo = list;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return connectedTo.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return 1;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (row < GetRowCount())
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(connectedTo[row]);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (row < GetRowCount())
			{
				return connectedTo[row];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			return GetObjectValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			return DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (!(GetObjectValue(0, column).GetType() == typeof(double)) && !(GetObjectValue(0, column).GetType() == typeof(float)))
			{
				return GetObjectValue(0, column).GetType() == typeof(int);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			return GetObjectValue(0, column).GetType() == typeof(DateTime);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			return GetObjectValue(0, column).GetType() == typeof(string);
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return GetObjectValue(row, column).GetType() == typeof(double);
		}
	}
	public class IListToChartAdapter2 : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private NTV[][] internalNTV;

		private int totalRows;

		private int totalColumns = 1024;

		public IListToChartAdapter2(IList enumerable)
		{
			object obj = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < enumerable.Count; i++)
			{
				obj = enumerable[i];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					totalRows++;
				}
			}
			if (totalRows <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			internalNTV = new NTV[totalRows][];
			PropertyDescriptorCollection props = ((!(enumerable is ITypedList typedList)) ? null : typedList.GetItemProperties(null));
			obj = null;
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < enumerable.Count; j++)
			{
				obj = enumerable[j];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					internalNTV[num] = NTV.GetNTV(obj, props);
					if (internalNTV[num].Length > 0 && internalNTV[num].Length < totalColumns)
					{
						totalColumns = internalNTV[num].Length;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return totalRows;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return totalColumns;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (row < GetRowCount())
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(internalNTV[row][column].Value);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (row < GetRowCount())
			{
				return internalNTV[row][column].Value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			return internalNTV[row][column].Value.ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			if (row < GetRowCount())
			{
				NTV[] array = internalNTV[row];
				foreach (NTV nTV in array)
				{
					if (nTV.Type.Equals(typeof(string)))
					{
						if (nTV.Value == null)
						{
							return "null";
						}
						return nTV.Value.ToString();
					}
				}
				if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && internalNTV.Length > 0 && rowLabelsColumn < internalNTV[0].Length && internalNTV[row][rowLabelsColumn] != null && internalNTV[row][rowLabelsColumn].Value != null)
				{
					return internalNTV[row][rowLabelsColumn].Value.ToString();
				}
			}
			return "ROW" + row;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			return internalNTV[0][column].Name;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < totalRows; i++)
			{
				object objectValue = GetObjectValue(i, column);
				flag = (objectValue != null && Util.NumericTypes.ContainsKey(objectValue.GetType())) || (internalNTV != null && internalNTV.Length > 0 && internalNTV[i] != null && internalNTV[i].Length > column && internalNTV[i][column] != null && Util.NumericTypes.ContainsKey(internalNTV[i][column].Type));
				if (flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (!(GetObjectValue(0, column) is DateTime))
			{
				if (internalNTV != null && internalNTV.Length > 0 && internalNTV[0] != null && internalNTV[0].Length > column && internalNTV[0][column] != null)
				{
					return internalNTV[0][column].Type == typeof(DateTime);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (!(GetObjectValue(0, column) is string))
			{
				if (internalNTV != null && internalNTV.Length > 0 && internalNTV[0] != null && internalNTV[0].Length > column && internalNTV[0][column] != null)
				{
					return internalNTV[0][column].Type == typeof(string);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(row, column);
			if (objectValue != null)
			{
				return Util.NumericTypes.ContainsKey(objectValue.GetType());
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class NTV
	{
		private string _Name;

		private Type _Type;

		private object _Value;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _Name;
			}
			set
			{
				_Name = value;
			}
		}

		public Type Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _Type;
			}
			set
			{
				_Type = value;
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _Value;
			}
			set
			{
				_Value = value;
			}
		}

		public NTV(string name, Type type, object val)
		{
			Name = name;
			Type = type;
			Value = val;
		}

		public static NTV[] GetNTV(object objectUnderObservation)
		{
			return GetNTV(objectUnderObservation, null);
		}

		public static NTV[] GetNTV(object objectUnderObservation, PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			if (props == null)
			{
				props = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(objectUnderObservation);
			}
			NTV[] array = new NTV[props.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < props.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = props[i].GetValue(objectUnderObservation);
				if (obj is DBNull)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				array[i] = new NTV(props[i].Name, props[i].PropertyType, obj);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	public class CandleSeries : SeriesBase
	{
		private CandleDataPointCollection _Points;

		private CandleSeriesDataAppearance _Data;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_34")]
		public CandleDataPointCollection Points => _Points;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public CandleSeriesDataAppearance Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public CandleSeries()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public CandleSeries(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Points = new CandleDataPointCollection(chartComponent);
			_Data = new CandleSeriesDataAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Points;
		}

		public CandleSeries Clone()
		{
			CandleSeries candleSeries = new CandleSeries(base.ChartComponent);
			candleSeries.Data = Data;
			candleSeries.Key = Key;
			candleSeries.Label = Label;
			candleSeries.Visible = Visible;
			candleSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			candleSeries._Points = Points.Clone();
			return candleSeries;
		}

		protected override ISeries OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data != null && Data.DataSource != null && Data.DataSource is DataTable)
			{
				DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
				for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
				{
					CandleDataPoint candleDataPoint = new CandleDataPoint();
					candleDataPoint.Date = DateTime.Parse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.DateColumn].ToString());
					double result = 0.0;
					double result2 = 0.0;
					double result3 = 0.0;
					double result4 = 0.0;
					double result5 = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.OpenColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LowColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.HighColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result3);
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.CloseColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result4);
					double.TryParse(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.VolumeColumn].ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result5);
					candleDataPoint.Open = result;
					candleDataPoint.Low = result2;
					candleDataPoint.High = result3;
					candleDataPoint.Close = result4;
					candleDataPoint.Volume = result5;
					candleDataPoint.DataBound = true;
					Points.Add(candleDataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public DateTime GetStartDate()
		{
			DateTime result = DateTime.MaxValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				if (result.CompareTo(point.Date) > 0)
				{
					result = point.Date;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public DateTime GetEndDate()
		{
			DateTime result = DateTime.MinValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				if (result.CompareTo(point.Date) < 0)
				{
					result = point.Date;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public double GetDataMaximumForOpenLowHighClose()
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, Math.Max(point.Open, Math.Max(point.Low, Math.Max(point.High, point.Close))));
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetDataMinimumForOpenLowHighClose()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, Math.Min(point.Open, Math.Min(point.Low, Math.Min(point.High, point.Close))));
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetDataMaximumForVolume()
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, point.Volume);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetDataMinimumForVolume()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (CandleDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, point.Volume);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string closeColumn, string dateColumn, string highColumn, string lowColumn, string openColumn, string volumeColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.CloseColumn = closeColumn;
			Data.DateColumn = dateColumn;
			Data.HighColumn = highColumn;
			Data.LowColumn = lowColumn;
			Data.OpenColumn = openColumn;
			Data.VolumeColumn = volumeColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string closeColumn, string dateColumn, string highColumn, string lowColumn, string openColumn, string volumeColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.CloseColumn = closeColumn;
			Data.DateColumn = dateColumn;
			Data.HighColumn = highColumn;
			Data.LowColumn = lowColumn;
			Data.OpenColumn = openColumn;
			Data.VolumeColumn = volumeColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string closeColumn, string dateColumn, string highColumn, string lowColumn, string openColumn, string volumeColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.CloseColumn = closeColumn;
			Data.DateColumn = dateColumn;
			Data.HighColumn = highColumn;
			Data.LowColumn = lowColumn;
			Data.OpenColumn = openColumn;
			Data.VolumeColumn = volumeColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Series
{
	public class NumericDataPointCollection : DataPointCollection
	{
		internal class ValueComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object a, object b)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = a as NumericDataPoint;
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2 = b as NumericDataPoint;
				if (numericDataPoint == numericDataPoint2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (numericDataPoint != null && numericDataPoint2 != null)
				{
					double num = numericDataPoint.Value - numericDataPoint2.Value;
					if (num < 0.0)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public NumericDataPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.List[index] as NumericDataPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual NumericDataPoint[] ToArray()
		{
			NumericDataPoint[] array = new NumericDataPoint[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		public virtual void AddRange(NumericDataPoint[] points)
		{
			foreach (NumericDataPoint point in points)
			{
				Add(point);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Contains(NumericDataPoint point)
		{
			return base.List.Contains(point);
		}

		public NumericDataPointCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public NumericDataPointCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public int Add(NumericDataPoint point)
		{
			return AddPoint(point);
		}

		protected override DataPointCollection OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public NumericDataPointCollection Clone()
		{
			NumericDataPointCollection numericDataPointCollection = new NumericDataPointCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				numericDataPointCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return numericDataPointCollection;
		}

		protected override object OnAddNew()
		{
			return this[Add(new NumericDataPoint())];
		}

		public virtual void Sort()
		{
			base.List.Sort(new ValueComparer());
		}

		public virtual void Reverse()
		{
			base.List.Reverse();
		}
	}
}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	public class TreeMapDataPoint : DataPointBase, IComparable
	{
		private double _SizeValue;

		private double _ColorValue;

		private TreeMapDataPointCollection _Points;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public int GetMaxDepth
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in Points)
				{
					int num2 = 1 + point.GetMaxDepth;
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(0.0)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_TreeMapDataPoint_SizeValue")]
		public double SizeValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasChildren)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					{
						foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in Points)
						{
							if (!point.Empty)
							{
								num += Math.Abs(point.SizeValue);
							}
						}
						return num;
					}
				}
				return _SizeValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_SizeValue = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(0.0)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_TreeMapDataPoint_ColorValue")]
		public double ColorValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasChildren)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					{
						foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in Points)
						{
							num += point.ColorValue;
						}
						return num;
					}
				}
				return _ColorValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_ColorValue = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public TreeMapDataPointCollection Points => _Points;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool HasChildren => _Points.Count > 0;

		public TreeMapDataPoint()
			: this(0.0, 0.0, "", empty: false)
		{
		}

		public TreeMapDataPoint(string label, bool empty)
			: base(label, empty)
		{
			SizeValue = 0.0;
			ColorValue = 0.0;
			Label = label;
			_Points = new TreeMapDataPointCollection(base.ChartComponent);
		}

		public TreeMapDataPoint(double sizeValue, double colorValue, string label, bool empty)
			: base(label, empty)
		{
			SizeValue = sizeValue;
			ColorValue = colorValue;
			Label = label;
			_Points = new TreeMapDataPointCollection(base.ChartComponent);
		}

		public int CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TreeMapDataPoint)
			{
				TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = (TreeMapDataPoint)obj;
				return SizeValue.CompareTo(treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("object is not a TreeMapDataPoint");
		}

		protected override DataPointBase OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public TreeMapDataPoint Clone()
		{
			TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = new TreeMapDataPoint();
			treeMapDataPoint._Points = Points.Clone();
			treeMapDataPoint.ColorValue = ColorValue;
			treeMapDataPoint.DataBound = DataBound;
			treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue = SizeValue;
			treeMapDataPoint.Empty = Empty;
			treeMapDataPoint.Label = Label;
			treeMapDataPoint.PE = PE.Clone();
			return treeMapDataPoint;
		}

		public virtual bool Match(TreeMapDataPoint pointB)
		{
			if (Empty == pointB.Empty && Label == pointB.Label && PE.Match(pointB.PE))
			{
				return SizeValue == pointB.SizeValue;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	public class FourDimensionalNumericSeries : SeriesBase
	{
		private FourDimensionalNumericDataPointCollection _Points;

		private FourDimensionalNumericSeriesDataAppearance _Data;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_34")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public FourDimensionalNumericDataPointCollection Points => _Points;

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public FourDimensionalNumericSeriesDataAppearance Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public FourDimensionalNumericSeries()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public FourDimensionalNumericSeries(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Points = new FourDimensionalNumericDataPointCollection(chartComponent);
			Data = new FourDimensionalNumericSeriesDataAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Points;
		}

		public FourDimensionalNumericSeries Clone()
		{
			FourDimensionalNumericSeries fourDimensionalNumericSeries = new FourDimensionalNumericSeries(base.ChartComponent);
			fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Data = Data;
			fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Key = Key;
			fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Visible = Visible;
			fourDimensionalNumericSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			foreach (FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Points.Add(point.Clone());
			}
			fourDimensionalNumericSeries.Label = Label;
			return fourDimensionalNumericSeries;
		}

		protected override ISeries OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data != null && Data.DataSource != null && Data.DataSource is DataTable)
			{
				DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
				for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
				{
					FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint = new FourDimensionalNumericDataPoint();
					object obj = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueWColumn];
					object obj2 = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueXColumn];
					object obj3 = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueYColumn];
					object obj4 = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueZColumn];
					string label = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LabelColumn].ToString();
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.Label = label;
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.Empty = obj2 is DBNull || obj2 == null || obj3 is DBNull || obj3 == null || obj4 is DBNull || obj4 == null;
					double result = 0.0;
					double result2 = 0.0;
					double result3 = 0.0;
					double result4 = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(obj.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					double.TryParse(obj2.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result2);
					double.TryParse(obj3.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result3);
					double.TryParse(obj4.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result4);
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueW = result;
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueX = result2;
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueY = result3;
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.ValueZ = result4;
					fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint.DataBound = true;
					Points.Add(fourDimensionalNumericDataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string valueXColumn, string valueYColumn, string valueZColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.ValueXColumn = valueXColumn;
			Data.ValueYColumn = valueYColumn;
			Data.ValueZColumn = valueZColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string valueXColumn, string valueYColumn, string valueZColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.ValueXColumn = valueXColumn;
			Data.ValueYColumn = valueYColumn;
			Data.ValueZColumn = valueZColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string valueXColumn, string valueYColumn, string valueZColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.ValueXColumn = valueXColumn;
			Data.ValueYColumn = valueYColumn;
			Data.ValueZColumn = valueZColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string valueXColumn, string valueYColumn, string valueZColumn)
		{

			Data.ValueXColumn = valueXColumn;

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	public class NumericSeries : SeriesBase
	{
		private NumericDataPointCollection _Points;

		private NumericSeriesDataAppearance _Data;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_34")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public NumericDataPointCollection Points => _Points;

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public NumericSeriesDataAppearance Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public NumericSeries()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public NumericSeries(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Points = new NumericDataPointCollection(chartComponent);
			Data = new NumericSeriesDataAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Points;
		}

		public NumericSeries Clone()
		{
			NumericSeries numericSeries = new NumericSeries(base.ChartComponent);
			numericSeries.Data = Data;
			numericSeries.Key = Key;
			numericSeries.Label = Label;
			numericSeries.Visible = Visible;
			numericSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			foreach (NumericDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				numericSeries.Points.Add(point.Clone());
			}
			return numericSeries;
		}

		protected override ISeries OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data == null || Data.DataSource == null || Data.ValueColumn == null || !(Data.DataSource is DataTable))
			{
				return;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
				if (dataTable.Rows[i].RowState != DataRowState.Deleted)
				{
					object obj = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueColumn];
					string label = "";
					if (Data.LabelColumn != null)
					{
						label = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LabelColumn].ToString();
					}
					numericDataPoint.Empty = obj is DBNull || obj == null || (obj is INullable && ((INullable)obj).IsNull);
					numericDataPoint.Label = label;
					double result = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(obj.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					numericDataPoint.Value = result;
					numericDataPoint.DataBound = true;
					Points.Add(numericDataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string valueColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string valueColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string valueColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			if (dataSet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataSet");
			}
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string valueColumn)
		{
			if (dataSet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataSet");
			}
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			DataBind();
		}
	}

	public class NumericTimeSeries : SeriesBase
	{
		private NumericTimeDataPointCollection _Points;

		private NumericTimeSeriesDataAppearance _Data;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20053_34")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public NumericTimeDataPointCollection Points => _Points;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public NumericTimeSeriesDataAppearance Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesDataAppearance GetDataAppearance()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public NumericTimeSeries()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public NumericTimeSeries(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Points = new NumericTimeDataPointCollection(chartComponent);
			Data = new NumericTimeSeriesDataAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Points;
		}

		public NumericTimeSeries Clone()
		{
			NumericTimeSeries numericTimeSeries = new NumericTimeSeries(base.ChartComponent);
			numericTimeSeries.Data = Data;
			numericTimeSeries.Key = Key;
			numericTimeSeries.Label = Label;
			numericTimeSeries.Visible = Visible;
			numericTimeSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			foreach (NumericTimeDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				numericTimeSeries.Points.Add(point.Clone());
			}
			return numericTimeSeries;
		}

		protected override ISeries OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data != null && Data.DataSource != null && Data.ValueColumn != null && Data.DataSource is DataTable)
			{
				DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
				bool flag = Data.LabelColumn != null && dataTable.Columns.Contains(Data.LabelColumn);
				for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
				{
					NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = new NumericTimeDataPoint();
					object obj = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueColumn];
					string label = ((!flag) ? "" : dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LabelColumn].ToString());
					numericTimeDataPoint.Empty = obj is DBNull || obj == null || (obj is INullable && ((INullable)obj).IsNull);
					numericTimeDataPoint.Label = label;
					double result = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(obj.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue = result;
					numericTimeDataPoint.TimeValue = Infragistics.UltraChart.Data.Util.DateTimeFromObject(dataTable.Rows[i][Data.TimeValueColumn]);
					numericTimeDataPoint.DataBound = true;
					Points.Add(numericTimeDataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string timeValueColumn, string valueColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.TimeValueColumn = timeValueColumn;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataTable dataTable, string timeValueColumn, string valueColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataTable;
			Data.TimeValueColumn = timeValueColumn;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		public void DataBind(DataSet dataSet, int tableIndex, string timeValueColumn, string valueColumn, string labelColumn)
		{
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.TimeValueColumn = timeValueColumn;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			Data.LabelColumn = labelColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

		{
			Data.DataSource = dataSet.Tables[tableIndex];
			Data.TimeValueColumn = timeValueColumn;
			Data.ValueColumn = valueColumn;
			DataBind();
		}

	public class SeriesCollection : ChartAppearance, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable, IChartData, IProvideGroupedLabels
	{
		private ArrayList _List = new ArrayList();

		public ISeries this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count > index)
				{
					return List[index] as ISeries;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected ArrayList List
		{
			get
			{
				return _List;
			}
			set
			{
				_List = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => List.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => List.IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => List.SyncRoot;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => List.IsFixedSize;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => List.IsReadOnly;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		int IProvideGroupedLabels.ItemCountTotal
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
						num += series.GetPoints().Count;
					}
					return num;
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		int IProvideGroupedLabels.SeriesCountTotal => Count;

		internal void RemoveDataViewEventHandlers()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
					if (series is SeriesBase seriesBase)
					{
						seriesBase.ClearListChangedEventHandlers();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public SeriesCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public SeriesCollection Clone()
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = new SeriesCollection();
			seriesCollection.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			seriesCollection.component = component;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				seriesCollection.Add(this[i].Clone() as ISeries);
			}
			seriesCollection.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			return seriesCollection;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "{Count = " + Count + "}";
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
					if (series is SeriesBase seriesBase)
					{
						seriesBase.ChartComponent = component;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(ISeries series)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("series");
			}
			IProvideChartComponent provideChartComponent = (IProvideChartComponent)series;
			if (provideChartComponent != null && provideChartComponent.ChartComponent == null)
			{
				provideChartComponent.ChartComponent = component;
			}
			if (series.Key == null || series.Key.Length == 0)
			{
				int num = Count;
				string key;
				do
				{
					num++;
					key = "series" + num;
				}
				while (FromKey(key) != null);
				series.Key = key;
			}
			int result = List.Add(series);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		public void AddRange(ISeries[] items)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				Add(items[i]);
			}
		}

		public ISeries[] ToArray()
		{
			return (ISeries[])List.ToArray(typeof(ISeries));
		}

		public int IndexOf(object obj)
		{
			return List.IndexOf(obj);
		}

		public ISeries FromKey(string key)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
					if (series.Key == key)
					{
						return series;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void DataBind()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] is SeriesBase seriesBase)
				{
					seriesBase.DataBind();
				}
			}
		}

		int IChartData.GetColumnCount()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = this[0].GetPoints().Count;
			for (int i = 1; i < Count; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, this[i].GetPoints().Count);
			}
			return num;
		}

		double IChartData.GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			IDataPoint dataPoint = this[row].GetPoints()[column];
			if (dataPoint is NumericDataPoint)
			{
				return ((NumericDataPoint)dataPoint).Value;
			}
			if (dataPoint is NumericTimeDataPoint)
			{
				return ((NumericTimeDataPoint)dataPoint).NumericValue;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		string IChartData.GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (Count > row)

				IProvideDataPoints points = this[row].GetPoints();
				if (points != null && points.Count > column)
				{
					return this[row].GetPoints()[column].Label;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		double IChartData.GetDataMaxColumn(int column)
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				IProvideDataPoints points = this[i].GetPoints();
				if (points[column] is NumericDataPoint)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, ((NumericDataPoint)points[column]).Value);
				}
				else if (points[column] is XYZDataPoint)
				{
					XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = (XYZDataPoint)points[column];
					num = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(xYZDataPoint.ValueX, xYZDataPoint.ValueY), xYZDataPoint.ValueZ), num);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

		public object GetDataMaximum(AxisDataType dataType)
		{
			switch (dataType)
			{
			case AxisDataType.Time:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator2 = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series2 = (ISeries)enumerator2.Current;
							IProvideDataPoints points2 = series2.GetPoints();
							for (int j = 0; j < points2.Count; j++)
							{
								if (points2[j] is GanttItem)
								{
									GanttItem ganttItem = (GanttItem)points2[j];
									foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in ganttItem.Times)
									{
										if (dateTime.CompareTo(time.End) <= 0)
										{
											dateTime = time.End;
										}
									}
								}
								else if (points2[j] is NumericTimeDataPoint)
								{
									DateTime timeValue = ((NumericTimeDataPoint)points2[j]).TimeValue;
									if (dateTime.CompareTo(timeValue) <= 0)
									{
										dateTime = timeValue;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator2 as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return dateTime;
			}
			default:
			{
				double num = double.MinValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
							IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
							for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
							{
								if (points[i] is NumericDataPoint)
								{
									num = Math.Max(((NumericDataPoint)points[i]).Value, num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is XYDataPoint)
								{
									XYDataPoint xYDataPoint = (XYDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Max(Math.Max(xYDataPoint.ValueX, xYDataPoint.ValueY), num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is XYZDataPoint)
								{
									XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = (XYZDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(xYZDataPoint.ValueX, xYZDataPoint.ValueY), xYZDataPoint.ValueZ), num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is NumericTimeDataPoint)
								{
									NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = (NumericTimeDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Max(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue, num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is BoxSet)
								{
									BoxSet boxSet = (BoxSet)points[i];
									num = Math.Max(num, Math.Max(boxSet.Max, Math.Max(boxSet.Min, Math.Max(boxSet.Q1, Math.Max(boxSet.Q2, boxSet.Q3)))));
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable2 = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable2 != null)
						{
							disposable2.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == double.MinValue)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			}
		}

		public object GetDataMinimum(AxisDataType dataType)
		{
			switch (dataType)
			{
			case AxisDataType.Time:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator2 = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series2 = (ISeries)enumerator2.Current;
							IProvideDataPoints points2 = series2.GetPoints();
							for (int j = 0; j < points2.Count; j++)
							{
								if (points2[j] is GanttItem)
								{
									GanttItem ganttItem = (GanttItem)points2[j];
									foreach (GanttTimeEntry time in ganttItem.Times)
									{
										if (dateTime.CompareTo(time.Start) >= 0)
										{
											dateTime = time.Start;
										}
									}
								}
								else if (points2[j] is NumericTimeDataPoint)
								{
									DateTime timeValue = ((NumericTimeDataPoint)points2[j]).TimeValue;
									if (dateTime.CompareTo(timeValue) > 0 && timeValue.CompareTo(DateTime.MinValue) > 0)
									{
										dateTime = timeValue;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator2 as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return dateTime;
			}
			default:
			{
				double num = GetMinimumAccortingToZeroAligned();
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
							IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
							for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
							{
								if (points[i] is NumericDataPoint)
								{
									num = Math.Min(((NumericDataPoint)points[i]).Value, num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is XYDataPoint)
								{
									XYDataPoint xYDataPoint = (XYDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Min(Math.Min(xYDataPoint.ValueX, xYDataPoint.ValueY), num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is XYZDataPoint)
								{
									XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = (XYZDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Min(Math.Min(Math.Min(xYZDataPoint.ValueX, xYZDataPoint.ValueY), xYZDataPoint.ValueZ), num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is NumericTimeDataPoint)
								{
									NumericTimeDataPoint numericTimeDataPoint = (NumericTimeDataPoint)points[i];
									num = Math.Min(numericTimeDataPoint.NumericValue, num);
								}
								else if (points[i] is BoxSet)
								{
									BoxSet boxSet = (BoxSet)points[i];
									num = Math.Min(num, Math.Min(boxSet.Max, Math.Min(boxSet.Min, Math.Min(boxSet.Q1, Math.Min(boxSet.Q2, boxSet.Q3)))));
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable2 = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable2 != null)
						{
							disposable2.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == double.MaxValue)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			}
		}

		private double GetMinimumAccortingToZeroAligned()
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (List.Count == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			IProvideChartComponent provideChartComponent = (IProvideChartComponent)List[0];
			bool flag = false;
			if (provideChartComponent.ChartComponent != null && provideChartComponent.ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) is DataAppearance dataAppearance)
			{
				flag = dataAppearance.ZeroAligned;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				result = double.MaxValue;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object GetMinimum(DataDimension dimension)
		{
			switch (dimension)
			{
			case DataDimension.XValues:
			{
				double num2 = double.MaxValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator3 = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator3.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series2 = (ISeries)enumerator3.Current;
							if (series2 is XYSeries)
							{
								XYDataPointCollection points2 = ((XYSeries)series2).Points;
								foreach (XYDataPoint item in points2)
								{
									num2 = Math.Min(num2, item.ValueX);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								if (!(series2 is XYZSeries))
								{
									continue;
								}
								XYZDataPointCollection points3 = ((XYZSeries)series2).Points;
								foreach (XYZDataPoint item2 in points3)
								{
									num2 = Math.Min(num2, item2.ValueX);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator3 as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return num2;
			}
			case DataDimension.YValues:
			{
				double num3 = double.MaxValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator6 = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator6.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series3 = (ISeries)enumerator6.Current;
							if (series3 is XYSeries)
							{
								XYDataPointCollection points4 = ((XYSeries)series3).Points;
								foreach (XYDataPoint item3 in points4)
								{
									num3 = Math.Min(num3, item3.ValueY);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								if (!(series3 is XYZSeries))
								{
									continue;
								}
								XYZDataPointCollection points5 = ((XYZSeries)series3).Points;
								foreach (XYZDataPoint item4 in points5)
								{
									num3 = Math.Min(num3, item4.ValueY);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable2 = enumerator6 as IDisposable;
						if (disposable2 != null)
						{
							disposable2.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return num3;
			}
			case DataDimension.ZValues:
			{
				double num = double.MaxValue;
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
							if (!(series is XYZSeries))
							{
								continue;
							}
							XYZDataPointCollection points = ((XYZSeries)series).Points;
							foreach (XYZDataPoint item5 in points)
							{
								num = Math.Min(num, item5.ValueZ);
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable3 = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable3 != null)
						{
							disposable3.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public virtual SeriesCollection GetVisibleSeries()
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = new SeriesCollection();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ISeries series = (ISeries)enumerator.Current;
					SeriesBase seriesBase = series as SeriesBase;
					if (seriesBase == null || seriesBase.Visible)
					{
						seriesCollection.Add(seriesBase);
					}
				}
				return seriesCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

	public enum DataDimension
	{
		XValues,
		YValues,
		ZValues

	internal class SeriesSwap
	{
		private SeriesSwap()
		{
		}

		internal static SeriesCollection Swap(SeriesCollection input)
		{
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = new SeriesCollection();
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			foreach (SeriesBase item2 in input)
			{
				Type type = item2.GetType();
				if (hashtable[type] == null)
				{
					hashtable[type] = new SeriesCollection();
				}
				(hashtable[type] as SeriesCollection).Add(item2);
			}
			foreach (Type key in hashtable.Keys)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection2 = hashtable[key] as SeriesCollection;
				if (seriesCollection2.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IProvideDataPoints[] array = new IProvideDataPoints[seriesCollection2.Count];
				PaintElementCollection[] array2 = new PaintElementCollection[seriesCollection2.Count];
				string[] array3 = new string[seriesCollection2.Count];
				int num = -1;
				for (int i = 0; i < seriesCollection2.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = seriesCollection2[i].GetPoints();
					array2[i] = seriesCollection2[i].PEs;
					array3[i] = seriesCollection2[i].Label;
					if (array[i].Count > num)
					{
						num = array[i].Count;
					}
				}
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = key.GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (!(constructor.Invoke(null) is ISeries series))
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<string> list = new List<string>(5);
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
					{
						IProvideDataPoints provideDataPoints = array[k];
						if (j >= provideDataPoints.Count)
						{
							continue;
						}
						IDataPoint dataPoint = provideDataPoints[j];
						if (dataPoint == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (dataPoint.Label != null && dataPoint.Label.Trim().Length > 0)
						{
							string item = dataPoint.Label.Trim();
							if (!list.Contains(item))
							{
								list.Add(item);
							}
						}
						if (dataPoint.GetType().InvokeMember("Clone", BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, dataPoint, new object[0]) is IDataPoint dataPoint2)
						{
							dataPoint2.Label = array3[k];
							if (dataPoint.PE != null && dataPoint.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
							{
								dataPoint2.PE = dataPoint.PE;
							}
							else if (array2.Length > 0 && array2[k % array2.Length] != null && array2[k % array2.Length].Count > 0)
							{
								PaintElementCollection paintElementCollection = array2[k % array2.Length];
								dataPoint2.PE = paintElementCollection[k % paintElementCollection.Count];
							}
							((DataPointCollection)series.GetPoints()).AddPointInternal(dataPoint2);
							num2++;
						}
					}
					if (num2 <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = null;
					int num3 = 0;
					foreach (string item3 in list)
					{
						text = text + ((num3 == 0) ? "" : ", ") + item3;
						num3++;
					}
					series.Label = text;
					seriesCollection.Add(series);
				}
			}
			return seriesCollection;
		}
	}

		private TreeMapDataPoint _FindParentOf(TreeMapDataPoint queryPoint, TreeMapDataPoint currentPoint, TreeMapDataPoint currentParent)
		{
			if (currentPoint == queryPoint)
			{
				return currentParent;
			}
			TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = null;
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in currentPoint.Points)
			{
				treeMapDataPoint = _FindParentOf(queryPoint, point, currentPoint);
				if (treeMapDataPoint != null)
				{
					return treeMapDataPoint;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public TreeMapDataPoint FindParentOf(TreeMapDataPoint point)
		{
			TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = new TreeMapDataPoint(Label, empty: false);
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point2 in Points)
			{
				treeMapDataPoint.Points.Add(point2);
			}
			TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint2 = null;
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point3 in Points)
			{
				treeMapDataPoint2 = _FindParentOf(point, point3, treeMapDataPoint);
				if (treeMapDataPoint2 != null)
				{
					return treeMapDataPoint2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IProvideDataPoints ProvidePoints()
		{
			return Points;
		}

			treeMapSeries.Key = Key;
			treeMapSeries.Label = Label;
			treeMapSeries.Visible = Visible;
			treeMapSeries.SetPEs(PEs.Clone());
			foreach (TreeMapDataPoint point in Points)
			{
				treeMapSeries.Points.Add(point.Clone());
			}
			return treeMapSeries;
		}

		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected override void InitializeData()
		{
			base.InitializeData();
			if (Data == null || Data.DataSource == null || Data.ValueColumn == null || !(Data.DataSource is DataTable))
			{
				return;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = (DataTable)Data.DataSource;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				TreeMapDataPoint treeMapDataPoint = new TreeMapDataPoint();
				if (dataTable.Rows[i].RowState != DataRowState.Deleted)
				{
					object obj = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.ValueColumn];
					string label = "";
					if (Data.LabelColumn != null)
					{
						label = dataTable.Rows[i][Data.LabelColumn].ToString();
					}
					treeMapDataPoint.Empty = obj is DBNull || obj == null || (obj is INullable && ((INullable)obj).IsNull);
					treeMapDataPoint.Label = label;
					double result = 0.0;
					double.TryParse(obj.ToString(), NumberStyles.Any, null, out result);
					treeMapDataPoint.SizeValue = result;
					treeMapDataPoint.DataBound = true;
					Points.Add(treeMapDataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

			object obj36 = (int32Types3[typeFromHandle19] = obj34);
