			int32Types[typeFromHandle17] = value4;
		}

		public static DateTime DateTimeFromObject(object timeObject)
		{
			if (timeObject is DateTime)
			{
				return (DateTime)timeObject;
			}
			if (timeObject != null)
			{
				try
				{
					return DateTime.Parse(timeObject.ToString());
				}
				catch (FormatException)
				{
				}
			}
			return DateTime.MinValue;
		}
	}
	public class XMLToChartAdapter : ChartDataAdapter
	{
		private DataTable tableConnectedTo;

		public XMLToChartAdapter(DataTable connectTo)
		{
			tableConnectedTo = connectTo;
		}

		public override int GetRowCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count;
		}

		public override int GetColumnCount()
		{
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count;
		}

		public override double GetValue(int row, int column)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				object value = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
				try
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ex.ToString();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override object GetObjectValue(int row, int column)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (row < GetRowCount() && column < GetColumnCount())
			{
				result = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string GetStringValue(int row, int column)
		{
			if (IsColumnString(column))
			{
				return (string)tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][column];
			}
			return GetValue(row, column).ToString();
		}

		public override object GetRowLabel(int row)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (useRowLabel && rowLabelsColumn >= 0 && rowLabelsColumn < tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				obj = tableConnectedTo.Rows[row][rowLabelsColumn];
				if (row >= GetRowCount() || rowLabelsColumn >= GetColumnCount())
				{
					obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = DataConstString.DemoRowLabel + row;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetColumnLabel(int column)
		{
			if (column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return DataConstString.DemoColLabel + column;
			}
			return tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].ColumnName;
		}

		public bool IsTableDataValid()
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableConnectedTo.Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string) || dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnDateTime(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnString(int column)
		{
			if (tableConnectedTo == null || column >= tableConnectedTo.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type dataType = tableConnectedTo.Columns[column].DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsColumnNumeric(int row, int column)
		{
			return IsColumnNumeric(column);
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Render.Flash
{
	internal class BasicFlashDrawing
	{
		private FlashDocument flashDocument;

		private Graphics graphics;

		private DefineButton defineButton = new DefineButton();

		internal FlashDocument FlashDocument
		{
			get
			{
				return flashDocument;
			}
			set
			{
				flashDocument = value;
			}
		}

		internal Graphics Graphics
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics = value;
			}
		}

		internal BasicFlashDrawing()
		{
		}

		private DefineButton FindButton(string url)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < flashDocument.FlashContainer.Urls.Count; i++)
			{
				if (url == (string)flashDocument.FlashContainer.Urls[i])
				{
					return (DefineButton)flashDocument.FlashContainer.DefineButtons[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void DrawWidenPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath pathOutline)
		{
			Pen pen2 = new Pen(pen.Color);
			pen2.Width = pen.Width;
			pen2.DashStyle = pen.DashStyle;
			DrawSolidPath(new Pen(pen.Color), pathOutline);
			if (pen.StartCap != LineCap.Flat)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = (GraphicsPath)pathOutline.Clone();
				graphicsPath.Widen(pen, new Matrix());
				GraphicsPathIterator graphicsPathIterator = new GraphicsPathIterator(graphicsPath);
				GraphicsPath path = new GraphicsPath();
				bool isClosed = false;
				for (int i = 1; i <= graphicsPathIterator.SubpathCount - 1; i++)
				{
					graphicsPathIterator.NextSubpath(path, out isClosed);
				}
				FillFlashPath(new SolidBrush(pen.Color), path);
			}
			if (pen.EndCap != LineCap.Flat)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = (GraphicsPath)pathOutline.Clone();
				graphicsPath2.Widen(pen, new Matrix());
				GraphicsPathIterator graphicsPathIterator2 = new GraphicsPathIterator(graphicsPath2);
				GraphicsPath path2 = new GraphicsPath();
				bool isClosed2 = false;
				for (int j = 1; j <= graphicsPathIterator2.SubpathCount; j++)
				{
					graphicsPathIterator2.NextSubpath(path2, out isClosed2);
				}
				FillFlashPath(new SolidBrush(pen.Color), path2);
			}
		}

		private void AlignPoints(PointF first, PointF second, PointF[] points)
		{
			if (first.X == second.X)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Length - 1; i++)
				{
					points[i + 1].X = points[i].X;
				}
			}
			if (first.Y == second.Y)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < points.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					points[j + 1].Y = points[j].Y;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DrawFlashPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if ((pen.StartCap != LineCap.Flat || pen.EndCap != LineCap.Flat || pen.DashStyle != DashStyle.Solid) && path.PointCount == 2)
			{
				DrawWidenPath(pen, path);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawSolidPath(pen, path);
			}
		}

		private void DrawSolidPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (FlashDocument.FlashContainer.UrlString == "")
			{
				SetClip();
				DrawSolidButtonPath(pen, path);
				PlaceObject2 placeObject = new PlaceObject2();
				placeObject.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, graphics.Transform);
				flashDocument.Set(placeObject);
				flashDocument.ShapeID++;
				return;
			}
			ButtonRecord buttonRecord = new ButtonRecord();
			Pen pen2 = pen;
			pen2 = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(flashDocument.FlashContainer.chartControl.Tooltips.PE.StrokeOpacity, flashDocument.FlashContainer.chartControl.Tooltips.PE.Stroke), flashDocument.FlashContainer.chartControl.Tooltips.PE.StrokeWidth);
			DrawSolidButtonPath(pen2, path);
			flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			buttonRecord.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID - 1, graphics.Transform, overState: true);
			defineButton.AddButtonRecord(buttonRecord);
			DrawSolidButtonPath(pen, path);
			flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			buttonRecord = new ButtonRecord();
			buttonRecord.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID - 1, graphics.Transform, overState: false);
			defineButton.AddButtonRecord(buttonRecord);
		}

		internal void SetClip()
		{
			RectangleF clipBounds = graphics.ClipBounds;
			SetClip(clipBounds);
		}

		internal void SetClip(RectangleF clip)
		{
			if (clip.Width < 1000f && clip.Height < 1000f)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPath.AddRectangle(clip);
				FillFlashButtonPath(new SolidBrush(Color.Black), graphicsPath);
				PlaceObject2 placeObject = new PlaceObject2();
				placeObject.ClipDepth = flashDocument.ShapeID + 1;
				placeObject.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, graphics.Transform);
				flashDocument.Set(placeObject);
				flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			}
		}

		private void DrawSolidButtonPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			DefineShape3 defineShape = new DefineShape3();
			LineStyle lineStyle = new LineStyle();
			lineStyle.Set(color: pen.PenType switch
			{
				PenType.LinearGradient => ((LinearGradientBrush)pen.Brush).LinearColors[0], 
				PenType.PathGradient => ((PathGradientBrush)pen.Brush).SurroundColors[0], 
				_ => pen.Color, 
			}, width: (int)pen.Width);
			defineShape.Shape.LineStyles.AddLineStyle(lineStyle);
			path.Flatten();
			PointF[] pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			Point[] array = ConvertToTwips(pathPoints);
			byte[] pathTypes = path.PathTypes;
			int x = 0;
			int y = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 1) == 0)
				{
					StyleChangeRecord styleChangeRecord = new StyleChangeRecord();
					styleChangeRecord.LineStyle = 1;
					styleChangeRecord.Set(array[i].X, array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(styleChangeRecord);
					num = array[i].X;
					num2 = array[i].Y;
				}
				else if ((pathTypes[i] & 1) == 1)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord.Set(x, y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord);
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 0x80) == 128)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord2 = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord2.Set(num - array[i].X, num2 - array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord2);
				}
				if (i < array.Length - 1)
				{
					x = array[i + 1].X - array[i].X;
					y = array[i + 1].Y - array[i].Y;
				}
			}
			EndShapeRecord endShapeRecord = new EndShapeRecord();
			endShapeRecord.Set();
			defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(endShapeRecord);
			defineShape.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, path.GetBounds());
			flashDocument.Set(defineShape);
		}

		internal void FillFlashPath(Brush brush, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (FlashDocument.FlashContainer.UrlString == "")
			{
				SetClip();
				FillFlashButtonPath(brush, path);
				PlaceObject2 placeObject = new PlaceObject2();
				placeObject.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, graphics.Transform);
				flashDocument.Set(placeObject);
				flashDocument.ShapeID++;
				return;
			}
			ButtonRecord buttonRecord = new ButtonRecord();
			Brush brush2 = brush;
			brush2 = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(flashDocument.FlashContainer.chartControl.Tooltips.PE.FillOpacity, flashDocument.FlashContainer.chartControl.Tooltips.PE.Fill));
			defineButton = FindButton(FlashDocument.FlashContainer.UrlString);
			FillFlashButtonPath(brush2, path);
			flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			buttonRecord.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID - 1, graphics.Transform, overState: true);
			defineButton.AddButtonRecord(buttonRecord);
			FillFlashButtonPath(brush, path);
			flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			buttonRecord = new ButtonRecord();
			buttonRecord.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID - 1, graphics.Transform, overState: false);
			defineButton.AddButtonRecord(buttonRecord);
		}

		internal void OpenButton()
		{
			defineButton = FindButton(FlashDocument.FlashContainer.UrlString);
			if (defineButton == null)
			{
				defineButton = new DefineButton();
				flashDocument.FlashContainer.DefineButtons.Add(defineButton);
				flashDocument.FlashContainer.Urls.Add(FlashDocument.FlashContainer.UrlString);
				flashDocument.FlashContainer.Clips.Add(graphics.ClipBounds);
			}
		}

		internal void CloseAllButtons()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DefineButton defineButton in flashDocument.FlashContainer.DefineButtons)
			{
				CloseButton(defineButton, num);
				num++;
			}
		}

		internal void CloseButton()
		{
			int index = flashDocument.FlashContainer.DefineButtons.Count - 1;
			DefineButton defineButton = (DefineButton)flashDocument.FlashContainer.DefineButtons[index];
			CloseButton(defineButton, index);
		}

		private void CloseButton(DefineButton defineButton, int index)
		{
			if (!defineButton.IsClosed && defineButton.buttonRecords.Count > 0)
			{
				SetClip((RectangleF)flashDocument.FlashContainer.Clips[index]);
				defineButton.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, (string)flashDocument.FlashContainer.Urls[index]);
				flashDocument.Set(defineButton);
				PlaceObject2 placeObject = new PlaceObject2();
				placeObject.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, new Matrix());
				flashDocument.Set(placeObject);
				flashDocument.ShapeID++;
			}
			defineButton.IsClosed = true;
		}

		internal void FillFlashButtonPath(Brush brush, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (brush is TextureBrush)
			{
				DefineJPEG defineJPEG = new DefineJPEG();
				defineJPEG.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID++, ((TextureBrush)brush).Image);
				flashDocument.Set(defineJPEG);
			}
			DefineShape3 defineShape = new DefineShape3();
			FillStyle fillStyle = SetFillStyle(brush, flashDocument.ShapeID - 1);
			defineShape.Shape.FillStyles.AddFillStyle(fillStyle);
			path.Flatten();
			PointF[] pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			Point[] array = ConvertToTwips(pathPoints);
			byte[] pathTypes = path.PathTypes;
			int x = 0;
			int y = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 1) == 0)
				{
					StyleChangeRecord styleChangeRecord = new StyleChangeRecord();
					styleChangeRecord.FillStyle = 1;
					styleChangeRecord.Set(array[i].X, array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(styleChangeRecord);
					num = array[i].X;
					num2 = array[i].Y;
				}
				else if ((pathTypes[i] & 1) == 1)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord.Set(x, y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord);
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 0x80) == 128)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord2 = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord2.Set(num - array[i].X, num2 - array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord2);
				}
				if (i < array.Length - 1)
				{
					x = array[i + 1].X - array[i].X;
					y = array[i + 1].Y - array[i].Y;
				}
			}
			EndShapeRecord endShapeRecord = new EndShapeRecord();
			endShapeRecord.Set();
			defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(endShapeRecord);
			defineShape.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, path.GetBounds());
			flashDocument.Set(defineShape);
		}

		internal void FillPathString(Brush brush, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (path.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetClip();
			DefineShape3 defineShape = new DefineShape3();
			FillStyle fillStyle = new FillStyle();
			fillStyle.Set(((SolidBrush)brush).Color);
			defineShape.Shape.FillStyles.AddFillStyle(fillStyle);
			PointF[] pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			Point[] array = ConvertToTwips(pathPoints);
			byte[] pathTypes = path.PathTypes;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 1) == 0)
				{
					StyleChangeRecord styleChangeRecord = new StyleChangeRecord();
					styleChangeRecord.FillStyle = 1;
					styleChangeRecord.Set(array[i].X, array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(styleChangeRecord);
					num = array[i].X;
					num2 = array[i].Y;
				}
				else if ((pathTypes[i] & 3) == 1)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord.Set(array[i].X - array[i - 1].X, array[i].Y - array[i - 1].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord);
				}
				else if ((pathTypes[i] & 3) == 3 && i < array.Length - 1)
				{
					CurvedEdgeRecord curvedEdgeRecord = new CurvedEdgeRecord();
					Point point = new Point(0, 0);
					point.X = (3 * array[i].X - array[i - 1].X) / 2;
					point.Y = (3 * array[i].Y - array[i - 1].Y) / 2;
					curvedEdgeRecord.Set(point.X - array[i - 1].X, point.Y - array[i - 1].Y, array[i + 2].X - point.X, array[i + 2].Y - point.Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(curvedEdgeRecord);
					i += 2;
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & 0x80) == 128)
				{
					StraightEdgeRecord straightEdgeRecord2 = new StraightEdgeRecord();
					straightEdgeRecord2.Set(num - array[i].X, num2 - array[i].Y);
					defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(straightEdgeRecord2);
				}
			}
			EndShapeRecord endShapeRecord = new EndShapeRecord();
			endShapeRecord.Set();
			defineShape.Shape.AddShapeRecord(endShapeRecord);
			defineShape.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, path.GetBounds());
			flashDocument.Set(defineShape);
			PlaceObject2 placeObject = new PlaceObject2();
			placeObject.Set(flashDocument.ShapeID, graphics.Transform);
			flashDocument.Set(placeObject);
			flashDocument.ShapeID++;
		}

		private Point[] ConvertToTwips(PointF[] points)
		{
			Point[] array = new Point[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].X = (int)(points[i].X * 20f);
				array[i].Y = (int)(points[i].Y * 20f);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private FillStyle SetFillStyle(Brush brush)
		{
			return SetFillStyle(brush, 0);
		}

		private FillStyle SetFillStyle(Brush brush, int imageID)
		{
			FillStyle fillStyle = new FillStyle();
			if (brush is SolidBrush)
			{
				fillStyle.Set(((SolidBrush)brush).Color);
			}
			else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush)
			{
				GradientStyle gradientStyle = flashDocument.FlashContainer.GradientStyle;
				fillStyle.Set(gradientStyle, ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[0], ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).LinearColors[1], ((LinearGradientBrush)brush).Rectangle);
			}
			else if (brush is PathGradientBrush)
			{
				GradientStyle gradientStyle2 = flashDocument.FlashContainer.GradientStyle;
				fillStyle.Set(gradientStyle2, ((PathGradientBrush)brush).CenterColor, ((PathGradientBrush)brush).SurroundColors[0], ((PathGradientBrush)brush).Rectangle);
			}
			else if (brush is TextureBrush)
			{
				fillStyle.Set(imageID);
			}
			return fillStyle;
		}
	}
	internal enum FT
	{
		SI16,
		SI8,
		SBN,
		UI32,
		UI16,
		UI8,
		UBN,
		RGB,
		RGBA,
		FBN,
		FIXED
	}
	internal class BasicType
	{
		private ArrayList bytes = new ArrayList();

		private int size;

		private bool aligned;

		internal int Size => size;

		internal bool Aligned => aligned;

		internal ArrayList ByteArray => bytes;

		internal BasicType()
		{
		}

		internal void SetAligned()
		{
			aligned = true;
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, Color val)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case FT.RGB:
				Set(FT.UI8, val.R);
				Set(FT.UI8, val.G);
				Set(FT.UI8, val.B);
				size = 24;
				break;
			case FT.RGBA:
				Set(FT.UI8, val.R);
				Set(FT.UI8, val.G);
				Set(FT.UI8, val.B);
				Set(FT.UI8, val.A);
				size = 32;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("An Invalid method used for this Flash type.");
			}
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, float val, int numOfBits)
		{
			if (type == FT.FBN)
			{
				long val2 = (long)(val * 65536f);
				Set(FT.SBN, val2, numOfBits);
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("An Invalid method used for this Flash type.");
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, long val)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (byte)(val >> 8 * i);
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case FT.SI8:
				bytes.Add(array[0]);
				size = 8;
				break;
			case FT.SI16:
				bytes.Add(array[0]);
				bytes.Add(array[1]);
				size = 16;
				break;
			case FT.UI8:
				bytes.Add(array[0]);
				size = 8;
				break;
			case FT.UI16:
				bytes.Add(array[0]);
				bytes.Add(array[1]);
				size = 16;
				break;
			case FT.UI32:
				bytes.Add(array[0]);
				bytes.Add(array[1]);
				bytes.Add(array[2]);
				bytes.Add(array[3]);
				size = 32;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("An Invalid method used for this Flash type.");
			}
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, long val, int bitsNum)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (byte)(val >> 8 * i);
			}
			int num = 0;
			switch (type)
			{
			case FT.UBN:
			{
				if (val < 0 || val > uint.MaxValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("BasicType - UBN", val, "The flash type variable rang is from 0 through 4,294,967,295.");
				}
				num = (bitsNum - 1) / 8 + 1;
				for (int num3 = num - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					bytes.Add(array[num3]);
				}
				size = bitsNum;
				break;
			}
			case FT.SBN:
			{
				if (val < int.MinValue || val > int.MaxValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("BasicType - SBN", val, "The flash type variable rang is from -2,147,483,648 through 2,147,483,647.");
				}
				num = (bitsNum - 1) / 8 + 1;
				for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					bytes.Add(array[num2]);
				}
				size = bitsNum;
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("An Invalid method used for this Flash type.");
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Render

	public class ChartRender : IDisposable
	{
		private IChartComponent component;

		private IFGGraphics2D graphics2d;

		private SceneGraph oShadowScene;

		public Bitmap chartImage;

		private Graphics localGraphics;

		private ChartDrawItemEventArgs eventObject = new ChartDrawItemEventArgs();

		private Color mBackColor = Color.Transparent;

		internal SvgContainer SvgContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics2d.SvgContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics2d.SvgContainer = value;
			}
		}

		internal FlashContainer FlashContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics2d.FlashContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics2d.FlashContainer = value;
			}
		}

		public SceneGraph ShadowScene
		{
			get
			{
				return oShadowScene;
			}
			set
			{
				oShadowScene = value;
			}
		}

		public Color BackColor
		{
			get
			{
				return mBackColor;
			}
			set
			{
				mBackColor = value;
			}
		}

		public event ChartDrawItemEventHandler ChartDrawItem;

		protected void OnChartDrawItem(ChartDrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ChartDrawItem != null)
			{
				this.ChartDrawItem(this, e);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			if (chartImage != null)
			{
				chartImage.Dispose();
			}
			if (graphics2d != null)
			{
				graphics2d.Dispose();
			}
			if (oShadowScene != null)
			{
				oShadowScene.Dispose();
			}
			if (localGraphics != null)
			{
				localGraphics.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public ChartRender(IChartComponent component)
		{
			this.component = component;
			CreateChartBitmap(500, 500);
			graphics2d = new IFGGraphics2D();
		}

		public void RenderChart(SceneGraph scene, int sceneWidth, int sceneHeight)
		{
			RenderChart(scene, new Size(sceneWidth, sceneHeight), new SizeF(localGraphics.DpiX, localGraphics.DpiY));
		}

		public void RenderChart(SceneGraph scene, Size sceneSize, SizeF resolution)
		{
			if (scene == null || scene.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (chartImage.Width != sceneSize.Width || chartImage.Height != sceneSize.Height)
			{
				CreateChartBitmap(sceneSize.Width, sceneSize.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				localGraphics.ResetClip();
				localGraphics.Clear(mBackColor);
			}
			chartImage.SetResolution(resolution.Width, resolution.Height);
			localGraphics = Graphics.FromImage(chartImage);
			RenderChart(scene, sceneSize.Width, sceneSize.Height, localGraphics);
			if (component == null || !(component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Effects) is EffectsAppearance { Enabled: not false } effectsAppearance))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IEffect effect in effectsAppearance.Effects)
			{
				if (!(effect is Effect) || ((Effect)effect).Enabled)
				{
					effect.Apply(chartImage);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RenderChart(SceneGraph scene, int sceneWidth, int sceneHeight, Graphics g)
		{
			RenderChart(scene, sceneWidth, sceneHeight, g, chartDrawItem: true);
		}

		internal void RenderChart(SceneGraph scene, int sceneWidth, int sceneHeight, Graphics g, bool chartDrawItem)
		{
			if (scene != null && scene.Count != 0)
			{
				RenderSceneGraph(scene, g, chartDrawItem);
			}
		}

		private void PaintPrimitive(Primitive p1)
		{
			PaintPrimitive(p1, chartDrawItem: true);
		}

		private void PaintPrimitive(Primitive p1, bool chartDrawItem)
		{
			eventObject.Primitive = p1;
			if (chartDrawItem)
			{
				OnChartDrawItem(eventObject);
			}
			Primitive primitive = eventObject.Primitive;
			if (primitive == null || !primitive.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (primitive is Line)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Line)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Text)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Text)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Box)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Box)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Ellipse)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Ellipse)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is PointSet)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((PointSet)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Symbol)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Symbol)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Polygon)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Polygon)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Polyline)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Polyline)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Wedge)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Wedge)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Arc)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Arc)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is ChartImage)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((ChartImage)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is GraphicsContext)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((GraphicsContext)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)primitive);
				}
				else if (primitive is Callout)
				{
					graphics2d.Draw((Callout)primitive);
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public void RenderSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, Graphics g)
		{
			RenderSceneGraph(scene, g, chartDrawItem: true);
		}

		internal void RenderSceneGraph(SceneGraph scene, Graphics g, bool chartDrawItem)
		{
			if (scene == null || g == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			g.SmoothingMode = component.SmoothingMode;
			g.TextRenderingHint = component.TextRenderingHint;
			IEnumerator enumerator = scene.GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.Reset();
			graphics2d.G = g;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Primitive primitive = (Primitive)enumerator.Current;
				PaintPrimitive(primitive, chartDrawItem);
				if (SvgContainer != null)
				{
					SvgContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
				}
				if (FlashContainer != null)
				{
					FlashContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues(primitive);
				}
			}
		}

		public Bitmap GetImage()
		{
			return (Bitmap)chartImage.Clone();
		}

		internal void CreateChartBitmap(int width, int height)
		{
			if (chartImage != null)
			{
				chartImage.Dispose();
			}
			if (localGraphics != null)
			{
				localGraphics.Dispose();
			}
			if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
			{
				width = 1;
				height = 1;
			}
			if (chartImage != null)
			{
				chartImage.Dispose();
			}
			try
			{
				chartImage = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
				localGraphics = Graphics.FromImage(chartImage);
				localGraphics.Clear(mBackColor);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
			}
		}
	}

		private GradientStyle gradientStyle = GradientStyle.None;

		internal void CreateFile(string SECU_KEY, Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chartControl, int width, int height, string eventName)
		{
			this.chartControl = chartControl;
			eventFunctionName = eventName;
			flashDocument.Set(width, height);
		}

		internal void CloseFile(Stream stream, Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chartControl)
		{
			BasicFlashDrawing.CloseAllButtons();
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ShowFrame showFrame = new ShowFrame();
			showFrame.Set();
			flashDocument.Set(showFrame);
			EndTag endTag = new EndTag();
			endTag.Set();
			flashDocument.Set(endTag);
			int size = flashDocument.GetSize(storeBuffer: true);
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.Set(FT.UI32, size);
			int position = 0;
			flashDocument.Add(arrayList, ref position);
			arrayList[4] = basicType.ByteArray[0];
			arrayList[5] = basicType.ByteArray[1];
			arrayList[6] = basicType.ByteArray[2];
			arrayList[7] = basicType.ByteArray[3];
			stream.Write((byte[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(byte)), 0, arrayList.Count);
		}

		internal static string SetSwfExtension(string fileName)
		{
			return System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(fileName, "swf");
		}

		internal void SetPrimitiveValues(Primitive primitive)
		{
			ChartDataEventArgs e = null;
			try
			{
				e = chartControl.ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitive);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (eventFunctionName != "" && e != null && ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None || (primitive.Caps & PCaps.Tooltip) > PCaps.None))
			{
				try
				{
					urlString = "javascript:" + eventFunctionName + "( null, " + e.DataRow + ", " + e.DataColumn + ", " + e.DataValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ", '" + e.RowLabel + "', '" + e.ColumnLabel + "', 'MOUSE_CLICKED' , '" + e.LayerID + "' )";
					BasicFlashDrawing.OpenButton();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (e != null)
			{
				try
				{
					toolTipsText = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartControl.ChartCore.Environment, TooltipLayer.GetTooltipFormat(chartControl.ChartType, primitive, chartControl.Tooltips, chartControl.ChartCore));
				}
				catch
				{
					toolTipsText = e.DataValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipsText = "";
			}
			_arePrimitivesSet = true;
		}

		internal void ClosePrimitiveValues(Primitive primitive)
		{
			if (_arePrimitivesSet)
			{
				ChartDataEventArgs e = null;
				try
				{
					e = chartControl.ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitive);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (eventFunctionName != "" && e != null && ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.HitTest) > PCaps.None || (primitive.Caps & PCaps.Tooltip) > PCaps.None) && primitive is PrimitiveShape)
				{
					BasicFlashDrawing.CloseButton();
				}
				ClosePrimitiveValues();
			}
		}

		internal void ClosePrimitiveValues()
		{
			toolTipsText = "";
			urlString = "";
			_arePrimitivesSet = false;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Render.Flash
{
	internal class FlashElement
	{
		private ArrayList basicTypes = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList buffer;

		internal ArrayList BasicTypes => basicTypes;

		internal void SetAligned()
		{
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.SetAligned();
			basicTypes.Add(basicType);
		}

		internal void Set(FlashElement element)
		{
			foreach (BasicType basicType in element.BasicTypes)
			{
				basicTypes.Add(basicType);
			}
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, long val)
		{
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.Set(type, val);
			basicTypes.Add(basicType);
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, float val, int numOfBits)
		{
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.Set(type, val, numOfBits);
			basicTypes.Add(basicType);
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, Color val)
		{
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.Set(type, val);
			basicTypes.Add(basicType);
		}

		internal void Set(FT type, long val, int bitsNum)
		{
			BasicType basicType = new BasicType();
			basicType.Set(type, val, bitsNum);
			basicTypes.Add(basicType);
		}

		internal void Add(ArrayList bytes, ref int position)
		{
			CompressBytes(bytes, ref position);
		}

		internal void CompressBytes(ArrayList bytes, ref int position)
		{
			if (buffer != null)
			{
				bytes.AddRange(buffer);
				return;
			}
			byte b = (byte)((position != 0) ? ((byte)bytes[bytes.Count - 1]) : 0);
			foreach (BasicType basicType in basicTypes)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (basicType.Aligned && position != 0)
				{
					position = 0;
					bytes.Add(b);
					b = 0;
				}
				foreach (byte item in basicType.ByteArray)
				{
					int secondSize = basicType.Size - (basicType.ByteArray.Count - 1) * 8;
					if (!flag)
					{
						secondSize = 8;
					}
					flag = false;
					byte[] array = CompressTwoBytes(b, item, ref position, secondSize);
					if (array.Length == 2)
					{
						bytes.Add(array[0]);
						if (position == 0)
						{
							bytes.Add(array[1]);
							b = 0;
						}
						else
						{
							b = array[1];
						}
					}
					else if (position == 0)
					{
						bytes.Add(array[0]);
						b = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						b = array[0];
					}
				}
			}
			if (position != 0)
			{
				bytes.Add(b);
			}
		}

		internal byte[] CompressTwoBytes(byte first, byte second, ref int position, int secondSize)
		{
			second &= (byte)(255 >> 8 - secondSize);
			position += secondSize;
			byte[] result;
			if (position == 8)
			{
				result = new byte[1] { (byte)(first | (second >> position - 8)) };
				position -= 8;
			}
			else if (position <= 8)
			{
				result = new byte[1] { (byte)(first | (second << 8 - position)) };
			}
			else
			{
				result = new byte[2]
				{
					(byte)(first | (second >> position - 8)),
					(byte)(second << 16 - position)
				};
				position -= 8;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal int GetNumBits(long val, bool signed)
		{
			if (val == 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (val < 0)
			{
				val *= -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				int num2 = (7 - i) * 8;
				byte val2 = (byte)(val >> num2);
				num = GetNumBits(val2);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					num += num2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (signed)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetNumBits(float val)
		{
			return GetNumBits((int)(val * 65536f), signed: true);
		}

		private int GetNumBits(byte val)
		{
			if (val == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (val < 2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (val < 4)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (val < 8)
			{
				return 3;
			}
			if (val < 16)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			if (val < 32)
			{
				return 5;
			}
			if (val < 64)
			{
				return 6;
			}
			if (val < 128)
			{
				return 7;
			}
			return 8;
		}

		protected internal int GetSize(bool storeBuffer)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int position = 0;
			CompressBytes(arrayList, ref position);
			if (storeBuffer)
			{
				buffer = arrayList;
			}
			else
			{
				buffer = null;
			}
			return arrayList.Count;
		}

		protected internal int GetSize()
		{
			return GetSize(storeBuffer: false);
		}

		protected internal ArrayList GetCompressed()
		{
			if (buffer != null)
			{
				return buffer;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int position = 0;
			CompressBytes(arrayList, ref position);
			return arrayList;
		}
	}

	internal class Rect : FlashElement
	{
		internal void Set(Rectangle rect)
		{
			rect.X *= 20;
			rect.Y *= 20;
			rect.Width *= 20;
			rect.Height *= 20;
			int numBits = GetNumBits(rect.X, signed: true);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rect.Y, signed: true), numBits);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rect.X + rect.Width, signed: true), numBits);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rect.Y + rect.Height, signed: true), numBits);
			Set(FT.UBN, numBits, 5);
			Set(FT.SBN, rect.X, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rect.X + rect.Width, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rect.Y, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rect.Y + rect.Height, numBits);
			SetAligned();
		}

		internal void Set(RectangleF rectF)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle
			{
				X = (int)(rectF.X * 20f),
				Y = (int)(rectF.Y * 20f),
				Width = (int)(rectF.Width * 20f),
				Height = (int)(rectF.Height * 20f)
			};
			int numBits = GetNumBits(rectangle.X, signed: true);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rectangle.Y, signed: true), numBits);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width, signed: true), numBits);
			numBits = Math.Max(GetNumBits(rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height, signed: true), numBits);
			Set(FT.UBN, numBits, 5);
			Set(FT.SBN, rectangle.X, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rectangle.X + rectangle.Width, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rectangle.Y, numBits);
			Set(FT.SBN, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height, numBits);
			SetAligned();
		}
	}

	internal class RecordHeader : FlashElement
	{
		internal RecordHeader()
		{
		}

		internal void SetRecordHeader(int tag)
		{
			int size = GetSize();
			FlashElement flashElement = new FlashElement();
			ArrayList arrayList = null;
			if (size > 62)
			{
				flashElement.Set(FT.UBN, tag, 10);
				flashElement.Set(FT.UBN, 63L, 6);
				flashElement.Set(FT.UI32, size);
			}
			else
			{
				flashElement.Set(FT.UBN, tag, 10);
				flashElement.Set(FT.UBN, size, 6);
			}
			arrayList = flashElement.GetCompressed();
			byte b = (byte)arrayList[0];
			arrayList[0] = arrayList[1];
			arrayList[1] = b;
			flashElement.BasicTypes.Clear();
			foreach (byte item in arrayList)
			{
				flashElement.Set(FT.UI8, item);
			}
			flashElement.Set(this);
			base.BasicTypes.Clear();
			Set(flashElement);
		}
	}

	internal class FillStyle : FlashElement
	{
		internal void Set(Color color)
		{
			Set(FT.UI8, 0L);
			Set(FT.RGBA, color);
		}

		internal void Set(int imageID)
		{
			MatrixFlash matrixFlash = new MatrixFlash();
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Scale(19.9f, 19.9f);
			matrixFlash.Set(matrix);
			Set(FT.UI8, 64L);
			Set(FT.UI16, imageID);
			Set(matrixFlash);
		}

		internal void Set(GradientStyle gradientStyle, Color color1, Color color2, RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			Gradient gradient = new Gradient();
			MatrixFlash matrixFlash = new MatrixFlash();
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Translate(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2f, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2f);
			float num = 0.0006103702f;
			rectangle.Width *= num;
			rectangle.Height *= num;
			switch (gradientStyle)
			{
			case GradientStyle.Horizontal:
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				matrix.Scale(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Width);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			case GradientStyle.Vertical:
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				matrix.Scale(rectangle.Height, rectangle.Height);
				matrix.Rotate(90f);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			case GradientStyle.Default:
			case GradientStyle.BackwardDiagonal:
			{
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				float num4 = Math.Max(rectangle.Height, rectangle.Width);
				matrix.Scale(num4, num4);
				matrix.Rotate(-45f);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			}
			case GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal:
			{
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				float num3 = Math.Max(rectangle.Height, rectangle.Width);
				matrix.Scale(num3, num3);
				matrix.Rotate(45f);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			}
			case GradientStyle.HorizontalBump:
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				matrix.Scale(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Width);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 128);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			case GradientStyle.VerticalBump:
				Set(FT.UI8, 16L);
				matrix.Scale(rectangle.Height, rectangle.Height);
				matrix.Rotate(90f);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 128);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			default:
			{
				Set(FT.UI8, 18L);
				float num2 = Math.Max(rectangle.Height, rectangle.Width);
				matrix.Scale(num2, num2);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color1, 0);
				gradient.AddGradientRecord(color2, 255);
				break;
			}
			}
			matrixFlash.Set(matrix);
			Set(matrixFlash);
			gradient.Set();
			Set(gradient);
		}
	}

	internal class StraightEdgeRecord : ShapeRecord
	{
		internal void Set(int x, int y)
		{
			Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			int num = Math.Max(GetNumBits(x, signed: true), GetNumBits(y, signed: true));
			num = ((num <= 1) ? num : (num -= 2));
			Set(FT.UBN, num, 4);
			Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			Set(FT.SBN, x, num + 2);
			Set(FT.SBN, y, num + 2);
		}
	}
	internal class CurvedEdgeRecord : ShapeRecord
	{
		internal void Set(int x, int y, int xA, int yA)
		{
			Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			int val = Math.Max(GetNumBits(x, signed: true), GetNumBits(y, signed: true));
			val = Math.Max(GetNumBits(xA, signed: true), val);
			val = Math.Max(GetNumBits(yA, signed: true), val);
			val = ((val <= 1) ? val : (val -= 2));
			Set(FT.UBN, val, 4);
			Set(FT.SBN, x, val + 2);
			Set(FT.SBN, y, val + 2);
			Set(FT.SBN, xA, val + 2);
			Set(FT.SBN, yA, val + 2);
		}
	}

	internal class MatrixFlash : FlashElement
	{
		internal void Set(Matrix matrix)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (matrix.Elements[0] != 1f || matrix.Elements[3] != 1f)
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
				num = GetNumBits(Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[0]));
				num = Math.Max(num, GetNumBits(Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[3])));
				Set(FT.UBN, num, 5);
				Set(FT.FBN, matrix.Elements[0], num);
				Set(FT.FBN, matrix.Elements[3], num);
			}
			else
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			}
			if (matrix.Elements[1] != 0f || matrix.Elements[2] != 0f)
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
				num = GetNumBits(Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[1]));
				num = Math.Max(num, GetNumBits(Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[2])));
				Set(FT.UBN, num, 5);
				Set(FT.FBN, matrix.Elements[1], num);
				Set(FT.FBN, matrix.Elements[2], num);
			}
			else
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			}
			num = GetNumBits((int)Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[4] * 20f), signed: true);
			num = Math.Max(num, GetNumBits((int)Math.Abs(matrix.Elements[5] * 20f), signed: true));
			Set(FT.UBN, num, 5);
			Set(FT.SBN, (int)(matrix.Elements[4] * 20f), num);
			Set(FT.SBN, (int)(matrix.Elements[5] * 20f), num);
			SetAligned();
		}
	}
	internal class ShapeWithStyle : FlashElement

		private ArrayList shapeRecords = new ArrayList();

		private FillStyleArray fillStyles = new FillStyleArray();

		private LineStyleArray lineStyles = new LineStyleArray();

			Set(FT.UBN, GetNumBits(fillStyles.FillStyles.Count, signed: false), 4);
			Set(FT.UBN, GetNumBits(lineStyles.LineStyles.Count, signed: false), 4);
			foreach (ShapeRecord shapeRecord in shapeRecords)
			{
				Set(shapeRecord);
			}
			SetAligned();
		}
	}
	internal class PlaceObject2 : RecordHeader
	{
		private int clipDepth;

		internal int ClipDepth
		{
			get
			{
				return clipDepth;
			}
			set
			{
				clipDepth = value;
			}
		}

		internal void Set(int characterID, Matrix matrix)
		{
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			if (clipDepth == 0)
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			}
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			if (matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			}
			Set(FT.UBN, 1L, 1);
			Set(FT.UBN, 0L, 1);
			Set(FT.UI16, characterID);
			Set(FT.UI16, characterID);
			if (!matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				MatrixFlash matrixFlash = new MatrixFlash();
				matrixFlash.Set(matrix);
				Set(matrixFlash);
			}
			if (clipDepth != 0)
			{
				Set(FT.UI16, clipDepth);
			}
			SetRecordHeader(26);
		}
	}

	internal class Gradient : FlashElement
	{
		private int numOfRecord;

		private ArrayList colors = new ArrayList();

		private ArrayList ratios = new ArrayList();

		internal void AddGradientRecord(Color color, int ratio)
		{
			colors.Add(color);
			ratios.Add(ratio);
			numOfRecord++;
		}

		internal void Set()
		{
			Set(FT.UI8, numOfRecord);
			for (int i = 0; i < numOfRecord; i++)
			{
				Set(FT.UI8, (int)ratios[i]);
				Set(FT.RGBA, (Color)colors[i]);
			}
		}
	}

			Set(FT.UI8, 217L);
			Set(FT.UI8, 255L);
			Set(FT.UI8, 216L);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			image.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Jpeg);
			byte[] array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			byte[] array2 = array;
			foreach (byte b in array2)
			{
				Set(FT.UI8, b);
			}
			Set(FT.UI8, 255L);
			Set(FT.UI8, 217L);
			SetRecordHeader(21);
		}
	}

	internal class GraphicsImage : IGraphics
	{
		private const int MAX_UNIT = 1073741951;

		private const int MIN_UNIT = -1073741951;

		protected internal Graphics graphics;

		public virtual Graphics Graphics
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual SmoothingMode SmoothingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.SmoothingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual Matrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.Transform;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.Transform = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual Region Clip
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.Clip;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.Clip = value;
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsImage()
		{
		}

		public virtual void FillPolygon(Brush brush, PointF[] points)
		{
			graphics.FillPolygon(brush, points);
		}

		public virtual void FillEllipse(Brush brush, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			graphics.FillEllipse(brush, x, y, width, height);
		}

		public virtual void FillPolygon(Brush brush, Point[] points, FillMode fillMode)
		{

		{
			graphics.DrawLine(pen, pt1, pt2);
		}

		internal static bool Validate(SizeF size)
		{
			if (size.Height > 0f && size.Height < 1.073742E+09f && size.Width > 0f)
			{
				return size.Width < 1.073742E+09f;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void DrawPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (path != null)
			{
				graphics.DrawPath(pen, path);
			}
		}

		{
			graphics.DrawImage(image, x, y, width, height);
		}

		}

		{
			graphics.ResetTransform();
		}

		{
			return graphics.MeasureString(text, font, width, format);
		}

		{
			graphics.DrawPie(pen, x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		{
			graphics.SetClip(path, combineMode);
		}

		{
			graphics.SetClip(rect);

		{
			return graphics.MeasureString(text, font);

		{
			graphics.SetClip(path);

		{
			if (graphics != null)
			{
				graphics.Dispose();
			}
		}

	internal class GraphicsSvg : GraphicsImage, IGraphics
	{
		private SvgContainer svgContainer;

		private int primitiveID;

		private int gradientID;

		private int markerID;

		public override SmoothingMode SmoothingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.SmoothingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = value;
			}
		}

		public override Matrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.Transform;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.Transform = value;
			}
		}

		public override Region Clip
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.Clip;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.Clip = value;
			}
		}

		internal SvgContainer SvgContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return svgContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				svgContainer = value;
			}
		}

		internal GraphicsSvg()
		{
		}

		public override void FillPolygon(Brush brush, PointF[] points)
		{
			OpenSections();
			CreateGradient(brush);
			SetStart("polygon");
			SetId();
			SetBrush(brush);
			SetAttribute("points", points);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void FillEllipse(Brush brush, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			OpenSections();
			CreateGradient(brush);
			SetStart("ellipse");
			SetId();
			SetBrush(brush);
			SetAttribute("cx", x + width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("cy", y + height / 2f);
			SetAttribute("rx", width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("ry", height / 2f);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void FillPolygon(Brush brush, Point[] points, FillMode fillMode)
		{
			OpenSections();
			CreateGradient(brush);
			SetStart("polygon");
			SetId();
			SetBrush(brush);
			SetAttribute("points", points);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void FillPie(Brush brush, float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.AddPie(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			FillPath(brush, graphicsPath);
		}

		public override void FillPath(Brush brush, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			path.Flatten();
			FillPolygon(brush, path.PathPoints);
		}

		public override void FillRectangle(Brush brush, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (brush is TextureBrush)
			{
				FillTexture(brush, rect);
				return;
			}
			OpenSections();
			CreateGradient(brush);
			SetStart("rect");
			SetId();
			SetBrush(brush);
			if (Transform.IsIdentity)
			{
				SetAttribute("shape-rendering", "crispEdges");
			}
			SetAttribute("x", rect.X);
			SetAttribute("y", rect.Y);
			SetAttribute("width", rect.Width);
			SetAttribute("height", rect.Height);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		private void FillTexture(Brush brush, Rectangle rect)
		{
			_ = (TextureBrush)brush;
			Image image = new Bitmap(rect.Width, rect.Height, graphics);
			Graphics.FromImage(image).FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			image.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Jpeg);
			SetStart("image");
			SetId();
			SetAttribute("xlink:href", "data:image/jpeg;base64," + Convert.ToBase64String(memoryStream.ToArray()));
			SetAttribute("x", rect.X);
			SetAttribute("y", rect.Y);
			SetAttribute("width", rect.Width);
			SetAttribute("height", rect.Height);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void FillEllipse(Brush brush, int x, int y, int width, int height)
		{
			OpenSections();
			CreateGradient(brush);
			SetStart("ellipse");
			SetId();
			SetBrush(brush);
			SetAttribute("cx", (float)x + (float)width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("cy", (float)y + (float)height / 2f);
			SetAttribute("rx", (float)width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("ry", (float)height / 2f);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void DrawEllipse(Pen pen, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("ellipse");
			SetPen(pen);
			SetAttribute("cx", x + width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("cy", y + height / 2f);
			SetAttribute("rx", width / 2f);
			SetAttribute("ry", height / 2f);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawLine(Pen pen, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetMarker(pen);
			SetStart("line");
			SetPen(pen);
			if (Transform.IsIdentity && (x1 == x2 || y1 == y2))
			{
				SetAttribute("shape-rendering", "crispEdges");
			}
			SetAttribute("x1", x1);
			SetAttribute("y1", y1);
			SetAttribute("x2", x2);
			SetAttribute("y2", y2);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawPolygon(Pen pen, PointF[] points)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("polygon");
			SetPen(pen);
			SetAttribute("points", points);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawRectangle(Pen pen, Rectangle rect)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("rect");
			SetPen(pen);
			if (Transform.IsIdentity)
			{
				SetAttribute("shape-rendering", "crispEdges");
			}
			SetAttribute("x", rect.X);

			SetAttribute("width", rect.Width);
			SetAttribute("height", rect.Height);
			SetEnd();
		}

			SetAttribute("points", points);
			SetEnd();

		}

		{
		}

		public override void DrawString(string s, Font font, Brush brush, float x, float y)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("text");
			SetBrush(brush);
			SetAttribute("font-size", font.SizeInPoints.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "pt");
			SetAttribute("font-family", font.FontFamily.Name);
			SetAttribute("x", x + font.SizeInPoints * 0.3f);
			SetAttribute("y", y + font.SizeInPoints * 1.3f);
			if (font.Bold)
			{
				SetAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
			}
			if (font.Italic)
			{
				SetAttribute("font-style", "italic");
			}
			if (font.Strikeout)
			{
				SetAttribute("text-decoration", "line-through");
			}
			if (font.Underline)
			{
				SetAttribute("text-decoration", "underline");
			}
			SetString(s);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawImage(Image image, RectangleF destRect, RectangleF srcRect, GraphicsUnit srcUnit)
		{
		}

		public override void DrawImage(Image image, Rectangle destRect, int srcX, int srcY, int srcWidth, int srcHeight, GraphicsUnit srcUnit)
		{
		}

		public override void DrawLine(Pen pen, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetMarker(pen);
			SetStart("line");
			SetPen(pen);
			if (Transform.IsIdentity && (x1 == x2 || y1 == y2))
			{
				SetAttribute("shape-rendering", "crispEdges");
			}
			SetAttribute("x1", x1);
			SetAttribute("y1", y1);
			SetAttribute("x2", x2);
			SetAttribute("y2", y2);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawString(string s, Font font, Brush brush, RectangleF layoutRectangle, StringFormat format)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = TruncateString(s, font, layoutRectangle, (format.FormatFlags & StringFormatFlags.NoWrap) == 0);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string item in arrayList)
			{
				PointF pointF = FormatedPosition(item, font, format, layoutRectangle, num, arrayList.Count);
				DrawString(item, font, brush, pointF.X, pointF.Y);
				num++;
			}
		}

		public override void DrawString(string s, Font font, Brush brush, PointF point, StringFormat format)
		{
		}

		public override void DrawLines(Pen pen, Point[] points)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetMarker(pen);
			SetStart("polyline");
			SetPen(pen);
			SetAttribute("points", points);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawEllipse(Pen pen, int x, int y, int width, int height)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("ellipse");
			SetPen(pen);
			SetAttribute("cx", x + width / 2);
			SetAttribute("cy", y + height / 2);
			SetAttribute("rx", width / 2);
			SetAttribute("ry", height / 2);
			SetEnd();
		}

		public override void DrawLine(Pen pen, Point pt1, Point pt2)
		{
			OpenSections();
			SetMarker(pen);
			SetStart("line");
			SetId();
			SetPen(pen);
			if (Transform.IsIdentity && (pt1.X == pt2.X || pt1.Y == pt2.Y))
			{
				SetAttribute("shape-rendering", "crispEdges");
			}
			SetAttribute("x1", pt1.X);
			SetAttribute("y1", pt1.Y);
			SetAttribute("x2", pt2.X);
			SetAttribute("y2", pt2.Y);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		public override void DrawPath(Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			path.Flatten();
			OpenSections();
			SetStart("polyline");
			SetPen(pen);
			SetAttribute("points", path.PathPoints);
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: true);
		}

		}

			graphicsPath.AddPie(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			DrawPath(pen, graphicsPath);
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, PointF[] points)
		{
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = points[i];
				string text2 = text;
				text = text2 + pointF.X.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "," + pointF.Y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " ";
			}
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, text);
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, Point[] points)
		{
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				string text2 = text;
				text = text2 + point.X.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "," + point.Y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " ";
			}
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, text);
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, int value)
		{
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, string value)
		{
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, value);
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, double value)
		{
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		private void SetAttribute(string attribute, Color color)
		{
			SetAttribute(attribute, color, svgContainer.TextWriter);
		}

		internal static void SetAttribute(string attribute, Color color, XmlTextWriter textWriter)
		{
			string text = $"#{color.R,2:X2}{color.G,2:X2}{color.B,2:X2}";
			textWriter.WriteAttributeString(attribute, text.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		private void SetString(string text)
		{
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteString(text);
		}

		private void SetStart(string element)
		{
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteStartElement(element);
		}

		private void SetEnd()
		{
			SetEnd(enabledTooltips: false);
		}

		private void SetEnd(bool enabledTooltips)
		{
			if (enabledTooltips && SvgContainer.TooltipString != "")
			{
				SetStart("desc");
				SvgContainer.TextWriter.WriteString(SvgContainer.TooltipString);
				SvgContainer.TextWriter.WriteEndElement();
			}
			if (SvgContainer.Args != null && SvgContainer.Primitive != null)
			{
				SetStart("igchart:DataArgs");
				SetAttribute("datarow", SvgContainer.Primitive.Row);
				SetAttribute("datacolumn", SvgContainer.Primitive.Column);
				SetAttribute("rowlabel", SvgContainer.Args.RowLabel);
				SetAttribute("columnlabel", SvgContainer.Args.ColumnLabel);
				SetAttribute("layerid", SvgContainer.Args.LayerID);
				SetAttribute("datavalue", SvgContainer.Args.DataValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				SvgContainer.TextWriter.WriteEndElement();
			}
			svgContainer.TextWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SetBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush is SolidBrush)
			{
				Color color = ((SolidBrush)brush).Color;
				double value = (double)(int)color.A / 255.0;
				SetAttribute("fill-opacity", value);
				SetAttribute("fill", color);
			}
			else if (brush is LinearGradientBrush || brush is PathGradientBrush)
			{
				SetAttribute("fill", "url(#Gradient" + (gradientID - 1) + ")");
			}
			SetAttribute("stroke", "none");
		}

		private void SetPen(Pen pen)
		{
			Color color;
			try
			{
				color = pen.Color;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				color = Color.Empty;
			}
			double value = (double)(int)color.A / 255.0;
			SetAttribute("stroke-opacity", value);
			SetAttribute("stroke", color);
			if (pen.Width == 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("stroke-width", 1);
			}
			else
			{
				SetAttribute("stroke-width", pen.Width);
			}
			SetAttribute("fill", "none");
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.Custom && pen.DashPattern != null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			catch (OutOfMemoryException)
			{
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (flag)
			{
				text = "";
				bool flag2 = true;
				float[] dashPattern = pen.DashPattern;
				foreach (float num in dashPattern)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						text += ",";
					}
					flag2 = false;
					text += Math.Floor(num);
				}
			}
			else if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.Dash)
			{
				text = "9,4";
			}
			else if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.DashDot)
			{
				text = "9,4,3,4";
			}
			else if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.DashDotDot)
			{
				text = "9,4,3,4,3,4";
			}
			else if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.Dot)
			{
				text = "3,4";
			}
			if (text != string.Empty)
			{
				SetAttribute("stroke-dasharray", text);
			}
			switch (pen.StartCap)
			{
			case LineCap.ArrowAnchor:
				SetAttribute("marker-start", "url(#MarkerStart" + markerID + ")");
				break;
			default:
				SetAttribute("marker-start", "url(#Marker" + markerID + ")");
				break;
			case LineCap.Flat:
				break;
			}
			switch (pen.EndCap)
			{
			case LineCap.ArrowAnchor:
				SetAttribute("marker-end", "url(#MarkerEnd" + markerID + ")");
				break;
			default:
				SetAttribute("marker-end", "url(#Marker" + markerID + ")");
				break;
			case LineCap.Flat:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetId()
		{
			if (SvgContainer.TooltipString != "")
			{
				SetAttribute("id", primitiveID++);
			}
		}

		private ArrayList TruncateString(string text, Font font, RectangleF rectangle, bool wrap)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			text = text.Replace("\n", "\n\\@ ");
			string text2 = " \n";
			char[] separator = text2.ToCharArray();
			string[] array = text.Split(separator);
			float num = 0f;
			string text3 = "";
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text4 in array2)
			{
				if (text4 != "\\@")
				{
					string text5 = text3 + text4;
					SizeF sizeF = graphics.MeasureString(text5, font);
					if (sizeF.Width > rectangle.Width)
					{
						num += sizeF.Height;
						if (num + sizeF.Height > rectangle.Height || !wrap)
						{
							arrayList.Add(text3 + "...");
							text3 = "";
							break;
						}
						arrayList.Add(text3);
						text3 = text4 + " ";
					}
					else
					{
						text3 = text3 + text4 + " ";
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(text3);
					text3 = "";
				}
			}
			if (text3 != "")
			{
				arrayList.Add(text3);
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private PointF FormatedPosition(string text, Font font, StringFormat format, PointF point, int rowIndx, int numOfRows)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = graphics.MeasureString(text, font, point, format);
			RectangleF rect = new RectangleF(point.X - sizeF.Width / 2f, point.Y - sizeF.Height / 2f, sizeF.Width, sizeF.Height);
			return FormatedPosition(text, font, format, rect, rowIndx, numOfRows);
		}

		private PointF FormatedPosition(string text, Font font, StringFormat format, RectangleF rect, int rowIndx, int numOfRows)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = graphics.MeasureString(text, font, (int)(rect.Size.Width * 2f), format);
			float num = 0f;
			num = ((format.Alignment == StringAlignment.Near) ? rect.X : ((format.Alignment != StringAlignment.Far) ? (rect.X + rect.Width / 2f - sizeF.Width / 2f) : (rect.X + rect.Width - sizeF.Width)));
			float num2 = 0f;
			num2 = ((format.LineAlignment == StringAlignment.Near) ? (rect.Y + sizeF.Height * (float)rowIndx) : ((format.LineAlignment != StringAlignment.Center) ? (rect.Y + rect.Height - sizeF.Height * (float)numOfRows + sizeF.Height * (float)rowIndx) : (rect.Y + rect.Height / 2f - sizeF.Height * (float)numOfRows / 2f + sizeF.Height * (float)rowIndx)));
			return new PointF(num, num2);
		}

		private void CreateGradient(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush is LinearGradientBrush)
			{
				LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = (LinearGradientBrush)brush;
				SetStart("defs");
				SetStart("linearGradient");
				SetAttribute("id", "Gradient" + gradientID);
				SetAttribute("gradientUnits", "objectBoundingBox");
				SetAttribute("spreadMethod", "reflect");
				if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.Horizontal)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "100%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "0%");
				}
				else if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.Vertical)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "100%");
				}
				else if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.HorizontalBump)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "100%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "50%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "0%");
				}
				else if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.VerticalBump)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "100%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "50%");
				}
				else if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "100%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "100%");
				}
				else if (SvgContainer.GradientStyle == GradientStyle.BackwardDiagonal)
				{
					SetAttribute("x1", "100%");
					SetAttribute("y1", "0%");
					SetAttribute("x2", "0%");
					SetAttribute("y2", "100%");
				}
				SetStart("stop");
				SetAttribute("offset", "0%");
				SetAttribute("stop-color", linearGradientBrush.LinearColors[0]);
				SetAttribute("stop-opacity", (double)(int)linearGradientBrush.LinearColors[0].A / 255.0);
				SetEnd();
				SetStart("stop");
				SetAttribute("offset", "100%");
				SetAttribute("stop-color", linearGradientBrush.LinearColors[1]);
				SetAttribute("stop-opacity", (double)(int)linearGradientBrush.LinearColors[1].A / 255.0);
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				gradientID++;
			}
			else if (brush is PathGradientBrush)
			{
				PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = (PathGradientBrush)brush;
				SetStart("defs");
				SetStart("radialGradient");
				SetAttribute("id", "Gradient" + gradientID);
				SetAttribute("gradientUnits", "objectBoundingBox");
				SetStart("stop");
				SetAttribute("offset", "0%");
				SetAttribute("stop-color", pathGradientBrush.CenterColor);
				SetAttribute("stop-opacity", (double)(int)pathGradientBrush.CenterColor.A / 255.0);
				SetEnd();
				SetStart("stop");
				SetAttribute("offset", "100%");
				SetAttribute("stop-color", pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors[0]);
				SetAttribute("stop-opacity", (double)(int)pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors[0].A / 255.0);
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				gradientID++;
			}
		}

		private void OpenSections()
		{
			SvgContainer.CloseSection();
			SvgContainer.OpenSection(graphics);
		}

		private void SetMarker(Pen pen)
		{
			markerID++;
			Color color = pen.Color;
			double value = (double)(int)color.A / 255.0;
			if (pen.EndCap == LineCap.ArrowAnchor || pen.StartCap == LineCap.ArrowAnchor)
			{
				SetStart("defs");
				SetStart("marker");
				SetAttribute("id", "MarkerStart" + markerID);
				SetAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 10 10");
				SetAttribute("refX", "5");
				SetAttribute("refY", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerUnits", "strokeWidth");
				SetAttribute("markerWidth", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerHeight", "5");
				SetAttribute("orient", "auto");
				SetStart("path");
				SetAttribute("stroke", "none");
				SetAttribute("fill-opacity", value);
				SetAttribute("fill", color);
				SetAttribute("d", "M 10 0 L 0 5 L 10 10 z");
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetStart("marker");
				SetAttribute("id", "MarkerEnd" + markerID);
				SetAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 10 10");
				SetAttribute("refX", "5");
				SetAttribute("refY", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerUnits", "strokeWidth");
				SetAttribute("markerWidth", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerHeight", "5");
				SetAttribute("orient", "auto");
				SetStart("path");
				SetAttribute("stroke", "none");
				SetAttribute("fill-opacity", value);
				SetAttribute("fill", color);
				SetAttribute("d", "M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z");
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
			}
			if (pen.EndCap == LineCap.RoundAnchor || pen.StartCap == LineCap.RoundAnchor)
			{
				SetStart("defs");
				SetStart("marker");
				SetAttribute("id", "Marker" + markerID);
				SetAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 10 10");
				SetAttribute("refX", "10");
				SetAttribute("refY", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerUnits", "strokeWidth");
				SetAttribute("markerWidth", "6");
				SetAttribute("markerHeight", "5");
				SetAttribute("orient", "auto");
				SetStart("ellipse");
				SetAttribute("stroke", "none");
				SetAttribute("fill-opacity", value);
				SetAttribute("fill", color);
				SetAttribute("cx", "5");
				SetAttribute("cy", "5");
				SetAttribute("rx", "5");
				SetAttribute("ry", "5");
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
			}
			if (pen.EndCap == LineCap.DiamondAnchor || pen.StartCap == LineCap.DiamondAnchor)
			{
				SetStart("defs");
				SetStart("marker");
				SetAttribute("id", "Marker" + markerID);
				SetAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 10 10");
				SetAttribute("refX", "10");
				SetAttribute("refY", "5");
				SetAttribute("markerUnits", "strokeWidth");
				SetAttribute("markerWidth", "6");
				SetAttribute("markerHeight", "5");
				SetStart("polygon");
				SetAttribute("stroke", "none");
				SetAttribute("fill-opacity", value);
				SetAttribute("fill", color);
				SetAttribute("points", "7,3 13,3 13,7 7,7");
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
				SetEnd();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class IFGGraphics2D : IDisposable
	{
		internal const int MAX_UNIT = 1073741951;

		internal const int MIN_UNIT = -1073741951;

		internal const float FONT_SIZE_MINIMUM = 6.5f;

		internal const float FONT_SIZE_MAXIMUM = 100f;

		private bool _ClippingText;

		private SvgContainer svgContainer;

		private FlashContainer flashContainer;

		private GraphicsImage graphics;

		private Rectangle clipRect;

		private bool useClip;

		private Pen linePen;

		private Brush fillBrush;

		private GraphicsPath drawPath;

		private Pen fillPen;

		private StringFormatParser formatParser = new StringFormatParser();

		private Brush SolidFillBrush;

		private Brush ImageBrush;

		private Brush HatchBrush;

		private Brush GradientBrush;

		private Pen StrokePen;

		private Brush ExtraBrush;

		private bool ClippingText
		{
			get
			{
				return _ClippingText;
			}
			set
			{
				_ClippingText = value;
			}
		}

		internal SvgContainer SvgContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return svgContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				svgContainer = value;
			}

		public Graphics G
		{
			set
			{
				if (svgContainer != null)
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsSvg();
					((GraphicsSvg)graphics).SvgContainer = svgContainer;
				}
				else if (flashContainer != null)
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsFlash();
					((GraphicsFlash)graphics).FlashContainer = flashContainer;
				}
				else
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsImage();
				}
				graphics.Graphics = value;
			}
