		public Graphics G
		{
			set
			{
				if (svgContainer != null)
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsSvg();
					((GraphicsSvg)graphics).SvgContainer = svgContainer;
				}
				else if (flashContainer != null)
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsFlash();
					((GraphicsFlash)graphics).FlashContainer = flashContainer;
				}
				else
				{
					graphics = new GraphicsImage();
				}
				graphics.Graphics = value;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (graphics != null)
			{
				graphics.Dispose();
			}
			if (linePen != null)
			{
				linePen.Dispose();
			}
			if (fillBrush != null && fillBrush != Brushes.Transparent)
			{
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (drawPath != null)
			{
				drawPath.Dispose();
			}
			if (fillPen != null)
			{
				fillPen.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static Pen GetLinePen(Color lineColor, int thickness, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			return GetLinePen(lineColor, thickness, lineStyle, PenAlignment.Center);
		}

		public static Pen GetLinePen(Color lineColor, int thickness, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle, PenAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (lineStyle == null)
			{
				lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			}
			Pen pen = new Pen(lineColor, thickness);
			switch (lineStyle.DrawStyle)
			{
			case LineDrawStyle.Dash:
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Dash;
				break;
			case LineDrawStyle.DashDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.DashDot;
				break;
			case LineDrawStyle.DashDotDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.DashDotDot;
				break;
			case LineDrawStyle.Dot:
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Dot;
				break;
			}
			switch (lineStyle.StartStyle)
			{
			case LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.ArrowAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.DiamondAnchor:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.DiamondAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Flat:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Flat;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Round:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Round;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.RoundAnchor:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.RoundAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Square:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Square;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.SquareAnchor:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.SquareAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Triangle:
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Triangle;
				break;
			}
			switch (lineStyle.EndStyle)
			{
			case LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.ArrowAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.DiamondAnchor:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.DiamondAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Flat:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Flat;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Round:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Round;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.RoundAnchor:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.RoundAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Square:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Square;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.SquareAnchor:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.SquareAnchor;
				break;
			case LineCapStyle.Triangle:
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Triangle;
				break;
			}
			pen.Alignment = alignment;
			return pen;
		}

		public static Pen GetLinePen(Color lineColor, int thickness, Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle, byte opacity)
		{
			Pen pen = GetLinePen(lineColor, thickness, lineStyle);
			pen.Color = Color.FromArgb(opacity, pen.Color.R, pen.Color.G, pen.Color.B);
			return pen;
		}

		public void Draw(Wedge w)
		{
			if (w.Radius < 1)
			{
				w.Radius = 1;
			}
			int num = 2 * w.Radius;
			float startAngle = w.startAngle;
			float angleSweep = w.angleSweep;
			if (w.RadiusInner > 0)
			{
				drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
				drawPath.AddArc(w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num, startAngle, angleSweep);
				drawPath.AddArc(w.Center.X - w.RadiusInner, w.Center.Y - w.RadiusInner, 2 * w.RadiusInner, 2 * w.RadiusInner, startAngle + angleSweep, 0f - angleSweep);
				drawPath.CloseFigure();
				if (angleSweep >= 360f)
				{
					if (w.PE.Stroke.A > 0)
					{
						Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(w.PE.StrokeOpacity, w.PE.Stroke);
						using Pen pen = GetLinePen(lineColor, w.PE.StrokeWidth, w.lineStyle, w.PE.StrokeAlignment);
						graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num);
						graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, w.Center.X - w.RadiusInner, w.Center.Y - w.RadiusInner, w.RadiusInner * 2, w.RadiusInner * 2);
					}
					using Brush brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(w.PE, w.GetBounds());
					Region clip = graphics.Clip;
					graphics.SetClip(drawPath);
					graphics.FillEllipse(brush, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num);
					graphics.Clip = clip;
				}
				else if (w.PE.Stroke.A > 0)
				{
					Color lineColor2 = Color.FromArgb(w.PE.StrokeOpacity, w.PE.Stroke);
					using Pen pen2 = GetLinePen(lineColor2, w.PE.StrokeWidth, w.lineStyle, w.PE.StrokeAlignment);
					graphics.DrawPath(pen2, drawPath);
				}
				if (w.PE != null)
				{
					fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(w.PE, drawPath);
					if (fillBrush != Brushes.Transparent)
					{
						graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, drawPath);
						if (w.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
						{
							fillBrush.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				else if (fillBrush != null)
				{
					fillBrush.Dispose();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (w.PE.Stroke.A > 0)
				{
					if (w.angleSweep >= 360f)
					{
						Color lineColor3 = Color.FromArgb(w.PE.StrokeOpacity, w.PE.Stroke);
						using (Brush brush2 = PaintElement.GetBrush(w.PE, w.GetBounds()))
						{
							graphics.FillEllipse(brush2, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num);
						}
						using Pen pen3 = GetLinePen(lineColor3, w.PE.StrokeWidth, w.lineStyle, w.PE.StrokeAlignment);
						graphics.DrawEllipse(pen3, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num);
					}
					else
					{
						Color lineColor4 = Color.FromArgb(w.PE.StrokeOpacity, w.PE.Stroke);
						using (Brush brush3 = PaintElement.GetBrush(w.PE, w.GetBounds()))
						{
							graphics.FillPie(brush3, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num, w.startAngle, w.startAngle + w.angleSweep);
						}
						using Pen pen4 = GetLinePen(lineColor4, w.PE.StrokeWidth, w.lineStyle, w.PE.StrokeAlignment);
						graphics.DrawPie(pen4, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num, w.startAngle, w.startAngle + w.angleSweep);
					}
				}
				if (w.PE != null)
				{
					fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(w.PE, w.GetBounds());
					_ = fillBrush;
					_ = Brushes.Transparent;
					if (w.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
					{
						fillBrush.Dispose();
					}
				}
				else if (fillBrush != null)
				{
					fillBrush.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (w.PE != null && w.PE.FillGradientStyle == GradientStyle.Raise)
			{
				drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
				if (w.RadiusInner > 0)
				{
					drawPath.AddArc(w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num, startAngle, angleSweep);
					drawPath.AddArc(w.Center.X - w.RadiusInner, w.Center.Y - w.RadiusInner, 2 * w.RadiusInner, 2 * w.RadiusInner, startAngle + angleSweep, 0f - angleSweep);
					drawPath.CloseFigure();
				}
				Color color = Color.FromArgb(w.PE.FillOpacity, w.PE.Fill);
				int num2 = (color.R + color.G + color.B) / 3;
				int factor = num2 / 5;
				fillBrush = PaintElement.GetHilightBrush(w.PE, drawPath, MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(color, factor));
				Region clip2 = graphics.Clip;
				graphics.SetClip(drawPath);
				graphics.FillPie(fillBrush, w.Center.X - w.Radius, w.Center.Y - w.Radius, num, num, w.startAngle, w.angleSweep);
				graphics.Clip = clip2;
				drawPath.Dispose();
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Draw(Text t)
		{
			if (t.bounds.Size != Size.Empty)
			{
				if (t.labelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && Math.Abs(t.labelStyle.RotationAngle) % 90 != 0)
				{
					DrawWithRotatedBounds(t);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawWithBounds(t);
				}
			}
			else if (t.bounds != Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				DrawWithoutBounds(t);
			}
		}

		public void DrawWithoutBounds(Text t)
		{
			Point location = t.bounds.Location;
			if (t.labelStyle == null)
			{
				t.labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			}
			bool flag = t.labelStyle.Flip;
			int num = t.labelStyle.RotationAngle;
			switch (t.labelStyle.Orientation)
			{
			case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				flag = true;
				num = -90;
				break;
			case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				flag = false;
				num = -90;
				break;
			case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
				flag = false;
				num = 0;
				break;
			}
			StringFormat format = new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces | StringFormatFlags.NoWrap);
			SizeF sizeF = this.graphics.MeasureString(t.GetTextString(), t.labelStyle.Font, 10000, format);
			int num2 = (int)(sizeF.Width * (float)(new int[3] { 1, 0, -1 })[(int)t.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign] / 2f);
			int num3 = (int)(sizeF.Height * (float)(new int[3] { 1, 0, -1 })[(int)t.labelStyle.VerticalAlign] / 2f);
			int num4 = (int)((float)(location.X + num2) - sizeF.Width / 2f);
			int num5 = (int)((float)(location.Y + num3) - sizeF.Height / 2f);
			Graphics graphics;
			GraphicsState gstate;
			using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
			{
				matrix.Translate(-location.X, -location.Y);
				matrix.Rotate(-num, MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Translate(location.X, location.Y, MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Translate(t.labelStyle.Dx, t.labelStyle.Dy, MatrixOrder.Append);
				Point point = new Point((int)((float)num4 + sizeF.Width / 2f), (int)((float)num5 + sizeF.Height / 2f));
				Point[] array = new Point[2] { point, location };
				matrix.TransformPoints(array);
				if (flag)
				{
					using Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
					int x = array[0].X;
					int y = array[0].Y;
					matrix2.Translate(-x, -y, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix2.Rotate(180f, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix2.Translate(x, y, MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				graphics = this.graphics.Graphics;
				gstate = graphics?.Save();
				this.graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			string text;
			if (t.labelStyle.ReverseText)
			{
				char[] array2 = t.GetTextString().ToCharArray();
				Array.Reverse(array2);
				text = new string(array2);
			}
			else
			{
				text = t.GetTextString();
			}
			Brush brush;
			if (t.PE == null || t.labelStyle == null)
			{
				brush = new SolidBrush(t.labelStyle.FontColor);
			}
			else
			{
				if (t.PE.Fill == Color.Transparent || t.PE.Fill == Color.Empty)
				{
					t.PE.Fill = t.labelStyle.FontColor;
				}
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, t.labelStyle.Font);
				Size size = new Size((int)stringSizePixels.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(t.PE, new Rectangle(new Point(num4, num5), size));
			}
			Region clip = this.graphics.Clip;
			if (!t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				this.graphics.ResetClip();
			}
			this.graphics.DrawString(text, t.labelStyle.Font, brush, num4, num5);
			this.graphics.Clip = clip;
			if (t.PE == null || t.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
			{
				brush.Dispose();
			}
			graphics?.Restore(gstate);
		}

		public void DrawWithBounds(Text t)
		{
			if (t.bounds.Width <= 1 || t.bounds.Height <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point location = t.bounds.Location;
			bool flag = t.labelStyle.Flip;
			int num = t.labelStyle.RotationAngle;
			switch (t.labelStyle.Orientation)
			{
			case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				flag = true;
				num = -90;
				break;
			case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				flag = false;
				num = -90;
				break;
			case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
				flag = false;
				num = 0;
				break;
			}
			if (!t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				_ = Math.Abs(num) % 90;
			}
			Rectangle bounds = t.bounds;
			bounds.X += 2;
			bounds.Width -= 2;
			int num2 = location.X + bounds.Width / 2;
			int num3 = location.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			Graphics graphics;
			GraphicsState gstate;
			using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
			{
				matrix.RotateAt(-num, new PointF(num2, num3), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Translate(t.labelStyle.Dx, t.labelStyle.Dy, MatrixOrder.Append);
				Point point = new Point(num2 + bounds.Width / 2, num3 + bounds.Height / 2);
				Point[] array = new Point[2] { point, location };
				matrix.TransformPoints(array);
				if (flag)
				{
					using Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
					_ = array[0].X;
					_ = array[0].Y;
					matrix2.RotateAt(180f, new PointF(num2, num3), MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				graphics = this.graphics.Graphics;
				gstate = graphics?.Save();
				this.graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat();
			StringFormatFlags stringFormatFlags = (StringFormatFlags)0;
			if (!t.labelStyle.WrapText)
			{
				stringFormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			}
			stringFormat.Trimming = t.labelStyle.Trimming;
			if (!t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				stringFormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoClip;
			}
			stringFormat.Alignment = t.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
			stringFormat.LineAlignment = t.labelStyle.VerticalAlign;
			stringFormat.FormatFlags = stringFormatFlags;
			if (t.labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit)
			{
				ScaleFontBestFit(t);
			}
			if (t.FitsInBox)
			{
				bounds = Rectangle.Round(Geometry.InnerBoundingBox(bounds, num));
			}
			new Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 2, bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 2);
			Region clip = this.graphics.Clip;
			if (ClippingText || t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				if (this.graphics.graphics != null)
				{
					this.graphics.SetClip(Rectangle.Intersect(bounds, Rectangle.Truncate(this.graphics.graphics.ClipBounds)));
				}
				else
				{
					this.graphics.SetClip(bounds);
				}
			}
			Brush brush;
			if (t.PE == null)
			{
				brush = new SolidBrush(t.labelStyle.FontColor);
			}
			else
			{
				if (t.PE.Fill == Color.Transparent && t.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
				{
					t.PE.Fill = t.labelStyle.FontColor;
				}
				brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(t.PE, bounds);
			}
			string text;
			if (t.labelStyle.ReverseText)
			{
				char[] array2 = t.GetTextString().ToCharArray();
				Array.Reverse(array2);
				text = new string(array2);
			}
			else
			{
				text = t.GetTextString();
			}
			if (brush != Brushes.Transparent)
			{
				string bestFitString = Platform.GetBestFitString(text, t.labelStyle.Font, ref bounds, stringFormat);
				this.graphics.DrawString(bestFitString, t.labelStyle.Font, brush, bounds, stringFormat);
			}
			if (t.PE == null || t.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
			{
				brush.Dispose();
			}
			this.graphics.Clip = clip;
			graphics?.Restore(gstate);
		}

		public void DrawWithRotatedBounds(Text t)
		{
			if (t.bounds.Width <= 1 || t.bounds.Height <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point location = t.bounds.Location;
			bool flip = t.labelStyle.Flip;
			int rotationAngle = t.labelStyle.RotationAngle;
			_ = t.labelStyle.ClipText;
			Rectangle bounds = t.bounds;
			int num = location.X + bounds.Width / 2;
			int num2 = location.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			if (!t.RotationOrigin.IsEmpty)
			{
				num = t.RotationOrigin.X;
				num2 = t.RotationOrigin.Y;
			}
			Graphics graphics;
			GraphicsState gstate;
			using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
			{
				matrix.RotateAt(-rotationAngle, new PointF(num, num2), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Translate(t.labelStyle.Dx, t.labelStyle.Dy, MatrixOrder.Append);
				Point point = new Point(num + bounds.Width / 2, num2 + bounds.Height / 2);
				Point[] array = new Point[2] { point, location };
				matrix.TransformPoints(array);
				if (flip)
				{
					using Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
					_ = array[0].X;
					_ = array[0].Y;
					matrix2.RotateAt(180f, new PointF(num, num2), MatrixOrder.Append);
					matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				graphics = this.graphics.Graphics;
				gstate = graphics?.Save();
				this.graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat();
			StringFormatFlags stringFormatFlags = (StringFormatFlags)0;
			if (!t.labelStyle.WrapText)
			{
				stringFormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			}
			stringFormat.Trimming = t.labelStyle.Trimming;
			if (!t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				stringFormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoClip;
			}
			stringFormat.Alignment = t.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
			stringFormat.LineAlignment = t.labelStyle.VerticalAlign;
			stringFormat.FormatFlags = stringFormatFlags;
			if (t.labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit)
			{
				ScaleFontBestFit(t);
			}
			new Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 2, bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 2);
			Region clip = this.graphics.Clip;
			if (ClippingText || t.labelStyle.ClipText)
			{
				if (this.graphics.graphics != null)
				{
					this.graphics.SetClip(Rectangle.Intersect(bounds, Rectangle.Truncate(this.graphics.graphics.ClipBounds)));
				}
				else
				{
					this.graphics.SetClip(bounds);
				}
			}
			Brush brush;
			if (t.PE == null)
			{
				brush = new SolidBrush(t.labelStyle.FontColor);
			}
			else
			{
				if (t.PE.Fill == Color.Transparent && t.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
				{
					t.PE.Fill = t.labelStyle.FontColor;
				}
				brush = PaintElement.GetBrush(t.PE, bounds);
			}
			string s;
			if (t.labelStyle.ReverseText)
			{
				char[] array2 = t.GetTextString().ToCharArray();
				Array.Reverse(array2);
				s = new string(array2);
			}
			else
			{
				s = t.GetTextString();
			}
			if (brush != Brushes.Transparent)
			{
				this.graphics.DrawString(s, t.labelStyle.Font, brush, bounds, stringFormat);
			}
			brush?.Dispose();
			this.graphics.Clip = clip;
			graphics?.Restore(gstate);
		}

		internal static Font FindBestFitFont(Text t)
		{
			return FindBestFitFont(t, 6.5f, 100f);
		}

		internal static Font FindBestFitFont(Text t, float minimumSize, float maximumSize)
		{
			GraphicsImage graphicsImage = new GraphicsImage();
			Font result = FindBestFitFont(t, graphicsImage, minimumSize, maximumSize);
			graphicsImage.Dispose();
			return result;
		}

		private static Font FindBestFitFont(Text t, GraphicsImage graphics)
		{
			return FindBestFitFont(t, graphics, 6.5f, 100f);
		}

		private static Font FindBestFitFont(Text t, GraphicsImage graphics, float minimumSize, float maximumSize)
		{
			LabelStyle labelStyle = t.GetLabelStyle();
			Font font = labelStyle.Font;
			float num;
			using (Font font2 = new Font(labelStyle.Font, labelStyle.Font.Style))
			{
				num = font2.SizeInPoints;
			}
			if (t.bounds.Width > 0 && t.bounds.Height > 0)
			{
				SizeF labelSizePixels;
				using (Font font3 = new Font(labelStyle.Font, labelStyle.Font.Style))
				{
					labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(t.GetTextString(), t.labelStyle, font3);
				}
				bool flag = true;
				Rectangle bounds = t.bounds;
				float num2 = bounds.Width;
				float num3 = num2;
				float num4 = bounds.Height;
				float num5 = num2 - num2 * 0.15f;
				float num6 = num5;
				double num7 = 0.6;
				if (labelStyle.WrapText)
				{
					TextOrientation orientation = labelStyle.Orientation;
					if (orientation == TextOrientation.Horizontal)
					{
						int num8 = (int)Math.Floor(num4 / labelSizePixels.Height);
						num3 = num2 * (float)num8;
						num6 = (int)((double)num3 * num7);
						if (labelSizePixels.Width < num3 && labelSizePixels.Width > num6)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag && (labelSizePixels.Width > num3 || labelSizePixels.Height > num4))
				{
					Font font4 = labelStyle.Font;
					Font font5 = null;
					for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
					{
						num -= num * 0.15f;
						num = Math.Max(num, minimumSize);
						font5 = new Font(font4.FontFamily, num, font4.Style);
						labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(t.GetTextString(), t.labelStyle, font5);
						font = font5;
						font4 = font5;
						if (labelStyle.WrapText)
						{
							int num9 = (int)Math.Floor(num4 / labelSizePixels.Height);
							num3 = num2 * (float)num9 - (float)(int)((double)num2 * 0.1);
							num6 = (int)((double)num3 * num7);
							if (labelSizePixels.Width < num3)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						else if (num <= minimumSize || (labelSizePixels.Width <= num3 && labelSizePixels.Height <= num4))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (flag && labelSizePixels.Width < num6)
				{
					Font font6 = labelStyle.Font;
					Font font7 = null;
					for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++)
					{
						num += num * 0.15f;
						if (num > maximumSize)
						{
							break;
						}
						font7 = new Font(font6.FontFamily, num, font6.Style);
						labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(t.GetTextString(), t.labelStyle, font7);
						if (labelStyle.WrapText)
						{
							int num10 = (int)Math.Floor(num4 / labelSizePixels.Height);
							num3 = num2 * (float)num10 - (float)(int)((double)num2 * 0.1);
							num6 = (int)((double)num3 * num7);
							if (labelSizePixels.Width < num3 && labelSizePixels.Width > num6)
							{
								font = font7;
								if (font6 != null && font6 != labelStyle.Font)
								{
									font6.Dispose();
								}
								break;
							}
						}
						else if (labelSizePixels.Width < num3 && labelSizePixels.Height <= num4)
						{
							font = font7;
							if (font6 != null && font6 != labelStyle.Font)
							{
								font6.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			float sizeInPoints;
			using (Font font8 = new Font(font, font.Style))
			{
				sizeInPoints = font8.SizeInPoints;
			}
			if (sizeInPoints < minimumSize || sizeInPoints > maximumSize)
			{
				Font font9 = font;
				font = new Font(font.FontFamily, Math.Min(maximumSize, Math.Max(minimumSize, sizeInPoints)), font.Style);
				font9.Dispose();
			}
			return font;
		}

		private void ScaleFontBestFit(Text t)
		{
			t.labelStyle.Font = FindBestFitFont(t, graphics);
		}

		public void Draw(Polyline polyline)
		{
			if (polyline.PE.StrokeWidth < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (svgContainer != null)
			{
				SvgContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
			}
			if (flashContainer != null)
			{
				FlashContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
			}
			Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(polyline.PE.StrokeOpacity, polyline.PE.Stroke);
			Color lineColor2 = Color.FromArgb(polyline.PE.FillOpacity, polyline.PE.Fill);
			linePen = GetLinePen(lineColor, polyline.PE.StrokeWidth, polyline.lineStyle, polyline.PE.StrokeAlignment);
			fillPen = GetLinePen(lineColor2, Math.Max(1, polyline.PE.StrokeWidth - 1), polyline.lineStyle, polyline.PE.StrokeAlignment);
			if (polyline.points != null && polyline.points.Length == 1)
			{
				Point point = polyline.points[0].point;
				Point pt = new Point(point.X + 1, point.Y);
				graphics.DrawLine(fillPen, point, pt);
			}
			else if (polyline.lineStyle.MidPointAnchors)
			{
				Point[] array = new Point[polyline.points.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < polyline.points.Length - 1; i++)
				{
					if ((double)polyline.splineTension == 0.0)
					{
						if (fillPen != null && fillPen.Color.A > 0)
						{
							graphics.DrawLine(fillPen, polyline.points[i].point, polyline.points[i + 1].point);
						}
						else if (linePen != null)
						{
							graphics.DrawLine(linePen, polyline.points[i].point, polyline.points[i + 1].point);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ref Point reference = ref array[i];
						reference = polyline.points[i].point;
						if (i != 0 || polyline.ClosedCurve)
						{
							graphics.DrawEllipse(linePen, array[i].X - 2, array[i].Y - 2, 4, 4);
						}
					}
				}
				if ((double)polyline.splineTension > 0.0)
				{
					drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
					if (polyline.ClosedCurve)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(array);
						arrayList.RemoveAt(arrayList.Count - 1);
						drawPath.AddClosedCurve((Point[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(Point)), polyline.splineTension);
					}
					else
					{
						ref Point reference2 = ref array[polyline.points.Length - 1];
						reference2 = polyline.points[polyline.points.Length - 1].point;
						drawPath.AddCurve(array, polyline.splineTension);
					}
					if (fillPen != null && fillPen.Color.A > 0)
					{
						graphics.DrawPath(fillPen, drawPath);
					}
					else if (linePen != null)
					{
						graphics.DrawPath(linePen, drawPath);
					}
					drawPath.Dispose();
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < polyline.points.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					if (svgContainer != null)
					{
						Point[] array2 = new Point[polyline.points.Length];
						ref Point reference3 = ref array2[j];
						reference3 = polyline.points[j].point;
						SvgContainer.SetPrimitiveValues(polyline.points[j]);
						graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(Color.Transparent), array2[j].X - 4, array2[j].Y - 4, 8, 8);
						SvgContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
						if (j == polyline.points.Length - 2)
						{
							ref Point reference4 = ref array2[j];
							reference4 = polyline.points[j + 1].point;
							SvgContainer.SetPrimitiveValues(polyline.points[j + 1]);
							graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(Color.Transparent), array2[j].X - 4, array2[j].Y - 4, 8, 8);
							SvgContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
						}
					}
					if (flashContainer != null)
					{
						Point[] array3 = new Point[polyline.points.Length];
						ref Point reference5 = ref array3[j];
						reference5 = polyline.points[j].point;
						FlashContainer.SetPrimitiveValues(polyline.points[j]);
						graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(Color.Transparent), array3[j].X - 4, array3[j].Y - 4, 8, 8);
						FlashContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
						if (j == polyline.points.Length - 2)
						{
							ref Point reference6 = ref array3[j];
							reference6 = polyline.points[j + 1].point;
							FlashContainer.SetPrimitiveValues(polyline.points[j + 1]);
							graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(Color.Transparent), array3[j].X - 4, array3[j].Y - 4, 8, 8);
							FlashContainer.ClosePrimitiveValues();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < polyline.points.Length; k++)
				{
					if (polyline.points[k] != null)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				Point[] array4 = new Point[num];
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int l = 0; l < array4.Length; l++)
				{
					if (polyline.points[l] != null)
					{
						ref Point reference7 = ref array4[num2];
						reference7 = polyline.points[l].point;
						num2++;
					}
				}
				if ((double)polyline.splineTension == 0.0)
				{
					if (fillPen != null && fillPen.Color.A > 0)
					{
						graphics.DrawLines(fillPen, array4);
					}
					else if (linePen != null)
					{
						graphics.DrawLines(linePen, array4);
					}
				}
				else if (array4.Length > 1)
				{
					drawPath = null;
					try
					{
						drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
						drawPath.AddCurve(array4, polyline.splineTension);
						graphics.DrawPath(fillPen, drawPath);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					finally
					{
						if (drawPath != null)
						{
							drawPath.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (linePen != null)
			{
				linePen.Dispose();
			}
			if (fillPen != null)
			{
				fillPen.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Draw(Polygon poly)
		{
			Point[] array = poly.Points;
			drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
			if (array == null)
			{
				if (poly.DataPoints == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = poly.DataPoints.Length;
				if (poly.flatBottom && poly.splineTension != 0f)
				{
					num -= 2;
				}
				array = new Point[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					ref Point reference = ref array[i];
					reference = poly.DataPoints[i].point;
				}
				drawPath.AddCurve(array, poly.splineTension);
				if (poly.Chart == ChartType.PolarChart || poly.Chart == ChartType.RadarChart)
				{
					drawPath.AddLine(poly.DataPoints[0].point, poly.DataPoints[poly.DataPoints.Length - 1].point);
				}
				else
				{
					drawPath.AddLine(poly.DataPoints[poly.DataPoints.Length - 2].point, poly.DataPoints[poly.DataPoints.Length - 1].point);
				}
			}
			if (poly.PE != null)
			{
				PaintElementType elementType = poly.PE.ElementType;
				if ((elementType == PaintElementType.Hatch || elementType == PaintElementType.Gradient) && poly.PE.Fill == Color.Transparent)
				{
					_ = poly.PE.FillOpacity;
				}
			}
			if (poly.PE.Stroke != Color.Transparent)
			{
				Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(poly.PE.StrokeOpacity, poly.PE.Stroke);
				using (linePen = GetLinePen(lineColor, poly.PE.StrokeWidth, poly.lineStyle, poly.PE.StrokeAlignment))
				{
					if (poly.splineTension == 0f)
					{
						graphics.DrawPolygon(linePen, array);
					}
					else
					{
						graphics.DrawPath(linePen, drawPath);
					}
				}
			}
			if (poly.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent)
			{
				if (poly.PE != null && (poly.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent || poly.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.CustomBrush))
				{
					if (drawPath.PointCount == 0 && poly.Points != null && poly.Points.Length > 0)
					{
						drawPath.AddLines(poly.Points);
					}
					drawPath.GetBounds();
					fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(poly.PE, drawPath);
				}
				else
				{
					fillBrush = Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				if (poly.splineTension == 0f)
				{
					using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
					graphicsPath.AddPolygon(array);
					graphicsPath.FillMode = FillMode.Winding;
					RectangleF bounds = graphicsPath.GetBounds();
					if (bounds.Width > 1f && bounds.Height > 1f)
					{
						graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, graphicsPath);
					}
				}
				else if (fillBrush != Brushes.Transparent)
				{
					graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, drawPath);
				}
				if (poly.PE == null || poly.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
				{
					fillBrush.Dispose();
				}
			}
			drawPath.Dispose();
		}

		public void Draw(Symbol sym)
		{
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(sym.PE.StrokeOpacity, sym.PE.Stroke);
			Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(sym.PE.FillOpacity, sym.PE.Fill);
			GetSymbolIconBitmap(sym.icon, sym.iconSize, color, color2);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath = GetSymbolIconPath(sym.icon, sym.iconSize);
			using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
			{
				matrix.Translate(sym.point.X - (int)sym.iconSize / 2, sym.point.Y - (int)sym.iconSize / 2);
				graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
			}
			using (SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(color2))
			{
				graphics.FillPath(brush, graphicsPath);
			}
			using Pen pen = new Pen(color);
			graphics.DrawPath(pen, graphicsPath);
		}

		private void DrawBitmap(GraphicsImage g, Bitmap bitmap, Point centerPoint)
		{
			if (bitmap != null)
			{
				ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
				imageAttributes.SetColorKey(Symbol.MaskColor, Symbol.MaskColor);
				int num = bitmap.Width / 2;
				Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(centerPoint.X - num, centerPoint.Y - num, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
				g.DrawImage(bitmap, destRect, 0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			}
		}

		private Bitmap GetSymbolIconBitmap(SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize, Color drawColor, Color fillColor)
		{
			int num = (int)iconSize;
			int height = num;
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(num, height);
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			Brush brush = new SolidBrush(Symbol.MaskColor);
			graphics.FillRectangle(brush, 0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			brush.Dispose();
			SolidBrush solidBrush = null;
			if (fillColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				solidBrush = new SolidBrush(fillColor);
			}
			Pen pen = null;
			if (fillColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				pen = new Pen(fillColor, num / 5 - 1);
			}
			Pen pen2 = null;
			Pen pen3 = null;
			if (drawColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				pen2 = new Pen(drawColor, num / 5 - 1 + num / 5);
				pen3 = new Pen(drawColor, 1f);
			}
			num--;
			height = num;
			Point[] array = null;
			switch (icon)
			{
			case SymbolIcon.Triangle:
				array = new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(0, height),
					new Point(num, height),
					new Point(num / 2, 0)
				};
				if (solidBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillPolygon(solidBrush, array);
				}
				if (pen3 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawPolygon(pen3, array);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Plus:
				if (pen2 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawLine(pen2, num / 2, 0, num / 2, height);
					graphics.DrawLine(pen2, 0, height / 2, num, height / 2);
				}
				if (pen != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, num / 2, 0, num / 2, height);
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, 0, height / 2, num, height / 2);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.X:
				if (pen2 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawLine(pen2, 0, 0, num, height);
					graphics.DrawLine(pen2, 0, height, num, 0);
				}
				if (pen != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, 0, 0, num, height);
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, 0, height, num, 0);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Square:
				if (solidBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillRectangle(solidBrush, 0, 0, num, height);
				}
				if (pen3 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawRectangle(pen3, 0, 0, num, height);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Circle:
				if (solidBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillEllipse(solidBrush, 0, 0, num, height);
				}
				if (pen3 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawEllipse(pen3, 0, 0, num, height);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Diamond:
				array = new Point[4]
				{
					new Point(num / 2, 0),
					new Point(num, height / 2),
					new Point(num / 2, height),
					new Point(0, height / 2)
				};
				if (solidBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillPolygon(solidBrush, array);
				}
				if (pen3 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawPolygon(pen3, array);
				}
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.UpsideDownTriangle:
				array = new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(0, 0),
					new Point(num / 2, height),
					new Point(num, 0)
				};
				if (solidBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillPolygon(solidBrush, array);
				}
				if (pen3 != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawPolygon(pen3, array);
				}
				break;
			}
			solidBrush?.Dispose();
			pen3?.Dispose();
			pen?.Dispose();
			pen2?.Dispose();
			graphics.Dispose();
			return bitmap;
		}

		private GraphicsPath GetSymbolIconPath(SymbolIcon icon, SymbolIconSize iconSize)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			int num = (int)iconSize;
			int num2 = num;
			num--;
			num2 = num;
			Point[] array = null;
			switch (icon)
			{
			case SymbolIcon.Triangle:
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(0, num2),
					new Point(num, num2),
					new Point(num / 2, 0)
				});
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Plus:
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(0, num2),
					new Point(num, num2),
					new Point(num / 2, 0)
				});
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.X:
				graphicsPath.AddLine(0, 0, num, num2);
				graphicsPath.AddLine(0, num2, num, 0);
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Square:
				graphicsPath.AddRectangle(new Rectangle(0, 0, num, num2));
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Circle:
				graphicsPath.AddEllipse(0, 0, num, num2);
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.Diamond:
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[4]
				{
					new Point(num / 2, 0),
					new Point(num, num2 / 2),
					new Point(num / 2, num2),
					new Point(0, num2 / 2)
				});
				break;
			case SymbolIcon.UpsideDownTriangle:
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3]
				{
					new Point(0, 0),
					new Point(num / 2, num2),
					new Point(num, 0)
				});
				break;
			}
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		public void Draw(PointSet PointSet)
		{
			if (PointSet.icon == SymbolIcon.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			Bitmap bitmap = null;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			if (PointSet.icon != SymbolIcon.Character)
			{
				Color color = Color.FromArgb(PointSet.PE.StrokeOpacity, PointSet.PE.Stroke);
				Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(PointSet.PE.FillOpacity, PointSet.PE.Fill);
				bitmap = GetSymbolIconBitmap(PointSet.icon, PointSet.iconSize, color, color2);
				for (int i = 0; i < PointSet.points.GetLength(0); i++)
				{
					if (PointSet.points[i] != null && PointSet.points[i].Visible)
					{
						graphicsPath = GetSymbolIconPath(PointSet.icon, PointSet.iconSize);
						int num = bitmap.Width / 2;
						Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(PointSet.points[i].point.X - num, PointSet.points[i].point.Y - num, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
						using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
						{
							matrix.Translate(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y);
							graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
						}
						using (SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(color2))
						{
							graphics.FillPath(brush, graphicsPath);
						}
						using (Pen pen = new Pen(color))
						{
							graphics.DrawPath(pen, graphicsPath);
						}
						using Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix();
						matrix2.Translate(-rectangle.X, -rectangle.Y);
						graphicsPath.Transform(matrix2);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (PointSet.character.ToString().Length > 0 && PointSet.font != null)
			{
				Color.FromArgb(PointSet.PE.StrokeOpacity, PointSet.PE.Stroke);
				string text = PointSet.character.ToString();
				SizeF sizeF = graphics.MeasureString(text, PointSet.font);
				Brush brush2 = PaintElement.GetBrush(PointSet.PE, new Rectangle(PointSet.point, new Size((int)sizeF.Width, (int)sizeF.Height)));
				sizeF.Height /= 2f;
				sizeF.Width /= 2f;
				for (int j = 0; j < PointSet.points.GetLength(0); j++)
				{
					if (PointSet.points[j] != null && PointSet.points[j].Visible)
					{
						graphics.DrawString(text, PointSet.font, brush2, (float)PointSet.points[j].point.X - sizeF.Width, (float)PointSet.points[j].point.Y - sizeF.Height);
					}
				}
				brush2.Dispose();
				return;
			}
			SolidBrush solidBrush = new SolidBrush(Color.Black);
			for (int k = 0; k < PointSet.points.GetLength(0); k++)
			{
				if (PointSet.points[k] != null && PointSet.points[k].Visible)
				{
					graphics.FillEllipse(solidBrush, PointSet.points[k].point.X, PointSet.points[k].point.Y, 3, 3);
				}
			}
			solidBrush.Dispose();
		}

		public void Draw(Line l)
		{
			Point p = l.p1;
			Point p2 = l.p2;
			Pen pen = null;
			if (l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.DiamondAnchor || l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.Flat || l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.RoundAnchor || l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.Square || l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.SquareAnchor || l.lineStyle.EndStyle == LineCapStyle.Triangle)
			{
				if (p.Y == p2.Y)
				{
					p2.X -= l.PE.StrokeWidth;
				}
				if (p.X == p2.X)
				{
					p2.Y += l.PE.StrokeWidth;
				}
			}
			Color color = Color.Transparent;
			if (l.PE.Stroke != Color.Transparent && l.PE.StrokeWidth > 0)
			{
				pen = GetLinePen(Color.FromArgb(l.PE.StrokeOpacity, l.PE.Stroke), l.PE.StrokeWidth, l.lineStyle, l.PE.StrokeAlignment);
				color = pen.Color;
				try
				{
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, p, p2);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				pen.Dispose();
			}
			if (l.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent && l.lineStyle.DrawStyle == LineDrawStyle.Solid)
			{
				int num = l.PE.StrokeWidth - 1;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(l.PE.FillOpacity, l.PE.Fill);
					pen = GetLinePen(lineColor, num, l.lineStyle, l.PE.StrokeAlignment);
					color = pen.Color;
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, p.X, p.Y, p2.X, p2.Y);
					pen.Dispose();
				}
			}
			double num2 = Math.Atan(((double)l.p2.Y * 1.0 - (double)l.p1.Y) / ((double)l.p2.X * 1.0 - (double)l.p1.X)) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			PointF pointF = l.p2;
			pointF = ((l.p2.X <= l.p1.X) ? new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X - Math.Cos(num2 * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)l.p2.Y - Math.Sin(num2 * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth)) : new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X + Math.Cos(num2 * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)l.p2.Y + Math.Sin(num2 * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth)));
			switch (l.lineStyle.EndStyle)
			{
			case LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor:
			{
				PointF[] array = new PointF[3];
				if (l.p2.X < l.p1.X)
				{
					array[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference5 = ref array[1];
					reference5 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference6 = ref array[2];
					reference6 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				else
				{
					array[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference7 = ref array[1];
					reference7 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference8 = ref array[2];
					reference8 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 30.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * 2.0 * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(color), array);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.DiamondAnchor:
			{
				PointF[] array2 = new PointF[4];
				double num4 = Math.Sqrt(2.0 * Math.Pow(l.PE.StrokeWidth, 2.0));
				if (l.p2.X < l.p1.X)
				{
					array2[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference9 = ref array2[1];
					reference9 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference10 = ref array2[2];
					reference10 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * num4), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * num4));
					ref PointF reference11 = ref array2[3];
					reference11 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				else
				{
					array2[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference12 = ref array2[1];
					reference12 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference13 = ref array2[2];
					reference13 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * num4), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * num4));
					ref PointF reference14 = ref array2[3];
					reference14 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 45.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(color), array2);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.RoundAnchor:
			{
				float num3 = (float)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 1f;
				graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(color), (float)l.p2.X - num3, (float)l.p2.Y - num3, num3 * 2f, num3 * 2f);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.SquareAnchor:
			{
				PointF[] array3 = new PointF[4];
				if (l.p2.X < l.p1.X)
				{
					ref PointF reference15 = ref array3[0];
					reference15 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference16 = ref array3[1];
					reference16 = new PointF((float)((double)array3[0].X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0), (float)((double)array3[0].Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0));
					ref PointF reference17 = ref array3[2];
					reference17 = new PointF((float)((double)array3[1].X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0), (float)((double)array3[1].Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0));
					ref PointF reference18 = ref array3[3];
					reference18 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				else
				{
					ref PointF reference19 = ref array3[0];
					reference19 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
					ref PointF reference20 = ref array3[1];
					reference20 = new PointF((float)((double)array3[0].X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0), (float)((double)array3[0].Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0));
					ref PointF reference21 = ref array3[2];
					reference21 = new PointF((float)((double)array3[1].X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0), (float)((double)array3[1].Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 2.0));
					ref PointF reference22 = ref array3[3];
					reference22 = new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth), (float)((double)pointF.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth));
				}
				graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(color), array3);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.Round:
			{
				float num3 = (float)l.PE.StrokeWidth * 1f;
				graphics.FillEllipse(new SolidBrush(color), (float)l.p2.X - num3 / 2f, (float)l.p2.Y - num3 / 2f, num3, num3);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.Triangle:
			{
				PointF[] array = new PointF[3];
				if (l.p2.X < l.p1.X)
				{
					array[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference = ref array[1];
					reference = new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0), (float)((double)l.p2.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0));
					ref PointF reference2 = ref array[2];
					reference2 = new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X + Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0), (float)((double)l.p2.Y + Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0));
				}
				else
				{
					array[0] = pointF;
					ref PointF reference3 = ref array[1];
					reference3 = new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0), (float)((double)l.p2.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 - 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0));
					ref PointF reference4 = ref array[2];
					reference4 = new PointF((float)((double)l.p2.X - Math.Sin((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0), (float)((double)l.p2.Y - Math.Cos((90.0 - num2 + 90.0) * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)l.PE.StrokeWidth / 2.0));
				}
				graphics.FillPolygon(new SolidBrush(color), array);
				break;
			}
			case LineCapStyle.Flat:
			case LineCapStyle.Square:
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Draw(ChartImage chartImage)
		{
			Image image = chartImage.image;
			switch (chartImage.FitStyle)
			{
			case ImageFitStyle.Tiled:
			{
				WrapMode wrapMode = WrapMode.Tile;
				if (chartImage.PE != null)
				{
					wrapMode = chartImage.PE.ImageWrapMode;
				}
				TextureBrush textureBrush = new TextureBrush(image, wrapMode);
				graphics.FillRectangle(textureBrush, chartImage.bounds);
				textureBrush.Dispose();
				break;
			}
			case ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit:
				graphics.DrawImage(chartImage.image, chartImage.bounds, 0, 0, chartImage.image.Width, chartImage.image.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				break;
			case ImageFitStyle.Centered:
			{
				int x = chartImage.bounds.Left + chartImage.bounds.Width / 2 - chartImage.image.Width / 2;
				int y = chartImage.bounds.Top + chartImage.bounds.Height / 2 - chartImage.image.Height / 2;
				int width = Math.Min(chartImage.bounds.Width, chartImage.image.Width);
				int height = Math.Min(chartImage.bounds.Height, chartImage.image.Height);
				Region clip = graphics.Clip;
				graphics.SetClip(chartImage.bounds);
				graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(chartImage.image, new Rectangle(x, y, width, height));
				graphics.SetClip(clip, CombineMode.Replace);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public void Draw(GraphicsContext gc)
		{
			if (gc.GetResetClip())
			{
				graphics.ResetClip();
				useClip = false;
			}
			if (gc.ClipPath != null)
			{
				graphics.SetClip(gc.ClipPath);
			}
			else
			{
				Rectangle clipBounds = gc.GetClipBounds();
				if (clipBounds.Width > 0 && clipBounds.Height > 0)
				{
					graphics.SetClip(clipBounds);
					clipRect = clipBounds;
					useClip = true;
				}
			}
			if (gc.ApplyRenderingMode())
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = gc.GetRenderingMode();
			}
			if (gc.ResetTransform)
			{
				graphics.ResetTransform();
			}
			if (gc.Transform != null)
			{
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(gc.Transform, MatrixOrder.Append);
			}
			ClippingText = gc.ClipText;
		}

		public void Draw(Ellipse e)
		{
			GraphicsState graphicsState = null;
			if (e.RotationAngle != 0)
			{
				using Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.RotateAt(e.RotationAngle, e.GetCenterPoint(), MatrixOrder.Append);
				if (graphics.Graphics != null)
				{
					graphicsState = graphics.Graphics.Save();
				}
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			if (e.PE != null)
			{
				if (e.PE.FillGradientStyle != GradientStyle.Raise)
				{
					if (e.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.Image && e.PE.FillImage != null)
					{
						drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
						drawPath.AddEllipse(e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y);
						Region clip = graphics.Clip;
						graphics.SetClip(drawPath, CombineMode.Intersect);
						switch (e.PE.ImageFitStyle)
						{
						case ImageFitStyle.Tiled:
							fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(e.PE, drawPath);
							graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, drawPath);
							break;
						case ImageFitStyle.Centered:
							graphics.DrawImage(e.PE.FillImage, e.p1.X + (e.p2.X - e.PE.FillImage.Width) / 2, e.p1.Y + (e.p2.Y - e.PE.FillImage.Height) / 2, e.PE.FillImage.Width, e.PE.FillImage.Height);
							break;
						case ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit:
						{
							GraphicsUnit pageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
							graphics.DrawImage(e.PE.FillImage, new Rectangle(e.p1, new Size(e.p2.X, e.p2.Y)), e.PE.FillImage.GetBounds(ref pageUnit), GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
							break;
						}
						}
						graphics.Clip = clip;
					}
					else
					{
						fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(e.PE, new Rectangle(e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y));
						if (fillBrush != Brushes.Transparent)
						{
							try
							{
								if (e.p2.X > 0 && e.p2.Y > 0)
								{
									graphics.FillEllipse(fillBrush, e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y);
								}
							}
							catch (ArgumentException)
							{
							}
							finally
							{
								if (e.PE == null || e.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
								{
									fillBrush.Dispose();
								}
							}
						}
					}
					Color color = Color.FromArgb(e.PE.StrokeOpacity, e.PE.Stroke);
					if (color != Color.Transparent && e.PE.StrokeWidth > 0)
					{
						linePen = GetLinePen(color, e.PE.StrokeWidth, e.lineStyle, e.PE.StrokeAlignment);
						try
						{
							graphics.DrawEllipse(linePen, e.p1.X + 1, e.p1.Y + 1, e.p2.X - 2, e.p2.Y - 2);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						finally
						{
							linePen.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
					try
					{
						drawPath.AddEllipse(e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y);
						Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(e.PE.FillOpacity, e.PE.Fill);
						fillBrush = PaintElement.GetHilightBrush(e.PE, drawPath, MiscFunctions.LightenColor(color2, 50.0));
						graphics.FillEllipse(fillBrush, e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
					}
					finally
					{
						fillBrush.Dispose();
						drawPath.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (e.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent)
			{
				fillBrush = new SolidBrush(e.PE.Fill);
				try
				{
					graphics.FillEllipse(fillBrush, e.p1.X, e.p1.Y, e.p2.X, e.p2.Y);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
				}
				finally
				{
					fillBrush.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (e.RotationAngle != 0 && graphics.Graphics != null && graphicsState != null)
			{
				graphics.Graphics.Restore(graphicsState);
			}
		}

		public void Draw(Box b, int roundness)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(b.rect.X, b.rect.Y, b.rect.Width, b.rect.Height);
			GraphicsState graphicsState = null;
			if (b.RotationAngle != 0)
			{
				using Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.RotateAt(b.RotationAngle, new PointF(rectangle.Left + rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Top + rectangle.Height / 2), MatrixOrder.Append);
				if (graphics.Graphics != null)
				{
					graphicsState = graphics.Graphics.Save();
				}
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			roundness = Math.Min(Math.Min(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height) / 3, roundness);
			drawPath = GetRoundedPath(rectangle, roundness);
			if (b.PE != null)
			{
				if (b.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent || b.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
				{
					fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(b.PE, rectangle);
				}
				else
				{
					fillBrush = new SolidBrush(b.PE.Fill);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				fillBrush = Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			if (b.PE != null && b.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.Image && b.PE.FillImage != null)
			{
				WIC386Fix(b);
			}
			else
			{
				graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, drawPath);
			}
			if (b.PE == null || b.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
			{
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (b.PE != null && b.PE.FillGradientStyle == GradientStyle.Raise)
			{
				Color color = Color.FromArgb(b.PE.FillOpacity, b.PE.Fill);
				if (b.Path != null)
				{
					b.Path.IndexOf("Border");
				}
				int num = (color.R + color.G + color.B) / 3;
				int factor = num / 5;
				Color color2 = MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(color, factor);
				Rectangle boxRect = rectangle;
				Color color3 = Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
				for (int i = -4; i < 12; i++)
				{
					boxRect.Inflate(-1, -1);
					using SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(color3, i * 4));
					int num2 = 0;
					if (i < 0 || roundness > 50)
					{
						num2 = Convert.ToInt32((double)roundness * 0.5 / (double)(5 + i));
						if (roundness > 50)
						{
							num2 *= 2;
						}
					}
					graphics.FillPolygon(brush, GetRoundedPath(boxRect, roundness + num2).PathPoints);
				}
				using (fillBrush = new SolidBrush(color2))
				{
					boxRect.Inflate(-1, -1);
					graphics.FillPolygon(fillBrush, GetRoundedPath(boxRect, roundness).PathPoints);
				}
			}
			if (b.PE != null && b.PE.StrokeWidth > 0 && b.PE.Stroke != Color.Transparent)
			{
				Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(b.PE.StrokeOpacity, b.PE.Stroke);
				linePen = GetLinePen(lineColor, b.PE.StrokeWidth, b.lineStyle, b.PE.StrokeAlignment);
				graphics.DrawPath(linePen, drawPath);
				linePen.Dispose();
			}
			if (drawPath != null)
			{
				drawPath.Dispose();
			}
			if (fillBrush != null)
			{
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (linePen != null)
			{
				linePen.Dispose();
			}
			if (b.RotationAngle != 0 && graphics.Graphics != null && graphicsState != null)
			{
				graphics.Graphics.Restore(graphicsState);
			}
		}

		internal void WIC386Fix(Box b)
		{
			Region clip = graphics.Clip;
			graphics.SetClip(drawPath);
			switch (b.PE.ImageFitStyle)
			{
			case ImageFitStyle.Tiled:
			case ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit:
			case ImageFitStyle.Centered:
				fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(b.PE, drawPath);
				graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, drawPath);
				break;
			}
			graphics.Clip = clip;
		}

		public void Draw(Box b)
		{
			if (b.rect.Width * b.rect.Height < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			fillBrush = null;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(b.rect.X, b.rect.Y, b.rect.Width, b.rect.Height);
			if (b.Roundness > 0)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(Math.Min(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height) / 3, b.Roundness);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					Draw(b, b.Roundness);
					return;
				}
			}
			GraphicsState graphicsState = null;
			if (b.RotationAngle != 0)
			{
				using Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.RotateAt(b.RotationAngle, new PointF(rectangle.Left + rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Top + rectangle.Height / 2), MatrixOrder.Append);
				if (graphics.Graphics != null)
				{
					graphicsState = graphics.Graphics.Save();
				}
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			if (useClip)
			{
				rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(rectangle, clipRect);
			}
			if (b.SE != null)
			{
				switch (b.SE.Tile)
				{
				case SkinTile.Stretched:
				{
					drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
					drawPath.AddRectangle(b.rect);
					PaintElement ele = new PaintElement(b.SE.Image);
					graphics.FillPath(PaintElement.GetBrush(ele, b.rect), drawPath);
					break;
				}
				case SkinTile.TileX:
				case SkinTile.TileY:
					break;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (b.PE != null)
			{
				fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(b.PE, rectangle);
				if (fillBrush != null && fillBrush != Brushes.Transparent)
				{
					try
					{
						if (b.PE.ElementType == PaintElementType.Image && b.PE.FillImage != null)
						{
							drawPath = new GraphicsPath();
							drawPath.AddRectangle(rectangle);
							WIC386Fix(b);
						}
						else if (rectangle.Height > 1 && rectangle.Width > 1)
						{
							graphics.FillRectangle(fillBrush, rectangle);
						}
						else if (rectangle.Height == 1 || rectangle.Width == 1)
						{
							using Pen pen = new Pen(fillBrush, 1f);
							graphics.DrawLine(pen, new Point(rectangle.Top, rectangle.Left), new Point(rectangle.Bottom, rectangle.Right));
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					if (b.PE == null || b.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
					{
						fillBrush.Dispose();
					}
				}
				if (b.PE.FillGradientStyle == GradientStyle.Raise)
				{
					Color color = Color.FromArgb(b.PE.FillOpacity, b.PE.Fill);
					int num2 = (b.PE.Fill.R + b.PE.Fill.G + b.PE.Fill.B) / 3;
					int factor = num2 / 5;
					Color color2 = MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(color, factor);
					Rectangle rect = rectangle;
					Color color3 = Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
					for (int i = -4; i < 12; i++)
					{
						rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
						using SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(MiscFunctions.BrightenColor(color3, i * 4));
						graphics.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
					}
					using (fillBrush = new SolidBrush(color2))
					{
						rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
						graphics.FillRectangle(fillBrush, rect);
					}
				}
				if (b.PE.StrokeWidth > 0 && b.PE.Stroke != Color.Transparent)
				{
					Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(b.PE.StrokeOpacity, b.PE.Stroke.R, b.PE.Stroke.G, b.PE.Stroke.B);
					linePen = GetLinePen(lineColor, b.PE.StrokeWidth, b.lineStyle, b.PE.StrokeAlignment);
					try
					{
						graphics.DrawRectangle(linePen, rectangle);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					linePen.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (b.RotationAngle != 0 && graphics.Graphics != null && graphicsState != null)
			{
				graphics.Graphics.Restore(graphicsState);
			}
		}

		private static GraphicsPath GetRoundedPath(Rectangle boxRect, int roundness)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(boxRect.X, boxRect.Y, boxRect.Width, boxRect.Height);
			rectangle.Inflate(-roundness, -roundness);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(boxRect.X, boxRect.Y, 2 * (rectangle.X - boxRect.X), 2 * (rectangle.Y - boxRect.Y));
			Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.Right - (boxRect.Right - rectangle.Right), boxRect.Y, 2 * (boxRect.Right - rectangle.Right), 2 * (rectangle.Y - boxRect.Y));
			Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(rectangle.Right - (boxRect.Right - rectangle.Right), rectangle.Bottom - (boxRect.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom), 2 * (boxRect.Right - rectangle.Right), 2 * (boxRect.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom));
			Rectangle rect4 = new Rectangle(boxRect.X, rectangle.Bottom - (boxRect.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom), 2 * (rectangle.X - boxRect.X), 2 * (boxRect.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom));
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect, 180f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(rect.X + rect.Width / 2, rect.Y, rect2.X + rect2.Width / 2, rect2.Y);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect2, 270f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(rect2.Right, rect2.Y + rect2.Height / 2, rect3.Right, rect3.Y + rect3.Width / 2);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect3, 0f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(rect3.X + rect3.Width / 2, rect3.Bottom, rect4.X + rect4.Width / 2, rect4.Bottom);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect4, 90f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(rect4.Left, rect4.Top, rect.Left, rect.Bottom);
			graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		public void Draw(Arc a)
		{
			Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(a.PE.StrokeOpacity, a.PE.Stroke.R, a.PE.Stroke.G, a.PE.Stroke.B);
			using Pen pen = GetLinePen(lineColor, a.PE.StrokeWidth, a.lineStyle, a.PE.StrokeAlignment);
			graphics.DrawArc(pen, a.Center.X - a.Radius, a.Center.Y - a.Radius, a.Radius * 2, a.Radius * 2, 0f - a.startAngle, a.angleSweep);
		}

		public void Draw(Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path)
		{
			if (path.Highlighted)
			{
				using (SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(path.HighlightPE.Fill))
				{
					graphics.FillPath(brush, path.GraphicsPath);
				}
				using Pen pen = new Pen(path.HighlightPE.Stroke, 1f);
				graphics.DrawPath(pen, path.GraphicsPath);
				return;
			}
			if (path.Brush != null)
			{
				if (path.OutlineOnly)
				{
					using (Pen pen2 = new Pen(path.Brush, 0f))
					{
						pen2.Color = Color.Transparent;
						graphics.DrawPath(pen2, path.GraphicsPath);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!path.Outline)
				{
					PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = path.Brush as PathGradientBrush;
					if (pathGradientBrush == null)
					{
						graphics.FillPath(path.Brush, path.GraphicsPath);
						using (new Pen(path.Brush, 0f))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				if (path.Chart == ChartType.HeatMapChart3D)
				{
					path.GraphicsPath.CloseAllFigures();
				}
				if (path.Brush is PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush2)
				{
					path.Brush = new LinearGradientBrush(pathGradientBrush2.Rectangle, pathGradientBrush2.CenterColor, pathGradientBrush2.SurroundColors[0], LinearGradientMode.Vertical);
				}
				graphics.FillPath(path.Brush, path.GraphicsPath);
				using Pen pen3 = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(path.PE.StrokeOpacity, path.PE.Stroke), 1f);
				graphics.DrawPath(pen3, path.GraphicsPath);
				return;
			}
			if (path.OutlineOnly)
			{
				Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(path.PE.StrokeOpacity, path.PE.Stroke.R, path.PE.Stroke.G, path.PE.Stroke.B);
				using Pen pen4 = GetLinePen(lineColor, path.PE.StrokeWidth, path.LineStyle, path.PE.StrokeAlignment);
				graphics.DrawPath(pen4, path.GraphicsPath);
				return;
			}
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = path.GraphicsPath;
			graphicsPath.CloseAllFigures();
			Color lineColor2 = Color.FromArgb(path.PE.StrokeOpacity, path.PE.Stroke.R, path.PE.Stroke.G, path.PE.Stroke.B);
			using (Pen pen5 = GetLinePen(lineColor2, path.PE.StrokeWidth, path.LineStyle, path.PE.StrokeAlignment))
			{
				graphics.DrawPath(pen5, graphicsPath);
			}
			fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(path.PE, graphicsPath);
			if (!(fillBrush is SolidBrush) || !(((SolidBrush)fillBrush).Color == Color.Transparent))
			{
				graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, graphicsPath);
			}
			if (path.PE == null || path.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
			{
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Draw(Callout callout)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(callout.CornerRadius, Math.Min(callout.BubbleRectangle.Width / 2, callout.BubbleRectangle.Height / 2)));
			Point pt = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + num, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom);
			Point pt2 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom - num);
			Point pt3 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + num);
			Point pt4 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + num, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top);
			Point pt5 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right - num, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top);
			Point pt6 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + num);
			Point pt7 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom - num);
			Point pt8 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right - num, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom);
			bool flag = callout.Origin.Y > callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom && callout.Origin.Y > callout.BubbleRectangle.Top;
			if (callout.Origin.Y < callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom)
			{
				_ = callout.Origin.Y;
				_ = callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom;
			}
			bool flag2 = callout.Origin.X > callout.BubbleRectangle.Right;
			bool flag3 = callout.Origin.X < callout.BubbleRectangle.Left;
			Point point = Point.Empty;
			Point point2 = Point.Empty;
			if (flag)
			{
				point = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + callout.BubbleRectangle.Width * 3 / 8, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom);
				point2 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + callout.BubbleRectangle.Width * 5 / 8, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom);
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				point = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + callout.BubbleRectangle.Width * 3 / 8, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top);
				point2 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left + callout.BubbleRectangle.Width * 5 / 8, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top);
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				point = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + callout.BubbleRectangle.Height * 3 / 8);
				point2 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + callout.BubbleRectangle.Height * 5 / 8);
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				point = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + callout.BubbleRectangle.Height * 3 / 8);
				point2 = new Point(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top + callout.BubbleRectangle.Height * 5 / 8);
			}
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			if (point != Point.Empty && point2 != Point.Empty)
			{
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3] { callout.Origin, point, point2 });
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top, num * 2, num * 2);
			Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right - num * 2, callout.BubbleRectangle.Top, num * 2, num * 2);
			Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(callout.BubbleRectangle.Right - num * 2, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom - num * 2, num * 2, num * 2);
			Rectangle rect4 = new Rectangle(callout.BubbleRectangle.Left, callout.BubbleRectangle.Bottom - num * 2, num * 2, num * 2);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(pt4, pt5);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect2, 270f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(pt6, pt7);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect3, 0f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(pt8, pt);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect4, 90f, 90f);
			graphicsPath.AddLine(pt2, pt3);
			graphicsPath.AddArc(rect, 180f, 90f);
			if (callout.LineStyle == null)
			{
				callout.LineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			}
			if (callout.PE == null)
			{
				callout.PE = new PaintElement();
			}
			Color lineColor = Color.FromArgb(callout.PE.StrokeOpacity, callout.PE.Stroke.R, callout.PE.Stroke.G, callout.PE.Stroke.B);
			linePen = GetLinePen(lineColor, callout.PE.StrokeWidth, callout.LineStyle, callout.PE.StrokeAlignment);
			graphics.DrawPath(linePen, graphicsPath);
			fillBrush = PaintElement.GetBrush(callout.PE, graphicsPath);
			if (callout.PE.Fill != Color.Transparent && callout.PE.Fill != Color.Empty)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(fillBrush, graphicsPath);
			}
			if (callout.PE == null || callout.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.CustomBrush)
			{
				fillBrush.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static double Area(Point[] simplePolygon)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < simplePolygon.Length; i++)
			{
				double num2 = simplePolygon[i].X;
				double num3 = simplePolygon[i].Y;
				double num4 = simplePolygon[(i + 1) % simplePolygon.Length].X;
				double num5 = simplePolygon[(i + 1) % simplePolygon.Length].Y;
				num += (num3 + num5) * (num2 - num4) / 2.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Draw(PaintElement PE, GraphicsPath gpath)
		{
			if (gpath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (PE == null)
			{
				graphics.DrawPath(Pens.Black, gpath);
				return;
			}
			SolidFillBrush = null;
			ImageBrush = null;
			HatchBrush = null;
			GradientBrush = null;
			StrokePen = null;
			ExtraBrush = null;
			StrokePen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(PE.StrokeOpacity, PE.Stroke), PE.StrokeWidth);
			if (SolidFillBrush != null)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(SolidFillBrush, gpath);
				SolidFillBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (ImageBrush != null)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(ImageBrush, gpath);
				ImageBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (HatchBrush != null)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(HatchBrush, gpath);
				HatchBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (GradientBrush != null)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(GradientBrush, gpath);
				GradientBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (ExtraBrush != null)
			{
				graphics.FillPath(ExtraBrush, gpath);
				GradientBrush.Dispose();
			}
			if (StrokePen != null)
			{
				graphics.DrawPath(StrokePen, gpath);
				StrokePen.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class StringFormatParser
	{
		public static Hashtable keywords;

		public static bool keywordsCreated;

		private static readonly Font FONT_DEFAULT = new Font("Times New Roman", 9f);

		public void PaintText(Graphics g, string s, LabelStyle style, Rectangle layoutRectangle)
		{
			if (g == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("g");
			}
			if (style == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("style");
			}
			if (!keywordsCreated)
			{
				BoldText boldText = new BoldText();
				ItalicText italicText = new ItalicText();
				SubscriptText subscriptText = new SubscriptText();
				SuperscriptText superscriptText = new SuperscriptText();
				UnderlineText underlineText = new UnderlineText();
				StrikeText strikeText = new StrikeText();
				FontText fontText = new FontText();
				keywords = new Hashtable();
				Hashtable hashtable = keywords;
				Hashtable hashtable2 = keywords;
				object obj = (keywords["<\\ *strong\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, boldText });
				object value = (hashtable2["<\\ *b\\ *>"] = obj);
				hashtable["<\\ *em\\ *>"] = value;
				Hashtable hashtable3 = keywords;
				Hashtable hashtable4 = keywords;
				object obj4 = (keywords["<\\ */\\ *strong\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, boldText });
				object value2 = (hashtable4["<\\ */\\ *b\\ *>"] = obj4);
				hashtable3["<\\ */\\ *em\\ *>"] = value2;
				keywords["<\\ *i\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, italicText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *i\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, italicText };
				keywords["<\\ *sub\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, subscriptText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *sub\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, subscriptText };
				keywords["<\\ *sup\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, superscriptText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *sup\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, superscriptText };
				keywords["<\\ *strike\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, strikeText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *strike\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, strikeText };
				keywords["<\\ *u\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, underlineText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *u\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, underlineText };
				keywords["<\\ *font(\\ *color\\ *=\\ *\"?\\ *.+?\\ *\"?)?\\ *>"] = new object[2] { 1, fontText };
				keywords["<\\ */\\ *font\\ *>"] = new object[2] { -1, fontText };
				keywordsCreated = true;
			}
			Brush b = new SolidBrush(style.FontColor);
			Font font = style.Font;
			if (font == null)
			{
				font = FONT_DEFAULT;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable5 = new Hashtable();
			Regex regex = new Regex("<.+?>");
			MatchCollection matchCollection = regex.Matches(s);
			foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
			{
				foreach (Capture capture in item.Captures)
				{
					hashtable5[capture.Index] = capture;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			char[] array = s.ToCharArray();
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = new DrawInstruction();
			drawInstruction.B = b;
			drawInstruction.F = font;
			string text = "";

			{
				bool flag = false;
				object[] array2 = null;
				foreach (string key in keywords.Keys)
				{
					if (hashtable5[num] != null && (flag = Regex.Match(((Capture)hashtable5[num]).Value, key).Success))
					{
						array2 = (object[])keywords[key];
						break;
					}
				}
				if (hashtable5[num] != null && flag)
				{
					string value3 = ((Capture)hashtable5[num]).Value;
					num += ((Capture)hashtable5[num]).Length;
					drawInstruction.S = text;
					text = "";
					arrayList.Add(drawInstruction);
					if (array2 != null && array2.Length > 1)
					{
						int num2 = (int)array2[0];
						IProcessMatch processMatch = (IProcessMatch)array2[1];
						drawInstruction = ((num2 <= 0) ? processMatch.ProcessReverse(drawInstruction, value3) : processMatch.Process(drawInstruction, value3));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					text += array[num];
					num++;
				}
				if (num > array.Length - 1)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			drawInstruction.S = text;
			arrayList.Add(drawInstruction);
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 2.1474836E+09f;
			float num5 = -2.1474836E+09f;

					}

					num--;
				}

			}
			int num13 = 0;

					}

					{

					}
				}
				num8 += num5 - num4;
			}
			num7 = num9;
			bool flag2 = false;
			switch (style.Orientation)
			{
			case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				g.TranslateTransform(-num6, -top, MatrixOrder.Append);
				g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
				g.RotateTransform(-90f, MatrixOrder.Append);
				g.TranslateTransform(num6, top, MatrixOrder.Append);

			case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
				g.TranslateTransform(-num6, -top, MatrixOrder.Append);
				g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
				g.RotateTransform(90f, MatrixOrder.Append);
				g.TranslateTransform(num6, top, MatrixOrder.Append);

			case TextOrientation.Custom:

			top += (int)(num8 / 2f);

			}
			g.DrawRectangle(Pens.Blue, num6, top, num7, 400f);

		}
	}
	public interface IProcessMatch
	{
		DrawInstruction Process(DrawInstruction d, string match);

		DrawInstruction ProcessReverse(DrawInstruction d, string match);
	}
	public class FontText : IProcessMatch
	{
		private Brush b;

		public DrawInstruction Process(DrawInstruction d, string match)
		{
			string text = "black";
			Color black = Color.Black;
			if (Regex.Match(match, "color=\"?(.+?)\"?").Success)
			{
				text = Regex.Match(match, "color=\"?(\\w+)\"?").Groups[1].Value;
			}
			black = Color.FromName(text);
			if (text.IndexOf("0x") == 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(2);
			}
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)d.Clone();
			_ = d.F.Style;
			b = drawInstruction.B;
			drawInstruction.B = new SolidBrush(black);
			drawInstruction.Dy = 0;
			return drawInstruction;
		}

		public DrawInstruction ProcessReverse(DrawInstruction d, string match)
		{
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)d.Clone();
			_ = d.F.Style;
			if (b != null)
			{
				drawInstruction.B = b;
			}
			drawInstruction.Dy = 0;
			return drawInstruction;
		}
	}
	public class BoldText : IProcessMatch
	{
		public DrawInstruction Process(DrawInstruction d, string match)
		{
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)d.Clone();
			FontStyle style = d.F.Style;
			drawInstruction.Dy = 0;
			drawInstruction.F = new Font(d.F, style | FontStyle.Bold);
			return drawInstruction;
		}

		public DrawInstruction ProcessReverse(DrawInstruction d, string match)
		{
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)d.Clone();
			FontStyle style = d.F.Style;
			drawInstruction.Dy = 0;
			drawInstruction.F = new Font(d.F, style & (FontStyle.Italic | FontStyle.Underline | FontStyle.Strikeout));
			return drawInstruction;
		}
	}

	public class DrawInstruction : ICloneable
	{
		private Font _F;

		private Brush _B;

		private int _Dx;

		private int _Dy;

		private string _S;

		private char[] cutChars = new char[6] { ' ', '.', ',', ';', ':', '-' };

		public Font F
		{
			get
			{
				return _F;
			}
			set
			{
				_F = value;
			}
		}

		public string S
		{
			get
			{
				return _S;
			}
			set
			{
				_S = value;
			}
		}

		public Brush B
		{
			get
			{
				return _B;
			}
			set
			{
				_B = value;
			}
		}

		public int Dx
		{
			get
			{
				return _Dx;
			}
			set
			{
				_Dx = value;
			}
		}

		public int Dy
		{
			get
			{
				return _Dy;
			}
			set
			{
				_Dy = value;
			}
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = new DrawInstruction();
			drawInstruction.F = F;
			drawInstruction.B = B;
			drawInstruction.Dx = Dx;
			drawInstruction.Dy = Dy;
			drawInstruction.S = S;
			return drawInstruction;
		}

		public SizeF GetSize(Graphics g)
		{
			return g.MeasureString(S, F);
		}

		public bool CanBreakAt(float at, StringTrimming trimType)
		{
			if (S == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (S.Length < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (S.IndexOf(" ") == -1 && (trimType == StringTrimming.EllipsisWord || trimType == StringTrimming.Word))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (at < 0f)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public DrawInstruction PleaseBreakAt(float at, StringTrimming trimType, Graphics g)
		{
			DrawInstruction drawInstruction = null;
			float num = 0f;
			string text = "";
			int num2 = 0;
			switch (trimType)
			{
			case StringTrimming.Character:
			case StringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter:
			{
				num2 = 0;
				char[] array2 = S.ToCharArray();
				foreach (char c2 in array2)
				{
					if (num < at)
					{
						text += c2;
						num2++;
						num = g.MeasureString(text, F).Width;
						continue;
					}
					text = S.Substring(0, num2);
					drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)Clone();
					drawInstruction.S = S.Substring(num2);
					S = text;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			case StringTrimming.Word:
			case StringTrimming.EllipsisWord:
			{
				int num3 = 0;
				num2 = 0;
				char[] array = S.ToCharArray();
				foreach (char c in array)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < cutChars.Length; j++)
					{
						if (cutChars[j] == c)
						{
							num3 = num2;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num < at)
					{
						num2++;
						text += c;
						num = g.MeasureString(text, F).Width;
						continue;
					}
					text = S.Substring(0, num3);
					drawInstruction = (DrawInstruction)Clone();
					drawInstruction.S = S.Substring(num3);
					S = text;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return drawInstruction;
		}
	}
