		{
		}

		internal void SetPrimitiveValues(Primitive primitive)
		{
			if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.Tooltip) > PCaps.None)
			{
				Args = chartControl.ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitive);
				Primitive = primitive;
			}
			else
			{
				Args = null;
				Primitive = null;
			}
			if (eventFunctionName != null && eventFunctionName.Length > 0 && Args != null)
			{
				urlString = "javascript:top." + eventFunctionName + "( null, " + Args.DataRow + ", " + Args.DataColumn + ", " + Args.DataValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ", '" + Args.RowLabel + "', '" + Args.ColumnLabel + "', 'MOUSE_CLICKED' , '" + Args.LayerID + "' )";
			}
			if (Args != null)
			{
				chartControl.ChartCore.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = Args.ColumnLabel;
				chartControl.ChartCore.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = Args.RowLabel;
				chartControl.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = Args.DataColumn;
				chartControl.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = Args.DataRow;
				chartControl.ChartCore.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = Args.DataValue;
				TooltipString = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(chartControl.ChartCore.Environment, TooltipLayer.GetTooltipFormat(chartControl.ChartType, primitive, chartControl.Tooltips, chartControl.ChartCore));
			}
			else
			{
				TooltipString = "";
			}
		}

		internal void ClosePrimitiveValues()
		{
			TooltipString = "";
			urlString = "";
		}

		internal static string SetSvgExtension(string fileName)
		{
			return System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(fileName, "svg");
		}

		internal void CreateFile(Stream stream, string SECU_KEY, Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraChart chartControl, int width, int height, string eventName)
		{
			this.chartControl = chartControl;
			eventFunctionName = eventName;
			_ = string.Empty;
			svgTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
			svgTextWriter.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			if (!ForceInlineSvg)
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartDocument();
			}
			svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("svg");
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg");
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("xmlns:xlink", "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink");
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("xmlns:igchart", "http://www.infragistics.com/2006/chartSvg");
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("id", chartControl.Name);
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("width", "100%");
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("height", "100%");
			if (!ForceInlineSvg)
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
			}
			svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
		}

		internal void CloseFile()
		{
			CloseFile(closeStream: true);
		}

		internal void CloseFile(bool closeStream)
		{
			CloseSection();
			CreateTooltipsScript();
			svgTextWriter.WriteEndElement();
			if (!ForceInlineSvg)
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteEndDocument();
			}
			svgTextWriter.Flush();
			if (closeStream)
			{
				svgTextWriter.Close();
			}
		}

       if (top.IGB.IsFirefox || top.IGB.IsIE9)\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t    textContent = tooltipsText.textContent = target.textContent;\r\n                           setTimeout('SetTooltipWidth(' + xTranslate + ', ' + yTranslate + ', ' + viewBoxWidth + ', ' + viewBoxHeight + ', ' + xScale + ', ' + yScale + ')', 10);\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\telse\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{\r\n                            textContent = GetDescText(target);\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif (typeof(tooltipsText.getComputedTextLength) != \"unknown\")\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t{\r\n                                SetTooltipWidth(xTranslate, yTranslate, viewBoxWidth, viewBoxHeight, xScale, yScale);\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r\n";
				if (text == "click")
				{
					text2 += "\t\t\t\t\t\tsetTimeout(\"HideTooltips()\", 2000);";
				}
				text2 += "\t\t\t\t\t}\r\n                    function SetTooltipWidth(xTranslate, yTranslate, viewBoxWidth, viewBoxHeight, xScale, yScale)\r\n                    {\r\n                        var textBoxWidth = tooltipsText.getComputedTextLength() + 8;\r\n                        var xOverflow = xTranslate + textBoxWidth - viewBoxWidth;\r\n                        if (xOverflow > 0)\r\n                        {   \r\n                            xTranslate -= xOverflow + 5;\r\n                            tooltips.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + xTranslate + ',' + yTranslate + ') scale(' + xScale + ',' + yScale + ')');\r\n                        }\r\n                        var yOverflow = -yTranslate;\r\n                        tooltipsBackground.setAttribute('width', textBoxWidth);\r\n                    }\r\n\t\t\t\t}";
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("script");
				svgTextWriter.WriteCData(text2);
				svgTextWriter.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		internal void OpenSection(Graphics graphics)
		{
			if (urlString != "")
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("a");
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("xlink:href", urlString);
				sectionLevel++;
			}
			if (!graphics.Transform.IsIdentity)
			{
				float[] elements = graphics.Transform.Elements;
				string value = $"matrix({elements[0]} {elements[1]} {elements[2]} {elements[3]} {elements[4]} {elements[5]})";
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("g");
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("transform", value);
				sectionLevel++;
			}
			RectangleF clipBounds = graphics.ClipBounds;
			if (clipBounds.X != -4194304f)
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("clipPath");
				regionID++;
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("id", "ClipRegion" + regionID);
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("clipPathUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("rect");
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("x", clipBounds.X.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("y", clipBounds.Y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("width", clipBounds.Width.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("height", clipBounds.Height.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				svgTextWriter.WriteEndElement();
				svgTextWriter.WriteEndElement();
				svgTextWriter.WriteStartElement("g");
				svgTextWriter.WriteAttributeString("clip-path", "url(#ClipRegion" + regionID + ")");
				sectionLevel++;
			}
		}

		internal void CloseSection()
		{
			for (int num = sectionLevel; num > 0; num--)
			{
				svgTextWriter.WriteEndElement();
			}
			sectionLevel = 0;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AppearanceHelper : ChartAppearance
	{
		protected ChartAppearance parentAppearance;

		protected string appearanceProperty;

		public ChartAppearance GetParentAppearance()
		{
			return parentAppearance;
		}

		public AppearanceHelper()
		{
			Initialize(null, "");
		}

		public void Initialize(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName)
		{
			parentAppearance = parent;
			appearanceProperty = propertyName;
		}

		public AppearanceHelper(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName)
		{
			Initialize(parent, propertyName);
		}

		public AppearanceHelper(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName, IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			Initialize(parent, propertyName);
		}

		public void SetParentAppearance(ChartAppearance parent)
		{
			parentAppearance = parent;
		}

		public void SetParentProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName != null)
			{
				appearanceProperty = propertyName;
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyName", string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_203"), "SetParentProperty"));
		}

		internal bool UpdateParentProperty()
		{
			if (base.noUpdate)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parentAppearance != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = null;
				try
				{
					propertyInfo = parentAppearance.GetType().GetProperty(appearanceProperty);
				}
				catch (ArgumentNullException)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("appearanceProperty", SR.GetString("SR_204"));
				}
				catch (AmbiguousMatchException inner)
				{
					throw new AmbiguousMatchException(string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_205"), appearanceProperty, parentAppearance.GetType().Name), inner);
				}
				if (propertyInfo != null)
				{
					try
					{
						propertyInfo.SetValue(parentAppearance, this, null);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(SR.GetString("SR_206"), appearanceProperty), "appearanceProperty");
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ChartTypeAppearanceConverter))]
	public abstract class ChartTypeAppearance : ChartAppearance
	{
		internal class ChartTypeAppearanceConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return ((ChartTypeAppearance)value).CreateInstanceDescriptor();
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ChartTypeAppearance()
		{
		}

		public ChartTypeAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		public virtual void CopyProperties(ChartTypeAppearance copyTo)
		{
			copyTo.component = component;
			copyTo.dirty = base.dirty;
			copyTo.noUpdate = base.noUpdate;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return SR.GetString("SR_61");
		}

		public abstract bool ShouldSerialize();

		protected virtual InstanceDescriptor CreateInstanceDescriptor()
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
			return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
		}
	}

		public AxisAppearance()
		{

			_Margin = new AxisMarginAppearance();
		}

		public AxisAppearance(IChartComponent component, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(component)
		{
			this.axisNumber = axisNumber;
			CreateApp();
			chartTypeChangedHandler = updateRadarYLabelOrientation;
			if (axisNumber == AxisNumber.Y_Axis)
			{
				component?.Subscribe("+ChartTypeChanged", chartTypeChangedHandler);
			}
			timeAxisAppearance = new TimeAxisAppearance(component);
		}

		private void CreateApp()
		{
			labelAppearance = new AxisLabelAppearance(this, "Labels", axisNumber, component);
			majorGridLines = new GridlinesAppearance(this, "MajorGridLines", GridlinesAppearance.GridlinesType.Major);
			minorGridLines = new GridlinesAppearance(this, "MinorGridLines", GridlinesAppearance.GridlinesType.Minor);
			stripLineAppearance = new StripLineAppearance(this, "StripLines");
			_ScrollScale = new ScrollScaleAppearance(this, "ScrollScale");
			cafs = new ChartAxisFormatSource();
			_Margin = new AxisMarginAppearance(this, "Margin", component);
		}

		public void SetAxisNumber(AxisNumber number)
		{
			axisNumber = number;
		}

		private void updateRadarYLabelOrientation(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (component.ChartType == ChartType.RadarChart)
			{
				Labels.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
			}
		}

		internal void validateRangeForLog()
		{
			ValidatePropertyDouble2("RangeMin", rangeMin, double.Epsilon, double.MaxValue, useLogMsg: true);
			ValidatePropertyDouble2("RangeMax", rangeMax, double.Epsilon, double.MaxValue, useLogMsg: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeLogNegativeHandling() && !ShouldSerializeLogZero() && !ShouldSerializeTickmarkIntervalType() && !ShouldSerializeExtent() && !ShouldSerializeLineColor() && !ShouldSerializeLineDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLineEndCapStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLineThickness() && !ShouldSerializeTickmarkInterval() && !ShouldSerializeMinorGridLines() && !ShouldSerializeMajorGridLines() && !ShouldSerializeTickmarkPercentage() && !ShouldSerializeTickmarkStyle() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeLabels() && !ShouldSerializeMargin())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeScrollScale();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "(" + SR.GetString("SR_187") + "=";
			if (TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.DataInterval)
			{
				text = ((tickInterval != 0.0) ? (text + tickInterval) : (text + SR.GetString("SR_188")));
			}
			else if (TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Percentage)
			{
				text = text + TickmarkPercentage.ToString("#0.#") + "%";
			}
			else if (TickmarkStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart)
			{
				text += "Smart";
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		{
			return timeAxisAppearance.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		{

			{
				TimeAxisStyle.ResetTimeAxisStyle();
			}
			else
			{
				TimeAxisStyle = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SmartAxisTickmarks(IAdvanceAxis axis)
		{
			axis.Scale = ScrollScale.Scale;
			axis.Scroll = ScrollScale.Scroll;
			if (tickStyle == AxisTickStyle.Smart)
			{
				int num = Labels.Font?.Height ?? 0;
				int num2 = (int)(Math.Abs(axis.MapRange) / (double)((float)num * 1.2f));
				NumericAxis numericAxis = axis as NumericAxis;
				num2 = ((!(axis is SetLabelAxis) && (numericAxis == null || numericAxis.AxisType == LinearAxisType.NumericData)) ? Math.Min(10, Math.Max(1, num2)) : Math.Max(num2, 1));
				Interval interval = null;
				if (axis.Maximum is double)
				{
					double xmax;
					double xmin;
					switch (RangeType)
					{
					case AxisRangeType.Custom:
						xmax = RangeMax;
						xmin = RangeMin;
						break;
					default:
						if (axis is SetLabelAxis)
						{
							xmax = (double)axis.WindowMaximum;
							xmin = (double)axis.WindowMinimum;
						}
						else
						{
							xmax = (double)axis.Maximum;
							xmin = (double)axis.Minimum;
						}
						break;
					}
					interval = AnInterval.GetScale(xmin, xmax, num2);
					if (ChartComponent != null && ChartComponent.ChartType == ChartType.RadarChart && ((double)interval.Maximum - (double)interval.Minimum) % interval.TickInterval != 0.0)
					{
						interval.TickInterval /= 2.0;
					}
				}
				else if (axis.Maximum is DateTime)
				{
					interval = DateTimeInterval.GetScale((DateTime)axis.Minimum, (DateTime)axis.Maximum, num2);
				}
				if (interval == null || (interval.Minimum is double && double.IsNaN((double)interval.Minimum)) || (interval.Maximum is double && double.IsNaN((double)interval.Maximum)) || double.IsNaN(interval.TickInterval))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (axis.RulerType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
				{
					if (interval is AnInterval anInterval)
					{
						if (anInterval.NumericMinimum > 0.0)
						{
							axis.Minimum = anInterval.Minimum;
						}
						if (anInterval.NumericMaximum > 0.0)
						{
							axis.Maximum = anInterval.Maximum;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (double.IsInfinity(interval.TickInterval))
					{
						interval.TickInterval = 0.1;
					}
					if (axis is SetLabelAxis)
					{
						interval.TickInterval = Math.Ceiling(interval.TickInterval);
					}
					if (axis is SetLabelAxis && Labels.Layout.Behavior != AxisLabelLayoutBehaviors.None)
					{
						tickInterval = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						tickInterval = interval.TickInterval;
					}
					if (numericAxis != null)
					{
						switch (numericAxis.AxisType)
						{
						default:
							axis.Maximum = interval.Maximum;
							axis.Minimum = interval.Minimum;
							break;
						case LinearAxisType.ItemRowLabeling:
						case LinearAxisType.ItemColumnLabeling:
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (!(axis is SetLabelAxis))
					{
						axis.Maximum = interval.Maximum;
						axis.Minimum = interval.Minimum;
					}
				}
				if (interval is DateTimeInterval)
				{
					_TickmarkIntervalType = ((DateTimeInterval)interval).IntervalType;
					tickInterval = interval.TickInterval;
				}
			}
			else if (axis is TimeAxis && axis.Minimum.Equals(axis.Maximum))
			{
				int num3 = Labels.Font?.Height ?? 0;
				int val = (int)(Math.Abs(axis.MapRange) / (double)((float)num3 * 1.2f));
				val = Math.Min(10, Math.Max(1, val));
				DateTimeInterval scale = DateTimeInterval.GetScale((DateTime)axis.Minimum, (DateTime)axis.Maximum, val);
				axis.Maximum = scale.Maximum;
				axis.Minimum = scale.Minimum;
				_TickmarkIntervalType = scale.IntervalType;
			}
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			if (base.component != null && base.component != component)
			{
				base.component.Subscribe("-ChartTypeChanged", chartTypeChangedHandler);
			}
			base.SetComponent(component);
			MajorGridLines.SetComponent(component);
			MajorGridLines.SetGridType(GridlinesAppearance.GridlinesType.Major);
			MinorGridLines.SetComponent(component);
			MajorGridLines.SetGridType(GridlinesAppearance.GridlinesType.Minor);
			Labels.SetComponent(component);
			ScrollScale.SetComponent(component);
			StripLines.SetComponent(component);
			if (component != null && NumericAxisType == NumericAxisType.Logarithmic)
			{
				component.ResetDemoData();
			}
		}

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetExtent();
			ResetLabels();
			ResetLineColor();
			ResetLineDrawStyle();
			ResetLineEndCapStyle();
			ResetLineThickness();
			ResetLogBase();
			ResetMajorGridLines();
			ResetMargin();
			ResetMinorGridLines();
			ResetNumericAxisType();
			ResetRangeMax();
			ResetRangeMin();

	[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisItemConverter))]
	public class AxisItem : AxisAppearance, ICloneable
	{
		internal class AxisItemConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return ((AxisItem)value).CreateInstanceDescriptor();
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		{
			if (Key != null && Key.Length > 0)

			return base.ToString();

		{

		}

		{
			if (Key != null)
			{
				return Key.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public AxisItem Clone()
		{
			AxisItem axisItem = new AxisItem(component, axisNumber);
			axisItem.DataType = DataType;
			axisItem.Extent = base.Extent;
			axisItem.Key = Key;
			axisItem.Labels = base.Labels.Clone() as AxisLabelAppearance;
			axisItem.LineColor = base.LineColor;
			axisItem.LineDrawStyle = base.LineDrawStyle;
			axisItem.LineEndCapStyle = base.LineEndCapStyle;
			axisItem.LineThickness = base.LineThickness;
			axisItem.LogBase = base.LogBase;
			axisItem.MajorGridLines = base.MajorGridLines.Clone();
			axisItem.Margin = base.Margin.Clone();
			axisItem.MinorGridLines = base.MinorGridLines.Clone();
			axisItem.NumericAxisType = base.NumericAxisType;
			axisItem.RangeMax = base.RangeMax;
			axisItem.RangeMin = base.RangeMin;
			axisItem.RangeType = base.RangeType;
			axisItem.SetLabelAxisType = SetLabelAxisType;
			axisItem.ScrollScale = ScrollScale.Clone();
			axisItem.StripLines = base.StripLines.Clone();
			axisItem.TickmarkInterval = base.TickmarkInterval;
			axisItem.TickmarkIntervalType = base.TickmarkIntervalType;
			axisItem.TickmarkPercentage = base.TickmarkPercentage;
			axisItem.TickmarkStyle = base.TickmarkStyle;
			axisItem.TimeAxisStyle = TimeAxisStyle;
			axisItem.Visible = Visible;
			return axisItem;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return !Visible;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			base.Margin.SetComponent(component);
		}

		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeFontColor()
		{
			return labelStyle.FontColor != DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontColor;
		}

		public void ResetFontColor()
		{
			labelStyle.FontColor = DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontColor;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeWrapText()
		{
			return labelStyle.WrapText;

		public void ResetWrapText()
		{
			WrapText = false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetHorizontalAlign()
		{
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisX2LabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisYLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisY2LabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisZLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
				break;
			default:
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisXLabelStyle.HorizontalAlign;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetVerticalAlign()
		{
			switch (axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisX2LabelStyle.VerticalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisYLabelStyle.VerticalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisY2LabelStyle.VerticalAlign;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisZLabelStyle.VerticalAlign;
				break;
			default:
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = DefaultConstants.D_AxisXLabelStyle.VerticalAlign;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeClipText()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetClipText()
		{
		}

		protected abstract bool ShouldSerializeOrientation();

		public abstract void ResetOrientation();

		protected bool ShouldSerializeFontSizeBestFit()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetFontSizeBestFit()
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeReverseText()
		{
			return ReverseText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetReverseText()
		{
			ReverseText = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeReverseText() && !ShouldSerializeClipText() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFontSizeBestFit() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeOrientation() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeWrapText();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetClipText();
			ResetFont();
			ResetFontColor();
			ResetFontSizeBestFit();
			ResetHorizontalAlign();
			ResetOrientation();
			ResetVerticalAlign();
			ResetVisible();
			ResetWrapText();
			ResetReverseText();
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			object obj = MemberwiseClone();
			if (obj is AxisLabelAppearance axisLabelAppearance)
			{
				axisLabelAppearance.labelStyle = labelStyle.Copy();
				axisLabelAppearance.labelStyle.Font = labelStyle.Font.Clone() as Font;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLayout()
		{
			return Layout.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetLayout()
		{
			Layout.Reset();
		}

		protected virtual void SetLayout(AxisLabelLayoutAppearance value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_Layout = value;
				_Layout.SetComponent(component);
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			Layout.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelAppearance : AxisLabelAppearanceBase
	{
		private AxisItemLabelFormat _ItemFormat;

		private string itemFormatString = string.Empty;

		private AxisSeriesLabelAppearance _seriesLabels;

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20")]
		public AxisItemLabelFormat ItemFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return _ItemFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				_ItemFormat = value;
				GenerateItemFormatString(value);
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_21")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public string ItemFormatString
		{
			get
			{
				return itemFormatString;
			}
			set
			{
				itemFormatString = value;
				switch (value)
				{
				case "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>":
					_ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.DataValue;
					break;
				case "<ITEM_LABEL>":
					_ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.ItemLabel;
					break;
				case "<ITEM_LABEL> (<DATA_VALUE:00.##>)":
					_ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.Label_and_Data;
					break;
				case "":
					_ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.None;
					break;
				default:
					_ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.Custom;
					break;
				}
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Obsolete("SeriesFormat is obsolete.  Please use SeriesLabels.Format instead.")]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_22")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public AxisSeriesLabelFormat SeriesFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return SeriesLabels.Format;
			}
			set
			{
				SeriesLabels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				SeriesLabels.Format = value;
				SeriesLabels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_23")]
		[Obsolete("SeriesFormatString is obsolete.  Please use SeriesLabels.FormatString instead.")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string SeriesFormatString
		{
			get
			{
				return SeriesLabels.FormatString;
			}
			set
			{
				SeriesLabels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
				SeriesLabels.FormatString = value;
				SeriesLabels.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public AxisSeriesLabelAppearance SeriesLabels
		{
			get
			{
				return _seriesLabels;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new AxisSeriesLabelAppearance(this, "SeriesLabels", base.AxisNumber, component);
				}
				_seriesLabels = value;
				_seriesLabels.SetParentAppearance(this);
				_seriesLabels.SetParentProperty("SeriesLabels");
				UpdateAll(resize: true, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public AxisLabelAppearance()
		{
			_seriesLabels = new AxisSeriesLabelAppearance();
		}

		internal AxisLabelAppearance(ChartAppearance parent, string property, AxisNumber axisNumber)
			: base(parent, property, axisNumber)
		{
			_seriesLabels = new AxisSeriesLabelAppearance(this, "SeriesLabels", base.AxisNumber, null);
		}

		internal AxisLabelAppearance(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName, AxisNumber axisNumber, IChartComponent component)
			: base(parent, propertyName, axisNumber, component)
		{
			_seriesLabels = new AxisSeriesLabelAppearance(this, "SeriesLabels", base.AxisNumber, component);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeItemFormat()
		{
			return false;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetItemFormat()
		{
			if (component != null)
			{
				ChartType chartType = component.ChartType;
				if (base.AxisFormatSource != null)
				{
					ItemFormat = base.AxisFormatSource.GetItemFormats(chartType, base.AxisNumber);
				}
				else
				{
					ItemFormat = AxisItemLabelFormat.Custom;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeItemFormatString()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetItemFormatString()
		{
			ResetItemFormat();
		}

		protected void GenerateItemFormatString(AxisItemLabelFormat format)
		{
			if (format != AxisItemLabelFormat.Custom)
			{
				string text = ChartAxisFormatSource.FormatStringFrom(format);
				if (itemFormatString != text)
				{
					itemFormatString = text;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSeriesFormat()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSeriesFormat()
		{
			SeriesLabels.Format = AxisSeriesLabelFormat.Custom;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSeriesFormatString()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSeriesFormatString()
		{
			ResetSeriesFormat();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeSeriesLabels()
		{
			return SeriesLabels.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetSeriesLabels()
		{
			SeriesLabels.Reset();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetItemFormatString();
			SeriesLabels.Reset();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeItemFormatString())
			{
				return SeriesLabels.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (base.Visible)
			{
				return ItemFormatString;
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_18");
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSerializeOrientation()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void ResetOrientation()
		{
			switch (base.AxisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				base.LabelStyle.Orientation = DefaultConstants.D_AxisX2LabelStyle.Orientation;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				base.LabelStyle.Orientation = DefaultConstants.D_AxisYLabelStyle.Orientation;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				base.LabelStyle.Orientation = DefaultConstants.D_AxisY2LabelStyle.Orientation;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Z_Axis:
				base.LabelStyle.Orientation = DefaultConstants.D_AxisZLabelStyle.Orientation;
				break;
			default:
				base.LabelStyle.Orientation = DefaultConstants.D_AxisXLabelStyle.Orientation;
				break;
			}
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			AxisLabelAppearance axisLabelAppearance = new AxisLabelAppearance(parentAppearance, appearanceProperty, base.AxisNumber, component);
			axisLabelAppearance.ClipText = base.ClipText;
			axisLabelAppearance.Flip = base.Flip;
			axisLabelAppearance.Font = base.Font.Clone() as Font;
			axisLabelAppearance.FontColor = base.FontColor;
			axisLabelAppearance.FontSizeBestFit = base.FontSizeBestFit;
			axisLabelAppearance.HorizontalAlign = base.HorizontalAlign;
			axisLabelAppearance.ItemFormatString = ItemFormatString;
			axisLabelAppearance.Orientation = base.Orientation;
			axisLabelAppearance.OrientationAngle = base.OrientationAngle;
			axisLabelAppearance.SeriesLabels = SeriesLabels.Clone() as AxisSeriesLabelAppearance;
			axisLabelAppearance.VerticalAlign = base.VerticalAlign;
			axisLabelAppearance.Visible = base.Visible;
			axisLabelAppearance.WrapText = base.WrapText;
			axisLabelAppearance.SetLayout(Layout.Clone());
			return axisLabelAppearance;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			SeriesLabels.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ChartCollectionBase : ChartAppearance, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private ArrayList _List = new ArrayList();

		protected virtual ArrayList List => _List;

		public virtual int Count => List.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => List.IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => List.SyncRoot;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => List.IsFixedSize;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => List.IsReadOnly;

		public virtual object ToArray(Type type)
		{
			return List.ToArray(type);
		}

		protected ChartCollectionBase(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public int IndexOf(object obj)
		{
			return List.IndexOf(obj);
		}

		protected void Remove(object obj)
		{
			List.Remove(obj);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		protected virtual int AddItem(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is IProvideChartComponent { ChartComponent: null } provideChartComponent)
			{
				provideChartComponent.ChartComponent = component;
			}
			int result = List.Add(obj);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void AddItems(object[] objs)
		{
			foreach (object obj in objs)
			{
				AddItem(obj);
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public virtual ChartCollectionBase Clone()
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(IChartComponent) });
			if (constructor != null && constructor.Invoke(new object[1] { component }) is ChartCollectionBase chartCollectionBase)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (GetItem(i) is ICloneable cloneable)
					{
						chartCollectionBase.AddItem(cloneable.Clone());
					}
				}
				return chartCollectionBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item is IProvideChartComponent provideChartComponent)
				{
					provideChartComponent.ChartComponent = chartComponent;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return List.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object item)
		{
			return AddItem(item);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			List.Clear();
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(ChartLayerAppearance layer)
		{
			return List.Contains(layer);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object item)
		{
			return Contains(item as ChartLayerAppearance);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item as ChartLayerAppearance);
		}

		public virtual void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object item)
		{
			Remove(item);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			List.RemoveAt(index);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		protected virtual void Insert(int index, object obj)
		{
			List.Insert(index, obj);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		protected virtual object GetItem(int index)
		{
			return List[index];
		}

		protected virtual void SetItem(int index, object obj)
		{
			List[index] = obj;
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}
	}

	public class AxisLabelInfoCollection : ChartCollectionBase
	{
		private bool _ForSeries;

		private int _Widest = -1;

		private int _Tallest = -1;

		public virtual bool ForSeries => _ForSeries;

		public AxisLabelInfo this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GetItem(index) as AxisLabelInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				SetItem(index, value);
			}
		}

		internal int Widest
		{
			get
			{
				return _Widest;
			}
			set
			{
				_Widest = value;
			}
		}

		internal int Tallest
		{
			get
			{
				return _Tallest;
			}
			set
			{
				_Tallest = value;
			}
		}

		public AxisLabelInfoCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public AxisLabelInfoCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal void SetForSeries(bool value)
		{
			_ForSeries = value;
		}

		public int Add(AxisLabelInfo item)
		{
			return AddItem(item);
		}

		public virtual bool FindTextOverflow()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] != null && this[i].TextPrimitive != null && !this[i].TextPrimitive.TextFitsInsideBounds())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool FindCollisions()
		{
			Rectangle[] array = new Rectangle[Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == null || this[i].TextPrimitive == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ref Rectangle reference = ref array[i];
				reference = this[i].TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds();
				int num = Math.Min(Count - 1, i + 2);
				for (int j = i + 1; j <= num; j++)
				{
					if (this[j] != null && this[j].TextPrimitive != null)
					{
						ref Rectangle reference2 = ref array[j];
						reference2 = this[j].TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds();
						if (array[i].IntersectsWith(array[j]))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual SizeF GetMaxLabelSize()
		{
			float num = float.MinValue;
			float num2 = float.MinValue;
			foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.TextPrimitive != null)
				{
					SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(item.TextPrimitive.GetTextString(), item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle);
					num = Math.Max(num, labelSizePixels.Width);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, labelSizePixels.Height);
				}
			}
			return new SizeF(num, num2);
		}

		public virtual void Offset(int x, int y)
		{
			foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.TextPrimitive != null)
				{
					item.TextPrimitive.bounds.Offset(x, y);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RollbackTo(AxisLabelInfoCollection oldVersion)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (oldVersion[i].TextPrimitive != null)
				{
					oldVersion[i].TextPrimitive.CopyStyleAndBoundsTo(this[i].TextPrimitive);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public abstract bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed);

		protected virtual AxisNumber GetAxisNumber(Axis axisLayer)
		{
			return axisLayer?.AxisNumber ?? AxisNumber.Z2_Axis;
		}

		protected virtual Size GetIdealLabelSize(bool vertical, Axis axisLayer, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (labels == null || labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			int count = labels.Count;
			if (vertical)
			{
				return new Size(bounds.Width, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)bounds.Height / (double)count));
			}
			Size result = ((!(axisLayer is SetLabelAxis)) ? new Size((axisLayer.endPoint.X - axisLayer.startPoint.X) / count, bounds.Height) : new Size((int)Math.Ceiling((double)bounds.Width / (double)count), bounds.Height));
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual Rectangle GetLabelBounds(int pixelMid, bool vertical, Rectangle labelAreaBounds, int idealWidth, int idealHeight)
		{
			int x;
			int y;
			int width;
			int height;
			if (vertical)
			{
				x = labelAreaBounds.Left;
				y = pixelMid - idealHeight / 2;
				width = labelAreaBounds.Width;
				height = idealHeight;
			}
			else
			{
				x = pixelMid - idealWidth / 2;
				y = labelAreaBounds.Top;
				width = idealWidth;
				height = labelAreaBounds.Height;
			}
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return OnClone();
		}

		protected abstract AxisLabelLayoutBehavior OnClone();

		protected virtual Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis)
		{
			if (axis is Axis axis2)
			{
				if ((axis2.drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0)
				{
					return new Rectangle(bounds.Left, axis2.OuterBound.Top, bounds.Width, axis2.OuterBound.Height);
				}
				return new Rectangle(axis2.OuterBound.Left, bounds.Top, axis2.OuterBound.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
			return bounds;
		}
	}

		private static AxisLabelLayoutBehavior[] GetRepeatingDefaultEffectsPart()
		{
			WrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new WrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			StaggerAxisLabelLayoutBehavior staggerAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new StaggerAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			RotateAxisLabelLayoutBehavior rotateAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new RotateAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			return new AxisLabelLayoutBehavior[3] { wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior, staggerAxisLabelLayoutBehavior, rotateAxisLabelLayoutBehavior };
		}

		public static AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection GetDefaultCollection()
		{
			return GetDefaultCollection(null);
		}

		public static AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection GetDefaultCollection(AxisLabelAppearanceBase labelsApp)
		{
			AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection = new AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection();
			FontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new FontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = false;
			axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.Add(fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior);
			axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.AddRange(GetRepeatingDefaultEffectsPart());
			fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new FontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = false;
			fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.MinimumSize = 5.9f;
			axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.Add(fontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior);
			axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.AddRange(GetRepeatingDefaultEffectsPart());
			ClipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new ClipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior();
			clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.ClipText = labelsApp == null || labelsApp.Orientation != TextOrientation.Custom || labelsApp.OrientationAngle % 90 == 0;
			axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection.Add(clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior);
			return axisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection;
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorGroup : AxisLabelLayoutBehavior
	{
		private AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection _Behaviors;

		public virtual AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection Behaviors => _Behaviors;

		public AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorGroup(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Behaviors = new AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorCollection(chartComponent);
		}

		public AxisLabelLayoutBehaviorGroup()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public override bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			boundsUsed = bounds;
			foreach (AxisLabelLayoutBehavior item in (IEnumerable)Behaviors)
			{
				flag &= item.Apply(bounds, axis, axisApp, labels, out boundsUsed);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "WrapText Behavior";
		}

		protected override AxisLabelLayoutBehavior OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public virtual WrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior Clone()
		{
			WrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new WrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(ChartComponent);
			wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.Enabled = Enabled;
			wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = EnableRollback;
			wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = UseOnlyToPreventCollisions;
			return wrapTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior;
		}
	}

			{
				return _Trimming;
			}
			set
			{
				_Trimming = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20062_23")]
		public virtual bool ClipText
		{
			get
			{
				return _ClipText;
			}
			set
			{
				_ClipText = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20062_24")]
		public virtual bool HideText
		{
			get
			{
				return _HideText;
			}
			set
			{
				_HideText = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public ClipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public ClipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeTrimming()
		{
			return Trimming != StringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetTrimming()
		{
			Trimming = StringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeClipText()
		{
			return !_ClipText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetClipText()
		{
			ClipText = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeHideText()
		{
			return !_HideText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetHideText()
		{
			HideText = true;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed)
		{
			foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)labels)
			{
				if (item.TextPrimitive == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle = item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Clone();
				item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.ClipText = ClipText;
				item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Trimming = Trimming;
				if (!HideText)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(item.TextPrimitive.GetTextString(), item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Font);
				switch (item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation)
				{
				case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
					if ((int)Math.Floor(stringSizePixels.Height) > item.TextPrimitive.bounds.Height)
					{
						item.TextPrimitive.SetTextString("");
					}
					break;
				case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
				case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
					if ((int)Math.Floor(stringSizePixels.Height) > item.TextPrimitive.bounds.Width)
					{
						item.TextPrimitive.SetTextString("");
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			boundsUsed = bounds;
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "ClipText Behavior";
		}

		{
			return Clone();
		}

			clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.Enabled = Enabled;
			clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = EnableRollback;
			clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = UseOnlyToPreventCollisions;
			clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.Trimming = Trimming;
			return clipTextAxisLabelLayoutBehavior;
		}

	internal class DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior : AxisLabelLayoutBehavior
	{
		public DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = false;
		}

		internal static void CorrectOrientation(Text textPrimitive, bool vertical)
		{
			int num = textPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation switch
			{
				TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing => 90, 
				TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing => -90, 
				TextOrientation.Horizontal => 0, 
				_ => textPrimitive.labelStyle.RotationAngle, 
			};
			textPrimitive.labelStyle = textPrimitive.labelStyle.Clone();
			switch (num % 360)
			{
			case 0:
				if (!vertical)
				{
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				}
				break;
			case -270:
			case 90:
				if (vertical)
				{
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
				}
				else
				{
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
				}
				break;
			case -90:
			case 270:
				if (vertical)
				{
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				}
				else
				{
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
					textPrimitive.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public override bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed)
		{
			boundsUsed = bounds;
			bool result = true;
			Axis axis2 = axis as Axis;
			bool flag = axis2 != null && (axis2.drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0;
			GetAxisNumber(axis2);
			Size idealLabelSize = GetIdealLabelSize(flag, axis2, labels, bounds);
			if (labels != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
				{
					AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = labels[i];
					if (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive == null || axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int pixelMid = (int)axis.Map(axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap);
					Rectangle actualBounds = axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
					Size size = new Size(Math.Min(idealLabelSize.Width, actualBounds.Width + 1), Math.Min(idealLabelSize.Height, actualBounds.Height + 1));
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = GetLabelBounds(pixelMid, flag, bounds, size.Width, size.Height);
					Rectangle boundingRectangle = GetBoundingRectangle(bounds, axis);
					Rectangle bounds2 = axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds;
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Intersect(boundingRectangle);
					if (!flag && labels.Count > 1 && i == labels.Count - 1 && !boundingRectangle.Contains(bounds2) && !axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.TextFitsInsideBounds())
					{
						Rectangle stringBounds = axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds();
						Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.X - (stringBounds.Width - axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Width), axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Y, stringBounds.Width, axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Height);
						Rectangle actualBounds2 = labels[i - 1].TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
						if (boundingRectangle.Contains(rectangle) && !actualBounds2.IntersectsWith(rectangle))
						{
							axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = rectangle;
						}
					}
					CorrectOrientation(axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive, flag);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override AxisLabelLayoutBehavior OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public virtual DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior Clone()

			DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior defaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(ChartComponent);
			defaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.Enabled = Enabled;
			defaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = EnableRollback;
			defaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = UseOnlyToPreventCollisions;
			return defaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior;

	internal class DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior : AxisLabelLayoutBehavior
	{
		public DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = false;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed)
		{
			boundsUsed = bounds;
			if (bounds == Rectangle.Empty && labels != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
				{
					if (labels[i] != null && labels[i].TextPrimitive != null)
					{
						labels[i].TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			bool result = true;
			Axis axis2 = axis as Axis;
			bool flag = axis2 != null && (axis2.drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0;
			AxisNumber axisNumber = GetAxisNumber(axis2);
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			int num3 = int.MaxValue;
			int num4 = int.MinValue;
			if (labels != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < labels.Count; j++)
				{
					if (labels[j] != null && labels[j].TextPrimitive != null)
					{
						DefaultPreAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.CorrectOrientation(labels[j].TextPrimitive, flag);
					}
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = bounds;
				if (axis2 is SetLabelAxis { axisType: SetLabelAxisType.ContinuousData } && !flag)
				{
					Rectangle stringBounds = labels[0].TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds();
					if (stringBounds.Left < bounds.Left)
					{
						labels[0].TextPrimitive.bounds = new Rectangle(stringBounds.Left, stringBounds.Top, labels[0].TextPrimitive.bounds.Width + (bounds.Left - stringBounds.Left), labels[0].TextPrimitive.bounds.Height);
					}
					Rectangle stringBounds2 = labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds();
					if (stringBounds2.Right > bounds.Right)
					{
						labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.bounds = new Rectangle(labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.bounds.Left, labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.bounds.Top, labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.bounds.Width + (stringBounds2.Right - bounds.Right), labels[labels.Count - 1].TextPrimitive.bounds.Height);
					}
					int num5 = Math.Min(bounds.Left, stringBounds.Left);
					int num6 = Math.Max(bounds.Right, stringBounds2.Right);
					rectangle = new Rectangle(num5, rectangle.Top, num6 - num5, rectangle.Height);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < labels.Count; k++)
				{
					int num7 = Math.Min(labels.Count, k + 2);
					for (int l = k + 1; l < num7; l++)
					{
						if (labels[k] == null || labels[l] == null || labels[k].TextPrimitive == null || labels[l].TextPrimitive == null || labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds == Rectangle.Empty || labels[l].TextPrimitive.bounds == Rectangle.Empty)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Rectangle actualBounds = labels[k].TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
						Rectangle actualBounds2 = labels[l].TextPrimitive.GetActualBounds();
						if (actualBounds.IntersectsWith(actualBounds2))
						{
							labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Truncate(Geometry.RectangleExclude(actualBounds, actualBounds2));
							labels[l].TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Truncate(Geometry.RectangleExclude(actualBounds2, labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds));
						}
						if (labels[k].TextPrimitive.TextFitsInsideBounds())
						{
							continue;
						}
						SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(labels[k].TextPrimitive.GetTextString(), labels[k].TextPrimitive.labelStyle);
						Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds.Location, Size.Ceiling(labelSizePixels));
						if (!rectangle.Contains(rectangle2) || rectangle2.IntersectsWith(actualBounds2))
						{
							continue;
						}
						bool flag2;
						switch (labels[k].TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation)
						{
						case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
						case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
							flag2 = !flag;
							break;
						case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
							flag2 = flag;
							break;
						default:
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
						if (!flag2)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (rectangle2.IntersectsWith(actualBounds2))
						{
							if (labels[k].TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing)
							{
								labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							labels[k].TextPrimitive.bounds = rectangle2;
						}
					}
				}
				AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = labels[labels.Count - 1];
				if (axisLabelInfo != null && axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive != null && !axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.TextFitsInsideBounds())
				{
					SizeF labelSizePixels2 = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.GetTextString(), axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle);
					Rectangle rectangle3 = new Rectangle(axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Location, Size.Ceiling(labelSizePixels2));
					if (bounds.Contains(rectangle3) && !flag)
					{
						if (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Horizontal)
						{
							axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = rectangle3;
						}
					}
					else if (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle != null && axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.ClipText)
					{
						switch (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation)
						{
						case TextOrientation.Horizontal:
							if (Math.Floor(labelSizePixels2.Height) - 1.0 > (double)axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Height)
							{
								axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
							}
							break;
						case TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing:
						case TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing:
							if (labelSizePixels2.Width > (float)axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds.Width)
							{
								axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing)
					{
						axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
				}
				foreach (AxisLabelInfo item in (IEnumerable)labels)
				{
					if (item.TextPrimitive != null && item.ValueToMap != null)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle4 = ((!item.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.ClipText) ? item.TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds() : Rectangle.Intersect(item.TextPrimitive.bounds, item.TextPrimitive.GetStringBounds()));
						if (rectangle4 != Rectangle.Empty)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, rectangle4.Left);
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, rectangle4.Right);
							num3 = Math.Min(num3, rectangle4.Top);
							num4 = Math.Max(num4, rectangle4.Bottom);
						}
					}
				}
				switch (axisNumber)
				{
				case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
				{
					int num11 = num3 - bounds.Top;
					labels.Offset(0, -num11);
					num3 -= num11;
					num4 -= num11;
					break;
				}
				case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
				{
					int num10 = num2 - bounds.Right;
					labels.Offset(-num10, 0);
					num += num10;
					num2 += num10;
					break;
				}
				case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				{
					int num9 = bounds.Bottom - num4 - 2 * axisApp.Labels.Layout.Padding;
					labels.Offset(0, num9);
					num3 += num9;
					num4 += num9;
					break;
				}
				case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				{
					int num8 = num - bounds.Left;
					labels.Offset(-num8, 0);
					num -= num8;
					num2 -= num8;
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			boundsUsed = new Rectangle(num, num3, num2 - num, num4 - num3);
			return result;
		}

		protected override AxisLabelLayoutBehavior OnClone()
		{
			return new DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(ChartComponent);
		}

		public virtual DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior Clone()
		{
			DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior defaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior = new DefaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(ChartComponent);
			defaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.Enabled = Enabled;
			defaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = EnableRollback;
			defaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = UseOnlyToPreventCollisions;
			return defaultPostAxisLabelLayoutBehavior;
		}

	internal class DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior : AxisLabelLayoutBehavior
	{
		public DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = false;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Rectangle bounds, IAdvanceAxis axis, AxisAppearance axisApp, AxisLabelInfoCollection labels, out Rectangle boundsUsed)
		{
			boundsUsed = bounds;
			Axis axis2 = axis as Axis;
			bool vertical = axis2 != null && (axis2.drawingStyle & 0x10000) > 0;
			GetAxisNumber(axis2);
			if (labels == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				AxisLabelInfo axisLabelInfo = labels[i];
				if (axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive != null && axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap != null)
				{
					int pixelMid = (int)axis.Map(axisLabelInfo.ValueToMap);
					SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.GetTextString(), axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Font);
					Size size = Size.Ceiling(stringSizePixels);
					Rectangle labelBounds = GetLabelBounds(axis2, pixelMid, vertical, bounds, size.Width, size.Height, axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle);
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.bounds = labelBounds;
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.RotationOrigin = GetRotationOrigin(axis2, labelBounds);
					axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle = axisLabelInfo.TextPrimitive.labelStyle.Clone();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Rectangle GetLabelBounds(Axis axisLayer, int pixelMid, bool vertical, Rectangle labelAreaBounds, int width, int height, LabelStyle labelStyle)
		{
			if (axisLayer.AxisNumber != AxisNumber.X_Axis && axisLayer.AxisNumber != AxisNumber.X2_Axis)
			{
				return base.GetLabelBounds(pixelMid, vertical, labelAreaBounds, width, height);
			}
			int rotationAngle = labelStyle.RotationAngle;
			int num = width / 2;
			_ = height / 2;
			int num2 = pixelMid - num;
			int num3;
			if (axisLayer.AxisNumber == AxisNumber.X_Axis)
			{
				num3 = labelAreaBounds.Top;
				int num4 = (int)(Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(rotationAngle)) * (double)num);
				switch (labelStyle.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					num3 += num4;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					num3 -= num4;
					break;
				}
				int num5 = (int)(Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(rotationAngle)) * (double)num);
				switch (labelStyle.HorizontalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					num2 += num5;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					num2 -= num5;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = labelAreaBounds.Bottom - height;
				int num6 = (int)(Math.Sin(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(rotationAngle)) * (double)num);
				switch (labelStyle.VerticalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					num3 += num6;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					num3 -= num6;
					break;
				}
				int num7 = (int)(Math.Cos(Geometry.DegreeToRadian(rotationAngle)) * (double)num);
				switch (labelStyle.HorizontalAlign)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					num2 += num7;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					num2 -= num7;
					break;
				}
			}
			return new Rectangle(num2, num3, width, height);
		}

		private Point GetRotationOrigin(Axis axisLayer, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Point result = Point.Empty;
			switch (axisLayer.AxisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
			{
				int x = rect.X + rect.Width / 2;
				int y = rect.Y + rect.Height / 2;
				result = new Point(x, y);
				break;
			}
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
			{
				int x = rect.X + rect.Width;
				int y = rect.Y + rect.Height / 2;
				result = new Point(x, y);
				break;
			}
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
			{
				int x = rect.X;
				int y = rect.Y + rect.Height / 2;
				result = new Point(x, y);
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override AxisLabelLayoutBehavior OnClone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		{
			DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior = new DefaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior(ChartComponent);
			defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior.Enabled = Enabled;
			defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior.EnableRollback = EnableRollback;
			defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior.UseOnlyToPreventCollisions = UseOnlyToPreventCollisions;
			return defaultAxisRotatedLabelLayoutBehavior;
		}

	{

		public FontScalingAxisLabelLayoutBehavior(IChartComponent chartComponent)

		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSameFontForAllLabels()
		{
			return !SameFontForAllLabels;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetSameFontForAllLabels()
		{
			SameFontForAllLabels = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeMinimumSize()
		{
			return MinimumSize != 7f;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
