		internal void PopulateChartLayers()
		{
			string[] array = ChartLayerListInternal.Split("|".ToCharArray());
			ChartLayerCollection chartLayers = ((CompositeChartAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Composite)).ChartLayers;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
				{
					ChartLayerAppearance chartLayerAppearance = chartLayers.FromKey(text);
					if (chartLayerAppearance != null && !ChartLayers.Contains(chartLayerAppearance))
					{
						ChartLayers.Add(chartLayerAppearance);
					}
				}
			}
			ChartLayerListInternal = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeChartLayerList()
		{
			string chartLayerList = ChartLayerList;
			if (chartLayerList != null)
			{
				return chartLayerList.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLabelStyle()
		{
			return LabelStyle.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLabelStyle()
		{
			LabelStyle.Reset();
		}

			borderLayer.FillSceneGraph(scene);
			outerBound = borderLayer.GetInnerBounds();
			if (outerBound.Width <= 0 || outerBound.Height <= 0)

				return;
			}

			FindItemSize(outerBound, core);

			LegendAppearance legendAppearance = new LegendAppearance();

			legendAppearance.AlphaLevel = PE.FillOpacity;
			legendAppearance.BorderColor = Border.Color;
			legendAppearance.BorderThickness = Border.Thickness;

			legendAppearance.FontColor = LabelStyle.FontColor;
			int num = -1;

				LegendItemData legendItemData2 = FindMatchInLegend(legendItemData, i);
				if (legendItemData2 != null || legendItemData.Label == string.Empty)

					continue;
				}
				num++;
				Point position = GetPosition(num);
				if (outerBound.Right < position.X)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (outerBound.Right < position.X + num2 && graphicsContext == null)
				{

					graphicsContext.SetClipBounds(outerBound, clipText: true);
					scene.Add(graphicsContext);
				}
				int x2 = position.X + itemHeight + outerBound.X;
				int y2 = position.Y + outerBound.Y;
				int width2 = num2 - itemHeight;
				int height2 = itemHeight;
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(x2, y2, width2, height2);
				LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
				LabelStyle.CopyTo(labelStyle);
				Text text = new Text(bounds, legendItemData.Label, labelStyle);
				scene.Add(text);
				if (labelStyle.WrapText)
				{
					SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text.GetTextString(), labelStyle);
					int num3 = outerBound.Right - bounds.X;
					if ((float)num3 < labelSizePixels.Width)

						num++;
					}
				}
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(bounds.X - itemHeight, bounds.Y, bounds.Height, bounds.Height);
				int num4 = Math.Max(rect.Height / 10, 1);
				rect.Offset(0, -1);
				rect.Inflate(-2 * num4, -2 * num4);
				if (LabelStyle.Orientation == TextOrientation.Custom && Math.Abs(LabelStyle.RotationAngle) % 90 != 0)
				{
					LabelStyle labelStyle2 = LabelStyle.Clone();
					labelStyle2.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
					float num5 = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(text.GetTextString(), labelStyle2).Width * 1.1f;
					if ((float)text.bounds.Width < num5)
					{
						text.bounds.Width = (int)num5;
					}
					int height3 = rect.Height;
					int num6 = rect.Y + rect.Height / 2;
					text.bounds.Height = height3;
					text.bounds.Y = num6 - height3 / 2;
				}
				DrawSymbol(i, rect, core, scene, legendAppearance);
			}
			if (flag && ChartLayers.Count > 1)
			{
				Point position2 = GetPosition(numOfItems);
				Rectangle drawRect = new Rectangle(outerBound.X, position2.Y, outerBound.Width, outerBound.Bottom - position2.Y);
				FillBubbleType(drawRect, chartComponent, scene, core);
			}
			if (SeriesForConcentricLegend != null && SeriesForConcentricLegend.Count > 1)
			{
				Point position3 = GetPosition(num + 1);
				StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				int num7 = -1;
				foreach (ISeries item3 in SeriesForConcentricLegend)
				{
					stringCollection.Add(item3.Label);
					if (item3.Label != null && item3.Label.Length > 0)
					{
						SizeF labelSize = GetLabelSize(item3.Label);
						arrayList.Add(labelSize);
						num7 = (int)labelSize.Width;
					}
				}
				int num8 = outerBound.Height - position3.Y;
				int num9 = outerBound.Width - position3.X;
				bool flag4 = Bounds == Rectangle.Empty || num8 > num9;
				LabelStyle labelStyle3 = LabelStyle.Clone();
				labelStyle3.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
				labelStyle3.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
				SizeF sizeF;
				SizeF sizeF2;
				if (arrayList.Count == 0)
				{
					sizeF = (sizeF2 = SizeF.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					sizeF = (SizeF)arrayList[0];
					sizeF2 = (SizeF)arrayList[arrayList.Count - 1];
				}
				Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineDrawStyle.Solid);
				int num11;
				Point p;
				Rectangle rectangle;
				int num12;
				Point p2;
				Rectangle rectangle2;
				Point point;
				Point p3;
				bool flag5;
				if (flag4)
				{
					labelStyle3.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
					int num10 = num7;
					int x3 = position3.X + num10 / 2;
					num11 = Math.Min(num8 / 3, num10 / 3);
					p = new Point(x3, position3.Y + num11);
					int y3 = p.Y + num11;
					rectangle = new Rectangle(position3.X, y3, num10, (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Height));
					num12 = num11 / 2;
					p2 = new Point(x3, outerBound.Bottom - num12);
					int y4 = p2.Y - num12 - (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF2.Height);
					rectangle2 = new Rectangle(position3.X, y4, num10, (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF2.Height));
					point = new Point(x3, rectangle.Bottom);
					p3 = new Point(x3, rectangle2.Top);
					flag5 = p3.Y - itemHeight > point.Y;
				}
				else
				{
					labelStyle3.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
					int num13 = num7;
					int y5 = position3.Y + num13 / 2;
					num11 = Math.Min(num9 / 3, num13 / 3);
					p = new Point(position3.X + num11, y5);
					int x4 = p.X + num11;
					rectangle = new Rectangle(x4, position3.Y, (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Width), num13);
					num12 = num11 / 2;
					p2 = new Point(outerBound.Right - num12, y5);
					int x5 = p2.X - num12 - (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF2.Width);
					rectangle2 = new Rectangle(x5, position3.Y, (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF2.Width), num13);
					point = new Point(rectangle.Right, y5);
					p3 = new Point(rectangle2.Left, y5);
					flag5 = p3.X - itemHeight > point.X;
				}
				Ellipse ellipse = new Ellipse(p, num11);
				scene.Add(ellipse);
				scene.Add(LegendLayer.NestEllipse(ellipse, 0.75));
				Point pos = new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2);

				Text value2 = new Text(pos2, stringCollection[stringCollection.Count - 1], labelStyle3);
				scene.Add(value2);
				Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(p2, num12);
				scene.Add(ellipse2);
				scene.Add(LegendLayer.NestEllipse(ellipse2, 0.75));
				Point p4 = point;
				int num14 = 1;
				int num15 = stringCollection.Count - 2;
				if (num15 > 0 && flag5)

		private void DrawSymbol(int index, Rectangle rect, ChartCore core, SceneGraph scene, LegendAppearance legendApp)
		{
			LegendItemData legendItemData = (LegendItemData)legendItemsData[index];
			if (legendItemData.Point != null)
			{
				bool flag = legendItemData.Point.Empty;
				if (flag)
				{
					ArrayList arrayList = FindMatchesInLegend(legendItemData, numOfItems);
					foreach (LegendItemData item in arrayList)
					{
						bool flag2 = item.Point == null || item.Point.Empty;
						flag = flag && flag2;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Primitive primitive = new Polyline(new DataPoint[3]);
					Line line = new Line(rect.Location, new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
					line.Path = "Legend";
					line.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
					line.PE.StrokeWidth = 2;
					scene.Add(line);
					Line line2 = new Line(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top));
					line2.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
					line2.PE.StrokeWidth = 2;
					scene.Add(line2);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (legendItemData != null && legendItemData.CurrentLayer != null)
			{
				switch (legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartType)
				{
				case ChartType.LineChart:
				case ChartType.SplineChart:
				case ChartType.StackLineChart:
				case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
				{
					Primitive primitive = new Polyline(new DataPoint[3]);
					primitive.Path = "Legend";
					Polyline polyline = (Polyline)primitive;
					primitive.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
					primitive.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
					primitive.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
					primitive.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					int y = rect.Top + rect.Height / 2;
					int x = rect.Left + rect.Width / 2;
					polyline.points[0] = new DataPoint(rect.Left, y);
					polyline.points[1] = new DataPoint(x, y);
					polyline.points[2] = new DataPoint(rect.Right, y);
					bool flag3 = polyline.PE.GetNoUpdate();
					polyline.PE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
					polyline.PE.StrokeWidth = 2;
					polyline.PE.SetNoUpdate(flag3);
					if (legendItemData.CurrentLayer != null && legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartLayer != null)
					{
						if (legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartTypeAppearance is LineChartAppearance lineChartAppearance)
						{
							polyline.lineStyle.DrawStyle = lineChartAppearance.DrawStyle;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						polyline.lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = true;
					}
					scene.Add(polyline);
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.ScatterChart:
				case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
				case ChartType.PolarChart:
				case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
					if (legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartLayer != null)
					{
						ScatterLayer scatterLayer = (ScatterLayer)legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartLayer;
						ScatterChartAppearance scatterChartAppearance = (ScatterChartAppearance)scatterLayer.GetAppearance();
						Point point = new Point(rect.X + rect.Height / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2);
						Primitive primitive2;
						if (scatterChartAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon.Character)
						{
							Text text = new Text(point, scatterLayer.GetSeriesCharacter(legendItemData.SeriesIndex, scatterChartAppearance.Character).ToString());
							primitive2 = text;
							Font font = new Font(scatterChartAppearance.CharacterFont.FontFamily, LabelStyle.Font.SizeInPoints, scatterChartAppearance.CharacterFont.Style);
							text.labelStyle.Font = font;
							text.labelStyle.FontColor = GetPaintElement(index, core).Fill;
							text.labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
						}
						else if (scatterChartAppearance.Icon == SymbolIcon.None && scatterChartAppearance.ConnectWithLines)
						{
							Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
							lineStyle.DrawStyle = scatterChartAppearance.LineAppearance.DrawStyle;
							primitive2 = new Polyline(new DataPoint[2]
							{
								new DataPoint(rect.Left, point.Y),
								new DataPoint(rect.Right, point.Y)
							}, lineStyle);
						}
						else
						{
							SymbolIconSize iconSize2 = ((rect.Height > 16) ? SymbolIconSize.Large : ((rect.Height <= 10) ? SymbolIconSize.Small : SymbolIconSize.Medium));
							SymbolIcon seriesSymbolIcon = scatterLayer.GetSeriesSymbolIcon(legendItemData.SeriesIndex, scatterChartAppearance);
							Primitive primitive = new Symbol(point, seriesSymbolIcon, iconSize2);
							primitive2 = primitive;
						}
						primitive2.Path = "Legend";
						primitive2.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
						primitive2.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
						primitive2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						primitive2.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
						scene.Add(primitive2);
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.ParetoChart:
				{
					Primitive primitive;
					if (legendItemData.Point == null)
					{
						primitive = new Polyline(new DataPoint[3]);
						primitive.Path = "Legend";
						Polyline polyline2 = (Polyline)primitive;
						primitive.PE.Fill = paretoApp.LinePE.Fill;
						primitive.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
						primitive.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
						primitive.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						int y2 = rect.Top + rect.Height / 2;
						int x2 = rect.Left + rect.Width / 2;
						polyline2.points[0] = new DataPoint(rect.Left, y2);
						polyline2.points[1] = new DataPoint(x2, y2);
						polyline2.points[2] = new DataPoint(rect.Right, y2);
						polyline2.PE.StrokeWidth = 2;
						polyline2.lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = true;
						scene.Add(polyline2);
						break;
					}
					Box box2 = new Box(Rectangle.Empty);
					primitive = box2;
					box2.Path = "Legend";
					box2.rect = rect;
					box2.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
					box2.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
					box2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					if (legendItemData.CurrentLayer != null && legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartLayer is ParetoLayer)
					{
						ParetoLayer paretoLayer = (ParetoLayer)legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartLayer;
						bool flag4 = false;
						foreach (Box column in paretoLayer.Columns)
						{
							if (column.DataPoint == legendItemData.Point)
							{
								primitive.PE = column.PE;
								flag4 = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!flag4)
						{
							primitive.PE = paretoLayer.Columns[index % paretoLayer.Columns.Count].PE;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						primitive.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
					}
					scene.Add(primitive);
					break;
				}
				case ChartType.PointChart3D:
					if (legendItemData.CurrentLayer.ChartTypeAppearance is PointChart3DAppearance pointChart3DAppearance)
					{
						SymbolIcon icon = pointChart3DAppearance.Icon switch
						{
							SymbolIcon3D.Diamond => SymbolIcon.Diamond, 
							SymbolIcon3D.Pyramid => SymbolIcon.Triangle, 
							SymbolIcon3D.PyramidDown => SymbolIcon.UpsideDownTriangle, 
							SymbolIcon3D.Sphere => SymbolIcon.Circle, 
							_ => SymbolIcon.Square, 
						};
						SymbolIconSize iconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;
						Point centerPoint = new Point(rect.X + rect.Height / 2, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2);
						Primitive primitive = new Symbol(centerPoint, icon, iconSize);
						primitive.Path = "Legend";
						primitive.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
						primitive.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
						primitive.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
						primitive.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
						scene.Add(primitive);
					}
					break;
				default:
				{
					Box box = new Box(Rectangle.Empty);
					Primitive primitive = box;
					box.Path = "Legend";
					box.rect = rect;
					box.Row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
					box.Column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
					box.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					box.PE = GetPaintElement(index, core);
					scene.Add(primitive);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			else if (legendItemData != null && legendItemData.EmptyApp != null && legendItemData.EmptyApp.ShowInLegend && (legendItemData.EmptyApp.EnablePE || legendItemData.EmptyApp.EnablePoint))
			{
				LegendLayer.AddEmptyIndicator(scene, legendItemData.EmptyApp, Rectangle.Inflate(Bounds, -2, 0), 0, itemHeight, itemHeight, itemHeight, rect.Width, index, "Legend", legendApp, drawLabel: false, rect);
			}
		}

		private PaintElement GetPaintElement(int index, ChartCore core)
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
			LegendItemData legendItemData = (LegendItemData)legendItemsData[index];
			ISeries series = legendItemData.Series;
			IDataPoint point = legendItemData.Point;
			if (legendItemData.LegendItemType == LegendItemType.Series)
			{
				if (series.PEs.Count > 0 && series.PEs[0].ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
				{
					paintElement = series.PEs[0].Clone();
				}
				else if (core != null && core.ChartColorModel != null)
				{
					paintElement = new PaintElement(core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(legendItemData.SeriesIndex, legendItemData.SeriesIndex, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else if (point != null && point.PE != null && point.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None)
			{
				paintElement = point.PE;
			}
			else if (series.PEs != null && series.PEs.Count > 0)
			{
				paintElement = series.PEs[legendItemData.PointIndex % series.PEs.Count];
			}
			else if (core != null && core.ChartColorModel != null)
			{
				int row;
				int column;
				if (core.ChartColorModel is SimpleColorModel && ((SimpleColorModel)core.ChartColorModel).GetColorByRow())
				{
					row = legendItemData.PointIndex;
					column = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					row = legendItemData.SeriesIndex;
					column = legendItemData.PointIndex;
				}
				paintElement = new PaintElement(core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(row, column, 0.0));
				paintElement.FillOpacity = paintElement.Fill.A;
			}
			return paintElement;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Bounds.ToString();
		}

		private void FillBubbleType(Rectangle drawRect, IChartComponent chartComponent, SceneGraph scene, ChartCore core)
		{
			if (drawRect.Width <= 0 || drawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			bool flag = false;
			BubbleChartAppearance bubbleChartAppearance = null;
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)ChartLayers)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = item.Series.GetVisibleSeries();
				if (item.SwapRowsAndColumns)
				{
					seriesCollection = SeriesSwap.Swap(seriesCollection);
				}
				if (seriesCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
				{
					bubbleChartAppearance = item.ChartTypeAppearance as BubbleChartAppearance;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < GetNumberOfSeries(item); i++)
				{
					ISeries series = seriesCollection[i];
					IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
					for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
					{
						IDataPoint dataPoint = points[j];
						if (dataPoint is XYZDataPoint)
						{
							XYZDataPoint xYZDataPoint = (XYZDataPoint)dataPoint;
							num = Math.Min(num, xYZDataPoint.ValueZ);
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, xYZDataPoint.ValueZ);
						}
						if (dataPoint.Empty)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == double.MaxValue || num2 == double.MinValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = (int)((double)drawRect.Height * 0.1);
			if (num4 > (drawRect.Width - num3 - num3) / 2)
			{
				num4 = (drawRect.Width - num3 - num3) / 2;
			}
			int num5 = num4;
			double num6 = 0.2;
			int num7 = num3;
			Point center = new Point(drawRect.X + num4 + num3, drawRect.Bottom - num4 - num3);
			Point point = new Point(center.X, center.Y);
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = (EmptyAppearance)component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty);
			bool flag2 = flag && emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.ShowInLegend && (emptyAppearance.EnablePE || emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle);
			if (bubbleChartAppearance == null)
			{
				bubbleChartAppearance = chartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Bubble) as BubbleChartAppearance;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Point center2 = new Point(drawRect.X + num3 / 2 + num4 / 2, center.Y);
				center.Y -= num4 * 2;
				point.Y -= num4 * 2;
				PrimitiveShape shape = BubbleLayer.GetShape(bubbleChartAppearance.BubbleShape, num4 / 2, center2);
				if (emptyAppearance.EnablePE)
				{
					shape.PE = emptyAppearance.PE;
				}
				if (emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle)
				{
					shape.lineStyle = emptyAppearance.LineStyle;
				}
				scene.Add(shape);
				int width = drawRect.Width - num4 - num3 / 2;
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(center2.X + num4 / 2 + num3 / 2, center2.Y - num4, width, num4 * 2);
				Text value = new Text(bounds, emptyAppearance.Text, LabelStyle);
				scene.Add(value);
			}
			while (center.Y > drawRect.Y + num4 + num3)
			{
				PrimitiveShape shape2 = BubbleLayer.GetShape(bubbleChartAppearance.BubbleShape, num4, center);
				Color outlineColor = core.ChartColorModel.getOutlineColor(0, 0, 0.0);
				Color fillColor = core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, 0.0);
				shape2.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
				shape2.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
				shape2.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				shape2.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
				shape2.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
				int row = (shape2.Column = 0);
				shape2.Row = row;
				scene.Add(shape2);
				center.Y -= num4;
				num4 -= (int)((double)num4 * num6);
				center.Y -= num4;
				center.Y -= num7;
				if (num4 < 2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(num.ToString("0.00"), LabelStyle.Font);
			stringSizePixels.Width = Math.Max(stringSizePixels.Width, Platform.GetStringSizePixels(num2.ToString("0.00"), LabelStyle.Font).Width);
			Point point2 = new Point((int)((float)(num5 * 2) + stringSizePixels.Width) + drawRect.Left, center.Y + num4 + num4 + num3);
			LabelStyle labelStyle = LabelStyle.Clone();
			labelStyle.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
			point.X = point2.X;
			Text value2 = new Text(point2, num.ToString("0.00"), labelStyle);
			Text value3 = new Text(point, num2.ToString("0.00"), labelStyle);
			scene.Add(value2);
			scene.Add(value3);
			Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle lineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle();
			lineStyle.EndStyle = LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor;
			point2.Y += (int)stringSizePixels.Height + 2;
			point.Y -= (int)stringSizePixels.Height - 2;
			Line line = new Line(point2, point, lineStyle);
			line.PE.StrokeWidth = 5;
			scene.Add(line);
		}

		private void FillCandleType(Rectangle drawRect, IChartComponent chartComponent, SceneGraph scene, ChartCore core, CandleChartAppearance candleApp)
		{
			int num = 20;
			int num2 = 5;
			Rectangle rectangle = drawRect;
			int num3 = 3;
			drawRect = new Rectangle(rectangle.X + num3, rectangle.Y + num3, rectangle.Width - num3 * 2, rectangle.Height - num3 * 2);
			if (drawRect.Width <= 0 || drawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num4 = num * drawRect.Width / 100;
			SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("Test String", LabelStyle.Font);
			SizeF stringSizePixels2 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels("T", LabelStyle.Font);
			int num5 = (int)stringSizePixels.Height;
			string[] array = new string[num2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetLabel(i);
			}
			int stringArrayAverageSizePixels = Platform.GetStringArrayAverageSizePixels(array, LabelStyle.Font, 80);
			num4 = num5;
			int innerHeight = num4;
			int num6 = num4 * 2;
			int num7 = 0;
			int num8 = 0;
			num5 += num5 / 2;
			string text = SR.GetString("SR_1027");
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				if (num5 * num8 + num5 > drawRect.Height)
				{
					num7 += stringArrayAverageSizePixels + num4 + num6;
					if (num7 + stringArrayAverageSizePixels > drawRect.Width)
					{
						Font mORE_FONT_DEFAULT = LegendLayer.MORE_FONT_DEFAULT;
						SizeF stringSizePixels3 = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(text, mORE_FONT_DEFAULT);

						text2.GetLabelStyle().Font = mORE_FONT_DEFAULT;
						scene.Add(text2);

					num8 = 0;
				}
				PrimitiveShape value = DrawLegendIcons(drawRect.X, num7, drawRect.Y, num5, num8, num4, innerHeight, j, candleApp);

		private void Reset()
		{
			numOfCol = 0;
			numOfRow = 0;
			itemHeight = 0;
			numOfItems = 0;
			columnSize.Clear();
			legendItemsData.Clear();
			SeriesForConcentricLegend = new SeriesCollection();
		}

		private bool ShouldPlotSeries(ISeries series, ChartLayerAppearance layerApp)
		{
			switch (layerApp.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				return series is NumericTimeSeries;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void FindItemSize(Rectangle legendRect, ChartCore core)
		{
			SizeF maxLabelSize = SizeF.Empty;
			EmptyAppearance emptyAppearance = ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Empty) as EmptyAppearance;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.ShowInLegend && (emptyAppearance.EnablePE || emptyAppearance.EnableLineStyle);
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)ChartLayers)
			{
				IMultiEmptyStyles multiEmptyStyles = item.ChartLayer as IMultiEmptyStyles;
				if (multiEmptyStyles == null || multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed == null || multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed.Count == 0)
				{
					flag |= flag2 && item.ChartLayer != null && item.ChartLayer != null && (item.ChartLayer.HasEmptyValues || !item.Visible);
				}
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = item.Series.GetVisibleSeries();
				if (item.SwapRowsAndColumns)
				{
					seriesCollection = SeriesSwap.Swap(seriesCollection);
				}
				if (seriesCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = GetNumberOfSeries(item);
				string label = ((!(item.ChartTypeAppearance is IOthersCategory othersCategory)) ? "" : othersCategory.OthersCategoryText);
				LegendItemType legendItemType = GetLegendItemType(item.ChartType, item);
				ISeries series = null;
				switch (item.ChartType)
				{
				case ChartType.BoxChart:
					foreach (ISeries item2 in seriesCollection)
					{
						if (item2 is BoxSetSeries)
						{
							series = item2;
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				case ChartType.PieChart:
				case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
					if (!(item.ChartTypeAppearance is PieChartAppearance pieChartAppearance))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (pieChartAppearance.Concentric)
					{
						if (pieChartAppearance.ShowConcentricLegend)
						{
							SeriesForConcentricLegend.AddRange(seriesCollection.ToArray());
						}
						if (legendItemType != LegendItemType.Point)
						{
							break;
						}
						StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
						for (int i = 0; i < seriesCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							ISeries series2 = seriesCollection[i];
							if (series2 == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							IProvideDataPoints points = seriesCollection[i].GetPoints();
							if (points == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
							{
								IDataPoint dataPoint = points[j];
								if (dataPoint != null)
								{
									if (j >= stringCollection.Count)
									{
										stringCollection.Add(points[j].Label);
										AddItemLabel(item, series2, i, dataPoint, j, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
										numOfItems++;
									}
									else if (points[j].Label != stringCollection[j])
									{
										AddItemLabel(item, series2, i, dataPoint, j, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
										numOfItems++;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					num = 1;
					break;
				case ChartType.BubbleChart:
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					if (legendItemType == LegendItemType.Series)
					{
						ISeries series4 = seriesCollection[k];
						if (!ShouldPlotSeries(series4, item))
						{
							num2++;
							continue;
						}
						SizeF labelSize = GetLabelSize(series4.Label);
						LegendItemData legendItemData = new LegendItemData();
						Hashtable environment = core.Environment;
						object value = (core.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = series4.Label);
						environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = value;
						Hashtable environment2 = core.Environment;
						object value2 = (core.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = k);
						environment2["DATA_ROW"] = value2;
						legendItemData.Label = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(core.Environment, FormatString);
						legendItemData.CurrentLayer = item;
						legendItemData.Series = series4;
						legendItemData.SeriesIndex = k - num2;
						legendItemData.LegendItemType = LegendItemType.Series;
						legendItemsData.Add(legendItemData);
						maxLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(maxLabelSize.Width, labelSize.Width);
						maxLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(maxLabelSize.Height, labelSize.Height);
						numOfItems++;
						continue;
					}
					if (item.ChartType == ChartType.BoxChart && series != null)
					{
						IProvideDataPoints points2 = series.GetPoints();
						for (int l = 0; l < points2.Count; l++)
						{
							IDataPoint dataPoint2 = points2[l];
							if (!dataPoint2.Empty || flag)
							{
								AddItemLabel(item, series, k, dataPoint2, l, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
								numOfItems++;
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (item.ChartType == ChartType.ParetoChart)
					{
						ISeries series5 = seriesCollection[k];
						IProvideDataPoints points3 = series5.GetPoints();
						if (item.ChartLayer is ParetoLayer paretoLayer)
						{
							foreach (Box column in paretoLayer.Columns)
							{
								IDataPoint dataPoint3 = column.DataPoint;
								int pointIndex = points3.IndexOf(dataPoint3);
								if (!dataPoint3.Empty || flag)
								{
									AddItemLabel(item, series5, k, dataPoint3, pointIndex, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
									numOfItems++;
								}
							}
						}
						if (pareto && paretoApp.ShowLineInLegend)
						{
							NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = new NumericDataPoint();
							numericDataPoint.Label = paretoApp.LineLabel;
							AddItemLabel(item, series5, k, numericDataPoint, points3.Count, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
							numOfItems++;
						}
						continue;
					}
					ISeries series6 = seriesCollection[k];
					IProvideDataPoints points4 = series6.GetPoints();
					bool flag3 = false;
					for (int m = 0; m < points4.Count; m++)
					{
						IDataPoint dataPoint4 = points4[m];
						if (dataPoint4.Empty && !flag)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (item.ChartLayer is IPointsInOthers pointsInOthers && pointsInOthers.PointsInOthers.Contains(dataPoint4))
						{
							flag3 = true;
							continue;
						}
						int pointIndex2 = ((item.ChartType != ChartType.GanttChart) ? m : numOfItems);
						if (AddItemLabel(item, series6, k, dataPoint4, pointIndex2, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core))
						{
							numOfItems++;
						}
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint2 = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint2.Label = label;
						AddItemLabel(item, series6, k, numericDataPoint2, series6.GetPoints().Count, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
						numOfItems++;
					}
					if (pareto && paretoApp.ShowLineInLegend)
					{
						NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint3 = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint3.Label = paretoApp.LineLabel;
						AddItemLabel(item, series6, k, numericDataPoint3, points4.Count, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
						numOfItems++;
					}
				}
				if (multiEmptyStyles == null || multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed == null || multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (EmptyAppearance item3 in multiEmptyStyles.EmptyStylesUsed)
				{
					if (item3.ShowInLegend)
					{
						NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint4 = new NumericDataPoint();
						numericDataPoint4.Label = item3.Text;
						AddItemLabel(null, null, -1, numericDataPoint4, -1, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, item3, core);
						numOfItems++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag & (emptyAppearance != null && emptyAppearance.ShowInLegend && ((emptyAppearance.EnablePE && emptyAppearance.LegendDisplayType == LegendEmptyDisplayType.PE) || (emptyAppearance.EnablePoint && emptyAppearance.LegendDisplayType == LegendEmptyDisplayType.Point))))
			{
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint5 = new NumericDataPoint();
				numericDataPoint5.Label = emptyAppearance.Text;
				AddItemLabel(null, null, -1, numericDataPoint5, -1, legendItemsData, ref maxLabelSize, emptyAppearance, core);
				numOfItems++;
			}
			itemHeight = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Ceiling(maxLabelSize.Height));
			if (itemHeight > 0)
			{
				if (legendRect.Height / itemHeight == 0)
				{
					numOfCol = numOfItems;
					numOfRow = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					numOfCol = numOfItems / (legendRect.Height / itemHeight) + 1;
					numOfRow = legendRect.Height / itemHeight;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				numOfCol = 1;
				numOfRow = numOfItems;
			}
			for (int n = 0; n < numOfCol; n++)
			{
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int num4 = 0; num4 < numOfItems; num4++)
				{
					if (GetColumn(num4) == n)
					{
						num3 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Max(num3, Math.Ceiling(Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(((LegendItemData)legendItemsData[num4]).Label, LabelStyle).Width + (float)itemHeight)));
					}
				}
				columnSize.Add(num3);
			}
		}

		private bool AddItemLabel(ChartLayerAppearance layer, ISeries series, int seriesIndex, IDataPoint point, int pointIndex, IList legendItemsData, ref SizeF maxLabelSize, EmptyAppearance emptyApp, ChartCore core)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (seriesIndex > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < numOfItems; i++)
				{
					LegendItemData legendItemData = (LegendItemData)legendItemsData[i];
					if (legendItemData.PointIndex > pointIndex)
					{
						num = i;
						break;
					}
					if (legendItemData.SeriesIndex > seriesIndex || legendItemData.PointIndex == pointIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (point != null)
			{
				core.Environment["ITEM_LABEL"] = point.Label;
			}
			Hashtable environment = core.Environment;
			object value = (core.Environment["DATA_COLUMN"] = pointIndex);
			environment["ITEM_NUMBER"] = value;
			core.Environment["DATA_ROW"] = seriesIndex;
			if (series != null)
			{
				core.Environment["SERIES_LABEL"] = series.Label;
				NumericSeries numericSeries = series as NumericSeries;
				NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint = point as NumericDataPoint;
				if (numericSeries != null && numericDataPoint != null)
				{
					core.Environment["DATA_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint.Value;
				}
				if (FormatString != null && FormatString.Contains("PERCENT_VALUE") && numericSeries != null && numericDataPoint != null)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					foreach (NumericDataPoint point2 in numericSeries.Points)
					{
						num2 += point2.Value;
					}
					core.Environment["PERCENT_VALUE"] = numericDataPoint.Value / num2 * 100.0;
				}
			}
			string label = LabelFormatter.replaceKeywords(core.Environment, FormatString);
			SizeF labelSize = GetLabelSize(label);
			LegendItemData legendItemData2 = new LegendItemData();
			legendItemData2.Label = label;
			legendItemData2.CurrentLayer = layer;
			legendItemData2.Series = series;
			legendItemData2.SeriesIndex = seriesIndex;
			legendItemData2.PointIndex = pointIndex;
			legendItemData2.Point = point;
			legendItemData2.LegendItemType = LegendItemType.Point;
			legendItemData2.EmptyApp = emptyApp;
			LegendItemData legendItemData3 = FindMatchInLegend(legendItemData2, this.legendItemsData.Count);
			if (legendItemData3 != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				legendItemsData.Add(legendItemData2);
			}
			else
			{
				legendItemsData.Insert(num, legendItemData2);
			}
			maxLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(maxLabelSize.Width, labelSize.Width);
			maxLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(maxLabelSize.Height, labelSize.Height);
			return true;
		}

		private SizeF GetLabelSize(string label)
		{
			SizeF labelSizePixels = Platform.GetLabelSizePixels(label, LabelStyle);
			labelSizePixels.Width = labelSizePixels.Width * 1.1f + labelSizePixels.Height;
			return labelSizePixels;
		}

		private int GetColumn(int index)
		{
			if (numOfRow == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return index / numOfRow;
		}

		private int GetRow(int index)
		{
			int column = GetColumn(index);
			return index - column * numOfRow;
		}

		private Point GetPosition(int index)
		{
			int column = GetColumn(index);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < column; i++)
			{
				num += (int)columnSize[i];
			}
			int y = GetRow(index) * itemHeight;
			return new Point(num, y);
		}

		private LegendItemType GetLegendItemType(ChartType chartType, ChartLayerAppearance currentLayer)
		{
			if (currentLayer.LegendItem == LegendItemType.Point)
			{
				return LegendItemType.Point;
			}
			if (currentLayer.LegendItem == LegendItemType.Series)
			{
				return LegendItemType.Series;
			}
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.BarChart3D:
			case ChartType.ColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.AreaChart3D:
			case ChartType.LineChart3D:
			case ChartType.HeatMapChart3D:
			case ChartType.RadarChart:
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
			case ChartType.PolarChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.CylinderColumnChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderBarChart3D:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
			case ChartType.PointChart3D:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineChart3D:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart3D:
				return LegendItemType.Series;
			default:
				if (ChartComponent != null && ChartComponent.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Color) is ColorAppearance { ModelStyle: ColorModels.CustomSkin } colorAppearance && colorAppearance.Skin.ApplyRowWise)
				{
					return LegendItemType.Series;
				}
				return LegendItemType.Point;
			}
		}

		protected void FillSceneGraphLinearGradient(Rectangle drawRect, SceneGraph scene, bool isHeatMap, ChartCore core)
		{
			if (drawRect.Width <= 0 || drawRect.Height <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Box box = null;
			Text text = null;
			Text text2 = null;
			Text text3 = null;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			foreach (ChartLayerAppearance item in (IEnumerable)ChartLayers)
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = item.Series.GetVisibleSeries();
				if (item.SwapRowsAndColumns)
				{
					seriesCollection = SeriesSwap.Swap(seriesCollection);
				}
				if (seriesCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, seriesCollection.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < seriesCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					ISeries series = seriesCollection[i];
					IProvideDataPoints points = series.GetPoints();
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, points.Count);
					for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
					{
						IDataPoint dataPoint = points[j];
						if (dataPoint is NumericDataPoint numericDataPoint)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, numericDataPoint.Value);
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, numericDataPoint.Value);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num != double.MaxValue && num2 != double.MinValue)
			{
				double num5 = (num2 + num) / 2.0;
				Color fillColor;
				Color fillColor2;
				if (isHeatMap)
				{
					fillColor = core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, 0.0);
					fillColor2 = core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(num3 - 1, num4 - 1, num2);
				}
				else
				{
					fillColor2 = core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(0, 0, num);
					fillColor = core.ChartColorModel.getFillColor(num3 - 1, num4 - 1, num2);
				}
				LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
				labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
				labelStyle.VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
				labelStyle.Font = LabelStyle.Font;
				labelStyle.FontColor = LabelStyle.FontColor;
				SizeF stringSizePixels = Platform.GetStringSizePixels(num.ToString(), labelStyle.Font);
				int num6 = 5;
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(drawRect.X + num6, drawRect.Y + num6, drawRect.Width - num6 * 2, drawRect.Height - num6 * 2);
				box = new Box(rect);
				box.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				box.PE.FillGradientStyle = GradientStyle.Vertical;
				box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				box.PE.FillStopColor = fillColor2;
				Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(drawRect.Left, drawRect.Top - num6 + drawRect.Height / 2, drawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				Rectangle bounds2 = new Rectangle(drawRect.Left, drawRect.Top + num6, drawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				Rectangle bounds3 = new Rectangle(drawRect.Left, drawRect.Bottom - num6 - (int)stringSizePixels.Height, drawRect.Width, (int)stringSizePixels.Height);
				if (isHeatMap)
				{
					text = new Text(bounds2, num.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
					text3 = new Text(bounds3, num2.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
				}
				else
				{
					text = new Text(bounds3, num.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
					text3 = new Text(bounds2, num2.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
				}
				text2 = new Text(bounds, num5.ToString("#.00"), labelStyle);
				scene.Add(box);
				scene.Add(text);
				scene.Add(text2);
				scene.Add(text3);
			}
		}

		private int GetNumberOfSeries(ChartLayerAppearance layer)
		{
			switch (ChartComponent.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.Composite:
				if (layer.AxisX != null && layer.AxisY != null && (layer.AxisX.DataType != AxisDataType.String || layer.AxisX.SetLabelAxisType != SetLabelAxisType.GroupBySeries) && layer.AxisY.DataType == AxisDataType.String)
				{
					_ = layer.AxisY.SetLabelAxisType;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (layer.ChartType != ChartType.PieChart && layer.ChartType != ChartType.DoughnutChart)
			{
				_ = layer.ChartType;
			}
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = layer.Series.GetVisibleSeries();
			if (layer.SwapRowsAndColumns)
			{
				seriesCollection = SeriesSwap.Swap(seriesCollection);
			}
			bool flag;
			switch (layer.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.PieChart3D:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart3D:
				flag = layer.ChartTypeAppearance is PieChartAppearance && !((PieChartAppearance)layer.ChartTypeAppearance).Concentric;
				break;
			case ChartType.ParetoChart:
			case ChartType.BoxChart:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart:
			case ChartType.FunnelChart3D:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart:
			case ChartType.PyramidChart3D:
			case ChartType.ConeChart3D:
				flag = true;
				break;
			default:
				flag = false;
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return Math.Min(1, seriesCollection.Count);
			}
			return seriesCollection.Count;
		}

		private string GetLabel(int i)
		{
			string result = "";
			switch (i)
			{
			case 0:
				result = SR.GetString("SR_1021");
				break;
			case 1:
				result = SR.GetString("SR_1022");
				break;
			case 2:
				result = SR.GetString("SR_1023");
				break;
			case 3:
				result = SR.GetString("SR_1020");
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private PrimitiveShape DrawLegendIcons(int drawRectX, int rowOffsetX, int drawRectY, int textHeight, int rowNumber, int innerWidth, int innerHeight, int legendNo, CandleChartAppearance candleApp)
		{
			PrimitiveShape result = null;
			switch (legendNo)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			{
				Box box3 = new Box(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), innerWidth / 2, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor3 = GetOutlineColor();
				Color fillColor3 = GetFillColor(legendNo, candleApp);
				box3.PE.Stroke = outlineColor3;
				box3.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor3.A;
				box3.PE.Fill = fillColor3;
				box3.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor3.A;
				result = box3;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				Line line = new Line(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber + textHeight / 2), new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX + innerWidth, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber + textHeight / 2));
				Color wickColor = candleApp.WickColor;
				line.PE.StrokeOpacity = wickColor.A;
				line.PE.Stroke = wickColor;
				line.PE.StrokeWidth = candleApp.WickThickness;
				result = line;
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				Box box2 = new Box(new Point(drawRectX + rowOffsetX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), innerWidth, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor2 = GetOutlineColor();
				Color fillColor2 = GetFillColor(legendNo, candleApp);
				box2.PE.Stroke = outlineColor2;
				box2.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor2.A;
				box2.PE.Fill = fillColor2;
				box2.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor2.A;
				result = box2;
				break;
			}
			case 4:
			{
				Box box = new Box(new Point(drawRectX, drawRectY + textHeight * rowNumber), 0, innerHeight);
				Color outlineColor = GetOutlineColor();
				Color fillColor = GetFillColor(legendNo, candleApp);
				box.PE.Stroke = outlineColor;
				box.PE.StrokeOpacity = outlineColor.A;
				box.PE.Fill = fillColor;
				box.PE.FillOpacity = fillColor.A;
				result = box;
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			ChartLayers.SetComponent(component);
			Border.SetComponent(component);
			LabelStyle.SetComponent(component);
		}

		private Color GetFillColor(int i, CandleChartAppearance candleApp)
		{
			return i switch
			{
				0 => candleApp.NegativeRangeColor, 
				1 => candleApp.PositiveRangeColor, 
				2 => candleApp.WickColor, 
				3 => candleApp.VolumeColor, 
				4 => candleApp.VolumeColor, 
				_ => Color.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private Color GetOutlineColor()
		{
			return Color.Black;
		}

		private LegendItemData FindMatchInLegend(LegendItemData legendItem, int numItems)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = FindMatchesInLegend(legendItem, numItems);
			if (arrayList == null || arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return arrayList[0] as LegendItemData;
		}

		private ArrayList FindMatchesInLegend(LegendItemData legendItem, int numItems)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < numItems; i++)
			{
				LegendItemData legendItemData = (LegendItemData)legendItemsData[i];
				if (legendItemData != null && legendItemData.Point != null && legendItem.Point != null && MatchLegendItems(legendItem, legendItemData))
				{
					arrayList.Add(legendItemData);
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private bool MatchLegendItems(LegendItemData item1, LegendItemData item2)
		{
			if (item1.Label == item2.Label && item1.Point.PE.Match(item2.Point.PE))
			{
				return item1.PointIndex == item2.PointIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			: this(null)

		}

			: base(chartComponent)

		}

		public int Add(CompositeLegend legend)
		{
			if (legend.component == null && component != null)
			{
				legend.SetComponent(component);
			}
			int result = List.Add(legend);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public CompositeLegendCollection Clone()
		{
			CompositeLegendCollection compositeLegendCollection = new CompositeLegendCollection(component);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				compositeLegendCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return compositeLegendCollection;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			foreach (CompositeLegend item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SetComponent(component);
			}
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)

		}

			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)

		}

		}

					Array array = value.Split('.');
					dataMember = array.GetValue(0).ToString();
					if (array.Length > 1 && (string)array.GetValue(1) != null && (string)array.GetValue(1) != string.Empty && (string)array.GetValue(1) != "")
					{
						relationName = array.GetValue(1).ToString();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataMember = (relationName = string.Empty);
				}
				SetDirty(dirty: true);
				AutoBind();
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		private void AutoBind()
		{
			if (!(component is UserControl) || component.IsDesignMode())
			{
				return;
			}
			cm = bindingManager as CurrencyManager;
			if (cm != null && cm.List is IBindingList)
			{
				IBindingList bindingList = (IBindingList)cm.List;
				if (bindingList != null)
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged -= BindingListChanged;
				}
			}
			if (DataSource != null && DataSource is DataSet && ((UserControl)component).BindingContext != null)
			{
				bindingManager = ((UserControl)component).BindingContext[DataSource, DataMember];
			}
			if (DataSource != null && (DataSource is DataTable || DataSource is DataView) && ((UserControl)component).BindingContext != null)
			{
				bindingManager = ((UserControl)component).BindingContext[DataSource];
			}
			else if (DataSource is BindingSource bindingSource)
			{
				bindingManager = bindingSource.CurrencyManager;
			}
			else
			{
				bindingManager = null;
			}
			cm = bindingManager as CurrencyManager;
			if (cm != null && cm.List is IBindingList)
			{
				IBindingList bindingList2 = (IBindingList)cm.List;
				if (bindingList2 != null)
				{
					bindingList2.ListChanged += BindingListChanged;
				}
			}
			if (cm != null)
			{
				cm.CurrentChanged += CurrentChanged;
				cm.ItemChanged += ItemChanged;
				cm.PositionChanged += PositionChanged;
			}
			else if (DataSource != null && DataSource.GetType().Name.IndexOf("UltraDataSource") >= 0)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = DataSource.GetType().GetProperty("Rows");
				EventInfo eventInfo = property.PropertyType.GetEvent("ListChanged");
				eventInfo.AddEventHandler(property.GetValue(DataSource, null), new ListChangedEventHandler(BindingListChanged));
			}
			else if (DataSource is IListSource && ((IListSource)DataSource).GetList() is IBindingList bindingList3)
			{
				bindingList3.ListChanged += BindingListChanged;
			}
			if (component == null || component.Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < component.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (component.Series[i] is SeriesBase seriesBase)
				{
					seriesBase.DataBind();
				}
			}
		}

		public void IncludeColumn(DataColumn dataColumn, bool include)
		{
			if (dataColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!include)
			{
				if (dataTable == null)
				{
					dataTable = GetTable(DataSource);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					if (dataTable.Columns[i] == dataColumn)
					{
						IncludeColumn(i, include: false);
						break;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int j;
			for (j = 0; j < dataTable.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (dataTable.Columns[j] == dataColumn)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				IncludeColumn(j, include);
			}
		}

		public void IncludeColumn(string dataColumnName, bool include)
		{
			if (dataColumnName == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!include)
			{
				if (dataTable == null)
				{
					dataTable = GetTable(DataSource);
				}
				if (dataTable == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("SR_CannotCallIncludeColumn_NoDataTable"));
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < dataTable.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					if (dataTable.Columns[i].ColumnName.Equals(dataColumnName))
					{
						IncludeColumn(i, include: false);
						break;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int j;
			for (j = 0; j < dataTable.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (dataTable.Columns[j].ColumnName.Equals(dataColumnName))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				IncludeColumn(j, include);
			}
		}

		public void IncludeColumn(int columnNum, bool include)
		{
			if (!include)
			{
				if (!excludedColumns.Contains(columnNum))
				{
					excludedColumns.Add(columnNum);
				}
			}
			else if (excludedColumns.Contains(columnNum))
			{
				excludedColumns.Remove(columnNum);
			}
			SetDirty(dirty: true);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public bool IsColumnExcluded(int columnNum)
		{
			return excludedColumns.Contains(columnNum);
		}

		public void ResetDataFilter()
		{

			excludedColumns.Clear();
			rowLabels = null;
			columnLabels = null;

			UpdateAll(resize: true, invalidate: true);
		}

			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			SetDataBindCalled(flag: true);
		}

		private DataTable GetTable(object obj)
		{
			DataTable result = null;
			if (obj is DataTable)
			{
				result = (DataTable)obj;
			}
			else if (obj is DataView)
			{
				result = ((DataView)obj).Table;
			}
			else if (obj is DataSet)
			{
				DataSet dataSet = (DataSet)obj;
				if (dataSet.Tables[DataMember] != null)
				{
					result = dataSet.Tables[DataMember];
				}
				else if (dataSet.Tables[0] != null)
				{
					result = dataSet.Tables[0];
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void InitializeAppearance(IChartData data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (rowLabelsColumn != -1)
			{
				data.SetUseRowLabels(useRowLabelsColumn);
				data.SetRowLabelsColumn(rowLabelsColumn);
			}
			if (!(data is IChartDataFilter))
			{
				return;
			}
			IChartDataFilter chartDataFilter = (IChartDataFilter)data;
			for (int i = 0; i < excludedColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				chartDataFilter.IncludeColumn((int)excludedColumns[i], include: false);
			}
			if (data is ChartDataFilter)
			{
				ChartDataFilter chartDataFilter2 = (ChartDataFilter)data;
				if (rowLabels != null)
				{
					chartDataFilter2.SetRowLabels(rowLabels);
				}
				if (columnLabels != null)
				{
					chartDataFilter2.SetColumnLabels(columnLabels);
				}
			}
			DataTable table = GetTable(DataSource);
			if (dataTable != null)
			{
				if (!dataTable.Equals(table))
				{
					dataTable.ColumnChanged -= columnChangeEvent;
					dataTable.RowChanged -= rowChangeEvent;
					if (table != null)
					{
						table.ColumnChanged += columnChangeEvent;
						table.RowChanged += rowChangeEvent;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (table != null)
			{
				table.ColumnChanged += columnChangeEvent;
				table.RowChanged += rowChangeEvent;
			}
			dataTable = table;
		}

		internal void RemoveTableEventHandlers()
		{
			if (dataTable != null)
			{
				dataTable.ColumnChanged -= columnChangeEvent;
				dataTable.RowChanged -= rowChangeEvent;
			}
		}

		private void OnDataTableColumnChanged(object sender, DataColumnChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			DataBind();
		}

		private void OnDataTableRowChanged(object sender, DataRowChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			DataBind();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeDataSource() && !ShouldSerializeRowLabelsColumn() && !ShouldSerializeSwapRowsAndColumns() && !ShouldSerializeUseRowLabelsColumn() && !ShouldSerializeZeroAligned() && !ShouldSerializeMinValue() && !ShouldSerializeMaxValue() && !ShouldSerializeUseMinMax() && !ShouldSerializeDataMember())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEmptyStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				return dataSource.ToString();
			}
			return SR.GetString("SR_18");
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeDataMember()
		{
			return dataMember != string.Empty;
		}

		public void ResetDataMember()
		{
			DataMember = string.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetOthersCategoryText()
		{
			OthersCategoryText = "Others";
		}

		public void BreakSlice(int sliceNumber, bool breakSlice)
		{
			if (!breakSlice)
			{
				breakSlices.Remove(sliceNumber);
			}
			else if (!breakSlices.Contains(sliceNumber))
			{
				breakSlices.Add(sliceNumber);
			}
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public IList GetOnlyExplicitlyBrokenSlices()
		{
			return breakSlices;
		}

		public void BreakSliceReset()
		{
			breakSlices.Clear();
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializePieThickness()
		{
			return pieThickness != 20;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetPieThickness()
		{
			pieThickness = 20;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeChartText()
		{
			if (chartTextAppearance.Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetChartText()
		{
			chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextCollection();
			chartTextAppearance.cApp = this;
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeConcentric() && !ShouldSerializeConcentricSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeBreakAllSlices() && !ShouldSerializeBreakAlternatingSlices() && !ShouldSerializeBreakDistancePercentage() && !ShouldSerializeBreakOthersSlice() && !ShouldSerializeColumnIndex() && !ShouldSerializeLabels() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryPercent() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryText() && !ShouldSerializePieThickness() && !ShouldSerializeStartAngle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeChartText();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			Labels.SetComponent(component);
		}
	}

	public class DrillDownAppearance : ChartAppearance
	{
		private class RestorableContext
		{
			private object _dataSource;

			private DrillElement[] _drillHierarchy;

			private ChartType _parentChartType;

			internal RestorableContext(DrillDownAppearance ddApp)
			{
				_drillHierarchy = new DrillElement[ddApp.DrillElements.Length];
				_parentChartType = (ChartType)ddApp.component.GetProperty("ChartType");
				DataAppearance dataAppearance = null;
				try
				{
					dataAppearance = ddApp.component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance;
					_dataSource = dataAppearance.DataSource;
					ddApp.DrillElements.CopyTo(_drillHierarchy, 0);
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
				catch (NullReferenceException)
				{
				}
			}

			internal void RestoreTo(DrillDownAppearance ddApp)
			{
				try
				{
					(ddApp.component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance).DataSource = _dataSource;
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
				catch (NullReferenceException)
				{
				}
				ddApp.DrillElements = _drillHierarchy;
				ddApp.component.SetProperty("ChartType", _parentChartType);
			}
		}

		private int _enabled;

		private bool _showButton;

		private DrillElement[] _drillElements;

		private DrillDownEventHandler _drillEh;

		private Stack _ancestors;

		private static bool[] _lkupEnabledFlags = new bool[2] { false, true };

		private DrillDownEventHandler[] _lkupEnabledHandlers;

		internal Stack Ancestors => _ancestors;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_270")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public DrillElement[] DrillElements
		{
			get
			{
				return _drillElements;
			}
			set
			{
				_drillElements = value;
				if (value != null && value.Length > 0)
				{
					Enabled = true;
				}
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_271")]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _lkupEnabledFlags[_enabled];
			}
			set
			{
				if (_lkupEnabledFlags[_enabled] != value)
				{
					_enabled = ~_enabled & 1;
					_drillEh = _lkupEnabledHandlers[_enabled];
					UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_272")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public DrillDownEventHandler DrillDownHandler => _drillEh;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_273")]
		public bool ShowButton
		{
			get
			{
				return _showButton;
			}
			set
			{
				_showButton = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_274")]
		public int Depth => _ancestors.Count;

		public DrillDownAppearance()
		{
			init();
		}

		public DrillDownAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			init();
		}

		private void init()
		{
			_enabled = 0;
			_showButton = false;
			_lkupEnabledHandlers = new DrillDownEventHandler[2] { doNothing, doDrilling };
			_drillElements = null;
			_drillEh = doNothing;
			_ancestors = new Stack(10);
		}

		private void doNothing(object sender, ChartDataEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void doDrilling(object sender, ChartDataEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (sender != null)
			{
				text = sender as string;
			}
			if (text.Equals("Drill.Prev"))
			{
				DrillBack();
			}
			else
			{
				if (_drillElements == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int num = DrillElements.Length; i < num; i++)
				{
					DrillElement drillElement = DrillElements[i];
					DrillDownID iD = drillElement.ID;
					if (e.DataRow != iD.Row || e.DataColumn != iD.Column)
					{
						continue;
					}
					RestorableContext obj = new RestorableContext(this);
					Ancestors.Push(obj);
					if (drillElement.DrillDown != null)
					{
						drillElement.DrillDown.Drill(iD.Row, iD.Column, drillElement.ChartType, drillElement.DataSource);
					}
					(component.GetChartAppearance(ChartAppearanceTypes.Data) as DataAppearance).DataSource = drillElement.DataSource;
					component.SetProperty("ChartType", drillElement.ChartType);
					if (drillElement.DrillDown is IDrillDown2)
					{
						IDrillDown2 drillDown = (IDrillDown2)drillElement.DrillDown;
						if (!drillDown.Cancel)
						{
							drillDown.PostDrill(iD.Row, iD.Column, drillElement.ChartType, drillElement.DataSource);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_drillElements == null)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			return string.Concat(_drillElements, " - element(s)");
		}

		public bool DrillBack()
		{
			if (Ancestors.Count > 0)
			{
				RestorableContext restorableContext = Ancestors.Pop() as RestorableContext;
				restorableContext.RestoreTo(this);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			{
				return ShouldSerializeLegendDisplayType();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetEnableLineStyle();
			ResetEnablePE();
			ResetEnablePoint();
			ResetLineStyle();
			ResetPE();
			ResetPointPE();
			ResetPointStyle();
			ResetShowInLegend();
			ResetText();
			ResetLegendDisplayType();
			ResetKey();
		}

		internal PointSet GetPointSet(DataPoint[] points)
		{
			PointSet pointSet = PointStyle.Icon switch
			{
				SymbolIcon.Character => new PointSet(points, PointStyle.CharacterFont, PointStyle.Character), 
				SymbolIcon.Random => new PointSet(points, RandomIcon, PointStyle.IconSize), 
				_ => new PointSet(points, PointStyle.Icon, PointStyle.IconSize), 
			};
			pointSet.PE = PointPE.Clone();
			return pointSet;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			if (Key != null)
			{
				return Key.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetKey()
		{
			Key = null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Key != null && Key.Length != 0)
			{
				return Key;
			}
			return "EmptyAppearance";
		}
	}

			return AddItem(item);
		}

		public virtual EmptyAppearance FromKey(string key)
		{
			foreach (EmptyAppearance item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Key == key)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
}

			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public virtual HierarchicalChart3DLabelsAppearance Labels => _Labels;

		protected Hierarchical3DAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected Hierarchical3DAppearance(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Labels = new HierarchicalChart3DLabelsAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSort()
		{
			return Sort != SortStyle.Descending;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetSort()
		{
			Sort = SortStyle.Descending;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeAxis()
		{
			return Axis != HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightAndRadius;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetAxis()
		{
			Axis = HierarchicalChartAxis.HeightAndRadius;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSpacing()
		{
			return Spacing != 0.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetSpacing()
		{
			Spacing = 0.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryPercent()
		{
			return OthersCategoryPercent != 3.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetOthersCategoryPercent()
		{
			OthersCategoryPercent = 3.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryText()
		{
			return OthersCategoryText != "Others";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetOthersCategoryText()
		{
			OthersCategoryText = "Others";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLabels()
		{
			return Labels.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetLabels()
		{
			Labels.Reset();
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			Labels.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAxis() && !ShouldSerializeLabels() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryPercent() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryText() && !ShouldSerializeSort())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSpacing();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetAxis();
			ResetLabels();
			ResetOthersCategoryPercent();
			ResetOthersCategoryText();
			ResetSort();
			ResetSpacing();
		}
	}

				return ShouldSerializeRadiusMin();

		{

			ResetRadiusMax();
			ResetFlat();
			ResetRadiusMin();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetBorderThickness()
		{
			BorderThickness = 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeBorderDrawStyle()
		{
			return BorderDrawStyle != LineDrawStyle.Solid;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetBorderDrawStyle()
		{
			BorderDrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign()
		{
			return HorizontalAlign != StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetHorizontalAlign()
		{
			HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign()
		{
			return VerticalAlign != StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetVerticalAlign()
		{
			VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBorderThickness() && !ShouldSerializeFillColor() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFormatString() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineColor() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineEndStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLinesVisible() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineThickness() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetBorderColor();
			ResetBorderDrawStyle();
			ResetBorderThickness();
			ResetFillColor();
			ResetFont();
			ResetFontColor();
			ResetFormatString();
			ResetHorizontalAlign();
			ResetLeaderLineColor();
			ResetLeaderLineDrawStyle();
			ResetLeaderLineEndStyle();
			ResetLeaderLinesVisible();
			ResetLeaderLineThickness();
			ResetVerticalAlign();
			ResetVisible();
		}
	}

			: this(null)

		}

			: base(chartComponent)
		{
			_Labels = new HierarchicalChartLabelsAppearance(chartComponent);
			_ChartText = new ChartTextCollection(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSort()

			return Sort != SortStyle.Descending;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetSpacing()

			Spacing = 0.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLabels()
		{
			return Labels.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetLabels()
		{
			Labels.Reset();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryPercent()
		{
			return OthersCategoryPercent != 3.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetOthersCategoryPercent()

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryText()
		{
			return OthersCategoryText != "Others";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetOthersCategoryText()
		{
			OthersCategoryText = "Others";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeChartText()
		{
			if (ChartText != null)
			{
				return ChartText.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetChartText()
		{
			_ChartText = new ChartTextCollection(ChartComponent);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAxis() && !ShouldSerializeChartText() && !ShouldSerializeLabels() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryPercent() && !ShouldSerializeOthersCategoryText() && !ShouldSerializeSort())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeSpacing();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetAxis();
			ResetChartText();
			ResetLabels();
			ResetOthersCategoryPercent();
			ResetOthersCategoryText();
			ResetSort();
			ResetSpacing();
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			ChartText.ChartComponent = chartComponent;
			Labels.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]

			return RadiusMin != 0.1;
		}

		public virtual void ResetRadiusMin()
		{
			RadiusMin = 0.1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeRadiusMax()
		{
			return RadiusMax != 1.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetRadiusMax()
		{
			RadiusMax = 1.0;
		}

		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeRadiusMax())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRadiusMin();

			base.Reset();
			ResetRadiusMax();

		public GanttChartAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			_columns = new GanttColumnAppearance(base.component);
			_emptyPercentagesPE = new PaintElement(this, "EmptyPercentagesPE");
			_emptyPercentagesPE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			_emptyPercentagesPE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
			_emptyPercentagesPE.Fill = Color.White;
			_emptyPercentagesPE.FillOpacity = byte.MaxValue;
			_emptyPercentagesPE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			_completePercentagesPE = new PaintElement(this, "CompletePercentagesPE");
			_completePercentagesPE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			_completePercentagesPE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
			_completePercentagesPE.Fill = Color.Yellow;
			_completePercentagesPE.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
			_ownersLabelStyle.component = base.component;
			_ownersLabelStyle.SetParentAppearance(this);
			_ownersLabelStyle.SetParentProperty("OwnersLabelStyle");
			_linkLineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineDrawStyle.Solid);
			_linkLineStyle.SetComponent(component);
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumns()

			return Columns.ShouldSerialize();
		}

			Columns.Reset();
		}

			CompletePercentagesPE.Fill = Color.Yellow;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeEmptyPercentagesPE()
		{
			return EmptyPercentagesPE.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetEmptyPercentagesPE()
		{
			EmptyPercentagesPE = new PaintElement(this, "EmptyPercentagesPE");
			EmptyPercentagesPE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
			EmptyPercentagesPE.FillOpacity = 0;
			EmptyPercentagesPE.Fill = Color.Transparent;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowLinks()
		{
			return ShowLinks;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetShowLinks()
		{
			ShowLinks = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLinkLineStyle()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLinkLineStyle()
		{
			LinkLineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor, LineCapStyle.ArrowAnchor, LineDrawStyle.Solid);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLinkLineColor()
		{
			return LinkLineColor != Color.Black;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLinkLineColor()
		{
			LinkLineColor = Color.Black;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLinkLineWidth()
		{
			return LinkLineWidth != 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLinkLineWidth()
		{
			LinkLineWidth = 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowOwners()
		{
			return ShowOwners;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetShowOwners()
		{
			ShowOwners = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeOwnersLabelStyle()
		{
			return OwnersLabelStyle != DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle.Clone();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetOwnersLabelStyle()
		{
			OwnersLabelStyle = DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeColumns() && !ShouldSerializeItemSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeSeriesSpacing() && !ShouldSerializeShowCompletePercentages() && !ShouldSerializeCompletePercentagesPE() && !ShouldSerializeShowLinks() && !ShouldSerializeLinkLineStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLinkLineColor() && !ShouldSerializeLinkLineWidth() && !ShouldSerializeShowOwners())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOwnersLabelStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetColumns();
			ResetItemSpacing();
			ResetSeriesSpacing();
			ResetShowCompletePercentages();
			ResetCompletePercentagesPE();
			ResetShowLinks();
			ResetLinkLineStyle();
			ResetLinkLineColor();
			ResetLinkLineWidth();
			ResetShowOwners();
			ResetOwnersLabelStyle();
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			Columns.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			CompletePercentagesPE.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			EmptyPercentagesPE.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			LinkLineStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			OwnersLabelStyle.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}
	}
