	public class GridlinesAppearance : AppearanceHelper, ICloneable
	{
		internal enum GridlinesType
		{
			Major,
			Minor
		}

		private GridlinesType gridType;

		private bool visible;

		private Color color;

		private int thickness = 1;

		private byte alpha;

		private LineDrawStyle lineStyle;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_77")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.LineStyleEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_78")]
		public LineDrawStyle DrawStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return lineStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				lineStyle = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_79")]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(1)]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.LineThicknessEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_80")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public int Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidatePropertyInt("Thickness", value, 0, 100);
				thickness = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.OpacityEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_81")]
		public byte AlphaLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return alpha;
			}
			set
			{
				alpha = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		public GridlinesAppearance()
		{
		}

		internal GridlinesAppearance(ChartAppearance parent, string property, GridlinesType gridType)
			: base(parent, property)
		{
			SetGridType(gridType);
			InitializeDefaults();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetVisible()
		{
			if (gridType == GridlinesType.Major)
			{
				Visible = true;
			}
			else
			{
				Visible = false;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeDrawStyle()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetDrawStyle()
		{
			if (gridType == GridlinesType.Major)
			{
				DrawStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMajorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				DrawStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMinorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetColor()
		{
			if (gridType == GridlinesType.Major)
			{
				Color = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMajorGridLineColor;
			}
			else
			{
				Color = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMinorGridLineColor;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeAlphaLevel()
		{
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetAlphaLevel()
		{
			if (gridType == GridlinesType.Major)
			{
				AlphaLevel = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMajorGridLineColor.A;
			}
			else
			{
				AlphaLevel = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMinorGridLineColor.A;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAlphaLevel() && !ShouldSerializeColor() && !ShouldSerializeDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeThickness())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Gridlines " + (visible ? "" : "Not ") + "Visible)";
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public GridlinesAppearance Clone()
		{
			GridlinesAppearance gridlinesAppearance = new GridlinesAppearance(parentAppearance, appearanceProperty, gridType);
			gridlinesAppearance.AlphaLevel = AlphaLevel;
			gridlinesAppearance.Color = Color;
			gridlinesAppearance.DrawStyle = DrawStyle;
			gridlinesAppearance.Thickness = Thickness;
			gridlinesAppearance.Visible = Visible;
			return gridlinesAppearance;
		}

		private void InitializeDefaults()
		{
			if (gridType == GridlinesType.Major)
			{
				visible = true;
				color = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMajorGridLineColor;
				lineStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMajorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				visible = false;
				color = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMinorGridLineColor;
				lineStyle = DefaultConstants.D_AxisMinorGridLineStyle.DrawStyle;
			}
			alpha = color.A;
		}

		internal void SetGridType(GridlinesType gridType)
		{
			this.gridType = gridType;
		}
	}
	public class HeatMapChartAppearance : ChartTypeAppearance
	{
		private HeatMapRenderQuality renderQuality = HeatMapRenderQuality.LowQuality;

		private int numSubsets;

		private ChartTextCollection chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextCollection();

			}

		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_283")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public ChartTextCollection ChartText => chartTextAppearance;

		public HeatMapChartAppearance()
		{
			chartTextAppearance.cApp = this;
		}

		public HeatMapChartAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			numSubsets = (int)renderQuality;
			chartTextAppearance.cApp = this;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeNullHandling()
		{
			return nullHandling != NullHandling.Zero;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetNullHandling()
		{
			nullHandling = NullHandling.Zero;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeRenderQuality()
		{
			return renderQuality != HeatMapRenderQuality.LowQuality;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetRenderQuality()
		{
			RenderQuality = HeatMapRenderQuality.LowQuality;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeChartText()
		{
			if (chartTextAppearance.Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetChartText()
		{
			chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextCollection();
			chartTextAppearance.cApp = this;
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeChartText() && !ShouldSerializeNullHandling())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRenderQuality();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class HistogramChartAppearance : ChartTypeAppearance
	{
		internal const int DEFAULT_COLUMNINDEX = -1;

		private HistogramLineAppearance _lineAppearance;

		private HistogramColumnAppearance _columnAppearance;

		private int _columnIndex = -1;

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20073_2")]
		public HistogramColumnAppearance ColumnAppearance
		{
			get
			{
				return _columnAppearance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					_columnAppearance = new HistogramColumnAppearance(component);
				}
				else
				{
					_columnAppearance = value;
					_columnAppearance.SetComponent(component);
				}
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20073_4")]
		public HistogramLineAppearance LineAppearance
		{
			get
			{
				return _lineAppearance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					_lineAppearance = new HistogramLineAppearance(component);
				}
				else
				{
					_lineAppearance = value;
					_lineAppearance.SetComponent(component);
				}
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20073_3")]
		public int ColumnIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _columnIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_columnIndex = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public HistogramChartAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public HistogramChartAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			_columnAppearance = new HistogramColumnAppearance(component);
			_lineAppearance = new HistogramLineAppearance(component);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ColumnAppearance.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return LineAppearance.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetHistogramChartAppearance()
		{
			ColumnAppearance.Reset();
			LineAppearance.Reset();
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			LineAppearance.SetComponent(component);
			ColumnAppearance.SetComponent(component);
		}
	}

	public class HistogramLineAppearance : ChartTypeAppearance
	{

		private bool _fillArea;

		private LineDrawStyle _drawStyle;

		private LineCapStyle _startStyle;

		private LineCapStyle _endStyle;

		private bool _showInLegend = true;

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]

			}

				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}

		public bool ShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return _showInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				_showInLegend = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue("<LINE_LABEL>")]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20073_12")]
		public string LineLabel
		{
			get
			{
				return _label;
			}
			set
			{
				_label = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public HistogramLineAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public HistogramLineAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			_pe = DEFAULT_PE.Clone();
			_pe.StrokeWidth = 1;
			_pe.SetComponent(component);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Visible && !FillArea && DEFAULT_PE.Match(_pe) && DrawStyle == LineDrawStyle.Solid && StartStyle == LineCapStyle.NoAnchor && EndStyle == LineCapStyle.NoAnchor && ShowInLegend)
			{
				return LineLabel != "<LINE_LABEL>";
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Visible = true;
			FillArea = false;
			PE = DEFAULT_PE.Clone();
			DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
			StartStyle = LineCapStyle.NoAnchor;
			EndStyle = LineCapStyle.NoAnchor;
			ShowInLegend = true;
			LineLabel = "<LINE_LABEL>";
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			PE.SetComponent(component);
		}
	}

			FormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAlphaLevel() && !ShouldSerializeBackgroundColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBorderThickness() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFormatString() && !ShouldSerializeLocation() && !ShouldSerializeMargins() && !ShouldSerializeSpanPercentage() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeMoreIndicatorText();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeDataAssociation()
		{
			return chartTypeData != ChartTypeData.DefaultData;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetDataAssociation()
		{
			chartTypeData = ChartTypeData.DefaultData;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeMoreIndicatorText()
		{
			if (_MoreIndicatorText != null)
			{
				return _MoreIndicatorText.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetMoreIndicatorText()
		{
			_MoreIndicatorText = "";
		}

		internal Rectangle BoundsReduction(LegendLayer legendLayer, Rectangle sourceRect)
		{
			Rectangle result = sourceRect;
			if (legendLayer.IsVisible())
			{
				switch (Location)
				{
				case LegendLocation.Bottom:
					result.Height -= legendLayer.OuterBound.Height;
					break;
				case LegendLocation.Top:
					result.Offset(0, legendLayer.OuterBound.Height);
					result.Height -= legendLayer.OuterBound.Height;
					break;
				case LegendLocation.Right:
					result.Width -= legendLayer.OuterBound.Width;
					break;
				case LegendLocation.Left:
					result.Offset(legendLayer.OuterBound.Width, 0);
					result.Width -= legendLayer.OuterBound.Width;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20063_09")]
		public virtual IconAppearance IconAppearance => _IconAppearance;

		public LineAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public LineAppearance(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			_LineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(this, "LineStyle", chartComponent);
			_IconAppearance = new IconAppearance(chartComponent);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLineStyle()
		{
			if (LineStyle != null)
			{
				return LineStyle.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetLineStyle()
		{
			if (LineStyle == null)
			{
				LineStyle = new Infragistics.UltraChart.Shared.Styles.LineStyle(this, "LineStyle", ChartComponent);
			}
			else
			{
				LineStyle.Reset();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeThickness()
		{
			return Thickness != 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetThickness()
		{
			Thickness = 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSplineTension()
		{
			return SplineTension != 0f;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetSplineTension()
		{
			SplineTension = 0f;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeKey()
		{
			if (Key != null)
			{
				return Key.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetKey()
		{
			Key = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeIconAppearance()
		{
			return IconAppearance.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetIconAppearance()
		{
			IconAppearance.Reset();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Key != null && Key.Length != 0)
			{
				return Key;
			}
			return "LineAppearance";
		}

		public virtual LineAppearance Clone()
		{
			LineAppearance lineAppearance = new LineAppearance(ChartComponent);
			lineAppearance.Key = Key;
			lineAppearance.LineStyle = LineStyle.Clone();
			lineAppearance.SplineTension = SplineTension;
			lineAppearance.Thickness = Thickness;
			lineAppearance._IconAppearance = IconAppearance.Clone();
			return lineAppearance;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			if (LineStyle != null)
			{
				LineStyle.SetComponent(component);
				IconAppearance.SetComponent(component);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeIconAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeLineStyle() && !ShouldSerializeSplineTension())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeThickness();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetIconAppearance();
			ResetKey();
			ResetLineStyle();
			ResetSplineTension();
			ResetThickness();
		}
	}

		}

			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		{
			return AddItem(item);
		}

		public virtual LineAppearance FromKey(string key)
		{
			foreach (LineAppearance item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Key == key)

				}
			}
			return null;
		}

			EmptyStyles.SetComponent(component);
			if (component != null && component.IsDesignMode() && component != ChartComponent)
			{
				component.ResetDemoData();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLineAppearances()
		{
			return LineAppearances.Count > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetLineAppearances()
		{
			LineAppearances.Clear();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			return EmptyStyles.Count > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetEmptyStyles()
		{
			EmptyStyles.Clear();
		}

		[LocalizedCategory("SR_331")]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_337")]
		[BrowsableForLocationType(LocationType.RowColumn)]
		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return _column;
			}
			set
			{
				_column = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[BrowsableForLocationType(LocationType.Pixels | LocationType.Percentage)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedCategory("SR_332")]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_338")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public double LocationX
		{
			get
			{
				return _locationX;
			}
			set
			{
				_locationX = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedCategory("SR_332")]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_339")]
		[BrowsableForLocationType(LocationType.Pixels | LocationType.Percentage)]
		public double LocationY
		{
			get
			{
				return _locationY;
			}
			set
			{
				_locationY = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public Location Clone()
		{
			Location location = new Location();
			location.Column = Column;
			location.LocationX = LocationX;
			location.LocationY = LocationY;
			location.Row = Row;
			location.Type = Type;
			location.ValueX = ValueX;
			location.ValueY = ValueY;
			return location;
		}

		public bool Match(Location locationB)
		{
			if (locationB != null)
			{
				if (Column == locationB.Column && LocationX == locationB.LocationX && LocationY == locationB.LocationY && Row == locationB.Row && Type == locationB.Type && ValueX == locationB.ValueX)
				{
					return ValueY == locationB.ValueY;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return !Match(new Location());
		}
	}

	public class OverrideAppearance : ChartAppearance
	{
		private OverrideCollection _overrides;

		private bool _enabled = true;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_293")]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.OverridesCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		public OverrideCollection Overrides
		{
			get
			{
				if (_overrides == null)
				{
					_overrides = new OverrideCollection(component);
				}
				return _overrides;
			}
		}

		public Override this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Overrides[index];
			}
			set
			{
				Overrides[index] = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_294")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_enabled = value;
				if (component != null)
				{
					component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
			}
		}

		public OverrideAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			_overrides = new OverrideCollection(base.component);
		}

		public int Add(Override ov)
		{
			return Overrides.Add(ov);
		}

		public void Remove(Override ov)
		{
			Overrides.Remove(ov);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Overrides.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeOverrides())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeEnabled();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeOverrides()
		{
			return Overrides.Count > 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeEnabled()
		{
			return !Enabled;
		}
	}

		public bool Match(PaintElement paintElementB)
		{
			if (CustomBrush == paintElementB.CustomBrush && ElementType == paintElementB.ElementType && Fill == paintElementB.Fill && FillGradientStyle == paintElementB.FillGradientStyle && FillImage == paintElementB.FillImage && FillOpacity == paintElementB.FillOpacity && FillStopColor == paintElementB.FillStopColor && FillStopOpacity == paintElementB.FillStopOpacity && Hatch == paintElementB.Hatch && ImageFitStyle == paintElementB.ImageFitStyle && ImagePath == paintElementB.ImagePath && ImageWrapMode == paintElementB.ImageWrapMode && Stroke == paintElementB.Stroke && StrokeOpacity == paintElementB.StrokeOpacity && StrokeWidth == paintElementB.StrokeWidth && Texture == paintElementB.Texture && TextureApplication == paintElementB.TextureApplication)
			{
				return StrokeAlignment == paintElementB.StrokeAlignment;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal PaintElement(ChartAppearance parent, string property)
			: base(parent, property)
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
		}

		public PaintElement()
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
		}

		public PaintElement(Color fillColor)
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
			fill = fillColor;
		}

		public PaintElement(Color fillColor, Color fillStopColor)
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
			fill = fillColor;
			fill_stop_color = fillStopColor;
		}

		public PaintElement(Color fillColor, Color fillStopColor, GradientStyle gradientStyle)
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
			elementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
			fill = fillColor;
			fill_stop_color = fillStopColor;
			fill_gradient_style = gradientStyle;
		}

		public PaintElement(Image image)
		{
			defaultPE = standardPE;
			initFields();
			fill_image = image;
			elementType = PaintElementType.Image;
		}

		public PaintElement(Color fill, Color fillStopColor, byte fillOpacity, byte fillStopOpacity, GradientStyle fillGradientStyle, PaintElementType elementType)
		{
			Fill = fill;
			FillStopColor = fillStopColor;
			FillOpacity = fillOpacity;
			FillStopOpacity = fillStopOpacity;
			FillGradientStyle = fillGradientStyle;
			ElementType = elementType;
		}

		internal PaintElement(DefaultPaintElement defaultPETemplate)
		{
			defaultPE = defaultPETemplate;
			initFields();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ElementType.ToString();
		}

		private void initFields()
		{
			fill_stop_opacity = defaultPE.FillStopOpacity;
			fill_opacity = defaultPE.FillOpacity;
			stroke_opacity = defaultPE.StrokeOpacity;
			stroke_width = defaultPE.StrokeWidth;
			stroke = defaultPE.Stroke;
			shadow = defaultPE.Shadow;
			fill = defaultPE.Fill;
			fill_stop_color = defaultPE.FillStopColor;
			imageWrapMode = defaultPE.ImageWrapMode;
			hatch = defaultPE.Hatch;
			fill_gradient_style = defaultPE.FillGradientStyle;
			elementType = defaultPE.ElementType;
			imageFitStyle = defaultPE.ImageFitStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeTextureApplication()
		{
			return TextureApplication != TextureApplicationStyle.Normal;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetTextureApplication()
		{
			TextureApplication = TextureApplicationStyle.Normal;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeTexture()
		{
			return Texture != TexturePresets.LightGrain;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetTexture()
		{
			Texture = TexturePresets.LightGrain;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeImageFitStyle()
		{
			return imageFitStyle != defaultPE.ImageFitStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetImageFitStyle()
		{
			imageFitStyle = defaultPE.ImageFitStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeElementType()
		{
			if ((!(parentAppearance is IconAppearance) || elementType == PaintElementType.None) && (!(appearanceProperty == "GridPE") || elementType == PaintElementType.None))
			{
				return elementType != defaultPE.ElementType;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetElementType()
		{
			ElementType = defaultPE.ElementType;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		private Image GetImage()
		{
			if (FillImage != null)
			{
				return FillImage;
			}
			if (ImagePath != null && ImagePath.Length > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					return Image.FromFile(_imagePath);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex)
				{
					if (ex.TargetSite != null && ex.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_377"));
					}
					throw ex;
				}
				catch (OutOfMemoryException ex2)
				{
					if (ex2.TargetSite != null && ex2.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_377"));
					}
					throw ex2;
				}
				catch (FileNotFoundException ex3)
				{
					if (ex3.TargetSite != null && ex3.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_377"));
					}
					throw ex3;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Brush GetTextureBrush(Color fillColor, PaintElement ele)
		{
			byte[,] array;
			if (ele.Texture != TexturePresets.CustomImage)
			{
				array = ((ele.TextureApplication != TextureApplicationStyle.Normal) ? TextureValues.Invert(TextureValues.FromPreset(ele.Texture)) : TextureValues.FromPreset(ele.Texture));
			}
			else
			{
				Image image = ele.GetImage();
				if (image == null)
				{
					return new SolidBrush(fillColor);
				}
				array = ((ele.TextureApplication != TextureApplicationStyle.Normal) ? TextureValues.Invert(TextureValues.FromImage(image as Bitmap)) : TextureValues.FromImage(image as Bitmap));
			}
			int upperBound = array.GetUpperBound(1);
			int upperBound2 = array.GetUpperBound(0);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(upperBound, upperBound2);
			if (ele.TextureApplication == TextureApplicationStyle.Normal)
			{
				byte b = Math.Min(fillColor.R, Math.Min(fillColor.G, fillColor.B));
				fillColor = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, fillColor.R - b, fillColor.G - b, fillColor.B - b);
				for (int i = 0; i < upperBound2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < upperBound; j++)
					{
						byte b2 = array[i, j];
						int red = Math.Min(fillColor.R + b2, 255);
						int green = Math.Min(fillColor.G + b2, 255);
						int blue = Math.Min(fillColor.B + b2, 255);
						bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, red, green, blue));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				byte b = (byte)Math.Min(255 - fillColor.R, Math.Min(255 - fillColor.G, 255 - fillColor.B));
				fillColor = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, fillColor.R + b, fillColor.G + b, fillColor.B + b);
				for (int k = 0; k < upperBound2; k++)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < upperBound; l++)
					{
						byte b3 = array[k, l];
						int red2 = Math.Max(fillColor.R - b3, 0);
						int green2 = Math.Max(fillColor.G - b3, 0);
						int blue2 = Math.Max(fillColor.B - b3, 0);
						bitmap.SetPixel(l, k, Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, red2, green2, blue2));
					}
				}
			}
			return new TextureBrush(bitmap);
		}

		public static Brush GetBrush(PaintElement ele, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			Brush brush = null;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = null;
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, ele.Fill);
			Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillStopOpacity, ele.FillStopColor);
			RectangleF bounds = path.GetBounds();
			if (bounds.Width < 2f || bounds.Height < 2f)
			{
				return Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			double num = Math.Sqrt(2.0);
			switch (ele.ElementType)
			{
			case PaintElementType.Image:
			{
				Image image = ele.GetImage();
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Round(path.GetBounds());
				if (image != null)
				{
					using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
					{
						matrix.Translate(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y);
						TextureBrush textureBrush;
						switch (ele.ImageFitStyle)
						{
						case ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit:
						{
							textureBrush = new TextureBrush(image);
							float scaleX = (float)rectangle.Width / (float)image.Width;
							float scaleY = (float)rectangle.Height / (float)image.Height;
							matrix.Scale(scaleX, scaleY);
							break;
						}
						case ImageFitStyle.Centered:
						{
							Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
							bitmap.SetResolution(image.HorizontalResolution, image.VerticalResolution);
							Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
							Point point = new Point(rectangle.Width / 2 - image.Width / 2, rectangle.Height / 2 - image.Height / 2);
							graphics.DrawImage(image, point);
							textureBrush = new TextureBrush(bitmap);
							break;
						}
						default:
							textureBrush = new TextureBrush(image, ele.ImageWrapMode);
							break;
						}
						textureBrush.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
						return textureBrush;
					}
				}
				return Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			case PaintElementType.Hatch:
			{
				if (ele.Hatch == FillHatchStyle.None || (ele.FillOpacity <= 0 && ele.FillStopOpacity <= 0))
				{
					return Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				int hatchstyle = Math.Max((int)(ele.Hatch - 2), 0);
				return new HatchBrush((HatchStyle)hatchstyle, color, color2);
			}
			case PaintElementType.CustomBrush:
				return ele.CustomBrush;
			case PaintElementType.Texture:
				if (ele.FillOpacity <= 0)
				{
					return Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				return GetTextureBrush(color, ele);
			case PaintElementType.Gradient:
				if (ele.FillOpacity <= 0 && ele.FillStopOpacity <= 0)
				{
					return Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				switch (ele.FillGradientStyle)
				{
				case GradientStyle.Default:
				case GradientStyle.BackwardDiagonal:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.Horizontal:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.Horizontal);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.Vertical:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.Vertical);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.VerticalBump:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, 90f, isAngleScaleable: true);
					(brush as LinearGradientBrush).SetBlendTriangularShape(0.5f, 1f);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.HorizontalBump:
					brush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, color, color2, 0f, isAngleScaleable: true);
					(brush as LinearGradientBrush).SetBlendTriangularShape(0.5f, 1f);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.Circular:
				{
					graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
					double num4 = Math.Sqrt(bounds.Width * bounds.Width + bounds.Height * bounds.Height);
					int num5 = (int)num4 + 2;
					Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle((int)bounds.X, (int)bounds.Y, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height);
					rect2.Inflate((num5 - (int)bounds.Width) / 2, (num5 - (int)bounds.Height) / 2);
					graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect2);
					brush = GetPathGradientBrush(graphicsPath, color, color2, bounds);
					break;
				}
				case GradientStyle.Rectangular:
					graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
					graphicsPath.AddRectangle(bounds);
					brush = GetPathGradientBrush(graphicsPath, color, color2, bounds);
					break;
				case GradientStyle.Elliptical:
				{
					graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
					Rectangle rect = new Rectangle((int)bounds.X, (int)bounds.Y, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height);
					int num2 = (int)((double)bounds.Height * num) + 2;
					int num3 = (int)((double)bounds.Width * num) + 2;
					rect.Inflate((num3 - (int)bounds.Width) / 2, (num2 - (int)bounds.Height) / 2);
					graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect);
					brush = GetPathGradientBrush(graphicsPath, color, color2, bounds);
					break;
				}
				default:
					return new SolidBrush(color);
				}
				return brush;
			default:
				if (color.A == 0)
				{
					return Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				return new SolidBrush(color);
			}
		}

		private static PathGradientBrush GetPathGradientBrush(GraphicsPath graphicsPath, Color fillColor, Color fillStopColor, RectangleF rectOfGraphic)
		{
			PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(graphicsPath);
			pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = fillColor;
			pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { fillStopColor };
			pathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = new PointF(rectOfGraphic.Left + rectOfGraphic.Width / 2f, rectOfGraphic.Top + rectOfGraphic.Height / 2f);
			return pathGradientBrush;
		}

		public static Brush GetBrush(PaintElement ele, Rectangle rect)
		{
			Brush brush = null;
			Color color = ele.Fill;
			Color color2 = ele.FillStopColor;
			if (color != Color.Transparent && color != Color.Empty)
			{
				color = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillOpacity, color);
			}
			if (color2 != Color.Transparent && color2 != Color.Empty)
			{
				color2 = Color.FromArgb(ele.FillStopOpacity, color2);
			}
			if (rect.Width < 2 || rect.Height < 2)
			{
				brush = Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			else
			{
				double num = Math.Sqrt(2.0);
				switch (ele.ElementType)
				{
				case PaintElementType.Image:
				{
					Image image = ele.GetImage();
					if (image != null)
					{
						TextureBrush textureBrush;
						using (Matrix matrix = new Matrix())
						{
							matrix.Translate(rect.X, rect.Y);
							switch (ele.ImageFitStyle)
							{
							case ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit:
							{
								textureBrush = new TextureBrush(image);
								float scaleX = (float)rect.Width / (float)image.Width;
								float scaleY = (float)rect.Height / (float)image.Height;
								matrix.Scale(scaleX, scaleY);
								break;
							}
							case ImageFitStyle.Centered:
							{
								Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(rect.Width, rect.Height);
								bitmap.SetResolution(image.HorizontalResolution, image.VerticalResolution);
								Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
								Point point = new Point(rect.Width / 2 - image.Width / 2, rect.Height / 2 - image.Height / 2);
								graphics.DrawImage(image, point);
								textureBrush = new TextureBrush(bitmap);
								break;
							}
							default:
								textureBrush = new TextureBrush(image, ele.ImageWrapMode);
								break;
							}
							textureBrush.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
						}
						brush = textureBrush;
						break;
					}
					return Brushes.Transparent;
				}
				case PaintElementType.Gradient:
					switch (ele.fill_gradient_style)
					{
					case GradientStyle.Default:
					case GradientStyle.BackwardDiagonal:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.Horizontal:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.Horizontal);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.Vertical:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, LinearGradientMode.Vertical);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.VerticalBump:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, 90f, isAngleScaleable: true);
						((LinearGradientBrush)brush).SetBlendTriangularShape(0.5f, 1f);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.HorizontalBump:
						brush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect, color, color2, 0f, isAngleScaleable: true);
						((LinearGradientBrush)brush).SetBlendTriangularShape(0.5f, 1f);
						break;
					case GradientStyle.Circular:
					case GradientStyle.Rectangular:
					case GradientStyle.Elliptical:
					{
						GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
						switch (ele.fill_gradient_style)
						{
						case GradientStyle.Circular:
						{
							double num4 = Math.Sqrt((double)rect.Width * (double)rect.Width + (double)rect.Height * (double)rect.Height);
							int num5 = (int)num4 + 2;
							Rectangle rect3 = rect;
							rect3.Inflate((num5 - rect.Width) / 2, (num5 - rect.Height) / 2);
							graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect3);
							break;
						}
						case GradientStyle.Rectangular:
							graphicsPath.AddRectangle(rect);
							break;
						case GradientStyle.Elliptical:
						{
							Rectangle rect2 = rect;
							int num2 = (int)((double)rect.Height * num) + 2;
							int num3 = (int)((double)rect.Width * num) + 2;
							rect2.Inflate((num3 - rect.Width) / 2, (num2 - rect.Height) / 2);
							graphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect2);
							break;
						}
						default:
							return new SolidBrush(color);
						}
						PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(graphicsPath);
						brush = pathGradientBrush;
						pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = color;
						pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { color2 };
						pathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = new Point(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2, rect.Top + rect.Height / 2);
						break;
					}
					}
					break;
				case PaintElementType.Hatch:
				{
					if (ele.Hatch == FillHatchStyle.None)
					{
						return Brushes.Transparent;
					}
					int hatchstyle = Math.Max((int)(ele.Hatch - 2), 0);
					return new HatchBrush((HatchStyle)hatchstyle, color, color2);
				}
				case PaintElementType.CustomBrush:
					brush = ele.CustomBrush;
					break;
				case PaintElementType.SolidFill:
					if (color == Color.Transparent)
					{
						return Brushes.Transparent;
					}
					return new SolidBrush(color);
				case PaintElementType.Texture:
					return GetTextureBrush(color, ele);
				default:
					return new SolidBrush(color);
				}
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = new SolidBrush(color);
			}
			return brush;
		}

		public static Brush GetHilightBrush(PaintElement ele, GraphicsPath strokePath, Color lightColor)
		{
			return GetHilightBrush(ele, strokePath, lightColor, square: false);
		}

		internal static Brush GetHilightBrush(PaintElement ele, GraphicsPath strokePath, Color lightColor, bool square)
		{
			PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(strokePath);
			pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = lightColor;
			pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = new Color[1] { Color.Transparent };
			float num = 0.95f;
			float num2 = 0.95f;
			if (square)
			{
				RectangleF bounds = strokePath.GetBounds();
				if (bounds.Width > bounds.Height)
				{
					num2 *= bounds.Height / bounds.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					num *= bounds.Width / bounds.Height;
				}
			}
			pathGradientBrush.FocusScales = new PointF(num, num2);
			return pathGradientBrush;
		}

		public XmlElement ToXml(XmlDocument doc)
		{
			XmlElement xmlElement = doc.CreateElement("PaintElement");
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (item.IsBrowsable && !item.IsReadOnly)
				{
					xmlElement.SetAttribute(item.Name, item.GetValue(this).ToString());
				}
			}
			return xmlElement;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public PaintElement Clone()
		{
			PaintElement paintElement = new PaintElement();
			if (CustomBrush != null)
			{
				paintElement.CustomBrush = CustomBrush.Clone() as Brush;
			}
			paintElement.ElementType = ElementType;
			paintElement.Fill = Fill;
			paintElement.FillGradientStyle = FillGradientStyle;
			if (FillImage != null)
			{
				paintElement.FillImage = FillImage.Clone() as Image;
			}
			paintElement.ImagePath = ImagePath;
			paintElement.FillOpacity = FillOpacity;
			paintElement.FillStopColor = FillStopColor;
			paintElement.FillStopOpacity = FillStopOpacity;
			paintElement.Hatch = Hatch;
			paintElement.ImageFitStyle = ImageFitStyle;
			paintElement.ImageWrapMode = ImageWrapMode;
			paintElement.Stroke = Stroke;
			paintElement.StrokeOpacity = StrokeOpacity;
			paintElement.StrokeWidth = StrokeWidth;
			paintElement.Texture = Texture;
			paintElement.TextureApplication = TextureApplication;
			paintElement.StrokeAlignment = StrokeAlignment;
			return paintElement;
		}
	}
	[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.PaintElementCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class PaintElementCollection : CollectionBase, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private IChartComponent _Component;

		public virtual IChartComponent ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return Component;
			}
			set
			{
				Component = value;
			}
		}

		public IChartComponent Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _Component;
			}
			set
			{
				_Component = value;
			}
		}

		public PaintElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.List[index] as PaintElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					value.component = _Component;
				}
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(int index, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemove(index, value);
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public virtual PaintElement[] ToArray()
		{
			PaintElement[] array = new PaintElement[base.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = this[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		public virtual void CopyTo(PaintElement[] array, int index)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public PaintElementCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public PaintElementCollection(IChartComponent component)
		{
			Component = component;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public PaintElementCollection Clone()
		{
			PaintElementCollection paintElementCollection = new PaintElementCollection(Component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PaintElement paintElement = (PaintElement)enumerator.Current;
					paintElementCollection.Add(paintElement.Clone());
				}
				return paintElementCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(PaintElement value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				value.component = _Component;
			}
			int result = base.List.Add(value);
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int AddRange(PaintElement[] value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
				{
					if (value[i] != null)
					{
						Add(value[i]);
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int IndexOf(PaintElement value)
		{
			return base.List.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, PaintElement value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				value.component = _Component;
			}
			base.List.Insert(index, value);
			if (ChartComponent != null)
			{
				ChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(PaintElement value)
		{
			base.List.Remove(value);
		}

		public bool Contains(PaintElement value)
		{
			return base.List.Contains(value);
		}
	}
	internal class DefaultPaintElement
	{
		private byte _fillStopOpacity = byte.MaxValue;

		private byte _fillOpacity = byte.MaxValue;

		private byte _strokeOpacity = byte.MaxValue;

		private int _strokeWidth = 1;

		private Color _stroke = Color.Black;

		private bool _shadow;

		private Color _fill = Color.Transparent;

		private Color _fillStopColor = Color.Transparent;

		private WrapMode _imageWrapMode;

		private FillHatchStyle _hatch = FillHatchStyle.None;

		private GradientStyle _gradientStyle = GradientStyle.None;

		private PaintElementType _elementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;

		private ImageFitStyle _ImageFitStyle = ImageFitStyle.StretchedFit;

		public byte FillStopOpacity => _fillStopOpacity;

		public byte FillOpacity => _fillOpacity;

		public byte StrokeOpacity => _strokeOpacity;

		public int StrokeWidth => _strokeWidth;

		public Color Stroke => _stroke;

		public bool Shadow => _shadow;

		public Color Fill => _fill;

		public Color FillStopColor => _fillStopColor;

		public WrapMode ImageWrapMode => _imageWrapMode;

		public FillHatchStyle Hatch => _hatch;

		public GradientStyle FillGradientStyle => _gradientStyle;

		public PaintElementType ElementType => _elementType;

		public ImageFitStyle ImageFitStyle => _ImageFitStyle;

		public DefaultPaintElement(byte fillStopOpacity, byte fillOpacity, byte strokeOpacity, int strokeWidth, Color stroke, bool shadow, Color fill, Color fillStopColor, WrapMode imageWrapMode, FillHatchStyle hatch, GradientStyle gradientStyle, PaintElementType elementType)
		{
			_fillStopOpacity = fillStopOpacity;
			_fillOpacity = fillOpacity;
			_strokeOpacity = strokeOpacity;
			_strokeWidth = strokeWidth;
			_stroke = stroke;
			_shadow = shadow;
			_fill = fill;
			_fillStopColor = fillStopColor;
			_imageWrapMode = imageWrapMode;
			_hatch = hatch;
			_gradientStyle = gradientStyle;
			_elementType = elementType;
		}
	}
	public class PaintElementConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object paintItem, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType != typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, paintItem, destinationType);
			}
			ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PaintElement).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
			return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
		}
	}

		private void GenerateFormatString()
		{
			switch (pieLabelStyle)
			{
			case PieLabelFormat.ItemLabel:
				labelFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>";
				break;
			case PieLabelFormat.DataValue:
				labelFormatString = "<DATA_VALUE:#0.00>";
				break;
			case PieLabelFormat.PercentValue:
				labelFormatString = "<PERCENT_VALUE:#0.00>%";
				break;
			case PieLabelFormat.Label_and_Percent:
				labelFormatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>\n<PERCENT_VALUE:#0.00>%";
				break;
			case PieLabelFormat.None:
				labelFormatString = "";
				break;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBorderThickness() && !ShouldSerializeFillColor() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFormat() && !ShouldSerializeFormatString() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderDrawStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderEndStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLinesVisible() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineThickness() && !ShouldSerializeLeaderLineColor())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(" + FormatString + ")";
		}
	}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_127")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public SymbolIcon3D Icon
		{
			get
			{
				return icon;
			}
			set
			{
				icon = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_128")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public SymbolIconSize IconSize
		{
			get
			{
				return iconSize;
			}
			set
			{
				iconSize = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public PointChart3DAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public PointChart3DAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeIcon()
		{
			return icon != SymbolIcon3D.Sphere;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetIcon()
		{
			Icon = SymbolIcon3D.Sphere;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeIconSize()
		{
			return iconSize != SymbolIconSize.Auto;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetIconSize()
		{
			IconSize = SymbolIconSize.Auto;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeIcon())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIconSize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetIcon();
			ResetIconSize();
		}
	}
	public class PointStyle : AppearanceHelper
	{
		private SymbolIcon _icon = SymbolIcon.X;

		private SymbolIconSize _iconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;

		private char _character = 'A';

		private Font _characterFont = DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;

		[DefaultValue(SymbolIcon.X)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_1063")]
		public SymbolIcon Icon
		{
			get
			{
				return _icon;
			}
			set
			{
				_icon = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_1064")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[DefaultValue(SymbolIconSize.Medium)]
		public SymbolIconSize IconSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _iconSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_iconSize = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue('A')]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_1065")]
		public char Character
		{
			get
			{
				return _character;
			}
			set
			{
				_character = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(typeof(Font), "Microsoft Sans Serif, 7.8pt")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_1066")]
		public Font CharacterFont
		{
			get
			{
				return _characterFont;
			}
			set
			{
				_characterFont = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		public PointStyle()
		{
		}

		public PointStyle(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName, IChartComponent component)
			: base(parent, propertyName, component)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeIcon()
		{
			return Icon != SymbolIcon.X;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetIcon()
		{
			Icon = SymbolIcon.X;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeIconSize()
		{
			return IconSize != SymbolIconSize.Medium;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetIconSize()
		{
			IconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeCharacter()
		{
			return Character != 'A';
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetCharacter()
		{
			Character = 'A';
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeCharacterFont()
		{
			return CharacterFont != DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetCharacterFont()
		{
			CharacterFont = DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeCharacter() && !ShouldSerializeCharacterFont() && !ShouldSerializeIcon())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeIconSize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			Character = 'A';
			CharacterFont = DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;
			Icon = SymbolIcon.X;
			IconSize = SymbolIconSize.Medium;
		}
	}

		{
			return !characterFont.Equals(DefaultConstants.D_ScatterChartSymbolFont);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetCharacterFont()
		{
			CharacterFont = DefaultConstants.D_ScatterChartSymbolFont;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeUseGroupByColumn()

			return groupByColumn;
		}

		public void ResetUseGroupByColumn()

			UseGroupByColumn = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeGroupByColumn()
		{
			return groupByColumnNumber != 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetGroupByColumn()

			GroupByColumn = 0;

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			return ColumnY != 2;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetColumnY()
		{
			ColumnY = 2;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeChartText()
		{
			if (chartTextAppearance.Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetChartText()
		{
			chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextCollection();
			chartTextAppearance.cApp = this;
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeCharacter() && !ShouldSerializeCharacterFont() && !ShouldSerializeChartText() && !ShouldSerializeColumnX() && !ShouldSerializeColumnY() && !ShouldSerializeConnectWithLines() && !ShouldSerializeGroupByColumn() && !ShouldSerializeIcon() && !ShouldSerializeIconSize() && !ShouldSerializeNullHandling() && !ShouldSerializeUseGroupByColumn())
			{
				return splineAppearance.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetCharacter();
			ResetCharacterFont();
			ResetChartText();
			ResetColumnX();
			ResetColumnY();
			ResetConnectWithLines();
			ResetGroupByColumn();
			ResetIcon();
			ResetIconSize();
			ResetNullHandling();
			ResetUseGroupByColumn();
		}

	public class PolarChartAppearance : ScatterChartAppearance
	{
		private bool _EnableLabelFlipping = true;

		private int _LabelFlippingStartAngle = 35;

		private int _LabelFlippingEndAngle = 145;

		private bool _FillArea;

		private bool _FreeStandingAxis;

		private AngleUnit _AngleUnit;

		public bool EnableLabelFlipping
		{
			get
			{
				return _EnableLabelFlipping;
			}
			set
			{
				_EnableLabelFlipping = value;
			}
		}

		public int LabelFlippingStartAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return _LabelFlippingStartAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				_LabelFlippingStartAngle = value;
			}
		}

		public int LabelFlippingEndAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return _LabelFlippingEndAngle;
			}
			set
			{
				_LabelFlippingEndAngle = value;
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_376")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public bool FillArea
		{
			get
			{
				return _FillArea;
			}
			set
			{
				_FillArea = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_375")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		public bool FreeStandingAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return _FreeStandingAxis;
			}
			set
			{
				_FreeStandingAxis = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public AngleUnit AngleUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return _AngleUnit;
			}
			set
			{
				_AngleUnit = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public override bool ConnectWithLines
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ConnectWithLines;
			}
			set
			{
				base.ConnectWithLines = value;
			}
		}

		public PolarChartAppearance()
		{
			base.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			base.ConnectWithLines = true;
			base.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
		}

		public PolarChartAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			base.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: true);
			base.ConnectWithLines = true;
			base.SetNoUpdate(noUpdate: false);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeEnableLabelFlipping()
		{
			return !_EnableLabelFlipping;
		}

		public void ResetEnableLabelFlipping()
		{
			EnableLabelFlipping = true;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeLabelFlippingStartAngle()
		{
			return _LabelFlippingStartAngle != 35;
		}

		public void ResetLabelFlippingStartAngle()
		{
			LabelFlippingStartAngle = 35;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeLabelFlippingEndAngle()
		{
			return _LabelFlippingEndAngle != 145;
		}

		public void ResetLabelFlippingEndAngle()
		{
			LabelFlippingEndAngle = 145;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeFillArea()
		{
			return _FillArea;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFillArea()
		{
			FillArea = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeFreeStandingAxis()
		{
			return _FreeStandingAxis;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFreeStandingAxis()
		{
			FreeStandingAxis = false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAngleUnit()
		{
			return _AngleUnit != AngleUnit.Degrees;
		}

		public void ResetAngleUnit()
		{
			AngleUnit = AngleUnit.Degrees;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void ResetConnectWithLines()
		{
			ConnectWithLines = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override bool ShouldSerializeConnectWithLines()
		{
			return !ConnectWithLines;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public new bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeFillArea())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFreeStandingAxis();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetCharacter();
			ResetCharacterFont();
			ResetChartText();
			ResetColumnX();
			ResetColumnY();
			ResetConnectWithLines();
			ResetFillArea();
			ResetGroupByColumn();
			ResetIcon();
			ResetIconSize();
			ResetUseGroupByColumn();
		}
	}

			lineAppearance.ResetNullHandling();

			lineAppearance.ResetThickness();

			scatterAppearance.ResetUseGroupByColumn();

		{

			Line.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			LineData.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			Scatter.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			ScatterData.SetComponent(chartComponent);
		}

		}

		public ScrollScaleAppearance(ChartAppearance parent, string property)
			: base(parent, property)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			return Width != 15;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetWidth()

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			return Visible;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			return _Scale < 1.0;
		}

		{

		}

		{
			return Clone();
		}

		{
			ScrollScaleAppearance scrollScaleAppearance = new ScrollScaleAppearance(parentAppearance, appearanceProperty);
			scrollScaleAppearance.component = component;
			scrollScaleAppearance.Height = Height;

			scrollScaleAppearance.Scroll = Scroll;

			return scrollScaleAppearance;

		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeScale() && !ShouldSerializeScroll() && !ShouldSerializeWidth() && !ShouldSerializeHeight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetScale();
			ResetScroll();
			ResetWidth();
			ResetHeight();
			ResetVisible();
		}

	public class SkinAppearance : ChartAppearance, ICloneable
	{
		private bool _ApplyRowWise = true;

		private PaintElement[] _PaintElement = new PaintElement[0];

		private PaintElementCollection _PEs;

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_268")]
		public bool ApplyRowWise
		{
			get
			{
				return _ApplyRowWise;
			}
			set
			{
				_ApplyRowWise = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.PaintElementCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_269")]
		public PaintElementCollection PEs
		{
			get
			{
				if (_PEs == null)
				{
					_PEs = new PaintElementCollection(component);
				}
				return _PEs;
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_269")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Obsolete("PaintElement [the array] is obsolete.  Please use PEs [the collection] instead.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public PaintElement[] PaintElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _PaintElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_PaintElement = value;
				PEs.Clear();
				if (value != null && value.Length > 0)
				{
					foreach (PaintElement value2 in value)
					{
						PEs.Add(value2);
					}
				}
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public SkinAppearance(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
			_PEs = new PaintElementCollection(component);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeApplyRowWise()
		{
			return !_ApplyRowWise;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetApplyRowWise()
		{
			_ApplyRowWise = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_PaintElement != null)
			{
				return PEs.Count + " - element(s)";
			}
			return "none";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializePEs()
		{
			if (PEs != null)
			{
				return PEs.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetPEs()
		{
			PEs.Clear();
		}

		public PaintElementCollection GetElements()
		{
			return PEs;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializePaintElement()
		{
			if (_PaintElement != null)
			{
				return _PaintElement.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetPaintElement()
		{
			_PaintElement = new PaintElement[0];
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeApplyRowWise() && !ShouldSerializePaintElement())
			{
				return ShouldSerializePEs();
			}
			return true;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public SkinAppearance Clone()
		{
			SkinAppearance skinAppearance = new SkinAppearance(component);
			skinAppearance.ApplyRowWise = ApplyRowWise;
			skinAppearance.PEs.Clear();
			foreach (PaintElement pE in PEs)
			{
				skinAppearance.PEs.Add(pE);
			}
			return skinAppearance;
		}
	}

		}

		public SplineChart3DAppearance()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public SplineChart3DAppearance(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeFlatness()

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		{
			Flatness = 0.1f;
		}

		{
			return (double)Flatness != 0.1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

			Flatness = 0.1f;
		}

	public class StripLineAppearance : AppearanceHelper, ICloneable
	{
		private bool visible;

		private int interval = 2;

		private PaintElement pe;

		private static DefaultPaintElement defaultPE = new DefaultPaintElement(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, 125, 2, DefaultConstants.D_StripLineStroke, shadow: false, DefaultConstants.D_StripLineStartColor, DefaultConstants.D_StripLineEndColor, WrapMode.Tile, FillHatchStyle.None, GradientStyle.None, PaintElementType.SolidFill);

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_218")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_219")]
		[DefaultValue(2)]
		public int Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return interval;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidatePropertyInt("Interval", value, 1, int.MaxValue);
				interval = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(PaintElementConverter))]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_220")]
		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return pe;
			}
			set
			{
				pe = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		public StripLineAppearance()
		{
			initPaintElement();
		}

		internal StripLineAppearance(ChartAppearance parent, string property)
			: base(parent, property)
		{
			initPaintElement();
		}

		private void initPaintElement()
		{
			pe = new PaintElement(this, "PE");
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			return visible;
		}

		public void ResetVisible()
		{
			visible = false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeInterval()
		{
			return interval != 2;
		}

		public void ResetInterval()
		{
			interval = 2;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePE()
		{
			return pe.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		public void ResetPE()
		{
			pe.ResetAll();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializePE() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeInterval();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(StripLines " + (visible ? "" : "Not ") + "Visible)";
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public StripLineAppearance Clone()
		{
			StripLineAppearance stripLineAppearance = new StripLineAppearance(parentAppearance, appearanceProperty);
			stripLineAppearance.component = component;
			stripLineAppearance.Interval = Interval;
			stripLineAppearance.PE = PE.Clone();
			stripLineAppearance.Visible = Visible;
			return stripLineAppearance;
		}
	}

		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.ShadowControlEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DefaultValue(0)]

		public TitleAppearance()
			: this(null, TitleLocation.Top, TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing)
		{
		}

		public TitleAppearance(IChartComponent component, TitleLocation location, TextOrientation orientation)
			: base(component)
		{
			titlePanel = location;
			titlePanelDefault = location;
			textOrientation = orientation;
			marginsAppearance = new MarginsAppearance(this, "Margins", margins);
			label.FontColor = DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontColor;
			SetupDefaults();
		}

		private void SetupDefaults()
		{
			switch (titlePanel)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Top:
				if (label.Font == DefaultConstants.D_TextFont)
				{
					label.Font = (Font)DefaultConstants.D_TitleFont.Clone();
				}
				widthOrHeight = 33;
				if (DefaultVisible)
				{
					visible = true;
				}
				if (DefaultOrientation)
				{
					TextOrientation textOrientation3 = (label.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					this.textOrientation = textOrientation3;
				}
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				if (label.Font == DefaultConstants.D_TextFont)
				{
					label.Font = (Font)DefaultConstants.D_TitleFont.Clone();
				}
				widthOrHeight = 26;
				if (DefaultVisible)
				{
					visible = false;
				}
				if (DefaultOrientation)
				{
					TextOrientation textOrientation7 = (label.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing);
					this.textOrientation = textOrientation7;
				}
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				if (label.Font == DefaultConstants.D_TextFont)
				{
					label.Font = (Font)DefaultConstants.D_TitleFont.Clone();
				}
				widthOrHeight = 26;
				if (DefaultVisible)
				{
					visible = false;
				}
				if (DefaultOrientation)
				{
					TextOrientation textOrientation5 = (label.Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing);
					this.textOrientation = textOrientation5;
				}
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				if (label.Font == DefaultConstants.D_TextFont)
				{
					label.Font = (Font)DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontFooter.Clone();
				}
				widthOrHeight = 26;
				if (DefaultVisible)
				{
					visible = true;
				}
				if (DefaultOrientation)
				{
					TextOrientation textOrientation = (label.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal);
					this.textOrientation = textOrientation;
				}
				if (DefaultHorizontalAlign)
				{
					label.HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetTitleLocation(TitleLocation location)
		{
			titlePanel = location;
			SetupDefaults();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeExtent()
		{
			int num = 0;
			switch (titlePanel)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Top:
				num = 33;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				num = 26;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				num = 26;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				num = 26;
				break;
			}
			return Extent != num;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetExtent()
		{
			int extent = 0;
			switch (titlePanel)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Top:
				extent = 33;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				extent = 26;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				extent = 26;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				extent = 26;
				break;
			}
			Extent = extent;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeVisible()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (titlePanel)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Top:
				flag = true;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				flag = false;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				flag = false;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
			return Visible != flag;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetVisible()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (titlePanel)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Top:
				flag = true;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				flag = false;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				flag = false;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
			Visible = flag;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeText()
		{
			string text = "";
			return Text != text;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetText()
		{
			string text = "";
			Text = text;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeFont()
		{
			if (titlePanelDefault == TitleLocation.Bottom)
			{
				return !Font.Equals(DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontFooter);
			}
			return !Font.Equals(DefaultConstants.D_TitleFont);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFont()
		{
			if (titlePanelDefault == TitleLocation.Bottom)
			{
				Font = DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontFooter;
			}
			Font = DefaultConstants.D_TitleFont;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeFontColor()
		{
			return FontColor != DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontColor;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFontColor()
		{
			FontColor = DefaultConstants.D_TitleFontColor;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeWrapText()
		{
			return WrapText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWrapText()
		{
			WrapText = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign()
		{
			if (titlePanelDefault == TitleLocation.Bottom)
			{
				return HorizontalAlign != StringAlignment.Far;
			}
			return HorizontalAlign != StringAlignment.Near;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetHorizontalAlign()
		{
			if (titlePanelDefault == TitleLocation.Bottom)
			{
				HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Far;
			}
			HorizontalAlign = StringAlignment.Near;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign()
		{
			return VerticalAlign != StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetVerticalAlign()
		{
			VerticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeFontSizeBestFit()
		{
			return FontSizeBestFit;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFontSizeBestFit()
		{
			FontSizeBestFit = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public TextOrientation GetTextOrientation()
		{
			return label.Orientation;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!visible)
			{
				return SR.GetString("SR_18");
			}
			return text;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeLocation()
		{
			return titlePanel != titlePanelDefault;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetLocation()
		{
			titlePanel = titlePanelDefault;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeClipText() && !ShouldSerializeOrientationAngle() && !ShouldSerializeReverseText() && !ShouldSerializeExtent() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFontSizeBestFit() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeLocation() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeWrapText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOrientation();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetExtent();
			ResetFont();
			ResetFontColor();
			ResetFontSizeBestFit();
			ResetHorizontalAlign();
			ResetText();
			ResetVerticalAlign();
			ResetWrapText();
			ResetClipText();
			ResetOrientation();
			ResetOrientationAngle();
			ResetReverseText();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeOrientation()
		{
			switch (Location)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				return textOrientation != TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				return textOrientation != TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing;
			case TitleLocation.Top:
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				return textOrientation != TextOrientation.Horizontal;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetOrientation()
		{
			switch (Location)
			{
			case TitleLocation.Left:
				Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Right:
				Orientation = TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing;
				break;
			case TitleLocation.Top:
			case TitleLocation.Bottom:
				Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
				break;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeOrientationAngle()
		{
			return OrientationAngle != 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetOrientationAngle()
		{
			OrientationAngle = 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeClipText()
		{
			return !ClipText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetClipText()
		{
			ClipText = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeReverseText()
		{
			return ReverseText;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetReverseText()
		{
			ReverseText = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeFlip()
		{
			return Flip;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetFlip()
		{
			Flip = false;
		}
	}
	public class TitleAppearanceCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		private IChartComponent component;

		public int Length => base.Count;

		public TitleAppearance this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= base.Count || index < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (TitleAppearance)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (index < base.Count || index >= 0)
				{
					base.List[index] = value;
					if (component != null)
					{
						((TitleAppearance)base.List[index]).SetComponent(component);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, TitleAppearance titleApp)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, titleApp);
		}

		public virtual void CopyTo(TitleAppearance[] array, int index)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public virtual void Remove(TitleAppearance titleApp)
		{
			Remove(titleApp);
		}

		public TitleAppearanceCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public TitleAppearanceCollection(IChartComponent component)
		{
			this.component = component;
		}

		public TitleAppearance Add(TitleAppearance mvAvgApp)
		{
			if (mvAvgApp != null && component != null)
			{
				mvAvgApp.SetComponent(component);
			}
			base.InnerList.Add(mvAvgApp);
			return mvAvgApp;
		}

		public void Remove(object ob)
		{
			base.InnerList.Remove(ob);
		}

		public new void Clear()
		{
			base.InnerList.Clear();
		}
	}
