		public class ColorInterval
		{
			public double StartValue;

			public Color StartColor;

			public double EndValue;

			public Color EndColor;

			public string CustomLabel;

			public ColorInterval(double sValue, Color sColor, double eValue, Color eColor)
			{
				if (eValue < sValue)
				{
					double num = eValue;
					eValue = sValue;
					sValue = num;
				}
				StartValue = sValue;
				StartColor = sColor;
				EndValue = eValue;
				EndColor = eColor;
				CustomLabel = null;
			}

			public ColorInterval(double sValue, Color sColor, double eValue, Color eColor, string customLabel)
			{
				if (eValue < sValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("ColorInterval Start Value must be <= End Value.");
				}
				StartValue = sValue;
				StartColor = sColor;
				EndValue = eValue;
				EndColor = eColor;
				CustomLabel = customLabel;
			}

			public bool Contains(double value)
			{
				if (value == StartValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (StartValue <= value && value < EndValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ColorInterval _getColorIntervalForValue(double value)
		{
			ColorInterval colorInterval = null;
			ColorInterval colorInterval2 = null;
			for (int num = _colorIntervals.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ColorInterval colorInterval3 = (ColorInterval)_colorIntervals[num];
				if (colorInterval3.Contains(value))
				{
					return colorInterval3;
				}
				if (colorInterval3.EndValue <= value)
				{
					if (colorInterval == null || colorInterval3.EndValue > colorInterval.EndValue)
					{
						colorInterval = colorInterval3;
					}
				}
				else if (colorInterval3.StartValue > value && (colorInterval2 == null || colorInterval3.StartValue < colorInterval2.StartValue))
				{
					colorInterval2 = colorInterval3;
				}
			}
			if (colorInterval != null)
			{
				return colorInterval;
			}
			if (colorInterval2 != null)
			{
				return colorInterval2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Color GetColorForValue(double value)
		{
			if (_colorIntervals.Count == 0)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			ColorInterval colorInterval = _getColorIntervalForValue(value);
			if (colorInterval == null)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			return GetColorForValueAndInterval(value, colorInterval);
		}

		internal Color GetColorForValueAndInterval(double value, ColorInterval interval)
		{
			double startValue = interval.StartValue;
			double endValue = interval.EndValue;
			if (endValue < startValue)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			if (interval.StartColor == interval.EndColor)
			{
				return interval.StartColor;
			}
			if (value <= startValue)
			{
				return interval.StartColor;
			}
			if (value >= endValue)
			{
				return interval.EndColor;
			}
			double num = value;
			double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.StartColor.R);
			double num3 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.EndColor.R);
			double num4 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.StartColor.G);
			double num5 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.EndColor.G);
			double num6 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.StartColor.B);
			double num7 = Convert.ToDouble(interval.EndColor.B);
			endValue -= startValue;
			num -= startValue;
			startValue -= startValue;
			double num8 = num / endValue;
			double value2 = num2 + (num3 - num2) * num8;
			double value3 = num4 + (num5 - num4) * num8;
			double value4 = num6 + (num7 - num6) * num8;
			return Color.FromArgb(Convert.ToInt32(value2), Convert.ToInt32(value3), Convert.ToInt32(value4));
		}

		}

		{
			return BorderWidth != 1;

		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeColorIntervals()
		{
			return _colorIntervals.Count != 0;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeColorValueLabel()
		{
			return ColorValueIndex != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLabelIndex()
		{
			return IndexOrder != null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeLabelStyle()
		{
			if (LabelStyle != null)
			{
				return !LabelStyle.Match(DEFAULT_LABELSTYLE);
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeStaticLeafPE()
		{
			if (StaticLeafPE != null)
			{
				return !StaticLeafPE.Match(DEFAULT_LEAFPE);
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeMargin()
		{
			return Margin != 2;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializePEs()
		{
			return PEs.Count != 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeRotation()
		{
			return Rotation != 45.0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeShowColorIntervalAxis()
		{
			return !ShowColorIntervalAxis;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeShowLabels()
		{
			return !ShowLabels;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeSizeValueLabel()
		{
			return SizeValueIndex != -1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeTreeMapType()
		{
			return TreeMapType != TreeMapType.Rectangular;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeUseLeafPE()
		{
			return UseStaticLeafPE;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderWidth() && !ShouldSerializeColorIntervals() && !ShouldSerializeColorValueLabel() && !ShouldSerializeLabelStyle() && !ShouldSerializeLabelIndex() && !ShouldSerializeStaticLeafPE() && !ShouldSerializeMargin() && !ShouldSerializePEs() && !ShouldSerializeRotation() && !ShouldSerializeShowColorIntervalAxis() && !ShouldSerializeShowLabels() && !ShouldSerializeSizeValueLabel() && !ShouldSerializeTreeMapType())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeUseLeafPE();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			BorderColor = DEFAULT_BORDERCOLOR;
			BorderWidth = 1;
			_colorIntervals = new ArrayList();
			ColorValueIndex = -1;
			LabelStyle = DEFAULT_LABELSTYLE;
			IndexOrder = null;
			StaticLeafPE = DEFAULT_LEAFPE;
			Margin = 2;
			PEs.Clear();
			Rotation = 45.0;
			ShowColorIntervalAxis = true;
			ShowLabels = true;
			SizeValueIndex = -1;
			TreeMapType = TreeMapType.Rectangular;
			UseStaticLeafPE = false;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent component)
		{
			base.SetComponent(component);
			PEs.ChartComponent = component;
			if (LabelStyle != null)
			{
				LabelStyle.SetComponent(component);
			}
			if (StaticLeafPE != null)
			{
				StaticLeafPE.SetComponent(component);
			}
		}

	public class View3DAppearance : ChartTypeAppearance
	{
		private float xrot = 144f;

		private float yrot = 12f;

		private float zrot;

		private float scale = 65f;

		private float perspective = 50f;

		private bool light = true;

		private bool outline;

		private float edge = 1f;

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_279")]
		public float XRotation
		{
			get
			{
				return xrot;
			}
			set
			{
				xrot = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_280")]
		public float YRotation
		{

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeXRotation() && !ShouldSerializeYRotation() && !ShouldSerializeZRotation() && !ShouldSerializeScale() && !ShouldSerializePerspective() && !ShouldSerializeLight() && !ShouldSerializeEdgeSize())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOutline();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void DrawSampleScene(View3DAppearance vApp, Graphics graphics)
		{
			if (vApp == null || vApp.ChartComponent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(120, 120);
			Graphics graphics2 = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			ArrayList fillPrimitives;
			switch (vApp.ChartComponent.ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.FunnelChart3D:
			{
				Funnel3DAppearance funnel3DAppearance = new Funnel3DAppearance();
				funnel3DAppearance.Flat = true;
				FunnelChart3D funnelChart3D = new FunnelChart3D(new RectangleF(20f, 20f, 80f, 80f), (float)Geometry.DegreeToRadian(144f - vApp.XRotation), (float)Geometry.DegreeToRadian(12f - vApp.YRotation), (float)Geometry.DegreeToRadian(0f - vApp.ZRotation), (int)vApp.Perspective, funnel3DAppearance);
				funnelChart3D.AddPartInfo(30.0, Color.Yellow, Color.Red, 0, 0, null, null, 0.0, "");
				funnelChart3D.AddPartInfo(50.0, Color.Red, Color.Red, 0, 0, null, null, 0.0, "");
				funnelChart3D.AddPartInfo(70.0, Color.Blue, Color.Red, 0, 0, null, null, 0.0, "");
				funnelChart3D.AddPartInfo(20.0, Color.Green, Color.Red, 0, 0, null, null, 0.0, "");
				funnelChart3D.Initialize();
				fillPrimitives = funnelChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(new PointF(60f, 60f));
				funnelChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.PieChart3D:
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart3D:
			{
				PieChart3D pieChart3D = new PieChart3D(PieType.Pie, new RectangleF(20f, 20f, 80f, 80f), (float)((double)(vApp.XRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)((vApp.YRotation + 90f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(vApp.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)vApp.Perspective, 1, 20, 0f, 0, flashMode: false, outlineMode: false);
				pieChart3D.AddSlice(30.0, Color.Yellow, Color.Red, exploded: false, 0, 0, 0, "", null, null, otherSlice: false, "");
				pieChart3D.AddSlice(50.0, Color.Red, Color.Red, exploded: false, 0, 0, 0, "", null, null, otherSlice: false, "");
				pieChart3D.AddSlice(70.0, Color.Green, Color.Red, exploded: false, 0, 0, 0, "", null, null, otherSlice: false, "");
				pieChart3D.Initialize();
				fillPrimitives = pieChart3D.GetFillPrimitives();
				pieChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.BarChart3D:
			case ChartType.Stack3DBarChart:
			case ChartType.CylinderStackBarChart3D:
			case ChartType.CylinderBarChart3D:
			{
				Scene3D scene2 = new Scene3D(new RectangleF(20f, 20f, 80f, 80f), 30f, 3f, 0.0, 30.0, 0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 1.0, Color.Wheat);
				BarChart3D barChart3D = new BarChart3D(scene2, (float)((double)((vApp.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(vApp.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(vApp.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)vApp.Perspective, 0.4, 0.4, 0f, cylinder: false, stacked: false, percent: false, 0.0, 50.0, flashMode: false, outlineMode: false);
				barChart3D.Add(1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 30.0, Color.Yellow, Color.Red);
				barChart3D.Add(1, 1, 1.5, 0.5, 15.0, Color.Red, Color.Red);
				barChart3D.Add(1, 1, 2.5, 0.5, 7.5, Color.Blue, Color.Red);
				barChart3D.Initialize();
				fillPrimitives = barChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(light: true, cylinder: false);
				barChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				Scene3D scene = new Scene3D(new RectangleF(20f, 20f, 80f, 80f), 30f, 3f, 0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 30.0, 0.0, 1.0, Color.Wheat);
				ColumnChart3D columnChart3D = new ColumnChart3D(scene, (float)((double)((vApp.XRotation - 114f) / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(vApp.YRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (float)((double)(vApp.ZRotation / 180f) * Math.PI), (int)vApp.Perspective, 0.4, 0.4, 0f, cylinder: false, stacked: false, percent: false, 0.0, 50.0, flashMode: false, outlineMode: false);
				columnChart3D.Add(1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 30.0, Color.Yellow, Color.Red);
				columnChart3D.Add(1, 1, 1.5, 0.5, 15.0, Color.Red, Color.Red);
				columnChart3D.Add(1, 1, 2.5, 0.5, 7.5, Color.Blue, Color.Red);
				columnChart3D.Initialize();
				fillPrimitives = columnChart3D.GetFillPrimitives(light: true, cylinder: false);
				columnChart3D.GetOutlinePrimitives();
				break;
			}
			}
			graphics2.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
			foreach (Path3D item in fillPrimitives)
			{
				graphics2.FillPath(item.Brush, item.Path);
			}
			graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap, 0, 0);
			bitmap.Dispose();
		}
	}

		public ChartDataEventArgs GetChartInfoFromPoint(int x, int y)
		{
			if (component != null)
			{
				return component.GetChartInfoFromPoint(new Point(x, y));
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void GenerateFormatString()
		{
			switch (format)
			{
			case TooltipStyle.None:
				formatString = "";
				break;
			case TooltipStyle.DataValue:
				formatString = "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
				break;
			case TooltipStyle.LabelPlusDataValue:
				formatString = "<ITEM_LABEL>: <DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
				break;
			case TooltipStyle.RowColumnPlusDataValue:
				formatString = "<DATA_ROW>,<DATA_COLUMN>: <DATA_VALUE:00.##>";
				break;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAlphaLevel() && !ShouldSerializeBackColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderColor() && !ShouldSerializeBorderStyle() && !ShouldSerializeBorderThickness() && !ShouldSerializeDisplay() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFormat() && !ShouldSerializeFormatString() && !ShouldSerializeHighlightDataPoint() && !ShouldSerializeHighlightFillColor() && !ShouldSerializeHighlightOutlineColor() && !ShouldSerializePE())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeOverflow();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (display == TooltipDisplay.Never)
			{
				return SR.GetString("SR_18");
			}
			return display.ToString();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializePE()
		{
			return mPE.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetPE()
		{
			mPE.ResetAll();
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources
{
	[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.AxisCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class AxisCollection : ChartAppearance, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private ArrayList _List = new ArrayList();

		public AxisItem this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index] as AxisItem;
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected ArrayList List
		{
			get
			{
				return _List;
			}
			set
			{
				_List = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual int Count => List.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => List.IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => List.SyncRoot;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => List.IsFixedSize;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => List.IsReadOnly;

		public AxisCollection()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public AxisCollection(IChartComponent chartComponent)
			: base(chartComponent)
		{
		}

		public int IndexOf(object obj)
		{
			return List.IndexOf(obj);
		}

		public void Remove(AxisItem axis)
		{
			List.Remove(axis);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public AxisItem FromKey(string key)
		{
			foreach (AxisItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Key == key)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public int Add(AxisItem axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && ((IProvideChartComponent)axis).ChartComponent == null)
			{
				((IProvideChartComponent)axis).ChartComponent = component;
			}
			if (axis.Key == null || axis.Key.Length == 0)
			{
				int num = Count;
				string key;
				do
				{
					num++;
					key = "axis" + num;
				}
				while (FromKey(key) != null);
				axis.Key = key;
			}
			int result = List.Add(axis);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			return result;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public AxisCollection Clone()
		{
			AxisCollection axisCollection = new AxisCollection(component);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				axisCollection.Add(this[i].Clone());
			}
			return axisCollection;
		}

		public override void SetComponent(IChartComponent chartComponent)
		{
			base.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			foreach (AxisItem item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.SetComponent(chartComponent);
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return List.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object item)
		{
			return Add(item as AxisItem);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			List.Clear();
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(ChartLayerAppearance layer)
		{
			return List.Contains(layer);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object item)
		{
			return Contains(item as ChartLayerAppearance);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item as ChartLayerAppearance);
		}

		public virtual void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, value as AxisItem);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object item)
		{
			Remove(item as AxisItem);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			List.RemoveAt(index);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, AxisItem axis)
		{
			List.Insert(index, axis);
			UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
		}
	}

	public class DrillDownID
	{
		private int dataRow = -1;

		private int dataCol = -1;

		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				return dataRow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value >= -1)
				{
					dataRow = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return dataCol;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value >= -1)
				{
					dataCol = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public DrillDownID()
		{
		}

		public DrillDownID(int row, int col)
		{
			dataRow = row;
			dataCol = col;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (dataRow << 8) | dataCol;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (other is DrillDownID drillDownID)
			{
				flag |= drillDownID.Row == dataRow;
				flag &= drillDownID.Column == dataCol;
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public class DrillElement
	{
		private DrillDownID _ID;

		private ChartType _chartType;

		private object _data;

		private IDrillDown _drillDown;

		public DrillDownID ID
		{
			get

				return _ID;

		public ChartType ChartType

			get

				return _data;

			set

			}
		}

		public IDrillDown DrillDown
		{
			get
			{
				return _drillDown;
			}

					_drillDown = value;
				}

				{
					_drillDown = null;

	public class DVS
	{
		private Hashtable _SnapshotState = new Hashtable();

		public Hashtable SnapshotState
		{
			get
			{
				return _SnapshotState;
			}
			set
			{
				_SnapshotState = value;
			}
		}

		public object GetDefault(string index)
		{
			return SnapshotState[index];
		}

		public Hashtable GetChangesSinceLastSnapshot(object component)
		{
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			foreach (string key in SnapshotState.Keys)
			{
				object obj = DigAndGetProperty(key, component);
				object obj2 = SnapshotState[key];
				if (obj2 != null && obj != null)
				{
					if (obj is IList)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList((ICollection)obj);
						ArrayList collectionDelta = GetCollectionDelta(arrayList, obj2);
						foreach (VSDelta item in collectionDelta)
						{
							switch (item.Diff)
							{
							case Delta.Add:
								arrayList.Add(item.Operand);
								break;
							case Delta.Remove:
								arrayList.Remove(item.Operand);
								break;
							}
						}
						if (arrayList.Count > 0)
						{
							hashtable.Add(key, arrayList);
						}
					}
					else if (!GetSimpleDelta(obj, obj2))
					{
						hashtable.Add(key, obj);
					}
				}
				else if (!GetSimpleDelta(obj, obj2))
				{
					hashtable.Add(key, obj);
				}
			}
			return hashtable;
		}

		public void TakeSnapshotOfState(object component)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(SnapshotState.Keys);
			foreach (string item in arrayList)
			{
				object obj = DigAndGetProperty(item, component);
				if (obj is ICollection c)
				{
					SnapshotState[item] = new ArrayList(c);
				}
				else
				{
					SnapshotState[item] = obj;
				}
			}
		}

		public void LoadViewState(object component, object savedState)
		{
			Hashtable hashtable = (Hashtable)savedState;
			foreach (string key in hashtable.Keys)
			{
				DigAndSetProperty(key, component, hashtable[key]);
			}
		}

		public static object DigAndSetProperty(string KeyName, object component, object propertyValue)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (KeyName != null && KeyName.Length > 0)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = null;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = null;
				object obj2 = null;
				string[] array = KeyName.Split('.');
				if (array.Length > 0)
				{
					propertyDescriptorCollection = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component);
					propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection[array[0]];
					if (propertyDescriptor == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					obj2 = component;
					obj = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						obj2 = obj;
						propertyDescriptorCollection = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj);
						propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection[array[i]];
						if (propertyDescriptor == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						obj = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(obj);
					}
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor != null && obj2 != null)
				{
					if (propertyValue is ArrayList)
					{
						foreach (object item in (IList)propertyValue)
						{
							if (!((IList)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(obj2)).Contains(item))
							{
								((IList)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(obj2)).Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						propertyDescriptor.SetValue(obj2, propertyValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static object DigAndGetProperty(string KeyName, object component)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (KeyName != null && KeyName.Length > 0)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = null;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = null;
				string[] array = KeyName.Split('.');
				if (array.Length > 0)
				{
					try
					{
						propertyDescriptorCollection = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component);
						propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection[array[0]];
						if (propertyDescriptor == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						obj = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
						for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							propertyDescriptorCollection = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj);
							propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection[array[i]];
							if (propertyDescriptor == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							obj = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(obj);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetSimpleDelta(object componentState, object SnapshotState)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			return componentState?.Equals(SnapshotState) ?? (SnapshotState == null);
		}

		protected virtual ArrayList GetCollectionDelta(object compState, object shotState)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			IList list = (IList)compState;
			IList list2 = (IList)shotState;
			if (SnapshotState != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in list)
				{
					if (list2.Contains(item))
					{
						arrayList.Add(new VSDelta(Delta.Remove, item));
					}
				}
				foreach (object item2 in list2)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(item2))
					{
						arrayList.Add(new VSDelta(Delta.Add, item2));
					}
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public static ArrayList GetProplist(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("type");
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties();
			for (int i = 0; i < properties.Length; i++)
			{
				recurse(arrayList, properties[i], "UltraChart", 0);
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public static void recurse(ArrayList list, PropertyInfo propInfo, string qualifier, int level)
		{
			if (propInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propInfo");
			}
			if (propInfo.PropertyType.Name.IndexOf("Appearance") < 0)
			{
				if (propInfo.CanRead && propInfo.CanWrite)
				{
					list.Add(new PropInfo(qualifier + "." + propInfo.Name, propInfo));
				}
				return;
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = propInfo.PropertyType.GetProperties();
			for (int i = 0; i < properties.Length; i++)
			{
				recurse(list, properties[i], qualifier + "." + propInfo.Name, level + 1);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class VSDelta
	{
		private Delta diff;

		private object operand;

		internal Delta Diff
		{
			get
			{
				return diff;
			}
			set
			{
				diff = value;
			}
		}

		internal object Operand
		{
			get
			{
				return operand;
			}
			set
			{
				operand = value;
			}
		}

		internal VSDelta(Delta del, object operand)
		{
			diff = del;
			this.operand = operand;
		}
	}
	internal enum Delta
	{
		Equal,
		Add,
		Remove
	}
	internal class PropInfo
	{
		private string _Path;

		private PropertyInfo _Info;

		public string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return _Path;
			}
			set
			{
				_Path = value;
			}
		}

		public PropertyInfo Info
		{
			get
			{
				return _Info;
			}
			set
			{
				_Info = value;
			}
		}

		public PropInfo(string path, PropertyInfo info)
		{
			_Path = path;
			_Info = info;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				return true;

			{
				return browsableFieldAttribute.Browsable == browsable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return browsable.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool IsDefaultAttribute()
		{
			return Equals(Default);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All)]
	public abstract class ConditionallyBrowsableAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private object _value;

		public abstract ConditionallyBrowsableAttribute DefaultValue { get; }

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is ConditionallyBrowsableAttribute conditionallyBrowsableAttribute)
			{
				if (conditionallyBrowsableAttribute == DefaultValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return Value == conditionallyBrowsableAttribute.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool IsDefaultAttribute()
		{
			return Equals(DefaultValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ConditionallyBrowsableAttributeBitwise : ConditionallyBrowsableAttribute
	{
		public int BitWiseValue => (int)base.Value;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is ConditionallyBrowsableAttributeBitwise conditionallyBrowsableAttributeBitwise)
			{
				if (conditionallyBrowsableAttributeBitwise == DefaultValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return (BitWiseValue & conditionallyBrowsableAttributeBitwise.BitWiseValue) > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	internal class ChartCollectionObjectConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		protected virtual InstanceDescriptor CreateInstanceDescriptor(object value)
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
			return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return CreateInstanceDescriptor(value);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All)]
	public class WebBrowsableAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private bool browsable;

		private static WebBrowsableAttribute _Default;

		private static WebBrowsableAttribute _No;

		private static WebBrowsableAttribute _Yes;

		public bool Browsable => browsable;

		public static WebBrowsableAttribute Default => _Default;

		public static WebBrowsableAttribute No => _No;

		public static WebBrowsableAttribute Yes => _Yes;

		static WebBrowsableAttribute()
		{
			_Yes = new WebBrowsableAttribute(browsable: true);
			_No = new WebBrowsableAttribute(browsable: false);
			_Default = Yes;
		}

		public WebBrowsableAttribute(bool browsable)
		{
			this.browsable = true;
			this.browsable = browsable;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is WebBrowsableAttribute webBrowsableAttribute)
			{
				return webBrowsableAttribute.Browsable == browsable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return browsable.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool IsDefaultAttribute()
		{
			return Equals(Default);
		}
	}

	public interface IEffect

		void Apply(SceneGraph scene);

		void Apply(Bitmap chartImage);

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ChartCollectionObjectConverter))]
	public abstract class Effect : IEffect, ICloneable
	{
		private IChartComponent _component;

		private bool _enabled = true;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public virtual IChartComponent Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _component;
			}
			set
			{
				_component = value;
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_362")]
		public virtual bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_enabled = value;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public Effect(IChartComponent component)
		{
			Component = component;
		}

		public Effect()
		{
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public abstract Effect Clone();

		public virtual void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Apply(Bitmap chartImage)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return GetType().Name;
		}

		public virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Effects
{
	[ListBindable(false)]
	public class EffectsCollection : CollectionBase, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private IChartComponent _component;

		IChartComponent IProvideChartComponent.ChartComponent
		{
			get
			{
				return Component;
			}
			set
			{
				Component = value;
			}
		}

		internal IChartComponent Component
		{
			get
			{
				return _component;
			}
			set
			{
				_component = value;
			}
		}

		public IEffect this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEffect)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
				if (Component != null)
				{
					Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual int IndexOf(Effect effect)
		{
			return base.List.IndexOf(effect);
		}

		public virtual void CopyTo(Effect[] array, int index)
		{
			base.List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public EffectsCollection(IChartComponent component)
		{
			Component = component;
		}

		public int Add(IEffect effect)
		{
			int result = base.List.Add(effect);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				if (effect is Effect effect2)
				{
					effect2.Component = Component;
				}
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Remove(IEffect effect)
		{
			base.List.Remove(effect);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, IEffect effect)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, effect);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public EffectsCollection Clone()
		{
			EffectsCollection effectsCollection = new EffectsCollection(Component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IEffect effect = (IEffect)enumerator.Current;
					if (effect is Effect effect2)
					{
						effectsCollection.Add(effect2.Clone());
					}
					else
					{
						effectsCollection.Add(effect);
					}
				}
				return effectsCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance
{
	public class GradientEffect : Effect
	{
		private GradientStyle _style = GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal;

		private GradientColoringStyle _coloring = GradientColoringStyle.Darken;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_363")]
		public GradientStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				_style = value;
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_364")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public GradientColoringStyle Coloring
		{
			get
			{
				return _coloring;
			}
			set
			{
				_coloring = value;
			}
		}

		public GradientEffect()
		{
		}

		public GradientEffect(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeStyle()
		{
			return Style != GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetStyle()
		{
			Style = GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColoring()
		{
			return Coloring != GradientColoringStyle.Darken;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetColoring()
		{
			Coloring = GradientColoringStyle.Darken;
		}

		public override Effect Clone()
		{
			GradientEffect gradientEffect = new GradientEffect(Component);
			gradientEffect.Coloring = Coloring;
			gradientEffect.Enabled = Enabled;
			gradientEffect.Style = Style;
			return gradientEffect;
		}

		public override void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (scene == null || (Component != null && Component.ChartType.ToString().IndexOf("3D") != -1))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Primitive item in scene)
			{
				if ((item.Caps & PCaps.Skin) <= PCaps.None || (item.Path != null && item.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") >= 0) || (item.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.SolidFill && item.PE.ElementType != PaintElementType.None))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = 1;
				Color baseColor = item.GetBaseColor();
				if (!(baseColor == Color.Transparent))
				{
					switch (Coloring)
					{
					case GradientColoringStyle.Lighten:
						num = Math.Min(Math.Min(255 - baseColor.R, 255 - baseColor.G), 255 - baseColor.B);
						break;
					case GradientColoringStyle.Darken:
						num = -1 * Math.Min(Math.Min(baseColor.R, baseColor.G), baseColor.B);
						break;
					}
					item.PE = item.PE.Clone();
					item.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
					item.PE.FillGradientStyle = Style;
					item.PE.Fill = baseColor;
					item.PE.FillStopColor = Color.FromArgb(baseColor.R + num, baseColor.G + num, baseColor.B + num);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ShadowEffect : Effect
	{
		private int _depth = 5;

		private Color _color = Color.DarkGray;

		private double _angle = 45.0;

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_365")]
		[DefaultValue(5)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public int Depth
		{
			get
			{
				return _depth;
			}
			set
			{
				_depth = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_366")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return _color;
			}
			set
			{
				_color = value;
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_367")]
		[DefaultValue(45)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		public double Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return _angle;
			}
			set
			{
				_angle = value;
			}
		}

		public ShadowEffect(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		public ShadowEffect()
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeColor()
		{
			return Color != Color.DarkGray;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetColor()
		{
			Color = Color.DarkGray;
		}

		public override Effect Clone()
		{
			ShadowEffect shadowEffect = new ShadowEffect(Component);
			shadowEffect.Angle = Angle;
			shadowEffect.Color = Color;
			shadowEffect.Depth = Depth;
			shadowEffect.Enabled = Enabled;
			return shadowEffect;
		}

		public override void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (scene == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)((double)Depth * Math.Cos(Math.PI * Angle / 180.0));
			int num2 = (int)((double)Depth * Math.Sin(Math.PI * Angle / 180.0));
			PrimitiveCollection primitiveCollection = new PrimitiveCollection();
			Primitive primitive = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < scene.Count; i++)
			{
				Primitive primitive2 = scene[i];
				if ((primitive2.Caps & PCaps.Skin) <= PCaps.None || (primitive2.Path != null && (primitive2.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") >= 0 || primitive2.Path.IndexOf("Legend") >= 0)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (primitive2 is Box)
				{
					Box box = (Box)primitive2;
					Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(box.rect.X + num, box.rect.Y + num2, box.rect.Width, box.rect.Height);
					Box box2 = new Box(rect);
					box2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
					box2.PE.FillOpacity = box.PE.FillOpacity;
					box2.PE.Fill = Color;
					box2.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
					box2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					if (box.Layer is ChartLayer { Stacked: not false })
					{
						primitiveCollection.Add(box2);
						if (primitive == null)
						{
							primitive = box;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						scene.InsertBefore(box2, box);
						i++;
					}
				}
				else if (primitive2 is Ellipse)
				{
					Ellipse ellipse = (Ellipse)primitive2;
					Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse(new Point(ellipse.p1.X + num, ellipse.p1.Y + num2), new Point(ellipse.p2.X, ellipse.p2.Y));
					ellipse2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
					ellipse2.PE.FillOpacity = ellipse.PE.FillOpacity;
					ellipse2.PE.Fill = Color;
					ellipse2.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
					ellipse2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					ellipse2.PE.Stroke = Color.Transparent;
					scene.InsertBefore(ellipse2, ellipse);
					i++;
				}
				else if (primitive2 is Wedge)
				{
					Wedge wedge = (Wedge)primitive2;
					Wedge wedge2 = new Wedge(new Point(wedge.Center.X + num, wedge.Center.Y + num2), wedge.Radius, wedge.startAngle, wedge.angleSweep);
					wedge2.PE.Stroke = Color.Transparent;
					wedge2.RadiusInner = wedge.RadiusInner;
					wedge2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
					wedge2.PE.FillOpacity = wedge.PE.FillOpacity;
					wedge2.PE.Fill = Color;
					wedge2.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
					wedge2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					scene.InsertBefore(wedge2, wedge);
					i++;
				}
				else if (primitive2 is Polyline)
				{
					Polyline polyline = (Polyline)primitive2;
					DataPoint[] array = new DataPoint[polyline.points.Length];
					for (int j = 0; j < polyline.points.Length; j++)
					{
						if (polyline.points[j] != null)
						{
							array[j] = new DataPoint(polyline.points[j].point);
							array[j].point.X += num;
							array[j].point.Y += num2;
						}
					}
					Polyline polyline2 = new Polyline(array, polyline.lineStyle);
					polyline2.splineTension = polyline.splineTension;
					polyline2.PE.StrokeWidth = polyline.PE.StrokeWidth;
					polyline2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
					polyline2.PE.FillOpacity = polyline.PE.FillOpacity;
					polyline2.PE.Fill = Color;
					polyline2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					scene.InsertBefore(polyline2, polyline);
					i++;
				}
				else if (primitive2 is PointSet)
				{
					PointSet pointSet = (PointSet)primitive2;
					DataPoint[] array2 = new DataPoint[pointSet.points.Length];
					for (int k = 0; k < pointSet.points.Length; k++)
					{
						if (pointSet.points[k] != null)
						{
							array2[k] = new DataPoint(pointSet.points[k].point);
							array2[k].point.X += num;
							array2[k].point.Y += num2;
							array2[k].PE.StrokeOpacity = pointSet.points[k].PE.StrokeOpacity;
							array2[k].PE.Stroke = Color;
							array2[k].PE.StrokeWidth = pointSet.points[k].PE.StrokeWidth;
							array2[k].PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
							array2[k].PE.FillOpacity = pointSet.points[k].PE.FillOpacity;
							array2[k].PE.Fill = Color;
							array2[k].PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
						}
					}
					PointSet pointSet2 = new PointSet(array2, pointSet.icon, pointSet.iconSize);
					pointSet2.PE.Stroke = Color;
					pointSet2.PE.StrokeOpacity = pointSet.PE.StrokeOpacity;
					pointSet2.PE.StrokeWidth = pointSet.PE.StrokeWidth;
					pointSet2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
					pointSet2.PE.FillOpacity = pointSet.PE.FillOpacity;
					pointSet2.PE.Fill = Color;
					pointSet2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					scene.InsertBefore(pointSet2, pointSet);
					i++;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(primitive2 is Polygon))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Polygon polygon = (Polygon)primitive2;
					Polygon polygon2 = null;
					if (polygon.DataPoints != null && polygon.DataPoints.Length > 0)
					{
						DataPoint[] array3 = new DataPoint[polygon.DataPoints.Length];
						for (int l = 0; l < polygon.DataPoints.Length; l++)
						{
							array3[l] = new DataPoint(polygon.DataPoints[l].point);
							array3[l].point.X += num;
							array3[l].point.Y += num2;
							array3[l].PE.StrokeWidth = polygon.DataPoints[l].PE.StrokeWidth;
							array3[l].PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
							array3[l].PE.FillOpacity = polygon.DataPoints[l].PE.FillOpacity;
							array3[l].PE.Fill = Color;
							array3[l].PE.StrokeOpacity = polygon.DataPoints[l].PE.StrokeOpacity;
							array3[l].PE.Stroke = Color;
						}
						polygon2 = new Polygon(array3);
					}
					else if (polygon.Points != null && polygon.Points.Length > 0)
					{
						Point[] array4 = new Point[polygon.Points.Length];
						for (int m = 0; m < polygon.Points.Length; m++)
						{
							ref Point reference = ref array4[m];
							reference = new Point(polygon.Points[m].X + num, polygon.Points[m].Y + num2);
						}
						polygon2 = new Polygon(array4);
					}
					if (polygon2 != null)
					{
						polygon2.splineTension = polygon.splineTension;
						polygon2.flatBottom = polygon.flatBottom;
						polygon2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.SolidFill;
						polygon2.PE.StrokeWidth = 0;
						polygon2.PE.FillOpacity = polygon.PE.FillOpacity;
						polygon2.PE.Fill = Color;
						polygon2.PE.Stroke = Color;
						polygon2.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
						scene.InsertBefore(polygon2, polygon);
						i++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (primitive != null && primitiveCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				scene.InsertBefore(primitiveCollection.ToArray(), primitive);
			}
		}
	}
	public class StrokeEffect : Effect
	{
		private int strokeWidth = 1;

		private Color strokeColor = Color.Black;

		private byte strokeOpacity = byte.MaxValue;

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DefaultValue(1)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_231")]
		public int StrokeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return strokeWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				strokeWidth = value;
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_228")]
		public Color StrokeColor
		{
			get
			{
				return strokeColor;
			}
			set
			{
				strokeColor = value;
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(255)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_230")]
		public byte StrokeOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return strokeOpacity;
			}
			set
			{
				strokeOpacity = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeStrokeColor()
		{
			return StrokeColor != Color.Black;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetStrokeColor()
		{
			StrokeColor = Color.Black;
		}

		public override Effect Clone()
		{
			StrokeEffect strokeEffect = new StrokeEffect();
			strokeEffect.Enabled = Enabled;
			strokeEffect.StrokeColor = StrokeColor;
			strokeEffect.StrokeWidth = StrokeWidth;
			strokeEffect.StrokeOpacity = strokeOpacity;
			return strokeEffect;
		}

		public override void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (scene == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Primitive item in scene)
			{
				if ((item.Caps & PCaps.Skin) > PCaps.None && (item.Path == null || item.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") < 0) && (StrokeWidth != 0 || (!(item is Polyline) && !(item is Line))))
				{
					item.PE = item.PE.Clone();
					item.PE.Stroke = StrokeColor;
					item.PE.StrokeWidth = StrokeWidth;
					item.PE.StrokeOpacity = StrokeOpacity;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TextureEffect : Effect
	{
		private TexturePresets _texture = TexturePresets.LightGrain;

		private Image _customImage;

		private string _customImagePath;

		private EffectApplicationMode _applyTo;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_368")]

		public TextureEffect(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeTexture()
		{
			return Texture != TexturePresets.LightGrain;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetTexture()
		{
			Texture = TexturePresets.LightGrain;
		}

		public override Effect Clone()
		{
			TextureEffect textureEffect = new TextureEffect(Component);
			textureEffect.Enabled = Enabled;
			textureEffect.Texture = Texture;
			if (CustomImage != null)
			{
				textureEffect.CustomImage = CustomImage.Clone() as Image;
			}
			textureEffect.CustomImagePath = CustomImagePath;
			return textureEffect;
		}

		public override void Apply(Bitmap chartImage)
		{
			if (ApplyTo != EffectApplicationMode.ChartImage)
			{
				return;
			}
			GraphicsUnit pageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			RectangleF bounds = chartImage.GetBounds(ref pageUnit);
			int num = (int)bounds.Width;
			int num2 = (int)bounds.Height;
			byte[,] array = TextureValues.Invert(TextureValues.FromPreset(Texture, GetImage() as Bitmap));
			int upperBound = array.GetUpperBound(1);
			int upperBound2 = array.GetUpperBound(0);
			if (upperBound == 0 || upperBound2 == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					Color pixel = chartImage.GetPixel(j, i);
					int num3 = j % upperBound;
					int num4 = i % upperBound2;
					int num5 = array[num4, num3];
					int red = Math.Max(pixel.R - num5, 0);
					int green = Math.Max(pixel.G - num5, 0);
					int blue = Math.Max(pixel.B - num5, 0);
					chartImage.SetPixel(j, i, Color.FromArgb(pixel.A, red, green, blue));
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			if (ApplyTo == EffectApplicationMode.Background)
			{
				foreach (Primitive item in scene)
				{
					if (item.Path == "Border")
					{
						item.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Texture;
						item.PE.Texture = Texture;
						item.PE.TextureApplication = TextureApplicationStyle.Inverted;
						item.PE.FillImage = GetImage();
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (ApplyTo != EffectApplicationMode.Skin)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Primitive item2 in scene)
			{
				if ((item2.Caps & PCaps.Skin) > PCaps.None && (item2.Path == null || item2.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") < 0))
				{
					item2.PE.ElementType = PaintElementType.Texture;
					item2.PE.Texture = Texture;
					item2.PE.TextureApplication = TextureApplicationStyle.Inverted;
					item2.PE.FillImage = GetImage();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeApplyTo()
		{
			return ApplyTo != EffectApplicationMode.Background;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetApplyTo()
		{
			ApplyTo = EffectApplicationMode.Background;
		}

		private Image GetImage()
		{
			if (CustomImage != null)
			{
				return CustomImage;
			}
			if (CustomImagePath != null && CustomImagePath.Length > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					return Image.FromFile(_customImagePath);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex)
				{
					if (ex.TargetSite != null && ex.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_373"));
					}
					throw ex;
				}
				catch (OutOfMemoryException ex2)
				{
					if (ex2.TargetSite != null && ex2.TargetSite.DeclaringType == typeof(Image))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("SR_373"));
					}
					throw ex2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ThreeDEffect : Effect
	{
		public ThreeDEffect(IChartComponent component)
			: base(component)
		{
		}

		public ThreeDEffect()
		{
		}

		public override Effect Clone()
		{
			ThreeDEffect threeDEffect = new ThreeDEffect(Component);
			threeDEffect.Enabled = Enabled;
			return threeDEffect;
		}

		public override void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < scene.Count; i++)
			{
				Primitive primitive = scene[i];
				if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.Skin) > PCaps.None && (primitive.Path == null || (primitive.Path.IndexOf("Legend") < 0 && primitive.Path.IndexOf("ScrollBar") < 0)) && primitive is Box)
				{
					Box box = (Box)primitive;
					Polygon polygon = new Polygon(new Point[6]
					{
						new Point(box.rect.X, box.rect.Y),
						new Point(box.rect.X + 5, box.rect.Y - 5),
						new Point(box.rect.X + 5 + box.rect.Width, box.rect.Y - 5),
						new Point(box.rect.X + 5 + box.rect.Width, box.rect.Y - 5 + box.rect.Height),
						new Point(box.rect.X + box.rect.Width, box.rect.Y + box.rect.Height),
						new Point(box.rect.X + box.rect.Width, box.rect.Y)
					});
					polygon.PE.Fill = box.GetBaseColor();
					polygon.PE.FillOpacity = box.PE.FillOpacity;
					polygon.PE.Stroke = Color.Transparent;
					polygon.PE.StrokeOpacity = 0;
					polygon.Row = box.Row;
					polygon.Column = box.Column;
					polygon.Caps = PCaps.Skin;
					polygon.Chart = box.Chart;
					scene.InsertBefore(polygon, box);
					i++;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public static Color DarkenColor(Color color, double percent)
		{
			int num = (int)((double)(int)color.R - (double)(int)color.R * percent);
			int num2 = (int)((double)(int)color.G - (double)(int)color.G * percent);
			int num3 = (int)((double)(int)color.B - (double)(int)color.B * percent);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num > 255)
			{
				num = 255;
			}
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			if (num2 > 255)
			{
				num2 = 255;
			}
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			if (num3 > 255)
			{
				num3 = 255;
			}
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, num, num2, num3);
		}

		public static Color LightenColor(Color color, double percent)

			int num = (int)((double)(int)color.R + (double)(int)color.R * percent);

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderDateTime(DateTime[] orderParam)
		{
			return GetSortedOrderDateTime(orderParam, 0, orderParam.Length - 1);
		}

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderDateTime(DateTime[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int[] array = new int[orderParam.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = i;
			}
			RecursiveSortDateTime(array, orderParam, left, right);
			return array;
		}

		public static void RecursiveSortDateTime(int[] indexer, DateTime[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int num = left;
			int num2 = right;
			DateTime dateTime = orderParam[indexer[(left + right) / 2]];
			while (true)
			{
				if (((IComparable)orderParam[indexer[num]]).CompareTo((object)dateTime) > 0 && num < right)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				while (((IComparable)dateTime).CompareTo((object)orderParam[indexer[num2]]) > 0 && num2 > left)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					int num3 = indexer[num];
					indexer[num] = indexer[num2];
					indexer[num2] = num3;
					num++;
					num2--;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (left < num2)
			{
				RecursiveSortDateTime(indexer, orderParam, left, num2);
			}
			if (num < right)
			{
				RecursiveSortDateTime(indexer, orderParam, num, right);
			}
		}

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderDouble(double[] orderParam)
		{
			return GetSortedOrderDouble(orderParam, 0, orderParam.Length - 1);
		}

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderDouble(double[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int[] array = new int[orderParam.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = i;
			}
			RecursiveSortDouble(array, orderParam, left, right);
			return array;
		}

		public static void RecursiveSortDouble(int[] indexer, double[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int num = left;
			int num2 = right;
			double num3 = orderParam[indexer[(left + right) / 2]];
			while (true)
			{
				if (orderParam[indexer[num]] > num3 && num < right)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				while (num3 > orderParam[indexer[num2]] && num2 > left)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					int num4 = indexer[num];
					indexer[num] = indexer[num2];
					indexer[num2] = num4;
					num++;
					num2--;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (left < num2)
			{
				RecursiveSortDouble(indexer, orderParam, left, num2);
			}
			if (num < right)
			{
				RecursiveSortDouble(indexer, orderParam, num, right);
			}
		}

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderFloat(float[] orderParam)
		{
			return GetSortedOrderFloat(orderParam, 0, orderParam.Length - 1);
		}

		public static int[] GetSortedOrderFloat(float[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int[] array = new int[orderParam.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = i;
			}
			RecursiveSortFloat(array, orderParam, left, right);
			return array;
		}

		public static void RecursiveSortFloat(int[] indexer, float[] orderParam, int left, int right)
		{
			int num = left;
			int num2 = right;
			float num3 = orderParam[indexer[(left + right) / 2]];
			while (true)
			{
				if (orderParam[indexer[num]] > num3 && num < right)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				while (num3 > orderParam[indexer[num2]] && num2 > left)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					int num4 = indexer[num];
					indexer[num] = indexer[num2];
					indexer[num2] = num4;
					num++;
					num2--;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (left < num2)
			{
				RecursiveSortFloat(indexer, orderParam, left, num2);
			}
			if (num < right)
			{
				RecursiveSortFloat(indexer, orderParam, num, right);
			}
		}

namespace Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Appearance

	[TypeConverter(typeof(ChartCollectionObjectConverter))]
	public class Override : ICloneable
	{
		private PaintElement _pE = new PaintElement();

		private int _row = -1;

		private int _column = -1;

		private bool _enabled = true;

		[TypeConverter(typeof(PaintElementConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.InnerProperty)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_358")]
		public PaintElement PE
		{
			get
			{
				return _pE;
			}
			set
			{
				_pE = value;
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_359")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				return _row;
			}
			set
			{
				_row = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_360")]
		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return _column;
			}
			set
			{
				_column = value;
			}
		}

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_361")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_enabled = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePE()
		{
			return PE.ShouldSerialize();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetPE()
		{
			PE.ResetAll();
		}

		internal void Apply(SceneGraph scene)
		{
			foreach (Primitive item in scene)
			{
				if (Match(item))
				{
					if (item.Path != null && item.Path.IndexOf("Legend") >= 0)
					{
						if (item is Text)
						{
							continue;
						}
						PaintElement pE = item.PE;
						item.PE = PE.Clone();
						item.PE.StrokeWidth = pE.StrokeWidth;
					}
					else
					{
						item.PE = PE;
					}
				}
				DataPoint[] array = null;
				if (item is PointSet)
				{
					array = ((PointSet)item).points;
				}
				else if (item is Polyline)
				{
					array = ((Polyline)item).points;
				}
				if (array == null || array.Length <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				DataPoint[] array2 = array;
				foreach (DataPoint dataPoint in array2)
				{
					if (Match(dataPoint))
					{
						dataPoint.PE = PE;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					item.PE = PE;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool Match(Primitive primitive)
		{
			if (primitive != null && Row != -1 && Column != -1 && primitive.Row != -1 && primitive.Column != -1 && (Row == primitive.Row || Row == -2 || primitive.Row == -2) && (Column == primitive.Column || Column == -2 || primitive.Column == -2))
			{
				return primitive.Chart != ChartType.CandleChart;
			}
			return false;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public Override Clone()
		{
			Override obj = new Override();
			obj.Row = Row;
			obj.Column = Column;
			obj.PE = PE;
			obj.Enabled = Enabled;
			return obj;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Override {" + Row + "," + Column + "}";
		}
	}

	public class OverrideCollection : CollectionBase, IChartCollection, IProvideChartComponent, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable

			set

				Component = value;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _component;
			}
			set
			{
				_component = value;
			}
		}

		public Override this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Override)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public OverrideCollection(IChartComponent component)
		{
			Component = component;
		}

		public int Add(Override ov)
		{
			int result = base.List.Add(ov);
			if (Component != null)
			{
				Component.Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Remove(Override ov)
		{
			base.List.Remove(ov);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Override ov)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, ov);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public OverrideCollection Clone()
		{
			OverrideCollection overrideCollection = new OverrideCollection(Component);
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Override obj = (Override)enumerator.Current;
					Override obj2 = obj;
					if (obj2 != null)
					{
						overrideCollection.Add(obj2.Clone());
					}
					else
					{
						overrideCollection.Add(obj);
					}
				}
				return overrideCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public class LabelStyle : AppearanceHelper, ICloneable, IDisposable
	{
		private Font fontStyle = DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;

		private Color fontColor = Color.Empty;

		private bool wrapText;

		private bool clipText = true;

		private bool fontSizeBestFit;

		private StringAlignment horizontalAlign;

		private StringAlignment verticalAlign = StringAlignment.Center;

		private TextOrientation orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;

		private int rotationAngle;

		private StringTrimming _Trimming;

		private bool _ReverseText;

		private bool flip;

		private int dx;

		private int dy;

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_344")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return fontStyle;
			}
			set

				fontStyle = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_345")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public Color FontColor
		{
			get
			{
				return fontColor;
			}
			set
			{
				fontColor = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		internal Color FontColorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(fontColor != Color.Empty))
				{
					return DefaultConstants.D_TextColor;
				}
				return fontColor;
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_346")]
		public bool WrapText
		{
			get
			{
				return wrapText;
			}
			set
			{
				wrapText = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_347")]
		public StringAlignment HorizontalAlign
		{
			get
			{
				return horizontalAlign;
			}
			set
			{
				horizontalAlign = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_348")]
		public StringAlignment VerticalAlign
		{
			get
			{
				return verticalAlign;
			}
			set
			{
				verticalAlign = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_349")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public bool ClipText
		{
			get
			{
				return clipText;
			}
			set
			{
				clipText = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20062_21")]
		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]

		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(StringTrimming.None)]
		public virtual StringTrimming Trimming
		{
			get

				return _Trimming;

		[PersistenceMode(PersistenceMode.Attribute)]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_20062_17")]
		public virtual bool ReverseText
		{
			get
			{
				return _ReverseText;
			}
			set
			{
				_ReverseText = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_350")]

				return fontSizeBestFit;

				flip = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();

			}

				dx = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_355")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		public int Dy
		{
			get
			{
				return dy;
			}
			set
			{
				dy = value;
				UpdateParentProperty();
			}
		}

		internal int ActualRotationAngle()
		{
			return Orientation switch
			{
				TextOrientation.VerticalLeftFacing => -90, 
				TextOrientation.VerticalRightFacing => 90, 
				TextOrientation.Custom => RotationAngle, 
				_ => 0, 
			};
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			Font = null;
		}

		public LabelStyle()
		{
		}

		public LabelStyle(Font font, Color color, bool wrap, bool clip, bool bestFit, StringAlignment h, StringAlignment v, TextOrientation orient)
		{
			fontStyle = font;
			fontColor = color;
			clipText = clip;
			fontSizeBestFit = bestFit;
			horizontalAlign = h;
			verticalAlign = v;
			orientation = orient;
			WrapText = wrap;
		}

		public LabelStyle Copy()
		{
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle(fontStyle, fontColor, wrapText, clipText, fontSizeBestFit, horizontalAlign, verticalAlign, orientation);
			labelStyle.rotationAngle = rotationAngle;
			labelStyle.flip = flip;
			labelStyle.dx = dx;
			labelStyle.dy = dy;
			labelStyle.WrapText = WrapText;
			labelStyle.Trimming = Trimming;
			labelStyle.ReverseText = ReverseText;
			return labelStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeFont()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				return Font != DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle.Font;
			}
			return Font != DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFont()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				Font = DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle.Font;
			}
			else
			{
				Font = DefaultConstants.D_TextFont;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeFontColor()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				return FontColor != DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle.FontColor;
			}
			return FontColor != Color.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetFontColor()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public LabelStyle Clone()
		{
			LabelStyle labelStyle = new LabelStyle();
			labelStyle.ClipText = ClipText;
			labelStyle.Dx = Dx;
			labelStyle.Dy = Dy;
			labelStyle.Flip = Flip;
			if (Font != null)
			{
				labelStyle.Font = Font.Clone() as Font;
			}
			labelStyle.FontColor = FontColor;
			labelStyle.FontSizeBestFit = FontSizeBestFit;
			labelStyle.HorizontalAlign = HorizontalAlign;
			labelStyle.Orientation = Orientation;
			labelStyle.RotationAngle = RotationAngle;
			labelStyle.VerticalAlign = VerticalAlign;
			labelStyle.WrapText = WrapText;
			labelStyle.Trimming = Trimming;
			labelStyle.ReverseText = ReverseText;
			return labelStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				return !Match(DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle);
			}
			if (!ShouldSerializeTrimming() && !ShouldSerializeReverseText() && !ShouldSerializeClipText() && !ShouldSerializeDx() && !ShouldSerializeDy() && !ShouldSerializeFlip() && !ShouldSerializeFont() && !ShouldSerializeFontColor() && !ShouldSerializeFontSizeBestFit() && !ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlign() && !ShouldSerializeOrientation() && !ShouldSerializeRotationAngle() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalAlign())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeWrapText();
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			if (parentAppearance is GanttChartAppearance)
			{
				DefaultConstants.D_GanttChartOwnersLabelStyle.CopyTo(this);
				return;
			}
			ResetClipText();
			ResetDx();
			ResetDy();
			ResetFlip();
			ResetFont();
			ResetFontColor();
			ResetFontSizeBestFit();
			ResetHorizontalAlign();
			ResetOrientation();
			ResetRotationAngle();
			ResetVerticalAlign();
			ResetWrapText();
			ResetTrimming();
			ResetReverseText();
		}

		public bool Match(LabelStyle styleB)
		{
			if (styleB != null)
			{
				if (Trimming == styleB.Trimming && ReverseText == styleB.ReverseText && ClipText == styleB.ClipText && Dx == styleB.Dx && Dy == styleB.Dy && Flip == styleB.Flip && Font == styleB.Font && FontColor == styleB.FontColor && FontSizeBestFit == styleB.FontSizeBestFit && HorizontalAlign == styleB.HorizontalAlign && Orientation == styleB.Orientation && RotationAngle == styleB.RotationAngle && VerticalAlign == styleB.VerticalAlign)
				{
					return WrapText == styleB.WrapText;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyTo(LabelStyle destination)
		{
			if (destination == null)
			{
				destination = new LabelStyle();
			}
			destination.ClipText = ClipText;
			destination.Dx = Dx;
			destination.Dy = Dy;
			destination.Flip = Flip;
			destination.Font = Font;
			destination.FontColor = FontColor;
			destination.FontSizeBestFit = FontSizeBestFit;
			destination.HorizontalAlign = HorizontalAlign;
			destination.Orientation = Orientation;
			destination.RotationAngle = RotationAngle;
			destination.VerticalAlign = VerticalAlign;
			destination.WrapText = WrapText;
			destination.ReverseText = ReverseText;
			destination.Trimming = Trimming;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public class LineStyle : AppearanceHelper, ICloneable
	{
		private LineCapStyle startStyle;

		private LineCapStyle endStyle;

		private LineDrawStyle drawStyle;

		private bool midPointAnchors;

		[DefaultValue(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor)]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[LocalizedDescription("SR_340")]
		public LineCapStyle StartStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return startStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				startStyle = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_341")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(LineCapStyle.NoAnchor)]
		public LineCapStyle EndStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return endStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				endStyle = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_342")]
		[Editor("Infragistics.UltraChart.Resources.Editor.LineStyleEditor, Infragistics4.Win.UltraChart.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(LineDrawStyle.Solid)]
		public LineDrawStyle DrawStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return drawStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				drawStyle = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		[LocalizedDescription("SR_343")]
		[NotifyParentProperty(true)]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool MidPointAnchors
		{
			get
			{
				return midPointAnchors;
			}
			set
			{
				midPointAnchors = value;
				UpdateAll(resize: false, invalidate: true);
			}
		}

		public LineStyle()
		{
		}

		public LineStyle(ChartAppearance parent, string propertyName, IChartComponent component)
			: base(parent, propertyName, component)
		{
		}

		public LineStyle(LineStyle copy)
		{
			startStyle = copy.startStyle;
			endStyle = copy.endStyle;
			drawStyle = copy.drawStyle;
			midPointAnchors = copy.midPointAnchors;
		}

		public LineStyle(LineCapStyle startStyle, LineCapStyle endStyle, LineDrawStyle drawStyle)
		{
			this.startStyle = startStyle;
			this.endStyle = endStyle;
			this.drawStyle = drawStyle;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetStartStyle()
		{
			StartStyle = LineCapStyle.NoAnchor;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ResetEndStyle()
		{
			EndStyle = LineCapStyle.NoAnchor;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void ResetDrawStyle()
		{
			DrawStyle = LineDrawStyle.Solid;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void ResetMidPointAnchors()
		{
			MidPointAnchors = false;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public LineStyle Clone()
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = new LineStyle();
			lineStyle.DrawStyle = DrawStyle;
			lineStyle.EndStyle = EndStyle;
			lineStyle.MidPointAnchors = MidPointAnchors;
			lineStyle.StartStyle = StartStyle;
			return lineStyle;
		}

		public bool Match(LineStyle styleB)
		{
			if (styleB != null)
			{
				if (DrawStyle == styleB.DrawStyle && EndStyle == styleB.EndStyle && MidPointAnchors == styleB.MidPointAnchors)
				{
					return StartStyle == styleB.StartStyle;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return !Match(new LineStyle());
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetDrawStyle();
			ResetEndStyle();
			ResetMidPointAnchors();
			ResetStartStyle();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "LineStyle (" + DrawStyle.ToString() + ")";
		}
	}

	public class Margins
	{
		private int top;

		private int left;

		private int right;

		private int bottom;

		public int Top
		{
			get
			{
				return top;
			}
			set
			{
				top = value;
			}
		}

		public int Left
		{
			get
			{
				return left;
			}
			set
			{
				left = value;
			}
		}

		public int Right
		{
			get
			{
				return right;
			}
			set
			{
				right = value;
			}
		}

		public int Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins()
		{
		}

		public Margins(int top, int left, int right, int bottom)
		{
			this.top = top;
			this.left = left;
			this.right = right;
			this.bottom = bottom;
		}

		public Margins(Margins m)
		{
			top = m.Top;
			left = m.Left;
			right = m.Right;
			bottom = m.Bottom;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object o)
		{
			Margins margins = (Margins)o;
			if (margins.Top == Top && margins.Left == Left && margins.Right == Right && margins.Bottom == Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ToString().GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	{
		private Rectangle mSourceRect;

		private Rectangle mDestinationRect;

		private Bitmap mImage;

		private string mId;

		private SkinTile mTile;

		public SkinTile Tile
		{
			get
			{
				return mTile;
			}
			set
			{
				mTile = value;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle SourceRect
		{
			get
			{
				return mSourceRect;
			}
			set
			{
				mSourceRect = value;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle DestinationRect
		{
			get
			{
				return mDestinationRect;
			}
			set
			{
				mDestinationRect = value;
			}
		}

		public Bitmap Image => mImage;

		public string Id
		{
			get
			{
				return mId;
			}
			set
			{
				mId = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			if (mImage != null)
			{
				mImage.Dispose();
				mImage = null;
			}
		}

		public SkinElement(string mId, Rectangle mSourceRect)
		{
			this.mSourceRect = mSourceRect;
			this.mId = mId;
		}

		public SkinElement(string mId, Rectangle mSourceRect, SkinTile mTile)
		{
			this.mSourceRect = mSourceRect;
			this.mId = mId;
			this.mTile = mTile;
		}

		public void Load(Image sourceImage, int offsetX, int offsetY)
		{
			mImage = new Bitmap(mSourceRect.Width, mSourceRect.Height);
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(mImage);
			graphics.DrawImage(sourceImage, new Rectangle(0, 0, mSourceRect.Width, mSourceRect.Height), mSourceRect.X + offsetX, mSourceRect.Y + offsetY, mSourceRect.Width, mSourceRect.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
			graphics.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public abstract class ASkin
	{
		private SkinElement[] mElements;

		public SkinElement[] Elements
		{
			get
			{
				return mElements;
			}
			set
			{
				mElements = value;
			}
		}

		public string[] Keys
		{
			get
			{
				string[] array = null;
				if (mElements != null && mElements.Length > 0)
				{
					array = new string[mElements.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < mElements.Length; i++)
					{
						if (mElements[i] != null)
						{
							array[i] = mElements[i].Id;
						}
					}
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public SkinElement this[string Id]
		{
			get
			{
				SkinElement result = null;
				if (mElements != null && mElements.Length > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < mElements.Length; i++)
					{
						if (mElements[i].Id.Equals(Id))
						{
							result = mElements[i];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public void LoadSkin(Image bmp)
		{
			LoadSkin(bmp, 0, 0);
		}

		public void LoadSkin(Image bmp, int offsetX, int offsetY)
		{
			if (mElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < mElements.Length; i++)
			{
				if (mElements[i] != null)
				{
					mElements[i].Load(bmp, offsetX, offsetY);
				}
			}
		}

		public void MakeTransparent(Color transparent)
		{
			if (mElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < mElements.Length; i++)
			{
				if (mElements[i] != null)
				{
					mElements[i].Image.MakeTransparent(transparent);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarSkin : ASkin
	{
		public ScrollBarSkin(Bitmap bmp)
		{
			base.Elements = new SkinElement[30];
			string[] array = new string[10] { "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "scroll_v", "scroll_h", "back_v", "back_h", "plus", "minus" };
			string[] array2 = new string[3] { "", "over", "down" };
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					base.Elements[i * array.Length + j] = new SkinElement(array[j] + "_" + array2[i], new Rectangle(i * 24, j * 24, 24, 24));
				}
			}
			LoadSkin(bmp);
		}
	}
	public class PinSkin : ASkin
	{
		public PinSkin(Bitmap bmp)
		{
			base.Elements = new SkinElement[4]
			{
				new SkinElement("A", new Rectangle(0, 0, 32, 32)),
				new SkinElement("B", new Rectangle(32, 0, 32, 32)),
				new SkinElement("C", new Rectangle(64, 0, 32, 32)),
				new SkinElement("D", new Rectangle(96, 0, 32, 32))
			};
			LoadSkin(bmp);
		}
	}
	public class TileSkin : ASkin
	{
		public TileSkin(Bitmap bmp, Size sz, Size rocol)
			: this(bmp, sz, rocol, Size.Empty, Size.Empty)
		{
		}

		public TileSkin(Bitmap bmp, Size sz, Size rocol, Size interTileSpacing, Size topLeftOffset)
		{
			base.Elements = new SkinElement[rocol.Width * rocol.Height];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < rocol.Width; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < rocol.Height; j++)
				{
					num = i * rocol.Height + j;
					int x = topLeftOffset.Width + (i * sz.Width + i * interTileSpacing.Width);
					int y = topLeftOffset.Height + (j * sz.Height + j * interTileSpacing.Height);
					base.Elements[num] = new SkinElement("I" + num, new Rectangle(x, y, sz.Width, sz.Height));
				}
			}
			LoadSkin(bmp);
		}
	}
