		private TextureValues()
		{
		}

		internal static byte[,] Invert(byte[,] textureMap)
		{
			int upperBound = textureMap.GetUpperBound(0);
			int upperBound2 = textureMap.GetUpperBound(1);
			byte[,] array = new byte[upperBound + 1, upperBound2 + 1];
			byte b = byte.MaxValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < upperBound2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < upperBound; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = (byte)(255 - textureMap[j, i]);
					if (array[j, i] < b)
					{
						b = array[j, i];
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < upperBound2; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < upperBound; l++)
				{
					array[l, k] -= b;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static byte[,] FromPreset(TexturePresets preset, Bitmap customImage)
		{
			if (preset == TexturePresets.CustomImage && customImage != null)
			{
				return FromImage(customImage);
			}
			return FromPreset(preset);
		}

		internal static byte[,] FromPreset(TexturePresets preset)
		{
			return preset switch
			{
				TexturePresets.Arrow => Arrow, 
				TexturePresets.Bars => Bars, 
				TexturePresets.Blocks => Blocks, 
				TexturePresets.Boxes => Boxes, 
				TexturePresets.Button => Button, 
				TexturePresets.Canvas => Canvas, 
				TexturePresets.Carpet => Carpet, 
				TexturePresets.Circle => Circle, 
				TexturePresets.Cloud => Cloud, 
				TexturePresets.Crackle => Crackle, 
				TexturePresets.CrownJewels => CrownJewels, 
				TexturePresets.DarkGrain => DarkGrain, 
				TexturePresets.Diamonds => Diamonds, 
				TexturePresets.Eye => Eye, 
				TexturePresets.FabricA => FabricA, 
				TexturePresets.FabricB => FabricB, 
				TexturePresets.GrainA => GrainA, 
				TexturePresets.GrainB => GrainB, 
				TexturePresets.GrainC => GrainC, 
				TexturePresets.Grate => Grate, 
				TexturePresets.Horizontal => Horizontal, 
				TexturePresets.LightGrain => LightGrain, 
				TexturePresets.MetalCurtains => MetalCurtains, 
				TexturePresets.MoltenRock => MoltenRock, 
				TexturePresets.Needles => Needles, 
				TexturePresets.Nubs => Nubs, 
				TexturePresets.PaperTowel => PaperTowel, 
				TexturePresets.Rings => Rings, 
				TexturePresets.Speckle => Speckle, 
				TexturePresets.Staples => Staples, 
				TexturePresets.TVStatic => TvStatic, 
				TexturePresets.TreeRoots => TreeRoots, 
				TexturePresets.TwirlA => TwirlA, 
				TexturePresets.TwirlB => TwirlB, 
				TexturePresets.Vague => Vague, 
				TexturePresets.Vertical => Vertical, 
				TexturePresets.Weave => Weave, 
				TexturePresets.Wood => Wood, 
				_ => new byte[1, 1], 
			};
		}

		internal static byte[,] FromImage(Bitmap textureBmp)
		{
			if (textureBmp == null)
			{
				return new byte[1, 1];
			}
			int num = 255;
			GraphicsUnit pageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			RectangleF bounds = textureBmp.GetBounds(ref pageUnit);
			int num2 = (int)bounds.Width;
			int num3 = (int)bounds.Height;
			byte[,] array = new byte[num3, num2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
				{
					Color pixel = textureBmp.GetPixel(i, j);
					int num4 = (pixel.R + pixel.G + pixel.B) / 3;
					if (num4 < num)
					{
						num = num4;
					}
					array[j, i] = (byte)num4;
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < num3; l++)
				{
					array[l, k] = (byte)(array[l, k] - num);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

		internal static DateTime ValidDateTime(long ticks)
		{
			return new DateTime(Math.Min(Math.Max(DateTime.MinValue.Ticks, ticks), DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks));
		}

		public static void DemoSetup(IChartComponent component)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("SR_245"));
			}
			Assembly assembly = typeof(Util).Assembly;
			string text = "";
			text = ((assembly.FullName.IndexOf("UltraWebChart") < 0) ? "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart" : "Infragistics.WebUI.UltraWebChart");
			string name = text + ".ChartCore.Resources.DemoStyle.xml";
			Stream manifestResourceStream = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			XmlPersist.UnPersist(component, new StreamReader(manifestResourceStream));
			ChartType chartType = (ChartType)component.GetProperty("ChartType");
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Monthly Expense");
			dataTable.Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			dataTable.Columns.AddRange(new DataColumn[5]
			{
				new DataColumn("Clothes", typeof(double)),
				new DataColumn("Food", typeof(double)),
				new DataColumn("Travel", typeof(double)),
				new DataColumn("Other", typeof(double)),
				new DataColumn("Name", typeof(string))
			});
			dataTable.Rows.Add(100.0, 150.0, 320.0, 52.0, "Andy ");
			dataTable.Rows.Add(52.0, 200.0, 250.0, 90.0, "Alice ");
			dataTable.Rows.Add(5.0, 130.0, 200.0, 22.0, "Arnold ");
			dataTable.Rows.Add(19.0, 225.0, 150.0, 45.0, "Bob ");
			dataTable.Rows.Add(134.0, 156.0, 45.0, 92.0, "Charlie ");
			dataTable.Rows.Add(400.0, 300.0, 100.0, 50.0, "Davis ");
			if (chartType == ChartType.CandleChart || chartType == ChartType.StepAreaChart || chartType == ChartType.StepLineChart)
			{
				component.SetProperty("Data.DataSource", DemoTable.Table(1));
			}
			else
			{
				component.SetProperty("Data.DataSource", dataTable);
			}
			Color[] array = new Color[6]
			{
				Color.Red,
				Color.Green,
				Color.Yellow,
				Color.Blue,
				Color.Magenta,
				Color.Purple
			};
			component.SetProperty("ColorModel.CustomPalette", array);
			PaintElement[] array2 = new PaintElement[array.Length];
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.ColumnChart:
			case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = new PaintElement(array[j], Color.White, GradientStyle.HorizontalBump);
					array2[j].ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				}
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomSkin);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.ColumnLineChart:
			{
				for (int m = 0; m < array2.Length; m++)
				{
					array2[m] = new PaintElement(array[m], Color.White, GradientStyle.HorizontalBump);
					array2[m].ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
					array2[m].StrokeWidth = 2;
				}
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomSkin);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.BarChart:
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
				{
					array2[k] = new PaintElement(array[k], Color.White, GradientStyle.VerticalBump);
					array2[k].ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				}
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomSkin);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < array2.Length; l++)
				{
					array2[l] = new PaintElement(Color.White, array[l], GradientStyle.Circular);
					array2[l].ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				}
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomSkin);
				break;
			}
			case ChartType.DoughnutChart:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = new PaintElement(Color.White, array[i], GradientStyle.ForwardDiagonal);
					array2[i].ElementType = PaintElementType.Gradient;
				}
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomSkin);
				break;
			}
			default:
				array2 = null;
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.ModelStyle", ColorModels.CustomLinear);
				break;
			}
			if (component.GetProperty("ColorModel.Skin.PEs") is PaintElementCollection paintElementCollection)
			{
				paintElementCollection.Clear();
				paintElementCollection.AddRange(array2);
			}
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
			case ChartType.StackColumnChart:
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.Skin.ApplyRowWise", false);
				break;
			default:
				component.SetProperty("ColorModel.Skin.ApplyRowWise", true);
				break;
			}
			switch (chartType)
			{
			case ChartType.BarChart:
			case ChartType.BubbleChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.StackBarChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterLineChart:
			case ChartType.ProbabilityChart:
				component.SetProperty("Axis.X.Labels.ItemFormatString", "<DATA_VALUE:00.##>");
				break;
			case ChartType.CandleChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
				component.SetProperty("Axis.X.Labels.ItemFormatString", "<ITEM_LABEL:d>");
				break;
			case ChartType.RadarChart:
				component.SetProperty("Data.SwapRowsAndColumns", true);
				component.SetProperty("RadarChart.SplineTension", 0.4f);
				break;
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
				component.SetProperty("SplineChart.SplineTension", 0.3f);
				component.SetProperty("SplineAreaChart.SplineTension", 0.3f);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

			"Data", "DoughnutChart", "HeatMapChart", "HeatMapChart3D", "Legend", "LineChart", "PieChart", "PieChart3D", "RadarChart", "ScatterChart",
			"Skin", "SplineAreaChart", "SplineChart", "StackChart", "TitleBottom", "TitleLeft", "TitleRight", "TitleTop", "Tooltips", "Transform3D"
		};

		internal static FontConverter FC
		{
			get
			{
				return fc;
			}
			set
			{
				fc = value;
			}
		}

		private XmlPersist()
		{
		}

		public static void XmlElementToAppearance(IChartComponent component, XmlTextReader tr, string elementName, object appearance)
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat;
			string fullName = appearance.GetType().FullName;
			if (tr.HasAttributes)
			{
				string text = "";
				if (fullName.IndexOf("View3DAppearance") > -1)
				{
					View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)appearance;
					text = tr.GetAttribute("XRotation");
					if (text != null)
					{
						view3DAppearance.XRotation = float.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("YRotation");
					if (text != null)
					{
						view3DAppearance.YRotation = float.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("ZRotation");
					if (text != null)
					{
						view3DAppearance.ZRotation = float.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("Scale");
					if (text != null)
					{
						view3DAppearance.Scale = float.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
				}
				else if (fullName.IndexOf("BorderAppearance") > -1)
				{
					BorderAppearance borderAppearance = (BorderAppearance)appearance;

					{
						borderAppearance.Thickness = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("DrawStyle");

					{
						borderAppearance.DrawStyle = (LineDrawStyle)Enum.Parse(typeof(LineDrawStyle), text, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("Color");

						{
							borderAppearance.Color = color;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (fullName.IndexOf("LegendAppearance") > -1)
				{

					{

						legendAppearance.Location = (LegendLocation)Enum.Parse(typeof(LegendLocation), text, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("SpanPercentage");

					{
						legendAppearance.SpanPercentage = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);

							legendAppearance.Font = font;

						{
							legendAppearance.FontColor = fontColor;

						if (!backgroundColor.Equals(Color.Empty))
						{
							legendAppearance.BackgroundColor = backgroundColor;
						}
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("BorderThickness");
					if (text != null)
					{
						legendAppearance.BorderThickness = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("BorderColor");
					if (text != null)
					{
						Color borderColor = ConvertColor(text);
						if (!borderColor.Equals(Color.Empty))
						{
							legendAppearance.BorderColor = borderColor;
						}
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("BorderStyle");
					if (text != null)
					{
						legendAppearance.BorderStyle = (LineDrawStyle)Enum.Parse(typeof(LineDrawStyle), text, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("AlphaLevel");
					if (text != null)
					{
						legendAppearance.AlphaLevel = byte.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("FormatString");
					if (text != null)
					{
						legendAppearance.FormatString = ltgtit(text);
					}
					GotoNextElement(tr);
					XmlElementToAppearance(component, tr, "Margins", legendAppearance.Margins);
				}
				else if (fullName.IndexOf("MarginsAppearance") > -1)
				{
					MarginsAppearance marginsAppearance = (MarginsAppearance)appearance;
					text = tr.GetAttribute("Top");
					if (text != null)
					{
						marginsAppearance.Top = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);
					}
					text = tr.GetAttribute("Bottom");
					if (text != null)
					{
						marginsAppearance.Bottom = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);

						marginsAppearance.Right = int.Parse(text, numberFormat);

					XmlElementToAppearance(component, tr, "Y2", chartGridAppearance.Y2);

				else if (fullName.IndexOf("AxisAppearance") > -1)
				{

					text = tr.GetAttribute("LineThickness");

					}

					if (text != null)

		private static string ltgtit(string input)
		{
			string text = input.Replace("&lt;", "<");
			return text.Replace("&gt;", ">");
		}

		private static Color ConvertColor(string input)
		{
			Color result = Color.Empty;
			if (Regex.IsMatch(input, "Color \\[(\\w+)]"))
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection = Regex.Matches(input, "Color \\[(\\w+)]");
				result = Color.FromName(matchCollection[0].Groups[1].Value);
			}
			else if (Regex.IsMatch(input, "Color \\[A=(\\d+), R=(\\d+), G=(\\d+), B=(\\d+)\\]"))
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection2 = Regex.Matches(input, "Color \\[A=(\\d+), R=(\\d+), G=(\\d+), B=(\\d+)\\]");
				int alpha = int.Parse(matchCollection2[0].Groups[1].Value);
				int red = int.Parse(matchCollection2[0].Groups[2].Value);
				int green = int.Parse(matchCollection2[0].Groups[3].Value);
				int blue = int.Parse(matchCollection2[0].Groups[4].Value);
				result = Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
			}
			else if (Regex.IsMatch(input, "Color \\[R=(\\d+), G=(\\d+), B=(\\d+)\\]"))
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection3 = Regex.Matches(input, "Color \\[R=(\\d+), G=(\\d+), B=(\\d+)\\]");
				int red2 = int.Parse(matchCollection3[0].Groups[1].Value);
				int green2 = int.Parse(matchCollection3[0].Groups[2].Value);
				int blue2 = int.Parse(matchCollection3[0].Groups[3].Value);
				result = Color.FromArgb(red2, green2, blue2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Point ConvertPoint(string input)
		{
			Point result = Point.Empty;
			if (Regex.IsMatch(input, "\\{X=(\\d+),\\s*Y=(\\d+)\\}"))
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection = Regex.Matches(input, "\\{X=(\\d+),\\s*Y=(\\d+)\\}");
				result = new Point(int.Parse(matchCollection[0].Groups[1].Value), int.Parse(matchCollection[0].Groups[2].Value));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Size ConvertSize(string input)
		{
			Size result = Size.Empty;
			if (Regex.IsMatch(input, "\\{Width=(\\d+),\\s*Height=(\\d+)\\}"))
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection = Regex.Matches(input, "\\{Width=(\\d+),\\s*Height=(\\d+)\\}");
				result = new Size(int.Parse(matchCollection[0].Groups[1].Value), int.Parse(matchCollection[0].Groups[2].Value));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Font ConvertFontWin(string input)
		{
			Font font = null;
			return (Font)fc.ConvertFromInvariantString(input);
		}

		public static XmlElement AppearanceToXmlElement(XmlDocument doc, string elementName, object appearance)
		{
			string fullName = appearance.GetType().FullName;
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat;
			XmlElement xmlElement = doc.CreateElement(elementName);
			if (fullName.IndexOf("View3DAppearance") > -1)
			{
				View3DAppearance view3DAppearance = (View3DAppearance)appearance;
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("XRotation", view3DAppearance.XRotation.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("YRotation", view3DAppearance.YRotation.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("ZRotation", view3DAppearance.ZRotation.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Scale", view3DAppearance.Scale.ToString(numberFormat));
			}
			else if (fullName.IndexOf("BorderAppearance") > -1)
			{
				BorderAppearance borderAppearance = (BorderAppearance)appearance;
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Thickness", borderAppearance.Thickness.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("DrawStyle", borderAppearance.DrawStyle.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Color", borderAppearance.Color.ToString());
			}
			else if (fullName.IndexOf("LegendAppearance") > -1)
			{
				LegendAppearance legendAppearance = (LegendAppearance)appearance;
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Visible", legendAppearance.Visible.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Location", legendAppearance.Location.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("SpanPercentage", legendAppearance.SpanPercentage.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Font", fc.ConvertToInvariantString(legendAppearance.Font));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("FontColor", legendAppearance.FontColor.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("BackgroundColor", legendAppearance.BackgroundColor.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("BorderThickness", legendAppearance.BorderThickness.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("BorderColor", legendAppearance.BorderColor.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("BorderStyle", legendAppearance.BorderStyle.ToString());
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("AlphaLevel", legendAppearance.AlphaLevel.ToString(numberFormat));
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("FormatString", legendAppearance.FormatString.ToString());
				XmlElement newChild = AppearanceToXmlElement(doc, "Margins", legendAppearance.Margins);
				xmlElement.AppendChild(newChild);
			}

		private static void AddChartText(XmlElement root, XmlDocument doc, ChartTextCollection v)
		{
			XmlElement xmlElement = doc.CreateElement("ChartText");
			foreach (ChartTextAppearance item in v)
			{
				XmlElement newChild = AppearanceToXmlElement(doc, "ChartTextAppearance", item);
				xmlElement.AppendChild(newChild);
			}
			if (xmlElement.HasChildNodes)
			{
				root.AppendChild(xmlElement);
			}
		}

		public static void Persist(object component, string filePath)
		{
			XmlTextWriter xmlTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(File.CreateText(filePath));
			xmlTextWriter.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			Persist(component, xmlTextWriter);
			xmlTextWriter.Close();
		}

		public static void Persist(object component, TextWriter textWriter)
		{
			XmlTextWriter xmlTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(textWriter);
			xmlTextWriter.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			Persist(component, xmlTextWriter);
		}

		public static void Persist(object component, XmlTextWriter xmlW)
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			Type type = component.GetType();
			Assembly assembly = type.Assembly;
			XmlElement xmlElement = xmlDocument.CreateElement("UltraChartLayout");
			if (assembly != null)
			{
				string fullName = assembly.FullName;
				string[] array = fullName.Split(',');
				fullName = array[0].Trim();
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Assembly", fullName);
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("AssemblyVersion", array[1].Trim().Split('=')[1]);
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("ResourcesVersion", type.Assembly.FullName.Split(',')[1].Split('=')[1]);
				xmlElement.SetAttribute("Token", array[2].Trim().Split('=')[1]);
			}
			xmlDocument.AppendChild(xmlDocument.CreateComment("This is automatically generated file. Please do not modify."));
			xmlDocument.AppendChild(xmlElement);
			XmlElement xmlElement2 = xmlDocument.CreateElement("UltraChart");
			xmlElement.AppendChild(xmlElement2);
			string[] array2 = topLevelProperties;
			foreach (string name in array2)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(name);
				if (property != null)
				{
					object value = property.GetValue(component, null);
					if (value != null)
					{
						xmlElement2.SetAttribute(name, value.ToString());
					}
				}
			}
			xmlElement = xmlElement2;
			string[] array3 = topLevelAppearance;
			foreach (string text in array3)
			{
				PropertyInfo property2 = type.GetProperty(text);
				if (!(property2 != null))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value2 = property2.GetValue(component, null);
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					XmlElement xmlElement3 = AppearanceToXmlElement(xmlDocument, text, value2);
					if (xmlElement3 != null)
					{
						xmlElement.AppendChild(xmlElement3);
					}
					else
					{
						Console.WriteLine("Element for: " + text + " not found!");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Console.WriteLine("Appearance: " + text + " not found!");
				}
			}
			xmlDocument.WriteContentTo(xmlW);
		}

		public static void UnPersist(object component, string filePath)
		{
			XmlTextReader xmlTextReader = new XmlTextReader(File.OpenText(filePath));
			UnPersist(component, xmlTextReader);
			xmlTextReader.Close();
		}

		public static void UnPersist(object component, TextReader reader)
		{
			XmlTextReader tr = new XmlTextReader(reader);
			UnPersist(component, tr);
		}

		public static void UnPersist(object component, XmlTextReader tr)
		{
			Type type = component.GetType();
			IChartComponent component2 = component as IChartComponent;
			while (tr.Read())
			{
				XmlNodeType nodeType = tr.NodeType;
				if (nodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array = topLevelAppearance;
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					if (tr.Name == text)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(tr.Name);
					if (property != null)
					{
						object value = property.GetValue(component, null);
						XmlElementToAppearance(component2, tr, tr.Name, value);
						((ChartAppearance)value).SetComponent(component2);
					}
				}
				if (tr.Name.Equals("ChartText"))
				{
					if (tr.IsStartElement())
					{
						ChartTextableAppearance = LastAppearance;
						Textcollection = null;
						try
						{
							Textcollection = (ChartTextCollection)ChartTextableAppearance.GetType().InvokeMember("ChartText", BindingFlags.GetProperty, null, ChartTextableAppearance, null);
						}
						catch (MissingMethodException)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				else if (tr.Name.Equals("ChartTextAppearance"))
				{
					ChartTextAppearance chartTextAppearance = new ChartTextAppearance();
					chartTextAppearance.SetComponent(((ChartAppearance)LastAppearance).component);
					XmlElementToAppearance(((ChartAppearance)LastAppearance).component, tr, "ChartTextAppearance", chartTextAppearance);
					Textcollection.Add(chartTextAppearance);
				}
				if (!(tr.Name == "UltraChart"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string[] array2 = topLevelProperties;
				foreach (string name in array2)
				{
					PropertyInfo property2 = type.GetProperty(name);
					if (!(property2 != null))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string attribute = tr.GetAttribute(name);
					if (!property2.CanWrite || attribute == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj = null;
					Type propertyType = property2.PropertyType;
					if (propertyType == typeof(string))
					{
						obj = attribute;
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(ChartType))
					{
						obj = (ChartType)Enum.Parse(typeof(ChartType), attribute, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(Color))
					{
						Color color = ConvertColor(attribute);
						if (!color.Equals(Color.Empty))
						{
							obj = color;
						}
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(ImageFitStyle))
					{
						obj = (ImageFitStyle)Enum.Parse(typeof(ImageFitStyle), attribute, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(bool))
					{
						obj = bool.Parse(attribute);
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(Point))
					{
						Point point = ConvertPoint(attribute);
						if (point != Point.Empty)
						{
							obj = point;
						}
					}
					else if (propertyType == typeof(Size))
					{
						Size size = ConvertSize(attribute);
						if (size != Size.Empty)
						{
							obj = size;
						}
					}
					if (obj != null)
					{
						property2.SetValue(component, obj, null);
					}
				}
			}
			tr.Close();
		}

		public static void GotoNextElement(XmlReader tr)
		{
			if (tr == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tr");
			}
			while (tr.Read() && tr.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
			{
			}
		}

		public static void AddNode(XmlDocument doc, XmlElement root, string path, XmlElement child)
		{
			if (root == null || path == null || path.Length <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = path.Split('.');
			XmlElement xmlElement = root;
			if (array.Length <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (XmlElement childNode in xmlElement.ChildNodes)
				{
					if (childNode.Name.IndexOf(array[i]) == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						xmlElement = childNode;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					XmlElement xmlElement3 = doc.CreateElement(array[i]);
					xmlElement.AppendChild(xmlElement3);
					xmlElement = xmlElement3;
				}
			}
			xmlElement.AppendChild(child);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static SR loader;

		private ResourceManager resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string baseName = "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.ChartCore.Strings";
			resources = new ResourceManager(baseName, GetType().Assembly);
		}

		private static SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = sR.resources.GetString(name, culture);
			if (args != null && args.Length > 0)
			{
				text = string.Format(text, args);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static Bitmap GetBitmap(string name)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (Bitmap)sR.resources.GetObject(name);
		}
	}

		{

			{

					loaded = true;
					base.DescriptionValue = SR.GetString(base.Description);
				}
				return base.Description;
			}
		}

			: base(description)

		}

		[ToolboxItem(false)]
		public IGWinTooltip()
		{
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.UserMouse, value: true);
			base.TabStop = false;
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPaint(e);
			if (Renderer != null && Scene != null)
			{
				Renderer.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				Renderer.RenderSceneGraph(Scene, e.Graphics);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (ParentChangedHookedControls != null && ParentChangedHookedControls.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Control parentChangedHookedControl in ParentChangedHookedControls)
					{
						parentChangedHookedControl.ParentChanged -= HandleParentChanged;
					}
					ParentChangedHookedControls.Clear();
				}
				if (TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls != null && TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Control topLevelParentChangedHookedControl in TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls)
					{
						topLevelParentChangedHookedControl.ParentChanged -= HandleTopLevelParentChanged;
					}
					TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Clear();
				}
				if (LocationChangedHookedControls != null && LocationChangedHookedControls.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Control locationChangedHookedControl in LocationChangedHookedControls)
					{
						locationChangedHookedControl.LocationChanged -= HandleLocationChanged;
					}
					LocationChangedHookedControls.Clear();
				}
				if (TopLevel != null)
				{
					if (TopLevel.GetType().Name == "UltraPanel")
					{
						if (TopLevel.Controls.Count > 0 && TopLevel.Controls[0].Controls.Contains(this))
						{
							TopLevel.Controls[0].Controls.Remove(this);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						TopLevel.Controls.Remove(this);
						TopLevel = null;
					}
				}
				if (Renderer != null)
				{
					Renderer.Dispose();
					Renderer = null;
				}
				if (Scene != null)
				{
					Scene.Dispose();
					Scene = null;
				}
				if (Control != null)
				{
					Control = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public void SetLocation(Point location)
		{
			SetLocation(location, Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		internal void SetLocation(Point location, Rectangle containerBounds)
		{
			Point point = new Point(TopLocation.X + location.X + 15, TopLocation.Y + location.Y + 25);
			if (point.X < containerBounds.X)
			{
				point.X = containerBounds.X;
			}
			if (point.Y < containerBounds.Y)
			{
				point.Y = containerBounds.Y;
			}
			int right = containerBounds.Right;
			int bottom = containerBounds.Bottom;
			Control control = base.Parent;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			UltraChart ultraChart = Control as UltraChart;
			if (ultraChart != null)
			{
				flag3 = ultraChart.ParentForm != null && ultraChart.ParentForm.Contains(base.Parent);
			}
			while (control != null && (!(control is Form) || control.Parent != null))
			{
				if (control.GetType().ToString().IndexOf("DockableWindow") >= 0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (control.Parent is MdiClient)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (flag3 && !flag)
				{
					point.X -= control.Location.X;
					point.Y -= control.Location.Y;
				}
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					containerBounds.Offset(control.Location.X, control.Location.Y);
				}
				control = control.Parent;
			}
			if (containerBounds != Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				int num = point.X + base.Width;
				int num2 = point.Y + base.Height;
				if (num > right)
				{
					point.X -= num - right;
				}
				if (num2 > bottom)
				{
					point.Y -= num2 - bottom;
				}
			}
			base.Enabled = false;
			if (ultraChart != null)
			{
				BackColor = ultraChart.Tooltips.BackColor;
			}
			base.Location = (locationCache = point);
		}

		private Control FindDockableWindow(Control control)
		{
			if (control.GetType().ToString().IndexOf("DockableWindow") >= 0)
			{
				return control;
			}
			if (control.Parent != null)
			{
				return FindDockableWindow(control.Parent);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Control GetHighestParent(Control sourceControl)
		{
			if (sourceControl.Parent == null)
			{
				return sourceControl;
			}
			if (sourceControl.Parent is Form { IsMdiContainer: not false })
			{
				return sourceControl;
			}
			if (sourceControl.Parent is MdiClient)
			{
				return sourceControl;
			}
			return GetHighestParent(sourceControl.Parent);
		}

		private Control GetControlToAttachTo(Control chartControl)
		{
			Control control = FindDockableWindow(chartControl);
			Control highestParent = GetHighestParent(chartControl);
			if (control != null)
			{
				return control;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (chartControl.TopLevelControl != null)
			{
				string name = chartControl.TopLevelControl.GetType().Name;
				if (name == "WindowForm" || name == "DropDownForm")
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (chartControl.TopLevelControl is Form { IsMdiContainer: not false } || chartControl.TopLevelControl == null)
				{
					return highestParent;
				}
				return chartControl.TopLevelControl;
			}
			if (chartControl.Parent != null)
			{
				return chartControl.Parent;
			}
			return chartControl;
		}

		public void Attach(Control chartControl)
		{
			if (chartControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control = chartControl;
			TopLocation = CalcLocations(chartControl, SubscribeLocation.Register);
			TopLevel = GetControlToAttachTo(chartControl);
			if (TopLevel != null)
			{
				bool flag = Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major == 5 && Environment.OSVersion.Version.Minor == 2;
				bool flag2 = TopLevel.Parent is MdiClient && TopLevel is Form && ((Form)TopLevel).WindowState == FormWindowState.Maximized;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					TopLevel.Paint += TopLevel_Paint;
				}
				else
				{
					AddToControlsCollection(TopLevel);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			if (Control != null && Control.TopLevelControl != null)
			{
				CalcLocations(Control, SubscribeLocation.Unregister);
				Control.TopLevelControl.Controls.Remove(this);
				TopLocation = new Point(0, 0);
			}
		}

		private Point CalcLocations(Control c, SubscribeLocation registerListener)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			Control controlToAttachTo = GetControlToAttachTo(c);
			if (controlToAttachTo != null)
			{
				Control control = c;
				while (control != controlToAttachTo && control != null)
				{
					switch (registerListener)
					{
					case SubscribeLocation.Register:
						if (!ParentChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							control.ParentChanged += HandleParentChanged;
							ParentChangedHookedControls.Add(control);
						}
						if (!LocationChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							control.LocationChanged += HandleLocationChanged;
							LocationChangedHookedControls.Add(control);
						}
						break;
					case SubscribeLocation.Unregister:
						control.LocationChanged -= HandleLocationChanged;
						control.ParentChanged -= HandleParentChanged;
						if (LocationChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							LocationChangedHookedControls.Remove(control);
						}
						if (ParentChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							ParentChangedHookedControls.Remove(control);
						}
						break;
					}
					num += control.Location.X;
					num2 += control.Location.Y;
					if (control is Form)
					{
						int num3 = (control.Width - control.ClientSize.Width) / 2;
						int num4 = control.Height - control.ClientSize.Height - num3;
						num += num3;
						num2 += num4;
					}
					control = control.Parent;
				}
				if (control == controlToAttachTo)
				{
					switch (registerListener)
					{
					case SubscribeLocation.Register:
						if (!TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							control.ParentChanged += HandleTopLevelParentChanged;
							TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Add(control);
						}
						break;
					case SubscribeLocation.Unregister:
						control.ParentChanged -= HandleTopLevelParentChanged;
						if (TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Contains(control))
						{
							TopLevelParentChangedHookedControls.Remove(control);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (Control control2 in controlToAttachTo.Controls)
			{
				if (!(control2.GetType() == typeof(ToolStrip)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				ToolStrip toolStrip = control2 as ToolStrip;
				if (toolStrip.Visible)
				{
					if (toolStrip.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						num2 -= toolStrip.Size.Height;
					}
					else
					{
						num -= toolStrip.Size.Width;
					}
				}
			}
			return new Point(num, num2);
		}

		private bool IsMyParent(Control childControl, Control parentControl)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (Control control = childControl.Parent; control != null; control = control.Parent)
			{
				if (control == parentControl)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsMyParent(Control parentControl)
		{
			return IsMyParent(this, Control);
		}

		private bool ParentIsValidContainerType(Control parentControl)
		{
			string name = parentControl.GetType().Name;
			if (name != "UltraExpandableGroupBox")
			{
				return name != "TabControl";
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParentIsValidContainerOfAttachTarget(Control attachTarget, Control parent)
		{
			if (IsMyParent(attachTarget, parent))
			{
				return ParentIsValidContainerType(parent);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldAttachTo(Control attachTarget, Control parent)
		{
			if (attachTarget == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent == attachTarget)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParentIsValidContainerOfAttachTarget(attachTarget, parent))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void HandleParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = Control.TopLevelControl;
			if (control == null)
			{
				control = GetHighestParent(Control);
			}
			Control control2 = sender as Control;
			if (control2 != null && !IsMyParent(control2) && control2 != control)
			{
				control2.ParentChanged -= HandleParentChanged;
				if (ParentChangedHookedControls.Contains(sender))
				{
					ParentChangedHookedControls.Remove(sender);
				}
			}
			foreach (Control locationChangedHookedControl in LocationChangedHookedControls)
			{
				locationChangedHookedControl.LocationChanged -= HandleLocationChanged;
			}
			LocationChangedHookedControls.Clear();
			if (ShouldAttachTo(Control, control2))
			{
				Attach(Control);
			}
			else
			{
				TopLocation = CalcLocations(Control, SubscribeLocation.Register);
			}
		}

		private void HandleLocationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RecalcLocations();
		}

		private void HandleTopLevelParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RecalcLocations();
		}

		private void RecalcLocations()
		{
			TopLocation = CalcLocations(Control, SubscribeLocation.None);
		}

		private void AddToControlsCollection(Control controlToAttachTo)
		{
			if (TopLevel == null || (Control is UltraChart ultraChart && ultraChart.IsDesignMode()) || TopLevel.Controls.IsReadOnly)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control topLevel = TopLevel;
			topLevel.SuspendLayout();
			try
			{
				TopLevel.Controls.Add(this);
				TopLevel.Controls.SetChildIndex(this, 0);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				Control fallbackContainer = GetFallbackContainer(TopLevel);
				TopLevel = fallbackContainer;
				if (TopLevel != null)
				{
					AddToControlsCollection(TopLevel);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				topLevel.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
			}
		}

		private Control GetFallbackContainerHelper(Control currentControl, Control container)
		{
			if (currentControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (currentControl.Parent == container)
			{
				return currentControl;
			}
			return GetFallbackContainerHelper(currentControl.Parent, container);
		}

		private Control GetFallbackContainer(Control currentContainer)
		{
			return GetFallbackContainerHelper(Control, currentContainer);
		}

		private void TopLevel_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is Control control)
			{
				AddToControlsCollection(control);
				control.Paint -= TopLevel_Paint;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface ICalculateDelay
	{
		int GetDelay(double timeElapsed);
	}
	public interface IRepeat : IDisposable
	{
		bool Repeating { get; set; }

		Delegate Function { get; set; }

		ICalculateDelay DelayClass { get; set; }
	}
	public class LinearDecay : ICalculateDelay
	{
		private Point P1 = new Point(300, 300);

		private Point P2 = new Point(2000, 50);

		public Point StartDecay
		{
			get
			{
				return P1;
			}
			set
			{
				P1 = value;
			}
		}

		public Point EndDecay
		{
			get
			{
				return P2;
			}
			set
			{
				P2 = value;
			}
		}

		public int GetDelay(double millisecondsElapsed)
		{
			int result = int.MaxValue;
			if (millisecondsElapsed < (double)P1.X)
			{
				result = P1.Y;
			}
			else if (millisecondsElapsed < (double)P2.X)
			{
				result = (int)((double)P1.Y - (double)(P1.Y - P2.Y) * (millisecondsElapsed - (double)P1.X) / (double)(P2.X - P1.X));
			}
			else if (millisecondsElapsed > (double)P2.X)
			{
				result = P2.Y;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public delegate void RepeaterHandler();
	public class ExpDecay : ICalculateDelay
	{
		public int GetDelay(double millisecondsElapsed)
		{
			double num = 100.0 * Math.Exp(-0.001 * millisecondsElapsed);
			if (num < 10.0)
			{
				num = 10.0;
			}
			return (int)num;
		}
	}
	public class Repeater : IRepeat, IDisposable
	{
		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer;

		private ICalculateDelay delay;

		private DateTime then;

		private Delegate function;

		private object[] param;

		public bool Repeating
		{
			get
			{
				return timer.Enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					if (delay != null)
					{
						timer.Interval = delay.GetDelay(0.0);
						then = DateTime.Now;
						timer.Start();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					timer.Stop();
				}
			}
		}

		public Delegate Function
		{
			get
			{
				return function;
			}
			set
			{
				function = value;
			}
		}

		public object[] Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				return param;
			}
			set
			{
				param = value;
			}
		}

		public ICalculateDelay DelayClass
		{
			get
			{
				return delay;
			}
			set
			{
				delay = value;
			}
		}

		public Repeater()
		{
			timer = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer();
			timer.Interval = int.MaxValue;
			timer.Tick += RepeatingHandler;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			function = null;
			if (timer != null)
			{
				timer.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void RepeatingHandler(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = DateTime.Now.Subtract(then);
			if (delay != null)
			{
				timer.Interval = delay.GetDelay(timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds);
			}
			if ((object)function != null)
			{
				function.DynamicInvoke(param);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class SRProvider
	{
		public static Bitmap GetBitmap(string name)
		{
			return SR.GetBitmap(name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name);
		}
	}
	public interface IInteractionTool
	{
		bool CanStart();

		void Start();

		void KeyDown();

		void MouseDown();

		void MouseMove();

		void MouseUp();

		void MouseWheel();

		void Stop();
	}
	public abstract class InteractionTool : IInteractionTool
	{
		private UltraChart ultraChart;

		public UltraChart UltraChart
		{
			get
			{
				return ultraChart;
			}
			set
			{
				ultraChart = value;
			}
		}

		public InputContext LastInput => ultraChart.LastInput;

		public SceneGraph SceneGraph => ultraChart.Scene;

		public ChartCore ChartCore => ultraChart.ChartCore;

		protected InteractionTool(UltraChart ultraChart)
		{
			this.ultraChart = ultraChart;
		}

		public virtual bool CanStart()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void Start()
		{
		}

		public virtual void KeyDown()
		{
			if (LastInput.Key == Keys.Escape)
			{
				StopTool();
			}
		}

		public virtual void MouseDown()
		{
		}

		public virtual void MouseMove()
		{
		}

		public virtual void MouseUp()
		{
			StopTool();
		}

		public virtual void MouseWheel()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Stop()
		{
		}

		public Primitive HitTest(Point pt)
		{
			return ultraChart.HitTest(pt);
		}

		public virtual void StopTool()
		{
			if (UltraChart.Tool == this)
			{
				UltraChart.Tool = null;
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateView(CacheLevel cacheLevel)
		{
			((IChartComponent)ultraChart).Invalidate(cacheLevel);
		}
	}
	public class AxisDraggingTool : InteractionTool
	{
		private const string scaleScroller = "Scroll.Scroller";

		private Point lastPoint;

		private Box box;

		private AxisAppearance axisApp;

		private Axis axis;

		private double outDistance;

		public AxisDraggingTool(UltraChart view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanStart()
		{
			Primitive primitive = base.UltraChart.HitTest(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
			if (primitive == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((primitive.Caps & PCaps.InteractionPrimitive) > PCaps.None && primitive.Path.IndexOf("Scroll.Scroller") > -1)
			{
				box = primitive as Box;
				if (box == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Start()
		{
			axis = (Axis)box.Layer;
			axisApp = (AxisAppearance)axis.GetAppearance();
			lastPoint = base.LastInput.ViewPoint;
			outDistance = 0.0;
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			if (axis.Scale == 1.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point viewPoint = base.LastInput.ViewPoint;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			switch (axisApp.axisNumber)
			{
			case AxisNumber.X_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.X2_Axis:
				num = viewPoint.X - lastPoint.X;
				num2 = -64.0;
				break;
			case AxisNumber.Y_Axis:
			case AxisNumber.Y2_Axis:
				num = viewPoint.Y - lastPoint.Y;
				num2 = 64.0;
				break;
			}
			if (outDistance != 0.0)
			{
				num += outDistance;
			}
			double num3 = (axis.MapRange + num2) * (1.0 - axis.Scale);
			double num4 = num / num3;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				double num5 = axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll + num4;
				outDistance = 0.0;
				if (num5 < 0.0)
				{
					outDistance = num;
					num5 = 0.0;
				}
				if (num5 > 1.0)
				{
					outDistance = num;
					num5 = 1.0;
				}
				ChartScrollScaleEventArgs e = new ChartScrollScaleEventArgs(axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll, num5, ScrollScaleEventType.Scrolling, axis);
				base.UltraChart.RaiseScrollbarScroll(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll = num5;
					InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
				lastPoint = viewPoint;
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisTool : InteractionTool, IDisposable
	{
		private enum AxisAction
		{
			ScalePlus,
			ScaleMinus,
			MoveTopLeft,
			MoveBottomRight
		}

		private const string scalePlus = "Scale.Plus";

		private const string scaleMinus = "Scale.Minus";

		private const string scrollTopLeft = "Scroll.BoxTopLeft";

		private const string scrollBottomRight = "Scroll.BoxBottomRight";

		private Repeater repeater;

		private Primitive hitPrimitive;

		private Layer axis;

		private AxisAppearance axisApp;

		private AxisAction axisAction;

		private bool disposed;

		public AxisTool(UltraChart view)
			: base(view)
		{
			repeater = new Repeater();
			repeater.DelayClass = new ExpDecay();
			repeater.Repeating = false;
			repeater.Function = new RepeaterHandler(Repeat);
		}

		public override bool CanStart()
		{
			hitPrimitive = base.UltraChart.HitTest(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
			if (hitPrimitive == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((hitPrimitive.Caps & PCaps.InteractionPrimitive) > PCaps.None && InitAction())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void MouseDown()
		{
			DoAction();
			repeater.Repeating = true;
		}

		public override void MouseUp()
		{
			repeater.Repeating = false;
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			hitPrimitive = base.UltraChart.HitTest(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
			if (hitPrimitive == null || (hitPrimitive.Caps & PCaps.InteractionPrimitive) == 0)
			{
				StopTool();
				return;
			}
			axis = (Layer)hitPrimitive.Layer;
			axisApp = (AxisAppearance)axis.GetAppearance();
			if (!InitAction())
			{
				StopTool();
			}
		}

		public override void MouseWheel()
		{
			switch (axisAction)
			{
			case AxisAction.ScalePlus:
			case AxisAction.ScaleMinus:
				Scale(base.LastInput.Delta < 0);
				InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				break;
			case AxisAction.MoveTopLeft:
			case AxisAction.MoveBottomRight:
				Scroll(base.LastInput.Delta < 0);
				InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Stop()
		{
			repeater.Repeating = false;
		}

		private bool InitAction()
		{
			string path = hitPrimitive.Path;
			if (path.IndexOf("Scale.Plus") > -1)
			{
				axisAction = AxisAction.ScalePlus;
				return true;
			}
			if (path.IndexOf("Scale.Minus") > -1)
			{
				axisAction = AxisAction.ScaleMinus;
				return true;
			}
			if (path.IndexOf("Scroll.BoxTopLeft") > -1)
			{
				axisAction = AxisAction.MoveTopLeft;
				return true;
			}
			if (path.IndexOf("Scroll.BoxBottomRight") > -1)
			{
				axisAction = AxisAction.MoveBottomRight;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Repeat()
		{
			DoAction();
		}

		private void Scale(bool positive)
		{
			if (axisApp != null && axisApp.ScrollScale != null)
			{
				double num = (positive ? (axisApp.ScrollScale.Scale / 1.05) : (axisApp.ScrollScale.Scale * 1.05));
				num = ((!positive) ? (Math.Round(Math.Ceiling(num * 1000.0)) / 1000.0) : (Math.Round(Math.Round(num * 1000.0)) / 1000.0));
				if (num < 0.01)
				{
					num = 0.01;
				}
				if (num >= 1.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				ChartScrollScaleEventArgs e = new ChartScrollScaleEventArgs(axisApp.ScrollScale.Scale, num, ScrollScaleEventType.Scaling, axis as Axis);
				base.UltraChart.RaiseScrollbarScale(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					axisApp.ScrollScale.Scale = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Scroll(bool positive)
		{
			if (axisApp != null && axisApp.ScrollScale != null)
			{
				double num = axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll + 0.05 * (double)(positive ? 1 : (-1));
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				if (num > 1.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				ChartScrollScaleEventArgs e = new ChartScrollScaleEventArgs(axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll, num, ScrollScaleEventType.Scrolling, axis as Axis);
				base.UltraChart.RaiseScrollbarScroll(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					axisApp.ScrollScale.Scroll = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoAction()
		{
			_ = hitPrimitive.Path;
			switch (axisAction)
			{
			case AxisAction.ScalePlus:
			case AxisAction.ScaleMinus:
			{
				bool positive = axisAction == AxisAction.ScalePlus;
				Scale(positive);
				break;
			}
			case AxisAction.MoveTopLeft:
			case AxisAction.MoveBottomRight:
			{
				bool positive = axisAction == AxisAction.MoveBottomRight;
				Scroll(positive);
				break;
			}
			}
			InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					repeater.Dispose();
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~AxisTool()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}
	}
	public class Rotate3DTool : InteractionTool
	{
		private Point lastPoint;

		public Rotate3DTool(UltraChart view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanStart()
		{
			if (base.LastInput.Alt && base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3D)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Start()
		{
			lastPoint = base.LastInput.ViewPoint;
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			if (base.LastInput.Buttons == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				float xRotation = base.UltraChart.Transform3D.XRotation;
				float yRotation = base.UltraChart.Transform3D.YRotation;
				xRotation += (float)(lastPoint.Y - base.LastInput.ViewPoint.Y) * 360f / (float)base.UltraChart.Width;
				yRotation += (float)(lastPoint.X - base.LastInput.ViewPoint.X) * 360f / (float)base.UltraChart.Height;
				base.UltraChart.Transform3D.XRotation = xRotation;
				base.UltraChart.Transform3D.YRotation = yRotation;
				InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				base.UltraChart.RaiseChart3DTransformed(new ChartTransform3DEventArgs(base.UltraChart.Transform3D));
			}
			lastPoint = base.LastInput.ViewPoint;
		}
	}
	public class InputContext

		private Keys modifiers;

		public bool Control => (Modifiers & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control;

		public Keys Key => keyEventArgs.KeyCode;

		public KeyEventArgs KeyEventArgs

				return modifiers;

			set

				modifiers = value;
			}
		}

		public MouseEventArgs MouseEventArgs
		{
			get
			{
				return mouseEventArgs;
			}
			set
			{
				mouseEventArgs = value;
			}
		}

		public Point ViewPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return viewPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				viewPoint = value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DefaultTool : InteractionTool
	{
		private bool clicked;

		internal Primitive oldPrimitive;

		public DefaultTool(UltraChart ultraChart)
			: base(ultraChart)
		{
		}

		public override void KeyDown()
		{
		}

		public override void MouseDown()
		{
			foreach (object mouseDownTool in base.UltraChart.MouseDownTools)
			{
				if (mouseDownTool is IInteractionTool interactionTool && interactionTool.CanStart())
				{
					base.UltraChart.Tool = interactionTool;
					return;
				}
			}
			Primitive primitive = base.UltraChart.HitTest(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
			if (primitive == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.UltraChart.SendEvents(primitive, base.LastInput.MouseEventArgs);
			if (base.UltraChart.Drill.Enabled && (primitive.Caps & PCaps.InteractionPrimitive) != PCaps.InteractionPrimitive)
			{
				ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPoint = ((IChartComponent)base.UltraChart).GetChartInfoFromPoint(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
				if (chartInfoFromPoint != null)
				{
					base.UltraChart.Drill.DrillDownHandler(primitive.Path, chartInfoFromPoint);
					base.UltraChart.RaiseDrilledDown(chartInfoFromPoint);
				}
			}
			if (base.UltraChart.Tooltips.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseClick)
			{
				ShowHilight(primitive);
				clicked = true;
			}
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			foreach (object mouseMoveTool in base.UltraChart.MouseMoveTools)
			{
				if (mouseMoveTool is IInteractionTool interactionTool && interactionTool.CanStart())
				{
					base.UltraChart.Tool = interactionTool;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3D && base.UltraChart.EnableCrossHair)
			{
				base.UltraChart.crossHair.hairx = base.LastInput.ViewPoint.X;
				base.UltraChart.crossHair.hairy = base.LastInput.ViewPoint.Y;
				if (base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Dirty)
				{
					InvalidateView(CacheLevel.ImageLevelCache);
				}
				else
				{
					InvalidateView(CacheLevel.SceneGraphLevelCache);
				}
			}
			ProcessMouseMove();
		}

		public override void MouseUp()
		{
		}

		public override void MouseWheel()
		{
			if (!base.LastInput.Alt || !base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3D)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = 5f;
			float num2 = base.UltraChart.Transform3D.Scale;
			if (base.LastInput.Delta < 0)
			{
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num2 -= num;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += num;
			}
			base.UltraChart.Transform3D.Scale = Math.Max(Math.Min(num2, 100f), 0f);
			InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			base.UltraChart.RaiseChart3DTransformed(new ChartTransform3DEventArgs(base.UltraChart.Transform3D));
		}

		public override void Stop()
		{
			bool flag = !base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3D && base.UltraChart.EnableCrossHair;
			if (flag || base.UltraChart.Tooltips.Display != TooltipDisplay.Never)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					base.UltraChart.crossHair.hairx = -1;
					base.UltraChart.crossHair.hairy = -1;
				}
				base.UltraChart.HideHilight();
				base.UltraChart.HideTooltip();
				oldPrimitive = null;
				clicked = false;
				InvalidateView(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		private void ShowHilight(Primitive hitPrimitive)
		{
			if (hitPrimitive is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path p && base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3DNew)
			{
				base.UltraChart.ShowHilight(p);
			}
			else
			{
				base.UltraChart.ShowHilight(hitPrimitive);
			}
			InvalidateView(CacheLevel.SceneGraphLevelCache);
		}

		private void ProcessMouseMove()
		{
			Primitive primitive = base.UltraChart.HitTest(base.LastInput.ViewPoint);
			if (primitive != null && (primitive.Caps & PCaps.Tooltip) == 0)
			{
				primitive = null;
			}
			if ((base.UltraChart.Tooltips.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseClick && clicked) || base.UltraChart.Tooltips.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseMove)
			{
				base.UltraChart.ProcessTooltip(primitive, base.LastInput.MouseEventArgs);
			}
			if (base.UltraChart.ChartCore.Is3D && oldPrimitive != null && primitive != null)
			{
				if (IsSameDataItem(oldPrimitive, primitive))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (oldPrimitive == primitive)
			{
				return;
			}
			clicked = false;
			base.UltraChart.HideHilight();
			base.UltraChart.HideTooltip();
			if (primitive != null)
			{
				if (base.UltraChart.Tooltips.Display == TooltipDisplay.MouseMove)
				{
					ShowHilight(primitive);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InvalidateView(CacheLevel.ImageLevelCache);
			}
			if (oldPrimitive != null)
			{
				ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPrimitive = base.UltraChart.ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(oldPrimitive);
				if (chartInfoFromPrimitive != null)
				{
					base.UltraChart.RaiseDataItemOut(chartInfoFromPrimitive);
				}
			}
			if (primitive != null)
			{
				ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPrimitive2 = base.UltraChart.ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(primitive);
				if (chartInfoFromPrimitive2 != null)
				{
					base.UltraChart.RaiseDataItemOver(chartInfoFromPrimitive2);
				}
			}
			oldPrimitive = primitive;
		}

		private static bool IsSameDataItem(Primitive primitive1, Primitive primitive2)
		{
			if (primitive1.Row != primitive2.Row)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (primitive1.Column != primitive2.Column)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		internal IInteractionTool Tool
		{
			get
			{
				return tool;
			}
			set
			{
				if (tool != value)
				{
					if (tool != null)
					{
						tool.Stop();
					}
					if (value == null)
					{
						tool = defaultTool;
					}
					else
					{
						tool = value;
					}
					if (tool != null)
					{
						tool.Start();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		XmlDocument ISupportPresetSerialization.FilterDocument
		{
			get
			{
				if (filterDoc != null)
				{
					return filterDoc;
				}
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = null;
				Stream stream = null;
				XmlTextReader xmlTextReader = null;
				try
				{
					stream = typeof(UltraChart).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.UltraWinChartPresetMask.xml");
					if (stream == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					xmlTextReader = new XmlTextReader(stream);
					if (xmlTextReader != null)
					{
						xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
						xmlDocument.Load(xmlTextReader);
					}
					filterDoc = xmlDocument;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				finally
				{
					xmlTextReader?.Close();
					xmlTextReader = null;
					stream?.Close();
					stream = null;
				}
				return filterDoc;
			}
		}

			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new Cone3DAppearance(this);
				}
				chartTypeAppearance[48] = value;
				chartTypeAppearance[48].SetComponent(this);
				((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			}
		}

		private RenderingType RenderingType
		{
			get
			{
				if (renderCS != null)
				{
					if (renderCS.FlashContainer != null)
					{
						return RenderingType.Flash;
					}
					if (renderCS.SvgContainer != null)
					{
						return RenderingType.Svg;
					}
				}
				return RenderingType.Image;
			}
		}

		RenderingType IChartComponent.RenderingType => RenderingType;

		public void BeginInit()
		{
			_ChartInitilizing = true;
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			_ChartInitilizing = false;
			Invalidate();
			if (!_HasPainted)
			{
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				SaveTo(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Jpeg);
				memoryStream.Close();
				if (chartCore != null)
				{
					chartCore.InitializeLayersAndLegendsForCompositeChart();
					ChartCore.Dirty = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraChart()
		{
			defaultTool = new DefaultTool(this);
			axisTool = new AxisTool(this);
			tool = defaultTool;
			lastInput = new InputContext();
			mouseMoveTools = new ArrayList();
			mouseMoveTools.Add(axisTool);
			mouseDownTools = new ArrayList();
			mouseDownTools.Add(new Rotate3DTool(this));
			mouseDownTools.Add(new AxisDraggingTool(this));
			BackgroundImageLayout = ImageLayout.Center;
			license = (UltraLicense)LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraChart), this);
			getChartType = GetChartTypePreCore;
			CreateAppearanceObjects();
			chartCore = new ChartCore(this);
			getChartType = GetChartTypePostCore;
			chartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
			chartCore.Environment["WIN_VERSION"] = "5.0";
			string text = "";
			text += "RELEASE ";
			text += "GAC_ABLE ";
			chartCore.Environment["VERSION_TYPE"] = text;
			renderCS = new ChartRender(this);
			renderPDF = new ChartRenderPDF(this);
			renderCSForAdornments = new ChartRender(this);
			chartLayer = chartCore.GetChartLayer();
			titleLayer = chartCore.GetTitleLayer();
			borderLayer = chartCore.GetBorderLayer();
			adornmentLayer = chartCore.GetAdornmentLayer();
			drillLayer = chartCore.GetDrillLayer();
			crossHair = new CrossHairLayer(this, null);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: true);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint, value: true);
			new ChartDemoData();
			((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			ttplayer = new TooltipLayer(this, chartCore);
			Axis.Y.Labels.Orientation = TextOrientation.Horizontal;
			stackXform.unit();
			Tooltip = new IGWinTooltip();
		}

		internal void ShowHilight(Primitive p)
		{
			if (!tooltipAppearance.HighlightDataPoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (p is DataPoint)
			{
				adornmentLayer.FillSceneGraph(tooltipAppearance, HilightSceneGraph, p);
				((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.AdornmentLayerCache);
				return;
			}
			hilightedPrimitive = p;
			originalFill = p.PE;
			if (Tooltips.HighlightFillColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				p.PE = new PaintElement(Tooltips.HighlightFillColor);
				p.PE.FillOpacity = Tooltips.AlphaLevel;
				p.PE.StrokeOpacity = Tooltips.AlphaLevel;
			}
			else
			{
				p.PE = p.PE.Clone();
				p.PE.StrokeOpacity = Tooltips.HighlightOutlineColor.A;
				p.SetHighlightProperties();
			}
			p.PE.Stroke = Tooltips.HighlightOutlineColor;
		}

		internal void ShowHilight(Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path p)
		{
			if (!tooltipAppearance.HighlightDataPoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearHighlightedPrimitives();
			ArrayList arrayList = FindHighlightedPrimitives(p);
			foreach (Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path item in arrayList)
			{
				if (item.HighlightPE == null)
				{
					item.HighlightPE = new PaintElement();
					item.HighlightPE.Fill = Tooltips.HighlightFillColor;
					item.HighlightPE.Stroke = Tooltips.HighlightOutlineColor;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HideHilight()
		{
			if (tooltipAppearance.HighlightDataPoint)
			{
				if (chartCore.Is3D)
				{
					ClearHighlightedPrimitives();
					((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
				else if (hilightedPrimitive != null)
				{
					hilightedPrimitive.PE = originalFill;
					hilightedPrimitive = null;
					((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
				}
				else
				{
					HilightSceneGraph.Clear();
					((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.AdornmentLayerCache);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HideTooltip()
		{
			if (Tooltip.Visible)
			{
				ttplayer.ClearText();
				Tooltip.Hide();
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessTooltip(Primitive p, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Tooltip == null || p == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle containerBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			switch (Tooltips.Overflow)
			{
			case TooltipOverflow.ChartArea:
				containerBounds = new Rectangle(GetClientX(this, Tooltip.Parent), GetClientY(this, Tooltip.Parent), base.Width, base.Height);
				break;
			case TooltipOverflow.ClientArea:
				if (base.ParentForm != null)
				{
					containerBounds = base.ParentForm.ClientRectangle;
				}
				break;
			}
			int num = e.X;
			int num2 = e.Y;
			Point location = new Point(num, num2);
			if (Tooltip.Parent != null)
			{
				Tooltip.Parent.SuspendLayout();
			}
			Tooltip.SetLocation(location, containerBounds);
			if (!tooltipAppearance.UseControl)
			{
				if (ChartCore.ChartType switch
				{
					ChartType.Composite => true, 
					ChartType.ScatterLineChart => p.Chart == ChartType.ScatterLineChart || p.Chart == ChartType.ScatterChart, 
					_ => p.Chart == ChartCore.ChartType && (p.Path == null || p.Path.IndexOf(".ScrollBar") == -1), 
				})
				{
					string tooltip = TooltipLayer.GetTooltip(chartCore, this, p, ttplayer);
					if (ttplayer.Text != tooltip)
					{
						SceneGraph scene = new SceneGraph();
						ttplayer.FillSceneGraph(scene, p);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ttplayer.Text))
						{
							Rectangle outerBounds = ttplayer.GetOuterBounds();
							outerBounds.Location = Tooltip.Location;
							Tooltip.Bounds = outerBounds;
							Tooltip.Show();
							Tooltip.Scene = scene;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HideTooltip();
				}
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ttplayer.Text))
			{
				Tooltip.Show();
			}
			if (Tooltip.Parent != null)
			{
				if (Tooltip.Visible)
				{
					Tooltip.VisibleChanged += Tooltip_VisibleChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					ResumeTooltipLayout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResumeTooltipLayout()
		{
			if (Tooltip != null && Tooltip.Parent != null)
			{
				Tooltip.Parent.ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			}
		}

		private void Tooltip_VisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Tooltip != null)
			{
				Tooltip.VisibleChanged -= Tooltip_VisibleChanged;
				if (!Tooltip.Visible)
				{
					Tooltip.Parent.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(ResumeTooltipLayout));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearHighlightedPrimitives()
		{
			foreach (Primitive item in chartCore.SceneGraph)
			{
				if (item is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
				{
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = item as Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path;
					path.Highlighted = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private ArrayList FindHighlightedPrimitives(Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path selectedPath)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (Primitive item in chartCore.SceneGraph)
			{
				if (item is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
				{
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = item as Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path;
					if (selectedPath.Column == path.Column && selectedPath.Row == path.Row && path.Value != null)
					{
						path.Highlighted = true;
						arrayList.Add(path);
					}
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private bool IsInsideRect(int x, int y, Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (x > rect.X && y > rect.Y && x < rect.Right)
			{
				return y < rect.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (components != null)
				{
					components.Dispose();
				}
				if (license != null)
				{
					license.Dispose();
					license = null;
				}
				if (propsToRemove != null)
				{
					propsToRemove.Clear();
				}
				if (axisTool != null)
				{
					axisTool.Dispose();
				}
				if (renderCS != null)
				{
					renderCS.Dispose();
				}
				if (renderCSForAdornments != null)
				{
					renderCSForAdornments.Dispose();
				}
				if (chartCore != null)
				{
					chartCore.Dispose();
				}
				if (Tooltip != null)
				{
					Tooltip.Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		}

		public void ResetEmptyChartText()
		{
			chartCore.DataBindNotCalledMessage = SR.GetString("Win_SR_31");
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnResize(e);
			chartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
		}

		protected override void OnSizeChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSizeChanged(e);
			chartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPaint(e);
			if (!dataAppearance.GetDataBindCalled() && dataAppearance.IsDirty())
			{
				dataAppearance.DataBind();
			}
			lock (renderCS)
			{
				if (base.Parent != null)
				{
					renderCS.BackColor = base.Parent.BackColor;
				}
				_ = ChartCore.Dirty;
				if (cacheLevel == CacheLevel.SceneGraphLevelCache)
				{
					renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, base.Width, base.Height);
				}
				else if (chartCore.Dirty)
				{
					chartCore.SceneGraph.Clear();
					chartCore.DrawChart();
					renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, base.Width, base.Height);
				}
				e.Graphics.DrawImageUnscaled(renderCS.chartImage, 0, 0);
			}
			renderCSForAdornments.RenderSceneGraph(HilightSceneGraph, e.Graphics);
			if (EnableCrossHair && !chartCore.Is3D && chartType != ChartType.PieChart && chartType != ChartType.RadarChart && chartType != ChartType.DoughnutChart)
			{
				SceneGraph scene = new SceneGraph();
				crossHair.ChartType = chartType;
				if (chartType == ChartType.PolarChart)
				{
					crossHair.Center = ((PolarLayer)chartLayer).CenterResolved;
					crossHair.Radius = ((PolarLayer)chartLayer).RadiusResolved;
				}
				crossHair.SetBounds(0, 0, base.Width, base.Height);
				crossHair.FillSceneGraph(scene);
				renderCSForAdornments.RenderSceneGraph(scene, e.Graphics);
			}
			if (!_HasPainted)
			{
				adornmentLayer.InitializeClipBounds();
			}
			_HasPainted = true;
		}

		public void PrintChart(PrinterSettings printer, PageSettings page)
		{
			try
			{
				PrintDocument printDocument = new PrintDocument();
				if (printer != null)
				{
					printDocument.PrinterSettings = printer;
				}
				if (page != null)
				{
					printDocument.DefaultPageSettings = page;
				}
				printDocument.PrintPage += Chart_PrintPage;
				printDocument.Print();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				MessageBox.Show(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		public void PrintChart()
		{
			PrintChart(null, null);
		}

		private void Chart_PrintPage(object sender, PrintPageEventArgs ev)
		{
			_ = ev.Graphics;
			Size size = base.Size;
			int sceneWidth = ev.MarginBounds.Width;
			int sceneHeight = ev.MarginBounds.Height;
			chartCore.SetSize(sceneWidth, sceneHeight);
			chartCore.DrawChart();
			GraphicsState gstate = ev.Graphics.Save();
			ev.Graphics.TranslateTransform(ev.MarginBounds.X, ev.MarginBounds.Y);
			renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, sceneWidth, sceneHeight, ev.Graphics);
			ev.Graphics.Restore(gstate);
			chartCore.SetSize(size.Width, size.Height);
			ev.HasMorePages = false;
		}

		public void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = null;
			chartCore.DrawChart();
			renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, base.Width, base.Height);
			try
			{
				bitmap = renderCS.GetImage();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			try
			{
				Clipboard.SetDataObject(bitmap, copy: true);
			}
			catch (ExternalException)
			{
				Clipboard.SetDataObject(bitmap);
			}
		}

		public void RenderPdfFriendlyGraphics(Graphics g)
		{
			RenderPdfFriendlyGraphics(g, base.Width, base.Height);
		}

		public void RenderPdfFriendlyGraphics(Graphics g, int width, int height)
		{
			ChartCore.SetSize(width, height);
			ChartCore.DrawChart();
			renderPDF.RenderChart(ChartCore.SceneGraph, width, height, g);
			if (width != base.Width || height != base.Height)
			{
				ChartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
				ChartCore.DrawChart();
			}
			ChartCore.Dirty = true;
		}

		private void ChartTypeSetting(ChartType value)
		{
			((ISupportInitialize)this).BeginInit();
			if ((object)value == null || value < ChartType.ColumnChart || value > ChartType.TreeMapChart)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The value assigned to this property must be of the enumeration, ChartType.");
			}
			chartType = value;
			chartCore.ChartType = value;
			chartLayer = chartCore.GetChartLayer();
			InitializeChartTypeAppearance(value);
			((IChartComponent)this).Invalidate(CacheLevel.LayerLevelCache);
			if (renderCS != null && renderCS.ShadowScene != null)
			{
				renderCS.ShadowScene.Clear();
			}
			HideHilight();
			if (Tooltip != null)
			{
				Tooltip.Hide();
			}
			stackXform.unit();
			if (value == ChartType.Stack3DBarChart)
			{
				stackXform.scale(1f, 0.25f, 1f);
			}
			if (value == ChartType.Stack3DColumnChart)
			{
				stackXform.scale(0.25f, 1f, 1f);
			}
			((ISupportInitialize)this).EndInit();
			((EventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_CHARTTYPECHANGED])?.Invoke(this, new EventArgs());
			OnUpdated();
		}

		private void UpdateComponentDesigner()
		{
			propsToRemove.Clear();
			propsToRemove.AddRange(Enum.GetNames(typeof(ChartType)));
			propsToRemove.Add("StackChart");
			string text = chartType.ToString();
			string text2 = text.ToLower();
			if (text2.IndexOf("stack") > -1)
			{
				propsToRemove.Remove("StackChart");
				if (text2.IndexOf("bar") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("BarChart");
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("column") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("ColumnChart");
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("splinearea") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("SplineAreaChart");
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("area") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("AreaChart");
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("spline") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("SplineChart");
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("line") > -1)
				{
					propsToRemove.Remove("LineChart");
				}
			}
			switch (ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.AreaChart:
			case ChartType.LineChart:
			case ChartType.ScatterChart:
			case ChartType.SplineChart:
			case ChartType.SplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StepLineChart:
			case ChartType.StepAreaChart:
			case ChartType.GanttChart:
			case ChartType.StackAreaChart:
			case ChartType.StackLineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineChart:
			case ChartType.StackSplineAreaChart:
			case ChartType.Composite:
				propsToRemove.Remove("TimeAxisStyle");
				break;
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.StepLineChart)
			{
				propsToRemove.Remove("LineChart");
			}
			if (chartType == ChartType.StepAreaChart)
			{
				propsToRemove.Remove("AreaChart");
			}
			propsToRemove.Remove(text);
			TypeDescriptor.Refresh(this);
		}

		private static int GetClientX(Control control, Control relativeTo)
		{
			if ((control is Form && control.Parent == null) || control == relativeTo)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (control.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetClientX(control.Parent, relativeTo) + control.Location.X;
			}
			return control.Location.X;
		}

		private static int GetClientY(Control control, Control relativeTo)
		{
			if ((control is Form && control.Parent == null) || control == relativeTo)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (control.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetClientY(control.Parent, relativeTo) + control.Location.Y;
			}
			return control.Location.Y;
		}

		protected override void OnLoad(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoad(e);
			ultraChartReady = true;
			UpdateComponentDesigner();
			Tooltip.Attach(this);
			Tooltip.Size = new Size(500, 500);
			Tooltip.Hide();
			Tooltip.Renderer = renderCSForAdornments;
			tooltipAppearance.TooltipControl = Tooltip;
		}

		void IChartComponent.Invalidate(CacheLevel cacheLevel)
		{
			if (_ChartInitilizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.cacheLevel = cacheLevel;
			switch (cacheLevel)
			{
			case CacheLevel.ImageLevelCache:
			case CacheLevel.AdornmentLayerCache:
				Invalidate();
				return;
			case CacheLevel.SceneGraphLevelCache:
				Invalidate();
				return;
			}
			if (adornmentLayer != null)
			{
				adornmentLayer.highlightPrimitive = null;
				adornmentLayer.Clear();
			}
			if (HilightSceneGraph != null)
			{
				HilightSceneGraph.Clear();
			}
			if (chartCore != null)
			{
				chartCore.Dirty = true;
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		void IChartComponent.ResizeAll()
		{
			chartCore.ResizeAllLayers();
		}

		ChartDataEventArgs IChartComponent.GetChartInfoFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			return ChartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(ChartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point));
		}

		public void InvalidateLayers()
		{
			foreach (object key in chartCore.LayerHash.Keys)
			{
				((ILayer)chartCore.LayerHash[key]).ChartCore = chartCore;
				((ILayer)chartCore.LayerHash[key]).ChartComponent = this;
			}
			Invalidate();
			chartCore.Invalidate();
		}

		void IChartComponent.OnAppearanceChanged()
		{
			if (base.DesignMode && GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(this, null, null, null);
			}
		}

		{
			return base.DesignMode;
		}

		{
			return propsToRemove;
		}

		void IChartComponent.Subscribe(string evtName, EventHandler handler)
		{
			if (evtName.StartsWith("+"))
			{
				if (evtName == "+ChartTypeChanged")
				{
					ChartTypeChanged += handler;
				}
			}
			else if (evtName.StartsWith("-") && evtName == "-ChartTypeChanged")
			{
				ChartTypeChanged -= handler;
			}
		}

		internal Primitive HitTest(Point p)
		{
			Primitive primitive = ChartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(p);
			if (!IsInsideRect(p.X, p.Y, adornmentLayer.GetInnerBounds()) && primitive != null && primitive.Value != null)
			{
				primitive = null;
			}
			return primitive;
		}

		internal void RaiseDrilledDown(ChartDataEventArgs e)
		{
			OnDrilledDown(e);
		}

		internal void SendEvents(Primitive p, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ChartDataClickedEventHandler chartDataClickedEventHandler = (ChartDataClickedEventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_CHARTDATACLICKED];
			if (e == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Clicks == 1)
			{
				if (chartDataClickedEventHandler != null && chartDataClickedEventHandler.GetInvocationList().Length > 0)
				{
					ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPrimitive = chartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(p);
					if (chartInfoFromPrimitive != null)
					{
						OnChartDataClicked(chartInfoFromPrimitive);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.Clicks != 2)
				{
					return;
				}
				ChartDataClickedEventHandler chartDataClickedEventHandler2 = (ChartDataClickedEventHandler)base.Events[EVENT_CHARTDATADOUBLECLICKED];
				if (chartDataClickedEventHandler2 != null && chartDataClickedEventHandler2.GetInvocationList().Length > 0)
				{
					ChartDataEventArgs chartInfoFromPrimitive2 = chartCore.GetChartInfoFromPrimitive(p);
					if (chartInfoFromPrimitive2 != null)
					{
						OnChartDataDoubleClicked(chartInfoFromPrimitive2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RequestFocus()
		{
			try
			{
				Focus();
			}
			catch (VerificationException)
			{
				OnGotFocus(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				OnGotFocus(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs evt)
		{
			lastInput.ViewPoint = new Point(evt.X, evt.Y);
			lastInput.Buttons = evt.Button;
			lastInput.Modifiers = Control.ModifierKeys;
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = evt;
			if (AcceptsFocus)
			{
				base.OnMouseDown(evt);
				Tool.MouseDown();
			}
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
			lastInput.ViewPoint = PointToClient(mousePosition);
			lastInput.Buttons = Control.MouseButtons;
			lastInput.Modifiers = Control.ModifierKeys;
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = null;
			tool.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			Tool = null;
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs evt)
		{
			Point viewPoint = new Point(evt.X, evt.Y);
			lastInput.ViewPoint = viewPoint;
			lastInput.Buttons = evt.Button;
			lastInput.Modifiers = Control.ModifierKeys;
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = evt;
			Tool.MouseMove();
			base.OnMouseMove(evt);
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs evt)
		{
			lastInput.ViewPoint = new Point(evt.X, evt.Y);
			lastInput.Buttons = evt.Button;
			lastInput.Modifiers = Control.ModifierKeys;
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = evt;
			Tool.MouseUp();
			base.OnMouseUp(evt);
			lastInput.MouseEventArgs = null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs evt)

		}

		public virtual void SaveTo(string filePath, ImageFormat imageType)
		{
			try
			{
				if (imageType == ImageFormat.Wmf || imageType == ImageFormat.Emf || imageType == ImageFormat.Exif)
				{
					chartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
					chartCore.DrawChart();
					renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, base.Width, base.Height);
					renderCS.GetImage().Save(filePath, imageType);
				}
				else
				{
					FileStream fileStream = File.Create(filePath);
					SaveTo(fileStream, imageType);
					fileStream.Close();
				}
			}
			catch (PathInvalidException ex)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				throw ex2;
			}
		}
