			catch (PathInvalidException ex)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				throw ex2;
			}
		}

		public ReverseHitTest HitTest(Primitive primitive)
		{
			return HitTest(primitive.Row, primitive.Column, primitive, primitive.Value);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1)
		{
			return HitTest(row1, column1, null, null);
		}

		public ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1, object val)
		{
			return HitTest(row1, column1, null, val);
		}

		public ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1, Primitive prim)
		{
			return HitTest(row1, column1, prim, prim.Value);
		}

		public ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1, Type primitiveType)
		{
			return HitTest(row1, column1, null, null, primitiveType);
		}

		private ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1, Primitive prim, object val)
		{
			return HitTest(row1, column1, prim, val, typeof(Primitive));
		}

		private ReverseHitTest HitTest(int row1, int column1, Primitive prim, object val, Type primitiveType)
		{
			Point point;
			switch (ChartType)
			{
			case ChartType.HistogramChart:
			case ChartType.TreeMapChart:
				point = new Point(row1, column1);
				break;
			default:
				point = chartCore.InternalRowAndColumn(new Point(row1, column1));
				break;
			}
			int num = point.X;
			int num2 = point.Y;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				num = row1;
			}
			Point[] array = null;
			Primitive primitive = null;
			foreach (Primitive item in chartCore.SceneGraph)
			{
				if ((item.Caps & (PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin)) > PCaps.None)
				{
					if ((item.Path != null && item.Path.IndexOf("Legend") >= 0) || (prim != null && item != prim))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						bool flag = val == item.Value;
						Array array2 = val as Array;
						Array array3 = item.Value as Array;
						if (array2 != null && array3 != null && array2.Length == array3.Length)
						{
							flag = true;
							for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
							{
								object value = array2.GetValue(i);
								object value2 = array3.GetValue(i);
								if (value is DateTime && value2 is DateTime)
								{
									if (((DateTime)value).ToString("s", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) != ((DateTime)value2).ToString("s", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
									{
										flag = false;
									}
								}
								else if (array2.GetValue(i) != array3.GetValue(i))
								{
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (primitiveType != null && primitiveType != typeof(DataPoint) && !primitiveType.IsInstanceOfType(item))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (item.Row == num && item.Column == num2)
					{
						primitive = item;
						if (primitiveType != null && !primitiveType.IsInstanceOfType(item))
						{
							IList primitives = item.GetPrimitives();
							if (primitives == null || primitives.Count == 0)
							{
								continue;
							}
						}
						if (item is Box)
						{
							array = ((Box)item).GetHull();
						}
						else if (item is Ellipse)
						{
							array = new Point[4]
							{
								((Ellipse)item).p1,
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X + ((Ellipse)item).p2.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y),
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X + ((Ellipse)item).p2.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y + ((Ellipse)item).p2.Y),
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y + ((Ellipse)item).p2.Y)
							};
						}
						else if (item is Wedge)
						{
							array = ((Wedge)item).GetHull();
							primitive = item;
						}
						else if (item is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
						{
							Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = (Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)item;
							if (path.GraphicsPath != null && path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints != null)
							{
								array = new Point[path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints.Length];
								for (int j = 0; j < path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints.Length; j++)
								{
									ref Point reference = ref array[j];
									reference = new Point((int)path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints[j].X, (int)path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints[j].Y);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (array != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item is PointSet)
				{
					DataPoint[] points = ((PointSet)item).points;
					for (int k = 0; k < points.Length; k++)
					{
						Primitive primitive3 = points[k];
						if (primitive3.Row == num && primitive3.Column == num2)
						{
							array = new Point[1] { points[k].point };
							primitive = points[k];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (item is Polyline)
				{
					DataPoint[] points2 = ((Polyline)item).points;
					for (int l = 0; l < points2.Length; l++)
					{
						Primitive primitive4 = points2[l];
						if (primitive4.Row == num && primitive4.Column == num2)
						{
							array = new Point[1] { points2[l].point };
							primitive = points2[l];
							break;
						}
					}
					if (primitive != null && array != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(item is Polygon))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Polygon polygon = (Polygon)item;
					if (polygon.DataPoints != null && polygon.DataPoints.Length > 0)
					{
						for (int m = 0; m < polygon.DataPoints.Length; m++)
						{
							Primitive primitive5 = polygon.DataPoints[m];
							if (primitive5.Row == num && primitive5.Column == num2)
							{
								array = new Point[1] { polygon.DataPoints[m].point };
								primitive = polygon.DataPoints[m];
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (item.Row == num && item.Column == num2 && polygon.Points != null && polygon.Points.Length > 0)
					{
						array = polygon.Points;
						primitive = polygon;
					}
				}
			}
			ReverseHitTest reverseHitTest = new ReverseHitTest(array, primitive);
			ResolveExclusivePoint(reverseHitTest);
			return reverseHitTest;
		}

		private void ResolveExclusivePoint(ReverseHitTest hit)
		{
			if (ChartType == ChartType.Composite)
			{
				adornmentLayer.RefreshClipBoundsForCompositeChart(hit.Primitive);
			}
			hit.ExclusivePoint = hit.Center;
			if (hit.Hull != null && hit.Hull.Length == 1 && !Geometry.PointInsideRectangle(hit.Center, adornmentLayer.ClipBounds))
			{
				hit.ExclusivePoint = new Point(Math.Min(Math.Max(hit.Center.X, adornmentLayer.ClipBounds.Left + 1), adornmentLayer.ClipBounds.Right - 1), Math.Min(Math.Max(hit.Center.Y, adornmentLayer.ClipBounds.Top + 1), adornmentLayer.ClipBounds.Bottom - 1));
			}
			if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(hit.ExclusivePoint) != hit.Primitive)
			{
				if (hit.Primitive is Ellipse)
				{
					Ellipse ellipse = (Ellipse)hit.Primitive;
					Point centerPoint = ellipse.GetCenterPoint();
					int num = ellipse.p2.Y / 2 - 1;
					int num2 = ellipse.p2.X / 2 - 1;
					Point point = new Point(centerPoint.X, centerPoint.Y - num);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point;
					}
					Point point2 = new Point(centerPoint.X + num2, centerPoint.Y);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point2) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point2;
					}
					Point point3 = new Point(centerPoint.X, centerPoint.Y + num);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point3) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point3;
					}
					Point point4 = new Point(centerPoint.X - num2, centerPoint.Y);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point4) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point4;
					}
				}
				if (hit.Primitive is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
				{
					Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = hit.Primitive as Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path;
					if (path.ExclusivePoint != Point.Empty)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = path.ExclusivePoint;
						return;
					}
					ArrayList arrayList = FindHighlightedPrimitives(path);
					_ = RectangleF.Empty;
					foreach (Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path item in arrayList)
					{
						PointF[] pathPoints = item.GraphicsPath.PathPoints;
						for (int i = 0; i < pathPoints.Length; i++)
						{
							Point point5 = RoundCoordinates(pathPoints, i);
							Primitive chartPrimitiveFromPoint = chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point5);
							if (chartPrimitiveFromPoint == null || chartPrimitiveFromPoint.Column != path.Column || chartPrimitiveFromPoint.Row != path.Row)
							{
								continue;
							}
							hit.ExclusivePoint = point5;
							{
								foreach (Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path item2 in arrayList)
								{
									item2.ExclusivePoint = point5;
								}
								return;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (hit.Primitive is Box)
				{
					Box box = (Box)hit.Primitive;
					Point point6 = new Point(box.rect.Left + 1, box.rect.Top + 1);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point6) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point6;
					}
					Point point7 = new Point(box.rect.Right - 1, box.rect.Top + 1);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point7) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point7;
					}
					Point point8 = new Point(box.rect.Right - 1, box.rect.Bottom - 1);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point8) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point8;
					}
					Point point9 = new Point(box.rect.Left + 1, box.rect.Bottom - 1);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point9) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point9;
					}
				}
				else if (hit.Primitive is DataPoint)
				{
					DataPoint dataPoint = (DataPoint)hit.Primitive;
					Point point10 = new Point(dataPoint.point.X - dataPoint.hitTestRadius, dataPoint.point.Y - dataPoint.hitTestRadius);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point10) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point10;
					}
					Point point11 = new Point(dataPoint.point.X + dataPoint.hitTestRadius, dataPoint.point.Y - dataPoint.hitTestRadius);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point11) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point11;
					}
					Point point12 = new Point(dataPoint.point.X + dataPoint.hitTestRadius, dataPoint.point.Y + dataPoint.hitTestRadius);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point12) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point12;
					}
					Point point13 = new Point(dataPoint.point.X - dataPoint.hitTestRadius, dataPoint.point.Y + dataPoint.hitTestRadius);
					if (chartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(point13) == hit.Primitive)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = point13;
					}
					if (ChartCore.GetChartPrimitiveFromPoint(hit.ExclusivePoint) != dataPoint)
					{
						hit.ExclusivePoint = Point.Empty;
					}
				}
				else if (hit.Primitive is Wedge)
				{
					Wedge wedge = hit.Primitive as Wedge;
					if (!wedge.HitTest(hit.ExclusivePoint))
					{
						double radius = (double)(wedge.RadiusInner + wedge.Radius) / 2.0;
						double degree = (double)wedge.startAngle + (double)wedge.angleSweep / 2.0;
						Point point14 = Geometry.AngularToCartesian(wedge.Center, radius, Geometry.DegreeToRadian(degree));
						if (wedge.HitTest(point14))
						{
							hit.ExclusivePoint = point14;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (hit.ExclusivePoint == Point.Empty && hit.Center != Point.Empty)
			{
				hit.ExclusivePoint = hit.Center;
			}
		}

		private Point RoundCoordinates(PointF[] points, int index)
		{
			if (index > points.Length - 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Index out of PointF array.", "index");
			}
			Point result = new Point(0, 0);
			PointF pointF = points[index];
			PointF pointF2 = ((index != 0) ? points[index - 1] : points[points.Length - 1]);
			PointF pointF3 = ((index != points.Length - 1) ? points[index + 1] : points[0]);
			PointF pointF4 = new PointF((pointF2.X + pointF3.X) / 2f, (pointF2.Y + pointF3.Y) / 2f);
			if (pointF.X > pointF4.X)
			{
				result.X = (int)Math.Floor(pointF.X);
			}
			else
			{
				result.X = (int)Math.Ceiling(pointF.X);
			}
			if (pointF.Y > pointF4.Y)
			{
				result.Y = (int)Math.Floor(pointF.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				result.Y = (int)Math.Ceiling(pointF.Y);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ReverseHitTest CompositeHitTest(string layerId, string seriesKey, int indexOfDataPoint)
		{
			Point[] array = null;
			Primitive p = null;
			foreach (Primitive item in chartCore.SceneGraph)
			{
				if ((item.Caps & (PCaps.HitTest | PCaps.Skin)) > PCaps.None)
				{
					if (item.Path != null && item.Path.IndexOf("Legend") >= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (item.Layer != null && item.Layer.LayerID == layerId && item.Series != null && item.Series.Key == seriesKey && item.Series.GetPoints() != null && item.Series.GetPoints().IndexOf(item.DataPoint) == indexOfDataPoint)
					{
						p = item;
						if (item is Box)
						{
							array = ((Box)item).GetHull();
						}
						else if (item is Ellipse)
						{
							array = new Point[4]
							{
								((Ellipse)item).p1,
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X + ((Ellipse)item).p2.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y),
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X + ((Ellipse)item).p2.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y + ((Ellipse)item).p2.Y),
								new Point(((Ellipse)item).p1.X, ((Ellipse)item).p1.Y + ((Ellipse)item).p2.Y)
							};
						}
						else if (item is Wedge)
						{
							array = ((Wedge)item).GetHull();
						}
						else if (item is Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)
						{
							Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path path = (Infragistics.UltraChart.Core.Primitives.Path)item;
							if (path.GraphicsPath != null && path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints != null)
							{
								array = new Point[path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints.Length];
								for (int i = 0; i < path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints.Length; i++)
								{
									ref Point reference = ref array[i];
									reference = new Point((int)path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints[i].X, (int)path.GraphicsPath.PathPoints[i].Y);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (array != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item is PointSet)
				{
					DataPoint[] points = ((PointSet)item).points;
					for (int j = 0; j < points.Length; j++)
					{
						Primitive primitive2 = points[j];
						if (primitive2.Layer != null && primitive2.Layer.LayerID == layerId && primitive2.Series != null && primitive2.Series.Key == seriesKey && primitive2.Series.GetPoints() != null && primitive2.Series.GetPoints().IndexOf(primitive2.DataPoint) == indexOfDataPoint)
						{
							array = new Point[1] { points[j].point };
							p = points[j];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (item is Polyline)
				{
					DataPoint[] points2 = ((Polyline)item).points;
					for (int k = 0; k < points2.Length; k++)
					{
						Primitive primitive3 = points2[k];
						if (primitive3.Layer != null && primitive3.Layer.LayerID == layerId && primitive3.Series != null && primitive3.Series.Key == seriesKey && primitive3.Series.GetPoints() != null && primitive3.Series.GetPoints().IndexOf(primitive3.DataPoint) == indexOfDataPoint)
						{
							array = new Point[1] { points2[k].point };
							p = points2[k];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(item is Polygon))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Polygon polygon = (Polygon)item;
					if (polygon.DataPoints != null && polygon.DataPoints.Length > 0)
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < polygon.DataPoints.Length; l++)
						{
							Primitive primitive4 = polygon.DataPoints[l];
							if (primitive4.Layer != null && primitive4.Layer.LayerID == layerId && primitive4.Series != null && primitive4.Series.Key == seriesKey && primitive4.Series.GetPoints() != null && primitive4.Series.GetPoints().IndexOf(primitive4.DataPoint) == indexOfDataPoint)
							{
								array = new Point[1] { polygon.DataPoints[l].point };
								p = polygon.DataPoints[l];
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (polygon.Layer != null && polygon.Layer.LayerID == layerId && polygon.Series != null && polygon.Series.Key == seriesKey && polygon.Series.GetPoints() != null && polygon.Series.GetPoints().IndexOf(polygon.DataPoint) == indexOfDataPoint)
					{
						array = polygon.Points;
						p = polygon;
					}
				}
			}
			ReverseHitTest reverseHitTest = new ReverseHitTest(array, p);
			ResolveExclusivePoint(reverseHitTest);
			return reverseHitTest;
		}

		public virtual void SaveTo(Stream stream, RenderingType renderingType)
		{
			bool dirty = ChartCore.Dirty;
			ChartCore.Dirty |= renderingType != RenderingType;
			switch (renderingType)
			{
			case RenderingType.Flash:
				lock (renderCS)
				{
					renderCS.FlashContainer = new FlashContainer();
					renderCS.FlashContainer.CreateFile(null, this, base.Width, base.Height, null);
					renderCS.RenderChart(Scene, base.Width, base.Height);
					renderCS.FlashContainer.CloseFile(stream, this);
					renderCS.FlashContainer = null;
				}
				break;
			case RenderingType.Svg:
				lock (renderCS)
				{
					renderCS.SvgContainer = new SvgContainer();
					renderCS.SvgContainer.CreateFile(stream, null, this, base.Width, base.Height, null);
					renderCS.RenderChart(Scene, base.Width, base.Height);
					renderCS.SvgContainer.CloseFile(closeStream: false);
					renderCS.SvgContainer = null;
				}
				break;
			default:
				SaveTo(stream, ImageFormat.Bmp);
				break;
			}
			ChartCore.Dirty = dirty;
		}

		public virtual void SaveTo(Stream stream, ImageFormat format, Size imageSize, SizeF resolution)
		{
			SizeF resolution2 = new SizeF(renderCS.chartImage.HorizontalResolution, renderCS.chartImage.VerticalResolution);
			SuspendLayout();
			chartCore.SetSize(imageSize.Width, imageSize.Height);
			chartCore.DrawChart();
			renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, imageSize, resolution);
			renderCS.GetImage().Save(stream, format);
			chartCore.SetSize(base.Width, base.Height);
			renderCS.RenderChart(chartCore.SceneGraph, base.Size, resolution2);
			ResumeLayout();
		}

	public class ReverseHitTest
	{
		private Point[] _Hull;

		private Primitive _Primitive;

		private Point _Center;

		private Point _ExclusivePoint;

		public Point[] Hull
		{
			get
			{
				return _Hull;
			}
			set
			{
				_Hull = value;
				if (_Hull != null)
				{
					Point[] hull = _Hull;
					for (int i = 0; i < hull.Length; i++)
					{
						Point point = hull[i];
						_Center.X += point.X;
						_Center.Y += point.Y;
					}
					_Center.X /= _Hull.Length;
					_Center.Y /= _Hull.Length;
				}
			}
		}

		public Primitive Primitive
		{
			get
			{
				return _Primitive;
			}
			set
			{
				_Primitive = value;
			}
		}

		public Point Center
		{
			get
			{
				return _Center;
			}
			set
			{
				_Center = value;
			}
		}

		public Point ExclusivePoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _ExclusivePoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_ExclusivePoint = value;
			}
		}

		public ReverseHitTest(Point[] hull, Primitive p)
		{
			Primitive = p;
			Hull = hull;
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (target is ISupportPresetSerialization)
				{
					return ((ISupportPresetSerialization)target).FilterDocument;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

			set

				presetType = value;
			}
		}

		private string TagPrefix
		{
			get
			{
				if (target == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}

		public static void LoadPreset(object target, string filePath, bool reset)
		{
			PresetInfo presetInfo = null;
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("LE_PresetLoadTargetNull_Msg", "target");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = null;
			try
			{
				fileStream = File.OpenRead(filePath);
				presetInfo = PresetInfo.LoadFromXml(fileStream, target);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (fileStream != null)
				{
					Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
					if (presetInfo != null)
					{
						serializer.presetType = presetInfo.PresetType;
					}
					serializer.ReadLayoutFromXml(serializer.GetXmlReader(fileStream), reset);
					fileStream.Close();
					fileStream = null;
					serializer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void LoadPreset(object target, Stream xtw, bool reset)
		{
			if (target != null && xtw != null)
			{
				PresetInfo presetInfo = PresetInfo.LoadFromXml(xtw, target);
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				if (presetInfo != null)
				{
					serializer.presetType = presetInfo.PresetType;
				}
				serializer.ReadLayoutFromXml(serializer.GetXmlReader(xtw), reset);
				serializer = null;
			}
		}

		public static void LoadPreset(object target, TextReader reader, bool reset)
		{
			string text = reader.ReadToEnd();
			if (target != null && reader != null)
			{
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				PresetInfo presetInfo = PresetInfo.LoadFromXml(new StringReader(text), target);
				if (presetInfo != null)
				{
					serializer.presetType = presetInfo.PresetType;
				}
				serializer.ReadLayoutFromXml(serializer.GetXmlReader(text), reset);
				serializer = null;
			}
		}

		internal Serializer(object target)
		{
			this.target = target;
		}

		private string GetPresetHeader(string name, string desc, PresetType presetType)
		{
			return $"<PresetInfo {((name != null && name.Length > 0) ? $"PresetName=\"{name}\"" : string.Empty)} {((desc != null && desc.Length > 0) ? $"PresetDescription=\"{desc}\"" : string.Empty)} {$"PresetType=\"{Enum.GetName(typeof(PresetType), presetType)}\""} />";
		}

		private Type GetTypeFromPrefix(string prefix, string objectName)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (target is IComponent)
			{
				object[] customAttributes = target.GetType().Assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TagPrefixAttribute), inherit: true);
				object[] array = customAttributes;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					TagPrefixAttribute tagPrefixAttribute = (TagPrefixAttribute)array[i];
					if (tagPrefixAttribute.TagPrefix == prefix)
					{
						type = target.GetType().Assembly.GetType(tagPrefixAttribute.NamespaceName + "." + objectName);
					}
				}
				if (type == null)
				{
					AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = target.GetType().Assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
					Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
					AssemblyName[] array2 = referencedAssemblies;
					foreach (AssemblyName assemblyName in array2)
					{
						if (!IsSignedByInfragistics(assemblyName))
						{
							continue;
						}
						Assembly[] array3 = assemblies;
						foreach (Assembly assembly in array3)
						{
							if (!(assembly.FullName == assemblyName.FullName))
							{
								continue;
							}
							TagPrefixAttribute[] tagPrefixAttributes = GetTagPrefixAttributes(assembly);
							if (tagPrefixAttributes == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							TagPrefixAttribute[] array4 = tagPrefixAttributes;
							foreach (TagPrefixAttribute tagPrefixAttribute2 in array4)
							{
								if (tagPrefixAttribute2.TagPrefix == prefix)
								{
									type = assembly.GetType(tagPrefixAttribute2.NamespaceName + "." + objectName);
									break;
								}
							}
							if (type != null)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						if (type != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return type;
		}

		private TagPrefixAttribute[] GetTagPrefixAttributes(Assembly assembly)
		{
			if (assembly != null && assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TagPrefixAttribute), inherit: true) is TagPrefixAttribute[] array && array.Length > 0)
			{
				return array;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string[] GetAllAssemblyPrefixes(Assembly assembly)
		{
			string[] array = null;
			if (assembly != null)
			{
				Attribute[] array2 = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TagPrefixAttribute), inherit: true) as Attribute[];
				TagPrefixAttribute tagPrefixAttribute = null;
				if (array2 != null && array2.Length > 0)
				{
					array = new string[array2.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						tagPrefixAttribute = array2[i] as TagPrefixAttribute;
						array[i] = tagPrefixAttribute.TagPrefix;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private string GetTagPrefixForType(Type objectType)
		{
			string result = "";
			Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(objectType);
			if (assembly != null)
			{
				Attribute[] array = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TagPrefixAttribute), inherit: true) as Attribute[];
				TagPrefixAttribute tagPrefixAttribute = null;
				if (array != null && array.Length > 0)
				{
					if (array.Length > 1)
					{
						Attribute[] array2 = array;
						foreach (Attribute attribute in array2)
						{
							tagPrefixAttribute = attribute as TagPrefixAttribute;
							if (tagPrefixAttribute != null && tagPrefixAttribute.NamespaceName == objectType.Namespace)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						tagPrefixAttribute = array[0] as TagPrefixAttribute;
					}
					if (tagPrefixAttribute != null)
					{
						result = tagPrefixAttribute.TagPrefix;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetTargetNamespaceForType(Type objectType)
		{
			return objectType.Namespace;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

		{
			if (target != null && writer != null)
			{
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				XmlTextWriter xmlTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(writer);
				xmlTextWriter.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
				serializer.WriteLayoutToXml(xmlTextWriter, string.Empty, null, serializeAllValues: true);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public static void SaveAsXml(object target, PresetInfo presetInfo)

				try
				{
					xmlTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(presetInfo.FileInfo.FullName, Encoding.UTF8);
				}
				catch (Exception)

				}

					xmlTextWriter.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
					Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
					serializer.WriteLayoutToXml(xmlTextWriter, serializer.GetPresetHeader(presetInfo.Name, presetInfo.Description, presetInfo.PresetType));
					xmlTextWriter.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteLayoutToXml(XmlTextWriter xmlWriter, string commentNode)
		{
			WriteLayoutToXml(xmlWriter, commentNode, Exclusions);
		}

		private void WriteLayoutToXml(XmlTextWriter xmlWriter, string commentNode, XmlDocument filterDoc)
		{
			WriteLayoutToXml(xmlWriter, commentNode, filterDoc, serializeAllValues: false);
		}

		private void WriteLayoutToXml(XmlTextWriter xmlWriter, string commentNode, XmlDocument filterDoc, bool serializeAllValues)
		{
			string text = TagPrefix;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				text += ":";
			}
			if (xmlWriter != null)
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteStartDocument();
				xmlWriter.WriteComment(commentNode);
				xmlWriter.WriteStartElement(text + target.GetType().Name);
				XmlNode filterNode = filterDoc?.DocumentElement;
				WriteProperties(xmlWriter, target, filterNode, serializeAllValues);
				xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
				xmlWriter.WriteEndDocument();
			}
		}

		private void WriteInnerProperty(XmlTextWriter xmlWriter, PropertyDescriptor prop, object component, XmlNode filterNode, bool serializeAllValues)
		{
			xmlWriter.WriteStartElement(prop.Name);
			WriteProperties(xmlWriter, prop.GetValue(component), filterNode, serializeAllValues);
			xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void WriteProperties(XmlTextWriter xmlWriter, object component, XmlNode filterNode, bool serializeAllValues)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Queue queue = new Queue();
			if (component is ICollection collection)
			{
				object[] array = new object[collection.Count];
				collection.CopyTo(array, 0);
				foreach (object obj in array)
				{
					if (obj != null)
					{
						string text = GetTagPrefixForType(obj.GetType());
						if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
						{
							text += ":";
						}
						xmlWriter.WriteStartElement(text + obj.GetType().Name);
						WriteProperties(xmlWriter, obj, filterNode, serializeAllValues);
						xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (component is Image)
			{
				Image image = (Image)component;
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				image.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Png);
				byte[] array2 = memoryStream.ToArray();
				xmlWriter.WriteBase64(array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection filteredProperties = GetFilteredProperties(component, filterNode);
				if (filteredProperties != null)
				{
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in filteredProperties)
					{
						if (item == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						bool flag = false;
						if (item.Attributes[typeof(PersistenceModeAttribute)] is PersistenceModeAttribute persistenceModeAttribute)
						{
							flag = persistenceModeAttribute.Mode == PersistenceMode.InnerProperty;
						}
						if (item.SerializationVisibility == DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden || !item.ShouldSerializeValue(component))
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							XmlNode xmlNode = null;
							if (filterNode != null)
							{
								xmlNode = filterNode.SelectSingleNode("descendant::" + item.Name);
							}
							queue.Enqueue(new object[3] { item, component, xmlNode });
						}
						else if (item.SerializationVisibility == DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)
						{
							if (!item.ShouldSerializeValue(component) && !serializeAllValues)
							{
								continue;
							}
							foreach (PropertyDescriptor childProperty in item.GetChildProperties(item.GetValue(component)))
							{
								if (childProperty.SerializationVisibility == DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible && (childProperty.ShouldSerializeValue(item.GetValue(component)) || serializeAllValues) && childProperty.Converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
								{
									try
									{
										xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString(item.Name + "-" + childProperty.Name, childProperty.Converter.ConvertToInvariantString(childProperty.GetValue(item.GetValue(component))));
									}
									catch (NullReferenceException)
									{
									}
								}
							}
						}
						else if ((item.ShouldSerializeValue(component) || serializeAllValues) && item.Converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
						{
							xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString(item.Name, item.Converter.ConvertToInvariantString(item.GetValue(component)));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (queue != null && queue.Count > 0)
			{
				while (queue.Count > 0)
				{
					object[] array3 = queue.Dequeue() as object[];
					WriteInnerProperty(xmlWriter, array3[0] as PropertyDescriptor, array3[1], array3[2] as XmlNode, serializeAllValues);
				}
			}
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetFilteredProperties(object component, XmlNode filterNode)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = null;
			string[] array2 = null;
			string[] array3 = null;
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(properties);
			ArrayList arrayList2 = null;
			ArrayList arrayList3 = null;
			if (filterNode != null)
			{
				if (filterNode.Attributes != null && filterNode.Attributes.Count > 0)
				{
					XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = filterNode.Attributes["Exclusions"];
					if (xmlAttribute != null)
					{
						array = xmlAttribute.Value.Split(' ');
					}
					xmlAttribute = filterNode.Attributes["BehaviorProperties"];
					if (xmlAttribute != null)
					{
						array2 = xmlAttribute.Value.Split(' ');
					}
					xmlAttribute = filterNode.Attributes["AppearanceProperties"];
					if (xmlAttribute != null)
					{
						array3 = xmlAttribute.Value.Split(' ');
					}
				}
				if (array3 != null && array3.Length > 0 && array3[0] != "*")
				{
					arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
					for (int i = 0; i < array3.Length; i++)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties[array3[i]];
						if (propertyDescriptor != null)
						{
							arrayList2.Add(propertyDescriptor);
						}
					}
				}
				if (array2 != null && array2.Length > 0 && array2[0] != "*")
				{
					arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
					for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor value = properties[array2[j]];
						arrayList3.Add(value);
					}
				}
				switch (PresetType)
				{
				case PresetType.All:
					if (arrayList2 == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					arrayList = arrayList2;
					if (arrayList3 == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in arrayList3)
					{
						if (!arrayList.Contains(item))
						{
							arrayList.Add(item);
						}
					}
					break;
				case PresetType.Behavior:
					if (arrayList3 != null)
					{
						arrayList = arrayList3;
					}
					break;
				case PresetType.Appearance:
					if (arrayList2 != null)
					{
						arrayList = arrayList2;
					}
					if ((array3 == null || (array3.Length <= 1 && array3[0] == "*")) && arrayList3 != null && arrayList3.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < arrayList3.Count; k++)
						{
							arrayList.Remove(arrayList3[k]);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				if (array != null && array.Length > 0)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < array.Length; l++)
					{
						arrayList.Remove(properties[array[l]]);
					}
				}
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PropertyDescriptor)) as PropertyDescriptor[]);
			}
			return properties;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public static void LoadFromXml(object target, Stream stream, bool reset)
		{
			if (target != null && stream != null)
			{
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				XmlTextReader xmlReader = serializer.GetXmlReader(stream);
				if (xmlReader != null)
				{
					serializer.ReadLayoutFromXml(xmlReader, reset, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void LoadFromXml(object target, string XmlFragment, bool reset)
		{
			if (target != null && XmlFragment != null && XmlFragment.Length != 0)
			{
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				XmlTextReader xmlReader = serializer.GetXmlReader(XmlFragment);
				if (xmlReader != null)
				{
					serializer.ReadLayoutFromXml(xmlReader, reset, null);
					serializer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal XmlDocument GetDocumentFromStream(object stream)
		{
			XmlTextReader xmlReader = GetXmlReader(stream);
			return GetXmlDocument(xmlReader);
		}

		private XmlTextReader GetXmlReader(object stream)
		{
			XmlTextReader result = null;
			NameTable nameTable = new NameTable();
			XmlNamespaceManager xmlNamespaceManager = new XmlNamespaceManager(nameTable);
			string text = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(InfragisticsPublicKeyBytes);
			Type type = Target.GetType();
			while (type != null && type != typeof(object))
			{
				string[] allAssemblyPrefixes = GetAllAssemblyPrefixes(type.Assembly);
				if (allAssemblyPrefixes != null)
				{
					string[] array = allAssemblyPrefixes;
					foreach (string prefix in array)
					{
						xmlNamespaceManager.AddNamespace(prefix, "");
					}
				}
				type = type.BaseType;
			}
			AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = target.GetType().Assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
			Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			AssemblyName[] array2 = referencedAssemblies;
			foreach (AssemblyName assemblyName in array2)
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] publicKeyToken = assemblyName.GetPublicKeyToken();
					string text2 = string.Empty;
					if (publicKeyToken != null && publicKeyToken.Length > 0)
					{
						text2 = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(publicKeyToken);
					}
					if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0 && text != null && text.Length > 0 && !text.Equals(text2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Assembly[] array3 = assemblies;
					foreach (Assembly assembly in array3)
					{
						if (!(assembly.FullName == assemblyName.FullName))
						{
							continue;
						}
						Type[] exportedTypes = assembly.GetExportedTypes();
						if (exportedTypes != null && exportedTypes.Length > 0)
						{
							xmlNamespaceManager.AddNamespace(GetTagPrefixForType(exportedTypes[0]), "urn:" + GetTargetNamespaceForType(exportedTypes[0]));
						}
						string[] allAssemblyPrefixes2 = GetAllAssemblyPrefixes(assembly);
						if (allAssemblyPrefixes2 == null || allAssemblyPrefixes2.Length <= 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						for (int l = 0; l < allAssemblyPrefixes2.Length; l++)
						{
							string text3 = xmlNamespaceManager.LookupNamespace(allAssemblyPrefixes2[l]);
							if (text3 == null || text3.Length == 0)
							{
								xmlNamespaceManager.AddNamespace(allAssemblyPrefixes2[l], "urn:infragistics.com");
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			XmlParserContext context = new XmlParserContext(null, xmlNamespaceManager, null, XmlSpace.None);
			if (stream is string)
			{
				try
				{
					result = new XmlTextReader((string)stream, XmlNodeType.Element, context);
				}
				catch (XmlException)
				{
				}
			}
			else if (stream is FileStream)
			{
				result = new XmlTextReader((FileStream)stream, XmlNodeType.Element, context);
			}
			else if (stream is TextReader)
			{
				string xmlFragment = ((TextReader)stream).ReadToEnd();
				result = new XmlTextReader(xmlFragment, XmlNodeType.Element, context);
			}
			else if (stream is Stream)
			{
				result = new XmlTextReader((Stream)stream, XmlNodeType.Element, context);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private XmlDocument GetXmlDocument(XmlTextReader xmlReader)
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			try
			{
				xmlDocument.Load(xmlReader);
				return xmlDocument;
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void ReadLayoutFromXml(XmlTextReader xmlReader, bool reset)
		{
			ReadLayoutFromXml(xmlReader, reset, Exclusions);
		}

		private bool IsSignedByInfragistics(AssemblyName assembly)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			byte[] array = null;
			try
			{
				array = assembly.GetPublicKeyToken();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (array != null && array.Length > 0)
			{
				text = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(array);
			}
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				return text.Equals(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(InfragisticsPublicKeyBytes));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsSignedByInfragistics(Assembly assembly)
		{
			if (assembly != null)
			{
				return IsSignedByInfragistics(assembly.GetName());
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ReadLayoutFromXml(XmlTextReader xmlReader, bool reset, XmlDocument filterDoc)
		{
			string text = TagPrefix;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				text += ":";
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = GetXmlDocument(xmlReader);
			if (xmlDocument == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode = FindControlNode(xmlDocument.DocumentElement, text + target.GetType().Name);
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				Type type = target.GetType();
				while (type != null && type != typeof(object))
				{
					if (type.Namespace.StartsWith("Infragistics.WebUI") && IsSignedByInfragistics(type.Assembly))
					{
						xmlNode = FindControlNode(xmlDocument.DocumentElement, GetTagPrefixForType(type) + ":" + type.Name);
						if (xmlNode != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
			}
			XmlNode filterNode = null;
			if (filterDoc != null)
			{
				filterNode = filterDoc.DocumentElement;
			}
			ProcessXmlData(target, xmlNode, target, ignoreCase: false, reset, filterNode);
		}

		private XmlNode FindControlNode(XmlNode node, string componentName)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode = null;
			if (string.Compare(node.Name, componentName, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				return node;
			}
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				if (node.HasChildNodes)
				{
					foreach (XmlNode childNode in node.ChildNodes)
					{
						xmlNode = FindControlNode(childNode, componentName);
						if (xmlNode != null)
						{
							return xmlNode;
						}
					}
					return xmlNode;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanResetValue(PropertyDescriptor prop, object target)
		{
			if (prop != null)
			{
				if (!prop.CanResetValue(target))
				{
					if (prop.IsReadOnly)
					{
						return prop.ComponentType.GetMethod("Reset" + prop.Name, new Type[0]) != null;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessXmlData(object control, XmlNode node, object currentObj, bool ignoreCase, bool reset, XmlNode filterNode)
		{
			if (control == null || node == null || currentObj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = null;
			if (reset && filterNode != null)
			{
				propertyDescriptorCollection = GetFilteredProperties(currentObj, filterNode);
				if (propertyDescriptorCollection != null)
				{
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorCollection)
					{
						try
						{
							if (CanResetValue(item, currentObj))
							{
								item.ResetValue(currentObj);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
				}
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (currentObj is Array)
			{
				Array array = (Array)currentObj;
				{
					foreach (XmlNode childNode in node.ChildNodes)
					{
						if (childNode != null && childNode.Attributes != null && childNode.Attributes["Index"] != null && childNode.Attributes["Value"] != null)
						{
							int index = Convert.ToInt32(childNode.Attributes["Index"].Value);
							obj = childNode.Attributes["Value"].Value;
							TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(array.GetType().GetElementType());
							if (converter != null && converter.CanConvertFrom(typeof(string)))
							{
								obj = converter.ConvertFromInvariantString((string)obj);
							}
							array.SetValue(obj, index);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (currentObj is IList && currentObj is ICollection)
			{
				int num = 0;
				{
					foreach (XmlNode childNode2 in node.ChildNodes)
					{
						if (childNode2 != null)
						{
							object obj2 = null;
							if (((ICollection)currentObj).Count < num + 1)
							{
								string name = childNode2.Name;
								string[] array2 = new string[2] { TagPrefix, childNode2.LocalName };
								if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
								{
									array2 = name.Split(':');
								}
								Type typeFromPrefix = GetTypeFromPrefix(array2[0], array2[1]);
								if (typeFromPrefix != null)
								{
									ConstructorInfo constructor = typeFromPrefix.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes);
									if (constructor != null)
									{
										obj2 = constructor.Invoke(new object[0]);
									}
									if (obj2 != null)
									{
										MethodInfo method = currentObj.GetType().GetMethod("Add", new Type[1] { typeFromPrefix });
										if (method != null)
										{
											method.Invoke(currentObj, new object[1] { obj2 });
										}
										else
										{
											((IList)currentObj).Add(obj2);
										}
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								obj2 = ((IList)currentObj)[num];
							}
							ProcessXmlData(control, childNode2, obj2, ignoreCase: false, reset, (filterNode != null && filterNode.ChildNodes != null && filterNode.ChildNodes.Count > num) ? filterNode.ChildNodes[num] : null);
						}
						num++;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (XmlAttribute attribute in node.Attributes)
			{
				object component = currentObj;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = null;
				if (attribute.Name.IndexOf('-') > -1)
				{
					string[] array3 = attribute.Name.Split('-');
					if (array3 != null && array3.Length == 2)
					{
						propertyDescriptor2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(currentObj).Find(array3[0], ignoreCase);
						component = propertyDescriptor2.GetValue(currentObj);
						if (propertyDescriptor2 != null)
						{
							propertyDescriptor2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component).Find(array3[1], ignoreCase);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					propertyDescriptor2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component).Find(attribute.Name, ignoreCase);
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor2 == null || propertyDescriptor2.IsReadOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				obj = attribute.Value;
				if (!propertyDescriptor2.Converter.CanConvertFrom(typeof(string)) && !(propertyDescriptor2.PropertyType == typeof(object)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					obj = propertyDescriptor2.Converter.ConvertFromInvariantString((string)obj);
				}
				catch
				{
					if (!(propertyDescriptor2.PropertyType == typeof(int)))
					{
						throw;
					}
					obj = ParseInt((string)obj);
				}
				try
				{
					propertyDescriptor2.SetValue(component, obj);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			foreach (XmlNode childNode3 in node.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (!childNode3.HasChildNodes && childNode3.Attributes.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor3 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(currentObj).Find(childNode3.Name, ignoreCase);
				XmlNode xmlNode4 = null;
				if (filterNode != null && filterNode.ChildNodes != null && propertyDescriptor3 != null)
				{
					xmlNode4 = filterNode.SelectSingleNode("descendant::" + propertyDescriptor3.Name);
				}
				if (xmlNode4 == null && propertyDescriptor3 != null && propertyDescriptorCollection != null && propertyDescriptorCollection[propertyDescriptor3.Name] != null)
				{
					xmlNode4 = filterNode.OwnerDocument.CreateElement(propertyDescriptor3.Name);
					filterNode.AppendChild(xmlNode4);
					XmlAttribute xmlAttribute2 = xmlNode4.Attributes.Append(filterNode.OwnerDocument.CreateAttribute("AppearanceProperties"));
					xmlAttribute2.Value = "*";
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor3 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor3.PropertyType == typeof(Image))
				{
					using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(Convert.FromBase64String(childNode3.InnerText));
					propertyDescriptor3.SetValue(currentObj, new Bitmap(Image.FromStream(stream)));
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessXmlData(control, childNode3, propertyDescriptor3.GetValue(currentObj), ignoreCase, reset, xmlNode4);
				}
			}
		}

		private int ParseInt(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			char[] array = s.ToCharArray();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			char[] array2 = array;
			foreach (char c in array2)
			{
				if (char.IsDigit(c))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
			}
			return int.Parse(stringBuilder.ToString());
		}
	}
	public class PresetInfo
	{
		private FileInfo fileInfo;

		private string name = string.Empty;

		private string description = string.Empty;

		private PresetType presetType = PresetType.All;

		public FileInfo FileInfo => fileInfo;

		public string Description => description;

		public string Name => name;

		public PresetType PresetType => presetType;

		public PresetInfo(FileInfo fileInfo, string name, string description, PresetType presetType)
		{
			this.fileInfo = fileInfo;
			this.name = name;
			this.description = description;
			this.presetType = presetType;
		}

		public static PresetInfo LoadFromXml(Stream stream, object target)
		{
			return LoadFromXmlStreamOrReader(stream, target);
		}

		private static PresetInfo LoadFromXmlStreamOrReader(object reader, object target)
		{
			PresetInfo presetInfo = null;
			try
			{
				presetInfo = new PresetInfo(null, string.Empty, string.Empty, PresetType.All);
				Serializer serializer = new Serializer(target);
				XmlDocument documentFromStream = serializer.GetDocumentFromStream(reader);
				if (documentFromStream == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (reader is Stream stream)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				XmlNode xmlNode = documentFromStream.FirstChild;
				while (xmlNode != null && xmlNode.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Comment && xmlNode.NextSibling != null)
				{
					xmlNode = xmlNode.NextSibling;
				}
				if (xmlNode != null && xmlNode.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Comment)
				{
					XmlTextReader reader2 = new XmlTextReader(xmlNode.InnerText.Trim(), XmlNodeType.Element, null);
					XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
					xmlDocument.Load(reader2);
					XmlNode documentElement = xmlDocument.DocumentElement;
					if (documentElement != null && string.Compare(documentElement.Name, "PresetInfo", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
					{
						XmlAttribute xmlAttribute;
						if ((xmlAttribute = documentElement.Attributes["PresetType"]) != null && xmlAttribute.Value != null && xmlAttribute.Value.Length > 0)
						{
							presetInfo.presetType = (PresetType)Enum.Parse(typeof(PresetType), xmlAttribute.Value, ignoreCase: true);
						}
						if ((xmlAttribute = documentElement.Attributes["PresetDescription"]) != null && xmlAttribute.Value != null && xmlAttribute.Value.Length > 0)
						{
							presetInfo.description = xmlAttribute.Value;
						}
						if ((xmlAttribute = documentElement.Attributes["PresetName"]) != null && xmlAttribute.Value != null && xmlAttribute.Value.Length > 0)
						{
							presetInfo.name = xmlAttribute.Value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
			}
			return presetInfo;
		}

		public static PresetInfo LoadFromXml(TextReader stream, object target)
		{
			return LoadFromXmlStreamOrReader(stream, target);
		}

		public static PresetInfo LoadFromXml(FileInfo fileInfo, object target)
		{
			if (fileInfo == null || !fileInfo.Exists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PresetInfo presetInfo = null;
			Stream stream = null;
			try
			{
				stream = fileInfo.OpenRead();
				presetInfo = LoadFromXmlStreamOrReader(stream, target);
				if (presetInfo != null)
				{
					presetInfo.fileInfo = fileInfo;
					if (presetInfo.name == null || presetInfo.name.Length == 0)
					{
						presetInfo.name = fileInfo.Name;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (FileLoadException)
			{
				presetInfo = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				stream?.Close();
				stream = null;
			}
			return presetInfo;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum PresetType
	{
		Appearance = 1,
		Behavior = 2,
		All = -1
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart
{
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Assembly, AllowMultiple = true)]
	public sealed class TagPrefixAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private string _NamespaceName;

		private string _TagPrefix;

		public string NamespaceName => _NamespaceName;

		public string TagPrefix => _TagPrefix;

		public TagPrefixAttribute(string namespaceName, string tagPrefix)
		{
			if (namespaceName == null || namespaceName.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("namespaceName");
			}
			if (tagPrefix == null || tagPrefix.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("tagPrefix");
			}
			_NamespaceName = namespaceName;
			_TagPrefix = tagPrefix;
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All)]
	internal sealed class PersistenceModeAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private PersistenceMode _Mode;

		public PersistenceMode Mode => _Mode;

		public PersistenceModeAttribute(PersistenceMode mode)
		{
			_Mode = mode;
		}
	}
	internal enum PersistenceMode
	{
		Attribute,
		InnerProperty
	}
}

		private void About_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(licensedComponent.GetType()))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_0"));
			}
			UltraLicense license = licensedComponent.License;
			if (license == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_1"));
			}
			Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(licensedComponent.GetType());
			lblVersion.Text = assembly.GetName().Version.ToString();
			lblProductName.Text = license.ProductInfo.ProductName;
			lblComponentName.Text = license.ComponentName;
			Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogDialogTitle", license.ComponentName);
			SetProductInformationLiterals(license);
			SetupComments(license);
			InitializeLiterals();
			base.Opacity = 0.0;
			FadeIn();
		}

		private void InitializeLiterals()
		{
			cmdOK.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogOkCaption");
			labelExpirationHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogExpirationHeader");
			labelProductInformationHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogProductInformationHeader");
			labelProductKeyHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogProductKeyHeader");
			labelRegisteredToHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogRegisteredToHeader");
			labelStatusHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogStatusHeader");
			labelVersionHeader.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogVersionHeader");
			labelVisitUsAt.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogVisitUsAtHeader");
			lblSecondaryLink.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLink2Header");
			linkLabelSecondary.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLink2URLDisplayText");
			HideEmptyLabelControl(labelStatusHeader, lblStatus);
			HideEmptyLabelControl(labelVersionHeader, lblVersion);
			HideEmptyLabelControl(labelExpirationHeader, lblExpirationDate);
			HideEmptyLabelControl(labelProductKeyHeader, lblProductKey);
			HideEmptyLabelControl(labelRegisteredToHeader, lblUserName);
			HideEmptyLabelControl(lblSecondaryLink, linkLabelSecondary);
			lblCompanyName.Visible = lblUserName.Visible;
		}

		private void HideEmptyLabelControl(Label labelHeader, Label labelValue)
		{
			string text = labelHeader.Text;
			if (text == null || text.Trim().Length == 0)
			{
				labelHeader.Visible = false;
				labelValue.Visible = false;
			}
		}

		private void FadeIn()
		{
			fadeInTimer = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer();
			fadeInTimer.Tick += OnFadeInTimerTick;
			fadeInTimer.Interval = 100;
			fadeInTimer.Enabled = true;
		}

		private void OnFadeInTimerTick(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Opacity += 0.15;
			if (base.Opacity >= 1.0)
			{
				fadeInTimer.Enabled = false;
				fadeInTimer.Tick -= OnFadeInTimerTick;
				fadeInTimer.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void SetupComments(UltraLicense license)
		{
			switch (license.ProductInfo.Type)
			{
			case ProductType.WinFormsComponent:
				lblCommentsTitle.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsTitle");
				lblComment1Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsTitle1");
				lblComment1Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsBody1");
				lblComment2Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsTitle2");
				lblComment2Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsBody2");
				lblComment3Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsTitle3");
				lblComment3Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsBody3");
				lblCommentsSummary.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWinFormsCommentsSummary");
				break;
			case ProductType.WebFormsComponent:
				lblCommentsTitle.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsTitle");
				lblComment1Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsTitle1");
				lblComment1Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsBody1");
				lblComment2Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsTitle2");
				lblComment2Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsBody2");
				lblComment3Title.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsTitle3");
				lblComment3Text.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsBody3");
				lblCommentsSummary.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogWebFormsCommentsSummary");
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetProductInformationLiterals(UltraLicense license)
		{
			lblExpirationDate.Text = license.ProductInfo.Expiration;
			switch (license.ProductInfo.Status)
			{
			case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodExpired:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("LDR_About_GraceExpired");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodValid:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("LDR_About_InGrace");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.BetaExpired:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionBetaExpired");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.BetaValid:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionBeta");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.TrialExpired:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionTrialExpired");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.TrialValid:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionTrial");
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.CDKeyValid:
			case LicenseStatus.Licensed:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionLicensed");
				lblProductKey.Text = license.LicenseKey;
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.Unchecked:
			case LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound:
			case LicenseStatus.CDKeyInvalid:
				lblStatus.Text = SR.GetString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionUnknown");
				break;
			}
			if (license.ProductInfo.Key != null && license.ProductInfo.Key.Length != 0)
			{
				if (license.ProductInfo.Key.Length != 18)
				{
					string text = license.ProductInfo.Key;
					if (text == "{Trial}")
					{
						text = SR.GetString("TrialKey_AboutDialogLabel");
					}
					lblProductKey.Text = text;
				}
				else
				{
					lblProductKey.Text = license.ProductInfo.Key.Substring(0, 4) + "-" + license.ProductInfo.Key.Substring(4, 7) + "-" + license.ProductInfo.Key.Substring(11, 7);
				}
			}
			if (license.ProductInfo.UserName != null && license.ProductInfo.UserName.Length != 0)
			{
				lblUserName.Text = license.ProductInfo.UserName;
			}
			if (license.ProductInfo.CompanyName != null && license.ProductInfo.CompanyName.Length != 0)
			{
				lblCompanyName.Text = license.ProductInfo.CompanyName;
			}
		}

	[ComVisible(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
	public sealed class AboutDialogEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context.Instance is IUltraLicensedComponent licensedComponent)
			{
				AboutDialog aboutDialog = new AboutDialog(licensedComponent);
				aboutDialog.ShowDialog();
				aboutDialog.Dispose();
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class UltraLicense : License
	{
		private UltraProductInfoBase productInfo;

		private string key;

		private string componentName;

		public UltraProductInfoBase ProductInfo => productInfo;

		public string ComponentName => componentName;

		public override string LicenseKey
		{
			get
			{
				if (key != null)
				{
					return key;
				}
				return productInfo.Key;
			}
		}

		internal UltraLicense(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo)
		{
			this.productInfo = productInfo;
			this.componentName = componentName;
		}

		internal UltraLicense(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo, string key)
		{
			this.productInfo = productInfo;
			this.key = key;
			this.componentName = componentName;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class DisposableObject : MarshalByRefObject, IDisposable
	{
		private const string publicKeyTokenLiteral = "PublicKeyToken";

		private bool disposed;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool Disposed => disposed;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static bool HasSamePublicKey(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string publicKeyToken = GetPublicKeyToken(type);
			string publicKeyToken2 = GetPublicKeyToken(typeof(DisposableObject));
			return publicKeyToken.Equals(publicKeyToken2);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static string GetPublicKeyToken(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_2"));
			}
			Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(type);
			return GetPublicKeyToken(assembly);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static string GetPublicKeyToken(Assembly assemblyToCheck)
		{
			if (assemblyToCheck == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_3"));
			}
			string[] array = assemblyToCheck.FullName.Split('=');
			for (int num = array.Length - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				if (array[num - 1].Length >= "PublicKeyToken".Length)
				{
					string text = array[num - 1].Substring(array[num - 1].Length - "PublicKeyToken".Length);
					if (text.Equals("PublicKeyToken"))
					{
						if (array[num].Length < 17)
						{
							return array[num];
						}
						return array[num].Substring(0, 16);
					}
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static object CloneSerializableObject(ISerializable source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter();
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			binaryFormatter.Serialize(memoryStream, source);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			object result = binaryFormatter.Deserialize(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Close();
			return result;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				disposed = true;
				OnDispose();
			}
		}

		public void VerifyNotDisposed()
		{
			if (Disposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().ToString());
			}
		}

		protected abstract void OnDispose();

		public static object ConvertValue(object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value == null || destinationType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type == destinationType)
			{
				return value;
			}
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(destinationType);
			if (!converter.CanConvertFrom(type))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return converter.ConvertFrom(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, value);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class UltraLicenseProvider : LicenseProvider
	{
		private static bool hasDisplayedRuntimeDemoMsg;

		public override License GetLicense(LicenseContext context, Type type, object instance, bool allowExceptions)
		{
			UltraLicense ultraLicense = null;
			if (context != null)
			{
				UltraLicenseBaseAttribute licenseAttribute = GetLicenseAttribute(type, instance, allowExceptions);
				if (licenseAttribute != null)
				{
					if (context.UsageMode == LicenseUsageMode.Runtime)
					{
						string key;
						try
						{
							key = context.GetSavedLicenseKey(type, null);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							key = null;
						}
						ultraLicense = GetRunTimeLicense(key, type, instance, allowExceptions, licenseAttribute);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraLicense = GetDesignTimeLicense(type, instance, allowExceptions, licenseAttribute);
						if (ultraLicense != null)
						{
							context.SetSavedLicenseKey(type, ultraLicense.LicenseKey);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraLicense;
		}

		private UltraLicenseBaseAttribute GetLicenseAttribute(Type type, object instance, bool allowExceptions)
		{
			if (!DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(type))
			{
				if (allowExceptions)
				{
					throw new LicenseException(type, instance, "Public key not Infragistics");
				}
				return null;
			}
			UltraLicenseBaseAttribute ultraLicenseBaseAttribute = null;
			object[] customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < customAttributes.Length; i++)
				{
					ultraLicenseBaseAttribute = customAttributes[i] as UltraLicenseBaseAttribute;
					if (ultraLicenseBaseAttribute != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraLicenseBaseAttribute == null && allowExceptions)
			{
				throw new LicenseException(type, instance, "License attribute not found");
			}
			return ultraLicenseBaseAttribute;
		}

		private UltraLicense GetDesignTimeLicense(Type type, object instance, bool allowExceptions, UltraLicenseBaseAttribute licenseAttribute)
		{
			UltraProductInfoBase[] allProducts = licenseAttribute.AllProducts;
			if (allProducts == null || allProducts.Length < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraProductInfoBase ultraProductInfoBase = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < allProducts.Length; i++)
			{
				if (ultraProductInfoBase == null || ultraProductInfoBase.Status < allProducts[i].Status)
				{
					ultraProductInfoBase = allProducts[i];
				}
				if (ultraProductInfoBase.Status == LicenseStatus.Licensed)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ultraProductInfoBase == null)
			{
				if (allowExceptions)
				{
					throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionUnlicensed"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ultraProductInfoBase.Status)
				{
				case LicenseStatus.BetaValid:
				case LicenseStatus.TrialValid:
				case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodValid:
				case LicenseStatus.Licensed:
					if (ultraProductInfoBase is UltraProductInfo ultraProductInfo && allowExceptions)
					{
						ultraProductInfo.DisplayPrompt();
					}
					return new UltraLicense(licenseAttribute.ComponentName, ultraProductInfoBase);
				case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodExpired:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionGracePeriodExpired", ultraProductInfoBase.ProductName, ultraProductInfoBase.Expiration));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.BetaExpired:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionBetaExpired", ultraProductInfoBase.ProductName, ultraProductInfoBase.Expiration));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.TrialExpired:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionTrialExpired", ultraProductInfoBase.ProductName, ultraProductInfoBase.Expiration));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.CDKeyValid:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionIncomplete"));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.CDKeyInvalid:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionInvalidCDKey"));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionInformationNotFound"));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.InsufficientSecurityPermissions:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionSecurityPermission"));
					}
					break;
				case LicenseStatus.UnableToLocateLicenseAssembly:
					if (allowExceptions)
					{
						throw new LicenseException(type, instance, "Unable to locate license assembly.");
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private UltraLicense GetRunTimeLicense(string key, Type type, object instance, bool allowExceptions, UltraLicenseBaseAttribute licenseAttribute)
		{
			UltraProductInfoBase[] licensedWithProducts = licenseAttribute.LicensedWithProducts;
			if (licensedWithProducts == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (key == null)
			{
				return new UltraLicense(licenseAttribute.ComponentName, licensedWithProducts[0], string.Empty);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < licensedWithProducts.Length; i++)
			{
				if (licensedWithProducts[i].Type == ProductType.WebFormsComponent)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < licensedWithProducts.Length; j++)
			{
				if (!licensedWithProducts[j].IsKeyValid(key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!hasDisplayedRuntimeDemoMsg && !flag && allowExceptions && key == "{Trial}")
				{
					try
					{
						hasDisplayedRuntimeDemoMsg = true;
						string text = SR.GetString("LicenseExceptionUnlicensedProgram", licensedWithProducts[j].ProductName);
						string caption = SR.GetString("LicensedProductPromptDialogTitle", licensedWithProducts[j].ProductName);
						MessageBox.Show(text, caption, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				return new UltraLicense(licenseAttribute.ComponentName, licensedWithProducts[j], key);
			}
			if (allowExceptions)
			{
				throw new LicenseException(type, instance, "Invalid license key");
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public enum LicenseStatus
	{
		Unchecked,
		UnableToLocateLicenseAssembly,
		InsufficientSecurityPermissions,
		RegKeyNotFound,
		CDKeyInvalid,
		BetaExpired,
		BetaValid,
		TrialExpired,
		ActivationGracePeriodExpired,
		CDKeyValid,
		TrialValid,
		ActivationGracePeriodValid,
		Licensed
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public enum ProductType
	{
		WinFormsComponent,
		WebFormsComponent
	}

			: base(productName, productType)
